theorem not_isField_of_isSquare_discr [NeZero (2 : K)] {a b : K}
    (h : IsSquare (discr a b)) : ¬ IsField (QuadraticAlgebra K a b)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible (2 : K) := invertibleOfNonzero two_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_sq_eq_iff_isSquare_discr.mpr h
  intro hfield
  let := hfield.toField
  have : (⟨r, -1⟩ : QuadraticAlgebra K a b) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra K a b) := by
    simp [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero, QuadraticAlgebra.ext_iff]
  rw [← norm_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff, show norm ⟨r, -1⟩ = 0 by rw [norm_def]; grind] at this
  exact zero_notMem_nonZeroDivisors this

name: isField_iff_not_isSquare_discr
statement:
theorem isField_iff_not_isSquare_discr [NeZero (2 : K)] {a b : K} :
    IsField (QuadraticAlgebra K a b) ↔ ¬ IsSquare (discr a b)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible (2 : K) := invertibleOfNonzero two_ne_zero
  refine ⟨fun hfield h ↦ not_isField_of_isSquare_discr h hfield, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have : Fact (¬ IsSquare (discr a b)) := ⟨h⟩
  exact Field.toIsField (QuadraticAlgebra K a b)

statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_norm_isUnit {x : QuadraticAlgebra R a b} :
    IsUnit x ↔ IsUnit (x.norm)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact IsUnit.map norm
  · simp only [isUnit_iff_exists]
    rintro ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩
    rw [← C_inj (R := R) (a := a) (b := b), C_mul, C_eq_algebraMap, algebraMap_norm_eq_mul_star,
      mul_assoc, map_one] at hr
    refine ⟨_, hr, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm, hr]

name: algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff {r : R} :
    algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) r ∈ (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)⁰ ↔ r ∈ R⁰
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
  constructor
  · intro H x hxr
    rw [← algebraMap_inj, map_zero]
    apply H
    rw [← map_mul, hxr, map_zero]
  · intro h z hz
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.ext_iff, re_zero, im_zero] at hz
    simp only [re_mul, algebraMap_re, algebraMap_im, mul_zero, add_zero, im_mul, zero_add] at hz
    simp [QuadraticAlgebra.ext_iff, re_zero, im_zero, h _ hz.left, h _ hz.right]

name: star_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right] at hz ⊢
  intro w hw
  apply star_involutive.injective
  rw [star_zero]
  apply hz
  rw [← star_involutive z, ← star_mul, mul_comm, hw, star_zero]

name: star_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff
statement:

    star z ∈ (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)⁰ ↔ z ∈ (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)⁰
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, star_mem_nonZeroDivisors⟩
  rw [← star_involutive z]
  exact star_mem_nonZeroDivisors h

name: norm_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff
statement:
theorem norm_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff {z : QuadraticAlgebra R a b} :
    z.norm ∈ R⁰ ↔ z ∈ (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)⁰
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
    intro h w hw
    have : norm z • w = 0 := by
      rw [← C_mul_eq_smul, C_eq_algebraMap, algebraMap_norm_eq_mul_star, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, hw,
        zero_mul]
    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.ext_iff, re_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, re_zero, im_smul,
      im_zero] at this
    ext <;> simp [h _ this.left, h _ this.right]
  · intro hz
    rw [← algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff, algebraMap_norm_eq_mul_star]
    exact Submonoid.mul_mem _ hz (star_mem_nonZeroDivisors hz)

name: changeGenerator_relation
statement:
private theorem changeGenerator_relation (a b u k : R) :
    (u • ω + algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) k) *
        (u • ω + algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) k) =
      (u ^ 2 * a - u * b * k - k ^ 2) • 1 +
        (u * b + 2 * k) • (u • ω + algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) k)

name: changeGenerator_omega
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeGenerator_omega (a b u k : R) {a' b' : R} (ha : a' = u ^ 2 * a - u * b * k - k ^ 2)

    changeGenerator a b u k ha hb ω = u • ω + algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) k

name: changeGenerator_injective
statement:
theorem changeGenerator_injective (a b u k : R) {a' b' : R}
    (ha : a' = u ^ 2 * a - u * b * k - k ^ 2)
    (hb : b' = u * b + 2 * k) (hu : IsRegular u) :
    Function.Injective (changeGenerator a b u k ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  have hy : z.im = w.im := hu.right <| by simpa using congr_arg im h
  exact QuadraticAlgebra.ext (by simpa [hy] using congr_arg re h) hy

name: norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero {z : QuadraticAlgebra K a b} :
    norm z = 0 ↔ z = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [norm_def] at hz
    by_cases h : z.im = 0
    · simp [h] at hz
      aesop
    · exfalso
      rw [← pow_two, sub_eq_zero, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hz
      apply Hab.out (-z.re / z.im)
      grind
  · intro hz
    simp [hz]

  rw [add_nsmul, add_assoc, hab, add_nsmul, add_assoc, ← hbc, add_left_comm]

statement:

protected theorem add_iff_left (h : a ≡ b [PMOD p]) :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hadd ↦ ?_, h.add⟩

  rcases hadd with ⟨m, n, hadd⟩

  apply add_right_cancel (b := a)
  rw [add_assoc, add_comm c, add_nsmul, add_right_comm, hadd, ← add_assoc, add_right_comm _ b,
    add_right_comm _ b, add_assoc, ← h, add_add_add_comm, add_nsmul, ← add_assoc]

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, n, h⟩

    rw [sub_zsmul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, add_comm b]
    exact mod_cast h
  · rintro ⟨m, h⟩
    use m.toNat, (-m).toNat
    rwa [add_comm _ b, ← sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, ← natCast_zsmul, ← natCast_zsmul,

name: modEq_nsmul_cases
statement:
theorem modEq_nsmul_cases (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    a ≡ b [PMOD p] ↔ ∃ i < n, a ≡ b + i • p [PMOD (n • p)]
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← sub_modEq_iff_modEq_add, modEq_comm (b := b)]
  simp_rw [modEq_iff_zsmul', sub_right_comm, sub_eq_iff_eq_add (b := _ • _), ← natCast_zsmul,
    ← mul_zsmul, ← add_zsmul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨(k % n).toNat, ?_⟩
    rw [← Int.ofNat_lt, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ (mod_cast hn))]
    refine ⟨?_, k / n, ?_⟩
    · refine Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ ?_
      lia
    · rw [hk, Int.ediv_mul_add_emod]
  · rintro ⟨k, _, j, hj⟩
    rw [hj]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: npowRec_add
statement: @[to_additive] theorem npowRec_add : npowRec (m + n) a = npowRec m a * npowRec n a
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | n := n; · exact (hn rfl).elim
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [npowRec, ha]
  | succ n ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, npowRec, ih n.succ_ne_zero]; simp only [npowRec, mul_assoc]

proof:
:= by

name: npowRec'_succ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem npowRec'_succ {M : Type*} [Mul M] [One M] {k : ℕ} (_ : k ≠ 0) (m : M) :
    npowRec' (k + 1) m = npowRec' k m * m

name: npowRec'_two_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem npowRec'_two_mul {M : Type*} [Semigroup M] [One M] (k : ℕ) (m : M) :
    npowRec' (2 * k) m = npowRec' k (m * m)
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind k' ih =>
    match k' with
    | 0 => rfl
    | 1 => simp [npowRec']
    | k + 2 =>
      simp [npowRec', ← mul_assoc, ← ih, Nat.mul_succ]

name: npowRec'_mul_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem npowRec'_mul_comm {M : Type*} [Semigroup M] [One M] {k : ℕ} (k0 : k ≠ 0) (m : M) :
    m * npowRec' k m = npowRec' k m * m
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind k' ih =>
    match k' with
    | 1 => simp [npowRec']
    | k + 2 => simp [npowRec', ← mul_assoc, ih]

name: npowRec_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem npowRec_eq {M : Type*} [Semigroup M] [One M] (k : ℕ) (m : M) :
    npowRec (k + 1) m = 1 * npowRec' (k + 1) m
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind k' ih =>
    match k' with
    | 0 => rfl
    | k + 1 =>
      rw [npowRec, npowRec'_succ k.succ_ne_zero, ← mul_assoc]
      congr
      simp [ih]

name: npowBinRec.go_spec
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem npowBinRec.go_spec {M : Type*} [Semigroup M] [One M] (k : ℕ) (m n : M) :
    npowBinRec.go (k + 1) m n = m * npowRec' (k + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold go
  generalize hk : k + 1 = k'
  replace hk : k' ≠ 0 := by lia
  induction k' using Nat.binaryRecFromOne generalizing n m with
  | zero => simp at hk
  | one => simp [npowRec']
  | bit b k' k'0 ih =>
    rw [Nat.binaryRec_eq _ _ (Or.inl rfl), ih _ _ k'0]
    cases b <;> simp only [Nat.bit, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, npowRec'_two_mul]
    rw [npowRec'_succ (by lia), npowRec'_two_mul, ← npowRec'_two_mul,
      ← npowRec'_mul_comm (by lia), mul_assoc]

name: npowRec_eq_npowBinRec
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := csimp)]
theorem npowRec_eq_npowBinRec : @npowRecAuto = @npowBinRecAuto
proof:
:= by
  funext M _ _ k m
  rw [npowBinRecAuto, npowRecAuto, npowBinRec]
  match k with
  | 0 => rw [npowRec, npowBinRec.go, Nat.binaryRec_zero]
  | k + 1 => rw [npowBinRec.go_spec, npowRec_eq]

name: npowBinRec_zero

name: npowBinRec_succ

@[to_additive] theorem npowBinRec_succ {M : Type*} [Semigroup M] [One M] (n : ℕ) (m : M) :
    npowBinRec (n + 1) m = npowBinRec n m * m
proof:
:= by
  iterate 2 rw [← npowBinRecAuto, ← npowRec_eq_npowBinRec]
  rfl

proof:
:= by
  refine (mulIndicator_congr fun x hx => ?_).trans mulIndicator_mulSupport
  have : g x = 1 := notMem_mulSupport.1 (disjoint_left.1 h hx)
  rw [Pi.mul_apply, this, mul_one]

proof:
:= by

  · rw [piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ h, Pi.mul_apply, Set.mulIndicator_of_notMem h,
      Set.mulIndicator_of_mem (Set.mem_compl h), one_mul]

name: mulSupport_subset_subsingleton_of_disjoint_on_mulSupport
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mulSupport_subset_subsingleton_of_disjoint_on_mulSupport [One β] {s : γ → Set α} (f : α → β)
  (hs : Pairwise (Disjoint on (fun j ↦ s j ∩ f.mulSupport))) (i : α) (j : γ) (hj : i ∈ s j) :
    (fun d ↦ (s d).mulIndicator f i).mulSupport ⊆ {j}
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ j', j' ≠ j → {i} ⊆ s j → {i} ⊆ s j' → {i} ⊆ mulSupport f → False by by_contra; aesop
  intro j' h hj hj' hi
  simp only [Pairwise, Disjoint, Set.subset_inter_iff] at hs
  simpa using hs h ⟨hj', hi⟩ ⟨hj, hi⟩

name: exists_type_univ_nonempty_mulEquiv.
statement:
lemma exists_type_univ_nonempty_mulEquiv.{u, v} (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] :
    ∃ (G' : Type v) (_ : Group G') (_ : Fintype G'), Nonempty (G ≃* G')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin G
  let f : Fin n ≃ ULift (Fin n) := Equiv.ulift.symm
  let e : G ≃ ULift (Fin n) := e.trans f
  let groupH : Group (ULift (Fin n)) := e.symm.group
  exact ⟨ULift (Fin n), groupH, inferInstance, ⟨MulEquiv.symm <| e.symm.mulEquiv⟩⟩

name: exists_mrange_eq_mgraph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `f : G → H × I` be a homomorphism to a product of monoids. Assume that `f` is surjective on the
first factor and that the image of `f` intersects every "vertical line" `{(h, i) | i : I}` at most
once. Then the image of `f` is the graph of some monoid homomorphism `f' : H → I`. -/]
lemma exists_mrange_eq_mgraph {f : G →* H × I} (hf₁ : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ f))
    (hf : ∀ g₁ g₂, (f g₁).1 = (f g₂).1 → (f g₁).2 = (f g₂).2) :
    ∃ f' : H →* I, mrange f = f'.mgraph
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f', hf'⟩ := exists_range_eq_graphOn_univ hf₁ hf
  simp only [Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_range, mem_graphOn, mem_univ, true_and, Prod.forall] at hf'
  use
  { toFun := f'
    map_one' := (hf' _ _).1 ⟨1, map_one _⟩
    map_mul' := by
      simp_rw [hf₁.forall]
      rintro g₁ g₂
      exact (hf' _ _).1 ⟨g₁ * g₂, by simp [Prod.ext_iff, (hf' (f _).1 _).1 ⟨_, rfl⟩]⟩ }
  simpa [SetLike.ext_iff] using hf'

name: exists_mulEquiv_mrange_eq_mgraph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `f : G → H × I` be a homomorphism to a product of monoids. Assume that `f` is surjective on both
factors and that the image of `f` intersects every "vertical line" `{(h, i) | i : I}` and every
"horizontal line" `{(h, i) | h : H}` at most once. Then the image of `f` is the graph of some
monoid isomorphism `f' : H ≃ I`. -/]
lemma exists_mulEquiv_mrange_eq_mgraph {f : G →* H × I} (hf₁ : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ f))
    (hf₂ : Surjective (Prod.snd ∘ f)) (hf : ∀ g₁ g₂, (f g₁).1 = (f g₂).1 ↔ (f g₁).2 = (f g₂).2) :
    ∃ e : H ≃* I, mrange f = e.toMonoidHom.mgraph
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := f.exists_mrange_eq_mgraph hf₁ fun _ _ ↦ (hf _ _).1
  obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := (MulEquiv.prodComm.toMonoidHom.comp f).exists_mrange_eq_mgraph (by simpa) <|
    by simp [hf]
  have he₁₂ h i : e₁ h = i ↔ e₂ i = h := by
    rw [SetLike.ext_iff] at he₁ he₂
    aesop (add simp [Prod.swap_eq_iff_eq_swap])
  exact ⟨
  { toFun := e₁
    map_mul' := e₁.map_mul'
    invFun := e₂
    left_inv := fun h ↦ by rw [← he₁₂]
    right_inv := fun i ↦ by rw [he₁₂] }, he₁⟩

name: Submonoid.exists_eq_mgraph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `G ≤ H × I` be a submonoid of a product of monoids. Assume that `G` surjects onto the first
factor and `G` intersects every "vertical line" `{(h, i) | i : I}` at most once. Then `G` is the
graph of some monoid homomorphism `f : H → I`. -/]
lemma Submonoid.exists_eq_mgraph {G : Submonoid (H × I)} (hG₁ : Bijective (Prod.fst ∘ G.subtype)) :
    ∃ f : H →* I, G = f.mgraph
proof:
:= by
  simpa using MonoidHom.exists_mrange_eq_mgraph hG₁.surjective
    fun a b h ↦ congr_arg (Prod.snd ∘ G.subtype) (hG₁.injective h)

name: Submonoid.exists_mulEquiv_eq_mgraph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `G ≤ H × I` be a submonoid of a product of additive monoids. Assume that the natural maps from
`G` to both factors are bijective. Then `G` is the graph of some isomorphism `f : H ≃+ I`. -/]
lemma Submonoid.exists_mulEquiv_eq_mgraph {G : Submonoid (H × I)}
    (hG₁ : Bijective (Prod.fst ∘ G.subtype)) (hG₂ : Bijective (Prod.snd ∘ G.subtype)) :
    ∃ e : H ≃* I, G = e.toMonoidHom.mgraph
proof:
:= by
  simpa using MonoidHom.exists_mulEquiv_mrange_eq_mgraph hG₁.surjective hG₂.surjective
    fun _ _ ↦ hG₁.injective.eq_iff.trans hG₂.injective.eq_iff.symm

name: exists_range_eq_graph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `f : G → H × I` be a homomorphism to a product of groups. Assume that `f` is surjective on the
first factor and that the image of `f` intersects every "vertical line" `{(h, i) | i : I}` at most
once. Then the image of `f` is the graph of some group homomorphism `f' : H → I`. -/]
lemma exists_range_eq_graph {f : G →* H × I} (hf₁ : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ f))
    (hf : ∀ g₁ g₂, (f g₁).1 = (f g₂).1 → (f g₁).2 = (f g₂).2) :
    ∃ f' : H →* I, range f = f'.graph
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SetLike.ext_iff] using! exists_mrange_eq_mgraph hf₁ hf

name: exists_mulEquiv_range_eq_graph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `f : G → H × I` be a homomorphism to a product of groups. Assume that `f` is surjective on both
factors and that the image of `f` intersects every "vertical line" `{(h, i) | i : I}` and every
"horizontal line" `{(h, i) | h : H}` at most once. Then the image of `f` is the graph of some
group isomorphism `f' : H ≃ I`. -/]
lemma exists_mulEquiv_range_eq_graph {f : G →* H × I} (hf₁ : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ f))
    (hf₂ : Surjective (Prod.snd ∘ f)) (hf : ∀ g₁ g₂, (f g₁).1 = (f g₂).1 ↔ (f g₁).2 = (f g₂).2) :
    ∃ e : H ≃* I, range f = e.toMonoidHom.graph
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SetLike.ext_iff] using! exists_mulEquiv_mrange_eq_mgraph hf₁ hf₂ hf

name: Subgroup.exists_eq_graph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `G ≤ H × I` be a submonoid of a product of monoids. Assume that `G` surjects onto the first
factor and `G` intersects every "vertical line" `{(h, i) | i : I}` at most once. Then `G` is the
graph of some monoid homomorphism `f : H → I`. -/]
lemma Subgroup.exists_eq_graph {G : Subgroup (H × I)} (hG₁ : Bijective (Prod.fst ∘ G.subtype)) :

name: Subgroup.exists_mulEquiv_eq_graph
statement:
@[to_additive /

Let `G ≤ H × I` be a submonoid of a product of additive monoids. Assume that the natural maps from
`G` to both factors are bijective. Then `G` is the graph of some isomorphism `f : H ≃+ I`. -/]
lemma Subgroup.exists_mulEquiv_eq_graph {G : Subgroup (H × I)}

    ∃ e : H ≃* I, G = e.toMonoidHom.graph
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SetLike.ext_iff] using! Submonoid.exists_mulEquiv_eq_mgraph hG₁ hG₂

  · obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hf a

  all_goals

  exact ⟨fun a ↦ by simpa using h1 (update x i a) i,
    fun b c ↦ by simpa using h2 (update x i b) (update x i c) i,
    fun a b ↦ by simpa using h3 (update x i a) (update x i b) i⟩

name: _root_.Semigroup.mem_center_iff

    z ∈ Set.center M ↔ ∀ g, g * z = z * g
proof:
:= ⟨fun a g ↦ by rw [IsMulCentral.comm a g],
  fun h ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ (h _).symm, fun _ _ ↦ (mul_assoc z _ _).symm, fun _ _ ↦ mul_assoc _ _ z⟩ ⟩

    fun h _ _ _ hm ↦ (h hm).comm _⟩

name: pow_mul_pow_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma pow_mul_pow_eq_one : ∀ n, a * b = 1 → a ^ n * b ^ n = 1
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, h =>
    calc
      a ^ n.succ * b ^ n.succ = a ^ n * a * (b * b ^ n)
proof:
:= by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ']
      _ = a ^ n * (a * b) * b ^ n := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by simp [h, pow_mul_pow_eq_one]

name: zpow_induction_left
statement:
@[to_additive /
addition by `g` and `-g` on the left. For additive subgroups generated by more than one element, see
`AddSubgroup.closure_induction_left`. -/]
lemma zpow_induction_left {g : G} {P : G → Prop} (h_one : P (1 : G))
    (h_mul : ∀ a, P a → P (g * a)) (h_inv : ∀ a, P a → P (g⁻¹ * a)) (n : ℤ) : P (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rwa [zpow_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Int.add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one]
    exact h_mul _ ih
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [Int.sub_eq_add_neg, Int.add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_neg_one]
    exact h_inv _ ih

name: zpow_induction_right
statement:
@[to_additive /
addition by `g` and `-g` on the right. For additive subgroups generated by more than one element,
see `AddSubgroup.closure_induction_right`. -/]
lemma zpow_induction_right {g : G} {P : G → Prop} (h_one : P (1 : G))
    (h_mul : ∀ a, P a → P (a * g)) (h_inv : ∀ a, P a → P (a * g⁻¹)) (n : ℤ) : P (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rwa [zpow_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [zpow_add_one]
    exact h_mul _ ih
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [zpow_sub_one]
    exact h_inv _ ih

name: multiplicative_of_symm_of_total
statement:
@[to_additive additive_of_symm_of_total]
lemma multiplicative_of_symm_of_total [Std.Symm p]
    (hf_swap : ∀ {a b}, p a b → f a b * f b a = 1)
    (hmul : ∀ {a b c}, r a b → r b c → p a b → p b c → p a c → f a c = f a b * f b c)
    {a b c : α} (pab : p a b) (pbc : p b c) (pac : p a c) : f a c = f a b * f b c
proof:
:= by
  have hmul' : ∀ {b c}, r b c → p a b → p b c → p a c → f a c = f a b * f b c := by
    intro b c rbc pab pbc pac
    obtain rab | rba := total_of r a b
    · exact hmul rab rbc pab pbc pac
    rw [← one_mul (f a c), ← hf_swap pab, mul_assoc]
    obtain rac | rca := total_of r a c
    · rw [hmul rba rac (symm pab) pac pbc]
    · rw [hmul rbc rca pbc (symm pac) (symm pab), mul_assoc, hf_swap (symm pac), mul_one]
  obtain rbc | rcb := total_of r b c
  · exact hmul' rbc pab pbc pac
  · rw [hmul' rcb pac (symm pbc) pab, mul_assoc, hf_swap (symm pbc), mul_one]

name: multiplicative_of_total
statement:
@[to_additive additive_of_total /
  relation `r` to an additive monoid is anti-symmetric (i.e. satisfies `f a b + f b a = 0`), in
  order to show it is additive (i.e. satisfies `f a c = f a b + f b c`), we may assume `r a b` and
  `r b c` are satisfied. We allow restricting to a subset specified by a predicate `p`. -/]
theorem multiplicative_of_total (p : α → Prop) (hswap : ∀ {a b}, p a → p b → f a b * f b a = 1)
    (hmul : ∀ {a b c}, r a b → r b c → p a → p b → p c → f a c = f a b * f b c) {a b c : α}
    (pa : p a) (pb : p b) (pc : p c) : f a c = f a b * f b c
proof:
:= by
  have : Std.Symm (p · ∧ p ·) := { symm _ _ := And.symm }
  apply multiplicative_of_symm_of_total (p · ∧ p ·) r f
  · simp_rw [and_imp]; exact @hswap
  · exact fun rab rbc pab _pbc pac => hmul rab rbc pab.1 pab.2 pac.2
  exacts [⟨pa, pb⟩, ⟨pb, pc⟩, ⟨pa, pc⟩]

name: hom_coe_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma hom_coe_pow {F : Type*} [Monoid F] (c : F → M → M) (h1 : c 1 = id)
    (hmul : ∀ f g, c (f * g) = c f ∘ c g) (f : F) : ∀ n, c (f ^ n) = (c f)^[n]
  | 0 => by
    rw [pow_zero, h1]
    rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, iterate_succ, hmul, hom_coe_pow c h1 hmul f n]

name: coe_closure
statement:
theorem coe_closure [Semigroup M] {s : Set M} :
    (closure s : Set M) = s ∪ univ * s
proof:
:= by
  let I : SemigroupIdeal M :=
    { carrier := s ∪ univ * s
      smul_mem' x y := by
        rintro (hy | ⟨y, -, z, hz, rfl⟩)
        · exact .inr <| mul_mem_mul (mem_univ _) hy
        · simpa [← mul_assoc] using .inr <| mul_mem_mul (mem_univ _) hz }
  suffices closure s = I by rw [this]; rfl
  refine (closure_le.2 fun x => Or.inl).antisymm fun x hx => hx.elim mem_closure_of_mem ?_
  rintro ⟨y, -, z, hz, rfl⟩
  exact SemigroupIdeal.mul_mem _ _ (mem_closure_of_mem hz)

theorem subtypePerm_zpow (f : Perm α) (n : ℤ) (hf) :
    (f.subtypePerm hf ^ n : Perm { x // p x }) = (f ^ n).subtypePerm (zpow_aux hf)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n => exact subtypePerm_pow _ _ _
  | negSucc n => simp only [zpow_negSucc, subtypePerm_pow, subtypePerm_inv]

name: ofSubtype_subtypePerm
statement:
theorem ofSubtype_subtypePerm {f : Perm α} (h₁ : ∀ x, p (f x) ↔ p x) (h₂ : ∀ x, f x ≠ x → p x) :
    ofSubtype (subtypePerm f h₁) = f
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext fun x => by
    by_cases hx : p x
    · exact (subtypePerm f h₁).extendDomain_apply_subtype _ hx
    · rw [ofSubtype, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
        Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_not_subtype _ _ hx]
      exact not_not.mp fun h => hx (h₂ x (Ne.symm h))

proof:
:=

    simpa only [h, iff_true, MonoidHom.coe_mk, ofSubtype_apply_of_mem f h] using (f ⟨x, h⟩).2
  else by simp [h, ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f h]

name: ofSubtype_injective
statement: theorem ofSubtype_injective : Function.Injective (ofSubtype : Perm (Subtype p) → Perm α)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rw [Perm.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro a
  specialize h a
  rwa [ofSubtype_apply_coe, ofSubtype_apply_coe, SetCoe.ext_iff] at h

  Equiv.ext fun x => Subtype.coe_injective (ofSubtype_apply_coe f x)

name: Monoid.ext
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := ext)]
theorem Monoid.ext {M : Type u} ⦃m₁ m₂ : Monoid M⦄
    (h_mul : (letI := m₁; HMul.hMul : M → M → M) = (letI := m₂; HMul.hMul : M → M → M)) :
    m₁ = m₂
proof:
:= by
  have : m₁.toMulOneClass = m₂.toMulOneClass := MulOneClass.ext h_mul
  have h₁ : m₁.one = m₂.one := congr_arg (·.one) this
  let f : @MonoidHom M M m₁.toMulOne m₂.toMulOne :=
    @MonoidHom.mk _ _ (_) _ (@OneHom.mk _ _ (_) _ id h₁)
      (fun x y => congr_fun (congr_fun h_mul x) y)
  have : m₁.npow = m₂.npow := by
    ext n x
    exact @MonoidHom.map_pow M M m₁ m₂ f x n
  rcases m₁ with @⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨_⟩, _, _, _, ⟨_⟩⟩
  congr

statement:
@[to_additive (attr := ext)]
theorem DivInvMonoid.ext {M : Type*} ⦃m₁ m₂ : DivInvMonoid M⦄
    (h_mul : (letI := m₁; HMul.hMul : M → M → M) = (letI := m₂; HMul.hMul : M → M → M))
    (h_inv : (letI := m₁; Inv.inv : M → M) = (letI := m₂; Inv.inv : M → M)) : m₁ = m₂
proof:
:= by
  have h_mon := Monoid.ext h_mul
  have h₁ : m₁.one = m₂.one := congr_arg (·.one) h_mon
  let f : @MonoidHom M M m₁.toMulOne m₂.toMulOne :=
    @MonoidHom.mk _ _ (_) _ (@OneHom.mk _ _ (_) _ id h₁)
      (fun x y => congr_fun (congr_fun h_mul x) y)
  have : m₁.zpow = m₂.zpow := by
    ext m x
    exact @MonoidHom.map_zpow' M M m₁ m₂ f (congr_fun h_inv) x m
  have : m₁.div = m₂.div := by
    ext a b
    exact (@div_eq_mul_inv _ m₁ a b).trans
      (((congr_fun (congr_fun h_mul a) _).trans
        (congr_arg _ (congr_fun h_inv b))).trans (@div_eq_mul_inv _ m₂ a b).symm)
  rcases m₁ with @⟨_, ⟨_⟩, ⟨_⟩, ⟨_⟩⟩
  congr

proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : g₁.one = g₂.one := congr_arg (·.one) (Monoid.ext h_mul)
  let f : @MonoidHom G G g₁.toMulOne g₂.toMulOne :=
    @MonoidHom.mk _ _ (_) _ (@OneHom.mk _ _ (_) _ id h₁)
      (fun x y => congr_fun (congr_fun h_mul x) y)
  exact
    Group.toDivInvMonoid_injective

name: induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected lemma induction {motive : (ι →₀ M) → Prop} (f : ι →₀ M) (zero : motive 0)
    (single_add : ∀ (a b) (f : ι →₀ M),
      a ∉ f.support → b ≠ 0 → motive f → motive (single a b + f)) : motive f
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ (s) (f : ι →₀ M), f.support = s → motive f from this _ _ rfl
  fun s =>
  Finset.cons_induction_on s (fun f hf => by rwa [support_eq_empty.1 hf]) fun a s has ih f hf => by
    suffices motive (single a (f a) + f.erase a) by rwa [single_add_erase] at this
    classical
      apply single_add
      · rw [support_erase, mem_erase]
        exact fun H => H.1 rfl
      · rw [← mem_support_iff, hf]
        exact mem_cons_self _ _
      · apply ih _ _
        rw [support_erase, hf, Finset.erase_cons]

name: induction
statement:

      a ∉ f.support → b ≠ 0 → motive f → motive (f + single a b)) : motive f
proof:
:= by
  refine f.induction zero ?_
  convert! add_single using 7
  apply (addCommute_of_disjoint _).eq
  simp_all

    (single : ∀ a b, motive (single a b)) : motive f
proof:
:=
  induction₂ f zero fun _a _b _f _ _ w => add _ _ w (single _ _)

name: induction_on_max
statement:
lemma induction_on_max (f : ι →₀ M) (zero : motive 0)
    (single_add : ∀ a b (f : ι →₀ M), (∀ c ∈ f.support, c < a) → b ≠ 0 →
      motive f → motive (single a b + f)) : motive f
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ (s) (f : ι →₀ M), f.support = s → motive f from this _ _ rfl
  refine fun s => s.induction_on_max (fun f h => ?_) (fun a s hm hf f hs => ?_)
  · rwa [support_eq_empty.1 h]
  · have hs' : (erase a f).support = s := by
      rw [support_erase, hs, erase_insert (fun ha => (hm a ha).false)]
    rw [← single_add_erase a f]
    refine single_add _ _ _ (fun c hc => hm _ <| hs'.symm ▸ hc) ?_ (hf _ hs')
    rw [← mem_support_iff, hs]
    exact mem_insert_self a s

statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp, norm_cast) natCast_zsmul]
theorem zpow_natCast (a : G) : ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ (n : ℤ) = a ^ n
  | 0 => (zpow_zero _).trans (pow_zero _).symm
  | n + 1 => calc
    a ^ (↑(n + 1) : ℤ) = a ^ (n : ℤ) * a
proof:
:= DivInvMonoid.zpow_succ' _ _
    _ = a ^ n * a := congrArg (· * a) (zpow_natCast a n)
    _ = a ^ (n + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm

name: npow_add
statement: theorem npow_add (k n : ℕ) (x : M) : x ^ (k + n) = x ^ k * x ^ n

name: npow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem npow_zero (x : M) : x ^ 0 = 1

name: npow_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem npow_one (x : M) : x ^ 1 = x

name: npow_mul_assoc
statement:
theorem npow_mul_assoc (k m n : ℕ) (x : M) :
    (x ^ k * x ^ m) * x ^ n = x ^ k * (x ^ m * x ^ n)

name: npow_mul_comm
statement:
theorem npow_mul_comm (m n : ℕ) (x : M) :
    x ^ m * x ^ n = x ^ n * x ^ m

name: npow_mul
statement: theorem npow_mul (x : M) (m n : ℕ) : x ^ (m * n) = (x ^ m) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [npow_zero, mul_zero, npow_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [mul_add, npow_add, ih, mul_one, npow_add, npow_one]

name: npow_mul'
statement: theorem npow_mul' (x : M) (m n : ℕ) : x ^ (m * n) = (x ^ n) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact npow_mul x n m

name: neg_npow_assoc
statement:
theorem neg_npow_assoc {R : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [Pow R ℕ] [NatPowAssoc R] (a b : R) (k : ℕ) :
    (-1) ^ k * a * b = (-1) ^ k * (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [npow_zero, one_mul]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [npow_add, npow_one, ← neg_mul_comm, mul_one]
    simp only [neg_mul, ih]

name: Nat.cast_npow
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem Nat.cast_npow (R : Type*) [NonAssocSemiring R] [Pow R ℕ] [NatPowAssoc R] (n m : ℕ) :
    (↑(n ^ m) : R) = (↑n : R) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Nat.cast_one, npow_zero]
  | succ m ih => rw [npow_add, npow_add, Nat.cast_mul, ih, npow_one, npow_one]

name: fwdDiff_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_add (h : M) (f g : M → G) :
    Δ_[h] (f + g) = Δ_[h] f + Δ_[h] g

name: fwdDiff_const
statement: @[simp] lemma fwdDiff_const (g : G) : Δ_[h] (fun _ ↦ g : M → G) = fun _ ↦ 0

name: fwdDiff_smul
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Module R G] (f : M → R) (g : M → G) :
    Δ_[h] (f • g) = Δ_[h] f • g + f • Δ_[h] g + Δ_[h] f • Δ_[h] g
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [fwdDiff, Pi.smul_apply', Pi.add_apply, smul_sub, sub_smul]
  abel

name: fwdDiff_const_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_const_smul {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R G] (r : R) (f : M → G) :
    Δ_[h] (r • f) = r • Δ_[h] f

name: fwdDiff_smul_const
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_smul_const {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Module R G] (f : M → R) (g : G) :
    Δ_[h] (fun y ↦ f y • g) = Δ_[h] f • fun _ ↦ g
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [fwdDiff, Pi.smul_apply', sub_smul]

name: coe_fwdDiff
statement: lemma coe_fwdDiffₗ : ↑(fwdDiffₗ M G h) = fwdDiff h

name: coe_fwdDiff
statement: lemma coe_fwdDiffₗ_pow (n : ℕ) : ↑(fwdDiffₗ M G h ^ n) = (fwdDiff h)^[n]

name: shift
statement: lemma shiftₗ_apply (f : M → G) (y : M) : shiftₗ M G h f y = f (y + h)

name: shift
statement: lemma shiftₗ_pow_apply (f : M → G) (k : ℕ) (y : M) : (shiftₗ M G h ^ k) f y = f (y + k • h)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k IH => simp [pow_add, IH (shiftₗ M G h f), shiftₗ_apply, add_assoc, add_nsmul]

name: fwdDiff_finsetSum
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_finsetSum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → M → G) :
    Δ_[h] (∑ k ∈ s, f k) = ∑ k ∈ s, Δ_[h] (f k)
proof:
:=
  map_sum (fwdDiffₗ M G h) f s

name: fwdDiff_iter_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_iter_add (f g : M → G) (n : ℕ) :
    Δ_[h]^[n] (f + g) = Δ_[h]^[n] f + Δ_[h]^[n] g
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coe_fwdDiffₗ_pow] using map_add (fwdDiffₗ M G h ^ n) f g

name: fwdDiff_iter_const_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_iter_const_smul {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R G]
    (r : R) (f : M → G) (n : ℕ) : Δ_[h]^[n] (r • f) = r • Δ_[h]^[n] f
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => simp only [iterate_zero, id_eq]
  | succ n IH => simp only [iterate_succ_apply, fwdDiff_const_smul, IH]

name: fwdDiff_iter_finsetSum
statement:
@[simp] lemma fwdDiff_iter_finsetSum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → M → G) (n : ℕ) :
    Δ_[h]^[n] (∑ k ∈ s, f k) = ∑ k ∈ s, Δ_[h]^[n] (f k)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coe_fwdDiffₗ_pow] using map_sum (fwdDiffₗ M G h ^ n) f s

name: fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift
statement:
theorem fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift (f : M → G) (n : ℕ) (y : M) :
    Δ_[h]^[n] f y = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (n - k) * n.choose k) • f (y + k • h)
proof:
:= by
  
  have : fwdDiffₗ M G h = shiftₗ M G h - 1 := by simp only [shiftₗ, add_sub_cancel_right]
  rw [← coe_fwdDiffₗ, this, ← Module.End.pow_apply]
  
  have : Commute (shiftₗ M G h) (-1) := (Commute.one_right _).neg_right
  convert congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun (this.add_pow n) f) y
  · simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
  · rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, sum_apply]
    congr 1 with k
    have : ((-1) ^ (n - k) * n.choose k : Module.End ℤ (M → G))
              = ↑((-1) ^ (n - k) * n.choose k : ℤ) := by norm_cast
    rw [mul_assoc, Module.End.mul_apply, this, Module.End.intCast_apply, map_smul,
      Pi.smul_apply, shiftₗ_pow_apply]

name: fwdDiff_iter_comp_add
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_iter_comp_add (f : M → G) (m : M) (n : ℕ) (y : M) :
    Δ_[h]^[n] (fun r ↦ f (r + m)) y = (Δ_[h]^[n] f) (y + m)

name: fwdDiff_comp_add
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_comp_add (f : M → G) (m : M) (y : M) :
    Δ_[h] (fun r ↦ f (r + m)) y = (Δ_[h] f) (y + m)

name: shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter
statement:
theorem shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter (f : M → G) (n : ℕ) (y : M) :
    f (y + n • h) = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), n.choose k • Δ_[h]^[k] f y
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun ((Commute.one_right (fwdDiffₗ M G h)).add_pow n) f) y using 1
  · rw [← shiftₗ_pow_apply h f, shiftₗ]
  · simp [Module.End.pow_apply, coe_fwdDiffₗ]

name: fwdDiff_choose
statement: lemma fwdDiff_choose (j : ℕ) : Δ_[1] (fun x ↦ x.choose (j + 1) : ℕ → R) = fun x ↦ x.choose j
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [fwdDiff, choose_succ_succ' n j, cast_add, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: fwdDiff_iter_choose
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_iter_choose (j k : ℕ) :
    Δ_[1]^[k] (fun x ↦ x.choose (k + j) : ℕ → R) = fun x ↦ x.choose j
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing j with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add, iterate_zero, id_eq]
  | succ k IH =>
    simp only [iterate_succ_apply', add_assoc, add_comm 1 j, IH, fwdDiff_choose]

name: fwdDiff_iter_choose_zero
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_iter_choose_zero (m n : ℕ) :
    Δ_[1]^[n] (fun x ↦ x.choose m : ℕ → R) 0 = if n = m then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy m n with hmn | rfl | hnm
  · rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hmn with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simp_rw [hmn.ne', ite_false, (by ring : m + k + 1 = k + 1 + m), iterate_add_apply,
      add_zero m ▸ fwdDiff_iter_choose 0 m, choose_zero_right, iterate_one, cast_one, fwdDiff_const,
      fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, smul_zero, sum_const_zero]
  · simp only [ite_true, add_zero m ▸ fwdDiff_iter_choose 0 m, choose_zero_right, cast_one]
  · rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hnm with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simp_rw [hnm.ne, ite_false, add_assoc n k 1, fwdDiff_iter_choose, choose_zero_succ, cast_zero]

name: fwdDiff_addChar_eq
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_addChar_eq {M R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Ring R]
    (φ : AddChar M R) (x h : M) (n : ℕ) : Δ_[h]^[n] φ x = (φ h - 1) ^ n * φ x
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n IH =>
    simp only [pow_succ, iterate_succ_apply', fwdDiff, IH, ← mul_sub, mul_assoc]
    rw [sub_mul, ← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, add_comm h x, one_mul]

name: fwdDiff_iter_pow_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem fwdDiff_iter_pow_eq_zero_of_lt {j n : ℕ} (h : j < n) :
    Δ_[1]^[n] (fun (r : R) ↦ r ^ j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero => aesop
  | succ n ih =>
    have : (Δ_[1] fun (r : R) ↦ r ^ j) = ∑ i ∈ range j, j.choose i • fun r ↦ r ^ i := by
      ext x
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul, fwdDiff, add_pow, sum_range_succ, mul_comm]
    rw [iterate_succ_apply, this, fwdDiff_iter_finsetSum]
    exact sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ by
      rw [fwdDiff_iter_const_smul, ih (by have := mem_range.1 hi; lia), nsmul_zero]

name: fwdDiff_iter_eq_factorial
statement:
theorem fwdDiff_iter_eq_factorial {n : ℕ} :
    Δ_[1]^[n] (fun (r : R) ↦ r ^ n) = n !
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => aesop
  | succ n IH =>
    have : (Δ_[1] fun (r : R) ↦ r ^ (n + 1)) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (n + 1).choose i • fun r ↦ r ^ i := by
      ext x
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul, fwdDiff, add_pow, sum_range_succ, mul_comm]
    simp_rw [iterate_succ_apply, this, fwdDiff_iter_finsetSum, fwdDiff_iter_const_smul,
       sum_range_succ]
    simpa [IH, factorial_succ] using sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ by
      rw [fwdDiff_iter_pow_eq_zero_of_lt (by have := mem_range.1 hi; lia), mul_zero]

name: Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_degree_eq_factorial
statement:
theorem Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_degree_eq_factorial (P : R[X]) :
    Δ_[1]^[P.natDegree] P.eval = P.leadingCoeff • P.natDegree !
proof:
:= funext fun x ↦ by
  simp_rw [P.eval_eq_sum_range, ← sum_apply _ _ (fun i x ↦ P.coeff i * x ^ i),
    fwdDiff_iter_finsetSum, ← smul_eq_mul, ← Pi.smul_def, fwdDiff_iter_const_smul, Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [sum_apply, sum_range_succ, sum_eq_zero (fun i hi ↦ ?_), zero_add,
    fwdDiff_iter_eq_factorial, leadingCoeff, Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [fwdDiff_iter_pow_eq_zero_of_lt (mem_range.mp hi), smul_zero, Pi.zero_apply]

name: Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_eq_zero_of_degree_lt {P : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hP : P.natDegree < n) :
    Δ_[1]^[n] P.eval = 0
proof:
:= funext fun x ↦ by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hP
  rw [add_assoc, add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply,
    P.fwdDiff_iter_degree_eq_factorial, Pi.smul_def]
  simp [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift]

name: Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_degree_add_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_degree_add_one_eq_zero (P : R[X]) :
    Δ_[1]^[P.natDegree + 1] P.eval = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hP : P.natDegree < P.natDegree + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self P.natDegree
  exact Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hP

name: fwdDiff_iter_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fwdDiff_iter_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (P : ℕ → R) :
    Δ_[1]^[n] (fun r : R ↦ ∑ k ∈ range n, P k * r ^ k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← sum_apply _ _ (fun i x ↦ P i * x ^ i), fwdDiff_iter_finsetSum, sum_fn, ← smul_eq_mul,
    ← Pi.smul_def, fwdDiff_iter_const_smul, ← sum_fn]
  exact sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ smul_eq_zero_of_right _ <| fwdDiff_iter_pow_eq_zero_of_lt
    <| mem_range.mp hi

name: sum_range_shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter
statement:
theorem sum_range_shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter (f : M → G) (y : M) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range n, f (y + k • h) = ∑ k ∈ range n, n.choose (k + 1) • Δ_[h]^[k] f y
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n IH =>
    simp_rw [sum_range_succ, IH, shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter h f n y, choose_succ_succ',
      add_smul, sum_add_distrib, sum_range_succ, choose_succ_self]
    grind

name: _root_.MonoidHom.compAddChar_apply

lemma sum_eq_ite (ψ : AddChar A R) [Decidable (ψ = 0)] :

  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ne_one_iff.1 h
  refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hx ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft x) _ _ fun y ↦ (map_add_eq_mul ..).symm

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext1 y

    simpa only [mulShift_apply] using! DFunLike.ext_iff.mp h (hu.unit⁻¹ * y)
  · solve_by_elim

name: schwartz_zippel_sup_sum
statement:
lemma schwartz_zippel_sup_sum :
    ∀ {n} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R} (hp : p ≠ 0) (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      #{x ∈ S ^^ n | eval x p = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0) ≤
        p.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #(S i) : ℚ≥0)
  | 0, p, hp, S => by
    
    rw [p.eq_C_of_isEmpty] at *
    simp [C_ne_zero.mp hp]
    
  | n + 1, p, hp, S => by
    
    set p' : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
proof:
:= finSuccEquiv R n p with hp'
    
    
    set k := p'.natDegree with hk
    set pₖ := p'.leadingCoeff with hpₖ
    have hp'₀ : p' ≠ 0 := EmbeddingLike.map_ne_zero_iff.2 hp
    have hpₖ₀ : pₖ ≠ 0 := by simpa [pₖ, k]
    calc
      
      #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval x p = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0)
          
        = #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval x p = 0 ∧ eval (tail x) pₖ = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0)
          
          + #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval x p = 0 ∧ eval (tail x) pₖ ≠ 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0) := by
        rw [← add_div, ← Nat.cast_add, ← card_union_add_card_inter, filter_union_right,
          ← filter_and]
        simp [← and_or_left, em, and_and_and_comm]
      _ ≤ (pₖ.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #(S i.succ) : ℚ≥0)) + p.degreeOf 0 / #(S 0) := ?_
      _ ≤ p.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #(S i) : ℚ≥0) := ?_
    · gcongr ?_ + ?_
      · 
        calc
          #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval x p = 0 ∧ eval (tail x) pₖ = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0)
            ≤ #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval (tail x) pₖ = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0) := by
            gcongr with x; exact And.right
          _ = #(S 0) * #{xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n | eval xₜ pₖ = 0}
              / (#(S 0) * (∏ i, #(S (.succ i)) : ℚ≥0)) := by
            rw [card_consEquiv_filter_piFinset S fun x ↦ eval x pₖ = 0, prod_univ_succ, tail_def]
            norm_cast
          _ ≤ #{xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n | eval xₜ pₖ = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S (.succ i)) : ℚ≥0) :=
            mul_div_mul_left_le (by positivity)
          _ ≤ (pₖ.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #(S (.succ i)) : ℚ≥0)) :=
            schwartz_zippel_sup_sum hpₖ₀ _
      · 
        
        
        
        calc
          #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval x p = 0 ∧ eval (tail x) pₖ ≠ 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0)
            ≤ ↑(p.degreeOf 0 * ∏ i, #(S (.succ i))) / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0) := ?_
          _ = p.degreeOf 0 * (∏ i, #(S (.succ i))) / (#(S 0) * ∏ i, #(S (.succ i))) := by
            norm_cast; rw [prod_univ_succ]
          _ ≤ (p.degreeOf 0 / #(S 0) : ℚ≥0) := mul_div_mul_right_le (by positivity)
        gcongr
        calc
          #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval x p = 0 ∧ eval (tail x) pₖ ≠ 0}
            = #{x ∈ S ^^ (n + 1) | eval (tail x) pₖ ≠ 0 ∧ eval x p = 0} := by simp_rw [and_comm]
          _ = #({xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n | eval xₜ pₖ ≠ 0}.biUnion fun xₜ ↦ image (fun x₀ ↦ (x₀, xₜ))
                {x₀ ∈ S 0 | eval (cons x₀ xₜ) p = 0}) := by
            rw [← filter_filter, filter_piFinset_eq_map_consEquiv S (fun r ↦ eval r pₖ ≠ 0),
              filter_map, card_map, product_eq_biUnion_right, filter_biUnion]
            simp [filter_image]
            rfl
          _ ≤ ∑ xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n with eval xₜ pₖ ≠ 0,
                #(image (fun x₀ ↦ (x₀, xₜ)) {x₀ ∈ S 0 | eval (cons x₀ xₜ) p = 0}) :=
            card_biUnion_le
          _ ≤ ∑ xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n with eval xₜ pₖ ≠ 0, #{x₀ ∈ S 0 | eval (cons x₀ xₜ) p = 0} := by
            gcongr; exact card_image_le
          _ ≤ ∑ xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n with eval xₜ pₖ ≠ 0, p.degreeOf 0 := ?_
          _ ≤ ∑ _xₜ ∈ tail S ^^ n, p.degreeOf 0 := by gcongr; exact filter_subset ..
          _ = p.degreeOf 0 * ∏ i, #(S (.succ i)) := by simp [mul_comm, tail]
        gcongr with xₜ hxₜ
        set pₓ := p'.map (eval xₜ) with hpₓ
        have hpₓdeg : pₓ.natDegree = k := by
          rw [hpₓ, hk, Polynomial.natDegree_map_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero _ (mem_filter.1 hxₜ).2]
        have hpₓ₀ : pₓ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ (mem_filter.1 hxₜ).2 <| by
          rw [hpₖ, Polynomial.leadingCoeff, ← hk, ← hpₓdeg, h, Polynomial.natDegree_zero,
            ← Polynomial.coeff_map, ← hpₓ, h, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
        calc
          #{x₀ ∈ S 0 | eval (cons x₀ xₜ) p = 0} ≤ #pₓ.roots.toFinset := by
            gcongr
            simp +contextual [subset_iff, eval_eq_eval_mv_eval', pₓ, hpₓ₀, p']
          _ ≤ Multiset.card pₓ.roots := pₓ.roots.toFinset_card_le
          _ ≤ pₓ.natDegree := pₓ.card_roots'
          _ = k := hpₓdeg
          _ ≤ p.degreeOf 0 := by
            have :
              (ofLex (AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree toLex p'.leadingCoeff)).cons k ∈ p.support := by
              rwa [← mem_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv, mem_support_iff, ← hp', hk,
                ← Polynomial.leadingCoeff, ← hpₖ, ← leadingCoeff_toLex,
                AddMonoidAlgebra.leadingCoeff_ne_zero toLex.injective]
            simpa using monomial_le_degreeOf 0 this
    · rw [Finset.sup_add (support_nonempty.mpr hpₖ₀)]
      apply Finset.sup_le
      rintro i hi
      refine le_sup_of_le (mem_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv.mp hi) ?_
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_comm]
      dsimp
      gcongr
      simp [natDegree_finSuccEquiv, p']

name: schwartz_zippel_sum_degreeOf
statement:
lemma schwartz_zippel_sum_degreeOf {n} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (S : Fin n → Finset R) :
    #{x ∈ S ^^ n | eval x p = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0) ≤ ∑ i, (p.degreeOf i / #(S i) : ℚ≥0)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ p.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #(S i) : ℚ≥0) := schwartz_zippel_sup_sum hp S
    _ ≤ ∑ i, (p.degreeOf i / #(S i) : ℚ≥0) := Finset.sup_le fun s hs ↦ by
      gcongr with i; exact monomial_le_degreeOf i hs

name: schwartz_zippel_totalDegree
statement:
lemma schwartz_zippel_totalDegree {n} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R} (hp : p ≠ 0) (S : Finset R) :
    #{f ∈ piFinset fun _ ↦ S | eval f p = 0} / (#S ^ n : ℚ≥0) ≤ p.totalDegree / #S
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = #{f ∈ piFinset fun _ ↦ S | eval f p = 0} / (∏ i : Fin n, #S : ℚ≥0) := by simp
    _ ≤ p.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #S : ℚ≥0) := schwartz_zippel_sup_sum hp _
    _ = p.totalDegree / #S := by
      obtain rfl | hs := S.eq_empty_or_nonempty
      · simp
      simp_rw [totalDegree, Nat.cast_finsetSup]
      rw [sup_div₀ (by positivity)]
      simp [← sum_div, Finsupp.sum_fintype]

name: pderiv_def
statement: theorem pderiv_def [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) : pderiv i = mkDerivation R (Pi.single i 1)

name: pderiv_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_monomial {i : σ} :
    pderiv i (monomial s a) = monomial (s - single i 1) (a * s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [pderiv_def, mkDerivation_monomial, Finsupp.smul_sum, smul_eq_mul, ← smul_mul_assoc,
    ← (monomial _).map_smul]
  refine (Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hne => ?_) fun hi => ?_).trans ?_
  · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hne]
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff] at hi; simp [hi]
  · simp

name: X_mul_pderiv_monomial
statement:
lemma X_mul_pderiv_monomial {i : σ} {m : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R} :
    X i * pderiv i (monomial m r) = m i • monomial m r
proof:
:= by
  rw [pderiv_monomial, X, monomial_mul_monomial, smul_monomial]
  by_cases h : m i = 0
  · simp_rw [h, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul, monomial_zero]
  rw [one_mul, mul_comm, nsmul_eq_mul, add_comm, sub_add_single_one_cancel h]

name: pderiv_C
statement: theorem pderiv_C {i : σ} : pderiv i (C a) = 0

name: pderiv_one
statement: theorem pderiv_one {i : σ} : pderiv i (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0

name: pderiv_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_X [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ) :
    pderiv i (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) = Pi.single (M := fun _ => _) i 1 j

name: pderiv_X_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_X_self (i : σ) : pderiv i (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) = 1

name: pderiv_X_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (h : j ≠ i) : pderiv i (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0

name: pderiv_eq_zero_of_notMem_vars
statement:
theorem pderiv_eq_zero_of_notMem_vars {i : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : i ∉ f.vars) :
    pderiv i f = 0
proof:
:=
  derivation_eq_zero_of_forall_mem_vars fun _ hj => pderiv_X_of_ne <| ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj h

name: pderiv_monomial_single
statement:
theorem pderiv_monomial_single {i : σ} {n : ℕ} : pderiv i (monomial (single i n) a) =
    monomial (single i (n - 1)) (a * n)

name: pderiv_mul
statement:
theorem pderiv_mul {i : σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    pderiv i (f * g) = pderiv i f * g + f * pderiv i g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [(pderiv i).leibniz f g, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, add_comm]

name: pderiv_pow
statement:
theorem pderiv_pow {i : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ} :
    pderiv i (f ^ n) = n * f ^ (n - 1) * pderiv i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [(pderiv i).leibniz_pow f n, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: pderiv_C_mul
statement: theorem pderiv_C_mul {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ} : pderiv i (C a * f) = C a * pderiv i f

name: coeff_pderiv
statement:
theorem coeff_pderiv {i : σ} (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (pderiv i p).coeff m = p.coeff (m + single i 1) * (m i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq, add_mul]
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [pderiv_monomial, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial]
    by_cases h : n = m + single i 1
    · simp [h]
    simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
    by_cases hn : n i = 0
    · simp [hn]
    apply ite_eq_right
    rwa [tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le (fun _ ↦ by grind)]

name: pderiv_map
statement:
theorem pderiv_map {S} [CommSemiring S] {φ : R →+* S} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ} :
    pderiv i (map φ f) = map φ (pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  apply induction_on f (fun r ↦ by simp) (fun p q hp hq ↦ by simp [hp, hq]) fun p j eq ↦ ?_
  obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne j i
  · simp [eq]
  · simp [eq, h]

name: pderiv_rename
statement:
lemma pderiv_rename {τ : Type*} {f : σ → τ} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    pderiv (f x) (rename f p) = rename f (pderiv x p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p a h =>
    simp only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.rename_X, Derivation.leibniz, MvPolynomial.pderiv_X,
      Pi.single_apply, hf.eq_iff, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, h, map_add]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: aeval_sumElim_pderiv_inl
statement:
lemma aeval_sumElim_pderiv_inl {S τ : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (f : τ → S) (j : σ) :
    aeval (Sum.elim X (C ∘ f)) ((pderiv (Sum.inl j)) p) =
      (pderiv j) ((aeval (Sum.elim X (C ∘ f))) p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p q h =>
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X, smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_mul, aeval_X, h]
    cases q <;> simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: pderiv_sumRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pderiv_sumRingEquiv {σ ι} (p i) :
    (sumRingEquiv R σ ι p).pderiv i = sumRingEquiv R σ ι (p.pderiv (.inl i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp
  | add p q _ _ => simp_all
  | mul_X p n _ => cases n <;> simp_all [pderiv_X, Pi.single_apply, apply_ite]

name: pderiv_sumAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pderiv_sumAlgEquiv {R S₁ S₂ : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (b : S₁) (p : MvPolynomial (S₁ ⊕ S₂) R) :
    pderiv b (sumAlgEquiv R S₁ S₂ p) = sumAlgEquiv R S₁ S₂ (pderiv (Sum.inl b) p)

name: mkDerivation
statement:
theorem mkDerivationₗ_monomial (f : σ → A) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    mkDerivationₗ R f (monomial s r) =
      r • s.sum fun i k => monomial (s - Finsupp.single i 1) (k : R) • f i

name: mkDerivation
statement: theorem mkDerivationₗ_C (f : σ → A) (r : R) : mkDerivationₗ R f (C r) = 0

name: mkDerivation
statement: theorem mkDerivationₗ_X (f : σ → A) (i : σ) : mkDerivationₗ R f (X i) = f i

name: derivation_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_C (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A) (a : R) : D (C a) = 0

name: derivation_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_C_mul (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A) (a : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    C (σ := σ) a • D f = a • D f
proof:
:= by
  have : C (σ := σ) a • D f = D (C a * f) := by simp
  rw [this, C_mul', D.map_smul]

name: derivation_eqOn_supported
derivation_eq_of_forall_mem_vars
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_of_forall_mem_vars {D₁ D₂ : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A}
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : ∀ i ∈ f.vars, D₁ (X i) = D₂ (X i)) : D₁ f = D₂ f

name: derivation_eq_zero_of_forall_mem_vars
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_forall_mem_vars {D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A}
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : ∀ i ∈ f.vars, D (X i) = 0) : D f = 0
proof:
:=
  show D f = (0 : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A) f from derivation_eq_of_forall_mem_vars h

name: derivation_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem derivation_ext {D₁ D₂ : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A} (h : ∀ i, D₁ (X i) = D₂ (X i)) :
    D₁ = D₂
proof:
:=
  Derivation.ext fun _ => derivation_eq_of_forall_mem_vars fun i _ => h i

name: leibniz_iff_X
statement:
theorem leibniz_iff_X (D : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] A) (h₁ : D 1 = 0) :
    (∀ p q, D (p * q) = p • D q + q • D p) ↔ ∀ s i, D (monomial s 1 * X i) =
    (monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial σ R) • D (X i) + (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) • D (monomial s 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H p i => H _ _, fun H => ?_⟩
  have hC : ∀ r, D (C r) = 0 := by intro r; rw [C_eq_smul_one, D.map_smul, h₁, smul_zero]
  have : ∀ p i, D (p * X i) = p • D (X i) + (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) • D p := by
    intro p i
    induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
    | monomial s r =>
      rw [← mul_one r, ← C_mul_monomial, mul_assoc, C_mul', D.map_smul, H, C_mul', smul_assoc,
        smul_add, D.map_smul, smul_comm r (X i)]
    | add p q hp hq => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hp, hq, add_smul, smul_add, add_add_add_comm]
  intro p q
  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c =>
    rw [mul_comm, C_mul', hC, smul_zero, zero_add, D.map_smul, C_eq_smul_one, smul_one_smul]
  | add q₁ q₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [mul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, smul_add, add_smul]; abel
  | mul_X q i hq =>
    simp only [this, ← mul_assoc, hq, mul_smul, smul_add, add_assoc]
    rw [smul_comm (X i), smul_comm (X i)]

name: mkDerivation_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkDerivation_X (f : σ → A) (i : σ) : mkDerivation R f (X i) = f i

name: mkDerivation_monomial
statement:
theorem mkDerivation_monomial (f : σ → A) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    mkDerivation R f (monomial s r) =
      r • s.sum fun i k => monomial (s - Finsupp.single i 1) (k : R) • f i

name: isNilpotent_iff_of_fintype
statement:
private theorem isNilpotent_iff_of_fintype [Finite σ] :
    IsNilpotent P ↔ ∀ i, IsNilpotent (P.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  refine have := Fintype.ofFinite σ; Fintype.induction_empty_option ?_ ?_ ?_ σ P
  · intro α β _ e h₁ P
    rw [← IsNilpotent.map_iff (rename_injective _ e.symm.injective), h₁,
      (Finsupp.equivCongrLeft e).forall_congr_left]
    simp [Finsupp.equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain, coeff_rename_mapDomain _ e.symm.injective]
  · simp [Unique.forall_iff, ← IsNilpotent.map_iff (isEmptyRingEquiv R PEmpty).injective,
      -isEmptyRingEquiv_apply, isEmptyRingEquiv_eq_coeff_zero]
  · intro α _ H P
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := (optionEquivLeft _ _).symm.surjective P
    simp [IsNilpotent.map_iff (optionEquivLeft _ _).symm.injective,
      Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff, H, Finsupp.optionEquiv.forall_congr_left,
      ← optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none, Finsupp.coe_update]

name: isNilpotent_iff
statement: theorem isNilpotent_iff : IsNilpotent P ↔ ∀ i, IsNilpotent (P.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, f, hf, P, rfl⟩ := P.exists_fin_rename
  rw [IsNilpotent.map_iff (rename_injective _ hf), MvPolynomial.isNilpotent_iff_of_fintype]
  lift f to Fin n ↪ σ using hf
  refine ⟨fun H i ↦ ?_, fun H i ↦ by simpa using H (i.embDomain f)⟩
  by_cases H : i ∈ Set.range (Finsupp.embDomain f)
  · aesop
  · rw [coeff_rename_eq_zero] <;> aesop (add simp Finsupp.embDomain_eq_mapDomain)

name: isUnit_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_iff : IsUnit P ↔ IsUnit (P.coeff 0) ∧ ∀ i ≠ 0, IsNilpotent (P.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨H.map constantCoeff, ?_⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, n i ≠ 0 := by simpa [Finsupp.ext_iff] using hn
    let e := (optionEquivLeft _ _).symm.trans (renameEquiv R (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i))
    have H := (Polynomial.coeff_isUnit_isNilpotent_of_isUnit (H.map e.symm)).2 (n i) hi
    simp only [ne_eq, isNilpotent_iff] at H
    convert! ← H (n.equivMapDomain (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).symm).some
    refine (optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none R { b // b ≠ i }
      (Finsupp.equivMapDomain (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).symm n)
      ((renameEquiv R (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i)).symm P)).trans ?_
    simp [Finsupp.equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain, -Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_symm_apply,
      coeff_rename_mapDomain _ (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).symm.injective]
  · have : IsNilpotent (P - C (P.coeff 0)) := by
      simp +contextual [isNilpotent_iff, apply_ite, eq_comm, h₂]
    simpa using this.isUnit_add_right_of_commute (h₁.map C) (.all _ _)

name: isUnit_iff_totalDegree_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_totalDegree_of_isReduced [IsReduced R] :
    IsUnit P ↔ IsUnit (P.coeff 0) ∧ P.totalDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  convert! isUnit_iff (P := P)
  rw [totalDegree_eq_zero_iff]
  simp [not_imp_comm (a := _ = (0 : R)), Finsupp.ext_iff]

name: isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced [IsReduced R] :
    IsUnit P ↔ ∃ r, IsUnit r ∧ P = C r
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff_totalDegree_of_isReduced, totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C]
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨_, H⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  simpa

name: comap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_apply (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R) (x : τ → R) (i : σ) :
    comap f x i = aeval x (f (X i))

name: comap_id_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_id_apply (x : σ → R) : comap (AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)) x = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [comap, AlgHom.id_apply, aeval_X]

name: comap_id
statement: theorem comap_id : comap (AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)) = id
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  exact comap_id_apply x

name: comap_comp_apply
statement:
theorem comap_comp_apply (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (g : MvPolynomial τ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial υ R) (x : υ → R) :
    comap (g.comp f) x = comap f (comap g x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  trans aeval x (aeval (fun i => g (X i)) (f (X i)))
  · apply eval₂Hom_congr rfl rfl
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply]
    suffices g = aeval fun i => g (X i) by rw [← this]
    exact aeval_unique g
  · simp only [comap, aeval_eq_eval₂Hom, map_eval₂Hom]
    refine eval₂Hom_congr ?_ rfl rfl
    ext r
    apply aeval_C

name: comap_comp
statement:
theorem comap_comp (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R)
    (g : MvPolynomial τ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial υ R) : comap (g.comp f) = comap f ∘ comap g

name: comap_eq_id_of_eq_id
statement:
theorem comap_eq_id_of_eq_id (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R) (hf : ∀ φ, f φ = φ)
    (x : σ → R) : comap f x = x
proof:
:= by
  convert! comap_id_apply x
  ext1 φ
  simp [hf, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: comap_rename
statement: theorem comap_rename (f : σ → τ) (x : τ → R) : comap (rename f) x = x ∘ f

name: comapEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapEquiv_coe (f : MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R) :
    (comapEquiv f : (τ → R) → σ → R) = comap f

name: comapEquiv_symm_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapEquiv_symm_coe (f : MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R) :
    ((comapEquiv f).symm : (σ → R) → τ → R) = comap f.symm

name: vars_def
statement: theorem vars_def [DecidableEq σ] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p.vars = p.degrees.toFinset

name: coe_vars_subset_iff
statement:
theorem coe_vars_subset_iff {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {s : Set σ} :
    (p.vars : Set σ) ⊆ s ↔ p ∈ (rename ((↑) : s → σ)).range
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.vars_def, AlgHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨p.killCompl Subtype.val_injective, ext _ _ fun m => ?_⟩
    by_cases hm : m ∈ Set.range (Finsupp.mapDomain ((↑) : s → σ))
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [coeff_rename_mapDomain _ Subtype.val_injective, coeff_killCompl]
    · suffices hp : p.coeff m = 0 by
        rw [hp]
        apply coeff_rename_eq_zero
        rintro m rfl
        rw [coeff_killCompl, hp]
      rw [mem_range_mapDomain_iff _ Subtype.val_injective, Subtype.range_coe] at hm
      push Not at hm
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hm⟩ := hm
      contrapose! hb
      apply h
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_degrees]
      exact ⟨m, hb, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [degrees_rename_of_injective Subtype.val_injective,
      Multiset.coe_toFinset, Set.ofPred_subset, Multiset.forall_mem_map_iff]
    simp

name: exists_rename_eq_of_vars_subset_range
statement:
theorem exists_rename_eq_of_vars_subset_range (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (f : τ → σ) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ↑p.vars ⊆ Set.range f) : ∃ q : MvPolynomial τ R, rename f q = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_vars_subset_iff, AlgHom.mem_range] at hf
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨q.rename (Equiv.ofInjective f hfi).symm, ?_⟩
  rw [rename_rename, Equiv.self_comp_ofInjective_symm, hq]

name: exists_rename_coe_vars_eq
statement:
theorem exists_rename_coe_vars_eq (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ q : MvPolynomial p.vars R, rename (↑) q = p

name: vars_rename
statement:
theorem vars_rename [DecidableEq τ] (f : σ → τ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (rename f φ).vars ⊆ φ.vars.image f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_rename_coe_vars_eq φ
  rw [← Finset.coe_subset, coe_vars_subset_iff, AlgHom.mem_range]
  refine ⟨p.rename (fun x => ⟨f x, Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩⟩), ?_⟩
  rw [rename_rename, Function.comp_def, ← Function.comp_def f, ← rename_rename, hp]

name: mem_vars_rename
statement:
theorem mem_vars_rename (f : σ → τ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) {j : τ} (h : j ∈ (rename f φ).vars) :
    ∃ i : σ, i ∈ φ.vars ∧ f i = j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [exists_prop, Finset.mem_image] using vars_rename f φ h

name: vars_0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vars_0 : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).vars = ∅

name: vars_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vars_monomial (h : r ≠ 0) : (monomial s r).vars = s.support
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [vars_def, degrees_monomial_eq _ _ h, Finsupp.toFinset_toMultiset]

name: vars_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vars_C : (C r : MvPolynomial σ R).vars = ∅

name: vars_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vars_X [Nontrivial R] : (X n : MvPolynomial σ R).vars = {n}
proof:
:= by
  rw [X, vars_monomial (one_ne_zero' R), Finsupp.support_single _ (one_ne_zero' ℕ)]

name: mem_vars_iff_mem_support
statement: theorem mem_vars_iff_mem_support (i : σ) : i ∈ p.vars ↔ ∃ d ∈ p.support, i ∈ d.support
proof:
:= by
  classical simp only [vars_def, Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_degrees, mem_support_iff]

name: mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero
statement: theorem mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero {i : σ} : i ∈ p.vars ↔ p.degreeOf i ≠ 0

name: mem_support_notMem_vars_zero
statement:
theorem mem_support_notMem_vars_zero {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (H : x ∈ f.support)
    {v : σ} (h : v ∉ vars f) : x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact (mem_vars_iff_mem_support v).mpr ⟨x, H, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h⟩

name: support_subset_vars_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem support_subset_vars_of_mem_support {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : s ∈ p.support) :
    s.support ⊆ p.vars
proof:
:= fun i hi ↦ by
  contrapose! hi
  simp [mem_support_notMem_vars_zero h hi]

name: vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C
statement: theorem vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C : p.vars = ∅ ↔ p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h]; simp⟩
  rw [← totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C]
  suffices p.degrees.card = 0 by grind [totalDegree_le_degrees_card p]
  classical rw [vars_def, Multiset.toFinset_eq_empty] at h
  simp_all

name: vars_add_subset
statement:
theorem vars_add_subset [DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p + q).vars ⊆ p.vars ∪ q.vars
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [vars_def, Finset.mem_union, Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hx ⊢
  simpa using Multiset.mem_of_le degrees_add_le hx

name: vars_add_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem vars_add_of_disjoint [DecidableEq σ] (h : Disjoint p.vars q.vars) :
    (p + q).vars = p.vars ∪ q.vars
proof:
:= by
  refine (vars_add_subset p q).antisymm fun x hx => ?_
  simp only [vars_def, Multiset.disjoint_toFinset] at h hx ⊢
  rwa [degrees_add_of_disjoint h, Multiset.toFinset_union]

name: vars_mul
statement: theorem vars_mul [DecidableEq σ] (φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ R) : (φ * ψ).vars ⊆ φ.vars ∪ ψ.vars
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [vars_def, ← Multiset.toFinset_add, Multiset.toFinset_subset]
  exact Multiset.subset_of_le degrees_mul_le

name: vars_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vars_one : (1 : MvPolynomial σ R).vars = ∅

name: vars_pow
statement: theorem vars_pow (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) : (φ ^ n).vars ⊆ φ.vars
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ']
    apply Finset.Subset.trans (vars_mul _ _)
    exact Finset.union_subset (Finset.Subset.refl _) ih

name: vars_prod
statement:
theorem vars_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] {s : Finset ι} (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).vars ⊆ s.biUnion fun i => (f i).vars
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert _ _ hs hsub =>
    simp only [hs, Finset.biUnion_insert, Finset.prod_insert, not_false_iff]
    apply Finset.Subset.trans (vars_mul _ _)
    exact Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.Subset.refl _) hsub

name: vars_C_mul
statement:
theorem vars_C_mul (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (φ : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    (C a * φ : MvPolynomial σ A).vars = φ.vars
proof:
:= by
  ext1 i
  simp only [mem_vars_iff_mem_support, mem_support_iff]
  apply exists_congr
  intro d
  rw [coeff_C_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff, eq_true ha, true_and]

name: vars_sum_subset
statement:
theorem vars_sum_subset [DecidableEq σ] :
    (∑ i ∈ t, φ i).vars ⊆ Finset.biUnion t fun i => (φ i).vars
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert _ _ has hsum =>
    rw [Finset.biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert has]
    refine Finset.Subset.trans
      (vars_add_subset _ _) (Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.Subset.refl _) ?_)
    assumption

name: vars_sum_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem vars_sum_of_disjoint [DecidableEq σ] (h : Pairwise <| (Disjoint on fun i => (φ i).vars)) :
    (∑ i ∈ t, φ i).vars = Finset.biUnion t fun i => (φ i).vars
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert _ _ has hsum =>
    rw [Finset.biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert has, vars_add_of_disjoint, hsum]
    unfold Pairwise onFun at h
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne] at h ⊢
    grind

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂Hom_congr' {f₁ f₂ : R →+* S} {g₁ g₂ : σ → S} {p₁ p₂ : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    f₁ = f₂ →
      (∀ i, i ∈ p₁.vars → i ∈ p₂.vars → g₁ i = g₂ i) →
        p₁ = p₂ → eval₂Hom f₁ g₁ p₁ = eval₂Hom f₂ g₂ p₂
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl h rfl
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_rename_coe_vars_eq p₁
  rw [← hp, eval₂Hom_rename, eval₂Hom_rename]
  exact congr(eval₂Hom f₁ (fun x : p₁.vars => $(h x.1 x.2 x.2)) p)

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂Hom_eq_constantCoeff_of_vars (f : R →+* S) {g : σ → S} {p : MvPolynomial σ R}

proof:
:= by

name: hom_congr_vars
proof:
:=
  calc
    f₁ p₁ = eval₂Hom (f₁.comp C) (f₁ ∘ X) p₁ := RingHom.congr_fun (by ext <;> simp) _
    _ = eval₂Hom (f₂.comp C) (f₂ ∘ X) p₂ := eval₂Hom_congr' hC hv hp
    _ = f₂ p₂ := RingHom.congr_fun (by ext <;> simp) _

name: aeval_ite_mem_eq_self
statement:
lemma aeval_ite_mem_eq_self (q : MvPolynomial σ R) {s : Set σ} (hs : (q.vars : Set σ) ⊆ s)
    [∀ i, Decidable (i ∈ s)] :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ if i ∈ s then .X i else 0) q = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum q, MvPolynomial.aeval_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u hu ↦ ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, MvPolynomial.monomial_eq]
  congr 1
  exact Finsupp.prod_congr (fun i hi ↦ by simp [hs ((mem_vars_iff_mem_support _).mpr ⟨u, hu, hi⟩)])

name: coeff_expand_smul

@[simp]
lemma coeff_expand_smul (hp : p ≠ 0) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  classical

name: coeff_expand_zero

proof:

name: support_expand_subset
statement:
lemma support_expand_subset [DecidableEq σ] :
    (expand p φ).support ⊆ φ.support.image (p • ·)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [φ.as_sum]
  simp only [map_sum, expand_monomial]
  refine MvPolynomial.support_sum.trans ?_
  aesop (add simp Finset.subset_iff)

name: coeff_expand_of_not_dvd
statement:

    (expand p φ).coeff m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  contrapose! h
  grw [← mem_support_iff, support_expand_subset, Finset.mem_image] at h
  rcases h with ⟨a, -, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨a i, by simp⟩

name: totalDegree_expand
statement:
theorem totalDegree_expand (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (expand p f).totalDegree = f.totalDegree * p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases p.eq_zero_or_pos with hp | hp
  · simp [hp]
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · rw [hf, map_zero, totalDegree_zero, zero_mul]
  simp_rw [totalDegree_eq, support_expand _ (p.ne_zero_iff_zero_lt.mpr hp)]
  simp only [Finsupp.card_toMultiset, Finset.sup_image, Finset.sup_mul₀, Function.comp_def]
  congr! 2 with d
  rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ Finsupp.support_smul _ (by simp)]
  simp [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm p]

name: isLocalHom_expand
statement: theorem isLocalHom_expand {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) : IsLocalHom (expand p (R := R) (σ := σ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun f hf => ?_⟩
  rw [MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff] at hf ⊢
  simp only [coeff_expand_zero p hp] at hf
  refine ⟨hf.1, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← coeff_expand_smul p hp]
  apply hf.2
  simp [hi, hp]

name: of_irreducible_expand
proof:
:=

  hf.of_map

name: killCompl_comp_rename

  algHom_ext fun i => by
    dsimp

:= by

name: killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_notMem_range
statement:
lemma killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_notMem_range {s : τ →₀ ℕ} (c : R)
    {a : τ} (ha : a ∈ s.support) (hs : a ∉ Set.range f) :
    (monomial s c).killCompl hf = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [killCompl, aeval_monomial, Finsupp.prod]
  apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero ha
  simp [hs, zero_pow (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ha)]

    (hs : ¬ ↑s.support ⊆ Set.range f) : (monomial s c).killCompl hf = 0
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, ha, hs⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hs
  killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_notMem_range hf c ha hs

name: killCompl_monomial_eq_monomial_comapDomain_of_subset

lemma killCompl_monomial_eq_monomial_comapDomain_of_subset {s : τ →₀ ℕ} (c : R)

    (monomial s c).killCompl hf = monomial (s.comapDomain f hf.injOn) c
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← s.mapDomain_comapDomain f hf hs, killCompl_monomial_mapDomain]

name: killCompl_monomial
statement:
lemma killCompl_monomial {s} {c : R} [Decidable (↑s.support ⊆ Set.range f)] :
    (monomial s c).killCompl hf =
      if ↑s.support ⊆ Set.range f then monomial (s.comapDomain f hf.injOn) c else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact killCompl_monomial_eq_monomial_comapDomain_of_subset hf c h
  · exact killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_not_subset hf c h

name: coeff_killCompl
statement:
lemma coeff_killCompl {s} :
    (p.killCompl hf).coeff s = p.coeff (s.mapDomain f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply p.induction_on' (P := fun p ↦ (p.killCompl hf).coeff s = p.coeff (s.mapDomain f))
  · intro u r
    rw [killCompl_monomial]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [← (Finsupp.mapDomain_injective hf).eq_iff, u.mapDomain_comapDomain _ hf h]
    · simp only [coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply, coeff_monomial, right_eq_ite_iff]
      intro rfl
      contrapose! h
      apply subset_trans <| SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr <| Finsupp.mapDomain_support
      simp
  · simp_intro ..

lemma support_killCompl {p : MvPolynomial τ R} :

name: exists_finset_rename
statement:
theorem exists_finset_rename (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ (s : Finset σ) (q : MvPolynomial { x // x ∈ s } R), p = rename (↑) q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply induction_on p
  · intro r
    exact ⟨∅, C r, by rw [rename_C]⟩
  · rintro p q ⟨s, p, rfl⟩ ⟨t, q, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨s ∪ t, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · refine rename (Subtype.map id ?_) p + rename (Subtype.map id ?_) q <;>
        simp +contextual only [id, true_or, or_true,
          Finset.mem_union, forall_true_iff]
    · simp only [rename_rename, map_add]
      rfl
  · rintro p n ⟨s, p, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨insert n s, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · refine rename (Subtype.map id ?_) p * X ⟨n, s.mem_insert_self n⟩
      simp +contextual only [id, or_true, Finset.mem_insert, forall_true_iff]
    · simp only [rename_rename, rename_X, map_mul]
      rfl

name: exists_finset_rename
statement:
theorem exists_finset_rename₂ (p₁ p₂ : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ (s : Finset σ) (q₁ q₂ : MvPolynomial s R), p₁ = rename (↑) q₁ ∧ p₂ = rename (↑) q₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₁, q₁, rfl⟩ := exists_finset_rename p₁
  obtain ⟨s₂, q₂, rfl⟩ := exists_finset_rename p₂
  classical
    use s₁ ∪ s₂
    use rename (fun x ↦ ⟨x, Finset.subset_union_left x.2⟩) q₁
    use rename (fun x ↦ ⟨x, Finset.subset_union_right x.2⟩) q₂
    constructor <;> simp [Function.comp_def]

name: exists_fin_rename
statement:
theorem exists_fin_rename (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → σ) (_hf : Injective f) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R), p = rename f q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, q, rfl⟩ := exists_finset_rename p
  let n := Fintype.card { x // x ∈ s }
  let e := Fintype.equivFin { x // x ∈ s }
  refine ⟨n, (↑) ∘ e.symm, Subtype.val_injective.comp e.symm.injective, rename e q, ?_⟩
  rw [← rename_rename, rename_rename e]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, rename_rename]

name: coeff_rename_mapDomain

@[simp]
theorem coeff_rename_mapDomain (f : σ → τ) (hf : Injective f) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (rename f φ).coeff (d.mapDomain f) = φ.coeff d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction φ using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial u r =>
    rw [rename_monomial, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial]
    simp only [(Finsupp.mapDomain_injective hf).eq_iff]
  | add =>
    simp only [*, map_add, coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply]

name: coeff_rename_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_rename_eq_zero (f : σ → τ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : τ →₀ ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u : σ →₀ ℕ, u.mapDomain f = d → φ.coeff u = 0) : (rename f φ).coeff d = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← notMem_support_iff]
  intro H
  replace H := mapDomain_support H
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at H
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := H
  specialize h u rfl
  rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hu
  contradiction

proof:

  apply coeff_rename_eq_zero _ _ _ h

theorem eval₂_mul_monomial :
    ∀ {s a}, (p * monomial s a).eval₂ f g = p.eval₂ f g * f a * s.prod fun n e => g n ^ e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply MvPolynomial.induction_on p
  · intro a' s a
    simp [C_mul_monomial, eval₂_monomial, f.map_mul]
  · intro p q ih_p ih_q
    simp [add_mul, eval₂_add, ih_p, ih_q]
  · intro p n ih s a
    exact
      calc (p * X n * monomial s a).eval₂ f g
        _ = (p * monomial (Finsupp.single n 1 + s) a).eval₂ f g := by
          rw [monomial_single_add, pow_one, mul_assoc]
        _ = (p * monomial (Finsupp.single n 1) 1).eval₂ f g * f a * s.prod fun n e => g n ^ e := by
          simp [ih, prod_single_index, prod_add_index, pow_one, pow_add, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm,

name: coeffs_map
statement:
lemma coeffs_map (f : R →+* S₁) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) [DecidableEq S₁] :
    (map f p).coeffs ⊆ p.coeffs.image f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using induction_on'' with
  | C a => aesop (add simp coeffs_C)
  | mul_X p n ih => simpa
  | monomial_add a s p ha hs hp ih =>
    rw [coeffs_add (disjoint_support_monomial ha hs), map_add, coeffs_add]
    · rw [Finset.image_union, Finset.union_subset_iff]
      exact ⟨ih.trans (by simp), hp.trans (by simp)⟩
    · exact Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left (support_map_subset _ _) <|
        Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (support_map_subset _ _) <|
          disjoint_support_monomial ha hs

proof:

name: mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset
statement:
lemma mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset {f : R →+* S₁} {x : MvPolynomial σ S₁} :
    x ∈ Set.range (MvPolynomial.map f) ↔ (x.coeffs : Set _) ⊆ .range f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact subset_trans (coe_coeffs_map f p) (by simp)
  · induction x using induction_on'' with
    | C a =>
      by_cases h : a = 0
      · subst h
        exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
      · simp only [coeffs_C, h, reduceIte, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at hx
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact ⟨C b, by simp⟩
    | mul_X p n ih =>
      rw [coeffs_mul_X] at hx
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := ih hx
      exact ⟨q * X n, by simp⟩
    | monomial_add a s p ha hs hp ih =>
      rw [coeffs_add (disjoint_support_monomial ha hs)] at hx
      simp only [Finset.coe_union, Set.union_subset_iff] at hx
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := ih hx.1
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hp hx.2
      exact ⟨q + u, by simp [hq, hu]⟩

name: aeval_range
statement: theorem aeval_range : (aeval f).range = Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨p, rfl⟩
    simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
    induction p using induction_on with
    | C a => exact aeval_C f a ▸ Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self a))
    | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hp hq
    | mul_X p n h =>
      simp only [map_mul, aeval_X]
      exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ h (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self n))
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    use X i, by aesop

name: eval
proof:
:= by
  classical
  replace hs : ∀ i, f (p.coeff i) ∈ s := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ p.support
    · exact hs i hi
    · rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hi, f.map_zero]
      exact zero_mem s
  induction p using MvPolynomial.monomial_add_induction_on with
  | C a =>
    simpa using hs 0
  | monomial_add a b f ha _ ih =>
    rw [eval₂_add, eval₂_monomial]
    refine add_mem (mul_mem ?_ <| prod_mem fun i _ => pow_mem (hv _) _) (ih fun i => ?_)
    · simpa [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 ha] using hs a
    have := hs i
    rw [coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, coeff_monomial] at this
    split_ifs at this with h
    · subst h
      rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 ha, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · rwa [zero_add] at this

statement:
