name: degrees_eq_zero_iff_support_subset_zero
statement: theorem degrees_eq_zero_iff_support_subset_zero : p.degrees = 0 ↔ p.support ⊆ {0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.subset_singleton_iff', Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
  refine ⟨fun h s hs ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Finsupp.support_eq_empty]
    simp only [mem_degrees] at h
    grind
  rcases mem_degrees.mp hi with ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩
  have := Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mpr (h s <| mem_support_iff.mpr hs1) ▸ hs2
  grind

name: le_degrees_add_left
statement: theorem le_degrees_add_left (h : Disjoint p.degrees q.degrees) : p.degrees ≤ (p + q).degrees
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro d hd
  rw [Multiset.disjoint_iff_ne] at h
  obtain rfl | h0 := eq_or_ne d 0
  · rw [toMultiset_zero]; apply Multiset.zero_le
  · refine Finset.le_sup_of_le (b := d) ?_ le_rfl
    rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply]
    suffices q.coeff d = 0 by rw [this, add_zero]; rwa [← mem_support_iff]
    rw [Ne, ← Finsupp.support_eq_empty, ← Ne, ← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty] at h0
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h0
    contrapose! h
    rw [mem_support_iff] at hd
    refine ⟨j, ?_, j, ?_, rfl⟩
    all_goals rw [mem_degrees]; refine ⟨d, ?_, hj⟩; assumption

name: le_degrees_add_right
statement: lemma le_degrees_add_right (h : Disjoint p.degrees q.degrees) : q.degrees ≤ (p + q).degrees

name: degrees_add_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem degrees_add_of_disjoint [DecidableEq σ] (h : Disjoint p.degrees q.degrees) :
    (p + q).degrees = p.degrees ∪ q.degrees

name: degrees_map_le
statement: lemma degrees_map_le [CommSemiring S] {f : R →+* S} : (map f p).degrees ≤ p.degrees

name: degrees_rename
statement:
theorem degrees_rename (f : σ → τ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (rename f φ).degrees ⊆ φ.degrees.map f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i
  rw [mem_degrees, Multiset.mem_map]
  rintro ⟨d, hd, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx⟩ := coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _ hd
  simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain, Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hi
  rw [sum_apply, Finsupp.sum] at hi
  contrapose! hi
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  intro j hj
  simp only [mem_degrees] at hi
  specialize hi j ⟨x, hx, hj⟩
  rw [Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hi]

name: degrees_map_of_injective
statement:
theorem degrees_map_of_injective [CommSemiring S] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) {f : R →+* S}
    (hf : Injective f) : (map f p).degrees = p.degrees

name: degrees_rename_of_injective
statement:
theorem degrees_rename_of_injective {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {f : σ → τ} (h : Function.Injective f) :
    degrees (rename f p) = (degrees p).map f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [degrees, Multiset.map_finset_sup p.support Finsupp.toMultiset f h,
    support_rename_of_injective h, Finset.sup_image]
  refine Finset.sup_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  exact (Finsupp.toMultiset_map _ _).symm

name: degreeOf_def
statement:
theorem degreeOf_def [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    p.degreeOf n = p.degrees.count n

name: degreeOf_eq_sup
statement:
theorem degreeOf_eq_sup (n : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf n f = f.support.sup fun m => m n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [degreeOf_def, degrees, Multiset.count_finset_sup]
  congr
  ext
  simp only [count_toMultiset]

name: degreeOf_lt_iff
statement:
theorem degreeOf_lt_iff {n : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} (h : 0 < d) :
    degreeOf n f < d ↔ ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, m ∈ f.support → m n < d

name: degreeOf_le_iff
statement:
lemma degreeOf_le_iff {n : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ} :
    degreeOf n f ≤ d ↔ ∀ m ∈ support f, m n ≤ d

name: degreeOf_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeOf_zero (n : σ) : degreeOf n (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical simp only [degreeOf_def, degrees_zero, Multiset.count_zero]

name: degreeOf_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeOf_one (n : σ) : degreeOf n (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0

name: degreeOf_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeOf_C (a : R) (x : σ) : degreeOf x (C a : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0

name: degreeOf_X
statement:
theorem degreeOf_X [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ) [Nontrivial R] :
    degreeOf i (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases c : i = j
  · simp only [c, ite_true, degreeOf_def, degrees_X, Multiset.count_singleton]
  simp [c, degreeOf_def, degrees_X]

name: degreeOf_X_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem degreeOf_X_self [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).degreeOf i = 1

name: ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero {i : σ} : p.degreeOf i ≠ 0 → p ≠ 0

name: degreeOf_add_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_add_le (n : σ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf n (f + g) ≤ max (degreeOf n f) (degreeOf n g)

name: monomial_le_degreeOf
statement:
theorem monomial_le_degreeOf (i : σ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h_m : m ∈ f.support) :
    m i ≤ degreeOf i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [degreeOf_eq_sup i]
  apply Finset.le_sup h_m

name: degreeOf_monomial_eq
statement:
lemma degreeOf_monomial_eq (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (monomial s a).degreeOf i = s i
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [degreeOf_def, degrees_monomial_eq _ _ ha, Finsupp.count_toMultiset]

name: degreeOf_X_self_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem degreeOf_X_self_pow [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ k).degreeOf i = k

name: le_degreeOf_of_mem_support
statement:
lemma le_degreeOf_of_mem_support (i : σ) {s : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    s ∈ p.support → s i ≤ p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  obtain si | si := eq_or_lt_of_le <| Nat.zero_le (s i)
  · simp [← si]
  rw [degreeOf_eq_sup, Finset.le_sup_iff si]
  use s

name: notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt
statement:
lemma notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt (i : σ) {s : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    p.degreeOf i < s i → s ∉ p.support
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  contrapose! h
  exact le_degreeOf_of_mem_support i h

name: degreeOf_mul_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_le (i : σ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf i (f * g) ≤ degreeOf i f + degreeOf i g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [degreeOf]
  convert! Multiset.count_le_of_le i degrees_mul_le
  rw [Multiset.count_add]

name: degreeOf_sum_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_sum_le {ι : Type*} (i : σ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf i (∑ j ∈ s, f j) ≤ s.sup fun j => degreeOf i (f j)

name: degreeOf_prod_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_prod_le {ι : Type*} (i : σ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf i (∏ j ∈ s, f j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, (f j).degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [degreeOf_eq_sup]
  exact supDegree_prod_le (by simp only [coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]) (by simp)

name: degreeOf_pow_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_pow_le (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    degreeOf i (p ^ n) ≤ n * degreeOf i p
proof:
:= by
  simpa using degreeOf_prod_le i (Finset.range n) (fun _ => p)

name: degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (h : i ≠ j) :
    degreeOf i (f * X j) = degreeOf i f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [degreeOf_eq_sup i, support_mul_X, Finset.sup_map]
  congr
  ext
  simp only [Finsupp.single, addRightEmbedding_apply, coe_mk,
    Pi.add_apply, comp_apply, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.single_eq_of_ne h, add_zero]

name: degreeOf_mul_X_self
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_self (j : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf j (f * X j) ≤ degreeOf j f + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [degreeOf]
  apply (Multiset.count_le_of_le j degrees_mul_le).trans
  simp only [Multiset.count_add, add_le_add_iff_left]
  convert! Multiset.count_le_of_le j <| degrees_X' j
  rw [Multiset.count_singleton_self]

name: degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne {i j : σ} (k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ j) :
    ((X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ k).degreeOf i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, ← C_1, degreeOf_C]
  | succ k hk => rw [pow_add, pow_one, degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h, hk]

name: degreeOf_X_of_ne
statement: theorem degreeOf_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (h : i ≠ j) : (X j : MvPolynomial σ R).degreeOf i = 0
proof:
:=
  pow_one (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ▸ degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne 1 h

name: degreeOf_mul_X_eq_degreeOf_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_eq_degreeOf_add_one_iff (j : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf j (f * X j) = degreeOf j f + 1 ↔ f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => by by_contra ha; simp [ha] at h, fun h => ?_⟩
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (degreeOf_mul_X_self j f)
  have : (f.support.sup fun m ↦ m j) + 1 = (f.support.sup fun m ↦ (m j + 1)) :=
    Finset.apply_sup_eq_sup_comp_of_nonempty @Nat.succ_le_succ (support_nonempty.mpr h)
  simp only [degreeOf_eq_sup, support_mul_X, this]
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.sup_map, bot_eq_zero', add_pos_iff, zero_lt_one, or_true, Finset.le_sup_iff]
  use x
  simpa using mem_support_iff.mp hx

name: degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero (i : σ) (k : ℕ) (h : p ≠ 0) :
    (p * X i ^ k).degreeOf i = p.degreeOf i + k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
  | succ k hk =>
    have : p * X i ^ k ≠ 0 := by
      rcases ne_zero_iff.mp h with ⟨s, hs⟩
      refine ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨s + Finsupp.single i k, ?_⟩
      rwa [X_pow_eq_monomial, coeff_mul_monomial, mul_one]
    rw [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc,
      (degreeOf_mul_X_eq_degreeOf_add_one_iff i _).mpr this, hk, add_assoc]

name: degreeOf_mul_X_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_pow_of_ne {i j : σ} (k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ j) :
    (p * X j ^ k).degreeOf i = p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, mul_one]
  | succ k hk => rw [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc, degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h, hk]

name: degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt
statement:
theorem degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt {i : σ} (h : q.degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) :
    (p + q).degreeOf i = p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← max_eq_left_of_lt h]
    exact degreeOf_add_le i p q
  nth_rw 2 [degreeOf_eq_sup]
  apply (Finset.le_sup_iff <| Nat.zero_lt_of_lt h).mpr
  have : p.support.Nonempty := by aesop
  have ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ this (fun s ↦ s i)
  rw [← degreeOf_eq_sup i p] at hs2
  refine ⟨s, ?_, by rw [hs2]⟩
  have : s ∉ q.support := by
    contrapose! h
    rw [hs2]
    exact le_degreeOf_of_mem_support i h
  simp only [mem_support_iff, ne_eq, coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, not_not] at hs1 ⊢ this
  rwa [this, add_zero]

name: degreeOf_eq_of_degreeOf_add_lt
statement:
theorem degreeOf_eq_of_degreeOf_add_lt {i : σ} (h : (p + q).degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) :
    p.degreeOf i = q.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  apply le_trans (Nat.le_max_left _ (q.degreeOf i))
  rcases Nat.lt_or_lt_of_ne h with h | h
  · simp [add_comm p q, degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h, max_eq_right_of_lt h]
  · simp [degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h, max_eq_left_of_lt h]

name: degreeOf_C_mul_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_C_mul_le (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ) (c : R) :
    (C c * p).degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  unfold degreeOf
  convert! Multiset.count_le_of_le i degrees_mul_le
  simp only [degrees_C, zero_add]

name: degreeOf_mul_C_le
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_C_le (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ) (c : R) :
    (p * C c).degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  unfold degreeOf
  convert! Multiset.count_le_of_le i degrees_mul_le
  simp only [degrees_C, add_zero]

name: degreeOf_rename_of_injective
statement:
theorem degreeOf_rename_of_injective {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {f : σ → τ} (h : Function.Injective f)
    (i : σ) : degreeOf (f i) (rename f p) = degreeOf i p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [degreeOf, degrees_rename_of_injective h, Multiset.count_map_eq_count' f p.degrees h]

name: totalDegree_eq
statement:
theorem totalDegree_eq (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    p.totalDegree = p.support.sup fun m => Multiset.card (toMultiset m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalDegree]
  congr; funext m
  exact (Finsupp.card_toMultiset _).symm

name: le_totalDegree
statement:
theorem le_totalDegree {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : s ∈ p.support) :
    (s.sum fun _ e => e) ≤ totalDegree p
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_sup (α := ℕ) (f := fun s => sum s fun _ e => e) h

name: totalDegree_le_degrees_card
statement:
theorem totalDegree_le_degrees_card (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    p.totalDegree ≤ Multiset.card p.degrees
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [totalDegree_eq]
  exact Finset.sup_le fun s hs => Multiset.card_le_card <| Finset.le_sup hs

name: totalDegree_le_of_support_subset
statement:
theorem totalDegree_le_of_support_subset (h : p.support ⊆ q.support) :
    totalDegree p ≤ totalDegree q

name: totalDegree_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalDegree_C (a : R) : (C a : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = 0

name: totalDegree_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalDegree_zero : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_0]; exact totalDegree_C (0 : R)

name: totalDegree_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalDegree_one : (1 : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = 0

name: totalDegree_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalDegree_X {R} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (s : σ) :
    (X s : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalDegree, support_X]
  simp only [Finset.sup, Finsupp.sum_single_index, Finset.fold_singleton, sup_bot_eq]

name: totalDegree_add
statement:
theorem totalDegree_add (a b : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (a + b).totalDegree ≤ max a.totalDegree b.totalDegree

name: totalDegree_add_eq_left_of_totalDegree_lt
statement:
theorem totalDegree_add_eq_left_of_totalDegree_lt {p q : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : q.totalDegree < p.totalDegree) : (p + q).totalDegree = p.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← max_eq_left_of_lt h]
      exact totalDegree_add p q
    by_cases hp : p = 0
    · simp [hp]
    obtain ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩ :=
      p.support.exists_mem_eq_sup (by simpa) fun m : σ →₀ ℕ => Multiset.card (toMultiset m)
    have hb : b ∉ q.support := by
      contrapose! h
      rw [totalDegree_eq p, hb₂, totalDegree_eq]
      apply Finset.le_sup h
    have hbb : b ∈ (p + q).support := by
      apply support_sdiff_support_subset_support_add
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
      exact ⟨hb₁, hb⟩
    rw [totalDegree_eq, hb₂, totalDegree_eq]
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun m => Multiset.card (Finsupp.toMultiset m)) hbb

name: totalDegree_add_eq_right_of_totalDegree_lt
statement:
theorem totalDegree_add_eq_right_of_totalDegree_lt {p q : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : q.totalDegree < p.totalDegree) : (q + p).totalDegree = p.totalDegree

name: totalDegree_mul
statement:
theorem totalDegree_mul (a b : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (a * b).totalDegree ≤ a.totalDegree + b.totalDegree

name: totalDegree_smul_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_smul_le [CommSemiring S] [DistribMulAction R S] (a : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ S) :
    (a • f).totalDegree ≤ f.totalDegree

name: totalDegree_pow
statement:
theorem totalDegree_pow (a : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    (a ^ n).totalDegree ≤ n * a.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.pow_eq_prod_const, ← Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.nsmul_eq_sum_const]
  refine supDegree_prod_le rfl (fun _ _ => ?_)
  exact Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

name: totalDegree_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalDegree_monomial (s : σ →₀ ℕ) {c : R} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (monomial s c : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = s.sum fun _ e => e
proof:
:= by
  classical simp [totalDegree, support_monomial, ite_eq_right hc]

name: totalDegree_monomial_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_monomial_le (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    (monomial s c).totalDegree ≤ s.sum fun _ ↦ id
proof:
:= by
  if hc : c = 0 then
    simp only [hc, map_zero, totalDegree_zero, zero_le]
  else
    rw [totalDegree_monomial _ hc, Function.id_def]

name: totalDegree_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalDegree_X_pow [Nontrivial R] (s : σ) (n : ℕ) :
    (X s ^ n : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = n

name: totalDegree_list_prod
statement:
theorem totalDegree_list_prod (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    l.prod.totalDegree ≤ (l.map MvPolynomial.totalDegree).sum

name: totalDegree_multiset_prod
statement:
theorem totalDegree_multiset_prod (s : Multiset (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    s.prod.totalDegree ≤ (s.map MvPolynomial.totalDegree).sum

name: totalDegree_finsetProd
statement:
theorem totalDegree_finsetProd {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (s.prod f).totalDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree

name: totalDegree_finsetSum
statement:
theorem totalDegree_finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (s.sum f).totalDegree ≤ Finset.sup s fun i => (f i).totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => exact zero_le
  | cons a s has hind =>
    rw [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sup_cons]
    exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le_max le_rfl hind)

name: totalDegree_finsetSum_le
statement:
lemma totalDegree_finsetSum_le {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree ≤ d) : (s.sum f).totalDegree ≤ d

name: degreeOf_le_totalDegree
statement: lemma degreeOf_le_totalDegree (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ) : f.degreeOf i ≤ f.totalDegree
proof:
:=
  degreeOf_le_iff.mpr fun d hd ↦ (eq_or_ne (d i) 0).elim (by lia) fun h ↦
    (Finset.single_le_sum (by lia) <| Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h).trans
    (le_totalDegree hd)

name: exists_degree_lt
statement:
theorem exists_degree_lt [Fintype σ] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ)
    (h : f.totalDegree < n * Fintype.card σ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ f.support) : ∃ i, d i < n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  calc
    n * Fintype.card σ = ∑ _s : σ, n := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm, Finset.card_univ]
    _ ≤ ∑ s, d s := Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => h s
    _ ≤ d.sum fun _ e => e := by
      rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype]
      intros
      rfl
    _ ≤ f.totalDegree := le_totalDegree hd

name: coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (h : f.totalDegree < ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i) : f.coeff d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalDegree, Finset.sup_lt_iff] at h
  · specialize h d
    rw [mem_support_iff] at h
    refine not_not.mp (mt h ?_)
    exact lt_irrefl _
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) h

name: totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C
statement:
theorem totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C {p : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    p.totalDegree = 0 ↔ p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · ext m; classical rw [coeff_C]; split_ifs with hm; · rw [← hm]
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt; rw [h]
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i hi ↦ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <| Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi)
      (Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr <| Ne.symm hm)
  · rw [h, totalDegree_C]

name: totalDegree_rename_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_rename_le (f : σ → τ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (rename f p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup_le fun b h => by
    classical
    have h' := Finsupp.mapDomain_support h
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at h'
    rcases h' with ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact (sum_mapDomain_index (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)).trans_le (le_totalDegree hs)

name: totalDegree_renameEquiv
statement:
lemma totalDegree_renameEquiv (f : σ ≃ τ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (renameEquiv R f p).totalDegree = p.totalDegree

name: mem_degreesLE
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_degreesLE : p ∈ degreesLE R σ s ↔ p.degrees ≤ s

name: degreesLE_add
statement: lemma degreesLE_add : degreesLE R σ (s + t) = degreesLE R σ s * degreesLE R σ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, Submodule.mul_le]
  refine ⟨fun x hx ↦ x.as_sum ▸ sum_mem fun i hi ↦ ?_,
    fun x hx y hy ↦ degrees_mul_le.trans (add_le_add hx hy)⟩
  replace hi : i.toMultiset ≤ s + t := (Finset.le_sup hi).trans hx
  let a := (i.toMultiset - t).toFinsupp
  let b := (i.toMultiset ⊓ t).toFinsupp
  have : a + b = i := Multiset.toFinsupp.symm.injective (by simp [a, b, Multiset.sub_add_inter])
  have ha : a.toMultiset ≤ s := by simpa [a, add_comm (a := t)] using hi
  have hb : b.toMultiset ≤ t := by simp [b, Multiset.inter_le_right]
  rw [show monomial i (x.coeff i) = monomial a (x.coeff i) * monomial b 1 by simp [this]]
  exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul ((degrees_monomial _ _).trans ha) ((degrees_monomial _ _).trans hb)

name: degreesLE_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma degreesLE_zero : degreesLE R σ 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (by simp)
  simp only [mem_degreesLE, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at hx
  have := (totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C (p := x)).mp
    (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (x.totalDegree_le_degrees_card.trans (by simp [hx])))
  exact ⟨x.coeff 0, by simp [Algebra.smul_def, ← this]⟩

name: vars_bind
statement:
theorem vars_bind₁ [DecidableEq τ] (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (bind₁ f φ).vars ⊆ φ.vars.biUnion fun i => (f i).vars
proof:
:= by
  calc (bind₁ f φ).vars
    _ = (φ.support.sum fun x : σ →₀ ℕ => (bind₁ f) (monomial x (φ.coeff x))).vars := by
      rw [← map_sum, ← φ.as_sum]
    _ ≤ φ.support.biUnion fun i : σ →₀ ℕ => ((bind₁ f) (monomial i (φ.coeff i))).vars :=
      (vars_sum_subset _ _)
    _ = φ.support.biUnion fun d : σ →₀ ℕ => vars (C (φ.coeff d) * ∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i) := by
      simp only [bind₁_monomial]
    _ ≤ φ.support.biUnion fun d : σ →₀ ℕ => d.support.biUnion fun i => vars (f i) := ?_
    
    _ ≤ φ.vars.biUnion fun i : σ => vars (f i) := ?_
    
  · apply Finset.biUnion_mono
    intro d _hd
    calc
      vars (C (φ.coeff d) * ∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i) ≤
          (C (φ.coeff d)).vars ∪ (∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i).vars :=
        vars_mul _ _
      _ ≤ (∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i).vars := by
        simp only [Finset.empty_union, vars_C, Finset.Subset.refl]
      _ ≤ d.support.biUnion fun i : σ => vars (f i ^ d i) := vars_prod _
      _ ≤ d.support.biUnion fun i : σ => (f i).vars := ?_
    apply Finset.biUnion_mono
    intro i _hi
    apply vars_pow
  · intro j
    simp_rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    rintro ⟨d, hd, ⟨i, hi, hj⟩⟩
    exact ⟨i, (mem_vars_iff_mem_support _).mpr ⟨d, hd, hi⟩, hj⟩

    (hdd' : d ≠ d') (hc : p.coeff d = c) :
    d ∉ (p - (monomial d c - monomial d' c)).support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [notMem_support_iff, coeff_sub, coeff_sub, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial,

name: support_sub_monomial_sub_monomial_subset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  have hd_not := notMem_support_sub_monomial_sub_monomial p d d' c hdd' hc
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_sub σ p _ hx) with hp | hdelta
  · by_cases hxd : x = d
    · exact absurd (hxd ▸ hx) hd_not
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hxd, hp⟩)
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_sub σ _ _ hdelta) with h1 | h2
  · rw [support_monomial] at h1
    split_ifs at h1
    · exact absurd h1 (Finset.notMem_empty _)
    exact absurd ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp h1) ▸ hx) hd_not
  rw [support_monomial] at h2
  split_ifs at h2
  · exact absurd h2 (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (by rwa [Finset.mem_singleton] at h2 ⊢)

lemma degreeOf_prod_eq {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    degreeOf n (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, degreeOf n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (MvPolynomial σ R) with nontrivial | nontrivial
  · simp [Subsingleton.eq_zero (α := MvPolynomial σ R)]
  · classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s a_not_mem ih =>
      simp only [mem_insert, ne_eq, forall_eq_or_imp] at h
      obtain ⟨ha, hs⟩ := h
      simp [a_not_mem, not_false_eq_true, prod_insert, sum_insert, degreeOf_mul_eq ha
        (by rw [prod_ne_zero_iff]; exact hs), ih hs]

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    use f.coeff 0
    suffices f.totalDegree = 0 by
      rw [totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C] at this
      refine ⟨?_, this⟩
      rw [this, C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff] at hf
      simpa using hf 0
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
    simpa using totalDegree_le_of_dvd_of_isDomain hf (by simp [ha])
  · rintro ⟨b, hab, rfl⟩
    exact map_dvd C hab

name: degreeOf_C_mul
statement: theorem degreeOf_C_mul (j : σ) (c : R) (hc : c ∈ R⁰) : degreeOf j (C c * p) = degreeOf j p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp]
  classical
  simp_rw [degreeOf_eq_natDegree, map_mul, ← renameEquiv_apply]
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul']
  · simp
  · have hp' : (optionEquivLeft R _ ((rename (optionSubtypeNe j).symm) p)).leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      exact hp (rename_injective _ (Equiv.injective _) (by simpa using h))
    simp_rw [ne_eq, renameEquiv_apply, algHom_C, algebraMap_eq, optionEquivLeft_C,
      Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C]
    contrapose hp'
    ext m
    apply hc.1
    simpa using congr_arg ((·.coeff m)) hp'

name: dvd_monomial_iff_exists
statement:
theorem dvd_monomial_iff_exists {n : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    p ∣ monomial n a ↔ ∃ m b, m ≤ n ∧ b ∣ a ∧ p = monomial m b
proof:
:= by
  rw [show monomial n a = monomial n 1 * C a by rw [mul_comm, C_mul_monomial, mul_one],
    dvd_monomial_mul_iff_exists]
  apply exists_congr
  intro m
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hmn, hr, h⟩
    rw [dvd_C_iff_exists ha] at hr
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hr⟩ := hr
    use b, hmn, hb
    rw [h, mul_comm, hr, C_mul_monomial, mul_one]
  · rintro ⟨b, hmn, hb, h⟩
    use C b, hmn, map_dvd C hb
    rwa [mul_comm, C_mul_monomial, mul_one]

name: dvd_monomial_one_iff_exists
statement:
theorem dvd_monomial_one_iff_exists {n : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    p ∣ monomial n 1 ↔ ∃ m u, m ≤ n ∧ IsUnit u ∧ p = monomial m u
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · suffices ∃ m, m ≤ n by simpa [Subsingleton.elim _ p]
    use n
  rw [dvd_monomial_iff_exists (one_ne_zero' R)]
  apply exists_congr
  intro m
  simp_rw [isUnit_iff_dvd_one]

name: dvd_smul_X_iff_exists
statement:
theorem dvd_smul_X_iff_exists {i : σ} {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    p ∣ r • X i ↔ ∃ s, s ∣ r ∧ (p = C s ∨ p = s • X i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X, smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, dvd_monomial_iff_exists hr, exists_comm]
  apply exists_congr
  intro b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hmn, hb, rfl⟩
    simp only [hb, true_and]
    suffices m = 0 ∨ m = Finsupp.single i 1 by
      apply this.imp <;> simp +contextual [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    by_cases hm : m i = 0
    · left
      ext j
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, ← Nat.le_zero]
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · rw [← hm, hj]
      · exact (hmn j).trans (Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hj).le
    · right
      ext j
      apply le_antisymm (hmn j)
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · simpa [hj, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
      · simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hj]
  · rintro ⟨hb, hp | hp⟩
    · use 0; simp [hb, hp]
    · use Finsupp.single i 1, le_rfl, hb
      simp [hp, smul_monomial]

name: dvd_X_iff_exists
statement:
theorem dvd_X_iff_exists {i : σ} :
    p ∣ X i ↔ ∃ r, IsUnit r ∧ (p = C r ∨ p = r • X i)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [← one_smul R (X i), dvd_smul_X_iff_exists (one_ne_zero' R)]
  apply exists_congr
  intro r
  rw [isUnit_iff_dvd_one, one_smul]

proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial_eq, C_1, one_mul, Finsupp.prod, Finset.prod_subset (support_indicator_subset _ _)]
  · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun _ hi ↦ by simp [Finsupp.indicator, hi])

name: induction_on_monomial
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_monomial {motive : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop}
    (C : ∀ a, motive (C a))
    (mul_X : ∀ p n, motive p → motive (p * X n)) : ∀ s a, motive (monomial s a)
proof:
:= by
  intro s a
  apply @Finsupp.induction σ ℕ _ _ s
  · change motive (monomial 0 a)
    exact C a
  · intro n e p _hpn _he ih
    have : ∀ e : ℕ, motive (monomial p a * X n ^ e) := by
      intro e
      induction e with
      | zero => simp [ih]
      | succ e e_ih => simp [pow_succ, (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm, mul_X, e_ih]
    simp [add_comm, monomial_add_single, this]

name: induction_on'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on' {P : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (monomial : ∀ (u : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R), P (monomial u a))
    (add : ∀ p q : MvPolynomial σ R, P p → P q → P (p + q)) : P p
proof:
:=
  induction p
    (suffices P (MvPolynomial.monomial 0 0) by rwa [monomial_zero] at this
    show P (MvPolynomial.monomial 0 0) from monomial 0 0)
    fun _ _ _ _ha _hb hPf => add _ _ (monomial _ _) hPf

name: monomial_add_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem monomial_add_induction_on {motive : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (C : ∀ a, motive (C a))
    (monomial_add :
      ∀ (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (b : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
        a ∉ f.coeff.support → b ≠ 0 → motive f → motive (monomial a b + f)) :
    motive p

name: induction_on''
statement:
theorem induction_on'' {motive : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (C : ∀ a, motive (C a))
    (monomial_add :
      ∀ (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (b : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
        a ∉ f.coeff.support → b ≠ 0 → motive f → motive (monomial a b) →
          motive ((monomial a b) + f))
    (mul_X : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ), motive p → motive (p * MvPolynomial.X n)) :
    motive p
proof:
:=
  monomial_add_induction_on p C fun a b f ha hb hf =>
    monomial_add a b f ha hb hf <| induction_on_monomial C mul_X a b

name: induction_on
statement:
@[recursor 5]
theorem induction_on {motive : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (C : ∀ a, motive (C a))
    (add : ∀ p q, motive p → motive q → motive (p + q))
    (mul_X : ∀ p n, motive p → motive (p * X n)) : motive p
proof:
:=
  induction_on'' p C (fun a b f _ha _hb hf hm => add (monomial a b) f hm hf) mul_X

name: eq_monomial_of_support_subset_singleton
statement:
theorem eq_monomial_of_support_subset_singleton {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {d₀ : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (h : ∀ d ∈ φ.support, d = d₀) : φ = monomial d₀ (coeff φ d₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  rcases eq_or_ne d d₀ with rfl | hd
  · rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · rw [notMem_support_iff.mp fun hmem ↦ hd (h d hmem), coeff_monomial,
      ite_eq_right fun e ↦ hd e.symm]

name: coeff_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_C [DecidableEq σ] (m) (a) :
    coeff (C a : MvPolynomial σ R) m = if 0 = m then a else 0

name: coeff_C_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem coeff_C_of_ne_zero {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : m ≠ 0) (a : R) : coeff (C a) m = 0

name: coeff_add_single_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_add_single_C {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (a : R) (i : σ) :
    coeff (C a) (m + Finsupp.single i n) = 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_C_of_ne_zero (fun H ↦ by simpa [NeZero.ne] using congr($(H) i)) a

name: eq_C_of_isEmpty
statement:
lemma eq_C_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty σ] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := C_surjective σ p
  simp

name: coeff_one
statement: theorem coeff_one [DecidableEq σ] (m) : coeff (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) m = if 0 = m then 1 else 0

name: coeff_zero_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_C (a) : coeff (C a : MvPolynomial σ R) 0 = a

name: coeff_zero_one
statement:
@[deprecated AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_one_zero (since := "2026-07-08")]
theorem coeff_zero_one : coeff (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) 0 = 1

name: coeff_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_X_pow [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (m) (k : ℕ) :
    (X i ^ k : MvPolynomial σ R).coeff m = if Finsupp.single i k = m then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := coeff_monomial m (Finsupp.single i k) (1 : R)
  rwa [@monomial_eq _ _ (1 : R) (Finsupp.single i k) _, C_1, one_mul, Finsupp.prod_single_index]
    at this
  exact pow_zero _

name: coeff_X
statement:
theorem coeff_X [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (m) :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).coeff m = if Finsupp.single i 1 = m then 1 else 0

name: coeff_X_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_X_same (i : σ) :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).coeff (Finsupp.single i 1) = 1

name: coeff_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_C_mul (m) (a : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (C a * p).coeff m = a * p.coeff m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mul_def, sum_C]
  · simp +contextual [sum_def]
  simp

name: coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_mul [DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (p * q).coeff n = ∑ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, p.coeff x.1 * q.coeff x.2

name: coeff_mul_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_monomial (m) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p * monomial s r).coeff (m + s) = p.coeff m * r

name: coeff_monomial_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_monomial_mul (m) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (monomial s r * p).coeff (s + m) = r * p.coeff m

name: coeff_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_X (m) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p * X s).coeff (m + Finsupp.single s 1) = p.coeff m

name: coeff_X_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_X_mul (m) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (X s * p).coeff (Finsupp.single s 1 + m) = p.coeff m

name: coeff_single_X_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_single_X_pow [DecidableEq σ] (s s' : σ) (n n' : ℕ) :
    (X (R := R) s ^ n).coeff (Finsupp.single s' n')
    = if s = s' ∧ n = n' ∨ n = 0 ∧ n' = 0 then 1 else 0

name: coeff_single_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_single_X [DecidableEq σ] (s s' : σ) (n : ℕ) :
    (X s).coeff (R := R) (Finsupp.single s' n) = if n = 1 ∧ s = s' then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [eq_comm, and_comm] using coeff_single_X_pow s s' 1 n

name: coeff_prod_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_X_pow [DecidableEq σ] (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (x : σ → ℕ) (s : Finset σ) :
    (∏ y ∈ s, (X y : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ x y).coeff d =
      if d = Finsupp.indicator s (fun i _ ↦ x i) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prod_X_pow x s, coeff_monomial, eq_comm]

name: support_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_mul_X (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p * X s).support = p.support.map (addRightEmbedding (Finsupp.single s 1))

name: support_X_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_X_mul (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (X s * p).support = p.support.map (addLeftEmbedding (Finsupp.single s 1))

name: support_smul_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_smul_eq {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [IsDomain S] [Module S R]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree S R] {a : S} (h : a ≠ 0) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (a • p).support = p.support

name: support_sdiff_support_subset_support_add
statement:
theorem support_sdiff_support_subset_support_add [DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    p.support \ q.support ⊆ (p + q).support
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  simp only [Classical.not_not, mem_support_iff, Finset.mem_sdiff, Ne] at hm
  simp [hm.2, hm.1]

name: support_symmDiff_support_subset_support_add
statement:
theorem support_symmDiff_support_subset_support_add [DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    p.support ∆ q.support ⊆ (p + q).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [symmDiff_def, Finset.sup_eq_union]
  apply Finset.union_subset
  · exact support_sdiff_support_subset_support_add p q
  · rw [add_comm]
    exact support_sdiff_support_subset_support_add q p

name: coeff_mul_monomial'
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_monomial' (m) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p * monomial s r).coeff m = if s ≤ m then p.coeff (m - s) * r else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  split_ifs with h
  · conv_rhs => rw [← coeff_mul_monomial _ s]
    rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le h]
  · contrapose! h
    rw [← mem_support_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ : ∃ j ∈ support p, j + s = m := by
      simpa [Finset.mem_add]
        using Finset.add_subset_add_left support_monomial_subset <| support_mul _ _ h
    exact le_add_left le_rfl

name: coeff_monomial_mul'
statement:
theorem coeff_monomial_mul' (m) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (monomial s r * p).coeff m = if s ≤ m then r * p.coeff (m - s) else 0
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [mul_comm, mul_comm r]
  exact coeff_mul_monomial' _ _ _ _

name: coeff_mul_X'
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_X' [DecidableEq σ] (m) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p * X s).coeff m = if s ∈ m.support then p.coeff (m - Finsupp.single s 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (coeff_mul_monomial' _ _ _ _).trans ?_
  simp_rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Nat.succ_le_iff, pos_iff_ne_zero,
    mul_one]

name: coeff_X_mul'
statement:
theorem coeff_X_mul' [DecidableEq σ] (m) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (X s * p).coeff m = if s ∈ m.support then p.coeff (m - Finsupp.single s 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (coeff_monomial_mul' _ _ _ _).trans ?_
  simp_rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Nat.succ_le_iff, pos_iff_ne_zero,
    one_mul]

name: eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem eq_zero_iff {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p = 0 ↔ ∀ d, p.coeff d = 0

name: ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem ne_zero_iff {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ d, p.coeff d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, eq_zero_iff]
  push Not
  rfl

name: X_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] (s : σ) :
    X (R := R) s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_zero_iff]
  use Finsupp.single s 1
  simp only [coeff_X_same, ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]

name: support_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_eq_empty {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p.support = ∅ ↔ p = 0

name: support_nonempty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_nonempty {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p.support.Nonempty ↔ p ≠ 0

name: exists_coeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem exists_coeff_ne_zero {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : p ≠ 0) : ∃ d, p.coeff d ≠ 0

name: _root_.IsRegular.monomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isLeftRegular_iff_isRegular]
  intro p q h
  ext d
  have h' := congr_arg ((·.coeff (m + d))) h
  simp only [coeff_monomial_mul] at h'
  rw [← ha.left.eq_iff, h']

name: monomial_one_mul_cancel_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_one_mul_cancel_left_iff {m : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    monomial m 1 * p = monomial m 1 * q ↔ p = q

name: X_mul_cancel_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_mul_cancel_left_iff {i : σ} :
    X i * p = X i * q ↔ p = q

name: monomial_one_mul_cancel_right_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_one_mul_cancel_right_iff {m : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    p * monomial m 1 = q * monomial m 1 ↔ p = q

name: X_mul_cancel_right_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_mul_cancel_right_iff {i : σ} :
    p * X i = q * X i ↔ p = q

name: C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff
statement: theorem C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (r : R) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) : C r ∣ φ ↔ ∀ i, r ∣ φ.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩ c
    rw [coeff_C_mul]
    apply dvd_mul_right
  · intro h
    choose C hc using h
    classical
      let c' : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R := fun i => if i ∈ φ.support then C i else 0
      let ψ : MvPolynomial σ R := ∑ i ∈ φ.support, monomial i (c' i)
      use ψ
      apply MvPolynomial.ext
      intro i
      simp only [ψ, c', coeff_C_mul, coeff_sum, coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
      split_ifs with hi
      · rw [hc]
      · rw [notMem_support_iff] at hi
        rwa [mul_zero]

name: isRegular_X
statement: @[simp] lemma isRegular_X : IsRegular (X n : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  suffices IsLeftRegular (X n : MvPolynomial σ R) from
    ⟨this, this.right_of_commute <| Commute.all _⟩
  intro P Q (hPQ : (X n) * P = (X n) * Q)
  ext i
  rw [← coeff_X_mul i n P, hPQ, coeff_X_mul i n Q]

name: isRegular_X_pow
statement: @[simp] lemma isRegular_X_pow (k : ℕ) : IsRegular (X n ^ k : MvPolynomial σ R)

name: isRegular_prod_X
statement:
@[simp] lemma isRegular_prod_X (s : Finset σ) :
    IsRegular (∏ n ∈ s, X n : MvPolynomial σ R)

name: coeffs_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeffs_zero : coeffs (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) = ∅

name: coeffs_one
statement: lemma coeffs_one : coeffs (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) ⊆ {1}

name: coeffs_eq_empty_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
lemma coeffs_eq_empty_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p.coeffs = ∅

name: coeffs_one_of_nontrivial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeffs_one_of_nontrivial [Nontrivial R] : coeffs (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) = {1}
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm coeffs_one
  simp only [coeffs, Finset.singleton_subset_iff, Finset.mem_image]
  exact ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: mem_coeffs_iff
statement:
lemma mem_coeffs_iff {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {c : R} :
    c ∈ p.coeffs ↔ ∃ n ∈ p.support, c = p.coeff n

name: coeff_mem_coeffs
statement:
lemma coeff_mem_coeffs {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (m : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (h : p.coeff m ≠ 0) : p.coeff m ∈ p.coeffs
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  Finset.mem_image_of_mem p.coeff (mem_support_iff.mpr h)

name: zero_notMem_coeffs
statement: lemma zero_notMem_coeffs (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : 0 ∉ p.coeffs
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnsupp, hn⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.mp hz
  exact (mem_support_iff.mp hnsupp) hn.symm

name: coeffs_C
statement: lemma coeffs_C [DecidableEq R] (r : R) : (C (σ := σ) r).coeffs = if r = 0 then ∅ else {r}

name: coeffs_C_subset
statement: lemma coeffs_C_subset (r : R) : (C (σ := σ) r).coeffs ⊆ {r}

name: coeffs_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeffs_mul_X (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ) : (p * X n).coeffs = p.coeffs

name: coeffs_X_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeffs_X_mul (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ) : (X n * p).coeffs = p.coeffs

name: coeffs_add
statement:
lemma coeffs_add [DecidableEq R] {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (p + q).coeffs = p.coeffs ∪ q.coeffs
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp only [mem_coeffs_iff, mem_support_iff, coeff_add, ne_eq, Finset.mem_union]
  have hl (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (hne : p.coeff n ≠ 0) : q.coeff n = 0 :=
    notMem_support_iff.mp <| h.notMem_of_mem_left_finset (mem_support_iff.mpr hne)
  have hr (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (hne : q.coeff n ≠ 0) : p.coeff n = 0 :=
    notMem_support_iff.mp <| h.notMem_of_mem_right_finset (mem_support_iff.mpr hne)
  have hor (n) (h : ¬p.coeff n + q.coeff n = 0) : p.coeff n ≠ 0 ∨ q.coeff n ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases hp : p.coeff n = 0 <;> simp_all
  refine ⟨fun ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain (h | h) := hor n hn1
    · exact Or.inl ⟨n, by simp [h, hn2, hl n h]⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by simp [h, hn2, hr n h]⟩
  · rintro (⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨n, by simp [hl n hn, hn]⟩
    · exact ⟨n, by simp [hr n hn, hn]⟩

name: constantCoeff_eq
statement: theorem constantCoeff_eq (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p.constantCoeff = p.coeff 0

name: constantCoeff_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_C (r : R) : constantCoeff (C r : MvPolynomial σ R) = r

name: constantCoeff_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_X (i : σ) : constantCoeff (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0

name: constantCoeff_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_smul {R : Type*} [SMulZeroClass R S₁] (a : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ S₁) :
    constantCoeff (a • f) = a • constantCoeff f

name: constantCoeff_monomial
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_monomial [DecidableEq σ] (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    constantCoeff (monomial d r) = if d = 0 then r else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constantCoeff_eq]
  exact coeff_monomial 0 d r

name: constantCoeff_comp_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_comp_C : constantCoeff.comp (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R) = RingHom.id R
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact constantCoeff_C σ x

name: constantCoeff_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_comp_algebraMap :
    constantCoeff.comp (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial σ R)) = RingHom.id R

name: support_sum_monomial_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_sum_monomial_coeff (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∑ v ∈ p.support, monomial v (p.coeff v) = p
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidAlgebra.ext; rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum]; exact Finsupp.sum_single _

name: as_sum
statement: theorem as_sum (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p = ∑ v ∈ p.support, monomial v (p.coeff v)

name: mem_coeffsIn
statement: lemma mem_coeffsIn : p ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ ∀ i, p.coeff i ∈ M

name: monomial_mem_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma monomial_mem_coeffsIn : monomial i x ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ x ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mem_coeffsIn, coeff_monomial]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h i, fun hs j ↦ by split <;> simp [hs]⟩

name: C_mem_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma C_mem_coeffsIn : C x ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ x ∈ M

name: one_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_coeffsIn : 1 ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ 1 ∈ M

name: mul_monomial_mem_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_monomial_mem_coeffsIn : p * monomial i 1 ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ p ∈ coeffsIn σ M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_coeffsIn, coeff_mul_monomial']
  constructor
  · rintro hp j
    simpa using hp (j + i)
  · rintro hp i
    split <;> simp [hp]

name: monomial_mul_mem_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma monomial_mul_mem_coeffsIn : monomial i 1 * p ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ p ∈ coeffsIn σ M

name: mul_X_mem_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_X_mem_coeffsIn : p * X s ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ p ∈ coeffsIn σ M

name: X_mul_mem_coeffsIn
statement:
@[simp]
lemma X_mul_mem_coeffsIn : X s * p ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ p ∈ coeffsIn σ M

name: coeffsIn_eq_span_monomial
statement: lemma coeffsIn_eq_span_monomial : coeffsIn σ M = .span R {monomial i m | (m ∈ M) (i : σ →₀ ℕ)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ <| Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  · rintro p hp
    rw [p.as_sum]
    exact sum_mem fun i hi ↦ Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, hp i, _, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨m, hm, s, n, rfl⟩ i
    simp
    split <;> simp [hm]

name: coeffsIn_le
statement:
lemma coeffsIn_le {N : Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ S)} :
    coeffsIn σ M ≤ N ↔ ∀ m ∈ M, ∀ i, monomial i m ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeffsIn_eq_span_monomial, Submodule.span_le, Set.subset_def,
    forall_comm (α := MvPolynomial σ S)]

name: mem_coeffsIn_iff_coeffs_subset
statement: lemma mem_coeffsIn_iff_coeffs_subset : p ∈ coeffsIn σ M ↔ (p.coeffs : Set S) ⊆ M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_coeffsIn, coeffs, Finset.coe_image, image_subset_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h x _ ↦ h x, fun h i ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hp : i ∈ p.support
  · exact h hp
  · convert! M.zero_mem
    simpa using hp

name: coeffsIn_mul
statement: lemma coeffsIn_mul (M N : Submodule R S) : coeffsIn σ (M * N) = coeffsIn σ M * coeffsIn σ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (coeffsIn_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · intro r hr s
    induction hr using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
    | mem_mul_mem m hm n hn =>
      rw [← add_zero s, ← monomial_mul_monomial]
      apply Submodule.mul_mem_mul <;> simpa
    | add x _ y _ hx hy =>
      simpa [map_add] using add_mem hx hy
  · rw [Submodule.mul_le]
    intro x hx y hy k
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_mul]
    exact sum_mem fun c hc ↦ Submodule.mul_mem_mul (hx _) (hy _)

name: coeffsIn_pow
statement:
lemma coeffsIn_pow : ∀ {n}, n ≠ 0 → ∀ M : Submodule R S, coeffsIn σ (M ^ n) = coeffsIn σ M ^ n
  | 1, _, M => by simp
  | n + 2, _, M => by rw [pow_succ, coeffsIn_mul, coeffsIn_pow, ← pow_succ]; exact n.succ_ne_zero

name: le_coeffsIn_pow
statement:
lemma le_coeffsIn_pow : ∀ {n}, coeffsIn σ M ^ n ≤ coeffsIn σ (M ^ n)
  | 0 => by simpa using ⟨1, map_one _⟩
  | n + 1 => (coeffsIn_pow n.succ_ne_zero _).ge

end Algebra
end coeffsIn

name: monomial_dvd_monomial
statement:
theorem monomial_dvd_monomial {r s : R} {i j : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    monomial i r ∣ monomial j s ↔ (s = 0 ∨ i ≤ j) ∧ r ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [MvPolynomial.ext_iff] at hx
    have hj := hx j
    have hi := hx i
    classical
    simp_rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left] at hj hi
    simp_rw [coeff_monomial_mul'] at hi hj
    split_ifs at hj with hi
    · exact ⟨Or.inr hi, _, hj⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hj, hj.symm ▸ dvd_zero _⟩
  · rintro ⟨h | hij, d, rfl⟩
    · simp_rw [h, monomial_zero, dvd_zero]
    · refine ⟨monomial (j - i) d, ?_⟩
      rw [monomial_mul_monomial, add_tsub_cancel_of_le hij]

name: monomial_one_dvd_monomial_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_one_dvd_monomial_one [Nontrivial R] {i j : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    monomial i (1 : R) ∣ monomial j 1 ↔ i ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial_dvd_monomial]
  simp_rw [one_ne_zero, false_or, dvd_rfl, and_true]

name: X_dvd_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_dvd_X [Nontrivial R] {i j : σ} :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ∣ (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ↔ i = j
proof:
:= by
  refine monomial_one_dvd_monomial_one.trans ?_
  simp_rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, Finsupp.single_apply_ne_zero,
    ne_eq, reduceCtorEq, not_false_eq_true, and_true]

name: X_dvd_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_dvd_monomial {i : σ} {j : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R} :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ∣ monomial j r ↔ r = 0 ∨ j i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine monomial_dvd_monomial.trans ?_
  simp_rw [one_dvd, and_true, Finsupp.single_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]

name: eq_divMonomial_single
statement:
theorem eq_divMonomial_single [IsLeftCancelAdd R]
    {i : σ} {p q r : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : p = X i * q + r)
    (hr : ∀ n ∈ r.support, n i = 0) :
    q = p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_divMonomial, h, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, coeff_X_mul, left_eq_add,
    ← notMem_support_iff]
  intro hn
  simpa using hr _ hn

name: eq_modMonomial_single
statement:
theorem eq_modMonomial_single [IsLeftCancelAdd R]
    {σ : Type*} {i : σ} {p q r : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : p = X i * q + r) (hr : ∀ n ∈ r.support, n i = 0) :
    r = p.modMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := id h
  rwa [← p.divMonomial_add_modMonomial_single i,
    eq_divMonomial_single h hr, add_right_inj, eq_comm] at h'

name: eq_modMonomial_single_iff
statement:
theorem eq_modMonomial_single_iff (h : X i ∣ p - r) :
    r = p.modMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1) ↔
      ∀ n ∈ r.support, n i = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h n ↦ ?_, fun hr ↦ ?_⟩
  · contrapose!
    intro hn
    rw [h, notMem_support_iff]
    apply coeff_modMonomial_of_le
    simpa [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
    apply eq_modMonomial_single (q := q) _ hr
    rwa [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add]

name: X_dvd_mul_iff
statement:
theorem X_dvd_mul_iff [IsCancelMulZero R] :
    X i ∣ p * q ↔ X i ∣ p ∨ X i ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  constructor
  · intro h
    suffices (p.modMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1)) * (q.modMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1)) =
          (p * q).modMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1) by
      simp only [X_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero] at h ⊢
      rwa [h, mul_eq_zero] at this
    have hp := p.modMonomial_add_divMonomial_single i
    have hq := q.modMonomial_add_divMonomial_single i
    rw [eq_modMonomial_single_iff]
    · intro n
      contrapose
      intro hn
      classical
      rw [notMem_support_iff, coeff_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
      simp only [← hx, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or] at hn
      rcases hn with hn | hn
      · rw [coeff_modMonomial_of_le, zero_mul]
        simpa [← Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero] using hn
      · rw [mul_comm, coeff_modMonomial_of_le, zero_mul]
        simpa [← Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero] using hn
    · nth_rewrite 1 [← hp]
      nth_rewrite 1 [← hq]
      simp only [add_mul, mul_add, add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_left]
      simp only [← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (X i)]
      simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_add (X i)]
      apply dvd_mul_right
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h q
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h p

name: X_prime
statement: theorem X_prime [IsCancelMulZero R] [Nontrivial R] : Prime (X i : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨X_ne_zero i, ?_, fun p q ↦ X_dvd_mul_iff.mp⟩
  intro h
  rw [isUnit_iff_exists] at h
  rcases h with ⟨u, hu, -⟩
  apply_fun constantCoeff at hu
  simp at hu

name: dvd_X_mul_iff
statement:
theorem dvd_X_mul_iff [IsCancelMulZero R] :
    p ∣ X i * q ↔ p ∣ q ∨ (X i ∣ p ∧ p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1) ∣ q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hp⟩
    have : X i ∣ p ∨ X i ∣ r := by simp [← X_dvd_mul_iff, ← hp]
    apply this.symm.imp
    · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
      obtain rfl : q = p * r := by rw [← X_mul_cancel_left_iff (i := i), hp, mul_left_comm]
      exact dvd_mul_right p r
    · intro hip
      refine ⟨hip, ?_⟩
      rw [X_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero] at hip
      rw [← p.modMonomial_add_divMonomial_single i, hip,
        zero_add, mul_assoc, X_mul_cancel_left_iff] at hp
      use r
  · rintro (hp | ⟨hi, hq⟩)
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hp (X i)
    · suffices p = X i * p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1) by
        rw [this]
        exact mul_dvd_mul_left (X i) hq
      conv_lhs => rw [← p.modMonomial_add_divMonomial (Finsupp.single i 1)]
      simpa only [← C_mul_X_eq_monomial, C_1, one_mul, add_eq_right,
        ← X_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero]

name: dvd_monomial_mul_iff_exists
statement:
theorem dvd_monomial_mul_iff_exists [IsCancelMulZero R] {n : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    p ∣ monomial n 1 * q ↔ ∃ m r, m ≤ n ∧ r ∣ q ∧ p = monomial m 1 * r
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · simp only [Subsingleton.elim _ p, dvd_refl, and_self, and_true, exists_const, true_iff]
    refine ⟨n, le_refl n⟩
  suffices ∀ (d) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (hd : n.degree = d) (p q : MvPolynomial σ R),
    p ∣ monomial n 1 * q ↔ ∃ m r, m ≤ n ∧ r ∣ q ∧ p = monomial m 1 * r from this n.degree n rfl p q
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro n hn p
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff] at hn
    simp only [hn, monomial_zero', C_1, one_mul, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, exists_and_left,
      exists_eq_left, exists_eq_right', implies_true]
  | succ d hd =>
    intro n hn p q
    refine ⟨fun hp ↦ ?_, fun ⟨m, r, hmn, hrq, hp⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : n.support.Nonempty := by
        rw [Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff]
        intro hn'
        simp [hn'] at hn
      let n' := n - Finsupp.single i 1
      have hn' : n' + Finsupp.single i 1 = n := by
        apply Finsupp.sub_add_single_one_cancel
        rwa [← Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
      have hnn' : n' ≤ n := by simp [← hn']
      have hd' : n'.degree = d := by
        rw [← add_left_inj, ← hn, ← hn']
        simp
      rw [← hn', monomial_add_single, pow_one, mul_comm _ (X i), mul_assoc, dvd_X_mul_iff] at hp
      rcases hp with hp | hp
      · obtain ⟨m, r, hm, hr, hp⟩ := (hd n' hd' p q).mp hp
        exact ⟨m, r, le_trans hm hnn', hr, hp⟩
      · obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := hp.1
        obtain ⟨m, r, hm, hr, hp⟩ := (hd n' hd' _ _).mp hp.2
        use m + Finsupp.single i 1, r, ?_, hr
        · simp [monomial_add_single, pow_one, mul_comm _ (X i), mul_assoc, ← hp]
        · simpa [← hn'] using hm
    · rw [hp, ← add_tsub_cancel_of_le hmn, ← mul_one 1, ← monomial_mul_monomial, mul_one, mul_assoc]
      apply mul_dvd_mul dvd_rfl
      apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hrq

name: mem_supported

:= by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    refine _root_.trans (Finset.coe_subset.2 (vars_rename _ _)) ?_

  · intro hs
    exact exists_rename_eq_of_vars_subset_range p ((↑) : s → σ) Subtype.val_injective (by simpa)

statement:
theorem exists_restrict_to_vars (R : Type*) [CommRing R] {F : MvPolynomial σ ℤ}
    (hF : ↑F.vars ⊆ s) : ∃ f : (s → R) → R, ∀ x : σ → R, f (x ∘ (↑) : s → R) = aeval x F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_supported, supported_eq_range_rename, AlgHom.mem_range] at hF
  obtain ⟨F', hF'⟩ := hF
  use fun z ↦ aeval z F'
  intro x
  simp only [← hF', aeval_rename]

name: uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial
statement:
theorem uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial [Unique σ] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R} :
    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ) (MvPolynomial.monomial d r)
      = Polynomial.monomial (d default) r

      = MvPolynomial.monomial d r

name: coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv [Unique σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ P : Polynomial R).coeff n =
      P.coeff (Finsupp.single default n)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using induction_on' with
  | monomial d r =>
      rw [uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial, Finsupp.unique_single d]
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]

name: optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none
statement:
theorem optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none
    (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R) :
    (Polynomial.coeff (optionEquivLeft R S₁ f) (n none)).coeff n.some = f.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on' generalizing n with
  | monomial j r =>
    rw [optionEquivLeft_monomial]
    classical
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, apply_ite, ite_apply,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    by_cases hj : j = n
    · simp [hj]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hj]
      simp only [ite_eq_right_iff]
      intro hj_none hj_some
      apply False.elim (hj _)
      simp only [Finsupp.ext_iff, Option.forall, hj_none, true_and]
      simpa only [Finsupp.ext_iff] using! hj_some
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq]

name: optionEquivLeft_elim_eval
statement:
theorem optionEquivLeft_elim_eval (s : S₁ → R) (y : R) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R) :
    eval (fun x ↦ Option.elim x y s) f =
      Polynomial.eval y (Polynomial.map (eval s) (optionEquivLeft R S₁ f))
proof:
:= by
  
  let φ : (MvPolynomial S₁ R)[X] →ₐ[R] R[X] :=
    { Polynomial.mapRingHom (eval s) with
      commutes' := fun r => by
        convert! Polynomial.map_C (eval s)
        exact (eval_C _).symm }
  change
    aeval (fun x ↦ Option.elim x y s) f =
      (Polynomial.aeval y).comp (φ.comp (optionEquivLeft _ _).toAlgHom) f
  congr 2
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  rw [Option.forall]
  simp only [aeval_X, Option.elim_none, AlgHom.coe_comp, Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval,
    AlgHom.coe_mk, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, comp_apply,
    optionEquivLeft_apply, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.eval_X, Option.elim_some,
    Polynomial.map_C, eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, implies_true, and_self, φ]

statement:
lemma support_optionEquivLeft (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) :
    (optionEquivLeft R σ p).support = Finset.image (fun m => m none) p.support
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Polynomial.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, MvPolynomial.ext_iff, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero,
    Finsupp.zero_apply, not_forall, Finset.mem_image, mem_support_iff,
    ← optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    exact ⟨optionElim i m, by simpa using! hm, optionElim_apply_none _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨some m, h⟩

  rw [Polynomial.degree, ← h', Nat.cast_withBot,

    Function.comp_def]

name: totalDegree_coeff_optionEquivLeft_add_le
statement:
lemma totalDegree_coeff_optionEquivLeft_add_le
    (p : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ p.totalDegree) :
    ((optionEquivLeft R S₁ p).coeff i).totalDegree + i ≤ p.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hpi : (optionEquivLeft R S₁ p).coeff i = 0
  · rw [hpi]; simpa
  rw [totalDegree, add_comm, Finset.add_sup (by simpa only [support_nonempty]), Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro σ hσ
  refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.le_sup (b := σ.embDomain .some + .single .none i) ?_)
  · simp [Finsupp.sum_add_index, Finsupp.sum_embDomain, add_comm i]
  · simpa [mem_support_iff, ← optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none R S₁] using hσ

  rw [totalDegree, Finset.sup_le_iff]

  refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.le_sup (b := σ.embDomain .some + .single .none i) ?_)

  · simpa [mem_support_iff, ← optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none R S₁] using hσ

name: finSuccEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_eq :
    (finSuccEquiv R n : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R →+* Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) =
      eval₂Hom (Polynomial.C.comp (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
        Fin.cases Polynomial.X (fun k => Polynomial.C (X k)) i
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 2
  · simp only [finSuccEquiv, optionEquivLeft_apply, aeval_C, AlgEquiv.coe_trans, RingHom.coe_coe,
      coe_eval₂Hom, comp_apply, renameEquiv_apply, eval₂_C, RingHom.coe_comp, rename_C]
    rfl
  · refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i <;> simp [optionEquivLeft_apply, finSuccEquiv]

name: finSuccEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_apply (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    finSuccEquiv R n p =
      eval₂Hom (Polynomial.C.comp (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
        (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => Fin.cases Polynomial.X (fun k => Polynomial.C (X k)) i) p

name: finSuccEquiv_comp_C_eq_C
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_comp_C_eq_C {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) :
    (↑(MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).symm : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) →+* _).comp
        (Polynomial.C.comp MvPolynomial.C) =
      (MvPolynomial.C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n.succ) R)
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  refine
    (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).injective
      (Trans.trans ((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).apply_symm_apply _) ?_)
  simp only [MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]

name: finSuccEquiv_X_zero
statement: theorem finSuccEquiv_X_zero : finSuccEquiv R n (X 0) = Polynomial.X

name: finSuccEquiv_X_succ
statement: theorem finSuccEquiv_X_succ {j : Fin n} : finSuccEquiv R n (X j.succ) = Polynomial.C (X j)

name: finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff (m : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.coeff (finSuccEquiv R n f) i).coeff m = f.coeff (m.cons i)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on' generalizing i m with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq]
  | monomial j r =>
    simp only [finSuccEquiv_apply, coe_eval₂Hom, eval₂_monomial, RingHom.coe_comp, Finsupp.prod_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, coeff_C_mul, coeff_monomial, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cases_zero,
      Fin.cases_succ, ← _root_.map_prod, ← map_pow, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← mul_boole, mul_comm (Polynomial.X ^ j 0), Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]; congr 1
    obtain rfl | hjmi := eq_or_ne j (m.cons i)
    · simpa only [cons_zero, cons_succ, ite_eq_left rfl, monomial_eq, C_1, one_mul,
        Finsupp.prod_pow] using! coeff_monomial m m (1 : R)
    · simp only [hjmi, ite_false]
      obtain hij | rfl := ne_or_eq i (j 0)
      · simp only [hij, ite_false, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
      simp only [ite_true]
      have hmj : m ≠ j.tail := by
        rintro rfl
        rw [cons_tail] at hjmi
        contradiction
      simpa only [monomial_eq, C_1, one_mul, Finsupp.prod_pow, tail_apply,
        ite_eq_right hmj.symm] using! coeff_monomial m j.tail (1 : R)

name: eval_eq_eval_mv_eval'
statement:
theorem eval_eq_eval_mv_eval' (s : Fin n → R) (y : R) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    eval (Fin.cons y s : Fin (n + 1) → R) f =
      Polynomial.eval y (Polynomial.map (eval s) (finSuccEquiv R n f))
proof:
:= by
  
  let φ : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)[X] →ₐ[R] R[X] :=
    { Polynomial.mapRingHom (eval s) with
      commutes' := fun r => by
        convert! Polynomial.map_C (eval s)
        exact (eval_C _).symm }
  change
    aeval (Fin.cons y s : Fin (n + 1) → R) f =
      (Polynomial.aeval y).comp (φ.comp (finSuccEquiv R n).toAlgHom) f
  congr 2
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  rw [Fin.forall_iff_succ]
  simp only [aeval_X, Fin.cons_zero, AlgHom.coe_comp, Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval,
    AlgHom.coe_mk, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    comp_apply, finSuccEquiv_apply, eval₂Hom_X', Fin.cases_zero, Polynomial.map_X,
    Polynomial.eval_X, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cases_succ, Polynomial.map_C, eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,
    implies_true, and_self, φ]

name: coeff_eval_eq_eval_coeff
statement:
theorem coeff_eval_eq_eval_coeff (s' : S₁ → R) (f : Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R))
    (i : ℕ) : Polynomial.coeff (Polynomial.map (eval s') f) i = eval s' (Polynomial.coeff f i)

name: mem_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem mem_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {i : ℕ} {m : Fin n →₀ ℕ} :
    m ∈ ((finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i).support ↔ m.cons i ∈ f.support
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro h
    simpa [← finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff] using h
  · intro h
    simpa [mem_support_iff, ← finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff m f i] using h

name: totalDegree_coeff_finSuccEquiv_add_le
statement:
lemma totalDegree_coeff_finSuccEquiv_add_le (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : (finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i ≠ 0) :
    totalDegree ((finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i) + i ≤ totalDegree f
proof:
:= by
  have hf'_sup : ((finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i).support.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, ne_eq, support_eq_empty]
    exact hi
  
  have ⟨σ, hσ1, hσ2⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (support _) hf'_sup
                          (fun s => Finsupp.sum s fun _ e => e)
  
  let σ' : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ := cons i σ
  convert! le_totalDegree (s := σ') _
  · rw [totalDegree, hσ2, sum_cons, add_comm]
  · rw [← mem_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv]
    exact hσ1

name: support_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem support_finSuccEquiv (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    (finSuccEquiv R n f).support = Finset.image (fun m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ => m 0) f.support
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Polynomial.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, MvPolynomial.ext_iff, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero,
    Finsupp.zero_apply, not_forall, Finset.mem_image, mem_support_iff, finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    exact ⟨cons i m, hm, cons_zero _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨tail m, by simpa using h⟩

name: mem_support_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem mem_support_finSuccEquiv {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {x} :
    x ∈ (finSuccEquiv R n f).support ↔ x ∈ (fun m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ _ ↦ m 0) '' f.support

name: image_support_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem image_support_finSuccEquiv {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {i : ℕ} :
    ((finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i).support.image (Finsupp.cons i) = {m ∈ f.support | m 0 = i}
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image, mem_support_iff]
  conv_lhs =>
    congr
    ext
    rw [mem_support_iff, finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff, Ne]
  constructor
  · grind [cons_zero]
  · intro h
    use tail m
    rw [← h.2, cons_tail]
    simp [h.1]

name: mem_image_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv
statement:
lemma mem_image_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} {i : ℕ} {x} :
    x ∈ Finsupp.cons i '' ((finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i).support ↔
      x ∈ f.support ∧ x 0 = i

name: nonempty_support_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_support_finSuccEquiv {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} (h : f ≠ 0) :
    (finSuccEquiv R n f).support.Nonempty

name: degree_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem degree_finSuccEquiv {f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R} (h : f ≠ 0) :
    (finSuccEquiv R n f).degree = degreeOf 0 f
proof:
:= by
  
  have h₀ : ∀ {α β : Type _} (f : α → β), (fun x => x) ∘ f = f := fun f => rfl
  have h₁ : ∀ {α β : Type _} (f : α → β), f ∘ (fun x => x) = f := fun f => rfl
  have h' : ((finSuccEquiv R n f).support.sup fun x => x) = degreeOf 0 f := by
    rw [degreeOf_eq_sup, support_finSuccEquiv, Finset.sup_image, h₀]
  rw [Polynomial.degree, ← h', Nat.cast_withBot,
    Finset.coe_sup_of_nonempty (nonempty_support_finSuccEquiv h), Finset.max_eq_sup_coe, h₁]

name: natDegree_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem natDegree_finSuccEquiv (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) :
    (finSuccEquiv R n f).natDegree = degreeOf 0 f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases c : f = 0
  · rw [c, map_zero, Polynomial.natDegree_zero, degreeOf_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree, degree_finSuccEquiv c, Nat.cast_withBot, WithBot.unbotD_coe]

name: degreeOf_eq_natDegree
statement:
lemma degreeOf_eq_natDegree [DecidableEq σ] (a : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    degreeOf a p =
      (optionEquivLeft R {b // b ≠ a} (rename (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe a).symm p)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDegree_optionEquivLeft, eq_comm]
  convert! degreeOf_rename_of_injective (Equiv.injective (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe a).symm) a
  rw [Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_symm_apply, dite_eq_left rfl]

name: degreeOf_coeff_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem degreeOf_coeff_finSuccEquiv (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (j : Fin n) (i : ℕ) :
    degreeOf j (Polynomial.coeff (finSuccEquiv R n p) i) ≤ degreeOf j.succ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [degreeOf_eq_sup, degreeOf_eq_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro m hm
  rw [← Finsupp.cons_succ j i m]
  exact Finset.le_sup
    (f := fun (g : Fin (Nat.succ n) →₀ ℕ) => g (Fin.succ j))
    (mem_support_coeff_finSuccEquiv.1 hm)

name: finSuccEquiv_rename_finSuccEquiv
statement:
lemma finSuccEquiv_rename_finSuccEquiv (e : σ ≃ Fin n) (φ : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) :
    ((finSuccEquiv R n) ((rename ((Equiv.optionCongr e).trans (_root_.finSuccEquiv n).symm)) φ)) =
      Polynomial.map (rename e).toRingHom (optionEquivLeft R σ φ)
proof:
:= by
  suffices (finSuccEquiv R n).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (rename ((Equiv.optionCongr e).trans
        (_root_.finSuccEquiv n).symm)).toRingHom =
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (rename e).toRingHom).comp (optionEquivLeft R σ) by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this φ
  apply ringHom_ext
  · simp [Polynomial.algebraMap_apply, algebraMap_eq, finSuccEquiv_apply, optionEquivLeft_apply]
  · rintro (i | i) <;> simp [finSuccEquiv_apply, optionEquivLeft_apply]

name: polynomial_eval_eval
statement:
theorem polynomial_eval_eval₂ [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    {x : S} (f : R →+* Polynomial S) (g : σ → Polynomial S) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    Polynomial.eval x (eval₂ f g p) =
      eval₂ ((Polynomial.evalRingHom x).comp f) (fun s => Polynomial.eval x (g s)) p
proof:
:= by
  apply induction_on p
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq
    simp [hp, hq]
  · intro p n hp
    simp [hp]

name: eval_polynomial_eval_finSuccEquiv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finSuccEquiv_apply, coe_eval₂Hom, polynomial_eval_eval₂, eval_eval₂]
  conv in RingHom.comp _ _ =>
    refine @RingHom.ext _ _ _ _ _ (RingHom.id _) fun r => ?_
    simp
  simp only [eval₂_id]
  congr
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases (by simp) (by simp) i

name: coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_eq
statement:
private lemma coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_eq (a : σ →₀ R) {n : ℕ}
    (hs : s.sum (fun _ m ↦ m) = n) :
    ((a.linearCombination R X : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ n).coeff s =
      s.multinomial * s.prod (fun r m ↦ a r ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [sum, linearCombination_apply, Finset.sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag, coeff_sum,
    ← C_eq_coe_nat, coeff_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, mul_pow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← map_pow,
    ← map_prod, coeff_prod_X_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (s : σ → ℕ)]
  · simp_rw [eq_indicator_self_iff]
    split_ifs with hs'
    · rw [prod_of_support_subset _ hs' _ (by simp), Finsupp.multinomial_of_support_subset hs']
    · rw [Finset.subset_iff] at hs'
      simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, not_forall, Decidable.not_not] at hs'
      obtain ⟨i, hsi, hai⟩ := hs'
      rw [← mul_prod_erase _ i _ (by simpa), hai, zero_pow hsi, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  · simp only [Finset.mem_piAntidiag, ne_eq, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ite_eq_right_iff, and_imp]
    intro _ _ _ _ hed
    simp [Finsupp.ext_iff] at hed
    grind
  · simp_rw [ite_eq_right_iff]
    intro hs' hs''
    rw [eq_indicator_self_iff] at hs''
    exfalso
    rw [Finset.mem_piAntidiag, not_and_or] at hs'
    rcases hs' with hs' | hs'
    · apply hs'
      rw [← hs, sum_of_support_subset _ hs'' _ (by simp)]
    · grind

name: coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [sum, linearCombination_apply, Finset.sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag, coeff_sum, ← map_pow,
    ← C_eq_coe_nat, coeff_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, mul_pow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod,
    coeff_prod_X_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  rw [ite_eq_right]
  rintro ⟨rfl⟩
  apply hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_piAntidiag] at hx
  rw [sum_of_support_subset _ (support_indicator_subset a.support _) _ (by simp), ← hx.1]
  congr
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ a.support
  · simp [Finsupp.indicator_of_mem hi]
  · grind [Finsupp.indicator_of_notMem hi]

name: coeff_linearCombination_X_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_linearCombination_X_pow (a : σ →₀ R) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((a.linearCombination R X : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ n).coeff s =
      if s.sum (fun _ m ↦ m) = n then s.multinomial * s.prod (fun r m ↦ a r ^ m) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hs
  · exact coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_eq a hs
  · exact coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_ne a hs

name: coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_fintype
statement:
lemma coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_fintype [Fintype σ] (a : σ → R) (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((∑ i, a i • X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ n).coeff s =
      if s.sum (fun _ m ↦ m) = n then s.multinomial * s.prod (fun r m ↦ a r ^ m) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofSupportFinite_coe (f := a) (hf := Set.toFinite _),
    prod_congr (fun r _ ↦ rfl), ← coeff_linearCombination_X_pow]
  simp [linearCombination_apply, sum_of_support_subset (s := Finset.univ)]

name: coeff_sum_X_pow_of_fintype
statement:
lemma coeff_sum_X_pow_of_fintype [Fintype σ] (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((∑ i, X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ n).coeff d =
      if d.sum (fun _ m ↦ m) = n then d.multinomial else 0
proof:
:= by
  have : (∑ i, X i : MvPolynomial σ R) = ∑ i, (1 : σ → R) i • X i := by simp
  simp [this, coeff_linearCombination_X_pow_of_fintype]

name: coeff_add_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_add_pow (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((X 0 + X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) ^ n).coeff d =
      if (d 0, d 1) ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n then n.choose (d 0) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_two, coeff_sum_X_pow_of_fintype]
  congr 1
  have : d.sum (fun x m ↦ m) = d 0 + d 1 := by
    simp [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset d (Finset.subset_univ d.support)]
  simp only [Finset.mem_antidiagonal, this]
  split_ifs with hd
  · rw [multinomial_eq_of_support_subset (Finset.subset_univ d.support), Finset.univ_fin2,
      Nat.binomial_eq_choose Fin.zero_ne_one, hd]
  · rfl

name: monomial_fin_two
statement:
theorem monomial_fin_two (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    monomial d a = C a * X 0 ^ d 0 * X 1 ^ d 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial_eq, mul_assoc, d.prod_fintype _ fun _ ↦ pow_zero _, Fin.prod_univ_two]

name: cardinalMk_eq_max_lift
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem cardinalMk_eq_max_lift [Nonempty σ] [Nontrivial R] :
    #(MvPolynomial σ R) = lift.{u} #R ⊔ lift.{v} #σ ⊔ ℵ₀

name: cardinalMk_eq_lift
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem cardinalMk_eq_lift [IsEmpty σ] : #(MvPolynomial σ R) = lift.{u} #R

name: cardinalMk_eq_one
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem cardinalMk_eq_one [Subsingleton R] : #(MvPolynomial σ R) = 1

name: cardinalMk_le_max_lift
statement:
theorem cardinalMk_le_max_lift {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] :
    #(MvPolynomial σ R) ≤ lift.{u} #R ⊔ lift.{v} #σ ⊔ ℵ₀
proof:
:= by

name: funext_fin
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    apply (MvPolynomial.isEmptyRingEquiv R (Fin 0)).injective
    simpa [constantCoeff] using h 0 finZeroElim
  | succ n ih =>
    apply (finSuccEquiv R n).injective
    rw [map_zero]
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot
    apply ((hs 0).image (C_injective ..).injOn).mono
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    refine ih (s ·.succ) (fun _ ↦ hs _) fun x hx ↦ ?_
    rw [eval_polynomial_eval_finSuccEquiv]
    exact h _ fun i _ ↦ i.cases (by simpa [eval_C] using hr) (by simpa using hx)

name: funext_set
statement:
theorem funext_set (h : ∀ x ∈ Set.pi .univ s, eval x p = eval x q) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ p, (∀ x ∈ Set.pi .univ s, eval x p = 0) → p = 0 by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, this (p - q)]
    intro x hx
    simp_rw [map_sub, h x hx, sub_self]
  intro p h
  obtain ⟨n, f, hf, p, rfl⟩ := exists_fin_rename p
  suffices p = 0 by rw [this, map_zero]
  refine funext_fin (s ∘ f) (fun _ ↦ hs _) fun x hx ↦ ?_
  choose g hg using fun i ↦ (hs i).nonempty
  convert! h (Function.extend f x g) fun i _ ↦ ?_
  · simp only [eval, eval₂Hom_rename, Function.extend_comp hf]
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ | nex := em (∃ x, f x = i)
  · rw [hf.extend_apply]; exact hx _ ⟨⟩
  · simp_rw [Function.extend, dite_eq_right nex, hg]

theorem IsLocalization.surj_of_gcd_domain [GCDMonoid R] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M A]
    (z : A) : ∃ a b : R, IsUnit (gcd a b) ∧ z * algebraMap R A b = algebraMap R A a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq M z
  obtain ⟨x', y', hx', hy', hu⟩ := extract_gcd x y
  use x', y', hu
  rw [mul_comm, IsLocalization.mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul]
  convert! IsLocalization.mk'_mul_cancel_left (M := M) (S := A) _ _ using 2
  grind

theorem gcd_eq_gcd_filter_ne_zero [DecidablePred fun x : β ↦ f x = 0] :
    s.gcd f = {x ∈ s | f x ≠ 0}.gcd f
proof:
:= by
  classical
    trans ({x ∈ s | f x = 0} ∪ {x ∈ s | f x ≠ 0}).gcd f
    · rw [filter_union_filter_not_eq]
    rw [gcd_union]
    refine Eq.trans (?_ : _ = GCDMonoid.gcd (0 : α) ?_) (?_ : GCDMonoid.gcd (0 : α) _ = _)
    · exact gcd {x ∈ s | f x ≠ 0} f
    · refine congr (congr rfl <| s.induction_on ?_ ?_) (by simp)
      · simp
      · intro a s _ h
        rw [filter_insert]
        split_ifs with h1 <;> simp [h, h1]
    simp only [gcd_zero_left, normalize_gcd]

name: extract_gcd'
statement:
theorem extract_gcd' (f g : β → α) (hs : ∃ x, x ∈ s ∧ f x ≠ 0)
    (hg : ∀ b ∈ s, f b = s.gcd f * g b) : s.gcd g = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalize_gcd, normalize_eq_one, ← associated_one_iff_isUnit]
  refine .of_mul_left (.symm <| .trans ?_ (gcd_mul_left' ..)) .rfl (a := s.gcd f) ?_
  · simp [← gcd_congr rfl hg]
  contrapose! hs
  exact s.gcd_eq_zero_iff.1 hs

name: extract_gcd
statement:
theorem extract_gcd (f : β → α) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g : β → α, (∀ b ∈ s, f b = s.gcd f * g b) ∧ s.gcd g = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
    by_cases! h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = (0 : α)
    · refine ⟨fun _ ↦ 1, fun b hb ↦ by rw [h b hb, gcd_eq_zero_iff.2 h, mul_one], ?_⟩
      rw [gcd_eq_gcd_image, image_const hs, gcd_singleton, id, normalize_one]
    · choose g' hg using @gcd_dvd _ _ _ _ s f
      refine ⟨fun b ↦ if hb : b ∈ s then g' hb else 0, fun b hb ↦ ?_,
          extract_gcd' f _ h fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
      · simp only [hb, hg, dite_true]
      rw [dite_eq_left hb, hg hb]

name: gcd_div_eq_one
statement: lemma gcd_div_eq_one (his : i ∈ s) (hfi : f i ≠ 0) : s.gcd (fun j ↦ f j / s.gcd f) = 1

:= by
  obtain ⟨g, he, hg⟩ := Finset.extract_gcd f ⟨i, his⟩
  refine (Finset.gcd_congr rfl fun a ha ↦ ?_).trans hg
  rw [he a ha, mul_div_cancel_left₀]
  exact mt Finset.gcd_eq_zero_iff.1 fun h ↦ hfi <| h i his

name: gcd_eq_of_dvd_sub
proof:
:= by
  classical
    revert h
    refine s.induction_on ?_ ?_
    · simp
    intro b s _ hi h
    rw [gcd_insert, gcd_insert, gcd_comm (f b), ← gcd_assoc,
      hi fun x hx ↦ h _ (mem_insert_of_mem hx), gcd_comm a, gcd_assoc,
      gcd_comm a (GCDMonoid.gcd _ _), gcd_comm (g b), gcd_assoc _ _ a, gcd_comm _ a]
    exact congr_arg _ (gcd_eq_of_dvd_sub_right (h _ (mem_insert_self _ _)))

name: gcd_assoc
statement: theorem gcd_assoc [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] (m n k : α) : gcd (gcd m n) k = gcd m (gcd n k)
proof:
:=
  dvd_antisymm_of_normalize_eq (normalize_gcd _ _) (normalize_gcd _ _)
    (dvd_gcd ((gcd_dvd_left (gcd m n) k).trans (gcd_dvd_left m n))
      (dvd_gcd ((gcd_dvd_left (gcd m n) k).trans (gcd_dvd_right m n)) (gcd_dvd_right (gcd m n) k)))
    (dvd_gcd
      (dvd_gcd (gcd_dvd_left m (gcd n k)) ((gcd_dvd_right m (gcd n k)).trans (gcd_dvd_left n k)))
      ((gcd_dvd_right m (gcd n k)).trans (gcd_dvd_right n k)))

      (dvd_gcd ((gcd_dvd_left (gcd m n) k).trans (gcd_dvd_right m n)) (gcd_dvd_right (gcd m n) k)))
    (dvd_gcd
      (dvd_gcd (gcd_dvd_left m (gcd n k)) ((gcd_dvd_right m (gcd n k)).trans (gcd_dvd_left n k)))
      ((gcd_dvd_right m (gcd n k)).trans (gcd_dvd_right n k)))

      let ⟨ca, ha⟩ := gcd_dvd_left a b

      rw [h, zero_mul] at ha hb
      exact ⟨ha, hb⟩)
    fun ⟨ha, hb⟩ => by
    rw [ha, hb, ← zero_dvd_iff]
    apply dvd_gcd <;> rfl
