name: gcd_mul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gcd_mul_left [StrongNormalizedGCDMonoid α] (a b c : α) :
    gcd (a * b) (a * c) = normalize a * gcd b c
proof:
:=
  (by_cases (by rintro rfl; simp))
    fun ha : a ≠ 0 =>
    suffices gcd (a * b) (a * c) = normalize (a * gcd b c) by simpa
    let ⟨d, eq⟩ := dvd_gcd (dvd_mul_right a b) (dvd_mul_right a c)
    gcd_eq_normalize
      (eq.symm ▸ mul_dvd_mul_left a
        (show d ∣ gcd b c from
          dvd_gcd ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha).1 <| eq ▸ gcd_dvd_left _ _)
            ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha).1 <| eq ▸ gcd_dvd_right _ _)))
      (dvd_gcd (mul_dvd_mul_left a <| gcd_dvd_left _ _) (mul_dvd_mul_left a <| gcd_dvd_right _ _))

name: gcd_mul_left'
statement:
theorem gcd_mul_left' [GCDMonoid α] (a b c : α) :
    Associated (gcd (a * b) (a * c)) (a * gcd b c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp only [zero_mul, gcd_zero_left']
  obtain ⟨d, eq⟩ := dvd_gcd (dvd_mul_right a b) (dvd_mul_right a c)
  apply associated_of_dvd_dvd
  · rw [eq]
    gcongr
    exact
      dvd_gcd ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha).1 <| eq ▸ gcd_dvd_left _ _)
        ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha).1 <| eq ▸ gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  · exact dvd_gcd (mul_dvd_mul_left a <| gcd_dvd_left _ _) (mul_dvd_mul_left a <| gcd_dvd_right _ _)

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.trans (mul_dvd_mul (gcd_dvd_right k m) dvd_rfl), dvd_gcd_mul_of_dvd_mul⟩

name: gcd_mul_dvd_mul_gcd
statement: theorem gcd_mul_dvd_mul_gcd [GCDMonoid α] (k m n : α) : gcd k (m * n) ∣ gcd k m * gcd k n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m', n', hm', hn', h⟩ := exists_dvd_and_dvd_of_dvd_mul (gcd_dvd_right k (m * n))
  replace h : gcd k (m * n) = m' * n' := h
  rw [h]
  have hm'n' : m' * n' ∣ k := h ▸ gcd_dvd_left _ _
  apply mul_dvd_mul
  · have hm'k : m' ∣ k := (dvd_mul_right m' n').trans hm'n'
    exact dvd_gcd hm'k hm'
  · have hn'k : n' ∣ k := (dvd_mul_left n' m').trans hm'n'
    exact dvd_gcd hn'k hn'

name: gcd_pow_right_dvd_pow_gcd
statement:
theorem gcd_pow_right_dvd_pow_gcd [GCDMonoid α] {a b : α} {k : ℕ} :
    gcd a (b ^ k) ∣ gcd a b ^ k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : gcd a b = 0
  · rw [gcd_eq_zero_iff] at hg
    rcases hg with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact
      (gcd_zero_left' (0 ^ k : α)).dvd.trans
        (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (gcd_zero_left' (0 : α)).symm.dvd _)
  · induction k with
    | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]; exact (gcd_one_right' a).dvd
    | succ k hk =>
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ']
      trans gcd a b * gcd a (b ^ k)
      · exact gcd_mul_dvd_mul_gcd a b (b ^ k)
      · exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hg).mpr hk

name: gcd_pow_left_dvd_pow_gcd
statement: theorem gcd_pow_left_dvd_pow_gcd [GCDMonoid α] {a b : α} {k : ℕ} : gcd (a ^ k) b ∣ gcd a b ^ k
proof:
:=
  calc
    gcd (a ^ k) b ∣ gcd b (a ^ k) := (gcd_comm' _ _).dvd
    _ ∣ gcd b a ^ k := gcd_pow_right_dvd_pow_gcd
    _ ∣ gcd a b ^ k := pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (gcd_comm' _ _).dvd _

name: pow_dvd_of_mul_eq_pow
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_of_mul_eq_pow [GCDMonoid α] {a b c d₁ d₂ : α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hab : IsUnit (gcd a b))
    {k : ℕ} (h : a * b = c ^ k) (hc : c = d₁ * d₂) (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ a) : d₁ ^ k ≠ 0 ∧ d₁ ^ k ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsUnit (gcd (d₁ ^ k) b) := by
    apply isUnit_of_dvd_one
    trans gcd d₁ b ^ k
    · exact gcd_pow_left_dvd_pow_gcd
    · apply IsUnit.dvd
      apply IsUnit.pow
      apply isUnit_of_dvd_one
      grw [hd₁, hab.dvd]
  have h2 : d₁ ^ k ∣ a * b := by
    use d₂ ^ k
    rw [h, hc]
    exact mul_pow d₁ d₂ k
  rw [mul_comm] at h2
  have h3 : d₁ ^ k ∣ a := by
    apply (dvd_gcd_mul_of_dvd_mul h2).trans
    rw [h1.mul_left_dvd]
  have h4 : d₁ ^ k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hdk
    rw [hdk] at h3
    apply absurd (zero_dvd_iff.mp h3) ha
  exact ⟨h4, h3⟩

name: exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow [GCDMonoid α] {a b c : α} (hab : IsUnit (gcd a b))
    {k : ℕ} (h : a * b = c ^ k) : ∃ d : α, Associated (d ^ k) a
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · use 0
    rw [Subsingleton.elim a (0 ^ k)]
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · use 0
    obtain rfl | hk := eq_or_ne k 0
    · simp [ha] at h
    · rw [ha, zero_pow hk]
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · use 1
    rw [one_pow]
    apply (associated_one_iff_isUnit.mpr hab).symm.trans
    rw [hb]
    exact gcd_zero_right' a
  obtain rfl | hk := k.eq_zero_or_pos
  · use 1
    rw [pow_zero] at h ⊢
    use Units.mkOfMulEqOne _ _ h
    rw [Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne, one_mul]
  have hc : c ∣ a * b := by
    rw [h]
    exact dvd_pow_self _ hk.ne'
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, hd₁, hd₂, hc⟩ := exists_dvd_and_dvd_of_dvd_mul hc
  use d₁
  obtain ⟨h0₁, ⟨a', ha'⟩⟩ := pow_dvd_of_mul_eq_pow ha hab h hc hd₁
  rw [mul_comm] at h hc
  rw [(gcd_comm' a b).isUnit_iff] at hab
  obtain ⟨h0₂, ⟨b', hb'⟩⟩ := pow_dvd_of_mul_eq_pow hb hab h hc hd₂
  rw [ha', hb', hc, mul_pow] at h
  have h' : a' * b' = 1 := by
    apply (mul_right_inj' h0₁).mp
    rw [mul_one]
    apply (mul_right_inj' h0₂).mp
    rw [← h]
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm a', ← mul_assoc _ b', ← mul_assoc b', mul_comm b']
  use Units.mkOfMulEqOne _ _ h'
  rw [Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne, ha']

name: exists_eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow [GCDMonoid α] [Subsingleton αˣ]
    {a b c : α} (hab : IsUnit (gcd a b)) {k : ℕ} (h : a * b = c ^ k) : ∃ d : α, a = d ^ k
proof:
:=
  let ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow hab h
  ⟨d, (associated_iff_eq.mp hd).symm⟩

name: isUnit_gcd_of_eq_mul_gcd
statement:
theorem isUnit_gcd_of_eq_mul_gcd {α : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [GCDMonoid α]
    {x y x' y' : α} (ex : x = gcd x y * x') (ey : y = gcd x y * y') (h : gcd x y ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (gcd x' y')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← associated_one_iff_isUnit]
  refine Associated.of_mul_left ?_ (Associated.refl <| gcd x y) h
  convert (gcd_mul_left' (gcd x y) x' y').symm
  rw [← ex, ← ey, mul_one]

name: extract_gcd
statement:
theorem extract_gcd {α : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [GCDMonoid α] (x y : α) :
    ∃ x' y', x = gcd x y * x' ∧ y = gcd x y * y' ∧ IsUnit (gcd x' y')
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : gcd x y = 0
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := (gcd_eq_zero_iff x y).1 h
    simp_rw [← associated_one_iff_isUnit]
    exact ⟨1, 1, by rw [h, zero_mul], by rw [h, zero_mul], gcd_one_left' 1⟩
  obtain ⟨x', ex⟩ := gcd_dvd_left x y
  obtain ⟨y', ey⟩ := gcd_dvd_right x y
  exact ⟨x', y', ex, ey, isUnit_gcd_of_eq_mul_gcd ex ey h⟩

    fun hxy => associated_of_dvd_dvd (dvd_gcd hxy dvd_rfl) (gcd_dvd_right x y)⟩

name: lcm_dvd_iff
statement: theorem lcm_dvd_iff [GCDMonoid α] {a b c : α} : lcm a b ∣ c ↔ a ∣ c ∧ b ∣ c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a = 0 ∨ b = 0
  · rcases h with (rfl | rfl) <;>
      simp +contextual only [iff_def, lcm_zero_left, lcm_zero_right,
        zero_dvd_iff, dvd_zero, and_true, imp_true_iff]
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := not_or.1 h
    have h : gcd a b ≠ 0 := fun H => h1 ((gcd_eq_zero_iff _ _).1 H).1
    rw [← mul_dvd_mul_iff_left h, (gcd_mul_lcm a b).dvd_iff_dvd_left, ←
      (gcd_mul_right' c a b).dvd_iff_dvd_right, dvd_gcd_iff, mul_comm b c, mul_dvd_mul_iff_left h1,
      mul_dvd_mul_iff_right h2, and_comm]

    show lcm (Units.mkOfMulEqOne a c hc.symm : α) (Units.mkOfMulEqOne b d hd.symm) = 1 by

name: lcm_mul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lcm_mul_left [StrongNormalizedGCDMonoid α] (a b c : α) :
    lcm (a * b) (a * c) = normalize a * lcm b c
proof:
:=
  (by_cases (by rintro rfl; simp))
    fun ha : a ≠ 0 =>
    suffices lcm (a * b) (a * c) = normalize (a * lcm b c) by simpa
    have : a ∣ lcm (a * b) (a * c) := (dvd_mul_right _ _).trans (dvd_lcm_left _ _)
    let ⟨_, eq⟩ := this
    lcm_eq_normalize
      (lcm_dvd (mul_dvd_mul_left a (dvd_lcm_left _ _)) (mul_dvd_mul_left a (dvd_lcm_right _ _)))
      (eq.symm ▸
        (mul_dvd_mul_left a <|
          lcm_dvd ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha).1 <| eq ▸ dvd_lcm_left _ _)
            ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha).1 <| eq ▸ dvd_lcm_right _ _)))

proof:

    dvd_antisymm_of_normalize_eq (normalize_lcm _ _) h (lcm_dvd (dvd_refl a) hab) (dvd_lcm_left _ _)

name: gcd_eq_of_dvd_sub_right
statement: theorem gcd_eq_of_dvd_sub_right {a b c : α} (h : a ∣ b - c) : gcd a b = gcd a c
proof:
:= by
  apply dvd_antisymm_of_normalize_eq (normalize_gcd _ _) (normalize_gcd _ _) <;>
    rw [dvd_gcd_iff] <;>
    refine ⟨gcd_dvd_left _ _, ?_⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨d, hd⟩
    rcases gcd_dvd_right a b with ⟨e, he⟩
    rcases gcd_dvd_left a b with ⟨f, hf⟩
    use e - f * d
    rw [mul_sub, ← he, ← mul_assoc, ← hf, ← hd, sub_sub_cancel]
  · rcases h with ⟨d, hd⟩
    rcases gcd_dvd_right a c with ⟨e, he⟩
    rcases gcd_dvd_left a c with ⟨f, hf⟩
    use e + f * d
    rw [mul_add, ← he, ← mul_assoc, ← hf, ← hd, ← add_sub_assoc, add_comm c b, add_sub_cancel_right]

:= by
  rw [gcd_comm _ a, gcd_comm _ a, gcd_eq_of_dvd_sub_right h]

nonempty_normalizedGCDMonoid_iff_isGCDMonoid
statement:
theorem nonempty_normalizedGCDMonoid_iff_isGCDMonoid {α} [CommMonoidWithZero α] :
    Nonempty (NormalizedGCDMonoid α) ↔ IsGCDMonoid α where
  mp
proof:
:= fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ inferInstance
  mpr := fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ by
    have := Classical.arbitrary (NormalizationMonoid α)
    classical exact ⟨normalizedGCDMonoidOfExistsGCD fun _ _ ↦ ⟨_, fun _ ↦ (dvd_gcd_iff ..).symm⟩⟩

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨_⟩⟩ ↦ by classical exact
    ⟨strongNormalizedGCDMonoidOfExistsGCD fun _ _ ↦ ⟨_, fun _ ↦ (dvd_gcd_iff ..).symm⟩⟩⟩

name: isGCDMonoid_iff_exists_gcd

theorem isGCDMonoid_iff_exists_gcd {α} [CommMonoidWithZero α] :
    IsGCDMonoid α ↔ IsCancelMulZero α ∧ ∀ a b : α, ∃ c : α, ∀ d : α, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ↔ d ∣ c where
  mp
proof:
:= fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, fun _ _ ↦ ⟨_, fun _ ↦ (dvd_gcd_iff ..).symm⟩⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ by classical exact ⟨gcdMonoidOfExistsGCD h⟩

  mp
proof:
:= fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, fun _ _ ↦ ⟨_, fun _ ↦ (lcm_dvd_iff ..).symm⟩⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ by classical exact ⟨gcdMonoidOfExistsLCM h⟩

statement:
@[simp]
theorem gcd_ndinsert (a : α) (s : Multiset α) : (ndinsert a s).gcd = GCDMonoid.gcd a s.gcd
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gcd_dedup, dedup_ext.2, gcd_dedup, gcd_cons]
  simp

name: extract_gcd'
statement:
theorem extract_gcd' (s t : Multiset α) (hs : ∃ x, x ∈ s ∧ x ≠ (0 : α))
    (ht : s = t.map (s.gcd * ·)) : t.gcd = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalize_gcd, normalize_eq_one, ← associated_one_iff_isUnit]
  refine .of_mul_left (.symm ?_) .rfl (a := s.gcd) ?_
  · simpa using (Associated.of_eq <| congr(gcd $ht)).trans (associated_gcd_map_mul ..)
  contrapose! hs
  exact s.gcd_eq_zero_iff.1 hs

name: extract_gcd
statement:
theorem extract_gcd (s : Multiset α) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : Multiset α, s = t.map (s.gcd * ·) ∧ t.gcd = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
    by_cases! h : ∀ x ∈ s, x = (0 : α)
    · use replicate (card s) 1
      rw [map_replicate, eq_replicate, mul_one, s.gcd_eq_zero_iff.2 h, ← nsmul_singleton,
    ← gcd_dedup, dedup_nsmul (card_pos.2 hs).ne', dedup_singleton, gcd_singleton]
      exact ⟨⟨rfl, h⟩, normalize_one⟩
    · choose f hf using @gcd_dvd _ _ _ s
      refine ⟨s.pmap @f fun _ ↦ id, ?_, extract_gcd' s _ h ?_⟩ <;>
      · rw [map_pmap]
        conv_lhs => rw [← s.map_id, ← s.pmap_eq_map _ _ fun _ ↦ id]
        congr with (x hx)
        rw [id, ← hf hx]

name: finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset {f : α → M}
    (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport (f ∘ PLift.down)) {s : Finset (PLift α)} (hs : hf.toFinset ⊆ s) :
    ∏ᶠ i, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i.down
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod, dite_eq_left hf]
  refine Finset.prod_subset hs fun x _ hxf => ?_
  rwa [hf.mem_toFinset, notMem_mulSupport] at hxf

name: finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_subset
proof:
:=
  finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset (s.finite_toSet.subset hs) fun x hx => by
    rw [Finite.mem_toFinset] at hx
    exact hs hx

name: finprod_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem finprod_one : (∏ᶠ _ : α, (1 : M)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (mulSupport fun x : PLift α => (fun _ => 1 : α → M) x.down) ⊆ (∅ : Finset (PLift α)) :=
    fun x h => by simp at h
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_subset this, Finset.prod_empty]

name: finprod_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty α] (f : α → M) : ∏ᶠ i, f i = 1

name: finprod_false
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem finprod_false (f : False → M) : ∏ᶠ i, f i = 1

name: finprod_eq_single
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_single (f : α → M) (a : α) (ha : ∀ x, x ≠ a → f x = 1) :
    ∏ᶠ x, f x = f a
proof:
:= by
  have : mulSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) ⊆ ({PLift.up a} : Finset (PLift α)) := by
    intro x
    contrapose
    simpa [PLift.eq_up_iff_down_eq] using ha x.down
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_subset this, Finset.prod_singleton]

name: finprod_unique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_unique [Unique α] (f : α → M) : ∏ᶠ i, f i = f default
proof:
:=
  finprod_eq_single f default fun _x hx => (hx <| Unique.eq_default _).elim

name: finprod_true
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem finprod_true (f : True → M) : ∏ᶠ i, f i = f trivial

name: finprod_eq_dif
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_dif {p : Prop} [Decidable p] (f : p → M) :
    ∏ᶠ i, f i = if h : p then f h else 1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · have : Unique p := ⟨⟨h⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
    exact finprod_unique f
  · have : IsEmpty p := ⟨h⟩
    exact finprod_of_isEmpty f

name: finprod_eq_if
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_if {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {x : M} : ∏ᶠ _ : p, x = if p then x else 1

name: finprod_congr
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_congr {f g : α → M} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : finprod f = finprod g

name: finprod_congr_Prop
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := congr)]
theorem finprod_congr_Prop {p q : Prop} {f : p → M} {g : q → M} (hpq : p = q)
    (hfg : ∀ h : q, f (hpq.mpr h) = g h) : finprod f = finprod g
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  exact finprod_congr hfg

name: finprod_induction
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      additive and holds on the summands. -/]
theorem finprod_induction {f : α → M} (p : M → Prop) (hp₀ : p 1)
    (hp₁ : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x * y)) (hp₂ : ∀ i, p (f i)) : p (∏ᶠ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod]
  split_ifs
  exacts [Finset.prod_induction _ _ hp₁ hp₀ fun i _ => hp₂ _, hp₀]

name: finprod_nonneg
statement:
theorem finprod_nonneg {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] [Preorder R] [ZeroLEOneClass R]
    [PosMulMono R] {f : α → R} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ ∏ᶠ x, f x
proof:
:=
  finprod_induction (fun x => 0 ≤ x) zero_le_one (fun _ _ => mul_nonneg) hf

name: one_le_finprod'
statement:
@[to_additive finsum_nonneg]
theorem one_le_finprod' {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [Preorder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M]
    {f : α → M} (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) :
    1 ≤ ∏ᶠ i, f i

name: one_le_finprod
statement:
lemma one_le_finprod {M : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [Preorder M] [ZeroLEOneClass M]
    [PosMulMono M] {f : α → M} (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) :
    1 ≤ ∏ᶠ i, f i

name: MonoidHom.map_finprod_plift
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MonoidHom.map_finprod_plift (f : M →* N) (g : α → M)
    (h : HasFiniteMulSupport <| g ∘ PLift.down) : f (∏ᶠ x, g x) = ∏ᶠ x, f (g x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_subset h.coe_toFinset.ge,
    finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_subset, _root_.map_prod]
  rw [h.coe_toFinset]
  exact mulSupport_comp_subset f.map_one (g ∘ PLift.down)

name: MonoidHom.map_finprod_Prop
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MonoidHom.map_finprod_Prop {p : Prop} (f : M →* N) (g : p → M) :
    f (∏ᶠ x, g x) = ∏ᶠ x, f (g x)

name: MonoidHom.map_finprod_of_preimage_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MonoidHom.map_finprod_of_preimage_one (f : M →* N) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 1 → x = 1) (g : α → M) :
    f (∏ᶠ i, g i) = ∏ᶠ i, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : HasFiniteMulSupport <| g ∘ PLift.down; · exact f.map_finprod_plift g hg
  rw [finprod, dite_eq_right, f.map_one, finprod, dite_eq_right]
  exacts [Infinite.mono (fun x hx => mt (hf (g x.down)) hx) hg, hg]

name: MonoidHom.map_finprod_of_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MonoidHom.map_finprod_of_injective (g : M →* N) (hg : Injective g) (f : α → M) :
    g (∏ᶠ i, f i) = ∏ᶠ i, g (f i)

name: MulEquiv.map_finprod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MulEquiv.map_finprod (g : M ≃* N) (f : α → M) : g (∏ᶠ i, f i) = ∏ᶠ i, g (f i)

name: MulEquivClass.map_finprod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem MulEquivClass.map_finprod {F : Type*} [EquivLike F M N] [MulEquivClass F M N] (g : F)

name: finsum_smul
statement:
theorem finsum_smul {R M : Type*} [Ring R] [IsDomain R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] (f : ι → R) (x : M) : (∑ᶠ i, f i) • x = ∑ᶠ i, f i • x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with (rfl | hx)
  · simp
  · exact ((smulAddHom R M).flip x).map_finsum_of_injective (smul_left_injective R hx) _

name: smul_finsum
statement:
theorem smul_finsum {R M : Type*} [Semiring R] [IsDomain R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] (c : R) (f : ι → M) : c • ∑ᶠ i, f i = ∑ᶠ i, c • f i
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with (rfl | hc)
  · simp
  · exact (smulAddHom R M c).map_finsum_of_injective (smul_right_injective M hc) _

name: finprod_inv_distrib
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_inv_distrib [DivisionCommMonoid G] (f : α → G) : (∏ᶠ x, (f x)⁻¹) = (∏ᶠ x, f x)⁻¹

name: finprod_eq_mulIndicator_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_mulIndicator_apply (s : Set α) (f : α → M) (a : α) :
    ∏ᶠ _ : a ∈ s, f a = mulIndicator s f a
proof:
:= by
  convert! finprod_eq_if (M := M) (p := a ∈ s) (x := f a)

name: finprod_apply_ne_one
statement:

theorem finprod_apply_ne_one (f : α → M) (a : α) : ∏ᶠ _ : f a ≠ 1, f a = f a

name: finprod_mem_def
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_def (s : Set α) (f : α → M) : ∏ᶠ a ∈ s, f a = ∏ᶠ a, mulIndicator s f a

name: finprod_mem_mulSupport
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finprod_mem_mulSupport (f : α → M) : ∏ᶠ a ∈ mulSupport f, f a = ∏ᶠ a, f a

name: finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset (f : α → M) {s : Finset α} (h : mulSupport f ⊆ s) :
    ∏ᶠ i, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= by
  have A : mulSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) = Equiv.plift.symm '' mulSupport f := by
    rw [mulSupport_comp_eq_preimage]
    exact (Equiv.plift.symm.image_eq_preimage_symm _).symm
  have : mulSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) ⊆ s.map Equiv.plift.symm.toEmbedding := by
    rw [A, Finset.coe_map]
    exact image_mono h
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_plift_of_mulSupport_subset this]
  simp only [Finset.prod_map, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding]
  congr

name: finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset (f : α → M) (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f)
    {s : Finset α} (h : hf.toFinset ⊆ s) : ∏ᶠ i, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:=
  finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ fun _ hx => h <| hf.mem_toFinset.2 hx

name: finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset_of_finite
finprod_eq_finsetProd_of_mulSupport_subset
proof:
:=
  haveI h' : (s.finite_toSet.subset h).toFinset ⊆ s := by
    simpa [← Finset.coe_subset, Set.coe_toFinset]
  finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset _ _ h'

name: finprod_def
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_def (f : α → M) [Decidable (HasFiniteMulSupport f)] :
    ∏ᶠ i : α, f i = if h : HasFiniteMulSupport f then ∏ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i else 1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset _ h (Finset.Subset.refl _)
  · rw [finprod, dite_eq_right]
    rw [HasFiniteMulSupport, mulSupport_comp_eq_preimage]
    exact mt (fun hf => hf.of_preimage Equiv.plift.surjective) h

name: finprod_of_infinite_mulSupport
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_of_infinite_mulSupport {f : α → M} (hf : (mulSupport f).Infinite) :
    ∏ᶠ i, f i = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finprod_def]
  simp only [HasFiniteMulSupport]
  rw [dite_eq_right hf]

name: finprod_of_not_hasFiniteMulSupport
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_of_not_hasFiniteMulSupport {f : α → M} (hf : ¬ f.HasFiniteMulSupport) :

name: hasFiniteMulSupport_of_finprod_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem hasFiniteMulSupport_of_finprod_ne_one {f : α → M} (h : ∏ᶠ i, f i ≠ 1) :
    HasFiniteMulSupport f

name: hasFiniteSupport_of_finsum_eq_one
statement:
theorem hasFiniteSupport_of_finsum_eq_one {R : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring R] {f : α → R}
    (h : ∑ᶠ i, f i = 1) : HasFiniteSupport f
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · simp_rw [HasFiniteSupport, Subsingleton.support_eq, finite_empty]
  · apply hasFiniteSupport_of_finsum_ne_zero
    rw [h]
    exact one_ne_zero

name: finprod_eq_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_prod (f : α → M) (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) :
    ∏ᶠ i : α, f i = ∏ i ∈ hf.toFinset, f i

name: finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype [Fintype α] (f : α → M) : ∏ᶠ i : α, f i = ∏ i, f i

name: finprod_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finprod_ne_zero {M₀ : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] [Nontrivial M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀]
    {f : α → M₀} (h : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0) :
    ∏ᶠ i, f i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₂ : Set.Finite f.mulSupport
  · grind [finprod_eq_prod f h₂, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  · simp [finprod_of_infinite_mulSupport h₂]

name: finprod_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finprod_apply_ne_zero {ι : Type*} {N₀ M₀ : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] [Nontrivial M₀]
    [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {n : N₀} {f : ι → N₀ → M₀} (h : ∀ i, f i n ≠ 0) :
    (∏ᶠ i, f i) n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₂ : f.mulSupport.Finite
  · rw [finprod_eq_prod f h₂]
    grind [Finset.prod_apply, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  · simp [finprod_of_infinite_mulSupport h₂]

name: map_finsetProd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_finsetProd {α F : Type*} [Fintype α] [EquivLike F M N] [MulEquivClass F M N] (f : F)
    (g : α → M) : f (∏ i : α, g i) = ∏ i : α, f (g i)

name: finprod_cond_eq_prod_of_cond_iff
proof:
:= by
  set s := { x | p x }
  change ∏ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), f i = ∏ i ∈ t, f i
  have : mulSupport (s.mulIndicator f) ⊆ t := by
    rw [Set.mulSupport_mulIndicator]
    intro x hx
    exact (h hx.2).1 hx.1
  rw [finprod_mem_def, finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ this]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun x hx => mulIndicator_apply_eq_self.2 fun hxs => ?_
  contrapose! hxs
  exact (h hxs).2 hx

name: finprod_cond_ne
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_cond_ne (f : α → M) (a : α) [DecidableEq α] (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) :
    (∏ᶠ (i) (_ : i ≠ a), f i) = ∏ i ∈ hf.toFinset.erase a, f i
proof:
:= by
  apply finprod_cond_eq_prod_of_cond_iff
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_mulSupport]
  grind

name: finprod_mem_eq_prod_of_inter_mulSupport_eq
proof:
:=
  finprod_cond_eq_prod_of_cond_iff _ <| by
    intro x hxf
    rw [← mem_mulSupport] at hxf
    refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
    · refine ((mem_inter_iff x t (mulSupport f)).mp ?_).1
      rw [← Set.ext_iff.mp h x, mem_inter_iff]
      exact ⟨hx, hxf⟩
    · refine ((mem_inter_iff x s (mulSupport f)).mp ?_).1
      rw [Set.ext_iff.mp h x, mem_inter_iff]
      exact ⟨hx, hxf⟩

name: finprod_mem_eq_prod_of_subset
proof:
:=
  finprod_cond_eq_prod_of_cond_iff _ fun hx => ⟨fun h => h₁ ⟨h, hx⟩, fun h => h₂ h⟩

statement:

theorem finprod_mem_eq_prod (f : α → M) {s : Set α} (hf : (s ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) :

theorem finprod_mem_eq_prod_filter (f : α → M) (s : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)]

@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_eq_toFinset_prod (f : α → M) (s : Set α) [Fintype s] :

name: finprod_mem_eq_finite_toFinset_prod

statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_finset_eq_prod (f : α → M) (s : Finset α) : ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i

statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_coe_finset (f : α → M) (s : Finset α) :

name: finprod_mem_eq_one_of_infinite
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_eq_one_of_infinite {f : α → M} {s : Set α} (hs : (s ∩ mulSupport f).Infinite) :
    ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod_mem_def]
  apply finprod_of_infinite_mulSupport
  rwa [← mulSupport_mulIndicator] at hs

name: finprod_mem_eq_one_of_forall_eq_one

theorem finprod_mem_eq_one_of_forall_eq_one {f : α → M} {s : Set α} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = 1) :

theorem finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport_eq (f : α → M) (s t : Set α)

name: finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport_eq'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport_eq' (f : α → M) (s t : Set α)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ mulSupport f, x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ t) : ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ᶠ i ∈ t, f i

name: finprod_mem_univ
statement:

name: finprod_mem_congr
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_congr (h₀ : s = t) (h₁ : ∀ x ∈ t, f x = g x) :
    ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ᶠ i ∈ t, g i
proof:
:=
  h₀.symm ▸ finprod_congr fun i => finprod_congr_Prop rfl (h₁ i)

name: finprod_eq_one_of_forall_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_eq_one_of_forall_eq_one {f : α → M} (h : ∀ x, f x = 1) : ∏ᶠ i, f i = 1

name: one_lt_finprod_cond
statement:
@[to_additive finsum_cond_pos]
theorem one_lt_finprod_cond {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedCancelMonoid M]
    {f : ι → M} {p : ι → Prop} (h : ∀ i, p i → 1 ≤ f i) (h' : ∃ i, p i ∧ 1 < f i)
    (hf : (mulSupport f ∩ {i | p i}).Finite) : 1 < ∏ᶠ (i) (_ : p i), f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod_cond_eq_prod_of_cond_iff (t := hf.toFinset)]
  · apply Finset.one_lt_prod'
    · simp +contextual [h]
    · aesop
  · simp +contextual

name: one_lt_finprod
statement:
@[to_additive finsum_pos]
theorem one_lt_finprod {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedCancelMonoid M]
    {f : ι → M}
    (h : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) (h' : ∃ i, 1 < f i) (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) : 1 < ∏ᶠ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_mem_univ]
  apply one_lt_finprod_cond <;> simpa

name: finprod_le_finprod
statement:
lemma finprod_le_finprod [PartialOrder M] [MulLeftMono M] (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f)
    (hg : HasFiniteMulSupport g) (h : f ≤ g) :
    ∏ᶠ a, f a ≤ ∏ᶠ a, g a
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype ↑(f.mulSupport ∪ g.mulSupport) := (hf.union hg).fintype
  let s := (f.mulSupport ∪ g.mulSupport).toFinset
  rw [finprod_eq_finsetProd_of_mulSupport_subset f (show f.mulSupport ⊆ s by grind),
    finprod_eq_finsetProd_of_mulSupport_subset g (show g.mulSupport ⊆ s by grind)]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod fun i _ ↦ h i

name: finprod_le_finprod
statement:
lemma finprod_le_finprod₀ {M : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [PartialOrder M] [ZeroLEOneClass M]
    [PosMulMono M] {f g : α → M} (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) (hf₀ : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a)
    (hg : HasFiniteMulSupport g) (h : f ≤ g) :
    ∏ᶠ a, f a ≤ ∏ᶠ a, g a
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype ↑(f.mulSupport ∪ g.mulSupport) := (hf.union hg).fintype
  let s := (f.mulSupport ∪ g.mulSupport).toFinset
  rw [finprod_eq_finsetProd_of_mulSupport_subset f (show f.mulSupport ⊆ s by grind),
    finprod_eq_finsetProd_of_mulSupport_subset g (show g.mulSupport ⊆ s by grind)]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ ↦ hf₀ i) fun i _ ↦ h i

name: finprod_zero_le_one
statement:
lemma finprod_zero_le_one {M α : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [PartialOrder M]
    [ZeroLEOneClass M] [PosMulMono M] :
    ∏ᶠ _ : α, (0 : M) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_one (α := α)]
  by_cases H : (fun _ : α ↦ (0 : M)).HasFiniteMulSupport
  · exact finprod_le_finprod₀ H (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) (by fun_prop) fun _ ↦ zero_le_one
  · rw [finprod_of_not_hasFiniteMulSupport H]
    exact finprod_one.symm.le

name: finprod_mul_distrib
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      equals the sum of `f i` plus the sum of `g i`. -/]
theorem finprod_mul_distrib (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) (hg : HasFiniteMulSupport g) :
    ∏ᶠ i, f i * g i = (∏ᶠ i, f i) * ∏ᶠ i, g i
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset f hf Finset.subset_union_left,
      finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset g hg Finset.subset_union_right, ←
      Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ ?_
    simp only [Finset.coe_union, Finite.coe_toFinset, mulSupport_subset_iff,
      mem_union, mem_mulSupport]
    intro x
    contrapose!
    rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    simp [hf, hg]

name: finprod_div_distrib
statement:
@[to_additive
      /

theorem finprod_div_distrib [DivisionCommMonoid G] {f g : α → G} (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f)
    (hg : HasFiniteMulSupport g) : ∏ᶠ i, f i / g i = (∏ᶠ i, f i) / ∏ᶠ i, g i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, finprod_mul_distrib hf <| hg.fun_inv, finprod_inv_distrib]

name: finprod_mem_mul_distrib'

    ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i * g i = (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, g i

  simp only [finprod_mem_def, mulIndicator_mul, finprod_mul_distrib hf hg]

name: finprod_mem_union_inter
statement:
@[to_additive /
theorem finprod_mem_empty : (∏ᶠ i ∈ (∅ : Set α), f i) = 1 := by simp

/
@[to_additive
/
theorem nonempty_of_finprod_mem_ne_one (h : ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 1) : s.Nonempty :=
  nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun h' => h <| h'.symm ▸ finprod_mem_empty

/
`f i` over `i ∈ s ∩ t` equals the product of `f i` over `i ∈ s` times the product of `f i`
over `i ∈ t`. -/
@[to_additive
      /
      `f i` over `i ∈ s ∩ t` equals the sum of `f i` over `i ∈ s` plus the sum of `f i`
      over `i ∈ t`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_union_inter (hs : s.Finite) (ht : t.Finite) :
    ((∏ᶠ i ∈ s ∪ t, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ s ∩ t, f i) = (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  lift s to Finset α using hs; lift t to Finset α using ht
  classical
    rw [← Finset.coe_union, ← Finset.coe_inter]
    simp only [finprod_mem_coe_finset, Finset.prod_union_inter]

name: finprod_mem_union_inter'
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      `t ∩ support f` rather than `s` and `t` to be finite. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_union_inter' (hs : (s ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) (ht : (t ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) :
    ((∏ᶠ i ∈ s ∪ t, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ s ∩ t, f i) = (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport f s, ← finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport f t, ←
    finprod_mem_union_inter hs ht, ← union_inter_distrib_right, finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport, ←
    finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport f (s ∩ t)]
  rw [inter_left_comm, inter_assoc, inter_assoc, inter_self, inter_left_comm]

name: finprod_mem_union'
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      `t ∩ support f` rather than `s` and `t` to be finite. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_union' (hst : Disjoint s t) (hs : (s ∩ mulSupport f).Finite)
    (ht : (t ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) : ∏ᶠ i ∈ s ∪ t, f i = (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_mem_union_inter' hs ht, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 hst, finprod_mem_empty,
    mul_one]

name: finprod_mem_union''

@[to_additive

theorem finprod_mem_union'' (hst : Disjoint (s ∩ mulSupport f) (t ∩ mulSupport f))
    (hs : (s ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) (ht : (t ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) :
    ∏ᶠ i ∈ s ∪ t, f i = (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ᶠ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport f s, ← finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport f t, ←

name: finprod_mem_dvd
statement: theorem finprod_mem_dvd {f : α → N} (a : α) (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) : f a ∣ finprod f
proof:

  · rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset f hf (Set.Subset.refl _)]
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem f ((Finite.mem_toFinset hf).mpr ha)

name: finprod_mem_image'
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      `g` is injective on `s ∩ support (f ∘ g)`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_image' {s : Set β} {g : β → α} (hg : (s ∩ mulSupport (f ∘ g)).InjOn g) :
    ∏ᶠ i ∈ g '' s, f i = ∏ᶠ j ∈ s, f (g j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    by_cases hs : (s ∩ mulSupport (f ∘ g)).Finite
    · have hg : ∀ x ∈ hs.toFinset, ∀ y ∈ hs.toFinset, g x = g y → x = y := by
        simpa only [hs.mem_toFinset]
      have := finprod_mem_eq_prod (comp f g) hs
      unfold Function.comp at this
      rw [this, ← Finset.prod_image hg]
      refine finprod_mem_eq_prod_of_inter_mulSupport_eq f ?_
      rw [Finset.coe_image, hs.coe_toFinset, ← image_inter_mulSupport_eq, inter_assoc, inter_self]
    · unfold Function.comp at hs
      rw [finprod_mem_eq_one_of_infinite hs, finprod_mem_eq_one_of_infinite]
      rwa [image_inter_mulSupport_eq, infinite_image_iff hg]

name: finprod_mem_inter_mul_sdiff'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_inter_mul_sdiff' (t : Set α) (h : (s ∩ mulSupport f).Finite) :

  · rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
    exact fun x hx => hx.2.2 hx.1.2

name: finprod_mem_iUnion
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      sum of `f a` over the union `⋃ i, t i` is equal to the sum over all indexes `i` of the
      sums of `f a` over `a ∈ t i`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_iUnion [Finite ι] {t : ι → Set α} (h : Pairwise (Disjoint on t))
    (ht : ∀ i, (t i).Finite) : ∏ᶠ a ∈ ⋃ i : ι, t i, f a = ∏ᶠ i, ∏ᶠ a ∈ t i, f a
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  lift t to ι → Finset α using ht
  classical
    rw [← biUnion_univ, ← Finset.coe_univ, ← Finset.coe_biUnion, finprod_mem_coe_finset,
      Finset.prod_biUnion]
    · simp only [finprod_mem_coe_finset, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype]
    · exact fun x _ y _ hxy => Finset.disjoint_coe.1 (h hxy)

name: finprod_mem_biUnion
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      all sets `t i`, `i ∈ I`, are finite, if all `t i`, `i ∈ I`, are pairwise disjoint, then the
      sum of `f a` over `a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ I, t i` is equal to the sum over `i ∈ I` of the sums of `f a`
      over `a ∈ t i`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_biUnion {I : Set ι} {t : ι → Set α} (h : I.PairwiseDisjoint t) (hI : I.Finite)
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ I, (t i).Finite) : ∏ᶠ a ∈ ⋃ x ∈ I, t x, f a = ∏ᶠ i ∈ I, ∏ᶠ j ∈ t i, f j
proof:
:= by
  have := hI.fintype
  rw [biUnion_eq_iUnion, finprod_mem_iUnion, ← finprod_set_coe_eq_finprod_mem]
  exacts [fun x y hxy => h x.2 y.2 (Subtype.coe_injective.ne hxy), fun b => ht b b.2]

name: finprod_mem_sUnion
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      `a ∈ ⋃₀ t` is the sum over `s ∈ t` of the sums of `f a` over `a ∈ s`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_sUnion {t : Set (Set α)} (h : t.PairwiseDisjoint id) (ht₀ : t.Finite)
    (ht₁ : ∀ x ∈ t, Set.Finite x) : ∏ᶠ a ∈ ⋃₀ t, f a = ∏ᶠ s ∈ t, ∏ᶠ a ∈ s, f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.sUnion_eq_biUnion]
  exact finprod_mem_biUnion h ht₀ ht₁

name: finprod_option
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finprod_option {f : Option α → M} (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport (f ∘ some)) :
    ∏ᶠ o, f o = f none * ∏ᶠ a, f (some a)
proof:
:= by
  replace hf : (mulSupport f).Finite := by simpa [finite_option]
  convert!
    finprod_mem_insert' f (show none ∉ Set.range Option.some by simp) (hf.subset inter_subset_right)
  · simp
  · rw [finprod_mem_range]
    exact Option.some_injective _

name: finprod_mem_powerset_insert
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finprod_mem_powerset_insert {f : Set α → M} {s : Set α} {a : α} (hs : s.Finite)
    (has : a ∉ s) : ∏ᶠ t ∈ 𝒫 insert a s, f t = (∏ᶠ t ∈ 𝒫 s, f t) * ∏ᶠ t ∈ 𝒫 s, f (insert a t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.powerset_insert,
    finprod_mem_union (disjoint_powerset_insert has) hs.powerset (hs.powerset.image (insert a)),
    finprod_mem_image (powerset_insert_injOn has)]

name: finprod_mem_powerset_sdiff_elem
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finprod_mem_powerset_sdiff_elem {f : Set α → M} {s : Set α} {a : α} (hs : s.Finite)
    (has : a ∈ s) : ∏ᶠ t ∈ 𝒫 s, f t = (∏ᶠ t ∈ 𝒫 (s \ {a}), f t)
    * ∏ᶠ t ∈ 𝒫 (s \ {a}), f (insert a t)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 2 [← Set.insert_sdiff_self_of_mem has] 
  exact finprod_mem_powerset_insert (hs.subset Set.sdiff_subset)
    (notMem_sdiff_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton a))

name: mul_finprod_cond_ne
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mul_finprod_cond_ne (a : α) (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) :
    (f a * ∏ᶠ (i) (_ : i ≠ a), f i) = ∏ᶠ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [finprod_eq_prod _ hf]
    have h : ∀ x : α, f x ≠ 1 → (x ≠ a ↔ x ∈ hf.toFinset \ {a}) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton, Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_mulSupport]
      grind
    rw [finprod_cond_eq_prod_of_cond_iff f (fun hx => h _ hx), Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
    by_cases ha : a ∈ mulSupport f
    · apply Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ ((Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr ha)
    · rw [mem_mulSupport, not_not] at ha
      rw [ha, one_mul]
      apply Finset.prod_erase _ ha

name: finprod_mem_comm
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      summing over `t`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_comm {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (f : α → β → M) (hs : s.Finite) (ht : t.Finite) :
    (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, ∏ᶠ j ∈ t, f i j) = ∏ᶠ j ∈ t, ∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i j
proof:
:= by
  lift s to Finset α using hs; lift t to Finset β using ht
  simp only [finprod_mem_coe_finset]
  exact Finset.prod_comm

name: finprod_mem_induction
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      additive and holds on summands. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_induction (p : M → Prop) (hp₀ : p 1) (hp₁ : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x * y))
    (hp₂ : ∀ x ∈ s, p <| f x) : p (∏ᶠ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:=
  finprod_induction _ hp₀ hp₁ fun x => finprod_induction _ hp₀ hp₁ <| hp₂ x

name: finprod_cond_nonneg
proof:
:=
  finprod_nonneg fun x => finprod_nonneg <| hf x

name: single_le_finprod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem single_le_finprod {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [Preorder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M]
    (i : α) {f : α → M}
    (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) (h : ∀ j, 1 ≤ f j) : f i ≤ ∏ᶠ j, f j
proof:
:= by
  classical calc
      f i ≤ ∏ j ∈ insert i hf.toFinset, f j :=
        Finset.single_le_prod (fun j _ => h j) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      _ = ∏ᶠ j, f j :=
        (finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_toFinset_subset _ hf (Finset.subset_insert _ _)).symm

name: finprod_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finprod_eq_zero {M₀ : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] (f : α → M₀) (x : α) (hx : f x = 0)
    (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) : ∏ᶠ x, f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality
  rw [finprod_eq_prod f hf]
  refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (hf.mem_toFinset.2 ?_) hx
  simp [hx]

name: finprod_prod_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_prod_comm (s : Finset β) (f : α → β → M)
    (h : ∀ b ∈ s, HasFiniteMulSupport fun a ↦ f a b) :
    (∏ᶠ a : α, ∏ b ∈ s, f a b) = ∏ b ∈ s, ∏ᶠ a : α, f a b
proof:
:= by
  have hU :
    (mulSupport fun a => ∏ b ∈ s, f a b) ⊆
      (s.finite_toSet.biUnion fun b hb => h b (Finset.mem_coe.1 hb)).toFinset := by
    rw [Finite.coe_toFinset]
    intro x hx
    simp only [exists_prop, mem_iUnion, Ne, mem_mulSupport, Finset.mem_coe]
    contrapose! hx
    rw [mem_mulSupport, not_not, Finset.prod_congr rfl hx, Finset.prod_const_one]
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ hU, Finset.prod_comm]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b hb => (finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ ?_).symm
  intro a ha
  simp only [Finite.coe_toFinset, mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨b, hb, ha⟩

name: prod_finprod_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_finprod_comm (s : Finset α) (f : α → β → M) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, HasFiniteMulSupport (f a)) :
    (∏ a ∈ s, ∏ᶠ b : β, f a b) = ∏ᶠ b : β, ∏ a ∈ s, f a b
proof:
:=
  (finprod_prod_comm s (fun b a => f a b) h).symm

name: finprod_prod_filter
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_prod_filter [DecidableEq α] (f : β → α) (s : Finset β) (g : β → M) :
    ∏ᶠ x, ∏ y ∈ s with f y = x, g y = ∏ k ∈ s, g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod_eq_finsetProd_of_mulSupport_subset]
  · rw [Finset.prod_image']
    exact fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  · intro x hx
    rw [mem_mulSupport] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, h, -⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_one_of_prod_ne_one hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.coe_image, mem_image, SetLike.mem_coe] at h ⊢
    exact ⟨a, h⟩

statement:

name: mul_finsum
statement:
theorem mul_finsum {R : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f : α → R)
    (r : R) :
    (r * ∑ᶠ a : α, f a) = ∑ᶠ a : α, r * f a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · simp_all
  by_cases h : f.support.Finite
  · exact mul_finsum' f r h
  simp [finsum_def, HasFiniteSupport, h, (by aesop : (r * f ·).support = f.support)]

name: mul_finsum_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_finsum]
  congr
  ext a
  by_cases h : a ∈ s <;> simp_all

name: finsum_mul
statement:
theorem finsum_mul {R : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f : α → R)
    (r : R) :
    (∑ᶠ a : α, f a) * r = ∑ᶠ a : α, f a * r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · simp_all
  by_cases h : f.support.Finite
  · exact finsum_mul' f r h
  simp [finsum_def, HasFiniteSupport, h, (by aesop : (f · * r).support = f.support)]

name: finsum_mem_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsum_mul]
  congr
  ext a
  by_cases h : a ∈ s <;> simp_all

name: finprod_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma finprod_apply {α ι : Type*} {f : ι → α → N} (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) (a : α) :
    (∏ᶠ i, f i) a = ∏ᶠ i, f i a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf' : HasFiniteMulSupport fun i ↦ f i a := by fun_prop (disch := simp)
  simp only [finprod_def, dite_eq_left, hf, hf', Finset.prod_apply]
  symm
  apply Finset.prod_subset <;> aesop

name: Finset.mulSupport_of_fiberwise_prod_subset_image
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Finset.mulSupport_of_fiberwise_prod_subset_image [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (f : α → M)
    (g : α → β) : (mulSupport fun b ↦ ∏ a ∈ s with g a = b, f a) ⊆ s.image g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.coe_image]
  intro b h
  suffices {a ∈ s | g a = b}.Nonempty by
    simpa only [fiber_nonempty_iff_mem_image, Finset.mem_image, exists_prop]
  exact Finset.nonempty_of_prod_ne_one h

name: finprod_mem_finset_product'
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      we can simplify the right-hand side of this lemma. However the form stated here is more
      useful for iterating this lemma, e.g., if we have `f : α × β × γ → M`. -/]
theorem finprod_mem_finset_product' [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset (α × β))
    (f : α × β → M) :
    (∏ᶠ (ab) (_ : ab ∈ s), f ab) =
      ∏ᶠ (a) (b) (_ : b ∈ (s.filter fun ab => Prod.fst ab = a).image Prod.snd), f (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  have (a : _) :
      ∏ i ∈ (s.filter fun ab => Prod.fst ab = a).image Prod.snd, f (a, i) =
        (s.filter (Prod.fst · = a)).prod f := by
    refine Finset.prod_nbij' (fun b ↦ (a, b)) Prod.snd ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> aesop
  rw [finprod_mem_finset_eq_prod]
  simp_rw [finprod_mem_finset_eq_prod, this]
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _
      (s.mulSupport_of_fiberwise_prod_subset_image f Prod.fst),
    ← Finset.prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (t := Finset.image Prod.fst s) _ f]
  
  simp only [Finset.mem_image]
  exact fun x hx => ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: finprod_mem_finset_product
statement:
theorem finprod_mem_finset_product (s : Finset (α × β)) (f : α × β → M) :
    (∏ᶠ (ab) (_ : ab ∈ s), f ab) = ∏ᶠ (a) (b) (_ : (a, b) ∈ s), f (a, b)

name: finprod_mem_finset_product
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_mem_finset_product₃ {γ : Type*} (s : Finset (α × β × γ)) (f : α × β × γ → M) :
    (∏ᶠ (abc) (_ : abc ∈ s), f abc) = ∏ᶠ (a) (b) (c) (_ : (a, b, c) ∈ s), f (a, b, c)

name: finprod_curry
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_curry (f : α × β → M) (hf : HasFiniteMulSupport f) :
    ∏ᶠ ab, f ab = ∏ᶠ (a) (b), f (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ∀ a, ∏ᶠ _ : a ∈ hf.toFinset, f a = f a := by simp
  have h₂ : ∏ᶠ a, f a = ∏ᶠ (a) (_ : a ∈ hf.toFinset), f a := by simp
  simp_rw [h₂, finprod_mem_finset_product, h₁]

name: finprod_curry
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_curry₃ {γ : Type*} (f : α × β × γ → M) (h : HasFiniteMulSupport f) :
    ∏ᶠ abc, f abc = ∏ᶠ (a) (b) (c), f (a, b, c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod_curry f h]
  congr
  ext a
  rw [finprod_curry]
  simp [h]

name: finprod_dmem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_dmem {s : Set α} [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (f : ∀ a : α, a ∈ s → M) :
    (∏ᶠ (a : α) (h : a ∈ s), f a h) = ∏ᶠ (a : α) (_ : a ∈ s), if h' : a ∈ s then f a h' else 1
proof:
:=
  finprod_congr fun _ => finprod_congr fun ha => (dite_eq_left ha).symm

name: finprod_emb_domain'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem finprod_emb_domain' {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) [DecidablePred (· ∈ Set.range f)]
    (g : α → M) :
    (∏ᶠ b : β, if h : b ∈ Set.range f then g (Classical.choose h) else 1) = ∏ᶠ a : α, g a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← finprod_eq_dif]
  rw [finprod_dmem, finprod_mem_range hf, finprod_congr fun a => _]
  intro a
  rw [dite_eq_left (Set.mem_range_self a), hf (Classical.choose_spec (Set.mem_range_self a))]

  · exact map_finprod (Nat.castRingHom R) hf
  · have H : ¬ (fun i ↦ (f i : R)).HasFiniteMulSupport :=

name: prod_eq_top
statement:
lemma prod_eq_top (hi : i ∈ s) (hi' : f i = ⊤) (h : ∀ j ∈ s, f j ≠ 0) :
    ∏ j ∈ s, f j = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [← prod_erase_mul _ _ hi]
  refine WithTop.mul_eq_top_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨?_, hi'⟩)
  refine prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr ?_
  intros
  simp_all only [ne_eq, mem_erase, not_false_eq_true]

name: prod_eq_top_ne_zero
statement: lemma prod_eq_top_ne_zero (hi : i ∈ s) (h : ∏ j ∈ s, f j = ⊤) : f i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h0
  apply WithTop.top_ne_zero (α := M₀)
  calc
    ⊤ = ∏ j ∈ s, f j := Eq.symm h
    _ = 0 := prod_eq_zero hi h0

name: prod_eq_top_ex_top

proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact WithTop.prod_ne_top h

name: prod_eq_top_iff

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨prod_eq_top_ex_top h, fun _ ih ↦ prod_eq_top_ne_zero ih h⟩
  · exact fun ⟨h, h'⟩ ↦ prod_eq_top (Exists.choose_spec h).1 (Exists.choose_spec h).2 h'

@[to_additive /
theorem prod_univ_zero (f : Fin 0 → M) : ∏ i, f i = 1 :=

/

name: prod_insertNth_go
statement:
@[to_additive]
private lemma prod_insertNth_go :
    ∀ n i (h : i < n + 1) x (p : Fin n → M), ∏ j, insertNth ⟨i, h⟩ x p j = x * ∏ j, p j
  | n, 0, h, x, p => by simp
  | 0, i, h, x, p => by simp [fin_one_eq_zero ⟨i, h⟩]
  | n + 1, i + 1, h, x, p => by
    obtain ⟨hd, tl, rfl⟩
proof:
:= exists_cons p
    have i_lt := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h
    let i_fin : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨i, i_lt⟩
    rw [show ⟨i + 1, h⟩ = i_fin.succ from rfl]
    simp only [insertNth_succ_cons, prod_cons]
    rw [prod_insertNth_go n i i_lt x tl, mul_left_comm]

name: prod_prod_eq_prod_triangle_mul
statement:
@[to_additive /
is equal to the sum of `g i j + g j i` over `i < j`.

This lemma is useful for some proofs about differential forms.
In this application, the function has the signature `f : Fin (n + 1) → Fin n → M`,
where `f i j` means `g i (Fin.succAbove i j)` in the informal statements.

Similarly, the sum of `g i j + g j i` over `i < j`
is written as `f (Fin.castSucc i) j + f (Fin.succ j) i` over `i j : Fin n`, `j ≥ i`.
-/]
theorem prod_prod_eq_prod_triangle_mul (f : Fin (n + 1) → Fin n → M) :
    ∏ i, ∏ j, f i j = ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ≥ i, (f i.castSucc j * f j.succ i)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (∏ i, ∏ j with i ≤ j.castSucc, f i j) * ∏ i, ∏ j with j.castSucc < i, f i j := by
    simp only [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← not_le, Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not]
  _ = (∏ i, ∏ j ≥ i, f i.castSucc j) * ∏ i, ∏ j ≤ i, f i.succ j := by
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    simp [Finset.filter_le_eq_Ici, Finset.filter_ge_eq_Iic]
  _ = (∏ i, ∏ j ≥ i, f i.castSucc j) * ∏ i, ∏ j ≥ i, f j.succ i := by
    congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_comm'
    simp
  _ = ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ≥ i, (f i.castSucc j * f j.succ i) := by
    simp only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: sum_pow_mul_eq_add_pow
statement:
theorem sum_pow_mul_eq_add_pow {n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (a b : R) :
    (∑ s : Finset (Fin n), a ^ s.card * b ^ (n - s.card)) = (a + b) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Fintype.sum_pow_mul_eq_add_pow (Fin n) a b

name: sum_neg_one_pow
statement:
lemma sum_neg_one_pow (R : Type*) [Ring R] (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ n : Fin m, (-1) ^ n.1 : R) = if Even m then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n IH =>
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc, IH, Fin.val_last, Nat.even_add_one, ite_not]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [*]
    · simp [(Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp h).neg_pow]

name: partialProd_zero
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem partialProd_zero (f : Fin n → M) : partialProd f 0 = 1

name: partialProd_succ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem partialProd_succ (f : Fin n → M) (j : Fin n) :
    partialProd f j.succ = partialProd f (Fin.castSucc j) * f j

name: partialProd_succ'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem partialProd_succ' (f : Fin (n + 1) → M) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    partialProd f j.succ = f 0 * partialProd (Fin.tail f) j

name: partialProd_init
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma partialProd_init {f : Fin (n + 1) → M} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    partialProd (init f) i = partialProd f i.castSucc
proof:
:=
  i.inductionOn (by simp) fun i hi => by simp_all [init, partialProd_succ]

name: partialProd_left_inv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem partialProd_left_inv {G : Type*} [Group G] (f : Fin (n + 1) → G) :
    (f 0 • partialProd fun i : Fin n => (f i.castSucc)⁻¹ * f i.succ) = f
proof:
:=
  funext fun x => Fin.inductionOn x (by simp) fun x hx => by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hx ⊢
    rw [partialProd_succ, ← mul_assoc, hx, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: partialProd_right_inv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem partialProd_right_inv {G : Type*} [Group G] (f : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    (partialProd f (Fin.castSucc i))⁻¹ * partialProd f i.succ = f i

name: partialProd_contractNth
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma partialProd_contractNth {G : Type*} [Monoid G] {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → G) (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    partialProd (contractNth a (· * ·) g) = partialProd g ∘ a.succ.succAbove
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  refine inductionOn i ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, succ_succAbove_succ] at *
    rw [partialProd_succ, partialProd_succ, hi]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (i : ℕ) a with (h | h | h)
    · rw [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, contractNth_apply_of_lt _ _ _ _ h,
        succAbove_of_castSucc_lt] <;>
      simp only [lt_def, val_castSucc, val_succ] <;>
      lia
    · rw [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, contractNth_apply_of_eq _ _ _ _ h,
        succAbove_of_le_castSucc, castSucc_succ, partialProd_succ, mul_assoc] <;>
      simp only [castSucc_lt_succ_iff, le_def, val_castSucc] <;>
      lia
    · rw [succAbove_of_le_castSucc, succAbove_of_le_castSucc, contractNth_apply_of_gt _ _ _ _ h,
        castSucc_succ] <;>
      simp only [le_def, val_succ, val_castSucc] <;>
      lia

name: inv_partialProd_mul_eq_contractNth
statement:
@[to_additive
      /
      Then if `k < j`, this says `-(g₀ + g₁ + ... + gₖ₋₁) + (g₀ + g₁ + ... + gₖ) = gₖ`.
      If `k = j`, it says `-(g₀ + g₁ + ... + gₖ₋₁) + (g₀ + g₁ + ... + gₖ₊₁) = gₖ + gₖ₊₁`.
      If `k > j`, it says `-(g₀ + g₁ + ... + gₖ) + (g₀ + g₁ + ... + gₖ₊₁) = gₖ₊₁.`
      Useful for defining group cohomology. -/]
theorem inv_partialProd_mul_eq_contractNth {G : Type*} [Group G] (g : Fin (n + 1) → G)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    (partialProd g (j.succ.succAbove (Fin.castSucc k)))⁻¹ * partialProd g (j.succAbove k).succ =
      j.contractNth (· * ·) g k
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (k : ℕ) j with (h | h | h)
  · rwa [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, partialProd_right_inv,
    contractNth_apply_of_lt]
    · assumption
    · rw [castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le, succ_le_succ_iff, le_iff_val_le_val]
      exact le_of_lt h
  · rwa [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, succAbove_of_le_castSucc, partialProd_succ,
    castSucc_succ, ← mul_assoc,
      partialProd_right_inv, contractNth_apply_of_eq]
    · simp [le_iff_val_le_val, ← h]
    · rw [castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le, succ_le_succ_iff, le_iff_val_le_val]
      exact le_of_eq h
  · rwa [succAbove_of_le_castSucc, succAbove_of_le_castSucc, partialProd_succ, partialProd_succ,
      castSucc_succ, partialProd_succ, inv_mul_cancel_left, contractNth_apply_of_gt]
    · exact le_iff_val_le_val.2 (le_of_lt h)
    · rw [le_iff_val_le_val, val_succ]
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt h

name: finFunctionFinEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem finFunctionFinEquiv_apply {m n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Fin m) :
    (finFunctionFinEquiv f : ℕ) = ∑ i : Fin n, ↑(f i) * m ^ (i : ℕ)

name: finFunctionFinEquiv_single
statement:
theorem finFunctionFinEquiv_single {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m) :
    (finFunctionFinEquiv (Pi.single i j) : ℕ) = j * m ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finFunctionFinEquiv_apply, Fintype.sum_eq_single i, Pi.single_eq_same]
  rintro x hx
  rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hx, Fin.val_zero, zero_mul]

name: finPiFinEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem finPiFinEquiv_apply {m : ℕ} {n : Fin m → ℕ} (f : ∀ i : Fin m, Fin (n i)) :
    (finPiFinEquiv f : ℕ) = ∑ i, f i * ∏ j, n (Fin.castLE i.is_lt.le j)

name: finPiFinEquiv_single
statement:
theorem finPiFinEquiv_single {m : ℕ} {n : Fin m → ℕ} [∀ i, NeZero (n i)] (i : Fin m)
    (j : Fin (n i)) :
    (finPiFinEquiv (Pi.single i j : ∀ i : Fin m, Fin (n i)) : ℕ) =
      j * ∏ j, n (Fin.castLE i.is_lt.le j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finPiFinEquiv_apply, Fintype.sum_eq_single i, Pi.single_eq_same]
  rintro x hx
  rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hx, Fin.val_zero, zero_mul]

name: finSigmaFinEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finSigmaFinEquiv_apply {m : ℕ} {n : Fin m → ℕ} (k : (i : Fin m) × Fin (n i)) :
    (finSigmaFinEquiv k : ℕ) = ∑ i : Fin k.1, n (Fin.castLE k.1.2.le i) + k.2
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact k.fst.elim0
  | succ m ih =>
  rcases k with ⟨⟨iv, hi⟩, j⟩
  rw [finSigmaFinEquiv]
  unfold finSumFinEquiv
  simp only [Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, Equiv.trans_def,
    Equiv.trans_apply, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast]
  by_cases him : iv < m
  · conv in Sigma.mk _ _ =>
      equals ⟨Sum.inl ⟨iv, him⟩, j⟩ => simp [Fin.addCases, him]
    simpa using! ih _
  · replace him := Nat.eq_of_lt_succ_of_not_lt hi him
    subst him
    conv in Sigma.mk _ _ =>
      equals ⟨Sum.inr 0, j⟩ => simp [Fin.addCases, Fin.natAdd]
    simp
    rfl

name: finSigmaFinEquiv_one
statement:
theorem finSigmaFinEquiv_one {n : Fin 1 → ℕ} (ij : (i : Fin 1) × Fin (n i)) :
    (finSigmaFinEquiv ij : ℕ) = ij.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [finSigmaFinEquiv_apply, add_eq_right]
  apply @Finset.sum_of_isEmpty _ _ _ _ (by simpa using Fin.isEmpty')

name: prod_take_ofFn
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_take_ofFn {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → M) (i : ℕ) :
    ((ofFn f).take i).prod = ∏ j with j.val < i, f j
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    simp
  | succ i IH =>
    by_cases h : i < n
    · have : i < length (ofFn f) := by rwa [length_ofFn]
      rw [prod_take_succ _ _ this]
      have A : ({j | j.val < i + 1} : Finset (Fin n)) =
          insert ⟨i, h⟩ ({j | Fin.val j < i} : Finset (Fin n)) := by grind
      grind
    · have A : (ofFn f).take i = (ofFn f).take i.succ := by
        rw [← length_ofFn (f := f)] at h
        have : length (ofFn f) ≤ i := not_lt.mp h
        rw [take_of_length_le this, take_of_length_le (le_trans this (Nat.le_succ _))]
      have B : ∀ j : Fin n, ((j : ℕ) < i.succ) = ((j : ℕ) < i) := by
        intro j
        have : (j : ℕ) < i := lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 (not_lt.mp h)
        simp [this, lt_trans this (Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
      simp [← A, B, IH]

name: prod_ofFn
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_ofFn {n : ℕ} {f : Fin n → M} : (ofFn f).prod = ∏ i, f i

name: alternatingProd_eq_finsetProd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem alternatingProd_eq_finsetProd {G : Type*} [DivisionCommMonoid G] :
    ∀ (L : List G), alternatingProd L = ∏ i : Fin L.length, L[i] ^ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)
  | [] => by
    rw [alternatingProd, Finset.prod_eq_one]
    rintro ⟨i, ⟨⟩⟩
  | g::[] => by
    change g = ∏ i : Fin 1, [g][i] ^ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]; simp
  | g::h::L =>
    calc g * h⁻¹ * L.alternatingProd
      = g * h⁻¹ * ∏ i : Fin L.length, L[i] ^ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:=
        congr_arg _ (alternatingProd_eq_finsetProd _)
    _ = ∏ i : Fin (L.length + 2), (g::h::L)[i] ^ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
        { rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]
          simp [pow_add]}

name: Fin.sum_neg_one_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Fin.sum_neg_one_pow_eq_zero {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α]
    {n : ℕ} (d : Fin (n + 2) → α) (r : Fin (n + 1) → α)
    (h_first : d 0 = r 0)
    (h_mid : ∀ i : Fin n, d i.succ.castSucc = r i.castSucc + r i.succ)
    (h_last : d (Fin.last _) = r (Fin.last _)) :
    ∑ i, (-1) ^ i.val • d i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val • d i =
      d 0 +
      ∑ i : Fin n, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1) • (d (Fin.castSucc i).succ) +
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1) • d (Fin.last (n + 1)) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [add_assoc]
  have h₂ : ∑ i : Fin n, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1) • (r (Fin.castSucc i) + r (Fin.succ i)) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1) • r (Fin.castSucc i) +
      ∑ i : Fin n, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1) • r (Fin.succ i) := by
    simp_rw [zsmul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have h₃ := Fin.sum_univ_castSucc fun i ↦ (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val • r i
  simp_all [Fin.sum_univ_succ, pow_succ']
  grind

name: prod_insertNone
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_insertNone (f : Option α → M) (s : Finset α) :
    ∏ x ∈ insertNone s, f x = f none * ∏ x ∈ s, f (some x)

name: mul_prod_eq_prod_insertNone
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mul_prod_eq_prod_insertNone (f : α → M) (x : M) (s : Finset α) :
    x * ∏ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ i ∈ insertNone s, i.elim x f

name: prod_eraseNone
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eraseNone (f : α → M) (s : Finset (Option α)) :
    ∏ x ∈ eraseNone s, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, Option.elim' 1 f x
proof:
:= by
  classical calc
      ∏ x ∈ eraseNone s, f x = ∏ x ∈ (eraseNone s).map Embedding.some, Option.elim' 1 f x :=
        (prod_map (eraseNone s) Embedding.some <| Option.elim' 1 f).symm
      _ = ∏ x ∈ s.erase none, Option.elim' 1 f x := by rw [map_some_eraseNone]
      _ = ∏ x ∈ s, Option.elim' 1 f x := prod_erase _ rfl

name: expect_univ
statement: lemma expect_univ [Fintype ι] : 𝔼 i, f i = (∑ i, f i) /ℚ Fintype.card ι

name: expect_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_empty (f : ι → M) : 𝔼 i ∈ ∅, f i = 0

name: expect_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_singleton (f : ι → M) (i : ι) : 𝔼 j ∈ {i}, f j = f i

name: expect_const_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_const_zero (s : Finset ι) : 𝔼 _i ∈ s, (0 : M) = 0

name: expect_congr
statement:
@[congr]
lemma expect_congr {t : Finset ι} (hst : s = t) (h : ∀ i ∈ t, f i = g i) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, f i = 𝔼 i ∈ t, g i
proof: := by rw [expect, expect, sum_congr hst h, hst]

name: expectWith_congr
statement:
lemma expectWith_congr (hst : s = t) (hpq : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ↔ q i) (h : ∀ i ∈ t, q i → f i = g i) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s with p i, f i = 𝔼 i ∈ t with q i, g i
proof:
:=
  expect_congr (by rw [hst, filter_inj'.2 hpq]) <| by simpa using h

name: expect_sum_comm
statement:
lemma expect_sum_comm (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι → κ → M) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, f i j = ∑ j ∈ t, 𝔼 i ∈ s, f i j
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [expect, smul_sum] using sum_comm

name: expect_comm
statement:
lemma expect_comm (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι → κ → M) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, 𝔼 j ∈ t, f i j = 𝔼 j ∈ t, 𝔼 i ∈ s, f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [expect, expect, ← expect_sum_comm, ← expect_sum_comm, expect, expect, smul_comm, sum_comm]

name: expect_eq_zero
statement: lemma expect_eq_zero (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0) : 𝔼 i ∈ s, f i = 0

name: exists_ne_zero_of_expect_ne_zero
statement: lemma exists_ne_zero_of_expect_ne_zero (h : 𝔼 i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) : ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h; exact expect_eq_zero h

name: expect_add_distrib
statement:
lemma expect_add_distrib (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → M) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, (f i + g i) = 𝔼 i ∈ s, f i + 𝔼 i ∈ s, g i

name: expect_add_expect_comm
statement:
lemma expect_add_expect_comm (f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ι → M) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, (f₁ i + f₂ i) + 𝔼 i ∈ s, (g₁ i + g₂ i) =
      𝔼 i ∈ s, (f₁ i + g₁ i) + 𝔼 i ∈ s, (f₂ i + g₂ i)

name: expect_eq_single_of_mem
statement:
lemma expect_eq_single_of_mem (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) (h : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → f j = 0) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, f i = f i /ℚ #s

name: expect_ite_zero
statement:
lemma expect_ite_zero (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, p i → p j → i = j) (a : M) :
    𝔼 i ∈ s, ite (p i) a 0 = ite (∃ i ∈ s, p i) (a /ℚ #s) 0

name: expect_ite_mem
statement:
lemma expect_ite_mem (s t : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :

name: sum_Ico_by_parts
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_by_parts (hmn : m < n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Ico m n, f i • g i =
      f (n - 1) • G n - f m • G m - ∑ i ∈ Ico m (n - 1), (f (i + 1) - f i) • G (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (∑ i ∈ Ico (m + 1) n, f i • G i) = ∑ i ∈ Ico m (n - 1), f (i + 1) • G (i + 1) := by
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hmn), ← sum_Ico_add']
    simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right]
  have h₂ :
    (∑ i ∈ Ico (m + 1) n, f i • G (i + 1)) =
      (∑ i ∈ Ico m (n - 1), f i • G (i + 1)) + f (n - 1) • G n - f m • G (m + 1) := by
    rw [← sum_Ico_sub_bot _ hmn, ← sum_Ico_succ_sub_top _ (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hmn),
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (pos_of_gt hmn), sub_add_cancel]
  rw [sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hmn]
  conv in (occs := 3) (f _ • g _) => rw [← sum_range_succ_sub_sum g]
  simp_rw [smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib, h₂, h₁]
  conv_lhs => congr; rfl; rw [← add_sub, add_comm, ← add_sub, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  have : ∀ i, f i • G (i + 1) - f (i + 1) • G (i + 1) = -((f (i + 1) - f i) • G (i + 1)) := by
    intro i
    rw [sub_smul]
    abel
  simp_rw [this, sum_neg_distrib, sum_range_succ, smul_add]
  abel

name: sum_Ioc_by_parts
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_by_parts (hmn : m < n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Ioc m n, f i • g i =
      f n • G (n + 1) - f (m + 1) • G (m + 1)
        - ∑ i ∈ Ioc m (n - 1), (f (i + 1) - f i) • G (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Ico_add_one_add_one_eq_Ioc, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hmn),
    add_tsub_cancel_right] using! sum_Ico_by_parts f g (Nat.succ_lt_succ hmn)

name: sum_range_by_parts
statement:
theorem sum_range_by_parts :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, f i • g i =
      f (n - 1) • G n - ∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), (f (i + 1) - f i) • G (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  · simp only [range_eq_Ico]
    rw [sum_Ico_by_parts f g (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), sum_range_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    simp only [← range_eq_Ico]

name: sum_range_by_parts'
statement:
theorem sum_range_by_parts' :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, f i • g i =
      (∑ i ∈ range n, f i) • g (n - 1) -
        ∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), (∑ j ∈ range (i + 1), f j) • (g (i + 1) - g i)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ (f := fun i ↦ f i • g i), ih]
      simp only [sum_range_succ, smul_sub, add_smul]
      abel

name: prod_indicator_apply
statement:
lemma prod_indicator_apply (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Set κ) (g : ι → κ → R) (j : κ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).indicator (g i) j = (⋂ x ∈ s, f x).indicator (∏ i ∈ s, g i) j

:= by
  rw [Set.indicator]
  split_ifs with hj
  · rw [Finset.prod_apply]
    congr! 1 with i hi
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hj
    exact Set.indicator_of_mem (hj _ hi) _
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hj⟩ := by simpa using hj
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero hi <| Set.indicator_of_notMem hj _

name: Pi.single_induction
statement:
lemma Pi.single_induction [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)] (p : (Π i, M i) → Prop) (f : Π i, M i)
    (zero : p 0) (add : ∀ f g, p f → p g → p (f + g))
    (single : ∀ i m, p (Pi.single i m)) : p f
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single f]
  exact Finset.sum_induction _ _ add zero (by simp [single])

name: Pi.mulSingle_induction
statement:
@[to_additive existing (attr := elab_as_elim)]
lemma Pi.mulSingle_induction [∀ i, CommMonoid (M i)] (p : (Π i, M i) → Prop) (f : Π i, M i)
    (one : p 1) (mul : ∀ f g, p f → p g → p (f * g))
    (mulSingle : ∀ i m, p (Pi.mulSingle i m)) : p f
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [← Finset.univ_prod_mulSingle f]
  exact Finset.prod_induction _ _ mul one (by simp [mulSingle])

name: eqOn_finsetProd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eqOn_finsetProd {ι α β : Type*} [CommMonoid α]
    {s : Set β} {f f' : ι → β → α} (h : ∀ (i : ι), Set.EqOn (f i) (f' i) s) (v : Finset ι) :
    Set.EqOn (∏ i ∈ v, f i) (∏ i ∈ v, f' i) s
proof:
:=
  fun t ht => by simp [funext fun i ↦ h i ht]

name: eqOn_fun_finsetProd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eqOn_fun_finsetProd {ι α β : Type*} [CommMonoid α]
    {s : Set β} {f f' : ι → β → α} (h : ∀ (i : ι), Set.EqOn (f i) (f' i) s) (v : Finset ι) :
    Set.EqOn (fun b ↦ ∏ i ∈ v, f i b) (fun b ↦ ∏ i ∈ v, f' i b) s
proof:
:= by
  convert! eqOn_finsetProd h v <;> simp

name: prod_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp, grind =)]
theorem prod_apply (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → F) (x : α) : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) x = ∏ i ∈ s, f i x
proof:
:= by

  induction s using Finset.induction_on with

  | insert i s his h => simp [his, h]

name: FunLike.coe_prod

name: balance_apply
statement: lemma balance_apply (f : ι → G) (x : ι) : balance f x = f x - 𝔼 y, f y

name: balance_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma balance_zero : balance (0 : ι → G) = 0

name: balance_add

proof:

name: balance_sub

name: balance_neg

name: sum_balance

name: expect_balance
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_balance (f : ι → G) : 𝔼 x, balance f x = 0

name: balance_idem

proof:

name: map_balance
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_balance [FunLike F G H] [LinearMapClass F ℚ≥0 G H] (g : F) (f : ι → G) (a : ι) :

name: Multiset.sum_map_div

name: dens_disjiUnion
statement:

lemma dens_disjiUnion (s : Finset α) (t : α → Finset β) (h) :

name: dens_biUnion
statement:
lemma dens_biUnion [DecidableEq β] (h : (s : Set α).PairwiseDisjoint t) :
    (s.biUnion t).dens = ∑ u ∈ s, (t u).dens

name: dens_biUnion_le
