name: prod_antidiagonal_succ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_succ {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ × ℕ → M} :
    (∏ p ∈ antidiagonal (n + 1), f p)
      = f (0, n + 1) * ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f (p.1 + 1, p.2)

name: prod_antidiagonal_swap
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_swap {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ × ℕ → M} :
    ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f p.swap = ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f p
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← map_swap_antidiagonal, Finset.prod_map]
  rfl

name: prod_antidiagonal_succ'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_succ' {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ × ℕ → M} : (∏ p ∈ antidiagonal (n + 1), f p) =
    f (n + 1, 0) * ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f (p.1, p.2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_antidiagonal_swap, prod_antidiagonal_succ, ← prod_antidiagonal_swap]
  rfl

name: prod_antidiagonal_subst
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_subst {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ → M} :
    ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f p n = ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f p (p.1 + p.2)
proof:
:=
  prod_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ by rw [mem_antidiagonal.mp hp]

name: prod_antidiagonal_eq_prod_range_succ_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_eq_prod_range_succ_mk {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ × ℕ → M)
    (n : ℕ) : ∏ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, f ij = ∏ k ∈ range n.succ, f (k, n - k)
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_map (range n.succ) ⟨fun i ↦ (i, n - i), fun _ _ h ↦ (Prod.mk.inj h).1⟩ f

name: prod_antidiagonal_eq_prod_range_succ
statement:
@[to_additive /
`Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk` when using `rw ← `. -/]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_eq_prod_range_succ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, f ij.1 ij.2 = ∏ k ∈ range n.succ, f k (n - k)

name: exists_mem_multiset_dvd
statement: theorem exists_mem_multiset_dvd (hp : Prime p) {s : Multiset M₀} : p ∣ s.prod → ∃ a ∈ s, p ∣ a
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s (fun h => (hp.not_dvd_one h).elim) fun a s ih h =>
    have : p ∣ a * s.prod := by simpa using h
    match hp.dvd_or_dvd this with
    | Or.inl h => ⟨a, Multiset.mem_cons_self a s, h⟩
    | Or.inr h =>
      let ⟨a, has, h⟩ := ih h
      ⟨a, Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem has, h⟩

name: exists_mem_multiset_map_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_mem_multiset_map_dvd (hp : Prime p) {s : Multiset ι} {f : ι → M₀} :
    p ∣ (s.map f).prod → ∃ a ∈ s, p ∣ f a
proof:
:= fun h => by
  simpa only [exists_prop, Multiset.mem_map, exists_exists_and_eq_and] using
    hp.exists_mem_multiset_dvd h

name: exists_mem_finset_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_mem_finset_dvd (hp : Prime p) {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M₀} :
    p ∣ s.prod f → ∃ i ∈ s, p ∣ f i

name: Prod.associated_iff
statement:
theorem Prod.associated_iff {M N : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N] {x z : M × N} :
    x ~ᵤ z ↔ x.1 ~ᵤ z.1 ∧ x.2 ~ᵤ z.2
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨u, hu⟩ => ⟨⟨(MulEquiv.prodUnits.toFun u).1, (Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq.1 hu).1⟩,
    ⟨(MulEquiv.prodUnits.toFun u).2, (Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq.1 hu).2⟩⟩,
  fun ⟨⟨u₁, h₁⟩, ⟨u₂, h₂⟩⟩ =>
    ⟨MulEquiv.prodUnits.invFun (u₁, u₂), Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq.2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩⟩

name: Associated.prod
statement:
theorem Associated.prod {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M)
    (g : ι → M) (h : ∀ i, i ∈ s → (f i) ~ᵤ (g i)) : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ~ᵤ (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_empty]
    rfl
  | insert j s hjs IH =>
    classical
    convert_to (∏ i ∈ insert j s, f i) ~ᵤ (∏ i ∈ insert j s, g i)
    grind [Associated.mul_mul]

name: exists_associated_mem_of_dvd_prod
statement:
theorem exists_associated_mem_of_dvd_prod [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] [IsCancelMulZero M₀]
    {p : M₀} (hp : Prime p)
    {s : Multiset M₀} : (∀ r ∈ s, Prime r) → p ∣ s.prod → ∃ q ∈ s, p ~ᵤ q
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s (by simp [mt isUnit_iff_dvd_one.2 hp.not_isUnit]) fun a s ih hs hps => by
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons] at hps
    rcases hp.dvd_or_dvd hps with h | h
    · have hap := hs a (Multiset.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
      exact ⟨a, Multiset.mem_cons_self a _, hp.associated_of_dvd hap h⟩
    · rcases ih (fun r hr => hs _ (Multiset.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hr))) h with ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂⟩
      exact ⟨q, Multiset.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hq₁), hq₂⟩

name: divisor_closure_eq_closure
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hprod⟩ := exists_multiset_of_mem_closure hxy
  induction m using Multiset.induction generalizing x y with
  | empty =>
    apply subset_closure
    push _ ∈ _
    simp only [Multiset.prod_zero] at hprod
    left; exact .of_mul_eq_one _ hprod.symm
  | cons c s hind =>
    simp only [Multiset.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp, Set.mem_ofPred] at hm
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons] at hprod
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hind
    obtain ⟨ha₁ | ha₂, hs⟩ := hm
    · rcases ha₁.exists_right_inv with ⟨k, hk⟩
      refine hind x (y * k) ?_ hs ?_
      · simp only [← mul_assoc, ← hprod, ← Multiset.prod_cons, mul_comm]
        refine multiset_prod_mem _ _ (Multiset.forall_mem_cons.2 ⟨subset_closure ?_,
          Multiset.forall_mem_cons.2 ⟨subset_closure ?_, fun t ht => subset_closure (hs t ht)⟩⟩)
        · left; exact .of_mul_eq_one_right _ hk
        · left; exact ha₁
      · rw [← mul_one s.prod, ← hk, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_right_iff, mul_comm]
        left; exact hprod
    · rcases ha₂.dvd_mul.1 (Dvd.intro _ hprod) with ⟨c, hc⟩ | ⟨c, hc⟩
      · rw [hc]; rw [hc, mul_assoc] at hprod
        refine Submonoid.mul_mem _ (subset_closure ?_)
          (hind _ _ ?_ hs (mul_left_cancel₀ ha₂.ne_zero hprod))
        · right; exact ha₂
        rw [← mul_left_cancel₀ ha₂.ne_zero hprod]
        exact multiset_prod_mem _ _ (fun t ht => subset_closure (hs t ht))
      rw [hc, mul_comm x _, mul_assoc, mul_comm c _] at hprod
      refine hind x c ?_ hs (mul_left_cancel₀ ha₂.ne_zero hprod)
      rw [← mul_left_cancel₀ ha₂.ne_zero hprod]
      exact multiset_prod_mem _ _ (fun t ht => subset_closure (hs t ht))

name: Multiset.prod_primes_dvd
statement:
theorem Multiset.prod_primes_dvd [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] [IsCancelMulZero M₀]
    [∀ a : M₀, DecidablePred (Associated a)] {s : Multiset M₀} (n : M₀) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, Prime a)
    (div : ∀ a ∈ s, a ∣ n) (uniq : ∀ a, s.countP (Associated a) ≤ 1) : s.prod ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on generalizing n with
  | empty => simp only [Multiset.prod_zero, one_dvd]
  | cons a s induct =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons]
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : a ∣ n := div a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    gcongr
    refine induct _ (fun a ha => h a (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem ha)) (fun b b_in_s => ?_)
      fun a => (Multiset.countP_le_of_le _ (Multiset.le_cons_self _ _)).trans (uniq a)
    have b_div_n := div b (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem b_in_s)
    have a_prime := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have b_prime := h b (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem b_in_s)
    refine (b_prime.dvd_or_dvd b_div_n).resolve_left fun b_div_a => ?_
    have assoc := b_prime.associated_of_dvd a_prime b_div_a
    have := uniq a
    rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos _ (Associated.refl _), Nat.succ_le_succ_iff, ← not_lt,
      Multiset.countP_pos] at this
    exact this ⟨b, b_in_s, assoc.symm⟩

name: Finset.prod_primes_dvd
statement:
theorem Finset.prod_primes_dvd [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] [IsCancelMulZero M₀] [Subsingleton M₀ˣ]
    {s : Finset M₀} (n : M₀) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, Prime a) (div : ∀ a ∈ s, a ∣ n) : ∏ p ∈ s, p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
    exact
      Multiset.prod_primes_dvd n (by simpa only [Multiset.map_id', Finset.mem_def] using h)
        (by simpa only [Multiset.map_id', Finset.mem_def] using div)
        (by
          simp only [Multiset.map_id', associated_eq_eq, Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter,
            ← s.val.count_eq_card_filter_eq, ← Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one, s.nodup])

name: prod_mk
statement: theorem prod_mk {p : Multiset M} : (p.map Associates.mk).prod = Associates.mk p.prod
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on p (by simp) fun a s ih => by simp [ih, Associates.mk_mul_mk]

name: finsetProd_mk
statement:
theorem finsetProd_mk {p : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} :
    (∏ i ∈ p, Associates.mk (f i)) = Associates.mk (∏ i ∈ p, f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, ← Function.comp_def, ← Multiset.map_map, prod_mk,
    ← Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod]

name: rel_associated_iff_map_eq_map
statement:
theorem rel_associated_iff_map_eq_map {p q : Multiset M} :
    Multiset.Rel Associated p q ↔ p.map Associates.mk = q.map Associates.mk
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.rel_eq, Multiset.rel_map]
  simp only [mk_eq_mk_iff_associated]

name: prod_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem prod_eq_one_iff {p : Multiset (Associates M)} :
    p.prod = 1 ↔ ∀ a ∈ p, (a : Associates M) = 1
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on p (by simp)
    (by simp +contextual [mul_eq_one, or_imp, forall_and])

name: prod_le_prod
statement: theorem prod_le_prod {p q : Multiset (Associates M)} (h : p ≤ q) : p.prod ≤ q.prod
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq (Associates M)
  suffices p.prod ≤ (p + (q - p)).prod by rwa [add_tsub_cancel_of_le h] at this
  suffices p.prod * 1 ≤ p.prod * (q - p).prod by simpa
  exact mul_mono (le_refl p.prod) one_le

name: exists_mem_multiset_le_of_prime
statement:
theorem exists_mem_multiset_le_of_prime {s : Multiset (Associates M₀)} {p : Associates M₀}
    (hp : Prime p) : p ≤ s.prod → ∃ a ∈ s, p ≤ a
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s (fun ⟨_, eq⟩ => (hp.ne_one (mul_eq_one.1 eq.symm).1).elim)
    fun a s ih h =>
    have : p ≤ a * s.prod := by simpa using h
    match Prime.le_or_le hp this with
    | Or.inl h => ⟨a, Multiset.mem_cons_self a s, h⟩
    | Or.inr h =>
      let ⟨a, has, h⟩ := ih h
      ⟨a, Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem has, h⟩

name: prod_ne_zero_of_prime
statement:
theorem prod_ne_zero_of_prime [CommMonoidWithZero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] [Nontrivial M₀]
    (s : Multiset M₀) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, Prime x) : s.prod ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Multiset.prod_ne_zero fun h0 => Prime.ne_zero (h 0 h0) rfl

name: Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff
statement:
theorem Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff {S : Finset M₀} {p : M} (pp : Prime p) (g : M₀ → M) :
    p ∣ S.prod g ↔ ∃ a ∈ S, p ∣ g a
proof:
:=
  ⟨pp.exists_mem_finset_dvd, fun ⟨_, ha1, ha2⟩ => dvd_trans ha2 (dvd_prod_of_mem g ha1)⟩

name: Prime.not_dvd_finsetProd
statement:
theorem Prime.not_dvd_finsetProd {S : Finset M₀} {p : M} (pp : Prime p) {g : M₀ → M}
    (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, ¬p ∣ g a) : ¬p ∣ S.prod g
proof:
:= by
  exact mt (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff pp _).1 <| not_exists.2 fun a => not_and.2 (hS a)

name: Prime.dvd_finsuppProd_iff
statement:
theorem Prime.dvd_finsuppProd_iff {f : M₀ →₀ M} {g : M₀ → M → ℕ} {p : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) :
    p ∣ f.prod g ↔ ∃ a ∈ f.support, p ∣ g a (f a)

name: Prime.not_dvd_finsuppProd
statement:
theorem Prime.not_dvd_finsuppProd {f : M₀ →₀ M} {g : M₀ → M → ℕ} {p : ℕ} (pp : Prime p)
    (hS : ∀ a ∈ f.support, ¬p ∣ g a (f a)) : ¬p ∣ f.prod g

name: prod_Ico_add'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_add' [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid α]
    [ExistsAddOfLE α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α]
    (f : α → M) (a b c : α) : (∏ x ∈ Ico a b, f (x + c)) = ∏ x ∈ Ico (a + c) (b + c), f x

name: prod_Ico_add
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_add [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid α]
    [ExistsAddOfLE α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α]
    (f : α → M) (a b c : α) : (∏ x ∈ Ico a b, f (c + x)) = ∏ x ∈ Ico (a + c) (b + c), f x
proof:
:= by
  convert! prod_Ico_add' f a b c using 2
  rw [add_comm]

name: prod_Ico_add_right_sub_eq
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_Ico_add_right_sub_eq [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid α]
    [ExistsAddOfLE α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α] (a b c : α) :
    ∏ x ∈ Ico (a + c) (b + c), f (x - c) = ∏ x ∈ Ico a b, f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← map_add_right_Ico, prod_map, addRightEmbedding_apply, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: prod_Ico_succ_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_succ_top {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (f : ℕ → M) :
    (∏ k ∈ Ico a (b + 1), f k) = (∏ k ∈ Ico a b, f k) * f b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.insert_Ico_right_eq_Ico_add_one hab, prod_insert right_notMem_Ico, mul_comm]

name: prod_Ico_consecutive
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_consecutive (f : ℕ → M) {m n k : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (hnk : n ≤ k) :
    ((∏ i ∈ Ico m n, f i) * ∏ i ∈ Ico n k, f i) = ∏ i ∈ Ico m k, f i
proof:
:=
  Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico hmn hnk ▸ Eq.symm (prod_union (Ico_disjoint_Ico_consecutive m n k))

name: prod_Ioc_consecutive
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ioc_consecutive (f : ℕ → M) {m n k : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (hnk : n ≤ k) :
    ((∏ i ∈ Ioc m n, f i) * ∏ i ∈ Ioc n k, f i) = ∏ i ∈ Ioc m k, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ioc_union_Ioc_eq_Ioc hmn hnk, prod_union]
  apply disjoint_left.2 fun x hx h'x => _
  intro x hx h'x
  exact lt_irrefl _ ((mem_Ioc.1 h'x).1.trans_le (mem_Ioc.1 hx).2)

name: prod_Ioc_succ_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ioc_succ_top {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (f : ℕ → M) :
    (∏ k ∈ Ioc a (b + 1), f k) = (∏ k ∈ Ioc a b, f k) * f (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_Ioc_consecutive _ hab (Nat.le_succ b), Nat.Ioc_succ_singleton, prod_singleton]

name: prod_Icc_succ_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Icc_succ_top {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b + 1) (f : ℕ → M) :
    (∏ k ∈ Icc a (b + 1), f k) = (∏ k ∈ Icc a b, f k) * f (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, prod_Ico_succ_top hab, Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc]

name: prod_range_mul_prod_Ico
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_mul_prod_Ico (f : ℕ → M) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    ((∏ k ∈ range m, f k) * ∏ k ∈ Ico m n, f k) = ∏ k ∈ range n, f k
proof:
:=
  Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range m ▸ Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range n ▸ prod_Ico_consecutive f m.zero_le h

name: prod_range_eq_mul_Ico
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_eq_mul_Ico (f : ℕ → M) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, f x = f 0 * ∏ x ∈ Ico 1 n, f x

name: prod_Ico_eq_mul_inv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_eq_mul_inv {δ : Type*} [CommGroup δ] (f : ℕ → δ) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    ∏ k ∈ Ico m n, f k = (∏ k ∈ range n, f k) * (∏ k ∈ range m, f k)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq.2 <| by (rw [mul_comm]; exact prod_range_mul_prod_Ico f h)

name: prod_Ico_eq_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_eq_div {δ : Type*} [CommGroup δ] (f : ℕ → δ) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    ∏ k ∈ Ico m n, f k = (∏ k ∈ range n, f k) / ∏ k ∈ range m, f k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using prod_Ico_eq_mul_inv f h

name: prod_range_div_prod_range
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_div_prod_range {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] {f : ℕ → G} {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    ((∏ k ∈ range m, f k) / ∏ k ∈ range n, f k) = ∏ k ∈ range m with n ≤ k, f k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_Ico_eq_div f hnm]
  congr
  apply Finset.ext
  simp only [mem_Ico, mem_filter, mem_range, *]
  tauto

name: sum_Ico_Ico_comm
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_Ico_comm {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (a b : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico a b, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i b, f i j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico a b, ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico a (j + 1), f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine sum_nbij' (fun x ↦ ⟨x.2, x.1⟩) (fun x ↦ ⟨x.2, x.1⟩) ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) <;>
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Sigma.forall, Finset.mem_sigma] <;>
  lia

name: sum_Ico_Ico_comm'
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_Ico_comm' {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (a b : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico a b, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) b, f i j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico a b, ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico a j, f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine sum_nbij' (fun x ↦ ⟨x.2, x.1⟩) (fun x ↦ ⟨x.2, x.1⟩) ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) <;>
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Sigma.forall, Finset.mem_sigma] <;>
  lia

name: prod_Ico_eq_prod_range
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_eq_prod_range (f : ℕ → M) (m n : ℕ) :
    ∏ k ∈ Ico m n, f k = ∏ k ∈ range (n - m), f (m + k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : m ≤ n
  · rw [← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, prod_Ico_add, zero_add, tsub_add_cancel_of_le h]
  · replace h := h.le
    rw [Ico_eq_empty_of_le h, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr h, range_zero, prod_empty, prod_empty]

name: prod_Ico_reflect
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_reflect (f : ℕ → M) (k : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n + 1) :
    (∏ j ∈ Ico k m, f (n - j)) = ∏ j ∈ Ico (n + 1 - m) (n + 1 - k), f j
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ i < m, i ≤ n := by
    intro i hi
    exact (add_le_add_iff_right 1).1 (le_trans (Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le.1 hi) h)
  rcases lt_or_ge k m with hkm | hkm
  · rw [← Nat.Ico_image_const_sub_eq_Ico (this _ hkm)]
    refine (prod_image ?_).symm
    simp only [mem_Ico, Set.InjOn, mem_coe]
    rintro i ⟨_, im⟩ j ⟨_, jm⟩ Hij
    rw [← tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le (this _ im), Hij, tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le (this _ jm)]
  · have : n + 1 - k ≤ n + 1 - m := by
      rw [tsub_le_tsub_iff_left h]
      exact hkm
    simp only [hkm, Ico_eq_empty_of_le, prod_empty, Ico_eq_empty_of_le this]

name: prod_range_reflect
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_reflect (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ j ∈ range n, f (n - 1 - j)) = ∏ j ∈ range n, f j
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simp
  · simp only [← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, tsub_zero]
    rw [prod_Ico_reflect _ _ le_rfl]
    simp

name: prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial : ∀ n : ℕ, (∏ x ∈ Ico 1 (n + 1), x) = n !
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [prod_Ico_succ_top <| Nat.succ_le_succ <| Nat.zero_le n, Nat.factorial_succ,
      prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial n, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_comm]

name: sum_range_id_mul_two
statement: theorem sum_range_id_mul_two (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ range n, i) * 2 = n * (n - 1)
proof:
:=
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ range n, i) * 2 = (∑ i ∈ range n, i) + ∑ i ∈ range n, (n - 1 - i) := by
      rw [sum_range_reflect (fun i => i) n, mul_two]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range n, (i + (n - 1 - i)) := sum_add_distrib.symm
    _ = ∑ _ ∈ range n, (n - 1) :=
      sum_congr rfl fun _ hi => add_tsub_cancel_of_le <| Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt <| mem_range.1 hi
    _ = n * (n - 1) := by rw [sum_const, card_range, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]

name: sum_range_id
statement: theorem sum_range_id (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, i = n * (n - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_range_id_mul_two n, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ Nat.zero_lt_two]

name: prod_range_diag_flip
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_range_diag_flip (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∏ m ∈ range n, ∏ k ∈ range (m + 1), f k (m - k)) =
      ∏ m ∈ range n, ∏ k ∈ range (n - m), f m k
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_sigma', prod_sigma']
  refine prod_nbij' (fun a ↦ ⟨a.2, a.1 - a.2⟩) (fun a ↦ ⟨a.1 + a.2, a.1⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
    simp +contextual only [mem_sigma, mem_range, lt_tsub_iff_left,
      Nat.lt_succ_iff, le_add_iff_nonneg_right, Nat.zero_le, and_true, and_imp, implies_true,
      Sigma.forall, add_tsub_cancel_of_le, add_tsub_cancel_left]
  exact fun a b han hba ↦ lt_of_le_of_lt hba han

name: prod_range_succ_div_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_succ_div_prod : ((∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), f i) / ∏ i ∈ range n, f i) = f n

name: prod_range_succ_div_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_succ_div_top : (∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), f i) / f n = ∏ i ∈ range n, f i

name: prod_Ico_div_bot
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_div_bot (hmn : m < n) : (∏ i ∈ Ico m n, f i) / f m = ∏ i ∈ Ico (m + 1) n, f i

name: prod_Ico_succ_div_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_succ_div_top (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (∏ i ∈ Ico m (n + 1), f i) / f n = ∏ i ∈ Ico m n, f i

name: prod_Ico_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Ico_div (hmn : m ≤ n) : ∏ i ∈ Ico m n, f (i + 1) / f i = f n / f m
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_Ico_eq_div _ hmn, prod_range_div, prod_range_div, div_div_div_cancel_right]

name: prod_Icc_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_Icc_div (hmn : m ≤ n) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∏ i ∈ Icc m n, f (i + 1) / f i = f (n + 1) / f m

name: Finset.prod_fin_Icc_eq_prod_nat_Icc
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma Finset.prod_fin_Icc_eq_prod_nat_Icc [CommMonoid α] {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n) (f : Fin n → α) :
    ∏ i ∈ Icc a b, f i = ∏ i ∈ Icc (a : ℕ) b, if h : i < n then f ⟨i, h⟩ else 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_ite_mem_eq, prod_fin_eq_prod_range]
  apply prod_congr_of_eq_on_inter <;> grind

name: Fin.prod_Iic_div
statement:
lemma Fin.prod_Iic_div [CommGroup M] {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n) (f : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    ∏ i ∈ Iic a, (f i.succ / f i.castSucc) = f a.succ / f 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_ite_mem_eq, prod_fin_eq_prod_range]
  convert! prod_range_div (fun i ↦ if hi : i < n + 1 then f ⟨i, hi⟩ else 1) (a + 1) using 1 with k
    hk
  · exact prod_congr_of_eq_on_inter (by grind) (by grind) (by simp_all; grind)
  · grind

name: Fin.prod_Icc_div
statement:
lemma Fin.prod_Icc_div [CommGroup M] {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (f : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    ∏ i ∈ Icc a b, (f i.succ / f i.castSucc) = f b.succ / f a.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_fin_Icc_eq_prod_nat_Icc]
  convert! Finset.prod_Icc_div (Fin.le_def.1 hab) (fun i ↦ if hi : i < n + 1 then f ⟨i, hi⟩ else 1)
  · simp_all
    grind
  · grind
  · simp only [Order.lt_add_one_iff, is_le', ↓reduceDIte]
    rfl

name: sum_sym2_filter_not_isDiag
statement:
theorem sum_sym2_filter_not_isDiag {ι M} [LinearOrder ι] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset ι) (p : Sym2 ι → M) :
    ∑ i ∈ s.sym2 with ¬ i.IsDiag, p i = ∑ i ∈ s.offDiag with i.1 < i.2, p s(i.1, i.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.offDiag_filter_lt_eq_filter_le]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter]
  refine (Finset.sum_equiv Sym2.sortEquiv.symm ?_ ?_).symm
  all_goals aesop

name: sum_count_of_mem_sym
statement:
theorem sum_count_of_mem_sym {α} [DecidableEq α] {m : ℕ} {k : Sym α m} {s : Finset α}
    (hk : k ∈ s.sym m) : (∑ i ∈ s, count i k) = m

name: smul_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_def [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] [GMonoid A] [Gmodule A M]
    (x : ⨁ i, A i) (y : ⨁ i, M i) :
    x • y = smulAddMonoidHom _ _ x y

name: smulAddMonoidHom_apply_of_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smulAddMonoidHom_apply_of_of [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] [GMonoid A] [Gmodule A M]
    {i j} (x : A i) (y : M j) :
    smulAddMonoidHom A M (DirectSum.of A i x) (of M j y) = of M (i +ᵥ j) (GSMul.smul x y)

name: of_smul_of
statement:
theorem of_smul_of [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] [GMonoid A] [Gmodule A M]
    {i j} (x : A i) (y : M j) :
    DirectSum.of A i x • of M j y = of M (i +ᵥ j) (GSMul.smul x y)

name: one_smul'
statement:
private theorem one_smul' [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] [GMonoid A] [Gmodule A M]
    (x : ⨁ i, M i) :
    (1 : ⨁ i, A i) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  suffices smulAddMonoidHom A M 1 = AddMonoidHom.id (⨁ i, M i) from DFunLike.congr_fun this x
  apply DirectSum.addHom_ext; intro i xi
  rw [show (1 : DirectSum ιA fun i => A i) = (of A 0) GOne.one by rfl]
  rw [smulAddMonoidHom_apply_of_of]
  exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (one_smul (GradedMonoid A) <| GradedMonoid.mk i xi)

name: mul_smul'
statement:
private theorem mul_smul' [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] [GSemiring A] [Gmodule A M]
    (a b : ⨁ i, A i)
    (c : ⨁ i, M i) : (a * b) • c = a • b • c
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    (
              smulAddMonoidHom
              A M).compHom.comp
        (DirectSum.mulHom A) =
      (AddMonoidHom.compHom AddMonoidHom.flipHom <|
          (smulAddMonoidHom A M).flip.compHom.comp <| smulAddMonoidHom A M).flip
    from 
      DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun this a) b) c
  ext ai ax bi bx ci cx : 6
  dsimp only [coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, compHom_apply_apply, flip_apply, flipHom_apply]
  rw [smulAddMonoidHom_apply_of_of, smulAddMonoidHom_apply_of_of, DirectSum.mulHom_of_of,
    smulAddMonoidHom_apply_of_of]
  exact
    DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq
      (mul_smul (GradedMonoid.mk ai ax) (GradedMonoid.mk bi bx) (GradedMonoid.mk ci cx))

name: spanRank_toENat_eq_iInf_encard
statement:
lemma spanRank_toENat_eq_iInf_encard (p : Submodule R M) : p.spanRank.toENat =
    (⨅ (s : Set M) (_ : span R s = p), s.encard)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanRank]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine le_iInf₂ (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    rw [Set.encard, ENat.card]
    exact toENat.monotone' (ciInf_le' _ (⟨s, hs⟩ : {s : Set M // span R s = p}))
  · have := congrFun toENat_comp_ofENat.{u}.symm (⨅ (s : Set M) (_ : span R s = p), s.encard)
    rw [id_eq] at this; rw [this]
    refine toENat.monotone' (le_ciInf fun s ↦ ?_)
    have : ofENat.{u} (⨅ (s' : Set M), ⨅ (_ : span R s' = p), s'.encard) ≤ ofENat s.1.encard :=
      ofENatHom.monotone' (le_trans (ciInf_le' _ s.1) (ciInf_le' _ s.2))
    apply le_trans this
    rw [Set.encard, ENat.card]
    exact Cardinal.ofENat_toENat_le _

name: spanRank_toENat_eq_iInf_finset_card
statement:
lemma spanRank_toENat_eq_iInf_finset_card (p : Submodule R M) :
    p.spanRank.toENat = ⨅ (s : {s : Finset M // span R s = p}), (s.1.card : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanRank_toENat_eq_iInf_encard]
  rcases eq_or_ne (⨅ (s : Set M) (_ : span R s = p), s.encard) ⊤ with (h1 | h2)
  · rw [h1, eq_comm]; simp_rw [iInf_eq_top] at h1 ⊢
    exact fun s ↦ False.elim (Set.encard_ne_top_iff.mpr s.1.finite_toSet (h1 s.1 s.2))
  · simp_rw [← Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_iInf fun s ↦ iInf₂_le (s.1 : Set M) s.2
    · refine le_iInf fun s ↦ le_iInf fun h ↦ ?_
      by_cases hs : s.Finite
      · exact iInf_le_of_le ⟨hs.toFinset, by simpa⟩ (by simp)
      · rw [Set.Infinite.encard_eq hs]
        exact OrderTop.le_top _

name: spanFinrank_eq_iInf
statement:
lemma spanFinrank_eq_iInf (p : Submodule R M) :
    p.spanFinrank = ⨅ (s : {s : Finset M // span R s = p}), s.1.card

name: spanRank_finite_iff_fg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma spanRank_finite_iff_fg {p : Submodule R M} : p.spanRank < aleph0 ↔ p.FG
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanRank, Submodule.fg_def]
  constructor
  · rintro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ⨅ (s : {s : Set M // span R s = p}), #s ∈
      Set.range (fun (s : {s : Set M // span R s = p}) ↦ #s) := csInf_mem ⟨#p, ⟨⟨p, by simp⟩, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨s.1, ?_, s.2⟩
    simpa [← hs] using h
  · rintro ⟨s, hs₁, hs₂⟩
    exact (ciInf_le' _ ⟨s, hs₂⟩).trans_lt (by simpa)

name: spanFinrank_of_not_fg
statement: lemma spanFinrank_of_not_fg {p : Submodule R M} (hp : ¬p.FG) : p.spanFinrank = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine toNat_eq_zero.2 ?_
  right
  by_contra! h
  exact hp (spanRank_finite_iff_fg.1 h)

name: fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank
statement: lemma fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank {p : Submodule R M} : p.spanRank = p.spanFinrank ↔ p.FG
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanFinrank, ← spanRank_finite_iff_fg, eq_comm]
  exact cast_toNat_eq_iff_lt_aleph0

name: FG.spanRank_eq_spanFinrank
statement: lemma FG.spanRank_eq_spanFinrank {p : Submodule R M} (fg : p.FG) : p.spanRank = p.spanFinrank

name: FG.spanRank_le_iff
statement:
lemma FG.spanRank_le_iff {p : Submodule R M} (hp : p.FG) (n : ℕ) :

name: FG.spanRank_eq_iff
statement:
lemma FG.spanRank_eq_iff {p : Submodule R M} (hp : p.FG) (n : ℕ) :
    p.spanRank = n ↔ p.spanFinrank = n

name: spanRank_span_le_card
statement: lemma spanRank_span_le_card (s : Set M) : (Submodule.span R s).spanRank ≤ #s
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanRank]
  let s' : {s1 : Set M // span R s1 = span R s} := ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact ciInf_le' _ s'

name: spanRank_span_range_of_linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_trans (spanRank_span_le_card _) mk_range_le) (le_ciInf fun x ↦ ?_)
  have : #x.1 = #((Subtype.val : span R (.range v) → _) ⁻¹' x.1) :=
    (mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range _ _ Subtype.val_injective (by simp [← x.2])).symm
  rw [this]
  refine le_trans ?_ ((Module.Basis.span hs).le_span (R := R) (J := Subtype.val ⁻¹' x.1) ?_)
  · rw [mk_range_eq]
    exact .of_comp (f := Subtype.val) (by convert! hv; ext; simp [Module.Basis.span_apply])
  · apply map_injective_of_injective (f := (span R _).subtype) (injective_subtype _)
    simp [map_span, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left, ← x.2]

name: spanRank_span_of_linearIndepOn
statement:
lemma spanRank_span_of_linearIndepOn [RankCondition R] (s : Set M) (hs : LinearIndepOn R id s) :
    (span R s).spanRank = #s

name: spanFinrank_span_le_encard
statement: lemma spanFinrank_span_le_encard (s : Set M) : (span R s).spanFinrank ≤ s.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanFinrank, Set.encard, ENat.card]
  exact le_trans (by simp) (toENat.monotone' (spanRank_span_le_card (R := R) s))

name: spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite
statement:
lemma spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite {s : Set M} (hs : s.Finite) :
    (span R s).spanFinrank ≤ s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞)]
  exact le_trans (spanFinrank_span_le_encard _) hs.cast_ncard_eq.ge

name: exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank
statement:
theorem exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank (p : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ s : Set M, #s = p.spanRank ∧ span R s = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanRank]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ⨅ (s : {s : Set M // span R s = p}), #s ∈
    Set.range (fun (s : {s : Set M // span R s = p}) ↦ #s) := csInf_mem ⟨#p, ⟨⟨p, by simp⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  exact ⟨s.1, ⟨hs, s.2⟩⟩

name: FG.exists_span_set_encard_eq_spanFinrank
statement:
theorem FG.exists_span_set_encard_eq_spanFinrank {p : Submodule R M} (h : p.FG) :
    ∃ s : Set M, s.encard = p.spanFinrank ∧ span R s = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩⟩ := exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank p
  refine ⟨s, ⟨?_, hs₂⟩⟩
  have := fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank.mpr h
  rw [Set.encard, ENat.card, spanFinrank, hs₁, this]
  simp

name: FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
statement:
theorem FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank {p : Submodule R M} (h : p.FG) :
    ∃ s : Finset M, s.card = p.spanFinrank ∧ span R s = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩⟩ := exists_span_set_encard_eq_spanFinrank h
  have s_f := Set.finite_of_encard_eq_coe hs₁
  refine ⟨s_f.toFinset, ⟨?_, by simpa using hs₂⟩⟩
  simpa [s_f.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card, ENat.natCast_inj] using hs₁

name: lift_spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le
statement:
lemma lift_spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le (p : Submodule R M) {a : Cardinal.{max u v}} :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} p.spanRank ≤ a ↔ ∃ s : Set M, Cardinal.lift.{v} #s ≤ a ∧ span R s = p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩⟩ := exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank p
    exact ⟨s, ⟨hs₁ ▸ h, hs₂⟩⟩
  · exact fun ⟨s, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩ ↦ h₂.symm ▸ (Cardinal.lift_le.mpr (spanRank_span_le_card s)).trans h₁

name: FG.spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le
statement:
lemma FG.spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le (p : Submodule R M) {a : Cardinal} :
    p.spanRank ≤ a ↔ ∃ s : Set M, #s ≤ a ∧ span R s = p

name: spanRank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma spanRank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot {I : Submodule R M} : I.spanRank = 0 ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩⟩ :=
      (FG.spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le I (a := 0)).mp (by rw [h])
    simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero, mk_eq_zero_iff, Set.isEmpty_coe_sort] at hs₁
    simp_all
  · rintro rfl; rw [spanRank]
    exact Cardinal.iInf_eq_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨⟨∅, by simp⟩, by simp⟩)

name: spanRank_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma spanRank_bot : (⊥ : Ideal R).spanRank = 0

name: spanFinrank_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma spanFinrank_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R M).spanFinrank = 0

name: spanRank_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
lemma spanRank_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (p : Submodule R M) : p.spanRank = 0

name: spanFinrank_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
lemma spanFinrank_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (p : Submodule R M) : p.spanFinrank = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Module.subsingleton R M
  simp [Submodule.eq_bot_of_subsingleton]

name: generators_card
statement: lemma generators_card (p : Submodule R M) : #(generators p) = spanRank p

name: FG.generators_ncard
statement:
lemma FG.generators_ncard {p : Submodule R M} (h : p.FG) :
    (generators p).ncard = spanFinrank p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := Cardinal), ← fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank.mpr h, Set.ncard, Set.encard,
     ENat.card, generators_card, toNat_toENat, ← spanFinrank]
  exact (fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank.mpr h).symm

name: FG.finite_generators
statement:
lemma FG.finite_generators {p : Submodule R M} (hp : p.FG) :
    p.generators.Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite, Submodule.generators_card]
  exact spanRank_finite_iff_fg.mpr hp

name: span_generators
statement: lemma span_generators (p : Submodule R M) : span R (generators p) = p

name: FG.generators_mem
statement: lemma FG.generators_mem (p : Submodule R M) : generators p ⊆ p
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← span_generators p]
  exact subset_span (s := generators p)

name: spanRank_sup_le_sum_spanRank
statement:
lemma spanRank_sup_le_sum_spanRank {p q : Submodule R M} :
    (p ⊔ q).spanRank ≤ p.spanRank + q.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  apply (FG.spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le (p ⊔ q)).mpr
  obtain ⟨sp, ⟨hp₁, rfl⟩⟩ := exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank p
  obtain ⟨sq, ⟨hq₁, rfl⟩⟩ := exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank q
  exact ⟨sp ∪ sq, ⟨hp₁ ▸ hq₁ ▸ (Cardinal.mk_union_le sp sq), span_union sp sq⟩⟩

name: spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot
statement:
lemma spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot {p : Submodule R M} (h : p.FG) :
    p.spanFinrank = 0 ↔ p = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun heq ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩
  rw [← Submodule.FG.generators_ncard h, Set.ncard_eq_zero h.finite_generators] at heq
  rw [← p.span_generators, heq, span_empty]

name: spanFinrank_singleton
statement: lemma spanFinrank_singleton {m : M} (hm : m ≠ 0) : (span R {m}).spanFinrank = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · exact le_trans (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (by simp)) (by simp)
  · by_contra!
    simp [Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot (fg_span_singleton m), hm] at this

name: spanFinrank_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma spanFinrank_eq_one_iff (p : Submodule R M) : p.spanFinrank = 1 ↔ p.IsPrincipal ∧ p ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, (by grind [spanFinrank_bot])⟩,
    fun ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, _⟩ ↦ ha ▸ spanFinrank_singleton (by simp_all)⟩
  have fg : p.FG := spanRank_finite_iff_fg.1 (by simp_all [spanFinrank])
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, p.generators = {a} := by simpa [← fg.generators_ncard] using h
  exact ⟨a, ha ▸ (p.span_generators).symm⟩

name: lift_spanRank_map_le
statement:
lemma lift_spanRank_map_le [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] L) (p : Submodule R M) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (p.map f).spanRank ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} p.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← generators_card p, lift_spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le]
  exact ⟨f '' p.generators, Cardinal.mk_image_le_lift, le_antisymm (span_le.2 (fun n ⟨m, hm, h⟩ ↦
    ⟨m, span_generators p ▸ subset_span hm, h⟩)) (by simp [span_generators])⟩

name: spanRank_map_le
statement:
lemma spanRank_map_le [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (p : Submodule R M) :
    (p.map f).spanRank ≤ p.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lift_spanRank_map_le f p

name: spanFinrank_map_le_of_fg
statement:
lemma spanFinrank_map_le_of_fg [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] L) {p : Submodule R M}
    (hp : p.FG) : (p.map f).spanFinrank ≤ p.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hp.map f).spanRank_le_iff, ← Cardinal.lift_le.{u}, Cardinal.lift_natCast,
    ← Cardinal.lift_natCast.{v}, ← hp.spanRank_eq_spanFinrank]
  exact p.lift_spanRank_map_le f

name: lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_injective
statement:
lemma lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_injective [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] L)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : Submodule R M) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (p.map f).spanRank = Cardinal.lift.{v} p.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  refine (lift_spanRank_map_le f p).antisymm ?_
  obtain ⟨s, hs, e⟩ := (p.map f).exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, f '' y = s := Set.subset_range_iff_exists_image_eq.mp
    ((subset_span.trans e.le).trans LinearMap.map_le_range)
  obtain rfl : span R s = p := by simpa [(map_injective_of_injective hf).eq_iff] using e
  grw [← hs, Cardinal.mk_image_eq_lift _ _ hf, Cardinal.lift_le, spanRank_span_le_card]

name: spanRank_map_eq_of_injective
statement:
lemma spanRank_map_eq_of_injective [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : Submodule R M) : (p.map f).spanRank = p.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_injective f hf p

name: spanFinrank_map_eq_of_injective
statement:
lemma spanFinrank_map_eq_of_injective [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] L)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) {p : Submodule R M} :
    (p.map f).spanFinrank = p.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.spanFinrank, Submodule.spanFinrank, ← Cardinal.toNat_lift.{u, v},
    ← Cardinal.toNat_lift.{v, u}, lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_injective f hf p]

name: spanRank_range_le
statement:
lemma spanRank_range_le [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] N) :
    (LinearMap.range f).spanRank ≤ (⊤ : Submodule R M).spanRank

name: spanRank_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma spanRank_top (p : Submodule R M) : (⊤ : Submodule R p).spanRank = p.spanRank

statement: lemma spanFinrank_top (p : Submodule R M) : (⊤ : Submodule R p).spanFinrank = p.spanFinrank

name: spanRank_eq_of_equiv
statement:
lemma spanRank_eq_of_equiv
    {σ' : S →+* R} [RingHomInvPair σ σ'] [RingHomInvPair σ' σ]
    (e : M ≃ₛₗ[σ] N) : (⊤ : Submodule R M).spanRank = (⊤ : Submodule S N).spanRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← spanRank_map_eq_of_injective e.toLinearMap e.injective ⊤, map_top, LinearEquiv.range]

name: le_spanRank_restrictScalars
statement:
lemma le_spanRank_restrictScalars (N : Submodule S M) :
    N.spanRank ≤ (N.restrictScalars R).spanRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, e⟩ := (N.restrictScalars R).exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank
  obtain rfl : span S s = N :=
    le_antisymm (span_le.mpr (span_le.mp e.le :)) (e.ge.trans (span_le_restrictScalars R S s))
  grw [← hs, spanRank_span_le_card]

name: spanRank_restrictScalars_eq
statement:
lemma spanRank_restrictScalars_eq (H : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R S))
    (N : Submodule S M) : (N.restrictScalars R).spanRank = N.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  refine N.le_spanRank_restrictScalars.antisymm' ?_
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := N.exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank
  grw [restrictScalars_span R S H s, ← hs, spanRank_span_le_card]

name: Ideal.lift_spanRank_map_le
statement:
lemma Ideal.lift_spanRank_map_le (f : R →+* T) (I : Ideal R) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (I.map f).spanRank ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} I.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← generators_card I, lift_spanRank_le_iff_exists_span_set_card_le]
  refine ⟨f '' I.generators, Cardinal.mk_image_le_lift, le_antisymm (span_le.2 (fun s ⟨r, hr, hfr⟩ ↦
    hfr ▸ mem_map_of_mem _ <| span_generators I ▸ subset_span hr)) ?_⟩
  refine map_le_of_le_comap (fun r hr ↦ ?_)
  simp only [submodule_span_eq, mem_comap]
  rw [← map_span, ← submodule_span_eq, span_generators]
  exact mem_map_of_mem f hr

name: Ideal.lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma Ideal.lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv (f : R ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (I.map f).spanRank = Cardinal.lift.{v} I.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  apply (I.lift_spanRank_map_le (f : R →+* T)).antisymm
  nth_rw 1 [← Ideal.map_of_equiv f (I := I)]
  exact Ideal.lift_spanRank_map_le (f.symm : T →+* R) _

name: Ideal.spanRank_map_le
statement: lemma Ideal.spanRank_map_le (f : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) : (I.map f).spanRank ≤ I.spanRank

name: Ideal.spanRank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Ideal.spanRank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv (f : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :

name: Ideal.spanFinrank_map_le_of_fg
statement:
lemma Ideal.spanFinrank_map_le_of_fg (f : R →+* T) {I : Ideal R} (hI : I.FG) :
    (I.map f).spanFinrank ≤ I.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.FG.spanRank_le_iff (hI.map f), ← Cardinal.lift_le.{u}, Cardinal.lift_natCast,
    ← Cardinal.lift_natCast.{v}, ← Submodule.FG.spanRank_eq_spanFinrank hI]
  exact I.lift_spanRank_map_le f

name: Ideal.spanFinrank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Ideal.spanFinrank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv (f : R ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map f).spanFinrank = I.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.spanFinrank, Submodule.spanFinrank, ← Cardinal.toNat_lift.{u, v},
    ← Cardinal.toNat_lift.{v, u}, I.lift_spanRank_map_eq_of_ringEquiv f]

name: Module.Basis.mk_eq_spanRank
statement:
lemma Module.Basis.mk_eq_spanRank [RankCondition R] {ι : Type*} (v : Basis ι R M) :
    #(Set.range v) = (⊤ : Submodule R M).spanRank
proof:

  rw [← v.span_eq, spanRank_span_of_linearIndepOn]
  exact v.linearIndependent.linearIndepOn_id

name: Submodule.rank_eq_spanRank_of_free
statement:
theorem Submodule.rank_eq_spanRank_of_free [Module.Free R M] [StrongRankCondition R] :
    Module.rank R M = (⊤ : Submodule R M).spanRank
proof:
:= by
  have := nontrivial_of_invariantBasisNumber R
  obtain ⟨I, B⟩ := ‹Module.Free R M›
  rw [← Basis.mk_eq_rank'' B, ← Basis.mk_eq_spanRank B, ← Cardinal.lift_id #(Set.range B),
    Cardinal.mk_range_eq_of_injective B.injective, Cardinal.lift_id _]

name: Module.finrank_eq_spanFinrank_of_free
statement:
lemma Module.finrank_eq_spanFinrank_of_free [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Free R M] :

name: Submodule.rank_le_spanRank
statement:
theorem Submodule.rank_le_spanRank [StrongRankCondition R] :
    Module.rank R M ≤ (⊤ : Submodule R M).spanRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.rank, Submodule.spanRank]
  refine ciSup_le' (fun ι ↦ (le_ciInf fun s ↦ ?_))
  have := linearIndependent_le_span'' ι.2 s.1 s.2
  simpa

name: mk_le_of_module
statement:
theorem mk_le_of_module (R : Type u) (E : Type v)
    [AddCommGroup E] [Ring R] [IsDomain R] [Module R E] [Nontrivial E] [Module.IsTorsionFree R E] :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (#R) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{u} (#E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ (x : E), x ≠ 0 := exists_ne 0
  have : Injective (fun k ↦ k • x) := smul_left_injective R hx
  exact lift_mk_le_lift_mk_of_injective this

name: isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_is_torsion_by_ideal
statement:
theorem isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_is_torsion_by_ideal
    {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hM : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M I) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun p : (factors I).toFinset =>
      torsionBySet R M (p ^ (factors I).count ↑p : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  let P := factors I
  have prime_of_mem := fun p (hp : p ∈ P.toFinset) =>
    prime_of_factor p (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hp)
  apply torsionBySet_isInternal (p := fun p => p ^ P.count p) _
  · convert! hM
    rw [← Finset.inf_eq_iInf, IsDedekindDomain.inf_pow_eq_prod_of_prime,
      ← Finset.prod_multiset_count, ← associated_iff_eq]
    · exact factors_prod hI
    · exact prime_of_mem
    · exact fun _ _ _ _ ij => ij
  · intro p hp q hq pq
    rw [Ideal.irreducible_pow_sup]
    · suffices (normalizedFactors _).count p = 0 by rw [this, zero_min, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
      rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero,
        normalizedFactors_of_irreducible_pow (prime_of_mem q hq).irreducible,
        Multiset.mem_replicate]
      exact fun H => pq <| H.2.trans <| normalize_eq q
    · rw [← Ideal.zero_eq_bot]; apply pow_ne_zero; exact (prime_of_mem q hq).ne_zero
    · exact (prime_of_mem p hp).irreducible

name: isInternal_prime_power_torsion
statement:
theorem isInternal_prime_power_torsion [Module.Finite R M]
    (hM : Module.IsTorsion R M) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun p : (factors (⊤ : Submodule R M).annihilator).toFinset =>
      torsionBySet R M (p ^ (factors (⊤ : Submodule R M).annihilator).count ↑p : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  have hM' := Module.isTorsionBySet_annihilator_top R M
  have hI := Submodule.annihilator_top_inter_nonZeroDivisors hM
  refine isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_is_torsion_by_ideal ?_ hM'
  rw [Submodule.ne_bot_iff]
  obtain ⟨x, H, hx⟩ := hI; exact ⟨x, H, nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hx⟩

name: exists_isInternal_prime_power_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_isInternal_prime_power_torsion [Module.Finite R M] (hM : Module.IsTorsion R M) :
    ∃ (P : Finset <| Ideal R) (_ : DecidableEq P) (_ : ∀ p ∈ P, Prime p) (e : P → ℕ),
      DirectSum.IsInternal fun p : P => torsionBySet R M (p ^ e p : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨_, _, fun p hp => prime_of_factor p (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hp), _,
    isInternal_prime_power_torsion hM⟩

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul, zero_smul]
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_smul, add_smul, one_smul, ih, one_smul]

theorem map_intCast_smul [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M₂] {F : Type*} [FunLike F M M₂]

name: CharZero.of_module
statement:
lemma CharZero.of_module [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoidWithOne M] [CharZero M] [Module R M] :
    CharZero R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun m n h => @Nat.cast_injective M _ _ _ _ ?_⟩

name: Submodule.isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_pid
statement:
theorem Submodule.isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_pid [Module.Finite R M]
    (hM : Module.IsTorsion R M) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun p : (factors (⊤ : Submodule R M).annihilator).toFinset =>
      torsionBy R M
        (IsPrincipal.generator (p : Ideal R) ^
          (factors (⊤ : Submodule R M).annihilator).count ↑p)
proof:
:= by
  convert! isInternal_prime_power_torsion hM
  rw [← torsionBySet_span_singleton_eq, Ideal.submodule_span_eq, ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
    Ideal.span_singleton_generator]

name: Submodule.exists_isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_pid
statement:
theorem Submodule.exists_isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_pid [Module.Finite R M]
    (hM : Module.IsTorsion R M) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : DecidableEq ι) (p : ι → R) (_ : ∀ i, Irreducible <| p i)
        (e : ι → ℕ), DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => torsionBy R M <| p i ^ e i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_, ?_, _, _, ?_, _, Submodule.isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_pid hM⟩
  · exact Finset.fintypeCoeSort _
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    have hP := prime_of_factor p (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hp)
    have := Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hP
    exact (IsPrincipal.prime_generator_of_isPrime p hP.ne_zero).irreducible

name: _root_.Ideal.torsionOf_eq_span_pow_pOrder
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.torsionOf_eq_span_pow_pOrder (x : M) :
    torsionOf R M x = span {p ^ pOrder hM x}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only [pOrder]
  rw [← (torsionOf R M x).span_singleton_generator, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton, ←
    Associates.mk_eq_mk_iff_associated, Associates.mk_pow]
  have prop :
    (fun n : ℕ => p ^ n • x = 0) = fun n : ℕ =>
      (Associates.mk <| generator <| torsionOf R M x) ∣ Associates.mk p ^ n := by
    ext n; rw [← Associates.mk_pow, Associates.mk_dvd_mk, ← mem_iff_generator_dvd]; rfl
  have := (isTorsion'_powers_iff p).mp hM x; rw [prop] at this
  convert!
    Associates.eq_pow_find_of_dvd_irreducible_pow (Associates.irreducible_mk.mpr hp)
      this.choose_spec

name: p_pow_smul_lift
statement:
theorem p_pow_smul_lift {x y : M} {k : ℕ} (hM' : Module.IsTorsionBy R M (p ^ pOrder hM y))
    (h : p ^ k • x ∈ R ∙ y) : ∃ a : R, p ^ k • x = p ^ k • a • y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hk : k ≤ pOrder hM y
  · let f :=
      ((R ∙ p ^ (pOrder hM y - k) * p ^ k).quotEquivOfEq _ ?_).trans
        (quotTorsionOfEquivSpanSingleton R M y)
    · have : f.symm ⟨p ^ k • x, h⟩ ∈
          R ∙ Ideal.Quotient.mk (R ∙ p ^ (pOrder hM y - k) * p ^ k) (p ^ k) := by
        rw [← Quotient.torsionBy_eq_span_singleton, mem_torsionBy_iff, ← f.symm.map_smul]
        · convert! f.symm.map_zero; ext
          rw [coe_smul_of_tower, coe_mk, coe_zero, smul_smul, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk,
            @hM' x]
        · exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero)
      rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at this; obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this; use a
      rw [f.eq_symm_apply, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk, ← Quotient.mk_smul] at ha
      dsimp only [smul_eq_mul, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk,
        quotTorsionOfEquivSpanSingleton_apply_mk] at ha
      rw [smul_smul, mul_comm]; exact congr_arg ((↑) : _ → M) ha.symm
    · symm; convert! Ideal.torsionOf_eq_span_pow_pOrder hp hM y
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
  · use 0
    rw [zero_smul, smul_zero, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel hk.le, pow_add, mul_smul, hM',
      smul_zero]

name: exists_smul_eq_zero_and_mk_eq
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq_zero_and_mk_eq {z : M} (hz : Module.IsTorsionBy R M (p ^ pOrder hM z))
    {k : ℕ} (f : (R ⧸ R ∙ p ^ k) →ₗ[R] M ⧸ R ∙ z) :
    ∃ x : M, p ^ k • x = 0 ∧ Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := span R {z}) x = f 1
proof:
:= by
  have f1 := mk_surjective (R ∙ z) (f 1)
  have : p ^ k • f1.choose ∈ R ∙ z := by
    rw [← Quotient.mk_eq_zero, mk_smul, f1.choose_spec, ← f.map_smul]
    convert! f.map_zero; change _ • Submodule.Quotient.mk _ = _
    rw [← mk_smul, Quotient.mk_eq_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := p_pow_smul_lift hp hM hz this
  refine ⟨f1.choose - a • z, by rw [smul_sub, sub_eq_zero, ha], ?_⟩
  rw [mk_sub, mk_smul, (Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr <| Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _,
    smul_zero, sub_zero, f1.choose_spec]

name: torsion_by_prime_power_decomposition
statement:
theorem torsion_by_prime_power_decomposition (hM : Module.IsTorsion' M (Submonoid.powers p))
    [h' : Module.Finite R M] :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (k : Fin d → ℕ), Nonempty <| M ≃ₗ[R] ⨁ i : Fin d, R ⧸ R ∙ p ^ (k i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, s, hs⟩ := @Module.Finite.exists_fin _ _ _ _ _ h'; use d; clear h'
  induction d generalizing M with
  | zero =>
    use finZeroElim
    rw [Set.range_eq_empty, Submodule.span_empty] at hs
    have : Unique M :=
      ⟨⟨0⟩, fun x => by dsimp; rw [← Submodule.mem_bot R, hs]; exact Submodule.mem_top⟩
    exact ⟨0⟩
  | succ d IH =>
    have : ∀ x : M, Decidable (x = 0) := fun _ => by classical infer_instance
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_isTorsionBy hM d.succ d.succ_ne_zero s hs
    let s' : Fin d → M ⧸ R ∙ s j := Submodule.Quotient.mk ∘ s ∘ j.succAbove
    
    
    have := IH ?_ s' ?_
    · obtain ⟨k, ⟨f⟩⟩ := this
      clear IH
      have : ∀ i : Fin d,
          ∃ x : M, p ^ k i • x = 0 ∧ f (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = DirectSum.lof R _ _ i 1 := by
        intro i
        let fi := f.symm.toLinearMap.comp (DirectSum.lof _ _ _ i)
        obtain ⟨x, h0, h1⟩ := exists_smul_eq_zero_and_mk_eq hp hM hj fi; refine ⟨x, h0, ?_⟩; rw [h1]
        simp only [fi, LinearMap.coe_comp, f.symm.coe_toLinearMap, f.apply_symm_apply,
          Function.comp_apply]
      refine ⟨?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
      · exact fun a => (fun i => (Option.rec (pOrder hM (s j)) k i : ℕ)) (finSuccEquiv d a)
      · refine
          (lequivProdOfRightSplitExact
            (g := f.toLinearMap.comp <| mkQ _)
            (f := (DirectSum.toModule _ _ _ fun i => (liftQSpanSingleton (p ^ k i)
                (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton _ _ _) (this i).choose_spec.left : R ⧸ _ →ₗ[R] _)))
              (R ∙ s j).injective_subtype ?_ ?_).symm ≪≫ₗ
          (((quotTorsionOfEquivSpanSingleton R M (s j)).symm ≪≫ₗ
            (quotEquivOfEq (torsionOf R M (s j)) _
              (Ideal.torsionOf_eq_span_pow_pOrder hp hM (s j)))).prodCongr (.refl _ _)) ≪≫ₗ
          (@DirectSum.lequivProdDirectSum R _ _
            (fun i => R ⧸ R ∙ p ^ @Option.rec _ (fun _ => ℕ) (pOrder hM <| s j) k i) _ _).symm ≪≫ₗ
          (DirectSum.lequivCongrLeft R (finSuccEquiv d).symm)
        · rw [range_subtype, LinearEquiv.ker_comp, ker_mkQ]
        · rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
          ext i : 3
          simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, mkQ_apply]
          rw [LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, LinearMap.id_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
            liftQSpanSingleton_apply, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one, Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk,
            map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk _), (this i).choose_spec.right]
    · exact (mk_surjective _).forall.mpr fun x =>
        ⟨(@hM x).choose, by rw [← Quotient.mk_smul, (@hM x).choose_spec, Quotient.mk_zero]⟩
    · have hs' := congr_arg (Submodule.map <| mkQ <| R ∙ s j) hs
      rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, range_mkQ] at hs'; simp only [mkQ_apply] at hs'
      simp only [s']; rw [← Function.comp_assoc, Set.range_comp (_ ∘ s), Fin.range_succAbove]
      rw [← Set.range_comp, ← Set.insert_image_compl_eq_range _ j, Function.comp_apply,
        (Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _),
        Submodule.span_insert_zero] at hs'
      exact hs'

name: equiv_directSum_of_isTorsion
statement:
theorem equiv_directSum_of_isTorsion [h' : Module.Finite R M] (hM : Module.IsTorsion R M) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (p : ι → R) (_ : ∀ i, Irreducible <| p i) (e : ι → ℕ),
      Nonempty <| M ≃ₗ[R] ⨁ i : ι, R ⧸ R ∙ p i ^ e i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, fI, _, p, hp, e, h⟩ := Submodule.exists_isInternal_prime_power_torsion_of_pid hM
  have :
    ∀ i,
      ∃ (d : ℕ) (k : Fin d → ℕ),
        Nonempty <| torsionBy R M (p i ^ e i) ≃ₗ[R] ⨁ j, R ⧸ R ∙ p i ^ k j := by
    exact fun i =>
      torsion_by_prime_power_decomposition.{u, v} (hp i)
        ((isTorsion'_powers_iff <| p i).mpr fun x => ⟨e i, smul_torsionBy _ _⟩)
  refine
    ⟨Σ i, Fin (this i).choose, inferInstance, fun ⟨i, _⟩ => p i, fun ⟨i, _⟩ => hp i, fun ⟨i, j⟩ =>
      (this i).choose_spec.choose j,
      ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap _) h).symm.trans <|
          (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun i => (this i).choose_spec.choose_spec.some).trans <|
            (DirectSum.sigmaLcurryEquiv R).symm.trans
              (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun i => quotEquivOfEq _ _ ?_)⟩⟩
  simp only

name: equiv_free_prod_directSum
statement:
theorem equiv_free_prod_directSum [h' : Module.Finite R M] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (p : ι → R) (_ : ∀ i, Irreducible <| p i) (e : ι → ℕ),
      Nonempty <| M ≃ₗ[R] (Fin n →₀ R) × ⨁ i : ι, R ⧸ R ∙ p i ^ e i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, fI, p, hp, e, ⟨h⟩⟩ :=
    equiv_directSum_of_isTorsion.{u, v} (@torsion_isTorsion R M _ _ _)
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨g⟩⟩ := @Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree' R _ (M ⧸ torsion R M) _ _ _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property _ LinearMap.id (torsion R M).mkQ_surjective
  refine
    ⟨n, I, fI, p, hp, e,
      ⟨(lequivProdOfRightSplitExact (torsion R M).injective_subtype ?_ hf).symm.trans <|
          (h.prodCongr g).trans <| LinearEquiv.prodComm.{u, u} R _ (Fin n →₀ R) ⟩⟩
  rw [range_subtype, ker_mkQ]

name: exists_ker_toSpanSingleton_eq_annihilator
statement:
theorem exists_ker_toSpanSingleton_eq_annihilator [Module.Finite R M] :
    ∃ x : M, ker (toSpanSingleton R _ x) = annihilator R M
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨m, ι, _, p, irr, n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := equiv_free_prod_directSum (R := R) (M := M)
  refine ⟨e.symm (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun _ ↦ 1, DFinsupp.equivFunOnFintype.symm
    fun _ ↦ mkQ _ 1), le_antisymm (fun x h ↦ ?_) fun x h ↦ mem_annihilator.mp h _⟩
  rw [mem_ker, toSpanSingleton_apply, ← map_smul,
    e.symm.map_eq_zero_iff, Prod.ext_iff, Finsupp.ext_iff, DFinsupp.ext_iff] at h
  obtain _ | m := m
  · rw [← mul_one x, ← smul_eq_mul, e.annihilator_eq, annihilator_prod]
    simp_rw [annihilator_eq_top_iff.mpr inferInstance, DirectSum, annihilator_dfinsupp,
      top_inf_eq, mem_iInf, Ideal.annihilator_quotient, ← Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact h.2
  · rw [show x = 0 by simpa using h.1 0]
    exact zero_mem _

name: map_inv_natCast_smul
statement:
theorem map_inv_natCast_smul [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] {F : Type*} [FunLike F M M₂]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F M M₂] (f : F) (R S : Type*)
    [DivisionSemiring R] [DivisionSemiring S] [Module R M]
    [Module S M₂] (n : ℕ) (x : M) : f ((n⁻¹ : R) • x) = (n⁻¹ : S) • f x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hR : (n : R) = 0 <;> by_cases hS : (n : S) = 0
  · simp [hR, hS, map_zero f]
  · suffices ∀ y, f y = 0 by rw [this, this, smul_zero]
    clear x
    intro x
    rw [← inv_smul_smul₀ hS (f x), ← map_natCast_smul f R S]
    simp [hR, map_zero f]
  · suffices ∀ y, f y = 0 by simp [this]
    clear x
    intro x
    rw [← smul_inv_smul₀ hR x, map_natCast_smul f R S, hS, zero_smul]
  · rw [← inv_smul_smul₀ hS (f _), ← map_natCast_smul f R S, smul_inv_smul₀ hR]

name: map_inv_intCast_smul
statement:
theorem map_inv_intCast_smul [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M₂] {F : Type*} [FunLike F M M₂]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F M M₂] (f : F) (R S : Type*) [DivisionRing R] [DivisionRing S] [Module R M]
    [Module S M₂] (z : ℤ) (x : M) : f ((z⁻¹ : R) • x) = (z⁻¹ : S) • f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := z.eq_nat_or_neg
  · rw [Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, map_inv_natCast_smul _ R S]
  · simp_rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, inv_neg, neg_smul, map_neg,
      map_inv_natCast_smul _ R S]

name: inv_natCast_smul_eq

statement:
protected lemma int.divByNat_self (n : ℕ) :
    int.divByNat n n = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h0 := eq_or_ne n 0
  · apply map_zero
  exact (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff _).mpr
    ⟨1, by simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero (R := ℚ).mpr h0)]⟩

name: intSpanEquivQuotAddOrderOf_apply_self

name: eq_zero_of_ofSpanSingleton_apply_self
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_ofSpanSingleton_apply_self (a : A)
    (h : ofSpanSingleton a ⟨a, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self a⟩ = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  erw [ofSpanSingleton, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, LinearMap.comp_apply,
     intSpanEquivQuotAddOrderOf_apply_self, Submodule.liftQSpanSingleton_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.coe_toIntLinearMap, int.divByNat, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one,
    AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff] at h
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩
  apply_fun Rat.den at hn
  rw [zsmul_one, Rat.den_intCast, Rat.inv_natCast_den_of_pos] at hn
  · split_ifs at hn
    · cases hn
    · rwa [eq_comm, AddMonoid.addOrderOf_eq_one_iff] at hn
  · grind

proof:
:=
  have ⟨c, hc⟩ := dual_surjective_of_injective _ (Submodule.injective_subtype _) (ofSpanSingleton a)
  ⟨c, fun h ↦ ne_zero <| eq_zero_of_ofSpanSingleton_apply_self a <| by rwa [← hc]⟩

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun a h0 ↦ eq_zero_of_character_apply fun c ↦ by
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h c; exact congr(c $h0).trans c.map_zero,
  dual_surjective_of_injective f⟩

name: surjective_of_dual_injective
statement:
lemma surjective_of_dual_injective (f : A →ₗ[R] A') (hf : Function.Injective (dual f)) :
    Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, ← Submodule.unique_quotient_iff_eq_top]
  refine ⟨Unique.mk inferInstance fun a ↦ eq_zero_of_character_apply fun c ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _ a
  suffices eq : dual (Submodule.mkQ _) c = 0 from congr($eq b)
  refine hf ?_
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← dual_comp, LinearMap.range_mkQ_comp, dual_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, dual_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_comp]

name: dual_injective_iff_surjective
statement:

    Function.Injective (dual f) ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ surjective_of_dual_injective f h, fun h ↦ dual_injective_of_surjective f h⟩

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨dual_surjective_iff_injective.mp h.2, dual_injective_iff_surjective.mp h.1⟩,
  fun h ↦ ⟨dual_injective_iff_surjective.mpr h.2, dual_surjective_iff_injective.mpr h.1⟩⟩

statement: lemma of_equiv (e : Q ≃ₗ[R] M) (h : Module.Baer R Q) : Module.Baer R M
proof:
:= fun I g ↦
  have ⟨g', h'⟩ := h I (e.symm ∘ₗ g)

name: congr

name: iff_surjective
statement:
lemma iff_surjective {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Module R M] : Module.Baer R M ↔
    ∀ (I : Ideal R), Function.Surjective (LinearMap.lcomp R M I.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h I g ↦ ?_, fun h I g ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h I g with ⟨g', hg'⟩
    use g'
    ext x
    simp [hg']
  · rcases h I g with ⟨g', hg'⟩
    use g'
    intro x hx
    simp [← hg']

name: ExtensionOf.ext
statement:
@[ext (iff := false)]
theorem ExtensionOf.ext {a b : ExtensionOf i f} (domain_eq : a.domain = b.domain)

      a.toLinearPMap ⟨x, ha⟩ = b.toLinearPMap ⟨x, hb⟩) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨a, a_le, e1⟩

name: ExtensionOf.dExt_iff
statement:
theorem ExtensionOf.dExt_iff {a b : ExtensionOf i f} :
    a = b ↔ ∃ _ : a.domain = b.domain, ∀ ⦃x : a.domain⦄ ⦃y : b.domain⦄,
    (x : N) = y → a.toLinearPMap x = b.toLinearPMap y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun r => r ▸ ⟨rfl, fun _ _ h => congr_arg a.toFun <| mod_cast h⟩, fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ =>
    ExtensionOf.dExt h1 h2⟩

    ⟨ExtensionOf.max hchain hnonempty, ExtensionOf.le_max hchain hnonempty⟩).choose_spec.eq_of_ge

name: extensionOfMax_adjoin.aux1
statement:
private theorem extensionOfMax_adjoin.aux1 {y : N} (x : supExtensionOfMaxSingleton i f y) :
    ∃ (a : (extensionOfMax i f).domain) (b : R), x.1 = a.1 + b • y
proof:
:= by
  have mem1 : x.1 ∈ (_ : Set _) := x.2
  rw [Submodule.coe_sup] at mem1
  rcases mem1 with ⟨a, a_mem, b, b_mem : b ∈ (Submodule.span R _ : Submodule R N), eq1⟩
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at b_mem
  rcases b_mem with ⟨z, eq2⟩
  exact ⟨⟨a, a_mem⟩, z, by rw [← eq1, ← eq2]⟩
