name: lowerCentralSeries_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_zero : lowerCentralSeries R L M 0 = ⊤

name: lowerCentralSeries_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_succ :
    lowerCentralSeries R L M (k + 1) = ⁅(⊤ : LieIdeal R L), lowerCentralSeries R L M k⁆

name: coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int_aux
statement:
private theorem coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int_aux (R₁ R₂ L M : Type*)
    [CommRing R₁] [CommRing R₂] [AddCommGroup M]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R₁ L] [LieAlgebra R₂ L] [Module R₁ M] [Module R₂ M] [LieRingModule L M]
    [LieModule R₁ L M] (k : ℕ) :
    let I
proof:
:= lowerCentralSeries R₂ L M k; let S : Set M := {⁅a, b⁆ | (a : L) (b ∈ I)}
    (Submodule.span R₁ S : Set M) ≤ (Submodule.span R₂ S : Set M) := by
  intro I S x hx
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe] at hx ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.closure_induction with
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z hy₁ hz₁ hy₂ hz₂ => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy₂ hz₂
  | smul_mem c y hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [← smul_lie]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨c • a, b, hb, rfl⟩

name: coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int
statement:
theorem coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int [LieModule R L M] (k : ℕ) :
    (lowerCentralSeries R L M k : Set M) = (lowerCentralSeries ℤ L M k : Set M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.coe_toSubmodule, ← LieSubmodule.coe_toSubmodule]
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, lowerCentralSeries_succ]
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span', LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span']
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at ih
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule] at ih
    simp only [LieSubmodule.mem_top, ih, true_and]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int_aux _ _ L M k
    · simp only [← ih]
      exact coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int_aux _ _ L M k

name: lcs_le_self
statement: theorem lcs_le_self : N.lcs k ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [lcs_succ]
    exact (LieSubmodule.mono_lie_right ⊤ ih).trans (N.lie_le_right ⊤)

name: lowerCentralSeries_eq_lcs_comap
statement: theorem lowerCentralSeries_eq_lcs_comap : lowerCentralSeries R L N k = (N.lcs k).comap N.incl
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [lcs_succ, lowerCentralSeries_succ] at ih ⊢
    have : N.lcs k ≤ N.incl.range := by
      rw [N.range_incl]
      apply lcs_le_self
    rw [ih, LieSubmodule.comap_bracket_eq _ N.incl _ N.ker_incl this]

name: lowerCentralSeries_map_eq_lcs
statement: theorem lowerCentralSeries_map_eq_lcs : (lowerCentralSeries R L N k).map N.incl = N.lcs k
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_eq_lcs_comap, LieSubmodule.map_comap_incl, inf_eq_right]
  apply lcs_le_self

name: lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_lcs_eq_bot
statement:
theorem lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_lcs_eq_bot :
    lowerCentralSeries R L N k = ⊥ ↔ lcs k N = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← N.lowerCentralSeries_map_eq_lcs, ← LieModuleHom.le_ker_iff_map]
    simpa
  · rw [N.lowerCentralSeries_eq_lcs_comap, comap_incl_eq_bot]
    simp [h]

name: antitone_lowerCentralSeries
statement: theorem antitone_lowerCentralSeries : Antitone <| lowerCentralSeries R L M
proof:
:= by
  intro l k
  induction k generalizing l with
  | zero => exact fun h ↦ (Nat.le_zero.mp h).symm ▸ le_rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro h
    rcases Nat.of_le_succ h with (hk | hk)
    · rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ]
      exact (LieSubmodule.mono_lie_right ⊤ (ih hk)).trans (LieSubmodule.lie_le_right _ _)
    · exact hk.symm ▸ le_rfl

name: eventually_iInf_lowerCentralSeries_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_iInf_lowerCentralSeries_eq [IsArtinian R M] :
    ∀ᶠ l in Filter.atTop, ⨅ k, lowerCentralSeries R L M k = lowerCentralSeries R L M l
proof:
:= by
  have h_wf : WellFoundedGT (LieSubmodule R L M)ᵒᵈ :=
    LieSubmodule.wellFoundedLT_of_isArtinian R L M
  obtain ⟨n, hn : ∀ m, n ≤ m → lowerCentralSeries R L M n = lowerCentralSeries R L M m⟩ :=
    h_wf.monotone_chain_condition ⟨_, antitone_lowerCentralSeries R L M⟩
  refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨n, fun l hl ↦ le_antisymm (iInf_le _ _) (le_iInf fun m ↦ ?_)⟩
  rcases le_or_gt l m with h | h
  · rw [← hn _ hl, ← hn _ (hl.trans h)]
  · exact antitone_lowerCentralSeries R L M (le_of_lt h)

name: trivial_iff_lower_central_eq_bot
statement: theorem trivial_iff_lower_central_eq_bot : IsTrivial L M ↔ lowerCentralSeries R L M 1 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · simp
  · rw [LieSubmodule.eq_bot_iff] at h; apply IsTrivial.mk; intro x m; apply h
    apply LieSubmodule.subset_lieSpan
    simp only [Subtype.exists, LieSubmodule.mem_top, exists_prop, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred]
    exact ⟨x, m, rfl⟩

name: iterate_toEnd_mem_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
theorem iterate_toEnd_mem_lowerCentralSeries (x : L) (m : M) (k : ℕ) :
    (toEnd R L M x)^[k] m ∈ lowerCentralSeries R L M k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [Function.iterate_zero, lowerCentralSeries_zero, LieSubmodule.mem_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ, Function.comp_apply, Function.iterate_succ',
      toEnd_apply_apply]
    exact LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie (LieSubmodule.mem_top x) ih

name: iterate_toEnd_mem_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
theorem iterate_toEnd_mem_lowerCentralSeries₂ (x y : L) (m : M) (k : ℕ) :
    (toEnd R L M x ∘ₗ toEnd R L M y)^[k] m ∈
      lowerCentralSeries R L M (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk : 2 * k.succ = (2 * k + 1) + 1 := rfl
    simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ, Function.comp_apply, Function.iterate_succ', hk,
      toEnd_apply_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, toEnd_apply_apply]
    refine LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie (LieSubmodule.mem_top x) ?_
    exact LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie (LieSubmodule.mem_top y) ih

name: map_lowerCentralSeries_le
statement:
theorem map_lowerCentralSeries_le (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M₂) :
    (lowerCentralSeries R L M k).map f ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L M₂ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [lowerCentralSeries_zero, le_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.map_bracket_eq]
    exact LieSubmodule.mono_lie_right ⊤ ih

name: map_lowerCentralSeries_eq
statement:
lemma map_lowerCentralSeries_eq {f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ M₂} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (lowerCentralSeries R L M k).map f = lowerCentralSeries R L M₂ k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (map_lowerCentralSeries_le k f)
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rwa [lowerCentralSeries_zero, lowerCentralSeries_zero, top_le_iff, f.map_top,
      f.range_eq_top]
  | succ =>
    simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.map_bracket_eq]
    apply LieSubmodule.mono_lie_right
    assumption

name: derivedSeries_le_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_le_lowerCentralSeries (k : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries R L k ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L L k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [derivedSeries_def, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero, lowerCentralSeries_zero]
  | succ k h =>
    have h' : derivedSeries R L k ≤ ⊤ := by simp only [le_top]
    rw [derivedSeries_def, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, lowerCentralSeries_succ]
    exact LieSubmodule.mono_lie h' h

name: isNilpotent_iff
statement:
lemma isNilpotent_iff :
    IsNilpotent L M ↔ ∃ k, lowerCentralSeries R L M k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [isNilpotent_iff_int, SetLike.ext'_iff, coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int R L M]

name: IsNilpotent.nilpotent
statement: lemma IsNilpotent.nilpotent [IsNilpotent L M] : ∃ k, lowerCentralSeries R L M k = ⊥

name: IsNilpotent.mk
statement: lemma IsNilpotent.mk {k : ℕ} (h : lowerCentralSeries R L M k = ⊥) : IsNilpotent L M

name: iInf_lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_of_isNilpotent
statement:
@[simp] lemma iInf_lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_of_isNilpotent [IsNilpotent L M] :
    ⨅ k, lowerCentralSeries R L M k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsNilpotent.nilpotent R L M
  rw [eq_bot_iff, ← hk]
  exact iInf_le _ _

name: _root_.LieSubmodule.isNilpotent_iff_exists_lcs_eq_bot
statement:
theorem _root_.LieSubmodule.isNilpotent_iff_exists_lcs_eq_bot (N : LieSubmodule R L M) :
    LieModule.IsNilpotent L N ↔ ∃ k, N.lcs k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNilpotent_iff R L N]
  refine exists_congr fun k => ?_
  rw [N.lowerCentralSeries_eq_lcs_comap k, LieSubmodule.comap_incl_eq_bot,
    inf_eq_right.mpr (N.lcs_le_self k)]

name: exists_forall_pow_toEnd_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_forall_pow_toEnd_eq_zero [IsNilpotent L M] :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ x : L, toEnd R L M x ^ k = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hM⟩ := IsNilpotent.nilpotent R L M
  use k
  intro x; ext m
  rw [Module.End.pow_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, ← @LieSubmodule.mem_bot R L M, ← hM]
  exact iterate_toEnd_mem_lowerCentralSeries R L M x m k

name: isNilpotent_toEnd_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_toEnd_of_isNilpotent [IsNilpotent L M] (x : L) :
    _root_.IsNilpotent (toEnd R L M x)
proof:
:= by
  change ∃ k, toEnd R L M x ^ k = 0
  have := exists_forall_pow_toEnd_eq_zero R L M
  tauto

name: isNilpotent_toEnd_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_toEnd_of_isNilpotent₂ [IsNilpotent L M] (x y : L) :
    _root_.IsNilpotent (toEnd R L M x ∘ₗ toEnd R L M y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hM⟩ := IsNilpotent.nilpotent R L M
  replace hM : lowerCentralSeries R L M (2 * k) = ⊥ := by
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← hM]; exact antitone_lowerCentralSeries R L M (by lia)
  use k
  ext m
  rw [Module.End.pow_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, ← LieSubmodule.mem_bot (R := R) (L := L), ← hM]
  exact iterate_toEnd_mem_lowerCentralSeries₂ R L M x y m k

name: maxGenEigenSpace_toEnd_eq_top
statement:
@[simp] lemma maxGenEigenSpace_toEnd_eq_top [IsNilpotent L M] (x : L) :
    ((toEnd R L M x).maxGenEigenspace 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace, zero_smul, sub_zero, Submodule.mem_top,
    iff_true]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_forall_pow_toEnd_eq_zero R L M
  exact ⟨k, by simp [hk x]⟩

name: nilpotentOfNilpotentQuotient
statement:
theorem nilpotentOfNilpotentQuotient {N : LieSubmodule R L M} (h₁ : N ≤ maxTrivSubmodule R L M)
    (h₂ : IsNilpotent L (M ⧸ N)) : IsNilpotent L M
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNilpotent_iff R L] at h₂ ⊢
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₂
  use k + 1
  simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ]
  suffices lowerCentralSeries R L M k ≤ N by
    replace this := LieSubmodule.mono_lie_right ⊤ (le_trans this h₁)
    rwa [ideal_oper_maxTrivSubmodule_eq_bot, le_bot_iff] at this
  rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.map_mk'_eq_bot_le, ← le_bot_iff, ← hk]
  exact map_lowerCentralSeries_le k (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' N)

name: isNilpotent_quotient_iff
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_quotient_iff :
    IsNilpotent L (M ⧸ N) ↔ ∃ k, lowerCentralSeries R L M k ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNilpotent_iff R L]
  refine exists_congr fun k ↦ ?_
  rw [← LieSubmodule.Quotient.map_mk'_eq_bot_le, map_lowerCentralSeries_eq k
    (LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' N)]

name: iInf_lcs_le_of_isNilpotent_quot
statement:
theorem iInf_lcs_le_of_isNilpotent_quot (h : IsNilpotent L (M ⧸ N)) :
    ⨅ k, lowerCentralSeries R L M k ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (isNilpotent_quotient_iff R L M N).mp h
  exact iInf_le_of_le k hk

name: nilpotencyLength_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nilpotencyLength_eq_zero_iff [IsNilpotent L M] :
    nilpotencyLength L M = 0 ↔ Subsingleton M
proof:
:= by
  let s := {k | lowerCentralSeries ℤ L M k = ⊥}
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsNilpotent.nilpotent ℤ L M
    exact ⟨k, hk⟩
  change sInf s = 0 ↔ _
  rw [← LieSubmodule.subsingleton_iff ℤ L M, ← subsingleton_iff_bot_eq_top, ←
    lowerCentralSeries_zero, @eq_comm (LieSubmodule ℤ L M)]
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ Nat.sInf_mem hs, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.sInf_eq_zero]
  exact Or.inl h

name: nilpotencyLength_eq_succ_iff
statement:
theorem nilpotencyLength_eq_succ_iff (k : ℕ) :
    nilpotencyLength L M = k + 1 ↔
      lowerCentralSeries R L M (k + 1) = ⊥ ∧ lowerCentralSeries R L M k ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have aux (k : ℕ) : lowerCentralSeries R L M k = ⊥ ↔ lowerCentralSeries ℤ L M k = ⊥ := by
    simp [SetLike.ext'_iff, coe_lowerCentralSeries_eq_int R L M]
  let s := {k | lowerCentralSeries ℤ L M k = ⊥}
  rw [aux, ne_eq, aux]
  change sInf s = k + 1 ↔ k + 1 ∈ s ∧ k ∉ s
  have hs : ∀ k₁ k₂, k₁ ≤ k₂ → k₁ ∈ s → k₂ ∈ s := by
    rintro k₁ k₂ h₁₂ (h₁ : lowerCentralSeries ℤ L M k₁ = ⊥)
    exact eq_bot_iff.mpr (h₁ ▸ antitone_lowerCentralSeries ℤ L M h₁₂)
  exact Nat.sInf_upward_closed_eq_succ_iff hs k

name: nilpotencyLength_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nilpotencyLength_eq_one_iff [Nontrivial M] :
    nilpotencyLength L M = 1 ↔ IsTrivial L M

name: isTrivial_of_nilpotencyLength_le_one
statement:
theorem isTrivial_of_nilpotencyLength_le_one [IsNilpotent L M] (h : nilpotencyLength L M ≤ 1) :
    IsTrivial L M
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality M
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp h with h | h
  · rw [nilpotencyLength_eq_zero_iff] at h; infer_instance
  · rwa [nilpotencyLength_eq_one_iff] at h

name: lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_max_triv
statement:
theorem lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_max_triv [LieModule R L M] :
    lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M ≤ maxTrivSubmodule R L M
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerCentralSeriesLast]
  rcases h : nilpotencyLength L M with - | k
  · exact bot_le
  · rw [le_max_triv_iff_bracket_eq_bot]
    rw [nilpotencyLength_eq_succ_iff R, lowerCentralSeries_succ] at h
    exact h.1

name: nontrivial_lowerCentralSeriesLast
statement:
theorem nontrivial_lowerCentralSeriesLast [LieModule R L M] [Nontrivial M] [IsNilpotent L M] :
    Nontrivial (lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieSubmodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot, lowerCentralSeriesLast]
  cases h : nilpotencyLength L M
  · rw [nilpotencyLength_eq_zero_iff, ← not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at h
    contradiction
  · rw [nilpotencyLength_eq_succ_iff R] at h
    exact h.2

name: lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_of_not_isTrivial
statement:
theorem lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_of_not_isTrivial [IsNilpotent L M] (h : ¬ IsTrivial L M) :
    lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L M 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerCentralSeriesLast]
  replace h : 1 < nilpotencyLength L M := by
    by_contra contra
    have := isTrivial_of_nilpotencyLength_le_one L M (not_lt.mp contra)
    contradiction
  rcases hk : nilpotencyLength L M with - | k <;> rw [hk] at h
  · contradiction
  · exact antitone_lowerCentralSeries _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h)

name: disjoint_lowerCentralSeries_maxTrivSubmodule_iff
statement:
lemma disjoint_lowerCentralSeries_maxTrivSubmodule_iff [IsNilpotent L M] :
    Disjoint (lowerCentralSeries R L M 1) (maxTrivSubmodule R L M) ↔ IsTrivial L M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simp⟩
  nontriviality M
  by_contra contra
  have : lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L M 1 ⊓ maxTrivSubmodule R L M :=
    le_inf_iff.mpr ⟨lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_of_not_isTrivial R L M contra,
      lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_max_triv R L M⟩
  suffices ¬ Nontrivial (lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M) by
    exact this (nontrivial_lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M)
  rw [h.eq_bot, le_bot_iff] at this
  exact this ▸ not_nontrivial _

name: nontrivial_max_triv_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem nontrivial_max_triv_of_isNilpotent [Nontrivial M] [IsNilpotent L M] :
    Nontrivial (maxTrivSubmodule R L M)
proof:
:=
  Set.nontrivial_mono (lowerCentralSeriesLast_le_max_triv R L M)
    (nontrivial_lowerCentralSeriesLast R L M)

name: coe_lcs_range_toEnd_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_lcs_range_toEnd_eq (k : ℕ) :
    (lowerCentralSeries R (toEnd R L M).range M k : Submodule R M) =
      lowerCentralSeries R L M k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span', ←
      (lowerCentralSeries R (toEnd R L M).range M k).mem_toSubmodule, ih]
    simp

name: isNilpotent_range_toEnd_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_range_toEnd_iff :
    IsNilpotent (toEnd R L M).range M ↔ IsNilpotent L M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isNilpotent_iff R _ M]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨k, hk⟩ <;> use k <;>
      rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_inj] at hk ⊢ <;>
    simpa using hk

name: ucs_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ucs_zero : N.ucs 0 = N

name: ucs_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ucs_succ (k : ℕ) : N.ucs (k + 1) = (N.ucs k).normalizer

name: ucs_add
statement: theorem ucs_add (k l : ℕ) : N.ucs (k + l) = (N.ucs l).ucs k

name: ucs_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem ucs_mono (k : ℕ) (h : N₁ ≤ N₂) : N₁.ucs k ≤ N₂.ucs k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [ucs_succ]
    gcongr

name: ucs_eq_self_of_normalizer_eq_self
statement: theorem ucs_eq_self_of_normalizer_eq_self (h : N₁.normalizer = N₁) (k : ℕ) : N₁.ucs k = N₁
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rwa [ucs_succ, ih]

name: ucs_le_of_normalizer_eq_self
statement:
theorem ucs_le_of_normalizer_eq_self (h : N₁.normalizer = N₁) (k : ℕ) :
    (⊥ : LieSubmodule R L M).ucs k ≤ N₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ucs_eq_self_of_normalizer_eq_self h k]
  gcongr
  simp

name: lcs_add_le_iff
statement: theorem lcs_add_le_iff (l k : ℕ) : N₁.lcs (l + k) ≤ N₂ ↔ N₁.lcs l ≤ N₂.ucs k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [(by abel : l + (k + 1) = l + 1 + k), ih, ucs_succ, lcs_succ, top_lie_le_iff_le_normalizer]

name: lcs_le_iff
statement: theorem lcs_le_iff (k : ℕ) : N₁.lcs k ≤ N₂ ↔ N₁ ≤ N₂.ucs k
proof:
:= by
  convert! lcs_add_le_iff (R := R) (L := L) (M := M) 0 k
  rw [zero_add]

name: gc_lcs_ucs
statement:
theorem gc_lcs_ucs (k : ℕ) :
    GaloisConnection (fun N : LieSubmodule R L M => N.lcs k) fun N : LieSubmodule R L M =>
      N.ucs k

name: ucs_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ucs_eq_top_iff (k : ℕ) : N.ucs k = ⊤ ↔ LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L M k ≤ N

name: _root_.LieModule.isNilpotent_iff_exists_ucs_eq_top
statement:
theorem _root_.LieModule.isNilpotent_iff_exists_ucs_eq_top :
    LieModule.IsNilpotent L M ↔ ∃ k, (⊥ : LieSubmodule R L M).ucs k = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieModule.isNilpotent_iff R]; exact exists_congr fun k => by simp [ucs_eq_top_iff]

name: ucs_comap_incl
statement:
theorem ucs_comap_incl (k : ℕ) :
    ((⊥ : LieSubmodule R L M).ucs k).comap N.incl = (⊥ : LieSubmodule R L N).ucs k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact N.ker_incl
  | succ k ih => simp [← ih]

name: isNilpotent_iff_exists_self_le_ucs
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_iff_exists_self_le_ucs :
    LieModule.IsNilpotent L N ↔ ∃ k, N ≤ (⊥ : LieSubmodule R L M).ucs k

name: ucs_bot_one
statement: theorem ucs_bot_one : (⊥ : LieSubmodule R L M).ucs 1 = LieModule.maxTrivSubmodule R L M

name: lieModule_lcs_map_le
statement:
theorem lieModule_lcs_map_le (k : ℕ) :
    (lowerCentralSeries R L M k : Submodule R M).map g ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L₂ M₂ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp [Submodule.map_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span', Submodule.map_span,
      Submodule.span_le]
    rintro m₂ ⟨m, ⟨x, n, m_n, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ, SetLike.mem_coe, LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule]
    have : ∃ y : L₂, ∃ n : lowerCentralSeries R L₂ M₂ k, ⁅y, n⁆ = g m := by
      use f x, ⟨g m_n, ih (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem h₁)⟩
      simp [hfg x m_n, h₂]
    obtain ⟨y, n, hn⟩ := this
    rw [← hn]
    apply LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie
    · simp
    · exact SetLike.coe_mem n

name: Function.Injective.lieModuleIsNilpotent
statement: theorem Function.Injective.lieModuleIsNilpotent [IsNilpotent L₂ M₂] : IsNilpotent L M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsNilpotent.nilpotent R L₂ M₂
  rw [isNilpotent_iff R]
  use k
  rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_inj] at hk ⊢
  apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective hg_inj
  simpa [hk] using lieModule_lcs_map_le hfg k

name: Function.Surjective.lieModule_lcs_map_eq
statement:
theorem Function.Surjective.lieModule_lcs_map_eq (k : ℕ) :
    (lowerCentralSeries R L M k : Submodule R M).map g = lowerCentralSeries R L₂ M₂ k
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (lieModule_lcs_map_le hfg k) ?_
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    suffices
      {m | ∃ (x : L₂) (n : _), n ∈ lowerCentralSeries R L M k ∧ ⁅x, g n⁆ = m} ⊆
        g '' {m | ∃ (x : L) (n : _), n ∈ lowerCentralSeries R L M k ∧ ⁅x, n⁆ = m} by
      simp only [← LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule] at this
      simp_rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span',
        Submodule.map_span, LieSubmodule.mem_top, true_and, ← LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule]
      refine Submodule.span_mono (Set.Subset.trans ?_ this)
      rintro m₁ ⟨x, n, hn, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨n', hn', rfl⟩ := ih hn
      exact ⟨x, n', hn', rfl⟩
    rintro m₂ ⟨x, n, hn, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf_surj x
    exact ⟨⁅y, n⁆, ⟨y, n, hn, rfl⟩, (hfg y n).symm⟩

name: Function.Surjective.lieModuleIsNilpotent
statement: theorem Function.Surjective.lieModuleIsNilpotent [IsNilpotent L M] : IsNilpotent L₂ M₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsNilpotent.nilpotent R L M
  rw [isNilpotent_iff R]
  use k
  rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_inj] at hk ⊢
  simp [← hf_surj.lieModule_lcs_map_eq hfg hg_surj k, hk]

name: Equiv.lieModule_isNilpotent_iff
statement:
theorem Equiv.lieModule_isNilpotent_iff (f : L ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ L₂) (g : M ≃ₗ[R] M₂)
    (hfg : ∀ x m, ⁅f x, g m⁆ = g ⁅x, m⁆) : IsNilpotent L M ↔ IsNilpotent L₂ M₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have hg : Surjective (g : M →ₗ[R] M₂) := g.surjective
    exact f.surjective.lieModuleIsNilpotent hfg hg
  · have hg : Surjective (g.symm : M₂ →ₗ[R] M) := g.symm.surjective
    refine f.symm.surjective.lieModuleIsNilpotent (fun x m => ?_) hg
    rw [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LieEquiv.coe_toLieHom, ← g.symm_apply_apply ⁅f.symm x, g.symm m⁆, ←
      hfg, f.apply_symm_apply, g.apply_symm_apply]

name: LieModule.isNilpotent_of_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LieModule.isNilpotent_of_top_iff :
    IsNilpotent (⊤ : LieSubalgebra R L) M ↔ IsNilpotent L M
proof:
:=
  Equiv.lieModule_isNilpotent_iff LieSubalgebra.topEquiv (1 : M ≃ₗ[R] M) fun _ _ => rfl

name: LieModule.isNilpotent_of_top_iff'
statement:
@[simp] lemma LieModule.isNilpotent_of_top_iff' :
    IsNilpotent L {x // x ∈ (⊤ : LieSubmodule R L M)} ↔ IsNilpotent L M

name: isNilpotent_of_le
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_of_le (M₁ M₂ : LieSubmodule R L M) (h₁ : M₁ ≤ M₂) [IsNilpotent L M₂] :
    IsNilpotent L M₁
proof:
:= by
  let f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L := LieHom.id
  let g : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂ := Submodule.inclusion h₁
  have hfg : ∀ x m, ⁅f x, g m⁆ = g ⁅x, m⁆ := by aesop
  exact (Submodule.inclusion_injective h₁).lieModuleIsNilpotent hfg

name: isNilpotent_iff_le_maxNilpotentSubmodule
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_iff_le_maxNilpotentSubmodule [IsNoetherian R M] (N : LieSubmodule R L M) :
    IsNilpotent L N ↔ N ≤ maxNilpotentSubmodule R L M
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ le_sSup h, fun h ↦ isNilpotent_of_le R L M N (maxNilpotentSubmodule R L M) h⟩

name: maxNilpotentSubmodule_eq_top_of_isNilpotent
statement:
@[simp] lemma maxNilpotentSubmodule_eq_top_of_isNilpotent [LieModule.IsNilpotent L M] :
    maxNilpotentSubmodule R L M = ⊤

name: LieAlgebra.nilpotent_ad_of_nilpotent_algebra
statement:
theorem LieAlgebra.nilpotent_ad_of_nilpotent_algebra [IsNilpotent L] :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ x : L, ad R L x ^ k = 0

name: coe_lowerCentralSeries_ideal_quot_eq
statement:
theorem coe_lowerCentralSeries_ideal_quot_eq {I : LieIdeal R L} (k : ℕ) :
    LieSubmodule.toSubmodule (lowerCentralSeries R L (L ⧸ I) k) =
      LieSubmodule.toSubmodule (lowerCentralSeries R (L ⧸ I) (L ⧸ I) k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_zero, LieSubmodule.top_toSubmodule]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span]
    congr
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨y, -⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl : ⁅y, z⁆ = x⟩
      rw [← LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, ih, LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule] at hz
      exact ⟨⟨LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk y, LieSubmodule.mem_top _⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨⟨y⟩, -⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl : ⁅y, z⁆ = x⟩
      rw [← LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, ← ih, LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule] at hz
      exact ⟨⟨y, LieSubmodule.mem_top _⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieModule.coe_lowerCentralSeries_ideal_le
statement:
theorem LieModule.coe_lowerCentralSeries_ideal_le {I : LieIdeal R L} (k : ℕ) :
    LieSubmodule.toSubmodule (lowerCentralSeries R I I k) ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L I k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span]
    apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro x ⟨⟨y, -⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, rfl : ⁅y, z⁆ = x⟩
    exact ⟨⟨y.val, LieSubmodule.mem_top _⟩, ⟨z, ih hz⟩, rfl⟩

name: LieAlgebra.nilpotent_of_nilpotent_quotient
statement:
theorem LieAlgebra.nilpotent_of_nilpotent_quotient {I : LieIdeal R L} (h₁ : I ≤ center R L)
    (h₂ : IsNilpotent (L ⧸ I)) : IsNilpotent L
proof:
:= by
  suffices LieModule.IsNilpotent L (L ⧸ I) by
    exact LieModule.nilpotentOfNilpotentQuotient R L L h₁ this
  simp only [LieRing.IsNilpotent, LieModule.isNilpotent_iff R] at h₂ ⊢
  gconvert h₂ with k hk
  simp [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_inj, coe_lowerCentralSeries_ideal_quot_eq, hk]

name: LieAlgebra.non_trivial_center_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem LieAlgebra.non_trivial_center_of_isNilpotent [Nontrivial L] [IsNilpotent L] :
    Nontrivial <| center R L

name: LieIdeal.map_lowerCentralSeries_le
statement:
theorem LieIdeal.map_lowerCentralSeries_le (k : ℕ) {f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'} :
    LieIdeal.map f (lowerCentralSeries R L L k) ≤ lowerCentralSeries R L' L' k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_zero, le_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ]
    exact le_trans (LieIdeal.map_bracket_le f) (LieSubmodule.mono_lie le_top ih)

name: LieIdeal.lowerCentralSeries_map_eq
statement:
theorem LieIdeal.lowerCentralSeries_map_eq (k : ℕ) {f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'} (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    LieIdeal.map f (lowerCentralSeries R L L k) = lowerCentralSeries R L' L' k
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (⊤ : LieIdeal R L).map f = ⊤ := by
    rw [← f.idealRange_eq_map]
    exact f.idealRange_eq_top_of_surjective h
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_zero]; exact h'
  | succ k ih => simp only [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ, LieIdeal.map_bracket_eq f h, ih, h']

name: Function.Injective.lieAlgebra_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem Function.Injective.lieAlgebra_isNilpotent [h₁ : IsNilpotent L'] {f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'}
    (h₂ : Function.Injective f) : IsNilpotent L
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieRing.IsNilpotent, LieModule.isNilpotent_iff R] at h₁ ⊢
  gconvert h₁ with k hk
  apply LieIdeal.bot_of_map_eq_bot h₂; rw [eq_bot_iff, ← hk]
  apply LieIdeal.map_lowerCentralSeries_le

name: Function.Surjective.lieAlgebra_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem Function.Surjective.lieAlgebra_isNilpotent [h₁ : IsNilpotent L] {f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'}
    (h₂ : Function.Surjective f) : IsNilpotent L'
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieRing.IsNilpotent, LieModule.isNilpotent_iff R] at h₁ ⊢
  gconvert h₁ with k hk
  rw [← LieIdeal.lowerCentralSeries_map_eq k h₂, hk]
  simp only [LieIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff, bot_le]

name: LieEquiv.nilpotent_iff_equiv_nilpotent
statement:
theorem LieEquiv.nilpotent_iff_equiv_nilpotent (e : L ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ L') :
    IsNilpotent L ↔ IsNilpotent L'
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact e.symm.injective.lieAlgebra_isNilpotent
  · exact e.injective.lieAlgebra_isNilpotent

name: LieHom.isNilpotent_range
statement: theorem LieHom.isNilpotent_range [IsNilpotent L] (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : IsNilpotent f.range

name: LieAlgebra.isNilpotent_range_ad_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LieAlgebra.isNilpotent_range_ad_iff : IsNilpotent (ad R L).range ↔ IsNilpotent L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : (ad R L).ker = center R L := by simp
    exact
      LieAlgebra.nilpotent_of_nilpotent_quotient (le_of_eq this)
        ((ad R L).quotKerEquivRange.nilpotent_iff_equiv_nilpotent.mpr h)
  · intro h
    exact (ad R L).isNilpotent_range

name: lcs_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lcs_zero : I.lcs M 0 = ⊤

name: lcs_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lcs_succ : I.lcs M (k + 1) = ⁅I, I.lcs M k⁆

name: lcs_top
statement: theorem lcs_top : (⊤ : LieIdeal R L).lcs M k = lowerCentralSeries R L M k

name: coe_lcs_eq
statement:
theorem coe_lcs_eq [LieModule R L M] :
    LieSubmodule.toSubmodule (I.lcs M k) = lowerCentralSeries R I M k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp_rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, lcs_succ, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span', ←
      (I.lcs M k).mem_toSubmodule, ih, LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule, LieSubmodule.mem_top,
      true_and, (I : LieSubalgebra R L).coe_bracket_of_module]
    simp

name: LieSubmodule.lowerCentralSeries_tensor_eq_baseChange
statement:
@[simp]
lemma LieSubmodule.lowerCentralSeries_tensor_eq_baseChange (k : ℕ) :
    lowerCentralSeries A (A ⊗[R] L) (A ⊗[R] M) k =
    (lowerCentralSeries R L M k).baseChange A
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ, ih, ← baseChange_top, lie_baseChange]

name: LieIdeal.isNilpotent_iff_le_maxNilpotentIdeal
statement:
theorem LieIdeal.isNilpotent_iff_le_maxNilpotentIdeal [IsNoetherian R L] (I : LieIdeal R L) :
    IsNilpotent L I ↔ I ≤ maxNilpotentIdeal R L

name: center_le_maxNilpotentIdeal
statement: theorem center_le_maxNilpotentIdeal : center R L ≤ maxNilpotentIdeal R L

name: maxNilpotentIdeal_le_radical
statement: theorem maxNilpotentIdeal_le_radical : maxNilpotentIdeal R L ≤ radical R L
proof:
:=
  sSup_le_sSup fun I (_ : IsNilpotent L I) ↦ isSolvable_of_isNilpotent I

name: maxNilpotentIdeal_eq_top_of_isNilpotent
statement:
@[simp] lemma maxNilpotentIdeal_eq_top_of_isNilpotent [LieRing.IsNilpotent L] :
    maxNilpotentIdeal R L = ⊤

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero : derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L 0 I = I

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ (k : ℕ) :
    derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L (k + 1) I =
      ⁅derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I, derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I⁆

name: derivedSeries_def
statement: theorem derivedSeries_def (k : ℕ) : derivedSeries R L k = derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k ⊤

name: coe_derivedSeries_one_eq
statement:
lemma coe_derivedSeries_one_eq :
    derivedSeries R L 1 = Submodule.span R {⁅x, y⁆ | (x : L) (y : L)}
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero,
    LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_toSubmodule, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span']
  aesop

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add
statement: theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add (k l : ℕ) : D (k + l) I = D k (D l I)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [Nat.zero_add, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero]
  | succ k ih => rw [Nat.succ_add k l, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, ih]

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le {I J : LieIdeal R L} {k l : ℕ} (h₁ : I ≤ J) (h₂ : l ≤ k) :
    D k I ≤ D l J
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing l with
  | zero => rw [le_zero_iff] at h₂; rw [h₂, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero]; exact h₁
  | succ k ih =>
    have h : l = k.succ ∨ l ≤ k := by rwa [le_iff_eq_or_lt, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at h₂
    rcases h with h | h
    · rw [h, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ]
      exact LieSubmodule.mono_lie (ih (le_refl k)) (ih (le_refl k))
    · rw [derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ]; exact le_trans (LieSubmodule.lie_le_left _ _) (ih h)

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ_le
statement: theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ_le (k : ℕ) : D (k + 1) I ≤ D k I

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le_self
statement: theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le_self (k : ℕ) : D k I ≤ I

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_mono
statement: theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_mono {I J : LieIdeal R L} (h : I ≤ J) (k : ℕ) : D k I ≤ D k J

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_antitone
statement: theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_antitone {k l : ℕ} (h : l ≤ k) : D k I ≤ D l I

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add_le_add
statement:
theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add_le_add (J : LieIdeal R L) (k l : ℕ) :
    D (k + l) (I + J) ≤ D k I + D l J
proof:
:= by
  let D₁ : LieIdeal R L →o LieIdeal R L :=
    { toFun := fun I => ⁅I, I⁆
      monotone' := fun I J h => LieSubmodule.mono_lie h h }
  have h₁ : ∀ I J : LieIdeal R L, D₁ (I ⊔ J) ≤ D₁ I ⊔ J := by
    simp [D₁, LieSubmodule.lie_le_right, LieSubmodule.lie_le_left, le_sup_of_le_right]
  rw [← D₁.iterate_sup_le_sup_iff] at h₁
  exact h₁ k l I J

name: derivedSeries_of_bot_eq_bot
statement: theorem derivedSeries_of_bot_eq_bot (k : ℕ) : derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k ⊥ = ⊥

name: abelian_iff_derived_one_eq_bot
statement: theorem abelian_iff_derived_one_eq_bot : IsLieAbelian I ↔ derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L 1 I = ⊥

name: abelian_iff_derived_succ_eq_bot
statement:
theorem abelian_iff_derived_succ_eq_bot (I : LieIdeal R L) (k : ℕ) :
    IsLieAbelian (derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I) ↔ derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L (k + 1) I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add I 1 k, abelian_iff_derived_one_eq_bot]

name: derivedSeriesOfIdeal_baseChange
statement:
@[simp] theorem derivedSeriesOfIdeal_baseChange {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (k : ℕ) :
    derivedSeriesOfIdeal A (A ⊗[R] L) k (I.baseChange A) =
      (derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I).baseChange A
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => simp only [derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, ih, LieSubmodule.lie_baseChange]

name: derivedSeries_baseChange
statement:
@[simp] theorem derivedSeries_baseChange {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (k : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries A (A ⊗[R] L) k = (derivedSeries R L k).baseChange A

name: derivedSeries_eq_derivedSeriesOfIdeal_comap
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_eq_derivedSeriesOfIdeal_comap (k : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries R I k = (derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I).comap I.incl
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [derivedSeries_def, comap_incl_self, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [derivedSeries_def, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ] at ih ⊢; rw [ih]
    exact comap_bracket_incl_of_le I (derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le_self I k)
      (derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le_self I k)

name: derivedSeries_eq_derivedSeriesOfIdeal_map
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_eq_derivedSeriesOfIdeal_map (k : ℕ) :
    (derivedSeries R I k).map I.incl = derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivedSeries_eq_derivedSeriesOfIdeal_comap, map_comap_incl, inf_eq_right]
  apply derivedSeriesOfIdeal_le_self

name: derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff (k : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries R I k = ⊥ ↔ derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I = ⊥

name: derivedSeries_add_eq_bot
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_add_eq_bot {k l : ℕ} {I J : LieIdeal R L} (hI : derivedSeries R I k = ⊥)
    (hJ : derivedSeries R J l = ⊥) : derivedSeries R (I + J) (k + l) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff] at hI hJ ⊢
  rw [← le_bot_iff]
  let D := derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L; change D k I = ⊥ at hI; change D l J = ⊥ at hJ
  calc
    D (k + l) (I + J) ≤ D k I + D l J := derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add_le_add I J k l
    _ ≤ ⊥ := by rw [hI, hJ]; simp

name: derivedSeries_map_le
statement: theorem derivedSeries_map_le (k : ℕ) : (derivedSeries R L' k).map f ≤ derivedSeries R L k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [derivedSeries_def, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero, le_top]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [derivedSeries_def, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ] at ih ⊢
    exact le_trans (map_bracket_le f) (LieSubmodule.mono_lie ih ih)

name: derivedSeries_map_eq
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_map_eq (k : ℕ) (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    (derivedSeries R L' k).map f = derivedSeries R L k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    change (⊤ : LieIdeal R L').map f = ⊤
    rw [← f.idealRange_eq_map]
    exact f.idealRange_eq_top_of_surjective h
  | succ k ih => simp only [derivedSeries_def, map_bracket_eq f h, ih, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ]

name: derivedSeries_succ_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_succ_eq_top_iff (n : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries R L (n + 1) = ⊤ ↔ derivedSeries R L 1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [derivedSeries_def]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rwa [ih.mpr h]⟩
    rw [← ih, eq_top_iff]
    conv_lhs => rw [← h]
    exact LieSubmodule.lie_le_right _ _

name: derivedSeries_eq_top
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_eq_top (n : ℕ) (h : derivedSeries R L 1 = ⊤) :
    derivedSeries R L n = ⊤

name: coe_derivedSeries_eq_int_aux
statement:
private theorem coe_derivedSeries_eq_int_aux (R₁ R₂ L : Type*) [CommRing R₁] [CommRing R₂]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R₁ L] [LieAlgebra R₂ L] (k : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ (x : L), x ∈ derivedSeriesOfIdeal R₁ L k ⊤ ↔ x ∈ derivedSeriesOfIdeal R₂ L k ⊤) :
    let I
proof:
:= derivedSeriesOfIdeal R₂ L k ⊤; let S : Set L := {⁅a, b⁆ | (a ∈ I) (b ∈ I)}
    (Submodule.span R₁ S : Set L) ≤ (Submodule.span R₂ S : Set L) := by
  intro I S x hx
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe] at hx ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.closure_induction with
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z hy₁ hz₁ hy₂ hz₂ => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy₂ hz₂
  | smul_mem c y hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [← smul_lie]
      refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨c • a, ?_, b, hb, rfl⟩
      rw [← ih] at ha ⊢
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha

name: coe_derivedSeries_eq_int
statement:
theorem coe_derivedSeries_eq_int (k : ℕ) :
    (derivedSeries R L k : Set L) = (derivedSeries ℤ L k : Set L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.coe_toSubmodule, ← LieSubmodule.coe_toSubmodule, derivedSeries_def,
    derivedSeries_def]
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ]
    rw [LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span', LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span']
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at ih
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LieSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule] at ih
    simp only [ih]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact coe_derivedSeries_eq_int_aux _ _ L k ih
    · simp

name: isSolvable_iff
statement: lemma isSolvable_iff : IsSolvable L ↔ ∃ k, derivedSeries R L k = ⊥

name: IsSolvable.solvable
statement: lemma IsSolvable.solvable [IsSolvable L] : ∃ k, derivedSeries R L k = ⊥

name: IsSolvable.mk
statement: lemma IsSolvable.mk {k : ℕ} (h : derivedSeries R L k = ⊥) : IsSolvable L

name: derivedSeries_lt_top_of_solvable
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_lt_top_of_solvable [IsSolvable L] [Nontrivial L] :
    derivedSeries R L 1 < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsSolvable.solvable (R := R) (L := L)
  rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  intro contra
  rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_top n contra] at hn
  exact top_ne_bot hn

name: isSolvable_tensorProduct_iff
statement: theorem isSolvable_tensorProduct_iff : IsSolvable (A ⊗[R] L) ↔ IsSolvable L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun _ ↦ inferInstance⟩
  rw [isSolvable_iff A, isSolvable_iff R]
  rintro ⟨k, h⟩
  use k
  rw [eq_bot_iff] at h ⊢
  intro x hx
  rw [derivedSeries_baseChange] at h
  specialize h <| Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem 1 hx
  rw [LieSubmodule.mem_bot] at h ⊢
  rwa [Module.FaithfullyFlat.one_tmul_eq_zero_iff] at h

name: Injective.lieAlgebra_isSolvable
statement:
theorem Injective.lieAlgebra_isSolvable [hL : IsSolvable L] (h : Injective f) :
    IsSolvable L'
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSolvable_iff R] at hL ⊢
  apply hL.imp
  intro k hk
  apply LieIdeal.bot_of_map_eq_bot h; rw [eq_bot_iff, ← hk]
  apply LieIdeal.derivedSeries_map_le

name: Surjective.lieAlgebra_isSolvable
statement:
theorem Surjective.lieAlgebra_isSolvable [hL' : IsSolvable L'] (h : Surjective f) :
    IsSolvable L
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSolvable_iff R] at hL' ⊢
  apply hL'.imp
  intro k hk
  rw [← LieIdeal.derivedSeries_map_eq k h, hk]
  simp only [LieIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff, bot_le]

name: solvable_iff_equiv_solvable
statement: theorem solvable_iff_equiv_solvable (e : L' ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ L) : IsSolvable L' ↔ IsSolvable L
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact e.symm.injective.lieAlgebra_isSolvable
  · exact e.injective.lieAlgebra_isSolvable

name: le_solvable_ideal_solvable
statement:
theorem le_solvable_ideal_solvable {I J : LieIdeal R L} (h₁ : I ≤ J) (_ : IsSolvable J) :
    IsSolvable I

name: LieIdeal.solvable_iff_le_radical
statement:
theorem LieIdeal.solvable_iff_le_radical [IsNoetherian R L] (I : LieIdeal R L) :
    IsSolvable I ↔ I ≤ radical R L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => le_sSup h, fun h => le_solvable_ideal_solvable h inferInstance⟩

name: center_le_radical
statement: theorem center_le_radical : center R L ≤ radical R L
proof:
:=
  have h : IsSolvable (center R L) := inferInstance
  le_sSup h

name: radical_eq_top_of_isSolvable
statement:
@[simp] lemma radical_eq_top_of_isSolvable [IsSolvable L] :
    radical R L = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  have h : IsSolvable (⊤ : LieSubalgebra R L) := inferInstance
  exact le_sSup h

name: derivedSeries_of_derivedLength_succ
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_of_derivedLength_succ (I : LieIdeal R L) (k : ℕ) :
    derivedLengthOfIdeal R L I = k + 1 ↔
      IsLieAbelian (derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I) ∧ derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [abelian_iff_derived_succ_eq_bot]
  let s := { k | derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I = ⊥ }
  change sInf s = k + 1 ↔ k + 1 ∈ s ∧ k ∉ s
  have hs : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ ≤ k₂ → k₁ ∈ s → k₂ ∈ s := by
    intro k₁ k₂ h₁₂ h₁
    suffices derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k₂ I ≤ ⊥ by exact eq_bot_iff.mpr this
    change derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k₁ I = ⊥ at h₁; rw [← h₁]
    exact derivedSeriesOfIdeal_antitone I h₁₂
  exact Nat.sInf_upward_closed_eq_succ_iff hs k

name: derivedLength_eq_derivedLengthOfIdeal
statement:
theorem derivedLength_eq_derivedLengthOfIdeal (I : LieIdeal R L) :
    derivedLength R I = derivedLengthOfIdeal R L I

name: abelian_derivedAbelianOfIdeal
statement:
theorem abelian_derivedAbelianOfIdeal (I : LieIdeal R L) :
    IsLieAbelian (derivedAbelianOfIdeal I)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp +instances only [derivedAbelianOfIdeal]
  rcases h : derivedLengthOfIdeal R L I with - | k
  · dsimp; infer_instance
  · rw [derivedSeries_of_derivedLength_succ] at h; exact h.1

name: derivedLength_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLength_zero (I : LieIdeal R L) [IsSolvable I] :
    derivedLengthOfIdeal R L I = 0 ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let s := { k | derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I = ⊥ }
  change sInf s = 0 ↔ _
  have hne : s.Nonempty :=
    have ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsSolvable.solvable R I
    ⟨k, by rwa [derivedSeries_def, LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff] at hk⟩
  simp [s, hne.ne_empty]

name: abelian_of_solvable_ideal_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem abelian_of_solvable_ideal_eq_bot_iff (I : LieIdeal R L) [h : IsSolvable I] :
    derivedAbelianOfIdeal I = ⊥ ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [derivedAbelianOfIdeal]
  split
  · simp_all only [derivedLength_zero]
  · rename_i k h
    obtain ⟨_, h₂⟩ := (derivedSeries_of_derivedLength_succ R L I k).mp h
    have h₃ : I ≠ ⊥ := by rintro rfl; apply h₂; apply derivedSeries_of_bot_eq_bot
    simp only [h₂, h₃]

name: AddEquiv.bracket_def
statement:
lemma AddEquiv.bracket_def (e : M ≃+ L) (x y : M) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.lieRing
    ⁅x, y⁆ = e.symm ⁅e x, e y⁆ := rfl

name: LinearEquiv.lieEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma LinearEquiv.lieEquiv_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] L) (a : M) :
    e.lieEquiv R a = e a

name: LinearEquiv.lieEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma LinearEquiv.lieEquiv_symm_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] L) (b : L) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.toAddEquiv.lieRing
    letI := e.lieAlgebra
    (e.lieEquiv R).symm b = e.symm b := rfl

name: bracket_def
statement:
@[deprecated AddEquiv.bracket_def (since := "2026-07-30")]
lemma bracket_def (x y : L') :
    letI
proof:
:= e.lieRing
    ⁅x, y⁆ = e.symm ⁅e x, e y⁆ := rfl

name: map_comap_le
statement: theorem map_comap_le : map f (comap f N₂) ≤ N₂

name: map_comap_eq
statement: theorem map_comap_eq (hf : N₂ ≤ f.range) : map f (comap f N₂) = N₂

name: le_comap_map
statement: theorem le_comap_map : N ≤ comap f (map f N)

name: comap_map_eq
statement: theorem comap_map_eq (hf : f.ker = ⊥) : comap f (map f N) = N
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetLike.ext'_iff]
  exact (N : Set M).preimage_image_eq (f.ker_eq_bot.mp hf)

name: map_comap_incl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comap_incl : map N.incl (comap N.incl N') = N ⊓ N'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toSubmodule_inj]
  exact (N : Submodule R M).map_comap_subtype N'

name: lieIdeal_oper_eq_span
statement:
theorem lieIdeal_oper_eq_span :
    ⁅I, N⁆ = lieSpan R L { ⁅(x : L), (n : M)⁆ | (x : I) (n : N) }

name: lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span
statement:
theorem lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span [LieModule R L M] :
    (↑⁅I, N⁆ : Submodule R M) = Submodule.span R { ⁅(x : L), (n : M)⁆ | (x : I) (n : N) }
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · let s := { ⁅(x : L), (n : M)⁆ | (x : I) (n : N) }
    have aux : ∀ (y : L), ∀ m' ∈ Submodule.span R s, ⁅y, m'⁆ ∈ Submodule.span R s := by
      intro y m' hm'
      refine Submodule.span_induction (R := R) (M := M) (s := s)
        (p := fun m' _ ↦ ⁅y, m'⁆ ∈ Submodule.span R s) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hm'
      · rintro m'' ⟨x, n, hm''⟩; rw [← hm'', leibniz_lie]
        refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_ <;> apply Submodule.subset_span
        · use ⟨⁅y, ↑x⁆, I.lie_mem x.property⟩, n
        · use x, ⟨⁅y, ↑n⁆, N.lie_mem n.property⟩
      · simp
      · intro m₁ m₂ _ _ hm₁ hm₂; rw [lie_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hm₁ hm₂
      · intro t m'' _ hm''; rw [lie_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ t hm''
    change _ ≤ ({ Submodule.span R s with lie_mem := fun hm' => aux _ _ hm' } : LieSubmodule R L M)
    rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]
    exact Submodule.subset_span
  · rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span]; apply submodule_span_le_lieSpan

name: lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span'
statement:
theorem lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span' [LieModule R L M] :
    (↑⁅I, N⁆ : Submodule R M) = Submodule.span R { ⁅x, n⁆ | (x ∈ I) (n ∈ N) }
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span]
  congr
  ext m
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, n, hn, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, n, hn, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩

name: lie_le_iff
statement: theorem lie_le_iff : ⁅I, N⁆ ≤ N' ↔ ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅x, m⁆ ∈ N'
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  refine ⟨fun h x hx m hm => h ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro h _ ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩
  exact h x hx m hm

name: lie_coe_mem_lie
statement: theorem lie_coe_mem_lie (x : I) (m : N) : ⁅(x : L), (m : M)⁆ ∈ ⁅I, N⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span]; apply subset_lieSpan; use x, m

name: lie_mem_lie
statement: theorem lie_mem_lie {x : L} {m : M} (hx : x ∈ I) (hm : m ∈ N) : ⁅x, m⁆ ∈ ⁅I, N⁆

name: lie_comm
statement: theorem lie_comm : ⁅I, J⁆ = ⁅J, I⁆
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ I J : LieIdeal R L, ⁅I, J⁆ ≤ ⁅J, I⁆ by exact le_antisymm (this I J) (this J I)
  clear! I J; intro I J
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]; rintro x ⟨y, z, h⟩; rw [← h]
  rw [← lie_skew, ← lie_neg, ← LieSubmodule.coe_neg]
  apply lie_coe_mem_lie

name: lie_le_right
statement: theorem lie_le_right : ⁅I, N⁆ ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]; rintro m ⟨x, n, hn⟩; rw [← hn]
  exact N.lie_mem n.property

name: lie_le_left
statement: theorem lie_le_left : ⁅I, J⁆ ≤ I
proof: := by rw [lie_comm]; exact lie_le_right I J

name: lie_le_inf
statement: theorem lie_le_inf : ⁅I, J⁆ ≤ I ⊓ J
proof: := by rw [le_inf_iff]; exact ⟨lie_le_left I J, lie_le_right J I⟩

name: lie_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lie_bot : ⁅I, (⊥ : LieSubmodule R L M)⁆ = ⊥

name: bot_lie
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_lie : ⁅(⊥ : LieIdeal R L), N⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  suffices ⁅(⊥ : LieIdeal R L), N⁆ ≤ ⊥ by exact le_bot_iff.mp this
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]; rintro m ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, n, hn⟩; rw [← hn]
  change x ∈ (⊥ : LieIdeal R L) at hx; rw [mem_bot] at hx; simp [hx]

name: lie_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem lie_eq_bot_iff : ⁅I, N⁆ = ⊥ ↔ ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ m ∈ N, ⁅(x : L), m⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_eq_bot_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h x hx m hm => h ⁅x, m⁆ ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro h - ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  exact h x hx n hn

name: mono_lie
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem mono_lie (h₁ : I ≤ J) (h₂ : N ≤ N') : ⁅I, N⁆ ≤ ⁅J, N'⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro m h
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, mem_lieSpan] at h; rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, mem_lieSpan]
  intro N hN; apply h; rintro m' ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩, hm⟩; rw [← hm]; apply hN
  use ⟨x, h₁ hx⟩, ⟨n, h₂ hn⟩

name: mono_lie_left
statement: theorem mono_lie_left (h : I ≤ J) : ⁅I, N⁆ ≤ ⁅J, N⁆

name: mono_lie_right
statement: theorem mono_lie_right (h : N ≤ N') : ⁅I, N⁆ ≤ ⁅I, N'⁆

name: lie_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lie_sup : ⁅I, N ⊔ N'⁆ = ⁅I, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅I, N'⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⁅I, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅I, N'⁆ ≤ ⁅I, N ⊔ N'⁆ := by
    rw [sup_le_iff]; constructor <;>
    apply mono_lie_right <;> [exact le_sup_left; exact le_sup_right]
  suffices ⁅I, N ⊔ N'⁆ ≤ ⁅I, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅I, N'⁆ by exact le_antisymm this h
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]
  rintro m ⟨x, ⟨n, hn⟩, h⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  rw [LieSubmodule.mem_sup] at hn ⊢
  rcases hn with ⟨n₁, hn₁, n₂, hn₂, hn'⟩
  use ⁅(x : L), (⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : N)⁆; constructor; · apply lie_coe_mem_lie
  use ⁅(x : L), (⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ : N')⁆; constructor; · apply lie_coe_mem_lie
  simp [← h, ← hn']

name: sup_lie
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_lie : ⁅I ⊔ J, N⁆ = ⁅I, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅J, N⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⁅I, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅J, N⁆ ≤ ⁅I ⊔ J, N⁆ := by
    rw [sup_le_iff]; constructor <;>
    apply mono_lie_left <;> [exact le_sup_left; exact le_sup_right]
  suffices ⁅I ⊔ J, N⁆ ≤ ⁅I, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅J, N⁆ by exact le_antisymm this h
  rw [lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]
  rintro m ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, n, h⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  rw [LieSubmodule.mem_sup] at hx ⊢
  rcases hx with ⟨x₁, hx₁, x₂, hx₂, hx'⟩
  use ⁅((⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ : I) : L), (n : N)⁆; constructor; · apply lie_coe_mem_lie
  use ⁅((⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ : J) : L), (n : N)⁆; constructor; · apply lie_coe_mem_lie
  simp [← h, ← hx']

name: lie_inf
statement: theorem lie_inf : ⁅I, N ⊓ N'⁆ ≤ ⁅I, N⁆ ⊓ ⁅I, N'⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_inf_iff]; constructor <;>
  apply mono_lie_right <;> [exact inf_le_left; exact inf_le_right]

name: inf_lie
statement: theorem inf_lie : ⁅I ⊓ J, N⁆ ≤ ⁅I, N⁆ ⊓ ⁅J, N⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_inf_iff]; constructor <;>
  apply mono_lie_left <;> [exact inf_le_left; exact inf_le_right]

name: map_bracket_eq
statement: theorem map_bracket_eq [LieModule R L M] : map f ⁅I, N⁆ = ⁅I, map f N⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toSubmodule_inj, toSubmodule_map, lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span,
    lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span, Submodule.map_span]
  congr
  ext m
  simp

name: comap_bracket_eq
statement:
theorem comap_bracket_eq [LieModule R L M] (hf₁ : f.ker = ⊥) (hf₂ : N₂ ≤ f.range) :
    comap f ⁅I, N₂⁆ = ⁅I, comap f N₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← map_comap_eq N₂ f hf₂]
  rw [← map_bracket_eq, comap_map_eq _ f hf₁]

name: map_bracket_le
statement: theorem map_bracket_le {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} : map f ⁅I₁, I₂⁆ ≤ ⁅map f I₁, map f I₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_le_iff_le_comap, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨y₁, hy₁⟩, ⟨y₂, hy₂⟩, hx⟩ := hx
  rw [← hx]
  let fy₁ : ↥(map f I₁) := ⟨f y₁, mem_map hy₁⟩
  let fy₂ : ↥(map f I₂) := ⟨f y₂, mem_map hy₂⟩
  change _ ∈ comap f ⁅map f I₁, map f I₂⁆
  simp only [mem_comap, LieHom.map_lie]
  exact LieSubmodule.lie_coe_mem_lie fy₁ fy₂

name: map_bracket_eq
statement:
theorem map_bracket_eq {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    map f ⁅I₁, I₂⁆ = ⁅map f I₁, map f I₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  suffices ⁅map f I₁, map f I₂⁆ ≤ map f ⁅I₁, I₂⁆ by exact le_antisymm (map_bracket_le f) this
  rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule, coe_map_of_surjective h,
    LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span,
    LinearMap.map_span]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro x ⟨⟨z₁, h₁⟩, ⟨z₂, h₂⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y₁, rfl⟩ := mem_map_of_surjective h h₁
  obtain ⟨y₂, rfl⟩ := mem_map_of_surjective h h₂
  exact ⟨⁅(y₁ : L), (y₂ : L)⁆, ⟨y₁, y₂, rfl⟩, by apply f.map_lie⟩

name: comap_bracket_le
statement: theorem comap_bracket_le {J₁ J₂ : LieIdeal R L'} : ⁅comap f J₁, comap f J₂⁆ ≤ comap f ⁅J₁, J₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_le_iff_le_comap]
  exact le_trans (map_bracket_le f) (LieSubmodule.mono_lie map_comap_le map_comap_le)

name: map_comap_incl
statement: theorem map_comap_incl {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} : map I₁.incl (comap I₁.incl I₂) = I₁ ⊓ I₂
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← I₁.incl_idealRange]
  rw [← map_comap_eq]
  exact I₁.incl_isIdealMorphism

name: comap_bracket_eq
statement:
theorem comap_bracket_eq {J₁ J₂ : LieIdeal R L'} (h : f.IsIdealMorphism) :
    comap f ⁅f.idealRange ⊓ J₁, f.idealRange ⊓ J₂⁆ = ⁅comap f J₁, comap f J₂⁆ ⊔ f.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_inj, comap_toSubmodule,
    LieSubmodule.sup_toSubmodule, f.ker_toSubmodule, ← Submodule.comap_map_eq,
    LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span,
    LinearMap.map_span]
  congr
  ext
  simp_all only [Subtype.exists, LieSubmodule.mem_inf, LieHom.mem_idealRange_iff, exists_prop,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq, LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, mem_comap,
    exists_exists_and_exists_and_eq_and, LieHom.map_lie]
  grind

name: map_comap_bracket_eq
statement:
theorem map_comap_bracket_eq {J₁ J₂ : LieIdeal R L'} (h : f.IsIdealMorphism) :
    map f ⁅comap f J₁, comap f J₂⁆ = ⁅f.idealRange ⊓ J₁, f.idealRange ⊓ J₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_sup_ker_eq_map, ← comap_bracket_eq h, map_comap_eq h, inf_eq_right]
  exact le_trans (LieSubmodule.lie_le_left _ _) inf_le_left

name: comap_bracket_incl
statement:
theorem comap_bracket_incl {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} :
    ⁅comap I.incl I₁, comap I.incl I₂⁆ = comap I.incl ⁅I ⊓ I₁, I ⊓ I₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs =>
    congr
    next => skip
    rw [← I.incl_idealRange]
  rw [comap_bracket_eq]
  · simp
  · exact I.incl_isIdealMorphism

name: comap_bracket_incl_of_le
statement:
theorem comap_bracket_incl_of_le {I₁ I₂ : LieIdeal R L} (h₁ : I₁ ≤ I) (h₂ : I₂ ≤ I) :
    ⁅comap I.incl I₁, comap I.incl I₂⁆ = comap I.incl ⁅I₁, I₂⁆
proof:
:= by
    rw [comap_bracket_incl]; rw [← inf_eq_right] at h₁ h₂; rw [h₁, h₂]

name: lie_tmul_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lie_tmul_right (x : L) (m : M) (n : N) : ⁅x, m ⊗ₜ[R] n⁆ = ⁅x, m⁆ ⊗ₜ n + m ⊗ₜ ⁅x, n⁆
proof:
:=
  show hasBracketAux x (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = _ by
    simp only [hasBracketAux, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, toEnd_apply_apply,
      LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]

name: lift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P) (m : M) (n : N) : lift R L M N P f (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m n

name: coe_liftLie_eq_lift_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_liftLie_eq_lift_coe (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N →ₗ[R] P) :
    ⇑(liftLie R L M N P f) = lift R L M N P f

name: liftLie_apply
statement:
theorem liftLie_apply (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N →ₗ[R] P) (m : M) (n : N) :
    liftLie R L M N P f (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m n

name: toLinearMap_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearMap_map (f : M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ P) (g : N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ Q) :
    (map f g : M ⊗[R] N →ₗ[R] P ⊗[R] Q) = TensorProduct.map (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q)

name: mapIncl_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapIncl_def (M' : LieSubmodule R L M) (N' : LieSubmodule R L N) :
    mapIncl M' N' = map M'.incl N'.incl

name: toModuleHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toModuleHom_apply (x : L) (m : M) : toModuleHom R L M (x ⊗ₜ m) = ⁅x, m⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toModuleHom, TensorProduct.LieModule.liftLie_apply, LieModuleHom.coe_mk,
    LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, toEnd_apply_apply]

name: lieIdeal_oper_eq_tensor_map_range
statement:
theorem lieIdeal_oper_eq_tensor_map_range :
    ⁅I, N⁆ = ((toModuleHom R L M).comp (mapIncl I N : I ⊗[R] N →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ L ⊗[R] M)).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toSubmodule_inj, lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span, LieModuleHom.toSubmodule_range,
    LieModuleHom.toLinearMap_comp, LinearMap.range_comp, mapIncl_def, toLinearMap_map,
    TensorProduct.range_map_eq_span_tmul, Submodule.map_span]
  congr; ext m; constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩; use x ⊗ₜ n; constructor
    · use ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩; rfl
    · simp
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩, h⟩; rw [← h]; use ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩; rfl

name: trivial_lie_zero
statement:
theorem trivial_lie_zero (L : Type v) (M : Type w) [Bracket L M] [Zero M] [LieModule.IsTrivial L M]
    (x : L) (m : M) : ⁅x, m⁆ = 0

name: Function.Injective.isLieAbelian
proof:
:=
  { trivial := fun x y => h₁ <|
      calc
        f ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅f x, f y⁆ := LieHom.map_lie f x y
        _ = 0 := trivial_lie_zero _ _ _ _
        _ = f 0 := (map_zero _).symm }

name: Function.Surjective.isLieAbelian
proof:
:=
  { trivial := fun x y => by
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := h₁ x
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := h₁ y
      rw [← LieHom.map_lie, trivial_lie_zero, map_zero] }

  simp [this, isMulCommutative_iff, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, sub_eq_zero]

name: LieSubalgebra.isLieAbelian_lieSpan_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem LieSubalgebra.isLieAbelian_lieSpan_iff
    {R L : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] {s : Set L} :
    IsLieAbelian (lieSpan R L s) ↔ ∀ᵉ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s), ⁅x, y⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x hx y hy ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · let x' : lieSpan R L s := ⟨x, subset_lieSpan hx⟩
    let y' : lieSpan R L s := ⟨y, subset_lieSpan hy⟩
    suffices ⁅x', y'⁆ = 0 by simpa [x', y', Subtype.ext_iff] using this
    simp [trivial_lie_zero]
  · induction hx using lieSpan_induction with
    | mem w hw =>
      induction hy using lieSpan_induction with
      | mem u hu => simpa [Subtype.ext_iff] using h w hw u hu
      | zero => simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
      | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
        simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_bracket, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, lie_add] at hu hv ⊢
        simp [hu, hv]
      | smul t u _ hu =>
        simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_bracket, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at hu
        simp [Subtype.ext_iff, hu]
      | lie u v _ _ hu hv =>
        simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_bracket, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at hu hv ⊢
        rw [leibniz_lie]
        simp [hu, hv]
    | zero => simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
    | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
      simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_bracket, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, add_lie] at hu hv ⊢
      simp [hu, hv]
    | smul t u _ hu =>
      simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_bracket, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at hu
      simp [Subtype.ext_iff, hu]
    | lie u v _ _ hu hv =>
      simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_bracket, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at hu hv ⊢
      simp [hu, hv]

  · ext y
    have := IsTrivial.trivial (⟨x, hx⟩ : I) y

    rw [← mem_maxTrivSubmodule R L M, h]; exact LieSubmodule.mem_top m

name: weightSpaceOfIsLieTower_aux
statement:
private lemma weightSpaceOfIsLieTower_aux (z : L) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ weightSpace V χ) :
    ⁅z, v⁆ ∈ weightSpace V χ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weightSpace] at hv ⊢
  intro a
  rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with (rfl | hv')
  · simp only [lie_zero, smul_zero]
  suffices χ ⁅z, a⁆ = 0 by
    rw [leibniz_lie, hv a, lie_smul, lie_swap_lie, hv, this, zero_smul, neg_zero, zero_add]
  let U' : ℕ →o Submodule R V :=
  { toFun n := Submodule.span R {((π z)^i) v | i < n},
    monotone' i j h := Submodule.span_mono (fun _ ⟨c, hc, hw⟩ ↦ ⟨c, lt_of_lt_of_le hc h, hw⟩) }
  have map_U'_le (n : ℕ) : Submodule.map (π z) (U' n) ≤ U' (n + 1) := by
    simp only [OrderHom.coe_mk, Submodule.map_span, toEnd_apply_apply, U']
    apply Submodule.span_mono
    suffices ∀ a < n, ∃ b < n + 1, ((π z) ^ b) v = ((π z) ^ (a + 1)) v by simpa [pow_succ']
    aesop
  have T_apply_succ (w : A) (n : ℕ) :
      Submodule.map (T χ w) (U' (n + 1)) ≤ U' n := by
    simp only [OrderHom.coe_mk, U', Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le, Set.image_subset_iff]
    simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, SetLike.mem_coe,
      forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    induction n generalizing w
    · simp only [zero_add, Nat.lt_one_iff, LinearMap.sub_apply, LieModule.toEnd_apply_apply,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, forall_eq, pow_zero, hv w, sub_self, zero_mem]
    · next n hn =>
      intro m hm
      obtain (hm | rfl) : m < n + 1 ∨ m = n + 1 := by lia
      · exact U'.mono (Nat.le_succ n) (hn w m hm)
      have H : ∀ w, ⁅w, (π z ^ n) v⁆ = (T χ w) ((π z ^ n) v) + χ w • ((π z ^ n) v) := by simp
      rw [T, LinearMap.sub_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, LieModule.toEnd_apply_apply,
        LieModule.toEnd_apply_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, leibniz_lie,
        lie_swap_lie w z, H, H, lie_add, lie_smul, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_assoc, sub_self, add_zero]
      refine add_mem (neg_mem <| add_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
      · exact U'.mono n.le_succ (hn _ n n.lt_succ_self)
      · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, n.lt_succ_self, rfl⟩)
      · exact map_U'_le _ <| Submodule.mem_map_of_mem <| hn w n n.lt_succ_self
  set U : LieSubmodule R A V :=
  { toSubmodule := ⨆ k : ℕ, U' k
    lie_mem {w} x hx := by
      rw [show ⁅w, x⁆ = (T χ w) x + χ w • x by simp]
      apply add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx)
      set U := ⨆ k : ℕ, U' k
      suffices Submodule.map (T χ w) U ≤ U from this <| Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
      rw [Submodule.map_iSup, iSup_le_iff]
      rintro (_ | i)
      · simp [U']
      · exact (T_apply_succ w i).trans (le_iSup _ _) }
  have hzU (x : V) (hx : x ∈ U) : (π z) x ∈ U := by
    suffices Submodule.map (π z) U ≤ U from this <| Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
    simp only [U, Submodule.map_iSup, iSup_le_iff]
    exact fun i ↦ (map_U'_le i).trans (le_iSup _ _)
  have trace_za_zero : (LieModule.toEnd R A _ ⁅z, a⁆).trace R U = 0 := by
    have hres : LieModule.toEnd R A U ⁅z, a⁆ = ⁅(π z).restrict hzU, LieModule.toEnd R A U a⁆ := by
      ext ⟨x, hx⟩
      change ⁅⁅z, a⁆, x⁆ = ⁅z, ⁅a, x⁆⁆ - ⁅a, ⁅z, x⁆⁆
      simp only [leibniz_lie z a, add_sub_cancel_right]
    rw [hres, LinearMap.trace_lie]
  have trace_T_U_zero (w : A) : (T χ w).trace R U = 0 := by
    have key (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0) : ∃ j < i, Submodule.map (T χ w) (U' i) ≤ U' j := by
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
      exact ⟨j, j.lt_succ_self, T_apply_succ w j⟩
    apply IsNilpotent.eq_zero
    apply LinearMap.isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent
    rw [Module.End.isNilpotent_iff_of_finite]
    suffices ⨆ i, U' i ≤ Module.End.maxGenEigenspace (T χ w) 0 by
      intro x
      specialize this x.2
      simp only [Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace, zero_smul, sub_zero] at this
      gconvert this with n hn
      ext
      simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, ← hn]; clear hn
      induction n <;> simp_all [pow_succ']
    apply iSup_le
    intro i x hx
    simp only [Module.End.mem_maxGenEigenspace, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x
    next i ih =>
    obtain rfl | hi := eq_or_ne i 0
    · simp_all [U']
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩ := key i hi
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih j hj (hj' <| Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx)
    use k + 1
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hk]
  have trace_za : (toEnd R A _ ⁅z, a⁆).trace R U = χ ⁅z, a⁆ • (finrank R U) := by
    simpa [T, sub_eq_zero] using trace_T_U_zero ⁅z, a⁆
  suffices finrank R U ≠ 0 by simp_all
  suffices Nontrivial U from Module.finrank_pos.ne'
  have hvU : v ∈ U := by
    apply Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 1
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    use 0, zero_lt_one
    rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply]
  exact nontrivial_of_ne ⟨v, hvU⟩ 0 <| by simp [hv']

name: exists_nontrivial_weightSpace_of_lieIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_weightSpace_of_lieIdeal [LieModule.IsTriangularizable k L V]
    (A : LieIdeal k L) (hA : IsCoatom A.toSubmodule)
    (χ₀ : Module.Dual k A) [Nontrivial (weightSpace V χ₀)] :
    ∃ (χ : Module.Dual k L), Nontrivial (weightSpace V χ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (hA.lt_top)
  let e : (k ∙ z) ≃ₗ[k] k := (LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton k L z <| by aesop).symm
  have he : ∀ x, e x • z = x := by simp [e]
  have hA : IsCompl A.toSubmodule (k ∙ z) := isCompl_span_singleton_of_isCoatom_of_notMem hA hz
  let π₁ : L →ₗ[k] A       := A.toSubmodule.projectionOnto (k ∙ z) hA
  let π₂ : L →ₗ[k] (k ∙ z) := (k ∙ z).projectionOnto ↑A hA.symm
  set W : LieSubmodule k L V := weightSpaceOfIsLieTower k V χ₀
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, (toEnd k _ W z).HasEigenvalue c := by
    have : Nontrivial W := inferInstanceAs (Nontrivial (weightSpace V χ₀))
    apply Module.End.exists_hasEigenvalue_of_genEigenspace_eq_top
    exact LieModule.IsTriangularizable.maxGenEigenspace_eq_top z
  obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hvc⟩ := hc.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hv' : ∀ (x : ↥A), ⁅x, v⁆ = χ₀ x • v := by
    simpa [W, weightSpaceOfIsLieTower, mem_weightSpace] using hv
  use (χ₀.comp π₁) + c • (e.comp π₂)
  refine nontrivial_of_ne ⟨v, ?_⟩ 0 ?_
  · rw [mem_weightSpace]
    intro x
    have hπ : (π₁ x : L) + π₂ x = x := projection_add_projection_eq_self hA x
    suffices ⁅projection _ _ hA.symm x, v⁆ = (c • e (π₂ x)) • v by
      calc ⁅x, v⁆
          = ⁅π₁ x, v⁆ + ⁅projection _ _ hA.symm x, v⁆ := congr(⁅$hπ.symm, v⁆) ▸ add_lie _ _ _
        _ = χ₀ (π₁ x) • v + (c • e (π₂ x)) • v    := by rw [hv' (π₁ x), this]
        _ = _ := by simp [add_smul]
    calc ⁅projection _ _ hA.symm x, v⁆
        = e (π₂ x) • ↑(c • ⟨v, hv⟩ : W) := by
          rw [projection_apply, ← he, smul_lie, ← hvc.apply_eq_smul]; rfl
      _ = (c • e (π₂ x)) • v            := by rw [smul_assoc, smul_comm]; rfl
  · simpa [ne_eq, LieSubmodule.mk_eq_zero] using hvc.right

name: exists_forall_lie_eq_smul_of_isSolvable_of_finite
statement:
private lemma exists_forall_lie_eq_smul_of_isSolvable_of_finite
    (L : Type*) [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra k L] [LieRingModule L V] [LieModule k L V]
    [IsSolvable L] [LieModule.IsTriangularizable k L V] [Module.Finite k L] :
    ∃ χ : Module.Dual k L, Nontrivial (weightSpace V χ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain H | ⟨A, hA, hAL⟩ := eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom (derivedSeries k L 1).toSubmodule
  · obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial L
    · use 0
      simpa [trivial_lie_zero, mem_weightSpace, nontrivial_iff] using exists_pair_ne V
    · rw [LieSubmodule.toSubmodule_eq_top] at H
      exact ((derivedSeries_lt_top_of_solvable k L).ne H).elim
  lift A to LieIdeal k L
  · intros
    exact hAL <| LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie (LieSubmodule.mem_top _) (LieSubmodule.mem_top _)
  obtain ⟨χ', _⟩ := exists_forall_lie_eq_smul_of_isSolvable_of_finite A
  exact exists_nontrivial_weightSpace_of_lieIdeal A hA χ'

name: exists_nontrivial_weightSpace_of_isSolvable
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_weightSpace_of_isSolvable
    [IsSolvable L] [LieModule.IsTriangularizable k L V] :
    ∃ χ : Module.Dual k L, Nontrivial (weightSpace V χ)
proof:
:= by
  let imL := (toEnd k L V).range
  let toEndo : L →ₗ[k] imL := LinearMap.codRestrict imL.toSubmodule (toEnd k L V)
      (fun x ↦ LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩ : ∀ x : L, (toEnd k L V) x ∈ imL)
  have ⟨χ, h⟩ := exists_forall_lie_eq_smul_of_isSolvable_of_finite k V imL
  use χ.comp toEndo
  obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hv0⟩ := exists_ne (0 : weightSpace V χ)
  refine nontrivial_of_ne ⟨v, ?_⟩ 0 ?_
  · rw [mem_weightSpace] at hv ⊢
    intro x
    apply hv (toEndo x)
  · simpa using hv0

name: orthogonal_disjoint
statement:
lemma orthogonal_disjoint
    (Φ : LinearMap.BilinForm R L) (hΦ_nondeg : Φ.Nondegenerate) (hΦ_inv : Φ.lieInvariant L)
    
    (hL : ∀ I : LieIdeal R L, IsAtom I → ¬IsLieAbelian I)
    (I : LieIdeal R L) (hI : IsAtom I) :
    Disjoint I (orthogonal Φ hΦ_inv I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff, ← hI.lt_iff, lt_iff_le_and_ne]
  suffices ¬I ≤ orthogonal Φ hΦ_inv I by simpa
  intro contra
  apply hI.1
  rw [eq_bot_iff, ← lie_eq_self_of_isAtom_of_nonabelian I hI (hL I hI),
      LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, LieSubmodule.lieSpan_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
  simp only [LieSubmodule.bot_coe, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  apply hΦ_nondeg.1
  intro z
  rw [hΦ_inv, neg_eq_zero]
  have hyz : ⁅(x : L), z⁆ ∈ I := lie_mem_left _ _ _ _ _ x.2
  exact contra hyz y y.2

name: atomistic
statement: lemma atomistic : ∀ I : LieIdeal K L, sSup {J : LieIdeal K L | IsAtom J ∧ J ≤ I} = I
proof:
:= by
  intro I
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sSup_le
    rintro J ⟨-, hJ'⟩
    exact hJ'
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · exact hI.le.trans bot_le
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hJI⟩ := (eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le I).resolve_left hI
  let J' := orthogonal Φ hΦ_inv J
  suffices I ≤ J ⊔ (J' ⊓ I) by
    refine this.trans ?_
    apply sup_le
    · exact le_sSup ⟨hJ, hJI⟩
    rw [← atomistic (J' ⊓ I)]
    apply sSup_le_sSup
    simp only [le_inf_iff, Set.ofPred_subset_ofPred, and_imp]
    tauto
  suffices J ⊔ J' = ⊤ by rw [← sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hJI, this, top_inf_eq]
  exact (orthogonal_isCompl Φ hΦ_nondeg hΦ_inv hΦ_refl hL J hJ).codisjoint.eq_top

name: isSemisimple_of_nondegenerate
statement: theorem isSemisimple_of_nondegenerate : IsSemisimple K L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hL⟩
  · simpa using atomistic Φ hΦ_nondeg hΦ_inv hΦ_refl hL ⊤
  intro I hI
  apply (orthogonal_disjoint Φ hΦ_nondeg hΦ_inv hL I hI).mono_right
  apply sSup_le
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, and_imp]
  intro J hJ hJI
  rw [← lie_eq_self_of_isAtom_of_nonabelian J hJ (hL J hJ), lieIdeal_oper_eq_span, lieSpan_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
  simp only [orthogonal_carrier, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  intro z hz
  rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← hΦ_inv]
  suffices ⁅(x : L), z⁆ = 0 by simp only [this, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  rw [← LieSubmodule.mem_bot (R := K) (L := L), ← (hJ.disjoint_of_ne hI hJI).eq_bot]
  apply lie_le_inf
  exact lie_mem_lie x.2 hz

name: LieSubalgebra.coe_ad_pow

:=
  LieSubmodule.coe_toEnd_pow R H L H.toLieSubmodule x y n

name: LieModule.toEnd_lie
statement:
lemma LieModule.toEnd_lie (x y : L) (z : M) :
    (φ x) ⁅y, z⁆ = ⁅ad R L x y, z⁆ + ⁅y, φ x z⁆

name: LieAlgebra.ad_lie
statement:
lemma LieAlgebra.ad_lie (x y z : L) :
    (ad R L x) ⁅y, z⁆ = ⁅ad R L x y, z⁆ + ⁅y, ad R L x z⁆

name: LieModule.toEnd_pow_lie
statement:
lemma LieModule.toEnd_pow_lie (x y : L) (z : M) (n : ℕ) :
    ((φ x) ^ n) ⁅y, z⁆ =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, n.choose ij.1 • ⁅((ad R L x) ^ ij.1) y, ((φ x) ^ ij.2) z⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_nsmul
      (fun i j ↦ ⁅((ad R L x) ^ i) y, ((φ x) ^ j) z⁆) n]
    simp only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_sum, map_nsmul,
      toEnd_lie, nsmul_add, sum_add_distrib]
    rw [add_comm, add_left_cancel_iff, sum_congr rfl]
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
    rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
    rw [Nat.choose_symm_of_eq_add hij.symm]

name: LieAlgebra.ad_pow_lie
statement:
lemma LieAlgebra.ad_pow_lie (x y z : L) (n : ℕ) :

name: bracket_ofTwoCocycle
statement:
lemma bracket_ofTwoCocycle {c : twoCocycle R L M} (x y : ofTwoCocycle c) :
    letI x₁
proof:
:= ((ofProd c).symm x).1; letI x₂ := ((ofProd c).symm x).2
    letI y₁ := ((ofProd c).symm y).1; letI y₂ := ((ofProd c).symm y).2
    ⁅x, y⁆ = ofProd c (⁅x₁, y₁⁆, (c : L →ₗ[R] L →ₗ[R] M) x₁ y₁ + ⁅x₁, y₂⁆ - ⁅y₁, x₂⁆) :=
  rfl

name: ringModuleOf_bracket_proj
statement:
lemma ringModuleOf_bracket_proj [IsLieAbelian M] (E : Extension R M L) (y : M) (z : E.L) :
    letI
proof:
:= E.ringModuleOf
    ⁅E.proj z, y⁆ = E.toKer.symm ⁅z, E.toKer y⁆ := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : E.proj_surjective.hasRightInverse.choose (E.proj z) - z ∈ E.incl.range := by
    rw [E.IsExtension.exact]
    change _ ∈ E.proj.ker
    simp [E.proj_surjective.hasRightInverse.choose_spec (E.proj z)]
  rw [ringModuleOf_bracket, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_lie,
    Subtype.ext_iff, LieSubmodule.coe_bracket, lie_toKer_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, ← hx,
    LieHom.coe_toLinearMap, ← LieHom.map_lie, trivial_lie_zero M M x y, map_zero]

name: lieModuleOf
statement:
lemma lieModuleOf [IsLieAbelian M] (E : Extension R M L) :
    letI
proof:
:= E.ringModuleOf
    LieModule R L M := by
  let := E.ringModuleOf
  set h := E.proj_surjective.hasRightInverse
  exact
    { smul_lie r x m := by
        rw [ringModuleOf_bracket, ringModuleOf_bracket, ← map_smul, ← smul_lie,
          EquivLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_lie]
        exact trivial_lie_zero E.proj.ker _ ⟨_, by simp [h.choose_spec _]⟩ (E.toKer m)
      lie_smul r x m := by simp }

name: toKer_bracket
statement:
lemma toKer_bracket [IsLieAbelian M] (E : Extension R M L) (x : E.proj.ker) (y : L) :
    letI
proof:
:= E.ringModuleOf
    E.toKer ⁅y, E.toKer.symm x⁆ = ⁅E.proj_surjective.hasRightInverse.choose y, x⁆ := by
  simp

name: lie_apply_proj_of_leftInverse_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_lie]
  exact trivial_lie_zero E.proj.ker E.proj.ker ⟨_, (by simp [hs.eq])⟩ y

name: d
proof:
:= E.ringModuleOf
    letI := E.lieModuleOf
    d₁₂ R L M (E.oneCochainOfTwoSplitting hs₁ hs₂) = E.twoCocycleOf hs₁ - E.twoCocycleOf hs₂ := by
  ext x y
  choose s hs using E.proj_surjective
  have {s' : L → E.L} (h : LeftInverse E.proj s') : ⁅s x - s' x, s' y - s y⁆ = (0 : E.L) := by
    have aux := trivial_lie_zero E.proj.ker E.proj.ker
      ⟨s x - s' x, by rw [LieHom.mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, h, hs]⟩
      ⟨s' y - s y, by rw [LieHom.mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, h, hs]⟩
    simpa only [Subtype.ext_iff, LieSubmodule.coe_zero, LieIdeal.coe_bracket_of_module,
      LieSubmodule.coe_bracket] using aux
  replace this {s' : L → E.L} (h : LeftInverse E.proj s') :
      ⁅s x, s' y⁆ = ⁅s' x, s' y⁆ + (⁅s x, s y⁆ - ⁅s' x, s y⁆) := by
    simpa [sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] using this h
  simp only [d₁₂_apply_coe_apply_apply, oneCochainOfTwoSplitting_apply, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub,
    twoCocycleOf_coe_coe, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LieEquiv.coe_toLinearEquiv]
  nth_rw 1 [← hs x]
  nth_rw 4 [← hs y]
  simp only [← EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq E.toKer, ringModuleOf_bracket_proj,
    LieEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_sub, Subtype.ext_iff, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub,
    LieSubmodule.coe_bracket, lie_sub, this hs₁, this hs₂, ← lie_skew (s₁ x) (s y),
    ← lie_skew (s₂ x) (s y)]
  abel

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.isSkewAdjoint_bracket
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_skewAdjointSubmodule] at *
  have hfg : IsAdjointPair B B (f * g) (g * f) := by rw [← neg_mul_neg g f]; exact hg.comp hf
  have hgf : IsAdjointPair B B (g * f) (f * g) := by rw [← neg_mul_neg f g]; exact hf.comp hg
  change IsAdjointPair B B (f * g - g * f) (-(f * g - g * f)); rw [neg_sub]
  exact hfg.sub hgf

name: Matrix.lie_transpose
statement: theorem Matrix.lie_transpose (A B : Matrix n n R) : ⁅A, B⁆ᵀ = ⁅Bᵀ, Aᵀ⁆
proof:
:=
  show (A * B - B * A)ᵀ = Bᵀ * Aᵀ - Aᵀ * Bᵀ by simp

name: Matrix.isSkewAdjoint_bracket
statement:
theorem Matrix.isSkewAdjoint_bracket {A B : Matrix n n R} (hA : A ∈ skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule J)
    (hB : B ∈ skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule J) : ⁅A, B⁆ ∈ skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule] at *
  change ⁅A, B⁆ᵀ * J = J * (-⁅A, B⁆)
  change Aᵀ * J = J * (-A) at hA
  change Bᵀ * J = J * (-B) at hB
  rw [Matrix.lie_transpose, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket,
    LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hA, hB, ← mul_assoc,
    ← mul_assoc, hA, hB]
  noncomm_ring

name: mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra (A : Matrix n n R) :

name: skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebraEquiv_apply

name: skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebraEquivTranspose_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebraEquivTranspose_apply {m : Type w} [DecidableEq m]
    [Fintype m] (e : Matrix n n R ≃ₐ[R] Matrix m m R) (h : ∀ A, (e A)ᵀ = e Aᵀ)
    (A : skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra J) :
    (skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebraEquivTranspose J e h A : Matrix m m R) = e A

name: mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra_unit_smul
statement:
theorem mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra_unit_smul (u : Rˣ) (J A : Matrix n n R) :
    A ∈ skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra (u • J) ↔ A ∈ skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra J
proof:
:= by
  change A ∈ skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule (u • J) ↔ A ∈ skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule J
  simp only [mem_skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule, Matrix.IsSkewAdjoint, Matrix.IsAdjointPair]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · simpa using congr_arg (fun B => u⁻¹ • B) h
  · simp [h]

name: leibniz_lie
statement:
lemma leibniz_lie [Add M] [IsLieTower L₁ L₂ M] (x : L₁) (y : L₂) (m : M) :

name: lie_swap_lie
statement:
lemma lie_swap_lie [Bracket L₂ L₁] [AddCommGroup M] [IsLieTower L₁ L₂ M] [IsLieTower L₂ L₁ M]
    (x : L₁) (y : L₂) (m : M) : ⁅⁅x, y⁆, m⁆ = -⁅⁅y, x⁆, m⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := leibniz_lie x y m
  have h2 := leibniz_lie y x m
  convert congr($h1.symm - $h2) <;> simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, sub_add_cancel_right]

proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.map_nsmul
    { toFun := fun x : L => ⁅x, m⁆, map_zero' := zero_lie m, map_add' := fun _ _ => add_lie _ _ _ }
    _ _
