name: inl_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_pow [Monoid R] [AddMonoid M] [DistribMulAction R M] [DistribMulAction Rᵐᵒᵖ M] (r : R)
    (n : ℕ) : (inl r ^ n : tsze R M) = inl (r ^ n)

name: fst_list_prod
statement:
theorem fst_list_prod [Monoid R] [AddMonoid M] [DistribMulAction R M] [DistribMulAction Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
    [SMulCommClass R Rᵐᵒᵖ M] (l : List (tsze R M)) : l.prod.fst = (l.map fst).prod
proof:
:=
  map_list_prod ({ toFun := fst, map_one' := fst_one, map_mul' := fst_mul } : tsze R M →* R) _

name: snd_list_prod
statement:
theorem snd_list_prod [Monoid R] [AddCommMonoid M] [DistribMulAction R M] [DistribMulAction Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
    [SMulCommClass R Rᵐᵒᵖ M] (l : List (tsze R M)) :
    l.prod.snd =
      (l.zipIdx.map fun x : tsze R M × ℕ =>
          ((l.map fst).take x.2).prod •> x.fst.snd <• ((l.map fst).drop x.2.succ).prod).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.zipIdx_cons']
    simp_rw [List.map_cons, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, Prod.map_snd, Prod.map_fst, id,
      List.take_zero, List.take_succ_cons, List.prod_nil, List.prod_cons, snd_mul, one_smul,
      List.drop, mul_smul, List.sum_cons, fst_list_prod, ih, List.smul_sum, List.map_map,
      ← smul_comm (_ : R) (_ : Rᵐᵒᵖ)]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: fst_invOf
statement: theorem fst_invOf (x : tsze R M) [Invertible x] [Invertible x.fst] : (⅟x).fst = ⅟(x.fst)
proof:
:= by

name: mul_left_eq_one
statement:
theorem mul_left_eq_one (r : R) (x : tsze R M) (h : r * x.fst = 1) :
    (inl r + inr (-((r •> x.snd) <• r))) * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> dsimp
  · rw [add_zero, h]
  · rw [add_zero, zero_add, smul_neg, op_smul_op_smul, h, op_one, one_smul,
      add_neg_cancel]

name: mul_right_eq_one
statement:
theorem mul_right_eq_one (x : tsze R M) (r : R) (h : x.fst * r = 1) :
    x * (inl r + inr (-(r •> (x.snd <• r)))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> dsimp
  · rw [add_zero, h]
  · rw [add_zero, zero_add, smul_neg, smul_smul, h, one_smul, neg_add_cancel]

name: snd_invOf
statement:
theorem snd_invOf (x : tsze R M) [Invertible x] [Invertible x.fst] :
    (⅟x).snd = -(⅟x.fst •> x.snd <• ⅟x.fst)
proof:
:= by
  let := invertibleOfInvertibleFst x
  convert! congr_arg (TrivSqZeroExt.snd (R := R) (M := M)) (_ : _ = ⅟x)
  convert! rfl

name: inv_inl
statement:
protected theorem inv_inl (r : R) :
    (inl r)⁻¹ = (inl (r⁻¹ : R) : tsze R M)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · rw [fst_inv, fst_inl, fst_inl]
  · rw [snd_inv, fst_inl, snd_inl, snd_inl, smul_zero, smul_zero, neg_zero]

name: inv_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_inr (m : M) : (inr m)⁻¹ = (0 : tsze R M)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · rw [fst_inv, fst_inr, fst_zero, inv_zero]
  · rw [snd_inv, snd_inr, fst_inr, inv_zero, op_zero, zero_smul, snd_zero, neg_zero]

statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem inv_zero : (0 : tsze R M)⁻¹ = (0 : tsze R M)

@[simp]
protected theorem inv_one : (1 : tsze R M)⁻¹ = (1 : tsze R M)

name: inv_mul_cancel
statement: protected theorem inv_mul_cancel {x : tsze R M} (hx : fst x ≠ 0) : x⁻¹ * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  convert mul_left_eq_one _ _ (_root_.inv_mul_cancel₀ hx)
  ext <;> simp

name: invOf_eq_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem invOf_eq_inv (x : tsze R M) [Invertible x] : ⅟x = x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let := invertibleFstOfInvertible x
  ext <;> simp [fst_invOf, snd_invOf]

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement: protected theorem mul_inv_cancel {x : tsze R M} (hx : fst x ≠ 0) : x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible x.fst := Units.invertible (.mk0 _ hx)
  have := invertibleOfInvertibleFst x
  rw [← invOf_eq_inv, mul_invOf_self]

name: mul_inv_rev
statement:
protected theorem mul_inv_rev (a b : tsze R M) :
    (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · rw [fst_inv, fst_mul, fst_mul, mul_inv_rev, fst_inv, fst_inv]
  · simp only [snd_inv, snd_mul, fst_mul, fst_inv]
    simp only [smul_neg, smul_add]
    simp_rw [mul_inv_rev, smul_comm (_ : R), op_smul_op_smul, smul_smul, add_comm, neg_add]
    obtain ha0 | ha := eq_or_ne (fst a) 0
    · simp [ha0]
    obtain hb0 | hb := eq_or_ne (fst b) 0
    · simp [hb0]
    rw [inv_mul_cancel_right₀ ha, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hb]

name: inv_inv
statement: protected theorem inv_inv {x : tsze R M} (hx : fst x ≠ 0) : x⁻¹⁻¹ = x
proof:
:=
  
  calc
    x⁻¹⁻¹ = 1 * x⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [one_mul]
    _ = x * x⁻¹ * x⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [TrivSqZeroExt.mul_inv_cancel hx]
    _ = x := by
      rw [mul_assoc, TrivSqZeroExt.mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
      rw [fst_inv]
      apply inv_ne_zero hx

name: isUnit_inv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isUnit_inv_iff {x : tsze R M} : IsUnit x⁻¹ ↔ IsUnit x

statement:

    (h : ∀ m, f (inr m) = g (inr m)) : f = g

name: algHom_ext'
statement:
@[ext]
theorem algHom_ext' {A} [Semiring A] [Algebra S A] ⦃f g : tsze R M →ₐ[S] A⦄
    (hinl : f.comp (inlAlgHom S R M) = g.comp (inlAlgHom S R M))
    (hinr : f.toLinearMap.comp (inrHom R M |>.restrictScalars S) =
      g.toLinearMap.comp (inrHom R M |>.restrictScalars S)) : f = g

name: lift_def
statement:
theorem lift_def (f : R →ₐ[S] A) (g : M →ₗ[S] A)
    (hg : ∀ x y, g x * g y = 0)
    (hfg : ∀ r x, g (r • x) = f r * g x)
    (hgf : ∀ r x, g (op r • x) = g x * f r) (x : tsze R M) :
    lift f g hg hfg hgf x = f x.fst + g x.snd

name: lift_apply_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply_inl (f : R →ₐ[S] A) (g : M →ₗ[S] A)
    (hg : ∀ x y, g x * g y = 0)
    (hfg : ∀ r x, g (r •> x) = f r * g x)
    (hgf : ∀ r x, g (x <• r) = g x * f r)
    (r : R) :
    lift f g hg hfg hgf (inl r) = f r
proof:
:=
  show f r + g 0 = f r by rw [map_zero, add_zero]

name: lift_apply_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply_inr (f : R →ₐ[S] A) (g : M →ₗ[S] A)
    (hg : ∀ x y, g x * g y = 0)
    (hfg : ∀ r x, g (r •> x) = f r * g x)
    (hgf : ∀ r x, g (x <• r) = g x * f r)
    (m : M) :
    lift f g hg hfg hgf (inr m) = g m
proof:
:=
  show f 0 + g m = g m by rw [map_zero, zero_add]

name: lift_comp_inlHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp_inlHom (f : R →ₐ[S] A) (g : M →ₗ[S] A)
    (hg : ∀ x y, g x * g y = 0)
    (hfg : ∀ r x, g (r •> x) = f r * g x)
    (hgf : ∀ r x, g (x <• r) = g x * f r) :
    (lift f g hg hfg hgf).comp (inlAlgHom S R M) = f
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext <| lift_apply_inl f g hg hfg hgf

name: lift_comp_inrHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp_inrHom (f : R →ₐ[S] A) (g : M →ₗ[S] A)
    (hg : ∀ x y, g x * g y = 0)
    (hfg : ∀ r x, g (r •> x) = f r * g x)
    (hgf : ∀ r x, g (x <• r) = g x * f r) :
    (lift f g hg hfg hgf).toLinearMap.comp (inrHom R M |>.restrictScalars S) = g
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext <| lift_apply_inr f g hg hfg hgf

name: lift_inlAlgHom_inrHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_inlAlgHom_inrHom :
    lift (inlAlgHom _ _ _) (inrHom R M |>.restrictScalars S)
      (inr_mul_inr R) (fun _ _ => (inl_mul_inr _ _).symm) (fun _ _ => (inr_mul_inl _ _).symm) =
    AlgHom.id S (tsze R M)

name: range_inlAlgHom_sup_adjoin_range_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_inlAlgHom_sup_adjoin_range_inr :
    (inlAlgHom S R M).range ⊔ Algebra.adjoin S (Set.range inr) = (⊤ : Subalgebra S (tsze R M))
proof:
:= by
  refine top_unique fun x hx => ?_; clear hx
  rw [← x.inl_fst_add_inr_snd_eq]
  refine add_mem ?_ ?_
  · exact le_sup_left (α := Subalgebra S _) <| Set.mem_range_self x.fst
  · exact le_sup_right (α := Subalgebra S _) <| Algebra.subset_adjoin <| Set.mem_range_self x.snd

name: range_liftAux
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_liftAux (f : R →ₐ[S] A) (g : M →ₗ[S] A)

name: add_pow_prime_pow_eq'
statement:
protected lemma add_pow_prime_pow_eq' (h : Commute x y) (n : ℕ) :
    (x + y) ^ p ^ n =
      x ^ p ^ n + y ^ p ^ n +
        p * ∑ k ∈ Ioo 0 (p ^ n), x ^ k * y ^ (p ^ n - k) * ↑((p ^ n).choose k / p)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 0 (p ^ n), x ^ k * y ^ (p ^ n - k) * (p ^ n).choose k := by
    rw [h.add_pow, ← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc]
  _ = x ^ p ^ n + y ^ p ^ n + ∑ k ∈ Ioo 0 (p ^ n), x ^ k * y ^ (p ^ n - k) * (p ^ n).choose k := by
    simp_rw [Icc_eq_cons_Ico zero_le, Ico_eq_cons_Ioo (pow_pos hp.pos _)]
    simp [-cons_eq_insert, add_assoc]
  _ = _ := by
    simp_rw [mul_sum]
    congr! 2 with k hk
    obtain ⟨hk₀, hk⟩ := mem_Ioo.1 hk
    
    rw [Nat.cast_comm, mul_assoc (_ * _)]
    norm_cast
    rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel (hp.dvd_choose_pow _ _)] <;> lia

name: add_pow_prime_pow_eq
statement:
protected lemma add_pow_prime_pow_eq (h : Commute x y) (n : ℕ) :
    (x + y) ^ p ^ n =
      x ^ p ^ n + y ^ p ^ n +
        p * x * y *
          ∑ k ∈ Ioo 0 (p ^ n), x ^ (k - 1) * y ^ (p ^ n - k - 1) * ↑((p ^ n).choose k / p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.add_pow_prime_pow_eq' hp, mul_assoc _ x, mul_assoc, mul_sum _ _ (_ * _)]
  congr! 3 with k hk
  obtain ⟨hk₀, hk⟩ := mem_Ioo.1 hk
  rw [← mul_pow_sub_one (by lia), ← mul_pow_sub_one (n := p ^ n - k) (by lia)]
  rw [(h.pow_left _).mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_assoc (x * y)]

statement:
theorem charP_zero_or_prime_power (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (q : ℕ)
    [char_R_q : CharP R q] : q = 0 ∨ IsPrimePow q
proof:
:= by
  
  apply or_iff_not_imp_left.2
  intro q_pos
  let K := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  have RM_char := ringChar.charP K
  let r := ringChar K
  let n := q.factorization r
  
  rcases CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero K r with r_prime | r_zero
  · let a := q / r ^ n
    
    have q_eq_a_mul_rn : q = r ^ n * a := by rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.ordProj_dvd q r)]
    have r_ne_dvd_a := Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl r_prime q_pos
    have rn_dvd_q : r ^ n ∣ q := ⟨a, q_eq_a_mul_rn⟩
    rw [mul_comm] at q_eq_a_mul_rn
    
    have a_unit : IsUnit (a : R) := by
      by_contra g
      rw [← mem_nonunits_iff] at g
      rw [← IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal] at g
      have a_cast_zero := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 g
      rw [map_natCast] at a_cast_zero
      have r_dvd_a := (ringChar.spec K a).1 a_cast_zero
      exact absurd r_dvd_a r_ne_dvd_a
    have rn_cast_zero : ↑(r ^ n) = (0 : R) := by
      rw [← one_mul (↑(r ^ n) : R), ← a_unit.val_inv_mul, mul_assoc, ← Nat.cast_mul,
        ← q_eq_a_mul_rn, CharP.cast_eq_zero R q, mul_zero]
    have q_eq_rn := Nat.dvd_antisymm ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R q (r ^ n)).mp rn_cast_zero) rn_dvd_q
    have n_pos : n ≠ 0 := fun n_zero =>
      absurd (by simpa [n_zero] using q_eq_rn) (CharP.char_ne_one R q)
    
    exact ⟨r, ⟨n, ⟨r_prime.prime, ⟨pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr n_pos, q_eq_rn.symm⟩⟩⟩⟩
  · have K_char_p_0 := ringChar.of_eq r_zero
    have K_char_zero : CharZero K := CharP.charP_to_charZero K
    have R_char_zero := RingHom.charZero (IsLocalRing.residue R)
    
    have q_zero := CharP.eq R char_R_q (CharP.ofCharZero R)
    exact absurd q_zero q_pos

name: reduce_to_p_prime
statement:
lemma reduce_to_p_prime {P : Prop} :
    (∀ p > 0, MixedCharZero R p → P) ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → MixedCharZero R p → P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h q q_prime q_mixedChar
    exact h q (Nat.Prime.pos q_prime) q_mixedChar
  · intro h q q_pos q_mixedChar
    rcases q_mixedChar.charP_quotient with ⟨I, hI_ne_top, _⟩
    
    rcases Ideal.exists_le_maximal I hI_ne_top with ⟨M, hM_max, h_IM⟩
    let r := ringChar (R ⧸ M)
    have r_pos : r ≠ 0 := by
      have q_zero :=
        congr_arg (Ideal.Quotient.factor h_IM) (CharP.cast_eq_zero (R ⧸ I) q)
      simp only [map_natCast, map_zero] at q_zero
      apply ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero (ne_of_gt q_pos)
      exact (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (R ⧸ M) r q).mp q_zero
    have r_prime : Nat.Prime r :=
      or_iff_not_imp_right.1 (CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero (R ⧸ M) r) r_pos
    apply h r r_prime
    have : CharZero R := q_mixedChar.toCharZero
    exact ⟨⟨M, hM_max.ne_top, ringChar.of_eq rfl⟩⟩

name: reduce_to_maximal_ideal
statement:
lemma reduce_to_maximal_ideal {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    (∃ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ ∧ CharP (R ⧸ I) p) ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, I.IsMaximal ∧ CharP (R ⧸ I) p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro g
    rcases g with ⟨I, ⟨hI_not_top, _⟩⟩
    
    rcases Ideal.exists_le_maximal I hI_not_top with ⟨M, ⟨hM_max, hM_ge⟩⟩
    use M
    constructor
    · exact hM_max
    · cases CharP.exists (R ⧸ M) with
      | intro r hr =>
        convert! hr
        have r_dvd_p : r ∣ p := by
          rw [← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (R ⧸ M) r p]
          convert! congr_arg (Ideal.Quotient.factor hM_ge) (CharP.cast_eq_zero (R ⧸ I) p)
        symm
        apply (Nat.Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd hp r r_dvd_p).resolve_left
        exact CharP.char_ne_one (R ⧸ M) r
  · intro ⟨I, hI_max, h_charP⟩
    use I
    exact ⟨Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top hI_max, h_charP⟩

name: of_algebraRat
statement: private lemma of_algebraRat [Algebra ℚ R] : ∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  intro I hI
  constructor
  intro a b h_ab
  contrapose! hI
  
  refine I.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem ?_ (IsUnit.map (algebraMap ℚ R) (IsUnit.mk0 (a - b : ℚ) ?_))
  · simpa only [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, map_natCast]
  simpa only [Ne, sub_eq_zero] using (@Nat.cast_injective ℚ _ _).ne hI

name: PNat.isUnit_natCast
statement:
private lemma PNat.isUnit_natCast [h : Fact (∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero (R ⧸ I))]
    (n : ℕ+) : IsUnit (n : R)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
  
  apply not_imp_comm.mp (h.elim (Ideal.span {↑n}))
  intro h_char_zero
  
  apply h_char_zero.cast_injective.ne n.ne_zero
  
  rw [← map_natCast (Ideal.Quotient.mk _), Nat.cast_zero, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: pnatCast_one
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.val_one]
  change ((PNat.isUnit_natCast (R := R) 1).unit : R) = 1
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec (PNat.isUnit_natCast 1)]
  rw [PNat.one_coe, Nat.cast_one]

name: pnatCast_eq_natCast
proof:
:= by
  change ((PNat.isUnit_natCast (R := R) n).unit : R) = ↑n
  simp only [IsUnit.unit_spec]

name: of_not_mixedCharZero
statement:
private lemma of_not_mixedCharZero [CharZero R] (h : ∀ p > 0, ¬MixedCharZero R p) :
    ∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  intro I hI_ne_top
  suffices CharP (R ⧸ I) 0 from CharP.charP_to_charZero _
  cases CharP.exists (R ⧸ I) with
  | intro p hp =>
    cases p with
    | zero => exact hp
    | succ p =>
      have h_mixed : MixedCharZero R p.succ := ⟨⟨I, ⟨hI_ne_top, hp⟩⟩⟩
      exact absurd h_mixed (h p.succ p.succ_pos)

name: to_not_mixedCharZero
statement:
private lemma to_not_mixedCharZero (h : ∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero (R ⧸ I)) :
    ∀ p > 0, ¬MixedCharZero R p
proof:
:= by
  intro p p_pos
  by_contra hp_mixedChar
  rcases hp_mixedChar.charP_quotient with ⟨I, hI_ne_top, hI_p⟩
  replace hI_zero : CharP (R ⧸ I) 0 := @CharP.ofCharZero _ _ (h I hI_ne_top)
  exact absurd (CharP.eq (R ⧸ I) hI_p hI_zero) (ne_of_gt p_pos)

statement:
theorem iff_not_mixedCharZero [CharZero R] :
    (∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero (R ⧸ I)) ↔ ∀ p > 0, ¬MixedCharZero R p

name: nonempty_algebraRat_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_algebraRat_iff :
    Nonempty (Algebra ℚ R) ↔ ∀ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h_alg
    have h_alg' : Algebra ℚ R := h_alg.some
    apply of_algebraRat
  · intro h
    apply Nonempty.intro
    exact algebraRat h

name: isEmpty_algebraRat_iff_mixedCharZero
statement:
lemma isEmpty_algebraRat_iff_mixedCharZero [CharZero R] :
    IsEmpty (Algebra ℚ R) ↔ ∃ p > 0, MixedCharZero R p
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  rw [← EqualCharZero.iff_not_mixedCharZero]
  apply EqualCharZero.nonempty_algebraRat_iff

name: split_equalCharZero_mixedCharZero
statement:
theorem split_equalCharZero_mixedCharZero [CharZero R] (h_equal : Algebra ℚ R → P)
    (h_mixed : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → MixedCharZero R p → P) : P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ p > 0, MixedCharZero R p
  · rcases h with ⟨p, ⟨H, hp⟩⟩
    rw [← MixedCharZero.reduce_to_p_prime] at h_mixed
    exact h_mixed p H hp
  · apply h_equal
    rw [← isEmpty_algebraRat_iff_mixedCharZero, not_isEmpty_iff] at h
    exact h.some

name: split_by_characteristic
statement:
theorem split_by_characteristic (h_pos : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≠ 0 → CharP R p → P)
    (h_equal : Algebra ℚ R → P)
    (h_mixed : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → MixedCharZero R p → P) : P
proof:
:= by
  cases CharP.exists R with
  | intro p p_charP =>
    by_cases h : p = 0
    · rw [h] at p_charP
      have h0 : CharZero R := CharP.charP_to_charZero R
      exact split_equalCharZero_mixedCharZero R h_equal h_mixed
    · exact h_pos p h p_charP

name: split_by_characteristic_domain
statement:
theorem split_by_characteristic_domain [IsDomain R]
    (h_pos : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → CharP R p → P)
    (h_equal : Algebra ℚ R → P) (h_mixed : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → MixedCharZero R p → P) : P
proof:
:= by
  refine split_by_characteristic R ?_ h_equal h_mixed
  intro p p_pos p_char
  have p_prime : Nat.Prime p := or_iff_not_imp_right.mp (CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero R p) p_pos
  exact h_pos p p_prime p_char

name: split_by_characteristic_localRing
statement:
theorem split_by_characteristic_localRing [IsLocalRing R]
    (h_pos : ∀ p : ℕ, IsPrimePow p → CharP R p → P) (h_equal : Algebra ℚ R → P)
    (h_mixed : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → MixedCharZero R p → P) : P
proof:
:= by
  refine split_by_characteristic R ?_ h_equal h_mixed
  intro p p_pos p_char
  have p_ppow : IsPrimePow (p : ℕ) := or_iff_not_imp_left.mp (charP_zero_or_prime_power R p) p_pos
  exact h_pos p p_ppow p_char

name: CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff
statement:
theorem CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff {n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : IsUnit (n : R) ↔ ¬p ∣ n where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    have := CharP.nontrivial_of_char_ne_one (R := R) hp.ne_one
    rw [← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (R := R)]
    exact h.ne_zero
  mpr not_dvd :=
    letI := invertibleOfCoprime (R := R) (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 not_dvd).symm
    isUnit_of_invertible _

  · simp [CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff hp, Int.ofNat_dvd]

  · exact (this R p h.symm (le_of_not_ge hle)).symm
  rw [Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hle] at h

    {p q : ℕ} [CharP R p] (hq : q.Prime) (hneq : p ≠ q) : (q : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [cast_eq_zero_iff R p q] at h
  rcases hq.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd _ h with rfl | h
  · exact false_of_nontrivial_of_char_one (R := R)
  · exact hneq h

name: Ring.two_ne_zero
statement:
protected lemma Ring.two_ne_zero {R : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring R] [Nontrivial R]
    (hR : ringChar R ≠ 2) : (2 : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, (by norm_cast : (2 : R) = (2 : ℕ)), ringChar.spec, Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_two]
  exact mt (or_iff_left hR).mp CharP.ringChar_ne_one

name: Ring.neg_one_ne_one_of_char_ne_two
statement:
lemma Ring.neg_one_ne_one_of_char_ne_two {R : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (hR : ringChar R ≠ 2) : (-1 : R) ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun h =>
  Ring.two_ne_zero hR (one_add_one_eq_two (R := R) ▸ neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero.mp h)

name: Ring.eq_self_iff_eq_zero_of_char_ne_two
statement:
lemma Ring.eq_self_iff_eq_zero_of_char_ne_two {R : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    [NoZeroDivisors R] (hR : ringChar R ≠ 2) {a : R} : -a = a ↔ a = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    (mul_eq_zero.mp <| (two_mul a).trans <| neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left
      (Ring.two_ne_zero hR),
    fun h => ((congr_arg (fun x => -x) h).trans neg_zero).trans h.symm⟩

name: Int.cast_injOn_of_ringChar_ne_two
statement:
lemma Int.cast_injOn_of_ringChar_ne_two {R : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (hR : ringChar R ≠ 2) : ({0, 1, -1} : Set ℤ).InjOn ((↑) : ℤ → R)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ (rfl | rfl | rfl) _ (rfl | rfl | rfl) h <;>
  simp only
    [cast_neg, cast_one, cast_zero, neg_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, zero_ne_one, zero_eq_neg] at h ⊢
  · exact ((Ring.neg_one_ne_one_of_char_ne_two hR).symm h).elim
  · exact ((Ring.neg_one_ne_one_of_char_ne_two hR) h).elim

name: charZero_iff_forall_prime_ne_zero
statement:
lemma charZero_iff_forall_prime_ne_zero [NonAssocRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] :
    CharZero R ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h p hp => by simp [hp.ne_zero], fun h => ?_⟩
  let p := ringChar R
  cases CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero R p with
  | inl hp => simpa using h p hp
  | inr h => have : CharP R 0 := h ▸ inferInstance; exact CharP.charP_to_charZero R

name: quotient
statement:
theorem quotient (p : ℕ) [hp1 : Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : ↑p ∈ nonunits R) :
    CharP (R ⧸ (Ideal.span ({(p : R)} : Set R) : Ideal R)) p
proof:
:=
  have hp0 : (p : R ⧸ (Ideal.span {(p : R)} : Ideal R)) = 0 :=
    map_natCast (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(p : R)} : Ideal R)) p ▸
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (Ideal.subset_span <| Set.mem_singleton _)
  ringChar.of_eq <|
    Or.resolve_left ((Nat.dvd_prime hp1.1).1 <| ringChar.dvd hp0) fun h1 =>
      hp2 <|
        isUnit_iff_dvd_one.2 <|
          Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 <|
            Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 <|
              @Subsingleton.elim _ (@CharOne.subsingleton _ _ (ringChar.of_eq h1)) _ _

name: quotient'
statement:
theorem quotient' (p : ℕ) [CharP R p] (I : Ideal R) (h : ∀ x : ℕ, (x : R) ∈ I → (x : R) = 0) :
    CharP (R ⧸ I) p where
  cast_eq_zero_iff x
proof:
:= by
    rw [← cast_eq_zero_iff R p x, ← map_natCast (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)]
    refine Ideal.Quotient.eq.trans (?_ : ↑x - 0 ∈ I ↔ _)
    rw [sub_zero]
    exact ⟨h x, fun h' => h'.symm ▸ I.zero_mem⟩

name: quotient_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_iff (n : ℕ) [CharP R n] (I : Ideal R) :
    CharP (R ⧸ I) n ↔ ∀ x : ℕ, ↑x ∈ I → (x : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ x hx => ?_, CharP.quotient' n I⟩
  rw [CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R n, ← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (R ⧸ I) n _]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero I).mpr hx

name: cast_eq_mod
statement: lemma cast_eq_mod (k : ℕ) : (k : R) = (k % p : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  have (a : ℕ) : ((p * a : ℕ) : R) = 0 := by
    rw [CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p]
    exact Nat.dvd_mul_right p a
  calc
    (k : R) = ↑(k % p + p * (k / p)) := by rw [Nat.mod_add_div]
    _ = ↑(k % p) := by simp [this]

name: cast_eq_iff_mod_eq
statement: lemma cast_eq_iff_mod_eq [IsLeftCancelAdd R] : (a : R) = (b : R) ↔ a % p = b % p
proof:
:= by
  wlog! hle : a ≤ b
  · simpa only [eq_comm] using (this _ _ hle.le)
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
  rw [Nat.cast_add, left_eq_add, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p]
  constructor
  · simp +contextual [Nat.add_mod, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
  intro h
  have := Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h.symm
  simpa [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] using this

name: eq
statement: lemma eq {p q : ℕ} (hp : CharP R p) (hq : CharP R q) : p = q

name: intCast_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma intCast_eq_zero_iff (a : ℤ) : (a : R) = 0 ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with (h | rfl | h)
  · rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← Int.cast_neg, ← Int.dvd_neg]
    lift -a to ℕ using Int.neg_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt h) with b
    rw [Int.cast_natCast, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]
  · simp
  · lift a to ℕ using le_of_lt h with b
    rw [Int.cast_natCast, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]

lemma CharP.neg_one_ne_one [AddGroupWithOne R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p] [Fact (2 < p)] :

proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_comm, ← sub_ne_zero, sub_neg_eq_add, one_add_one_eq_two, ← Nat.cast_two, Ne,
    CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p 2]

proof:

  absurd this one_ne_zero

name: char_is_prime_of_two_le
statement: lemma char_is_prime_of_two_le (p : ℕ) [CharP R p] (hp : 2 ≤ p) : Nat.Prime p
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ (d) (_ : d ∣ p), d = 1 ∨ d = p from Nat.prime_def.mpr ⟨hp, this⟩
  fun (d : ℕ) (hdvd : ∃ e, p = d * e) =>
  let ⟨e, hmul⟩ := hdvd
  have : (p : R) = 0 := (cast_eq_zero_iff R p p).mpr (dvd_refl p)
  have : (d : R) * e = 0 := @Nat.cast_mul R _ d e ▸ hmul ▸ this
  Or.elim (eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero this)
    (fun hd : (d : R) = 0 =>
      have : p ∣ d := (cast_eq_zero_iff R p d).mp hd
      show d = 1 ∨ d = p from Or.inr (this.antisymm' ⟨e, hmul⟩))
    fun he : (e : R) = 0 =>
    have : p ∣ e := (cast_eq_zero_iff R p e).mp he
    have : e ∣ p := dvd_of_mul_left_eq d (Eq.symm hmul)
    have : e = p := ‹e ∣ p›.antisymm ‹p ∣ e›
    have h₀ : 0 < p := by grind
    have : d * p = 1 * p := by grind
    show d = 1 ∨ d = p from Or.inl (mul_right_cancel₀ h₀.ne' this)

name: char_is_prime_or_zero
statement: lemma char_is_prime_or_zero (p : ℕ) [hc : CharP R p] : Nat.Prime p ∨ p = 0
proof:
:=
  match p, hc with
  | 0, _ => Or.inr rfl
  | 1, hc => absurd (Eq.refl (1 : ℕ)) (@char_ne_one R _ _ (1 : ℕ) hc)
  | m + 2, hc => Or.inl (@char_is_prime_of_two_le R _ _ (m + 2) hc (Nat.le_add_left 2 m))

lemma exists' (R : Type*) [NonAssocRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] :
    CharZero R ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, Fact p.Prime ∧ CharP R p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hchar⟩ := CharP.exists R
  rcases char_is_prime_or_zero R p with h | rfl
  exacts [Or.inr ⟨p, Fact.mk h, hchar⟩, Or.inl (charP_to_charZero R)]

name: CharOne.subsingleton
statement: lemma CharOne.subsingleton [CharP R 1] : Subsingleton R
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.intro <|
    suffices ∀ r : R, r = 0 from fun a b => show a = b by rw [this a, this b]
    fun r =>
    calc
      r = 1 * r := by rw [one_mul]
      _ = (1 : ℕ) * r := by rw [Nat.cast_one]
      _ = 0 * r := by rw [CharP.cast_eq_zero]
      _ = 0 := by rw [zero_mul]

  · rcases hq with hq | hq'
    exacts [rfl, False.elim (Nat.not_prime_zero (CharP.eq R ‹_› (CharP.ofCharZero R) ▸ hq'))]
  · rcases hq with hq | hq'
    exacts [False.elim (Nat.not_prime_zero (CharP.eq R ‹_› (CharP.ofCharZero R) ▸ hp')),
      CharP.eq R ‹_› ‹_›]

name: CharP.dvd_of_ringHom
statement:
theorem CharP.dvd_of_ringHom [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring A]
    (f : R →+* A) (p q : ℕ) [CharP R p] [CharP A q] : q ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  refine (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A q p).mp ?_
  rw [← map_natCast f p, CharP.cast_eq_zero, map_zero]

name: CharP.of_ringHom_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem CharP.of_ringHom_of_ne_zero [NonAssocSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    [NonAssocSemiring A] [Nontrivial A]
    (f : R →+* A) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) [CharP R p] : CharP A p
proof:
:= by
  have := f.domain_nontrivial
  have H := (CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero R p).resolve_right hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := CharP.exists A
  obtain ⟨k, e⟩ := dvd_of_ringHom f p q
  have := Nat.isUnit_iff.mp ((H.2 e).resolve_left (Nat.isUnit_iff.not.mpr (char_ne_one A q)))
  rw [this, mul_one] at e
  exact e ▸ hq

proof:
:= by

protected theorem RingHom.charP_iff [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring A]

    (q : ℕ) [hR : ExpChar R q] : ExpChar A q
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR with _ | hprime
  · have := charZero_of_injective_ringHom h; exact .zero

statement:
lemma RingHom.expChar [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring A] (f : R →+* A)

proof:
:= by
  cases ‹ExpChar A p› with
  | zero => have := f.charZero; exact .zero
  | prime hp => have := f.charP H p; exact .prime hp

name: RingHom.expChar_iff
statement:
lemma RingHom.expChar_iff [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring A] (f : R →+* A)
    (H : Function.Injective f) (p : ℕ) : ExpChar R p ↔ ExpChar A p
proof:

name: charP_end
statement:
theorem charP_end {p : ℕ} [hchar : CharP R p]
    (htorsion : ∃ x : M, Ideal.torsionOf R M x = ⊥) : CharP (M →ₗ[R] M) p where
  cast_eq_zero_iff n
proof:
:= by
    have exact : (n : M →ₗ[R] M) = (n : R) • 1 := by
      simp only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [exact, LinearMap.ext_iff, ← hchar.1]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ htorsion.casesOn fun x hx ↦ by simpa [← Ideal.mem_torsionOf_iff, hx] using h x,
      fun h ↦ (congrArg (fun t ↦ ∀ x, t • x = 0) h).mpr fun x ↦ zero_smul R x⟩

name: isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char_of_ringChar_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char_of_ringChar_ne_zero (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hR : ringChar R ≠ 0) : IsUnit (p : R) ↔ ¬p ∣ ringChar R
proof:
:= by
  have hch := CharP.cast_eq_zero R (ringChar R)
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  constructor
  · rintro h₁ ⟨q, hq⟩
    rcases IsUnit.exists_left_inv h₁ with ⟨a, ha⟩
    have h₃ : ¬ringChar R ∣ q := by
      rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
      rw [hr, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm p, mul_assoc] at hq
      nth_rw 1 [← mul_one (ringChar R)] at hq
      exact Nat.Prime.not_dvd_one hp ⟨r, mul_left_cancel₀ hR hq⟩
    simp_all only [ne_eq]
    grind [ringChar.dvd]
  · intro h
    rcases (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr h).isCoprime with ⟨a, b, hab⟩
    apply_fun ((↑) : ℤ → R) at hab
    push_cast at hab
    rw [hch, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_comm] at hab
    exact .of_mul_eq_one a hab

name: prime_dvd_char_iff_dvd_card
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_char_iff_dvd_card {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype R] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    p ∣ ringChar R ↔ p ∣ Fintype.card R
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h =>
      h.trans <|
        Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp <|
          (CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff R (ringChar R) (Fintype.card R)).mp <|
            mod_cast Nat.cast_card_eq_zero R,
      fun h => ?_⟩
  by_contra h₀
  rcases exists_prime_addOrderOf_dvd_card p h with ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hr₁ := addOrderOf_nsmul_eq_zero r
  rw [hr, nsmul_eq_mul] at hr₁
  rcases IsUnit.exists_left_inv ((isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char R p).mpr h₀) with ⟨u, hu⟩
  apply_fun (· * ·) u at hr₁
  rw [mul_zero, ← mul_assoc, hu, one_mul] at hr₁
  exact mt AddMonoid.addOrderOf_eq_one_iff.mpr (ne_of_eq_of_ne hr (Nat.Prime.ne_one Fact.out)) hr₁

name: not_isUnit_prime_of_dvd_card

    (hp : p ∣ Fintype.card R) : ¬IsUnit (p : R)

statement:
lemma charP_of_card_eq_prime {R : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [Fintype R] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (hR : Fintype.card R = p) : CharP R p
proof:
:=
  have := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.1 (hR ▸ hp.1.one_lt)
  (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero hp.1).2 (hR ▸ Nat.cast_card_eq_zero R)

name: charP_of_card_eq_prime_pow
statement:
lemma charP_of_card_eq_prime_pow {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Fintype R] {p f : ℕ}
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hR : Fintype.card R = p ^ f) : CharP R p
proof:
:=
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ not_subsingleton R <|
    Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mp <| by simpa [h0] using hR.le
  (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero hp.out).mpr
    (by simpa [hf, hR] using Nat.cast_card_eq_zero R)

      (((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr ⟨frobenius_inj R 2, rfl⟩).surjective a)

name: ExpChar.pow_prime_pow_mul_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ExpChar.pow_prime_pow_mul_eq_one_iff (p k m : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] (x : R) :

proof:
:= by

  convert! ← (iterateFrobenius_inj R p k).eq_iff
  apply map_one

name: Function.Injective.noZeroSMulDivisors
statement:
theorem Function.Injective.noZeroSMulDivisors {R M N : Type*} [Zero R] [Zero M] [Zero N]
    [SMul R M] [SMul R N] [NoZeroSMulDivisors R N] (f : M → N) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h0 : f 0 = 0) (hs : ∀ (c : R) (x : M), f (c • x) = c • f x) : NoZeroSMulDivisors R M
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun {_ _} h =>
    Or.imp_right (@hf _ _) <| h0.symm ▸ eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_smul_eq_zero (by rw [← hs, h, h0])⟩

name: noZeroSMulDivisors_iff_right_eq_zero_of_smul
statement:
theorem noZeroSMulDivisors_iff_right_eq_zero_of_smul [Zero R] [Zero M] [SMul R M] :
    NoZeroSMulDivisors R M ↔ ∀ r : R, r ≠ 0 → ∀ m : M, r • m = 0 → m = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [noZeroSMulDivisors_iff, or_iff_not_imp_left]
  exact ⟨fun h r hr m eq ↦ h eq hr, fun h r m eq hr ↦ h r hr m eq⟩

statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mem_stabilizer_set {s : Set α} : a ∈ stabilizer G s ↔ ∀ b, a • b ∈ s ↔ b ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_stabilizer_iff.trans ⟨fun h b ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← (smul_mem_smul_set_iff : a • b ∈ _ ↔ _), h]
  simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]

statement:

lemma map_stabilizer_le (f : G →* H) (s : Set G) :

proof:
:= by
  rintro a
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_map, mem_stabilizer_iff, forall_exists_index, and_imp]

name: stabilizer_mul_self

proof:

  ext
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ⟨_, (stabilizer G s).one_mem, _, h, one_mul _⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  rw [← mem_stabilizer_iff.1 ha]

name: stabilizer_union_eq_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma stabilizer_union_eq_left (hdisj : Disjoint s t) (hstab : stabilizer G s ≤ stabilizer G t)
    (hstab_union : stabilizer G (s ∪ t) ≤ stabilizer G t) :
    stabilizer G (s ∪ t) = stabilizer G s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · calc
      stabilizer G (s ∪ t)
        ≤ stabilizer G (s ∪ t) ⊓ stabilizer G t := by simpa
      _ ≤ stabilizer G ((s ∪ t) \ t) := stabilizer_inf_stabilizer_le_stabilizer_sdiff
      _ = stabilizer G s := by rw [union_sdiff_cancel_right]; simpa [← disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  · calc
      stabilizer G s
        ≤ stabilizer G s ⊓ stabilizer G t := by simpa
      _ ≤ stabilizer G (s ∪ t) := stabilizer_inf_stabilizer_le_stabilizer_union

name: stabilizer_union_eq_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma stabilizer_union_eq_right (hdisj : Disjoint s t) (hstab : stabilizer G t ≤ stabilizer G s)
    (hstab_union : stabilizer G (s ∪ t) ≤ stabilizer G s) :
    stabilizer G (s ∪ t) = stabilizer G t
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_comm, stabilizer_union_eq_left hdisj.symm hstab (union_comm .. ▸ hstab_union)]

name: stabilizer_subgroup

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma stabilizer_subgroup (s : Subgroup G) : stabilizer G (s : Set G) = s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [SetLike.ext_iff, mem_stabilizer_set]
  refine fun a ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ha b ↦ s.mul_mem_cancel_left ha⟩
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, SetLike.mem_coe, mul_one] using (h 1).2 s.one_mem

proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [SetLike.ext_iff, mem_stabilizer_set]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul_unop, SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.mem_op, «forall», unop_op]
  refine fun a ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ha b ↦ s.mul_mem_cancel_right ha⟩
  simpa only [op_smul_eq_mul, SetLike.mem_coe, one_mul] using (h 1).2 s.one_mem

name: stabilizer_subgroup_op

lemma stabilizer_subgroup_op (s : Subgroup Gᵐᵒᵖ) : stabilizer G (s : Set Gᵐᵒᵖ) = s.unop
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [SetLike.ext_iff, mem_stabilizer_set]
  refine fun a ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ha b ↦ s.mul_mem_cancel_right ha⟩
  have : 1 * MulOpposite.op a ∈ s := (h 1).2 s.one_mem
  simpa only [op_smul_eq_mul, SetLike.mem_coe, one_mul] using! this

name: stabilizer_image_coe_quotient

@[to_additive]
lemma stabilizer_image_coe_quotient : stabilizer Q (q '' s) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  induction a using QuotientGroup.induction_on with | _ a
  simp only [mem_stabilizer_iff, Subgroup.mem_bot, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
  have : q a • q '' s = q '' (a • s) :=
    (image_smul_distrib (QuotientGroup.mk' <| stabilizer G s) _ _).symm
  rw [this]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h]⟩
  rwa [QuotientGroup.image_coe_inj, mul_smul_comm, stabilizer_mul_self] at h

name: X_dvd_iff
statement: theorem X_dvd_iff {f : R[X]} : X ∣ f ↔ f.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨g, hfg⟩ => by rw [hfg, coeff_X_mul_zero], fun hf =>
    ⟨f.divX, by rw [← add_zero (X * f.divX), ← C_0, ← hf, X_mul_divX_add]⟩⟩

name: X_pow_dvd_iff
statement: theorem X_pow_dvd_iff {f : R[X]} {n : ℕ} : X ^ n ∣ f ↔ ∀ d < n, f.coeff d = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨g, hgf⟩ d hd => by
    simp only [hgf, coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right_iff, not_le_of_gt hd, IsEmpty.forall_iff],
    fun hd => by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [pow_zero]
    | succ n hn =>
      obtain ⟨g, hgf⟩ := hn fun d : ℕ => fun H : d < n => hd _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt H)
      have := coeff_X_pow_mul g n 0
      rw [zero_add, ← hgf, hd n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)] at this
      obtain ⟨k, hgk⟩ := Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mpr this.symm
      use k
      rwa [pow_succ, mul_assoc, ← hgk]⟩

name: finiteMultiplicity_of_degree_pos_of_monic
statement:
theorem finiteMultiplicity_of_degree_pos_of_monic (hp : (0 : WithBot ℕ) < degree p) (hmp : Monic p)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) : FiniteMultiplicity p q
proof:
:=
  have zn0 : (0 : R) ≠ 1 :=
    haveI := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hq
    zero_ne_one
  ⟨natDegree q, fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => by
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := fun hp0 => by simp [hp0] at hp
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := fun hr0 => by subst hr0; simp [hq] at hr
    have hpn1 : leadingCoeff p ^ (natDegree q + 1) = 1 := by simp [show _ = _ from hmp]
    have hpn0' : leadingCoeff p ^ (natDegree q + 1) ≠ 0 := hpn1.symm ▸ zn0.symm
    have hpnr0 : leadingCoeff (p ^ (natDegree q + 1)) * leadingCoeff r ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [leadingCoeff_pow' hpn0', leadingCoeff_eq_zero, hpn1, one_mul, Ne,
          hr0, not_false_eq_true]
    have hnp : 0 < natDegree p := Nat.cast_lt.1 <| by
      rw [← degree_eq_natDegree hp0]; exact hp
    have := congr_arg natDegree hr
    rw [natDegree_mul' hpnr0, natDegree_pow' hpn0', add_mul, add_assoc] at this
    exact
      ne_of_lt
        (lt_add_of_le_of_pos (le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) hnp)
          (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (by rwa [one_mul]) (Nat.zero_le _)))
        this⟩

name: eq_mul_leadingCoeff_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hdvd
  obtain rfl | hr := eq_or_ne r 0
  · simp
  have : r.natDegree = 0 := by simpa [hp.natDegree_mul' hr] using hdeg
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero this]
  simp [leadingCoeff_monic_mul hp]

name: eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le {p q : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic)
    (hq : q.Monic) (hdvd : p ∣ q) (hdeg : q.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree) : q = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_mul_leadingCoeff_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hp hdvd hdeg]
  simp [hq]

name: div_wf_lemma
statement:
theorem div_wf_lemma (h : degree q ≤ degree p ∧ p ≠ 0) (hq : Monic q) :
    degree (p - q * (C (leadingCoeff p) * X ^ (natDegree p - natDegree q))) < degree p
proof:
:=
  have hp : leadingCoeff p ≠ 0 := mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.1 h.2
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := hq.ne_zero_of_polynomial_ne h.2
  have hlt : natDegree q ≤ natDegree p :=
    (Nat.cast_le (α := WithBot ℕ)).1
      (by rw [← degree_eq_natDegree h.2, ← degree_eq_natDegree hq0]; exact h.1)
  degree_sub_lt_left
    (by
      rw [hq.degree_mul_comm, hq.degree_mul, degree_C_mul_X_pow _ hp, degree_eq_natDegree h.2,
        degree_eq_natDegree hq0, ← Nat.cast_add, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hlt])
    h.2 (by rw [leadingCoeff_monic_mul hq, leadingCoeff_mul_X_pow, leadingCoeff_C])

name: degree_modByMonic_lt
statement:
theorem degree_modByMonic_lt [Nontrivial R] :
    ∀ (p : R[X]) {q : R[X]} (_hq : Monic q), degree (p %ₘ q) < degree q
  | p, q, hq =>
    letI
proof:
:= Classical.decEq R
    if h : degree q ≤ degree p ∧ p ≠ 0 then by
      have _wf := div_wf_lemma ⟨h.1, h.2⟩ hq
      have :=
        degree_modByMonic_lt (p - q * (C (leadingCoeff p) * X ^ (natDegree p - natDegree q))) hq
      grind [divModByMonicAux, modByMonic]
    else
      Or.casesOn (not_and_or.1 h)
        (by
          unfold modByMonic divModByMonicAux
          dsimp
          rw [dite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_right h]
          exact lt_of_not_ge)
        (by
          intro hp
          unfold modByMonic divModByMonicAux
          dsimp
          rw [dite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_right h, Classical.not_not.1 hp]
          exact lt_of_le_of_ne bot_le (Ne.symm (mt degree_eq_bot.1 hq.ne_zero)))
  termination_by p => p

name: natDegree_modByMonic_lt
statement:
theorem natDegree_modByMonic_lt (p : R[X]) {q : R[X]} (hmq : Monic q) (hq : q ≠ 1) :
    natDegree (p %ₘ q) < q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p %ₘ q = 0
  · rw [hpq, natDegree_zero, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    contrapose hq
    exact eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero hmq hq
  · have := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hpq
    exact natDegree_lt_natDegree hpq (degree_modByMonic_lt p hmq)

theorem modByMonic_zero (p : R[X]) : p %ₘ 0 = p
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if h : Monic (0 : R[X]) then by
    have := monic_zero_iff_subsingleton.mp h
    simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]
  else by unfold modByMonic divModByMonicAux; rw [dite_eq_right h]

statement: theorem divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic (p : R[X]) (hq : ¬Monic q) : p /ₘ q = 0

name: modByMonic_eq_self_iff
statement: theorem modByMonic_eq_self_iff [Nontrivial R] (hq : Monic q) : p %ₘ q = p ↔ degree p < degree q
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq, fun h => by
    have : ¬degree q ≤ degree p := not_le_of_gt h
    unfold modByMonic divModByMonicAux; dsimp
    rw [dite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_right (mt And.left this)]⟩

name: degree_modByMonic_le_left
statement: theorem degree_modByMonic_le_left : degree (p %ₘ q) ≤ degree p
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  by_cases hq : q.Monic
  · cases lt_or_ge (degree p) (degree q)
    · rw [(modByMonic_eq_self_iff hq).mpr ‹_›]
    · exact (degree_modByMonic_le p hq).trans ‹_›
  · rw [modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic p hq]

name: modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div
statement:
theorem modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div :
    ∀ p q : R[X], p %ₘ q = p - q * (p /ₘ q)
  | p, q =>
    letI
proof:
:= Classical.decEq R
    if hq : q.Monic then
      if h : degree q ≤ degree p ∧ p ≠ 0 then by
        have _wf := div_wf_lemma h hq
        have ih := modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div
          (p - q * (C (leadingCoeff p) * X ^ (natDegree p - natDegree q))) q
        unfold modByMonic divByMonic divModByMonicAux
        rw [dite_eq_left hq, dite_eq_left h]
        rw [modByMonic, dite_eq_left hq] at ih
        refine ih.trans ?_
        rw [divByMonic, dite_eq_left hq, dite_eq_left hq, dite_eq_left h, mul_add,
          sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
      else by
        unfold modByMonic divByMonic divModByMonicAux
        dsimp
        rw [dite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_right h, dite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_right h, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    else by
      rw [modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq, divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  termination_by p => p

name: modByMonic_add_div
statement: theorem modByMonic_add_div (p q : R[X]) : p %ₘ q + q * (p /ₘ q) = p

name: dvd_modByMonic_sub
statement: theorem dvd_modByMonic_sub (p q : R[X]) : q ∣ (p %ₘ q - p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : q.Monic
  · simp [modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div]
  · simp [modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic, h]

name: dvd_modByMonic_iff_dvd
statement: @[simp] theorem dvd_modByMonic_iff_dvd : q ∣ p %ₘ q ↔ q ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  simpa using dvd_iff_dvd_of_dvd_sub <| dvd_modByMonic_sub p q

name: divByMonic_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem divByMonic_eq_zero_iff [Nontrivial R] (hq : Monic q) : p /ₘ q = 0 ↔ degree p < degree q
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    have := modByMonic_add_div p q
    rwa [h, mul_zero, add_zero, modByMonic_eq_self_iff hq] at this,
  fun h => by
    have : ¬degree q ≤ degree p := not_le_of_gt h
    unfold divByMonic divModByMonicAux; dsimp
    rw [dite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_right (mt And.left this)]⟩

name: degree_add_divByMonic
statement:
theorem degree_add_divByMonic (hq : Monic q) (h : degree q ≤ degree p) :
    degree q + degree (p /ₘ q) = degree p
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have hdiv0 : p /ₘ q ≠ 0 := by rwa [Ne, divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hq, not_lt]
  have hlc : leadingCoeff q * leadingCoeff (p /ₘ q) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Monic.def.1 hq, one_mul, Ne, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]
  have hmod : degree (p %ₘ q) < degree (q * (p /ₘ q)) :=
    calc
      degree (p %ₘ q) < degree q := degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [degree_mul' hlc, degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero, degree_eq_natDegree hdiv0, ←
            Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_le]
        exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  calc
    degree q + degree (p /ₘ q) = degree (q * (p /ₘ q)) := Eq.symm (degree_mul' hlc)
    _ = degree (p %ₘ q + q * (p /ₘ q)) := (degree_add_eq_right_of_degree_lt hmod).symm
    _ = _ := congr_arg _ (modByMonic_add_div _ _)

name: degree_divByMonic_le
statement: theorem degree_divByMonic_le (p q : R[X]) : degree (p /ₘ q) ≤ degree p
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if hp0 : p = 0 then by simp only [hp0, zero_divByMonic, le_refl]
  else
    if hq : Monic q then
      if h : degree q ≤ degree p then by
        have := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hp0
        rw [← degree_add_divByMonic hq h, degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero,
          degree_eq_natDegree (mt (divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hq).1 (not_lt.2 h))]
        exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
      else by
        unfold divByMonic divModByMonicAux
        simp [dite_eq_left hq, h, degree_zero, bot_le]
    else (divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic p hq).symm ▸ bot_le

name: degree_divByMonic_lt
statement:
theorem degree_divByMonic_lt (p q : R[X]) (hp0 : p ≠ 0)
    (h0q : 0 < degree q) : degree (p /ₘ q) < degree p
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if hq : q.Monic then
    if hpq : degree p < degree q then by
      have := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hp0
      rw [(divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hq).2 hpq, degree_eq_natDegree hp0]
      exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
    else by
      have := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hp0
      rw [← degree_add_divByMonic hq (not_lt.1 hpq), degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero,
        degree_eq_natDegree (mt (divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hq).1 hpq)]
      exact
        Nat.cast_lt.2
          (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left (Nat.cast_lt.1 <|
            by simpa [degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero] using! h0q))
  else by
    rwa [divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq, degree_zero, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, degree_ne_bot]

name: natDegree_divByMonic
statement:
theorem natDegree_divByMonic (f : R[X]) {g : R[X]} (hg : g.Monic) :
    natDegree (f /ₘ g) = natDegree f - natDegree g
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  by_cases hfg : f /ₘ g = 0
  · rw [hfg, natDegree_zero]
    rw [divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hg] at hfg
    rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr (natDegree_le_natDegree <| le_of_lt hfg)]
  have hgf := hfg
  rw [divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hg] at hgf
  push Not at hgf
  have := degree_add_divByMonic hg hgf
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    apply hfg
    rw [hf, zero_divByMonic]
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree hf, degree_eq_natDegree hg.ne_zero, degree_eq_natDegree hfg,
    ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_inj] at this
  rw [← this, add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: div_modByMonic_unique
statement:
theorem div_modByMonic_unique {f g} (q r : R[X]) (hg : Monic g)
    (h : r + g * q = f ∧ degree r < degree g) : f /ₘ g = q ∧ f %ₘ g = r
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have h₁ : r - f %ₘ g = -g * (q - f /ₘ g) :=
    eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      (by
        rw [← sub_eq_zero_of_eq (h.1.trans (modByMonic_add_div f g).symm)]
        simp [mul_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc])
  have h₂ : degree (r - f %ₘ g) = degree (g * (q - f /ₘ g)) := by simp [h₁]
  have h₄ : degree (r - f %ₘ g) < degree g :=
    calc
      degree (r - f %ₘ g) ≤ max (degree r) (degree (f %ₘ g)) := degree_sub_le _ _
      _ < degree g := max_lt_iff.2 ⟨h.2, degree_modByMonic_lt _ hg⟩
  have h₅ : q - f /ₘ g = 0 :=
    _root_.by_contradiction fun hqf =>
      not_le_of_gt h₄ <|
        calc
          degree g ≤ degree g + degree (q - f /ₘ g) := by
            rw [degree_eq_natDegree hg.ne_zero, degree_eq_natDegree hqf]
            norm_cast
            exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
          _ = degree (r - f %ₘ g) := by rw [h₂, degree_mul']; simpa [Monic.def.1 hg]
  exact ⟨Eq.symm <| eq_of_sub_eq_zero h₅, Eq.symm <| eq_of_sub_eq_zero <| by simpa [h₅] using h₁⟩

name: map_mod_divByMonic
statement:
theorem map_mod_divByMonic [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) (hq : Monic q) :
    (p /ₘ q).map f = p.map f /ₘ q.map f ∧ (p %ₘ q).map f = p.map f %ₘ q.map f
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality S
  have : Nontrivial R := f.domain_nontrivial
  have : map f p /ₘ map f q = map f (p /ₘ q) ∧ map f p %ₘ map f q = map f (p %ₘ q) :=
    div_modByMonic_unique ((p /ₘ q).map f) _ (hq.map f)
      ⟨Eq.symm <| by rw [← Polynomial.map_mul, ← Polynomial.map_add, modByMonic_add_div],
        calc
          _ ≤ degree (p %ₘ q) := degree_map_le
          _ < degree q := degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq
          _ = _ :=
            Eq.symm <|
              degree_map_eq_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero _
                (by rw [Monic.def.1 hq, f.map_one]; exact one_ne_zero)⟩
  exact ⟨this.1.symm, this.2.symm⟩

statement:
theorem map_divByMonic [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) (hq : Monic q) :

statement:
theorem map_modByMonic [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) (hq : Monic q) :

name: modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement: theorem modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd (hq : Monic q) : p %ₘ q = 0 ↔ q ∣ p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← modByMonic_add_div p q, h, zero_add]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _, fun h => by
    nontriviality R
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_eq_mul_right_of_dvd h
    by_contra hpq0
    have hmod : p %ₘ q = q * (r - p /ₘ q) := by rw [modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div, mul_sub, ← hr]
    have : degree (q * (r - p /ₘ q)) < degree q := hmod ▸ degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq
    have hrpq0 : leadingCoeff (r - p /ₘ q) ≠ 0 := fun h =>
      hpq0 <|
        leadingCoeff_eq_zero.1
          (by rw [hmod, leadingCoeff_eq_zero.1 h, mul_zero, leadingCoeff_zero])
    have hlc : leadingCoeff q * leadingCoeff (r - p /ₘ q) ≠ 0 := by rwa [Monic.def.1 hq, one_mul]
    rw [degree_mul' hlc, degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero,
      degree_eq_natDegree (mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.2 hrpq0)] at this
    exact not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.1 this)⟩

statement:

theorem modByMonic_self (hp : p.Monic) : p %ₘ p = 0

statement:

name: map_dvd_map
statement:
theorem map_dvd_map [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Injective f) {x y : R[X]}
    (hx : x.Monic) : x.map f ∣ y.map f ↔ x ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hx, ← modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd (hx.map f), ←
    map_modByMonic f hx]
  exact
    ⟨fun H => map_injective f hf <| by rw [H, Polynomial.map_zero], fun H => by
      rw [H, Polynomial.map_zero]⟩

statement:

theorem modByMonic_one (p : R[X]) : p %ₘ 1 = 0

statement:

theorem divByMonic_one (p : R[X]) : p /ₘ 1 = p

name: sum_modByMonic_coeff
statement:
theorem sum_modByMonic_coeff (hq : q.Monic) {n : ℕ} (hn : q.degree ≤ n) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, monomial i ((p %ₘ q).coeff i)) = p %ₘ q
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  exact
    (sum_fin (fun i c => monomial i c) (by simp) ((degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq).trans_le hn)).trans
      (sum_monomial_eq _)

name: mul_divByMonic_cancel_left
statement:
theorem mul_divByMonic_cancel_left (p : R[X]) {q : R[X]} (hmo : q.Monic) :
    q * p /ₘ q = p
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  refine (div_modByMonic_unique _ 0 hmo ⟨by rw [zero_add], ?_⟩).1
  rw [degree_zero]
  exact Ne.bot_lt fun h => hmo.ne_zero (degree_eq_bot.1 h)

name: coeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C_rec
statement:
lemma coeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C_rec (p : R[X]) (a : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (p /ₘ (X - C a)).coeff n = coeff p (n + 1) + a * (p /ₘ (X - C a)).coeff (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have := monic_X_sub_C a
  set q := p /ₘ (X - C a)
  rw [← p.modByMonic_add_div (X - C a)]
  have : degree (p %ₘ (X - C a)) < ↑(n + 1) := degree_X_sub_C a ▸ p.degree_modByMonic_lt this
    |>.trans_le <| WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr le_add_self
  simp [q, sub_mul, add_sub, coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt this]

name: coeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem coeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C (p : R[X]) (a : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (p /ₘ (X - C a)).coeff n = ∑ i ∈ Icc (n + 1) p.natDegree, a ^ (i - (n + 1)) * p.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  wlog h : p.natDegree ≤ n generalizing n
  · refine Nat.decreasingInduction' (fun n hn _ ih ↦ ?_) (le_of_not_ge h) ?_
    · rw [coeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C_rec, ih, eq_comm, Icc_eq_cons_Ioc (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hn),
          sum_cons, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_sum]
      congr 1; refine sum_congr ?_ fun i hi ↦ ?_
      · ext; simp
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', eq_comm, i.sub_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel]
      apply Nat.le_sub_of_add_le
      rw [add_comm]; exact (mem_Icc.mp hi).1
    · exact this _ le_rfl
  rw [Icc_eq_empty (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr h).not_ge, sum_empty]
  nontriviality R
  by_cases hp : p.natDegree = 0
  · rw [(divByMonic_eq_zero_iff <| monic_X_sub_C a).mpr, coeff_zero]
    apply degree_lt_degree; rw [hp, natDegree_X_sub_C]; simp
  · apply coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
    rw [natDegree_divByMonic p (monic_X_sub_C a), natDegree_X_sub_C]
    exact (Nat.pred_lt hp).trans_le h

name: finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C
statement: theorem finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C (a : R) (h0 : p ≠ 0) : FiniteMultiplicity (X - C a) p
proof:
:= by
  have := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne h0
  refine finiteMultiplicity_of_degree_pos_of_monic ?_ (monic_X_sub_C _) h0
  rw [degree_X_sub_C]
  decide

name: rootMultiplicity_eq_natFind_of_ne_zero
rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity [DecidableEq R]
    (p : R[X]) (a : R) :
    rootMultiplicity a p =
      if p = 0 then 0 else multiplicity (X - C a) p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rootMultiplicity, multiplicity, emultiplicity]
  split
  · rfl
  rename_i h
  simp only [finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C a h, ↓reduceDIte]
  congr

name: rootMultiplicity_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootMultiplicity_zero {x : R} : rootMultiplicity x 0 = 0

name: rootMultiplicity_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootMultiplicity_C (r a : R) : rootMultiplicity a (C r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · rw [Subsingleton.elim (C r) 0, rootMultiplicity_zero]
  classical
  rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]
  split_ifs with hr
  · rfl
  have h : natDegree (C r) < natDegree (X - C a) := by simp
  simp_rw [multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_dvd ((monic_X_sub_C a).not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt hr h)]

name: pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd
statement: theorem pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd (p : R[X]) (a : R) : (X - C a) ^ rootMultiplicity a p ∣ p
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if h : p = 0 then by simp [h]
  else by
    rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, ite_eq_right h]; apply pow_multiplicity_dvd

name: pow_mul_divByMonic_rootMultiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem pow_mul_divByMonic_rootMultiplicity_eq (p : R[X]) (a : R) :
    (X - C a) ^ rootMultiplicity a p * (p /ₘ (X - C a) ^ rootMultiplicity a p) = p
proof:
:= by
  have : Monic ((X - C a) ^ rootMultiplicity a p) := (monic_X_sub_C _).pow _
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← modByMonic_add_div p, (modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd this).2 (pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd _ _)]
  simp

name: exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd (p : R[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : R) :
    ∃ q : R[X], p = (X - C a) ^ p.rootMultiplicity a * q ∧ ¬ (X - C a) ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, ite_eq_right hp]
  apply (finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C a hp).exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd

name: le_rootMultiplicity_iff
statement:
lemma le_rootMultiplicity_iff (p0 : p ≠ 0) {a : R} {n : ℕ} :
    n ≤ rootMultiplicity a p ↔ (X - C a) ^ n ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [rootMultiplicity, dite_eq_right p0, Nat.le_find_iff, not_not]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h m hm => (pow_dvd_pow _ hm).trans h⟩
  rcases n with - | n
  · rw [pow_zero]
    apply one_dvd
  · exact h n n.lt_succ_self

name: rootMultiplicity_le_iff
statement:
lemma rootMultiplicity_le_iff (p0 : p ≠ 0) (a : R) (n : ℕ) :
    rootMultiplicity a p ≤ n ↔ ¬(X - C a) ^ (n + 1) ∣ p

name: rootMultiplicity_add
statement:
lemma rootMultiplicity_add {p q : R[X]} (a : R) (hzero : p + q ≠ 0) :
    min (rootMultiplicity a p) (rootMultiplicity a q) ≤ rootMultiplicity a (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_rootMultiplicity_iff hzero]
  exact min_pow_dvd_add (pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd p a) (pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd q a)

name: pow_rootMultiplicity_not_dvd
statement:
lemma pow_rootMultiplicity_not_dvd (p0 : p ≠ 0) (a : R) :
    ¬(X - C a) ^ (rootMultiplicity a p + 1) ∣ p

name: rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree'
statement: lemma rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree' : p.rootMultiplicity 0 = p.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · simp only [h, rootMultiplicity_zero, natTrailingDegree_zero]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [rootMultiplicity_le_iff h, map_zero, sub_zero, X_pow_dvd_iff, not_forall]
    exact ⟨p.natTrailingDegree,
      fun h' ↦ trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.2 h <| h' <| Nat.lt_add_one _⟩
  · rw [le_rootMultiplicity_iff h, map_zero, sub_zero, X_pow_dvd_iff]
    exact fun _ ↦ coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree

name: modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval (p : R[X]) (a : R) : p %ₘ (X - C a) = C (p.eval a)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have h : (p %ₘ (X - C a)).eval a = p.eval a := by
    rw [modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X,
      eval_C, sub_self, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  have : degree (p %ₘ (X - C a)) < 1 :=
    degree_X_sub_C a ▸ degree_modByMonic_lt p (monic_X_sub_C a)
  have : degree (p %ₘ (X - C a)) ≤ 0 := by
    revert this
    cases degree (p %ₘ (X - C a))
    · exact fun _ => bot_le
    · exact fun h => WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.1 h))
  rw [eq_C_of_degree_le_zero this, eval_C] at h
  rw [eq_C_of_degree_le_zero this, h]

name: mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot
statement: theorem mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot : (X - C a) * (p /ₘ (X - C a)) = p ↔ IsRoot p a
proof:
:=
  .trans
    ⟨fun h => by rw [← h, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_self, zero_mul],
    fun h => by
      conv_rhs => rw [← modByMonic_add_div p, modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval, h, C_0, zero_add]⟩
    IsRoot.def.symm

name: dvd_iff_isRoot
statement: theorem dvd_iff_isRoot : X - C a ∣ p ↔ IsRoot p a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rwa [← modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd (monic_X_sub_C _), modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval, ← C_0,
      C_inj] at h,
    fun h => ⟨p /ₘ (X - C a), by rw [mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.2 h]⟩⟩

name: X_sub_C_dvd_sub_C_eval
statement: theorem X_sub_C_dvd_sub_C_eval : X - C a ∣ p - C (p.eval a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dvd_iff_isRoot, IsRoot, eval_sub, eval_C, sub_self]

name: modByMonic_X
statement: theorem modByMonic_X (p : R[X]) : p %ₘ X = C (p.eval 0)

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root [CommRing S] {f : R →+* S} {p q : R[X]}
    {x : S} (hx : q.eval₂ f x = 0) : (p %ₘ q).eval₂ f x = p.eval₂ f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div, eval₂_sub, eval₂_mul, hx, zero_mul, sub_zero]

name: sub_dvd_eval_sub
statement: theorem sub_dvd_eval_sub (a b : R) (p : R[X]) : a - b ∣ p.eval a - p.eval b
proof:
:= by
  suffices X - C b ∣ p - C (p.eval b) by
    simpa only [coe_evalRingHom, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      using (_root_.map_dvd (evalRingHom a)) this
  simp [dvd_iff_isRoot]

name: IsRoot.dvd_coeff_zero
statement: lemma IsRoot.dvd_coeff_zero {p : R[X]} {x : R} (h : p.IsRoot x) : x ∣ p.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [h.eq_zero, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using sub_dvd_eval_sub 0 x p

name: rootMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff {p : R[X]} {x : R} :
    rootMultiplicity x p = 0 ↔ IsRoot p x → p = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp]
  classical
  simp [rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, multiplicity_eq_zero (finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C x hp),
    dvd_iff_isRoot, not_imp_not]

name: rootMultiplicity_eq_zero
statement: theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_zero {p : R[X]} {x : R} (h : ¬IsRoot p x) : rootMultiplicity x p = 0

name: rootMultiplicity_pos'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootMultiplicity_pos' {p : R[X]} {x : R} :
    0 < rootMultiplicity x p ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ IsRoot p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, rootMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff, Classical.not_imp, and_comm]

name: rootMultiplicity_pos
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_pos {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) {x : R} :
    0 < rootMultiplicity x p ↔ IsRoot p x

name: eval_divByMonic_pow_rootMultiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_divByMonic_pow_rootMultiplicity_ne_zero {p : R[X]} (a : R) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    eval a (p /ₘ (X - C a) ^ rootMultiplicity a p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nontrivial R := Nontrivial.of_polynomial_ne hp
  rw [Ne, ← IsRoot, ← dvd_iff_isRoot]
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have := pow_mul_divByMonic_rootMultiplicity_eq p a
  rw [hq, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, ite_eq_right hp] at this
  exact
    (finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C a hp).not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt
      (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (dvd_of_mul_right_eq _ this)

name: mul_self_modByMonic
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_self_modByMonic (hq : q.Monic) : (p * q) %ₘ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hq]
  exact dvd_mul_left q p

name: modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub
statement: lemma modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub (hq : q.Monic) (h : q ∣ p₁ - p₂) : p₁ %ₘ q = p₂ %ₘ q
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  obtain ⟨f, sub_eq⟩ := h
  refine (div_modByMonic_unique (p₂ /ₘ q + f) _ hq ⟨?_, degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq⟩).2
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp sub_eq, mul_add, ← add_assoc, modByMonic_add_div, add_comm]

name: add_divByMonic_modByMonic
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q.Monic
  · rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
    · simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]
    · exact div_modByMonic_unique (p₁ /ₘ q + p₂ /ₘ q) (p₁ %ₘ q + p₂ %ₘ q) hq
        ⟨by
          rw [mul_add, add_left_comm, add_assoc, modByMonic_add_div, ← add_assoc,
            add_comm (q * _), modByMonic_add_div],
          (degree_add_le _ _).trans_lt
            (max_lt (degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq) (degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq))⟩
  · simp [divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq, modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq]

name: add_divByMonic
statement: lemma add_divByMonic (p₁ p₂ : R[X]) : (p₁ + p₂) /ₘ q = p₁ /ₘ q + p₂ /ₘ q

name: add_modByMonic
statement: lemma add_modByMonic (p₁ p₂ : R[X]) : (p₁ + p₂) %ₘ q = p₁ %ₘ q + p₂ %ₘ q

name: neg_divByMonic
statement: lemma neg_divByMonic (p q : R[X]) : (-p) /ₘ q = -(p /ₘ q)

name: neg_modByMonic
statement: lemma neg_modByMonic (p q : R[X]) : (-p) %ₘ q = -(p %ₘ q)

name: sub_divByMonic
statement: lemma sub_divByMonic (p₁ p₂ q : R[X]) : (p₁ - p₂) /ₘ q = p₁ /ₘ q - p₂ /ₘ q

name: sub_modByMonic
statement: lemma sub_modByMonic (p₁ p₂ q : R[X]) : (p₁ - p₂) %ₘ q = p₁ %ₘ q - p₂ %ₘ q

name: mul_divByMonic_assoc
statement:
lemma mul_divByMonic_assoc (p₁ p₂ q : R[X]) (hd : q ∣ p₂) :
    (p₁ * p₂) /ₘ q = p₁ * (p₂ /ₘ q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : q.Monic
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hd
    rw [mul_left_comm]; simp only [mul_divByMonic_cancel_left _ h]
  · simp [divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ h]

name: mul_modByMonic
statement: lemma mul_modByMonic (p₁ p₂ q : R[X]) : (p₁ * p₂) %ₘ q = (p₁ %ₘ q) * (p₂ %ₘ q) %ₘ q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : ¬ q.Monic
  · simp [Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ h]
  apply Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub h
  have : p₁ * p₂ - p₁ %ₘ q * (p₂ %ₘ q) = (p₁ %ₘ q) * (p₂ - p₂ %ₘ q) + p₂ * (p₁ - p₁ %ₘ q) := by ring
  rw [this]
  apply dvd_add
  all_goals
  · apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right
    simp [Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div]

name: eval_divByMonic_eq_trailingCoeff_comp
statement:
lemma eval_divByMonic_eq_trailingCoeff_comp {p : R[X]} {t : R} :
    (p /ₘ (X - C t) ^ p.rootMultiplicity t).eval t = (p.comp (X + C t)).trailingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p 0
  · rw [zero_divByMonic, eval_zero, zero_comp, trailingCoeff_zero]
  have mul_eq := p.pow_mul_divByMonic_rootMultiplicity_eq t
  set m := p.rootMultiplicity t
  set g := p /ₘ (X - C t) ^ m
  have : (g.comp (X + C t)).coeff 0 = g.eval t := by
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, eval_comp, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, zero_add]
  rw [← congr_arg (comp · <| X + C t) mul_eq, mul_comp, pow_comp, sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp,
    add_sub_cancel_right, ← reverse_leadingCoeff, reverse_X_pow_mul, reverse_leadingCoeff,
    trailingCoeff, Nat.le_zero.1 (natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero <|
      this ▸ eval_divByMonic_pow_rootMultiplicity_ne_zero t hp), this]

name: le_rootMultiplicity_mul
statement:
lemma le_rootMultiplicity_mul {p q : R[X]} (x : R) (hpq : p * q ≠ 0) :
    rootMultiplicity x p + rootMultiplicity x q ≤ rootMultiplicity x (p * q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_rootMultiplicity_iff hpq, pow_add]
  gcongr <;> apply pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd

name: rootMultiplicity_le_rootMultiplicity_of_dvd
statement:
lemma rootMultiplicity_le_rootMultiplicity_of_dvd {p q : R[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hpq : p ∣ q) (x : R) :
    p.rootMultiplicity x ≤ q.rootMultiplicity x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hpq
  exact Nat.le_of_add_right_le <| le_rootMultiplicity_mul x hq

name: leadingCoeff_divByMonic_of_monic
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_divByMonic_of_monic (hmonic : q.Monic)
    (hdegree : q.degree ≤ p.degree) : (p /ₘ q).leadingCoeff = p.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality
  have h : q.leadingCoeff * (p /ₘ q).leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [divByMonic_eq_zero_iff hmonic, hmonic.leadingCoeff,
      Nat.WithBot.one_le_iff_zero_lt] using hdegree
  nth_rw 2 [← modByMonic_add_div p q]
  rw [leadingCoeff_add_of_degree_lt, leadingCoeff_monic_mul hmonic]
  rw [degree_mul' h, degree_add_divByMonic hmonic hdegree]
  exact (degree_modByMonic_lt p hmonic).trans_le hdegree

name: degree_eq_one_of_irreducible_of_root
statement:
lemma degree_eq_one_of_irreducible_of_root (hi : Irreducible p) {x : R} (hx : IsRoot p x) :
    degree p = 1
proof:
:=
  let ⟨g, hg⟩ := dvd_iff_isRoot.2 hx
  have : IsUnit (X - C x) ∨ IsUnit g := hi.isUnit_or_isUnit hg
  this.elim
    (fun h => by
      have h₁ : degree (X - C x) = 1 := degree_X_sub_C x
      have h₂ : degree (X - C x) = 0 := degree_eq_zero_of_isUnit h
      rw [h₁] at h₂; exact absurd h₂ (by decide))
    fun hgu => by rw [hg, degree_mul, degree_X_sub_C, degree_eq_zero_of_isUnit hgu, add_zero]

name: _root_.Irreducible.not_isRoot_of_natDegree_ne_one
statement:
lemma _root_.Irreducible.not_isRoot_of_natDegree_ne_one
    (hi : Irreducible p) (hdeg : p.natDegree ≠ 1) {x : R} : ¬p.IsRoot x
proof:
:=
  fun hr ↦ hdeg <| natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some <| degree_eq_one_of_irreducible_of_root hi hr

name: _root_.Irreducible.isRoot_eq_bot_of_natDegree_ne_one
statement:
lemma _root_.Irreducible.isRoot_eq_bot_of_natDegree_ne_one
    (hi : Irreducible p) (hdeg : p.natDegree ≠ 1) : p.IsRoot = ⊥

name: _root_.Irreducible.subsingleton_isRoot
statement:
lemma _root_.Irreducible.subsingleton_isRoot
    (hi : Irreducible p) : { x | p.IsRoot x }.Subsingleton
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ (subsingleton_isRoot_of_natDegree_eq_one <| natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some <|
    degree_eq_one_of_irreducible_of_root hi hx) hx

name: leadingCoeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_divByMonic_X_sub_C (p : R[X]) (hp : degree p ≠ 0) (a : R) :
    leadingCoeff (p /ₘ (X - C a)) = leadingCoeff p
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality
  rcases hp.lt_or_gt with hd | hd
  · rw [degree_eq_bot.mp <| Nat.WithBot.lt_zero_iff.mp hd, zero_divByMonic]
  refine leadingCoeff_divByMonic_of_monic (monic_X_sub_C a) ?_
  rwa [degree_X_sub_C, Nat.WithBot.one_le_iff_zero_lt]

name: eq_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff
statement:
lemma eq_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff {p q : R[X]} (hpq : p ∣ q)
    (h₁ : q.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree) (h₂ : p.leadingCoeff = q.leadingCoeff) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with rfl | hq
  · simpa using h₂
  replace h₁ := (natDegree_le_of_dvd hpq hq).antisymm h₁
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hpq
  rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at hq
  rw [natDegree_mul hq.1 hq.2, left_eq_add] at h₁
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero h₁, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C,
    eq_comm, mul_eq_left₀ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hq.1)] at h₂
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero h₁, h₂, map_one, mul_one]

name: associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff
statement:
lemma associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff {p q : R[X]} (hpq : p ∣ q)
    (h₁ : q.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree) (h₂ : q.leadingCoeff ∣ p.leadingCoeff) :
    Associated p q
proof:
:=
  have ⟨r, hr⟩ := hpq
  have ⟨u, hu⟩ := associated_of_dvd_dvd ⟨leadingCoeff r, hr ▸ leadingCoeff_mul p r⟩ h₂
  ⟨Units.map C.toMonoidHom u, eq_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff
    (by rwa [Units.mul_right_dvd]) (by simpa [natDegree_mul_C] using h₁) (by simpa using hu)⟩

name: associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
statement:
lemma associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le {K} [Field K] {p q : K[X]} (hpq : p ∣ q) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : q.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree) : Associated p q
proof:
:=
  associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff hpq h₁
    (IsUnit.dvd (by rwa [← leadingCoeff_ne_zero, ← isUnit_iff_ne_zero] at hq))

name: associated_of_dvd_of_degree_eq
statement:
lemma associated_of_dvd_of_degree_eq {K} [Field K] {p q : K[X]} (hpq : p ∣ q)
    (h₁ : p.degree = q.degree) : Associated p q
proof:
:=
  (Classical.em (q = 0)).elim (fun hq ↦ (show p = q by simpa [hq] using h₁) ▸ Associated.refl p)
    (associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hpq · (natDegree_le_natDegree h₁.ge))

name: eq_leadingCoeff_mul_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
coeffList_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffList_zero : (0 : R[X]).coeffList = []

name: coeffList_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffList_eq_nil {P : R[X]} : P.coeffList = [] ↔ P = 0

name: coeffList_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffList_C {x : R} (h : x ≠ 0) : (C x).coeffList = [x]
