statement:
theorem coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff (h : P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ls, P.coeffList = P.leadingCoeff :: ls

name: head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head?_coeffList (h : P ≠ 0) :
    P.coeffList.head? = P.leadingCoeff

name: head_coeffList
statement:
@[simp] theorem head_coeffList (P : R[X]) (hP) :
    P.coeffList.head hP = P.leadingCoeff
proof:
:=
  let h := coeffList_eq_nil.not.mp hP
  (coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff h).casesOn fun _ _ ↦
    Option.some.injEq _ _ ▸ List.head?_eq_some_head _ ▸ head?_coeffList h

name: length_coeffList_eq_withBotSucc_degree
statement: theorem length_coeffList_eq_withBotSucc_degree (P : R[X]) : P.coeffList.length = P.degree.succ

name: length_coeffList_eq_ite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_coeffList_eq_ite [DecidableEq R] (P : R[X]) :
    P.coeffList.length = if P = 0 then 0 else P.natDegree + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : P = 0 <;> simp [h, coeffList, withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one]

name: leadingCoeff_cons_eraseLead
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_cons_eraseLead (h : P.nextCoeff ≠ 0) :
    P.leadingCoeff :: P.eraseLead.coeffList = P.coeffList
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ := ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt (natDegree_pos_of_nextCoeff_ne_zero h)
  have h₃ := mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero h
  simpa [natDegree_eraseLead_add_one h, coeffList, withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one h₂,
    withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one h₃, List.range_succ] using
    (Polynomial.eraseLead_coeff_of_ne · ·.ne)

name: coeffList_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffList_monomial {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (monomial n x).coeffList = x :: List.replicate n 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mt (Polynomial.monomial_eq_zero_iff x n).mp hx
  apply List.ext_get (by classical simp [hx])
  rintro (_ | k) _ h₁
  · exact (coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff h).rec (by simp_all)
  · rw [List.length_cons, List.length_replicate] at h₁
    have : ((monomial n) x).natDegree.succ = n + 1 := by
      simp [Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_eq n hx]
    simpa [coeffList, withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one h]
      using Polynomial.coeff_monomial_of_ne _ (by lia)

name: coeffList_eraseLead
statement:
theorem coeffList_eraseLead (h : P ≠ 0) :
    P.coeffList =
      P.leadingCoeff :: (.replicate (P.natDegree - P.eraseLead.degree.succ) 0
        ++ P.eraseLead.coeffList)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdp : P.natDegree = 0
  · rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdp] at h ⊢
    simp [coeffList_C (C_ne_zero.mp h)]
  by_cases hep : P.eraseLead = 0
  · have h₂ : .monomial P.natDegree P.leadingCoeff = P := by
      simpa [hep] using P.eraseLead_add_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff
    nth_rewrite 1 [← h₂]
    simp [coeffList_monomial (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr h), hep]
  have h₁ := withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one h
  have h₂ := withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one hep
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn2⟩ : ∃ d, P.natDegree = P.eraseLead.natDegree + 1 + d ∧
      d = P.natDegree - P.eraseLead.degree.succ := by
    use P.natDegree - P.eraseLead.natDegree - 1
    have := eraseLead_natDegree_le P
    lia
  rw [← hn2]; clear hn2
  apply List.ext_getElem?
  rintro (_ | k)
  · obtain ⟨w, h⟩ := (coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff h)
    simp_all
  simp only [coeffList, List.map_reverse]
  by_cases! hkd : P.natDegree + 1 ≤ k + 1
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none]
      <;> simp <;> lia
  obtain ⟨dk, hdk⟩ := exists_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hkd)
  rw [List.getElem?_reverse (by simpa [withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one h] using hkd),
    List.getElem?_cons_succ, List.length_map, List.length_range, List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_range (by lia), Option.map_some]
  conv_lhs => arg 1; equals P.eraseLead.coeff dk =>
    rw [eraseLead_coeff_of_ne (f := P) dk (by lia)]
    congr
    lia
  by_cases! hkn : k < n
  · simpa [List.getElem?_append, hkn] using coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by lia)
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (List.length_replicate ▸ hkn),
      List.length_replicate, List.getElem?_reverse, List.getElem?_map]
    · rw [List.length_map, List.length_range,
        List.getElem?_range (by lia), Option.map_some]
      congr 2
      lia
    · simp
      lia

name: coeffList_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffList_neg : (-P).coeffList = P.coeffList.map (-·)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : P = 0
  · rw [hp, coeffList_zero, neg_zero, coeffList_zero, List.map_nil]
  · simp [coeffList]

name: coeffList_C_mul
statement: theorem coeffList_C_mul {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) : (C x * P).coeffList = P.coeffList.map (x * ·)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : P = 0
  · simp [hp]
  · simp [coeffList, Polynomial.degree_C hx]

name: coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span
statement:
lemma coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span : ∀ (p q : S[X]) (hq : q.Monic) (i),
    (p.divModByMonicAux hq).1.coeff i ∈ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(p) * spanCoeffs(p) ∧
    (p.divModByMonicAux hq).2.coeff i ∈ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(p) * spanCoeffs(p)
  | p, q, hq, i => by
    rw [divModByMonicAux]
    have H₀ (i) : p.coeff i ∈ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(p) * spanCoeffs(p)
proof:
:= by
      refine SetLike.le_def.mp ?_ <| subset_span <| mem_range_self i
      calc
        span R coeffs(p)
        _ = 1 ^ deg(p) * span R coeffs(p) := by simp
        _ ≤ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(p) * spanCoeffs(p) := by gcongr; exacts [le_sup_left, le_sup_right]
    split_ifs with hpq; swap
    · simpa using H₀ _
    simp only [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow]
    generalize hr : (p - q * (C p.leadingCoeff * X ^ (deg(p) - deg(q)))) = r
    by_cases hr' : r = 0
    · simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, hr', divModByMonicAux, degree_zero, le_bot_iff,
        degree_eq_bot, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, and_false, ↓reduceDIte, coeff_zero, add_zero,
        Submodule.zero_mem, and_true]
      split_ifs
      exacts [H₀ _, zero_mem _]
    have H : span R coeffs(r) ≤ span R coeffs(p) ⊔ span R coeffs(q) * span R coeffs(p) := by
      rw [span_le, ← hr]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rw [coeff_sub, ← mul_assoc, coeff_mul_X_pow', coeff_mul_C]
      apply sub_mem
      · exact SetLike.le_def.mp le_sup_left (subset_span (mem_range_self _))
      · split_ifs
        · refine SetLike.le_def.mp le_sup_right (mul_mem_mul ?_ ?_) <;> exact subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
        · exact zero_mem _
    have deg_r_lt_deg_p : deg(r) < deg(p) := natDegree_lt_natDegree hr' (hr ▸ div_wf_lemma hpq hq)
    have H'' := calc
      spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(r) * spanCoeffs(r)
      _ ≤ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(r) *
          (1 ⊔ (span R coeffs(p) ⊔ span R coeffs(q) * span R coeffs(p))) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(r) * (spanCoeffs(q) * spanCoeffs(p)) := by
        gcongr
        simp only [sup_le_iff]
        refine ⟨one_le_mul le_sup_left le_sup_left, ?_, mul_le_mul' le_sup_right le_sup_right⟩
        rw [Submodule.sup_mul, one_mul]
        exact le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_right
      _ = spanCoeffs(q) ^ (deg(r) + 1) * spanCoeffs(p) := by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ spanCoeffs(q) ^ deg(p) * spanCoeffs(p) := by gcongr; exacts [le_sup_left, deg_r_lt_deg_p]
    refine ⟨add_mem ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
    · split_ifs <;> simp only [mul_one, mul_zero]
      exacts [H₀ _, zero_mem _]
    · exact H'' (coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span r _ hq i).1
    · exact H'' (coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span _ _ hq i).2
  termination_by p => deg(p)

name: coeff_modByMonic_mem_pow_natDegree_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_modByMonic_mem_pow_natDegree_mul (p q : S[X])
    (Mp : Submodule R S) (hp : ∀ i, p.coeff i ∈ Mp) (hp' : 1 ∈ Mp)
    (Mq : Submodule R S) (hq : ∀ i, q.coeff i ∈ Mq) (hq' : 1 ∈ Mq) (i : ℕ) :
    (p %ₘ q).coeff i ∈ Mq ^ p.natDegree * Mp
proof:
:= by
  delta modByMonic
  split_ifs with H
  · refine SetLike.le_def.mp ?_ (coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span (R := R) p q H i).2
    gcongr <;> exact sup_le (by simpa) (by simpa [Submodule.span_le, Set.range_subset_iff])
  · rw [← one_mul (p.coeff i), ← one_pow p.natDegree]
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (Submodule.pow_mem_pow Mq hq' _) (hp i)

name: coeff_divByMonic_mem_pow_natDegree_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_divByMonic_mem_pow_natDegree_mul (p q : S[X])
    (Mp : Submodule R S) (hp : ∀ i, p.coeff i ∈ Mp) (hp' : 1 ∈ Mp)
    (Mq : Submodule R S) (hq : ∀ i, q.coeff i ∈ Mq) (hq' : 1 ∈ Mq) (i : ℕ) :
    (p /ₘ q).coeff i ∈ Mq ^ p.natDegree * Mp
proof:
:= by
  delta divByMonic
  split_ifs with H
  · refine SetLike.le_def.mp ?_ (coeff_divModByMonicAux_mem_span_pow_mul_span (R := R) p q H i).1
    gcongr <;> exact sup_le (by simpa) (by simpa [Submodule.span_le, Set.range_subset_iff])
  · simp

name: idealSpan_range_update_divByMonic
statement:
lemma idealSpan_range_update_divByMonic (hij : i ≠ j) (v : ι → R[X]) :
    span (Set.range (Function.update v j (v j %ₘ v i))) = span (Set.range v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, Ideal.span, Ideal.span,
    Submodule.span_range_update_sub_smul hij]

name: derivation_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_C (D : Derivation R R[X] A) (a : R) : D (C a) = 0

name: C_smul_derivation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_smul_derivation_apply (D : Derivation R R[X] A) (a : R) (f : R[X]) :
    C a • D f = a • D f
proof:
:= by
  have : C a • D f = D (C a * f) := by simp
  rw [this, C_mul', D.map_smul]

name: derivation_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem derivation_ext {D₁ D₂ : Derivation R R[X] A} (h : D₁ X = D₂ X) : D₁ = D₂
proof:
:=
  Derivation.ext fun f => Derivation.eqOn_adjoin (Set.eqOn_singleton.2 h) <| by
    simp only [adjoin_X, Algebra.coe_top, Set.mem_univ]

name: mkDerivation_apply
statement:
lemma mkDerivation_apply (a : A) (f : R[X]) :
    mkDerivation R a f = derivative f • a

name: mkDerivation_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkDerivation_X (a : A) : mkDerivation R a X = a

name: mkDerivation_one_eq_derivative'
statement: lemma mkDerivation_one_eq_derivative' : mkDerivation R (1 : R[X]) = derivative'

name: mkDerivation_one_eq_derivative
statement: lemma mkDerivation_one_eq_derivative (f : R[X]) : mkDerivation R (1 : R[X]) f = derivative f

name: mkDerivationEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mkDerivationEquiv_apply (a : A) :
    mkDerivationEquiv R a = mkDerivation R a

name: mkDerivationEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mkDerivationEquiv_symm_apply (D : Derivation R R[X] A) :
    (mkDerivationEquiv R).symm D = D X

name: compAEval_eq
statement:
theorem compAEval_eq (d : Derivation R A M) (f : R[X]) :
    d.compAEval a f = derivative f • (AEval.of R M a (d a))

name: comp_aeval_eq
statement:
theorem comp_aeval_eq (d : Derivation R A M) (f : R[X]) :
    d (aeval a f) = aeval a (derivative f) • d a
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = (AEval.of R M a).symm (d.compAEval a f) := rfl
    _ = _ := by simp [-compAEval_apply, compAEval_eq]

name: revAtFun_invol
statement: theorem revAtFun_invol {N i : ℕ} : revAtFun N (revAtFun N i) = i

name: revAtFun_inj
statement: theorem revAtFun_inj {N : ℕ} : Function.Injective (revAtFun N)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  rw [← @revAtFun_invol N a, hab, revAtFun_invol]

name: revAtFun_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem revAtFun_eq (N i : ℕ) : revAtFun N i = revAt N i

name: revAt_invol
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem revAt_invol {N i : ℕ} : (revAt N) (revAt N i) = i

name: revAt_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem revAt_le {N i : ℕ} (H : i ≤ N) : revAt N i = N - i

name: revAt_eq_self_of_lt
statement: lemma revAt_eq_self_of_lt {N i : ℕ} (h : N < i) : revAt N i = i

name: revAt_add
statement:
theorem revAt_add {N O n o : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (ho : o ≤ O) :
    revAt (N + O) (n + o) = revAt N n + revAt O o
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.le.dest hn with ⟨n', rfl⟩
  rcases Nat.le.dest ho with ⟨o', rfl⟩
  repeat' rw [revAt_le (le_add_right rfl.le)]
  rw [add_assoc, add_left_comm n' o, ← add_assoc, revAt_le (le_add_right rfl.le)]
  repeat' rw [add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: revAt_zero
statement: theorem revAt_zero (N : ℕ) : revAt N 0 = N

name: reflect_support
statement:
theorem reflect_support (N : ℕ) (f : R[X]) :
    (reflect N f).support = Finset.image (revAt N) f.support

name: coeff_reflect
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coeff_reflect (N : ℕ) (f : R[X]) (i : ℕ) : coeff (reflect N f) i = f.coeff (revAt N i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases f with ⟨f⟩
  simp only [reflect, coeff]
  calc
    f.coeff.embDomain (revAt N) i
      = f.coeff.embDomain (revAt N) (revAt N (revAt N i)) := by rw [revAt_invol]
    _ = f.coeff (revAt N i) := Finsupp.embDomain_apply_self _ _ _

name: reflect_reflect
statement: @[simp] lemma reflect_reflect {N : ℕ} {p : R[X]} : (p.reflect N).reflect N = p

name: reflect_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_zero {N : ℕ} : reflect N (0 : R[X]) = 0

name: reflect_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reflect_eq_zero_iff {N : ℕ} {f : R[X]} : reflect N (f : R[X]) = 0 ↔ f = 0

name: reflect_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_add (f g : R[X]) (N : ℕ) : reflect N (f + g) = reflect N f + reflect N g

name: reflect_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_C_mul (f : R[X]) (r : R) (N : ℕ) : reflect N (C r * f) = C r * reflect N f

name: reflect_C_mul_X_pow
statement: theorem reflect_C_mul_X_pow (N n : ℕ) {c : R} : reflect N (C c * X ^ n) = C c * X ^ revAt N n

name: reflect_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_C (r : R) (N : ℕ) : reflect N (C r) = C r * X ^ N
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← mul_one (C r), ← pow_zero X, reflect_C_mul_X_pow, revAt_zero]

name: reflect_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_monomial (N n : ℕ) : reflect N ((X : R[X]) ^ n) = X ^ revAt N n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul (X ^ n), ← one_mul (X ^ revAt N n), ← C_1, reflect_C_mul_X_pow]

name: reflect_one_X
statement: @[simp] lemma reflect_one_X : reflect 1 (X : R[X]) = 1

name: reflect_map
statement:
lemma reflect_map {S : Type*} [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (p.map f).reflect n = (p.reflect n).map f

name: reflect_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reflect_one (n : ℕ) : (1 : R[X]).reflect n = Polynomial.X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C.map_one, reflect_C, map_one, one_mul]

name: reflect_mul_induction
statement:
theorem reflect_mul_induction (cf cg : ℕ) (N O : ℕ) (f g : R[X]) (Cf : #f.support ≤ cf.succ)
    (Cg : #g.support ≤ cg.succ) (Nf : f.natDegree ≤ N) (Og : g.natDegree ≤ O) :
    reflect (N + O) (f * g) = reflect N f * reflect O g
proof:
:= by
  induction cf generalizing f with
  | zero =>
    induction cg generalizing g with
    | zero =>
      rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_self Cf, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_self Cg]
      simp_rw [mul_assoc, X_pow_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_add (X : R[X]), reflect_C_mul,
        reflect_monomial, add_comm, revAt_add Nf Og, mul_assoc, X_pow_mul, mul_assoc, ←
        pow_add (X : R[X]), add_comm]
    | succ cg hcg =>
      by_cases g0 : g = 0
      · rw [g0, reflect_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero, reflect_zero]
      rw [← eraseLead_add_C_mul_X_pow g, mul_add, reflect_add, reflect_add, mul_add, hcg, hcg] <;>
        try assumption
      · exact le_add_left card_support_C_mul_X_pow_le_one
      · exact le_trans (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le g.leadingCoeff g.natDegree) Og
      · exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (eraseLead_support_card_lt g0) Cg)
      · exact le_trans eraseLead_natDegree_le_aux Og
  | succ cf hcf =>
    by_cases f0 : f = 0
    · rw [f0, reflect_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, reflect_zero]
    rw [← eraseLead_add_C_mul_X_pow f, add_mul, reflect_add, reflect_add, add_mul, hcf, hcf] <;>
      try assumption
    · exact le_add_left card_support_C_mul_X_pow_le_one
    · exact le_trans (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le f.leadingCoeff f.natDegree) Nf
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (eraseLead_support_card_lt f0) Cf)
    · exact le_trans eraseLead_natDegree_le_aux Nf

name: reflect_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_mul (f g : R[X]) {F G : ℕ} (Ff : f.natDegree ≤ F) (Gg : g.natDegree ≤ G) :
    reflect (F + G) (f * g) = reflect F f * reflect G g
proof:
:=
  reflect_mul_induction _ _ F G f g f.support.card.le_succ g.support.card.le_succ Ff Gg

name: natDegree_reflect_le
statement:
lemma natDegree_reflect_le {N : ℕ} {p : R[X]} :
    (p.reflect N).natDegree ≤ max N p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual [-le_max_iff, natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero,
    revAt, not_le_of_gt, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt]

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_reflect_mul_pow (i : R →+* S) (x : S) [Invertible x] (N : ℕ) (f : R[X])
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ N) : eval₂ i (⅟x) (reflect N f) * x ^ N = eval₂ i x f
proof:
:= by
  refine
    induction_with_natDegree_le (fun f => eval₂ i (⅟x) (reflect N f) * x ^ N = eval₂ i x f) _ ?_ ?_
      ?_ f hf
  · simp
  · intro n r _ hnN
    simp only [revAt_le hnN, reflect_C_mul_X_pow, eval₂_X_pow, eval₂_C, eval₂_mul]
    conv in x ^ N => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hnN]
    rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (i r), ← mul_pow, invOf_mul_self, one_pow, mul_one]
  · intros
    simp [*, add_mul]

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_reflect_eq_zero_iff (i : R →+* S) (x : S) [Invertible x] (N : ℕ) (f : R[X])
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ N) : eval₂ i (⅟x) (reflect N f) = 0 ↔ eval₂ i x f = 0
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← eval₂_reflect_mul_pow i x N f hf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul]
  · intro h
    rw [← mul_one (eval₂ i (⅟x) _), ← one_pow N, ← mul_invOf_self x, mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, h,
      zero_mul]

name: coeff_reverse
statement: theorem coeff_reverse (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : f.reverse.coeff n = f.coeff (revAt f.natDegree n)

name: coeff_zero_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_reverse (f : R[X]) : coeff (reverse f) 0 = leadingCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_reverse, revAt_le zero_le, tsub_zero, leadingCoeff]

name: reverse_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_zero : reverse (0 : R[X]) = 0

name: reverse_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_eq_zero : f.reverse = 0 ↔ f = 0

name: reverse_natDegree_le
statement: theorem reverse_natDegree_le (f : R[X]) : f.reverse.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDegree_le_iff_degree_le, degree_le_iff_coeff_zero]
  intro n hn
  rw [Nat.cast_lt] at hn
  rw [coeff_reverse, revAt, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, ite_eq_right (not_le_of_gt hn),
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hn]

name: natDegree_eq_reverse_natDegree_add_natTrailingDegree
statement:
theorem natDegree_eq_reverse_natDegree_add_natTrailingDegree (f : R[X]) :
    f.natDegree = f.reverse.natDegree + f.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · rw [hf, reverse_zero, natDegree_zero, natTrailingDegree_zero]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine tsub_le_iff_right.mp ?_
    apply le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
    rw [reverse, coeff_reflect, ← revAt_le f.natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree, revAt_invol]
    exact trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.mpr hf
  · rw [← le_tsub_iff_left f.reverse_natDegree_le]
    apply natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero
    have key := mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp (mt reverse_eq_zero.mp hf)
    rwa [leadingCoeff, coeff_reverse, revAt_le f.reverse_natDegree_le] at key

name: reverse_natDegree
statement: theorem reverse_natDegree (f : R[X]) : f.reverse.natDegree = f.natDegree - f.natTrailingDegree

name: reverse_leadingCoeff
statement: theorem reverse_leadingCoeff (f : R[X]) : f.reverse.leadingCoeff = f.trailingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, reverse_natDegree, ← revAt_le f.natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree,
    coeff_reverse, revAt_invol, trailingCoeff]

name: natTrailingDegree_reverse
statement: theorem natTrailingDegree_reverse (f : R[X]) : f.reverse.natTrailingDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [natTrailingDegree_eq_zero, reverse_eq_zero, coeff_zero_reverse, leadingCoeff_ne_zero]
  exact eq_or_ne _ _

name: reverse_trailingCoeff
statement: theorem reverse_trailingCoeff (f : R[X]) : f.reverse.trailingCoeff = f.leadingCoeff

name: reverse_mul
statement:
theorem reverse_mul {f g : R[X]} (fg : f.leadingCoeff * g.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) :
    reverse (f * g) = reverse f * reverse g
proof:
:= by
  unfold reverse
  rw [natDegree_mul' fg, reflect_mul f g rfl.le rfl.le]

name: reverse_mul_of_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_mul_of_domain {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f g : R[X]) :
    reverse (f * g) = reverse f * reverse g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases f0 : f = 0
  · simp only [f0, zero_mul, reverse_zero]
  by_cases g0 : g = 0
  · rw [g0, mul_zero, reverse_zero, mul_zero]
  simp [reverse_mul, *]

name: trailingCoeff_mul
statement:
theorem trailingCoeff_mul {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (p q : R[X]) :
    (p * q).trailingCoeff = p.trailingCoeff * q.trailingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reverse_leadingCoeff, reverse_mul_of_domain, leadingCoeff_mul, reverse_leadingCoeff,
    reverse_leadingCoeff]

name: coeff_one_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_one_reverse (f : R[X]) : coeff (reverse f) 1 = nextCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_reverse, nextCoeff]
  split_ifs with hf
  · have : coeff f 1 = 0 := coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by simp only [hf, zero_lt_one])
    simp [*, revAt]
  · rw [revAt_le]
    exact Nat.succ_le_iff.2 (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hf)

name: reverse_C
statement:
@[simp] lemma reverse_C (t : R) :
    reverse (C t) = C t

name: reverse_mul_X
statement: @[simp] lemma reverse_mul_X (p : R[X]) : reverse (p * X) = reverse p
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · simp
  · simp [reverse, hp]

name: reverse_X_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma reverse_X_mul (p : R[X]) : reverse (X * p) = reverse p

name: reverse_mul_X_pow
statement: @[simp] lemma reverse_mul_X_pow (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : reverse (p * X ^ n) = reverse p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, reverse_mul_X, ih]

name: reverse_X_pow_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma reverse_X_pow_mul (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : reverse (X ^ n * p) = reverse p

name: reverse_add_C
statement:
@[simp] lemma reverse_add_C (p : R[X]) (t : R) :
    reverse (p + C t) = reverse p + C t * X ^ p.natDegree

name: reverse_C_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma reverse_C_add (p : R[X]) (t : R) :
    reverse (C t + p) = C t * X ^ p.natDegree + reverse p

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_reverse_mul_pow (i : R →+* S) (x : S) [Invertible x] (f : R[X]) :
    eval₂ i (⅟x) (reverse f) * x ^ f.natDegree = eval₂ i x f

name: eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval₂_reverse_eq_zero_iff (i : R →+* S) (x : S) [Invertible x] (f : R[X]) :
    eval₂ i (⅟x) (reverse f) = 0 ↔ eval₂ i x f = 0

name: reflect_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_neg (f : R[X]) (N : ℕ) : reflect N (-f) = -reflect N f
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, ← C_1, ← C_neg, reflect_C_mul, C_neg, C_1, ← neg_eq_neg_one_mul]

name: reflect_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflect_sub (f g : R[X]) (N : ℕ) : reflect N (f - g) = reflect N f - reflect N g

name: reverse_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_neg (f : R[X]) : reverse (-f) = -reverse f

name: signVariations_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signVariations_zero : signVariations (0 : R[X]) = 0

name: signVariations_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signVariations_monomial (d : ℕ) (c : R) : signVariations (monomial d c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcz : c = 0
  · simp [hcz]
  · simp [hcz, signVariations, coeffList_eraseLead (mt (monomial_eq_zero_iff c d).mp hcz)]

name: signVariations_eraseLead
statement:
theorem signVariations_eraseLead (h : SignType.sign P.leadingCoeff = SignType.sign P.nextCoeff) :
    signVariations P.eraseLead = signVariations P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpz : P = 0
  · simp_all
  · have h₂ : nextCoeff P ≠ 0 := by intro; simp_all
    obtain ⟨_, hl⟩ := coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff (mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero h₂)
    simp [signVariations, List.destutter, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff h₂, hl, h, h₂,
      coeffList_eraseLead hpz]

name: signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite
statement:
theorem signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite {P : Polynomial R} (h : P ≠ 0) :
    signVariations P = signVariations P.eraseLead + if SignType.sign P.leadingCoeff
      = -SignType.sign P.eraseLead.leadingCoeff then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpz : P = 0
  · simp_all
  have hsl : SignType.sign (leadingCoeff P) ≠ 0 := by simp_all
  rw [signVariations, signVariations, coeffList_eraseLead hpz]
  rw [List.map_cons, List.map_append, List.map_replicate]
  rcases h_eL : P.eraseLead.coeffList with _ | ⟨c, cs⟩
  · simp [coeffList_eq_nil.mp h_eL, h]
  simp only [List.filter_append, List.filter_replicate, List.map_cons, List.filter, ne_eq, hsl]
  have h₁ : SignType.sign c ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h₂
    suffices eraseLead P = 0 by grind [coeffList_zero]
    by_contra h
    have := coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff h
    grind [leadingCoeff_eq_zero, sign_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [decide_not, sign_zero, List.destutter, Bool.false_eq_true, reduceIte, h₁,
    decide_false, Bool.not_false, List.nil_append, List.destutter', decide_true, Bool.not_true]
  obtain rfl : c = leadingCoeff P.eraseLead := by
    have h_eL : eraseLead P ≠ 0 := by simp [← coeffList_eq_nil, h_eL]
    obtain ⟨ls, hls⟩ := coeffList_eq_cons_leadingCoeff h_eL
    grind
  by_cases h₄ : SignType.sign P.leadingCoeff = SignType.sign P.eraseLead.leadingCoeff
  · grind [SignType.neg_eq_self_iff]
  rw [ite_eq_left h₄, ite_eq_left ?_]
  · grind [Nat.sub_add_cancel, List.length_pos_of_ne_nil, List.destutter'_ne_nil]
  cases _ : SignType.sign P.leadingCoeff
  <;> cases _ : SignType.sign P.eraseLead.leadingCoeff
  <;> grind [= SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, SignType.zero_eq_zero, SignType.pos_eq_one,
      SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, neg_neg]

name: signVariations_eraseLead_le
statement: theorem signVariations_eraseLead_le : signVariations P.eraseLead ≤ signVariations P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpz : P = 0
  · simp [hpz]
  · grind [signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite]

name: signVariations_le_eraseLead_succ
statement: theorem signVariations_le_eraseLead_succ : signVariations P ≤ signVariations P.eraseLead + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpz : P = 0
  · simp [hpz]
  · grind [signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite]

name: signVariations_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signVariations_neg : signVariations (-P) = signVariations P
proof:
:= by
  rw [signVariations, signVariations, coeffList_neg]
  simp only [List.map_map, List.filter_map]
  have hsc : SignType.sign ∘ (fun (x : R) => -x) = (fun x => -x) ∘ SignType.sign := by
    grind [Left.sign_neg]
  have h_neg_destutter (l : List SignType) :
      (l.destutter (¬· = ·)).map (- ·) = (l.map (- ·)).destutter (¬· = ·) := by
    grind [List.map_destutter, neg_inj]
  rw [hsc, List.comp_map, ← h_neg_destutter, List.length_map]
  congr 5
  funext
  simp [SignType.sign]

name: signVariations_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signVariations_C_mul (P : Polynomial R) (hx : η ≠ 0) :
    signVariations (C η * P) = signVariations P
proof:
:= by
  wlog! hx2 : 0 < η
  · simpa [lt_of_le_of_ne hx2, hx] using this (η := -η) (P := -P)
  rw [signVariations, signVariations]
  rw [coeffList_C_mul _ (lt_or_lt_iff_ne.mp (.inr hx2)), ← List.comp_map]
  congr 5
  funext
  simp [hx2, sign_mul]

name: signVariations_eraseLead_mul_X_sub_C
statement:
lemma signVariations_eraseLead_mul_X_sub_C (hη : 0 < η) (hP₀ : 0 < leadingCoeff P)
    (hc : P.nextCoeff < 0) :
    ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead.signVariations = ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).signVariations
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one.mpr (natDegree_pos_of_nextCoeff_ne_zero hc.ne)
  have hndxP : natDegree ((X - C η) * P) = P.natDegree + 1 := by
    have hPn0 : P ≠ 0 :=
      leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mp hP₀.ne'
    rw [natDegree_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero η) hPn0, natDegree_X_sub_C, add_comm]
  have hndxeP : natDegree ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead) = P.natDegree := by
    have hePn0 : P.eraseLead ≠ 0 :=
      mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero hc.ne
    rw [natDegree_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero η) hePn0, natDegree_X_sub_C, add_comm]
    exact natDegree_eraseLead_add_one hc.ne
  have hQ : ((X - C η) * P).nextCoeff = coeff P d - η * coeff P (d + 1) := by
    grind [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos, coeff_X_sub_C_mul]
  have hQ₁ : ((X - C η) * P).nextCoeff < 0 := by
    rw [hQ, sub_neg]
    trans 0
    · grind [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos]
    · exact hd ▸ mul_pos hη hP₀
  have hndexP0 : natDegree (eraseLead ((X - C η) * P)) = P.natDegree := by
    apply Nat.add_right_cancel (m := 1)
    rw [← hndxP, natDegree_eraseLead_add_one hQ₁.ne]
  
  
  suffices eraseLead (eraseLead ((X - C η) * P)) = eraseLead ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead) by
    suffices (coeffList (eraseLead ((X - C η) * P))).map SignType.sign =
      (coeffList ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead)).map SignType.sign by
        rw [signVariations, signVariations, this]
    have : 0 < natDegree ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead) := by lia
    grind [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_X_sub_C, one_mul, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff,
      LT.lt.ne, sign_neg, coeffList_eraseLead, ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt,
      nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero]
  rw [← self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff hQ₁.ne]
  rw [hndexP0, ← self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_monic_mul (monic_X_sub_C η)]
  rw [← self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_monic_mul (monic_X_sub_C η)]
  rw [hndxeP, hndxP]
  rw [leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff hc.ne, ← self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff]
  rw [hQ, mul_sub, sub_mul, sub_mul, X_mul_monomial, C_mul_monomial, monomial_sub]
  rw [leadingCoeff, nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos (hd ▸ d.succ_pos), hd, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  abel

name: succ_signVariations_X_sub_C_mul_monomial
statement:
lemma succ_signVariations_X_sub_C_mul_monomial {d c} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hη : 0 < η) :
    (monomial d c).signVariations + 1 ≤ ((X - C η) * monomial d c).signVariations
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : nextCoeff ((X - C η) * monomial d c) = -(η * c) := by
    convert coeff_mul_monomial (X - C η) d 0 c
    · simp [hc, nextCoeff, natDegree_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero η)]
    · simp
  have h₂ : eraseLead ((X - C η) * monomial d c) ≠ 0 := by
    apply mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero
    simp [h₁, hc, hη.ne']
  have h₃ : SignType.sign c ≠ SignType.sign (-(η * c)) := by
    simp [hη, hc, Left.sign_neg, sign_mul]
  simpa [h₁, h₂, h₃, hc, hη.ne', signVariations, List.destutter_cons_cons,
    ← leadingCoeff_cons_eraseLead, coeffList_eraseLead, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff]
  using! List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (List.destutter'_ne_nil _ _)

name: exists_cons_of_leadingCoeff_pos
proof:
:= by
  have h₃ := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mp h₁.ne'
  have h₄ := natDegree_eraseLead_add_one h₂
  have h₅ : (X - C η) ≠ 0 := X_sub_C_ne_zero η
  have h₆ : P.eraseLead ≠ 0 := mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero h₂
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt (natDegree_pos_of_nextCoeff_ne_zero h₂)
  apply leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff at h₂
  have h_cons := coeffList_eraseLead (mul_ne_zero h₅ h₆)
  generalize ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).natDegree -
    ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).eraseLead.degree.succ = n at h_cons ⊢
  use nextCoeff ((X - C η) * P), .replicate n 0 ++ coeffList ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).eraseLead
  constructor
  · have h₇ : natDegree ((X - C η) * P) = P.natDegree + 1 := by
      rw [natDegree_mul h₅ h₃, natDegree_X_sub_C, add_comm]
    have h₈ : ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).eraseLead =
        (X - C η) * P.eraseLead - monomial P.natDegree P.nextCoeff := by
      simp [← self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff (_ * _), natDegree_mul,
        h₅, h₆, h₂, h₄, add_comm 1]
    have : P.eraseLead.natDegree + 2 = ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).coeffList.length := by
      simp [h₅, h₆, natDegree_mul, add_comm 1]
    have : P.natDegree + 2 = ((X - C η) * P).coeffList.length := by simp [X_sub_C_ne_zero, h₃, h₇]
    have := leadingCoeff_monic_mul (q := P) (monic_X_sub_C η)
    by_cases h₉ : ((X - C η) * P).nextCoeff = 0
    · suffices ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead = ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).eraseLead by
        have := coeffList_eraseLead (mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero η) h₃)
        #adaptation_note
        /
        Moving from `nightly-2025-10-13` to `nightly-2025-10-19`
        we now need to provide an intermediate step.
        -/
        have : ((X - C η) * P).natDegree - ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead.degree.succ = n + 1 := by grind
        grind [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_X_sub_C]
      suffices C η * monomial P.natDegree P.leadingCoeff = monomial P.natDegree P.nextCoeff by
        grind [X_mul_monomial, sub_mul, mul_sub, self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff]
      grind [leadingCoeff, nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos, eq_of_sub_eq_zero, coeff_X_sub_C_mul]
    · suffices ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead.eraseLead = ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).eraseLead by
        have := leadingCoeff_cons_eraseLead h₉
        have := coeffList_eraseLead (mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero h₉)
        grind [leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff]
      suffices monomial P.natDegree ((X - C η) * P).nextCoeff =
          monomial P.natDegree P.nextCoeff - C η * monomial P.natDegree P.leadingCoeff by
        grind [X_mul_monomial, sub_mul, mul_sub, self_sub_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff,
          natDegree_eraseLead_add_one, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff]
      grind [coeff_X_sub_C_mul, nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos, leadingCoeff]
  · rw [h_cons, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_X_sub_C, one_mul, h₂]

name: signVariations_X_sub_C_mul_eraseLead_le
statement:
lemma signVariations_X_sub_C_mul_eraseLead_le (h : 0 < P.leadingCoeff) (h₂ : 0 < P.nextCoeff) :
    signVariations ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead) ≤ signVariations ((X - C η) * P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, cs, ⟨hcs, hecs⟩⟩ := exists_cons_of_leadingCoeff_pos η h h₂.ne'
  simp +decide only [hcs, hecs, h, h₂, signVariations, List.destutter, List.map_cons, sign_pos,
    List.filter_cons_of_pos, tsub_le_iff_right,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (List.destutter'_ne_nil _ _))]
  rw [List.filter_cons]
  split; swap 
  · rfl
  rw [List.destutter'_cons]
  split; swap 
  · rfl
  rcases hcs : (cs.map SignType.sign).filter fun x ↦ decide (x ≠ 0) with _ | ⟨r, rs⟩
  · simp
  · rw [← List.destutter_cons', ← List.destutter_cons']
    grind [List.destutter_cons_cons]

name: succ_signVariations_le_X_sub_C_mul
statement:
theorem succ_signVariations_le_X_sub_C_mul (hη : 0 < η) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    signVariations P + 1 ≤ signVariations ((X - C η) * P)
proof:
:= by
  
  generalize hd : P.natDegree = d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing P with | _ d ih =>
  
  wlog h_lC : 0 < leadingCoeff P generalizing P with H
  · simpa using @H (-P) (by simpa) (by simpa) (by grind [leadingCoeff_eq_zero, leadingCoeff_neg])
  
  have h_mul : (X - C η) * P ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero η) hP
  have h_deg_mul : natDegree ((X - C η) * P) = natDegree P + 1 := by
    rw [natDegree_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero η) hP, natDegree_X_sub_C, add_comm]
  rcases d with _ | d
  · 
    have hcQ : 0 < coeff P 0 := by grind [leadingCoeff]
    have hxcQ : coeff ((X - C η) * P) 1 = coeff P 0 := by
      simp_all [coeff_X_sub_C_mul, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt]
    dsimp [signVariations, coeffList]
    rw [withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one hP, withBotSucc_degree_eq_natDegree_add_one h_mul]
    simp [h_deg_mul, hxcQ, hη, hcQ, hd, List.range_succ]
  
  generalize hs_nC : SignType.sign P.nextCoeff = s_nC
  generalize hs_nC_mul : SignType.sign ((X - C η) * P).nextCoeff = s_nC_mul
  
  have h_ih : P.eraseLead.natDegree < d + 1 := by grind [eraseLead_natDegree_le]
  have h_mul_lC : SignType.sign ((X - C η) * P).leadingCoeff = 1 := by simp [h_lC]
  have h_ηP : 0 < η * coeff P (d + 1) := by grind [leadingCoeff, mul_pos]
  rcases s_nC.trichotomy with rfl | rfl | rfl; rotate_left
  · 
    obtain rfl : s_nC_mul = -1 := by
      have : coeff P d = 0 := by simpa [nextCoeff, hd] using hs_nC
      simp [*, ← hs_nC_mul, nextCoeff, coeff_X_sub_C_mul]
    /- We would like to just `have : eraseLead P ≠ 0`, so that we can use the inductive
      hypothesis on eraseLead P. but that isn't actually true: we could have P a monomial
      and then eraseLead P = 0, and then the inductive hypothesis doesn't hold. (It's only
      true as written for P ≠ 0.) So we need to do a case-split and handle this separately. -/
    by_cases eraseLead P = 0
    · grind [succ_signVariations_X_sub_C_mul_monomial,
        eraseLead_add_monomial_natDegree_leadingCoeff, zero_add]
    · /- Dropping the lead of the product exactly drops the first two of the eraseLead. This
        decreases the sign variations of the eraseLead by at least one, and of the product by at
       most one, so we can induct. -/
      have : signVariations ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead + 1 =
          signVariations ((X - C η) * P) := by
        simp [-leadingCoeff_mul, ← sign_ne_zero,
          signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite h_mul, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff,
          hs_nC_mul, h_mul_lC]
      have : ((X - C η) * P.eraseLead).signVariations ≤
          ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead.signVariations := by
        have := signVariations_eraseLead_le (eraseLead ((X - C η) * P))
        rwa [← eraseLead_mul_eq_mul_eraseLead_of_nextCoeff_zero hη.ne']
        grind [sign_eq_zero_iff]
      grind [signVariations_le_eraseLead_succ]
  all_goals
    have h₁ : nextCoeff P ≠ 0 := by simp [← sign_ne_zero, hs_nC]
    specialize ih _ h_ih (mt nextCoeff_eq_zero_of_eraseLead_eq_zero h₁) rfl
  · /- P starts with [+,+,...]. (X-C)*P starts with [+,?,...]. After dropping the lead of P, this
      becomes [+,...] and [+,...]. So the sign variations on P are unchanged when we induct, while
      (X-C)*P can only lose at most one sign change. -/
    have : P.signVariations = P.eraseLead.signVariations + 0 := by
      simp [signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite hP, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff h₁, *]
    grind [sign_eq_one_iff, signVariations_X_sub_C_mul_eraseLead_le]
  · /- P starts with [+,-,...], so (X-C)*P starts with [+,-,...]. After dropping the lead of P, this
    becomes [-,...] and [-,...]. Dropping the first one of each decreases (X-C)*P by one and P by
    one, so we can induct. -/
    have : P.signVariations = P.eraseLead.signVariations + 1 := by
      simp [signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite hP, leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff h₁, *]
    trans ((X - C η) * P).eraseLead.signVariations + 1
    · grind [signVariations_eraseLead_mul_X_sub_C, sign_eq_neg_one_iff]
    · suffices SignType.sign ((X - C η) * P).nextCoeff = -1 by
        simp +decide [signVariations_eq_eraseLead_add_ite h_mul, h_lC,
          leadingCoeff_eraseLead_eq_nextCoeff, ← sign_eq_zero_iff, this]
      grind [← sign_eq_neg_one_iff, coeff_X_sub_C_mul, nextCoeff]

name: roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations
statement: theorem roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations : P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ signVariations P
proof:
:= by
  generalize h : P.roots.countP (0 < ·) = num_pos_roots
  induction num_pos_roots generalizing P 
  · exact zero_le
  rename_i ih
  have hp : P ≠ 0 := by grind [roots_zero, Multiset.countP_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨η, η_root, η_pos⟩ : ∃ x, x ∈ P.roots ∧ 0 < x := by grind [Multiset.countP_pos]
  
  obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (isRoot_of_mem_roots η_root)
  
  grw [ih Q, succ_signVariations_le_X_sub_C_mul η_pos]
  · exact right_ne_zero_of_mul hp
  · simp [← h, roots_mul (ne_zero_of_mem_roots η_root), η_pos, ← Nat.succ.injEq]

name: Monic.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three
statement:
theorem Monic.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic)
    (hp2 : 2 ≤ p.natDegree) (hp3 : p.natDegree ≤ 3) : Irreducible p ↔ p.roots = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne_zero
  have hp1 : p ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; rw [natDegree_one] at hp2; cases hp2
  rw [hp.irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt hp1]
  simp_rw [show p.natDegree / 2 = 1 from
      (Nat.div_le_div_right hp3).antisymm
        (by apply Nat.div_le_div_right (c := 2) hp2),
    show Finset.Ioc 0 1 = {1} from rfl,
    Finset.mem_singleton, Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem, mem_roots hp0, ← dvd_iff_isRoot]
  refine ⟨fun h r ↦ h _ (monic_X_sub_C r) (natDegree_X_sub_C r), fun h q hq hq1 ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hq.eq_X_add_C hq1, ← sub_neg_eq_add, ← C_neg]
  apply h

name: irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three
statement:
theorem irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three
    (hp2 : 2 ≤ p.natDegree) (hp3 : p.natDegree ≤ 3) :
    Irreducible p ↔ p.roots = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [natDegree_zero] at hp2; cases hp2
  rw [← irreducible_mul_leadingCoeff_inv,
      (monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hp0).irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three,
      mul_comm, roots_C_mul]
  · exact inv_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp0)
  · rwa [natDegree_mul_leadingCoeff_inv _ hp0]
  · rwa [natDegree_mul_leadingCoeff_inv _ hp0]

name: irreducible_of_degree_le_three_of_not_isRoot
statement:
lemma irreducible_of_degree_le_three_of_not_isRoot
    (hdeg : p.natDegree ∈ Finset.Icc 1 3) (hnot : ∀ x, ¬ IsRoot p x) :
    Irreducible p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hdeg
  by_cases hdeg2 : 2 ≤ p.natDegree
  · rw [Polynomial.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three hdeg2 hdeg.2]
    apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
    simp_all
  · apply Polynomial.irreducible_of_degree_eq_one
    rw [← Nat.cast_one, Polynomial.degree_eq_iff_natDegree_eq_of_pos (by simp)]
    exact le_antisymm (by rwa [not_le, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hdeg2) hdeg.1

name: smeval_eq_sum
statement: theorem smeval_eq_sum : p.smeval x = p.sum (smul_pow x)

name: smeval_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_C : (C r).smeval x = r • x ^ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smeval_eq_sum, smul_pow, zero_smul, sum_C_index]

name: smeval_monomial
statement:

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_smulOneHom_eq_smeval (R : Type*) [Semiring R] {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Module R S]
    [IsScalarTower R S S] (p : R[X]) (x : S) :
    p.eval₂ RingHom.smulOneHom x = p.smeval x
proof:

name: smeval_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_zero : (0 : R[X]).smeval x = 0

name: smeval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_one : (1 : R[X]).smeval x = 1 • x ^ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_1, smeval_C]
  simp only [one_smul]

name: smeval_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_X :
    (X : R[X]).smeval x = x ^ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smeval_eq_sum, smul_pow, zero_smul, sum_X_index, one_smul]

name: smeval_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_X_pow {n : ℕ} :
    (X ^ n : R[X]).smeval x = x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smeval_eq_sum, smul_pow, X_pow_eq_monomial, zero_smul, sum_monomial_index, one_smul]

name: smeval_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_add : (p + q).smeval x = p.smeval x + q.smeval x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smeval_eq_sum]
  refine sum_add_index p q (smul_pow x) (fun _ ↦ ?_) (fun _ _ _ ↦ ?_)
  · rw [smul_pow, zero_smul]
  · rw [smul_pow, smul_pow, smul_pow, add_smul]

name: smeval_natCast
statement: theorem smeval_natCast (n : ℕ) : (n : R[X]).smeval x = n • x ^ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [smeval_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]
  | succ n ih => rw [n.cast_succ, smeval_add, ih, smeval_one, ← add_nsmul]

name: smeval_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_smul (r : R) : (r • p).smeval x = r • p.smeval x
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => rw [smul_add, smeval_add, ph, qh, ← smul_add, smeval_add]
  | monomial n a => rw [smul_monomial, smeval_monomial, smeval_monomial, smul_assoc]

name: smeval.linearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval.linearMap_apply : smeval.linearMap R x p = p.smeval x

name: leval_coe_eq_smeval
statement:
theorem leval_coe_eq_smeval {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (r : R) :
    ⇑(leval r) = fun p => p.smeval r

name: leval_eq_smeval.linearMap
statement:
theorem leval_eq_smeval.linearMap {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (r : R) :
    leval r = smeval.linearMap R r
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext ?_
  intro
  rw [leval_apply, smeval.linearMap_apply, eval_eq_smeval]

name: smeval_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_neg : (-p).smeval x = -p.smeval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, ← smeval_add, neg_add_cancel, smeval_zero]

name: smeval_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smeval_sub : (p - q).smeval x = p.smeval x - q.smeval x

name: smeval_neg_nat
statement:
theorem smeval_neg_nat (S : Type*) [NonAssocRing S] [Pow S ℕ] [NatPowAssoc S] (q : ℕ[X])
    (n : ℕ) : q.smeval (-(n : S)) = q.smeval (-n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smeval_eq_sum, smeval_eq_sum]
  simp only [Polynomial.smul_pow, sum_def]
  simp

name: smeval_C_mul
statement: theorem smeval_C_mul : (C r * p).smeval x = r • p.smeval x
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => simp only [mul_add, smeval_add, ph, qh, smul_add]
  | monomial n b => simp only [C_mul_monomial, smeval_monomial, mul_smul]

name: smeval_at_natCast
statement: theorem smeval_at_natCast (q : ℕ[X]) : ∀ (n : ℕ), q.smeval (n : S) = q.smeval n
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh =>
    intro n
    simp only [smeval_add, ph, qh, Nat.cast_add]
  | monomial n a =>
    intro n
    rw [smeval_monomial, smeval_monomial, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_npow]

name: smeval_at_zero
statement: theorem smeval_at_zero : p.smeval (0 : S) = (p.coeff 0) • (1 : S)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => simp_all only [smeval_add, coeff_add, add_smul]
  | monomial n a =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [monomial_zero_left, smeval_C, npow_zero, coeff_C_zero]
    | succ n => rw [coeff_monomial_succ, smeval_monomial, npow_add, npow_one, mul_zero, zero_smul,
        smul_zero]

name: smeval_X_mul
statement: theorem smeval_X_mul : (X * p).smeval x = x * p.smeval x
proof:
:= by
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => simp only [smeval_add, ph, qh, mul_add]
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [← monomial_one_one_eq_X, monomial_mul_monomial, smeval_monomial, one_mul, npow_add,
      npow_one, ← mul_smul_comm, smeval_monomial]

name: smeval_X_pow_assoc
statement:
theorem smeval_X_pow_assoc (m n : ℕ) :
    x ^ m * x ^ n * p.smeval x = x ^ m * (x ^ n * p.smeval x)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => simp only [smeval_add, ph, qh, mul_add]
  | monomial n a => simp only [smeval_monomial, mul_smul_comm, npow_mul_assoc]

name: smeval_X_pow_mul
statement:
theorem smeval_X_pow_mul : ∀ (n : ℕ), (X ^ n * p).smeval x = x ^ n * p.smeval x
  | 0 => by
    simp [npow_zero, one_mul]
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [add_comm, npow_add, mul_assoc, npow_one, smeval_X_mul, smeval_X_pow_mul n, npow_add,
      smeval_X_pow_assoc, npow_one]

name: smeval_monomial_mul
statement:
theorem smeval_monomial_mul (n : ℕ) :
    (monomial n r * p).smeval x = r • (x ^ n * p.smeval x)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add r s hr hs =>
    simp only [smeval_add]
    rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_assoc, smeval_C_mul, smeval_X_pow_mul, smeval_add]
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [smeval_monomial, monomial_mul_monomial, smeval_monomial, npow_add, mul_smul, mul_smul_comm]

name: smeval_mul_X
statement: theorem smeval_mul_X : (p * X).smeval x = p.smeval x * x
proof:
:= by
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => simp only [add_mul, smeval_add, ph, qh]
  | monomial n a =>
    simp only [← monomial_one_one_eq_X, monomial_mul_monomial, smeval_monomial, mul_one,
      npow_add, smul_mul_assoc, npow_one]

name: smeval_assoc_X_pow
statement:
theorem smeval_assoc_X_pow (m n : ℕ) :
    p.smeval x * x ^ m * x ^ n = p.smeval x * (x ^ m * x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ph qh => simp only [smeval_add, ph, qh, add_mul]
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [smeval_monomial, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, npow_mul_assoc, ← smul_mul_assoc]

name: smeval_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem smeval_mul_X_pow : ∀ (n : ℕ), (p * X ^ n).smeval x = p.smeval x * x ^ n
  | 0 => by
    simp only [npow_zero, mul_one]
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [npow_add, ← mul_assoc, npow_one, smeval_mul_X, smeval_mul_X_pow n, npow_add,
      ← smeval_assoc_X_pow, npow_one]

variable [SMulCommClass R S S]

name: smeval_mul
statement: theorem smeval_mul : (p * q).smeval x = p.smeval x * q.smeval x
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add r s hr hs => simp only [hr, hs, smeval_add, add_mul]
  | monomial n a =>
    simp only [smeval_monomial, smeval_monomial_mul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: smeval_pow
statement:
theorem smeval_pow : ∀ (n : ℕ), (p ^ n).smeval x = (p.smeval x) ^ n
  | 0 => by
    simp only [npow_zero, smeval_one, one_smul]
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [npow_add, smeval_mul, smeval_pow n, pow_one, npow_add, npow_one]

name: smeval_comp
statement: theorem smeval_comp : (p.comp q).smeval x = p.smeval (q.smeval x)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add r s hr hs => simp [add_comp, hr, hs, smeval_add]
  | monomial n a => simp [smeval_monomial, smeval_C_mul, smeval_pow]

name: smeval_commute_left
statement: theorem smeval_commute_left (hc : Commute x y) : Commute (p.smeval x) y
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add r s hr hs => exact (smeval_add R r s x) ▸ Commute.add_left hr hs
  | monomial n a => simpa [smeval_monomial] using Commute.smul_left (Commute.pow_left hc _) _

name: smeval_commute
statement: theorem smeval_commute (hc : Commute x y) : Commute (p.smeval x) (q.smeval y)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add r s hr hs => exact (smeval_add R r s x) ▸ Commute.add_left hr hs
  | monomial n a =>
    simp only [smeval_monomial]
    refine Commute.smul_left ?_ a
    induction n with
    | zero => simp only [npow_zero, Commute.one_left]
    | succ n ih =>
      refine (commute_iff_eq (x ^ (n + 1)) (q.smeval y)).mpr ?_
      rw [commute_iff_eq (x ^ n) (q.smeval y)] at ih
      have hxq : x * q.smeval y = q.smeval y * x := by
        refine (commute_iff_eq x (q.smeval y)).mp ?_
        exact Commute.symm (smeval_commute_left R q (Commute.symm hc))
      rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← ih, mul_assoc, hxq, mul_assoc]

name: aeval_eq_smeval
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_smeval {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    (x : S) (p : R[X]) : aeval x p = p.smeval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, eval₂_def, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one', smeval_def]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]
  exact rfl

name: aeval_coe_eq_smeval
statement:
theorem aeval_coe_eq_smeval {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    (x : S) : ⇑(aeval x) = fun (p : R[X]) => p.smeval x
proof: := funext fun p => aeval_eq_smeval x p

name: homogenize_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_zero (n : ℕ) : homogenize (0 : R[X]) n = 0

name: homogenize_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_add (p q : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    homogenize (p + q) n = homogenize p n + homogenize q n

name: homogenize_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_smul {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Module S R] (c : S) (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    homogenize (c • p) n = c • homogenize p n

name: homogenize_finsetSum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    homogenize (∑ i ∈ s, p i) n = ∑ i ∈ s, homogenize (p i) n

name: homogenize_map
statement:
lemma homogenize_map {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    homogenize (p.map f) n = MvPolynomial.map f (homogenize p n)

name: homogenize_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_C_mul (c : R) (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    homogenize (C c * p) n = .C c * homogenize p n

name: homogenize_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_monomial {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (r : R) :
    homogenize (monomial m r) n = .monomial (fun₀ | 0 => m | 1 => n - m) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogenize, Finset.sum_eq_single (a := (m, n - m))]
  · simp
  · aesop (add simp coeff_monomial)
  · simp [h]

name: homogenize_monomial_of_lt
statement:
lemma homogenize_monomial_of_lt {m n : ℕ} (h : n < m) (r : R) :
    homogenize (monomial m r) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogenize]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  aesop (add simp coeff_monomial)

name: homogenize_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_X_pow {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    homogenize (X ^ m : R[X]) n = .X 0 ^ m * .X 1 ^ (n - m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, homogenize_monomial h, Finsupp.update_eq_add_single (by simp),
    MvPolynomial.monomial_single_add, ← MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial]

name: homogenize_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_X {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : homogenize (X : R[X]) n = .X 0 * .X 1 ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_one X, homogenize_X_pow, pow_one]
  rwa [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]

name: homogenize_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_C (c : R) (n : ℕ) : homogenize (.C c) n = .C c * .X 1 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [MvPolynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial] using homogenize_monomial (Nat.zero_le n) c

name: homogenize_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_one (n : ℕ) : homogenize (1 : R[X]) n = .X 1 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using homogenize_C (1 : R) n

name: coeff_homogenize
statement:
lemma coeff_homogenize (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    (homogenize p n).coeff m = if m 0 + m 1 = n then coeff p (m 0) else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q ihp ihq =>
    simp [*, ite_add_ite]
  | monomial k c =>
    rcases le_or_gt k n with hkn | hnk
    · rw [homogenize_monomial hkn, coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
      have : (fun₀ | 0 => m 0 | 1 => m 1) = m := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
      aesop
    · aesop (add simp homogenize_monomial_of_lt) (add simp coeff_monomial)

name: eq_zero_of_homogenize_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_homogenize_eq_zero {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n)
    (h : p.homogenize n = 0) :
    p = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [coeff_zero]
  rcases le_or_gt i p.natDegree with H | H
  · have : p.coeff i = (p.homogenize n).coeff fun₀ | 0 => i | 1 => n - i := by
      simp [coeff_homogenize, Nat.add_sub_of_le (H.trans hn)]
    simp [this, h]
  · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt H

name: homogenize_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma homogenize_eq_zero_iff {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    p.homogenize n = 0 ↔ p = 0

name: eval
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.induction_with_natDegree_le
    (fun p ↦ MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (p.homogenize n) = p.eval₂ f (g 0)) (N := n)
  · simp
  · simp +contextual [hg]
  · simp +contextual
  · assumption

name: aeval_homogenize_of_eq_one
aeval_homogenize_X_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma aeval_homogenize_X_one (p : R[X]) {n : ℕ} (hn : natDegree p ≤ n) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval ![X, 1] (p.homogenize n) = p

name: isHomogeneous_homogenize
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isHomogeneous_homogenize {n : ℕ} (p : R[X]) : (p.homogenize n).IsHomogeneous n
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.sum _ _ _ ?_
  simp only [Prod.forall, mem_antidiagonal]
  rintro a b rfl
  apply MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial
  simp [Finsupp.update_eq_add_single]

name: homogenize_eq_of_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  subst p
  rw [q.as_sum]
  simp only [MvPolynomial.aeval_sum, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, ← C_eq_algebraMap,
    homogenize_finsetSum, homogenize_C_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq]
  congr 1
  obtain rfl : m.weight 1 = n := hq <| by simpa using hm
  simp [Finsupp.prod_fintype, Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype, Fin.prod_univ_two,
    Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: homogenize_mul
statement:
lemma homogenize_mul (p q : R[X]) {m n : ℕ} (hm : natDegree p ≤ m) (hn : natDegree q ≤ n) :
    homogenize (p * q) (m + n) = homogenize p m * homogenize q n
proof:
:= by
  apply homogenize_eq_of_isHomogeneous
  · apply_rules [MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.mul, isHomogeneous_homogenize]
  · simp [*]

name: homogenize_finsetProd
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s hi ihs =>
    simp only [prod_cons, sum_cons, forall_mem_cons] at *
    rw [homogenize_mul _ _ h.1, ihs h.2]
    exact (natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans (sum_le_sum h.2)

name: homogenize_dvd
statement:
lemma homogenize_dvd [NoZeroDivisors R] {p q : R[X]} (h : p ∣ q) :
    homogenize p p.natDegree ∣ homogenize q q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨r, rfl⟩
  obtain rfl | rfl | ⟨hp₀, hr₀⟩ : p = 0 ∨ r = 0 ∨ p ≠ 0 ∧ r ≠ 0 := by tauto
  · simp
  · simp
  · rw [natDegree_mul hp₀ hr₀, homogenize_mul _ _ le_rfl le_rfl]
    apply dvd_mul_right

name: homogenize_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_neg (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : (-p).homogenize n = -p.homogenize n

name: homogenize_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogenize_sub (p q : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (p - q).homogenize n = p.homogenize n - q.homogenize n

name: eval_homogenize
statement:
lemma eval_homogenize {p : K[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (x : Fin 2 → K) (hx : x 1 ≠ 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (p.homogenize n) = p.eval (x 0 / x 1) * x 1 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homogenize, Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hn),
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, Finset.sum_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_monomial, Finsupp.update_eq_add_single, Finsupp.prod_add_index',
    Finsupp.prod_single_index, Finsupp.prod_single_index, pow_sub₀]
  · ring
  all_goals simp_all [pow_add]

name: toTupleMvPolynomial_zero_eq
statement:
lemma toTupleMvPolynomial_zero_eq (p : R[X]) :
    p.toTupleMvPolynomial 0 = p.homogenize p.natDegree

name: toTupleMvPolynomial_one_eq
statement:
lemma toTupleMvPolynomial_one_eq (p : R[X]) :
    p.toTupleMvPolynomial 1 = (MvPolynomial.X 1) ^ p.natDegree

name: isHomogeneous_toTupleMvPolynomial
statement:
lemma isHomogeneous_toTupleMvPolynomial (p : R[X]) (i : Fin 2) :
    (p.toTupleMvPolynomial i).IsHomogeneous p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · simp [toTupleMvPolynomial]
  · simpa [toTupleMvPolynomial] using MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X_pow 1 p.natDegree

name: eval_X_toTupleMvPolynomial_zero_eq
statement:
lemma eval_X_toTupleMvPolynomial_zero_eq (p : R[X]) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval ![X, 1] (p.toTupleMvPolynomial 0) =
      p * MvPolynomial.aeval ![X, 1] (p.toTupleMvPolynomial 1)

name: eval_eq_div_eval_toTupleMvPolynomial
statement:
lemma eval_eq_div_eval_toTupleMvPolynomial {R : Type*} [Field R] (p : R[X]) (x : R) :
    p.eval x =
      (p.toTupleMvPolynomial 0).eval ![x, 1] / (p.toTupleMvPolynomial 1).eval ![x, 1]

name: sum_eq_natDegree_of_mem_support_homogenize
proof:
:= by
  simp [(isHomogeneous_homogenize p).degree_eq_sum_deg_support hs, ← Finsupp.degree_apply,
        Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]

name: finsuppSum_homogenize_eq
statement:
lemma finsuppSum_homogenize_eq {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (p : R[X]) {f : R → M} :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff <| p.homogenize p.natDegree).sum (fun _ c ↦ f c) =
      p.sum fun _ c ↦ f c
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.sum_def, sum_def p]
  
  
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun s ↦ s 0) (fun n ↦ fun₀ | 0 => n | 1 => p.natDegree - n)
    (fun s hs ↦ ?_) (fun n hn ↦ ?_) (fun s hs ↦ ?_) (fun n hn ↦ by simp)
    fun s hs ↦ ?_
  · simpa [coeff_homogenize, sum_eq_natDegree_of_mem_support_homogenize p hs] using hs
  · simpa [coeff_homogenize, mem_support_iff.mp hn]
      using Nat.add_sub_of_le <| le_natDegree_of_mem_supp n hn
  · 
    grind only [= Finsupp.update_apply, = Finsupp.single_apply,
      sum_eq_natDegree_of_mem_support_homogenize p hs]
  · simp [coeff_homogenize, sum_eq_natDegree_of_mem_support_homogenize p hs]

name: coe_expand
statement: theorem coe_expand : (expand R p : R[X] → R[X]) = eval₂ C (X ^ p)

name: expand_eq_comp_X_pow
statement: theorem expand_eq_comp_X_pow {f : R[X]} : expand R p f = f.comp (X ^ p)

name: expand_eq_sum
statement: theorem expand_eq_sum {f : R[X]} : expand R p f = f.sum fun e a => C a * (X ^ p) ^ e

name: expand_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_C (r : R) : expand R p (C r) = C r

name: expand_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_X : expand R p X = X ^ p

name: expand_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_monomial (r : R) : expand R p (monomial q r) = monomial (q * p) r
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← smul_X_eq_monomial, map_smul, map_pow, expand_X, mul_comm, pow_mul]

name: expand_expand
statement: theorem expand_expand (f : R[X]) : expand R p (expand R q f) = expand R (p * q) f
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.induction_on f (fun r => by simp_rw [expand_C])
    (fun f g ihf ihg => by simp_rw [map_add, ihf, ihg]) fun n r _ => by
    simp_rw [map_mul, expand_C, map_pow, expand_X, map_pow, expand_X, pow_mul]

name: expand_mul
statement: theorem expand_mul (f : R[X]) : expand R (p * q) f = expand R p (expand R q f)

name: expand_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_zero (f : R[X]) : expand R 0 f = C (eval 1 f)

name: expand_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_one (f : R[X]) : expand R 1 f = f
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.induction_on f (fun r => by rw [expand_C])
    (fun f g ihf ihg => by rw [map_add, ihf, ihg]) fun n r _ => by
    rw [map_mul, expand_C, map_pow, expand_X, pow_one]

name: expand_pow
statement: theorem expand_pow (f : R[X]) : expand R (p ^ q) f = (expand R p)^[q] f
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn q (by rw [pow_zero, expand_one, Function.iterate_zero, id]) fun n ih => by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', pow_succ', expand_mul, ih]

name: derivative_expand
statement:
theorem derivative_expand (f : R[X]) : Polynomial.derivative (expand R p f) =
    expand R p (Polynomial.derivative f) * (p * (X ^ (p - 1) : R[X]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_expand, derivative_eval₂_C, derivative_pow, C_eq_natCast, derivative_X, mul_one]

name: coeff_expand
statement:
theorem coeff_expand {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (expand R p f).coeff n = if p ∣ n then f.coeff (n / p) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expand_eq_sum]
  simp_rw [coeff_sum, ← pow_mul, C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, coeff_monomial, sum]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n / p), Nat.mul_div_cancel' h, ite_eq_left rfl]
    · intro b _ hb2
      rw [ite_eq_right]
      intro hb3
      apply hb2
      rw [← hb3, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left b hp]
    · intro hn
      rw [notMem_support_iff.1 hn]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    intro k _
    rw [ite_eq_right]
    exact fun hkn => h ⟨k, hkn.symm⟩

name: coeff_expand_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_expand_mul {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (expand R p f).coeff (n * p) = f.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_expand hp, ite_eq_left (dvd_mul_left _ _), Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hp]

name: coeff_expand_mul'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_expand_mul' {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (expand R p f).coeff (p * n) = f.coeff n

name: expand_injective
statement: theorem expand_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Function.Injective (expand R n)
proof:
:= fun g g' H =>
  ext fun k => by rw [← coeff_expand_mul hn, H, coeff_expand_mul hn]

name: expand_inj
statement: theorem expand_inj {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {f g : R[X]} : expand R p f = expand R p g ↔ f = g

name: expand_eq_zero
statement: theorem expand_eq_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {f : R[X]} : expand R p f = 0 ↔ f = 0

name: expand_ne_zero
statement: theorem expand_ne_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {f : R[X]} : expand R p f ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0

name: expand_eq_C
statement: theorem expand_eq_C {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {f : R[X]} {r : R} : expand R p f = C r ↔ f = C r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← expand_C, expand_inj hp, expand_C]

name: natDegree_expand
statement: theorem natDegree_expand (p : ℕ) (f : R[X]) : (expand R p f).natDegree = f.natDegree * p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p.eq_zero_or_pos with hp | hp
  · rw [hp, coe_expand, pow_zero, mul_zero, ← C_1, eval₂_hom, natDegree_C]
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · rw [hf, map_zero, natDegree_zero, zero_mul]
  have hf1 : expand R p f ≠ 0 := mt (expand_eq_zero hp).1 hf
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := WithBot ℕ), ← degree_eq_natDegree hf1]
  refine le_antisymm ((degree_le_iff_coeff_zero _ _).2 fun n hn => ?_) ?_
  · rw [coeff_expand hp]
    split_ifs with hpn
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt]
      contrapose! hn
      norm_cast
      rw [← Nat.div_mul_cancel hpn]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right p hn
    · rfl
  · refine le_degree_of_ne_zero ?_
    rw [coeff_expand_mul hp, ← leadingCoeff]
    exact mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.1 hf

name: leadingCoeff_expand
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_expand {p : ℕ} {f : R[X]} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (expand R p f).leadingCoeff = f.leadingCoeff

name: monic_expand_iff
statement: theorem monic_expand_iff {p : ℕ} {f : R[X]} (hp : 0 < p) : (expand R p f).Monic ↔ f.Monic

name: map_expand
statement:
theorem map_expand {p : ℕ} {f : R →+* S} {q : R[X]} :
    map f (expand R p q) = expand S p (map f q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp]
  ext
  rw [coeff_map, coeff_expand (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp), coeff_expand (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp)]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: expand_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_eval (p : ℕ) (P : R[X]) (r : R) : eval r (expand R p P) = eval (r ^ p) P
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.induction_on P (fun a => by simp) (fun f g hf hg => ?_) fun n a _ => by simp
  rw [map_add, eval_add, eval_add, hf, hg]

name: expand_aeval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_aeval {A : Type*} [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] (p : ℕ) (P : R[X]) (r : A) :
    aeval r (expand R p P) = aeval (r ^ p) P
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.induction_on P (fun a => by simp) (fun f g hf hg => ?_) fun n a _ => by simp
  rw [map_add, aeval_add, aeval_add, hf, hg]

name: coeff_contract
statement:
theorem coeff_contract {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (contract p f).coeff n = f.coeff (n * p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [contract, coeff_monomial, sum_ite_eq', finsetSum_coeff, mem_range, not_lt,
    ite_eq_left_iff]
  intro hn
  apply (coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt _).symm
  calc
    f.natDegree < f.natDegree + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    _ ≤ n * 1 := by simpa only [mul_one] using hn
    _ ≤ n * p := by gcongr; exact hp.bot_lt

name: map_contract
statement:
theorem map_contract {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) {f : R →+* S} {q : R[X]} :
    (q.contract p).map f = (q.map f).contract p
proof:
:= ext fun n ↦ by
  simp only [coeff_map, coeff_contract hp]

name: contract_expand
statement: theorem contract_expand {f : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : contract p (expand R p f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [coeff_contract hp, coeff_expand hp.bot_lt, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hp.bot_lt]

name: contract_one
statement: theorem contract_one {f : R[X]} : contract 1 f = f
proof:
:=
  ext fun n ↦ by rw [coeff_contract one_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: contract_C
statement: @[simp] theorem contract_C (r : R) : contract p (C r) = C r

name: contract_add
statement:
theorem contract_add {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (f g : R[X]) :
    contract p (f + g) = contract p f + contract p g
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp_rw [coeff_add, coeff_contract hp, coeff_add]

name: contract_mul_expand
statement:
theorem contract_mul_expand {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (f g : R[X]) :
    contract p (f * expand R p g) = contract p f * g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_contract hp, coeff_mul, coeff_mul, ← sum_subset
    (s₁ := (antidiagonal n).image fun x ↦ (x.1 * p, x.2 * p)), sum_image]
  · simp_rw [coeff_expand_mul hp.bot_lt, coeff_contract hp]
  · intro x hx y hy eq; simpa only [Prod.ext_iff, Nat.mul_right_cancel_iff hp.bot_lt] using eq
  · simp_rw [subset_iff, mem_image, mem_antidiagonal]; rintro _ ⟨x, rfl, rfl⟩; simp_rw [add_mul]
  simp_rw [mem_image, mem_antidiagonal]
  intro ⟨x, y⟩ eq nex
  by_cases h : p ∣ y
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ : p ∣ x := (Nat.dvd_add_iff_left h).mpr (eq ▸ dvd_mul_left p n)
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h
    refine (nex ⟨⟨x, y⟩, (Nat.mul_right_cancel_iff hp.bot_lt).mp ?_, by simp_rw [mul_comm]⟩).elim
    rw [← eq, mul_comm, mul_add]
  · rw [coeff_expand hp.bot_lt, ite_eq_right h, mul_zero]

name: isCoprime_expand
statement:
@[simp] theorem isCoprime_expand {f g : R[X]} {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (expand R p f) (expand R p g) ↔ IsCoprime f g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨a, b, eq⟩ ↦ ⟨contract p a, contract p b, by
    simp_rw [← contract_mul_expand hp, ← contract_add hp, eq, ← C_1, contract_C]⟩, (·.map _)⟩

name: expand_contract
statement:
theorem expand_contract [CharP R p] [NoZeroDivisors R] {f : R[X]} (hf : Polynomial.derivative f = 0)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) : expand R p (contract p f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_expand hp.bot_lt, coeff_contract hp]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel h]
  · rcases n with - | n
    · exact absurd (dvd_zero p) h
    have := coeff_derivative f n
    rw [hf, coeff_zero, zero_eq_mul] at this
    rcases this with h' | _
    · rw [h']
    rename_i _ _ _ h'
    rw [← Nat.cast_succ, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p] at h'
    exact absurd h' h

name: expand_contract'
statement:
theorem expand_contract' [NoZeroDivisors R] {f : R[X]} (hf : Polynomial.derivative f = 0) :
    expand R p (contract p f) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | @⟨_, hprime, hchar⟩ := ‹ExpChar R p›
  · rw [expand_one, contract_one]
  · have := Fact.mk hchar; exact expand_contract p hf hprime.ne_zero

name: map_frobenius_expand
statement: theorem map_frobenius_expand (f : R[X]) : map (frobenius R p) (expand R p f) = f ^ p
proof:
:= by
  refine f.induction_on' (fun a b ha hb => ?_) fun n a => ?_
  · rw [map_add, Polynomial.map_add, ha, hb, add_pow_expChar]
  · rw [expand_monomial, map_monomial, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial,
      mul_pow, ← C.map_pow, frobenius_def]
    ring

name: map_iterateFrobenius_expand
statement:
theorem map_iterateFrobenius_expand (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    map (iterateFrobenius R p n) (expand R (p ^ n) f) = f ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k n_ih =>
    symm
    conv_lhs => rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, ← n_ih]
    simp_rw [← map_frobenius_expand p, pow_succ', add_comm k, iterateFrobenius_add,
      ← map_map, ← map_expand, ← expand_mul, iterateFrobenius_one]

name: rootMultiplicity_expand_pow
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_expand_pow :
    (expand R (p ^ n) f).rootMultiplicity r = p ^ n * f.rootMultiplicity (r ^ p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h0 := eq_or_ne f 0; · simp
  obtain ⟨g, hg, ndvd⟩ := f.exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd h0 (r ^ p ^ n)
  rw [dvd_iff_isRoot, ← eval_X (x := r), ← eval_pow, ← isRoot_comp, ← expand_eq_comp_X_pow] at ndvd
  conv_lhs => rw [hg, map_mul, map_pow, map_sub, expand_X, expand_C, map_pow, ← sub_pow_expChar_pow,
    ← pow_mul, mul_comm, rootMultiplicity_mul_X_sub_C_pow (expand_ne_zero (expChar_pow_pos R p n)
      |>.mpr <| right_ne_zero_of_mul <| hg ▸ h0), rootMultiplicity_eq_zero ndvd, zero_add]

name: rootMultiplicity_expand
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_expand :
    (expand R p f).rootMultiplicity r = p * f.rootMultiplicity (r ^ p)

name: isLocalHom_expand
statement: theorem isLocalHom_expand {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) : IsLocalHom (expand R p)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun f hf1 => ?_⟩
  have hf2 := eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero (degree_eq_zero_of_isUnit hf1)
  rw [coeff_expand hp, ite_eq_left (dvd_zero _), p.zero_div] at hf2
  rw [hf2, isUnit_C] at hf1; rw [expand_eq_C hp] at hf2; rwa [hf2, isUnit_C]

name: of_irreducible_expand
statement:
theorem of_irreducible_expand {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) {f : R[X]} (hf : Irreducible (expand R p f)) :
    Irreducible f

name: of_irreducible_expand_pow
statement:
theorem of_irreducible_expand_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) {f : R[X]} {n : ℕ} :
    Irreducible (expand R (p ^ n) f) → Irreducible f
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n (fun hf => by rwa [pow_zero, expand_one] at hf) fun n ih hf =>
    ih <| of_irreducible_expand hp <| by
      rw [pow_succ'] at hf
      rwa [expand_expand]

name: mirror_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mirror_zero : (0 : R[X]).mirror = 0

name: mirror_monomial
statement: theorem mirror_monomial (n : ℕ) (a : R) : (monomial n a).mirror = monomial n a
proof:
:= by
  classical
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · rw [ha, monomial_zero_right, mirror_zero]
    · rw [mirror, reverse, natDegree_monomial n a, ite_eq_right ha, natTrailingDegree_monomial ha, ←
        C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, reflect_C_mul_X_pow, revAt_le (le_refl n), tsub_self, pow_zero,
        mul_one]

name: mirror_C
statement: theorem mirror_C (a : R) : (C a).mirror = C a

name: mirror_X
statement: theorem mirror_X : X.mirror = (X : R[X])

name: mirror_natDegree
statement: theorem mirror_natDegree : p.mirror.natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, mirror_zero]
  nontriviality R
  rw [mirror, natDegree_mul', reverse_natDegree, natDegree_X_pow,
    tsub_add_cancel_of_le p.natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree]
  rwa [leadingCoeff_X_pow, mul_one, reverse_leadingCoeff, Ne, trailingCoeff_eq_zero]

name: mirror_natTrailingDegree
statement: theorem mirror_natTrailingDegree : p.mirror.natTrailingDegree = p.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, mirror_zero]
  · rw [mirror, natTrailingDegree_mul_X_pow ((mt reverse_eq_zero.mp) hp),
      natTrailingDegree_reverse, zero_add]

name: coeff_mirror
statement:
theorem coeff_mirror (n : ℕ) :
    p.mirror.coeff n = p.coeff (revAt (p.natDegree + p.natTrailingDegree) n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h2 : p.natDegree < n
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rwa [mirror_natDegree])]
    by_cases h1 : n ≤ p.natDegree + p.natTrailingDegree
    · rw [revAt_le h1, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree]
      grw [h2, add_tsub_cancel_left]
    · rw [← revAtFun_eq, revAtFun, ite_eq_right h1, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt h2]
  rw [not_lt] at h2
  rw [revAt_le (h2.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))]
  by_cases h3 : p.natTrailingDegree ≤ n
  · rw [← tsub_add_eq_add_tsub h2, ← tsub_tsub_assoc h2 h3, mirror, coeff_mul_X_pow',
      ite_eq_left h3, coeff_reverse, revAt_le (tsub_le_self.trans h2)]
  rw [not_le] at h3
  rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_tsub_iff_right.mpr (Nat.add_lt_add_left h3 _))]
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree (by rwa [mirror_natTrailingDegree])

name: mirror_eval_one
statement: theorem mirror_eval_one : p.mirror.eval 1 = p.eval 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eval_eq_sum_range, one_pow, mul_one, mirror_natDegree]
  refine Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun n _ _ => revAt (p.natDegree + p.natTrailingDegree) n
  · intro n hn hp
    rw [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff] at *
    rw [revAt_le (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))]
    rw [tsub_le_iff_tsub_le, add_comm, add_tsub_cancel_right, ← mirror_natTrailingDegree]
    exact natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero hp
  · exact fun n₁ _ _ _ _ _ h => by rw [← @revAt_invol _ n₁, h, revAt_invol]
  · intro n hn hp
    use revAt (p.natDegree + p.natTrailingDegree) n
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, revAt_invol⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff] at *
      rw [revAt_le (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))]
      rw [tsub_le_iff_tsub_le, add_comm, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      exact natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero hp
    · change p.mirror.coeff _ ≠ 0
      rwa [coeff_mirror, revAt_invol]
  · exact fun n _ _ => p.coeff_mirror n

name: mirror_mirror
statement: theorem mirror_mirror : p.mirror.mirror = p
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.ext fun n => by
    rw [coeff_mirror, coeff_mirror, mirror_natDegree, mirror_natTrailingDegree, revAt_invol]

name: mirror_involutive
statement: theorem mirror_involutive : Function.Involutive (mirror : R[X] → R[X])

statement: theorem mirror_eq_iff : p.mirror = q ↔ p = q.mirror

name: mirror_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mirror_inj : p.mirror = q.mirror ↔ p = q

name: mirror_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mirror_eq_zero : p.mirror = 0 ↔ p = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← p.mirror_mirror, h, mirror_zero], fun h => by rw [h, mirror_zero]⟩

name: mirror_trailingCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mirror_trailingCoeff : p.mirror.trailingCoeff = p.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, trailingCoeff, mirror_natTrailingDegree, coeff_mirror,
    revAt_le (Nat.le_add_left _ _), add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: mirror_leadingCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mirror_leadingCoeff : p.mirror.leadingCoeff = p.trailingCoeff

name: coeff_mul_mirror
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_mirror :
    (p * p.mirror).coeff (p.natDegree + p.natTrailingDegree) = p.sum fun _ => (· ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  refine
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_).trans
      (p.sum_eq_of_subset (fun _ ↦ (· ^ 2)) (fun _ ↦ zero_pow two_ne_zero) fun n hn ↦
          Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr
            ((le_natDegree_of_mem_supp n hn).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))).symm
  rw [coeff_mirror, ← revAt_le (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp hn), revAt_invol, ← sq]

name: natDegree_mul_mirror
statement: theorem natDegree_mul_mirror : (p * p.mirror).natDegree = 2 * p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, zero_mul, natDegree_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [natDegree_mul hp (mt mirror_eq_zero.mp hp), mirror_natDegree, two_mul]

name: natTrailingDegree_mul_mirror
statement:
theorem natTrailingDegree_mul_mirror :
    (p * p.mirror).natTrailingDegree = 2 * p.natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, zero_mul, natTrailingDegree_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [natTrailingDegree_mul hp (mt mirror_eq_zero.mp hp), mirror_natTrailingDegree, two_mul]

name: mirror_mul_of_domain
statement: theorem mirror_mul_of_domain : (p * q).mirror = p.mirror * q.mirror
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, zero_mul, mirror_zero, zero_mul]
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · rw [hq, mul_zero, mirror_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [mirror, mirror, mirror, reverse_mul_of_domain, natTrailingDegree_mul hp hq, pow_add]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc q.reverse, ← X_pow_mul (p := reverse q)]
  repeat' rw [mul_assoc]

name: mirror_smul
statement: theorem mirror_smul (a : R) : (a • p).mirror = a • p.mirror
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_mul', ← C_mul', mirror_mul_of_domain, mirror_C]

name: mirror_neg
statement: theorem mirror_neg : (-p).mirror = -p.mirror
proof:
:= by
  rw [mirror, mirror, reverse_neg, natTrailingDegree_neg, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]

name: irreducible_of_mirror
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_mirror (h1 : ¬IsUnit f)
    (h2 : ∀ k, f * f.mirror = k * k.mirror → k = f ∨ k = -f ∨ k = f.mirror ∨ k = -f.mirror)
    (h3 : IsRelPrime f f.mirror) : Irreducible f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact h1
  · intro g h fgh
    let k := g * h.mirror
    have key : f * f.mirror = k * k.mirror := by
      rw [fgh, mirror_mul_of_domain, mirror_mul_of_domain, mirror_mirror, mul_assoc, mul_comm h,
        mul_comm g.mirror, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    have g_dvd_f : g ∣ f := by
      rw [fgh]
      exact dvd_mul_right g h
    have h_dvd_f : h ∣ f := by
      rw [fgh]
      exact dvd_mul_left h g
    have g_dvd_k : g ∣ k := dvd_mul_right g h.mirror
    have h_dvd_k_rev : h ∣ k.mirror := by
      rw [mirror_mul_of_domain, mirror_mirror]
      exact dvd_mul_left h g.mirror
    have hk := h2 k key
    rcases hk with (hk | hk | hk | hk)
    · exact Or.inr (h3 h_dvd_f (by rwa [← hk]))
    · exact Or.inr (h3 h_dvd_f (by rwa [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr hk, mirror_neg, dvd_neg]))
    · exact Or.inl (h3 g_dvd_f (by rwa [← hk]))
    · exact Or.inl (h3 g_dvd_f (by rwa [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr hk, dvd_neg]))
