name: of_mem_support_derivative
statement:
theorem of_mem_support_derivative {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (h : n ∈ p.derivative.support) :
    n + 1 ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  mem_support_iff.2 fun h1 : p.coeff (n + 1) = 0 =>
    mem_support_iff.1 h <| show p.derivative.coeff n = 0 by rw [coeff_derivative, h1, zero_mul]

name: degree_derivative_lt
statement: theorem degree_derivative_lt {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : p.derivative.degree < p.degree
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sup_lt_iff <| bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 <| mt degree_eq_bot.1 hp).2 fun n hp =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 n.lt_succ_self) <|
      Finset.le_sup <| of_mem_support_derivative hp

name: degree_derivative_le
statement: theorem degree_derivative_le {p : R[X]} : p.derivative.degree ≤ p.degree
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if H : p = 0 then le_of_eq <| by rw [H, derivative_zero] else (degree_derivative_lt H).le

name: natDegree_derivative_lt
statement:
theorem natDegree_derivative_lt {p : R[X]} (hp : p.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    p.derivative.natDegree < p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (derivative p) 0 with hp' | hp'
  · rw [hp', Polynomial.natDegree_zero]
    exact hp.bot_lt
  · rw [natDegree_lt_natDegree_iff hp']
    exact degree_derivative_lt fun h => hp (h.symm ▸ natDegree_zero)

name: natDegree_derivative_le
statement: theorem natDegree_derivative_le (p : R[X]) : p.derivative.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases p0 : p.natDegree = 0
  · simp [p0, derivative_of_natDegree_zero]
  · exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (natDegree_derivative_lt p0)

name: natDegree_iterate_derivative
statement:
theorem natDegree_iterate_derivative (p : R[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    (derivative^[k] p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Nat.sub_zero]
  | succ d hd =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Nat.sub_succ']
      exact (natDegree_derivative_le _).trans <| Nat.sub_le_sub_right hd 1

name: derivative_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_natCast {n : ℕ} : derivative (n : R[X]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_natCast C n]
  exact derivative_C

name: derivative_ofNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_ofNat (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    derivative (ofNat(n) : R[X]) = 0

name: iterate_derivative_eq_zero
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_eq_zero {p : R[X]} {x : ℕ} (hx : p.natDegree < x) :
    Polynomial.derivative^[x] p = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction h : p.natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing p x with | _ _ ih
  subst h
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (pos_of_gt hx).ne'
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
  by_cases hp : p.natDegree = 0
  · rw [derivative_of_natDegree_zero hp, iterate_derivative_zero]
  have := natDegree_derivative_lt hp
  exact ih _ this (this.trans_le <| Nat.le_of_lt_succ hx) rfl

name: iterate_derivative_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_C {k} (h : 0 < k) : derivative^[k] (C a : R[X]) = 0

name: iterate_derivative_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_one {k} (h : 0 < k) : derivative^[k] (1 : R[X]) = 0

name: iterate_derivative_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_X {k} (h : 1 < k) : derivative^[k] (X : R[X]) = 0

name: derivative_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_mul {f g : R[X]} : derivative (f * g) = derivative f * g + f * derivative g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add => simp only [add_mul, map_add, add_assoc, add_left_comm, *]
  | monomial m a => ?_
  induction g using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add => simp only [mul_add, map_add, add_assoc, add_left_comm, *]
  | monomial n b => ?_
  simp only [monomial_mul_monomial, derivative_monomial]
  simp only [mul_assoc, (Nat.cast_commute _ _).eq, Nat.cast_add, mul_add, map_add]
  cases m with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
  | succ m =>
  cases n with
  | zero => simp only [add_zero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
  | succ n => grind

name: derivative_eval
statement:
theorem derivative_eval (p : R[X]) (x : R) :
    p.derivative.eval x = p.sum fun n a => a * n * x ^ (n - 1)

name: derivative_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_map [Semiring S] (p : R[X]) (f : R →+* S) :
    derivative (p.map f) = p.derivative.map f
proof:
:= by
  let n := max p.natDegree (map f p).natDegree
  rw [derivative_apply, derivative_apply]
  rw [sum_over_range' _ _ (n + 1) ((le_max_left _ _).trans_lt (lt_add_one _))]
  on_goal 1 => rw [sum_over_range' _ _ (n + 1) ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt (lt_add_one _))]
  · simp only [Polynomial.map_sum, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, map_mul, coeff_map,
      map_natCast, Polynomial.map_natCast, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X]
  all_goals intro n; rw [zero_mul, C_0, zero_mul]

name: iterate_derivative_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_map [Semiring S] (p : R[X]) (f : R →+* S) (k : ℕ) :
    Polynomial.derivative^[k] (p.map f) = (Polynomial.derivative^[k] p).map f
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [ih, Function.iterate_succ, Polynomial.derivative_map, Function.comp_apply]

name: derivative_natCast_mul
statement:
theorem derivative_natCast_mul {n : ℕ} {f : R[X]} :
    derivative ((n : R[X]) * f) = n * derivative f

name: iterate_derivative_natCast_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_natCast_mul {n k : ℕ} {f : R[X]} :
    derivative^[k] ((n : R[X]) * f) = n * derivative^[k] f
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing f <;> simp [*]

name: coeff_iterate_derivative
statement:
theorem coeff_iterate_derivative {k} (p : R[X]) (m : ℕ) :
    (derivative^[k] p).coeff m = (m + k).descFactorial k • p.coeff (m + k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      calc
        (derivative^[k + 1] p).coeff m
        _ = Nat.descFactorial (Nat.succ (m + k)) k • p.coeff (m + k.succ) * (m + 1) := by
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', coeff_derivative, ih m.succ, Nat.succ_add, Nat.add_succ]
        _ = ((m + 1) * Nat.descFactorial (Nat.succ (m + k)) k) • p.coeff (m + k.succ) := by
          rw [← Nat.cast_add_one, ← nsmul_eq_mul', smul_smul]
        _ = Nat.descFactorial (m.succ + k) k.succ • p.coeff (m + k.succ) := by
          rw [← Nat.succ_add, Nat.descFactorial_succ, add_tsub_cancel_right]
        _ = Nat.descFactorial (m + k.succ) k.succ • p.coeff (m + k.succ) := by
          rw [Nat.succ_add_eq_add_succ]

name: iterate_derivative_eq_sum
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_eq_sum (p : R[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] p =
      ∑ x ∈ (derivative^[k] p).support, C ((x + k).descFactorial k • p.coeff (x + k)) * X ^ x
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [(derivative^[k] p).as_sum_support_C_mul_X_pow]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_iterate_derivative, Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]

name: iterate_derivative_eq_factorial_smul_sum
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_eq_factorial_smul_sum (p : R[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] p = k ! •
      ∑ x ∈ (derivative^[k] p).support, C ((x + k).choose k • p.coeff (x + k)) * X ^ x
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [iterate_derivative_eq_sum]
  rw [smul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← smul_mul_assoc, smul_C, smul_smul, Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]

name: iterate_derivative_mul
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_mul {n} (p q : R[X]) :
    derivative^[n] (p * q) =
      ∑ k ∈ range n.succ, (n.choose k • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k] q))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp [Finset.range]
  | succ n IH =>
    calc
      derivative^[n + 1] (p * q) =
          derivative (∑ k ∈ range n.succ,
              n.choose k • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k] q)) := by
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', IH]
      _ = (∑ k ∈ range n.succ,
            n.choose k • (derivative^[n - k + 1] p * derivative^[k] q)) +
          ∑ k ∈ range n.succ,
            n.choose k • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k + 1] q) := by
        simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, nsmul_eq_mul, derivative_mul, derivative_natCast, zero_mul,
          derivative_sum, zero_add, Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply]
        simp_rw [mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
      _ = (∑ k ∈ range n.succ,
                n.choose k.succ • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k + 1] q)) +
              1 • (derivative^[n + 1] p * derivative^[0] q) +
            ∑ k ∈ range n.succ, n.choose k • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k + 1] q) :=
        ?_
      _ = ((∑ k ∈ range n.succ, n.choose k • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k + 1] q)) +
              ∑ k ∈ range n.succ,
                n.choose k.succ • (derivative^[n - k] p * derivative^[k + 1] q)) +
            1 • (derivative^[n + 1] p * derivative^[0] q) := by
        rw [add_comm, add_assoc]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ range n.succ,
              (n + 1).choose (i + 1) • (derivative^[n + 1 - (i + 1)] p * derivative^[i + 1] q)) +
            1 • (derivative^[n + 1] p * derivative^[0] q) := by
        simp_rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ, add_smul, sum_add_distrib]
      _ = ∑ k ∈ range n.succ.succ,
            n.succ.choose k • (derivative^[n.succ - k] p * derivative^[k] q) := by
        rw [sum_range_succ' _ n.succ, Nat.choose_zero_right, tsub_zero]
    congr
    refine (sum_range_succ' _ _).trans (congr_arg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_)
    · rw [sum_range_succ, Nat.choose_succ_self, zero_smul, add_zero]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
      rw [mem_range] at hk
      congr
      lia
    · rw [Nat.choose_zero_right, tsub_zero]

name: support_derivativeFinsupp_subset_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_derivativeFinsupp_subset_range {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (h : p.natDegree < n) :
    (derivativeFinsupp p).support ⊆ range n

name: derivativeFinsupp_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivativeFinsupp_C (r : R) : derivativeFinsupp (C r : R[X]) = .single 0 (C r)
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  match i with
  | 0 => simp
  | i + 1 => simp

name: derivativeFinsupp_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivativeFinsupp_one : derivativeFinsupp (1 : R[X]) = .single 0 1

name: derivativeFinsupp_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivativeFinsupp_X : derivativeFinsupp (X : R[X]) = .single 0 X + .single 1 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  match i with
  | 0 => simp
  | 1 => simp
  | (n + 2) => simp

name: derivativeFinsupp_map
statement:
theorem derivativeFinsupp_map [Semiring S] (p : R[X]) (f : R →+* S) :
    derivativeFinsupp (p.map f) = (derivativeFinsupp p).mapRange (·.map f) (by simp)

name: derivativeFinsupp_derivative
statement:
theorem derivativeFinsupp_derivative (p : R[X]) :
    derivativeFinsupp (derivative p) =
      (derivativeFinsupp p).comapDomain Nat.succ Nat.succ_injective.injOn

name: mem_support_derivative
statement: lemma mem_support_derivative : n ∈ (derivative p).support ↔ n + 1 ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  suffices ¬p.coeff (n + 1) * (n + 1 : ℕ) = 0 ↔ coeff p (n + 1) ≠ 0 by
    simpa only [mem_support_iff, coeff_derivative, Ne, Nat.cast_succ]
  rw [← nsmul_eq_mul', smul_eq_zero]
  simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, false_or]

name: degree_derivative
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degree_derivative (hp : p.natDegree ≠ 0) : degree (derivative p) = ↑(natDegree p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [derivative_apply]
    apply le_trans (degree_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sup_le _)
    intro n hn
    apply le_trans (degree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _) (WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 (tsub_le_tsub_right _ _))
    apply le_natDegree_of_mem_supp _ hn
  · refine le_sup ?_
    rw [mem_support_derivative, tsub_add_cancel_of_le (by lia), mem_support_iff,
      coeff_natDegree, leadingCoeff_ne_zero]
    rintro rfl
    simp at hp

name: natDegree_derivative
statement:
@[simp]
lemma natDegree_derivative (p : R[X]) : p.derivative.natDegree = p.natDegree - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.natDegree = 0
  · grind [natDegree_derivative_le]
  · simp [natDegree, degree_derivative hp]

name: derivative_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma derivative_eq_zero : p.derivative = 0 ↔ p.natDegree = 0 where
  mp hp
proof:
:= by
    obtain rfl | hp' := eq_or_ne p 0
    · exact natDegree_zero
    rw [natDegree_eq_zero_iff_degree_le_zero]
    by_contra! f_nat_degree_pos
    rw [← natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos] at f_nat_degree_pos
    let m := p.natDegree - 1
    have hm : m + 1 = p.natDegree := tsub_add_cancel_of_le (by lia)
    have h2 := coeff_derivative p m
    rw [Polynomial.ext_iff] at hp
    rw [hp m, coeff_zero, ← Nat.cast_add_one, ← nsmul_eq_mul', eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at h2
    replace h2 := h2.resolve_left m.succ_ne_zero
    rw [hm, ← leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_eq_zero] at h2
    exact hp' h2
  mpr hp := by rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hp, derivative_C]

name: derivative_ne_zero
statement: lemma derivative_ne_zero : p.derivative ≠ 0 ↔ p.natDegree ≠ 0

name: leadingCoeff_derivative
statement:
@[simp] lemma leadingCoeff_derivative (p : R[X]) :
    leadingCoeff (derivative p) = leadingCoeff p * p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.natDegree = 0
  · simp [hp]
  rw [leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff, coeff_derivative, natDegree_derivative]
  norm_cast
  congr <;> lia

name: eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero
statement: lemma eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero (h : derivative p = 0) : p = C (p.coeff 0)

name: degree_derivative_eq
statement:
@[deprecated degree_derivative (since := "2026-06-03")]
lemma degree_derivative_eq (p : R[X]) (hp : 0 < natDegree p) :
    degree (derivative p) = (natDegree p - 1 : ℕ)

name: derivative_pow_succ
statement:
theorem derivative_pow_succ (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    derivative (p ^ (n + 1)) = C (n + 1 : R) * p ^ n * derivative p
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n (by simp) fun n ih => by
    rw [pow_succ, derivative_mul, ih, Nat.add_one, mul_right_comm, C_add,
      add_mul, add_mul, pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, C_1, one_mul]; simp [add_mul]

name: derivative_pow
statement:
theorem derivative_pow (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    derivative (p ^ n) = C (n : R) * p ^ (n - 1) * derivative p
proof:
:=
  Nat.casesOn n (by simp) fun n ↦
    by rw [p.derivative_pow_succ n, Nat.add_one_sub_one, n.cast_succ]

name: derivative_sq
statement: theorem derivative_sq (p : R[X]) : derivative (p ^ 2) = C 2 * p * derivative p

name: pow_sub_one_dvd_derivative_of_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem pow_sub_one_dvd_derivative_of_pow_dvd {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ}
    (dvd : q ^ n ∣ p) : q ^ (n - 1) ∣ derivative p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := dvd
  rw [derivative_mul, derivative_pow]
  exact (((dvd_mul_left _ _).mul_right _).mul_right _).add ((pow_dvd_pow q n.pred_le).mul_right _)

name: pow_sub_dvd_iterate_derivative_of_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem pow_sub_dvd_iterate_derivative_of_pow_dvd {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ)
    (dvd : q ^ n ∣ p) : q ^ (n - m) ∣ derivative^[m] p
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing p with
  | zero => simpa
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Nat.sub_succ, Function.iterate_succ']
    exact pow_sub_one_dvd_derivative_of_pow_dvd (ih dvd)

name: pow_sub_dvd_iterate_derivative_pow
statement:
theorem pow_sub_dvd_iterate_derivative_pow (p : R[X]) (n m : ℕ) :
    p ^ (n - m) ∣ derivative^[m] (p ^ n)

name: dvd_iterate_derivative_pow
statement:
theorem dvd_iterate_derivative_pow (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (c : R) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (n : R) ∣ eval c (derivative^[m] (f ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, derivative_pow, mul_assoc, C_eq_natCast,
    iterate_derivative_natCast_mul, eval_mul, eval_natCast]
  exact dvd_mul_right _ _

name: iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_natCast_mul
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_natCast_mul (n k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] (X ^ n : R[X]) = ↑(Nat.descFactorial n k : R[X]) * X ^ (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [Function.iterate_zero_apply, tsub_zero, Nat.descFactorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, derivative_natCast_mul, derivative_X_pow, C_eq_natCast,
      Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.cast_mul]
    simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_C_mul
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_C_mul (n k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] (X ^ n : R[X]) = C (Nat.descFactorial n k : R) * X ^ (n - k)

name: iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_smul
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_smul (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] (X ^ n : R[X]) = (Nat.descFactorial n k : R) • X ^ (n - k)

name: derivative_X_add_C_pow
statement:
theorem derivative_X_add_C_pow (c : R) (m : ℕ) :
    derivative ((X + C c) ^ m) = C (m : R) * (X + C c) ^ (m - 1)

name: derivative_X_add_C_sq
statement: theorem derivative_X_add_C_sq (c : R) : derivative ((X + C c) ^ 2) = C 2 * (X + C c)

name: iterate_derivative_X_add_pow
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_X_add_pow (n k : ℕ) (c : R) :
    derivative^[k] ((X + C c) ^ n) = Nat.descFactorial n k • (X + C c) ^ (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k IH =>
      simp [Nat.sub_succ', Function.iterate_succ_apply', IH, derivative_X_add_C_pow]
      ring

name: iterate_derivative_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_mul_X_pow (n m : ℕ) (p : R[X]) :
    derivative^[n] (p * X ^ m) =
      ∑ k ∈ range (min m n).succ,
        (n.choose k * m.descFactorial k) • (derivative^[n - k] p * X ^ (m - k))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : derivative^[n] (p * X ^ m) =
      ∑ k ∈ range n.succ,
        (n.choose k * m.descFactorial k) • (derivative^[n - k] p * X ^ (m - k)) := by
    simp_rw [iterate_derivative_mul, iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_smul, mul_smul]
    congr! 2 with k hk
    norm_cast
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  refine sum_congr_of_eq_on_inter (fun k hk hk' ↦ ?_) (by simp_all) (by simp)
  rcases le_or_gt k m with hkm | hkm
  · replace hk' : n < k := by simpa [hkm] using hk'
    simp [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hk']
  · simp [Nat.descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr hkm]

name: iterate_derivative_mul_X
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_mul_X {n : ℕ} (p : R[X]) :
    derivative^[n] (p * X) = (derivative^[n] p) * X + n • derivative^[n - 1] p
proof:
:= by
  convert! p.iterate_derivative_mul_X_pow n 1; · simp
  rcases n with rfl | n <;> simp [sum_range_succ]

name: iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X {n : ℕ} (p : R[X]) :
    derivative^[n] (derivative p * X) = (derivative^[n + 1] p) * X + n • derivative^[n] p
proof:
:= by
  convert! (derivative p).iterate_derivative_mul_X_pow n 1; · simp
  rcases n with rfl | n <;> simp [sum_range_succ]

name: iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X_sq
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X_sq {n : ℕ} (p : R[X]) :
    derivative^[n] (derivative^[2] p * X ^ 2) =
      (derivative^[n + 2] p) * X ^ 2 + (2 * n) • (derivative^[n + 1] p) * X +
        (n * (n - 1)) • derivative^[n] p
proof:
:= by
  convert! (derivative^[2] p).iterate_derivative_mul_X_pow n 2
  rcases n with rfl | n; · simp
  rcases n with rfl | n; · simp [sum_range_succ, ← mul_assoc]
  suffices ((n + 1 + 1) * (n + 1) / 2) * 2 = (n + 1 + 1) * (n + 1) by
    simp -implicitDefEqProofs [this, -nsmul_eq_mul, sum_range_succ, Nat.choose_two_right]
    ring
  rw [mul_comm (n + 1 + 1)]
  exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.two_dvd_mul_add_one _)

name: derivative_comp
statement:
theorem derivative_comp (p q : R[X]) :
    derivative (p.comp q) = derivative q * p.derivative.comp q
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on'
  · simp [*, mul_add]
  · simp only [derivative_pow, derivative_mul, monomial_comp, derivative_monomial, derivative_C,
      zero_mul, C_eq_natCast, zero_add, map_mul]
    ring

name: derivative_eval
statement:
theorem derivative_eval₂_C (p q : R[X]) :
    derivative (p.eval₂ C q) = p.derivative.eval₂ C q * derivative q
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.induction_on p (fun r => by rw [eval₂_C, derivative_C, eval₂_zero, zero_mul])
    (fun p₁ p₂ ih₁ ih₂ => by
      rw [eval₂_add, derivative_add, ih₁, ih₂, derivative_add, eval₂_add, add_mul])
    fun n r ih => by
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, eval₂_mul, eval₂_X, derivative_mul, ih, @derivative_mul _ _ _ X,
      derivative_X, mul_one, eval₂_add, @eval₂_mul _ _ _ _ X, eval₂_X, add_mul, mul_right_comm]

name: derivative_prod
statement:
theorem derivative_prod [DecidableEq ι] {s : Multiset ι} {f : ι → R[X]} :
    derivative (Multiset.map f s).prod =
      (Multiset.map (fun i => (Multiset.map f (s.erase i)).prod * derivative (f i)) s).sum
proof:
:= by
  refine Multiset.induction_on s (by simp) fun i s h => ?_
  rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, derivative_mul, Multiset.map_cons _ i s,
    Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.erase_cons_head, mul_comm (derivative (f i))]
  congr
  rw [h, ← AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft, (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (f i)).map_multiset_sum _,
    AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Multiset.map_map]
  refine congr_arg _ (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← Multiset.prod_cons, ← Multiset.map_cons]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · simp [hij, Multiset.cons_erase hj]
  · simp [hij]

name: derivative_prod_finset
statement:
theorem derivative_prod_finset [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → R[X]} :
    derivative (∏ b ∈ s, f b) =
      ∑ a ∈ s, (∏ b ∈ s.erase a, f b) * derivative (f a)

name: derivative_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_neg (f : R[X]) : derivative (-f) = -derivative f

name: iterate_derivative_neg
statement: theorem iterate_derivative_neg {f : R[X]} {k : ℕ} : derivative^[k] (-f) = -derivative^[k] f

name: derivative_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_sub {f g : R[X]} : derivative (f - g) = derivative f - derivative g

name: derivative_X_sub_C
statement: theorem derivative_X_sub_C (c : R) : derivative (X - C c) = 1

name: iterate_derivative_sub
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_sub {k : ℕ} {f g : R[X]} :
    derivative^[k] (f - g) = derivative^[k] f - derivative^[k] g

name: derivative_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivative_intCast {n : ℤ} : derivative (n : R[X]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_eq_intCast n]
  exact derivative_C

name: derivative_intCast_mul
statement:
theorem derivative_intCast_mul {n : ℤ} {f : R[X]} : derivative ((n : R[X]) * f) =
    n * derivative f

name: iterate_derivative_intCast_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_intCast_mul {n : ℤ} {k : ℕ} {f : R[X]} :
    derivative^[k] ((n : R[X]) * f) = n * derivative^[k] f
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing f <;> simp [*]

name: derivative_comp_one_sub_X
statement:
theorem derivative_comp_one_sub_X (p : R[X]) :
    derivative (p.comp (1 - X)) = -p.derivative.comp (1 - X)

name: iterate_derivative_comp_one_sub_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_derivative_comp_one_sub_X (p : R[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] (p.comp (1 - X)) = (-1) ^ k * (derivative^[k] p).comp (1 - X)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => simp [ih (derivative p), derivative_comp, pow_succ]

name: eval_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_derivative
statement:
theorem eval_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_derivative [DecidableEq R]
    {S : Multiset R} {r : R} (hr : r ∈ S) :
    eval r (derivative (Multiset.map (fun a => X - C a) S).prod) =
      (Multiset.map (fun a => r - a) (S.erase r)).prod
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← Multiset.cons_erase hr]
  have := (evalRingHom r).map_multiset_prod (Multiset.map (fun a => X - C a) (S.erase r))
  simpa using this

name: derivative_X_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem derivative_X_sub_C_pow (c : R) (m : ℕ) :
    derivative ((X - C c) ^ m) = C (m : R) * (X - C c) ^ (m - 1)

name: derivative_X_sub_C_sq
statement: theorem derivative_X_sub_C_sq (c : R) : derivative ((X - C c) ^ 2) = C 2 * (X - C c)

name: iterate_derivative_X_sub_pow
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_X_sub_pow (n k : ℕ) (c : R) :
    derivative^[k] ((X - C c) ^ n) = n.descFactorial k • (X - C c) ^ (n - k)

name: iterate_derivative_X_sub_pow_self
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_X_sub_pow_self (n : ℕ) (c : R) :
    derivative^[n] ((X - C c) ^ n) = n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [iterate_derivative_X_sub_pow, n.sub_self, pow_zero, nsmul_one, n.descFactorial_self]

name: iterate_derivative_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_eq_zero_of_degree_lt {k : ℕ} {P : R[X]} (h : P.degree < k) :
    derivative^[k] P = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing P
  case zero => exact degree_eq_bot.mp <| WithBot.lt_coe_bot.mp h
  case succ k ind =>
    by_cases P = 0
    case pos hP => simp [hP]
    case neg hP =>
      rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, Function.iterate_one]
      by_cases derivative P = 0
      case pos hP' => simp [hP']
      case neg hP' =>
        have hP'' : P.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
          contrapose hP'
          exact derivative_of_natDegree_zero hP'
        refine ind <| (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hP').mp ?_
        linarith [(natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hP).mpr h, natDegree_derivative_lt hP'']

name: iterate_derivative_prod_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_prod_X_sub_C {k : ℕ} {S : Finset R} (hk : k ≤ #S) :
    derivative^[k] (∏ a ∈ S, (X - C a)) =
    k.factorial * ∑ T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - k), ∏ a ∈ T, (X - C a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k
  case zero => simp
  case succ k ind =>
    specialize ind (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk)
    nth_rewrite 1 [add_comm]
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, Function.iterate_one, ind, ← nsmul_eq_mul, derivative_smul,
      nsmul_eq_mul, derivative_sum, Nat.factorial_succ, mul_comm (k + 1), Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    calc
      ∑ T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - k), derivative (∏ a ∈ T, (X - C a)) =
      ∑ T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - k), ∑ i ∈ T, ∏ a ∈ T.erase i, (X - C a) := by
        congr! with T hT
        simp_rw [derivative_prod_finset, derivative_X_sub_C, mul_one]
      _ = ∑ (T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - k)) (i ∈ S) with i ∈ T, ∏ a ∈ T.erase i, (X - C a) := by
        rw [← sum_finset_product']
        grind
      _ = ∑ (T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - (k + 1))) (i ∈ S) with i ∉ T, ∏ a ∈ T, (X - C a) := by
        apply sum_bij' (fun ⟨T, i⟩ _ => ⟨T.erase i, i⟩) (fun ⟨T, i⟩ _ => ⟨insert i T, i⟩)
        · intro r hr; dsimp at hr ⊢; congr 1; grind
        · intro r hr; dsimp at hr ⊢; congr 1; grind
        all_goals grind
      _ = ∑ T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - (k + 1)), ∑ i ∈ S \ T, ∏ a ∈ T, (X - C a) := by
        rw [← sum_finset_product']
        grind
      _ = (k + 1) * ∑ T ∈ S.powersetCard (#S - (k + 1)), ∏ a ∈ T, (X - C a) := by
        rw [mul_sum]
        congr! 1 with T hT
        simp [sum_const, show #(S \ T) = k + 1 by grind]
      _ = _ := by grind

name: dvd_derivative_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dvd_derivative_iff {P : R[X]} : P ∣ derivative P ↔ derivative P = 0 where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    by_cases hP : P = 0
    · simp only [hP, derivative_zero]
    exact eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt h (degree_derivative_lt hP)
  mpr h := by simp [h]

name: derivative_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivative_pow_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (chn : (n : R) ≠ 0) {a : R[X]} :
    derivative (a ^ n) = 0 ↔ derivative a = 0
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [← C_ne_zero, C_eq_natCast] at chn
  simp +contextual [derivative_pow, chn]

name: trinomial_def
statement: theorem trinomial_def : trinomial k m n u v w = C u * X ^ k + C v * X ^ m + C w * X ^ n

name: trinomial_leading_coeff'
statement:
theorem trinomial_leading_coeff' (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).coeff n = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [trinomial_def, coeff_add, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
    ite_eq_right (hkm.trans hmn).ne', ite_eq_right hmn.ne', ite_eq_left rfl, zero_add, zero_add]

name: trinomial_middle_coeff
statement:
theorem trinomial_middle_coeff (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).coeff m = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [trinomial_def, coeff_add, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
    ite_eq_right hkm.ne', ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right hmn.ne, zero_add, add_zero]

name: trinomial_trailing_coeff'
statement:
theorem trinomial_trailing_coeff' (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).coeff k = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [trinomial_def, coeff_add, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
    ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right hkm.ne, ite_eq_right (hkm.trans hmn).ne, add_zero, add_zero]

name: trinomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem trinomial_natDegree (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  refine
    natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some
      ((Finset.sup_le fun i h => ?_).antisymm <|
        le_degree_of_ne_zero <| by rwa [trinomial_leading_coeff' hkm hmn])
  replace h := support_trinomial_subset k m n u v w h
  rw [mem_insert, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (hkm.trans hmn).le
  · exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hmn.le
  · exact le_rfl

name: trinomial_natTrailingDegree
statement:
theorem trinomial_natTrailingDegree (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).natTrailingDegree = k
proof:
:= by
  refine
    natTrailingDegree_eq_of_trailingDegree_eq_some
      ((Finset.le_inf fun i h => ?_).antisymm <|
          trailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero <| by rwa [trinomial_trailing_coeff' hkm hmn]).symm
  replace h := support_trinomial_subset k m n u v w h
  rw [mem_insert, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hkm.le
  · exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (hkm.trans hmn).le

name: trinomial_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem trinomial_leadingCoeff (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).leadingCoeff = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, trinomial_natDegree hkm hmn hw, trinomial_leading_coeff' hkm hmn]

name: trinomial_trailingCoeff
statement:
theorem trinomial_trailingCoeff (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).trailingCoeff = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [trailingCoeff, trinomial_natTrailingDegree hkm hmn hu, trinomial_trailing_coeff' hkm hmn]

name: trinomial_monic
statement: theorem trinomial_monic (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) : (trinomial k m n u v 1).Monic
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  exact trinomial_leadingCoeff hkm hmn one_ne_zero

name: trinomial_mirror
statement:
theorem trinomial_mirror (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).mirror = trinomial k (n - m + k) n w v u
proof:
:= by
  rw [mirror, trinomial_natTrailingDegree hkm hmn hu, reverse, trinomial_natDegree hkm hmn hw,
    trinomial_def, reflect_add, reflect_add, reflect_C_mul_X_pow, reflect_C_mul_X_pow,
    reflect_C_mul_X_pow, revAt_le (hkm.trans hmn).le, revAt_le hmn.le, revAt_le le_rfl, add_mul,
    add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← pow_add,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (hkm.trans hmn).le, Nat.sub_self, zero_add, add_comm, add_comm (C u * X ^ n),
    ← add_assoc, ← trinomial_def]

name: trinomial_support
statement:
theorem trinomial_support (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (trinomial k m n u v w).support = {k, m, n}
proof:
:=
  support_trinomial hkm hmn hu hv hw

name: not_isUnit
statement: theorem not_isUnit (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) : ¬IsUnit p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, u, v, w, rfl⟩ := hp
  exact fun h =>
    ne_zero_of_lt hmn
      ((trinomial_natDegree hkm hmn w.ne_zero).symm.trans
        (natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (degree_eq_zero_of_isUnit h)))

name: card_support_eq_three
statement: theorem card_support_eq_three (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) : #p.support = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, u, v, w, rfl⟩ := hp
  exact card_support_trinomial hkm hmn u.ne_zero v.ne_zero w.ne_zero

name: ne_zero
statement: theorem ne_zero (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) : p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  simpa using hp.card_support_eq_three

name: coeff_isUnit
statement:
theorem coeff_isUnit (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ p.support) :
    IsUnit (p.coeff k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, u, v, w, rfl⟩ := hp
  have := support_trinomial_subset k m n (u : ℤ) v w hk
  rw [mem_insert, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at this
  rcases this with (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · refine ⟨u, by rw [trinomial_trailing_coeff' hkm hmn]⟩
  · refine ⟨v, by rw [trinomial_middle_coeff hkm hmn]⟩
  · refine ⟨w, by rw [trinomial_leading_coeff' hkm hmn]⟩

name: leadingCoeff_isUnit
statement: theorem leadingCoeff_isUnit (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff

name: trailingCoeff_isUnit
statement: theorem trailingCoeff_isUnit (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) : IsUnit p.trailingCoeff

name: isUnitTrinomial_iff
statement:
theorem isUnitTrinomial_iff :
    p.IsUnitTrinomial ↔ #p.support = 3 ∧ ∀ k ∈ p.support, IsUnit (p.coeff k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hp => ⟨hp.card_support_eq_three, fun k => hp.coeff_isUnit⟩, fun hp => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, x, y, z, hx, hy, hz, rfl⟩ := card_support_eq_three.mp hp.1
  rw [support_trinomial hkm hmn hx hy hz] at hp
  replace hx := hp.2 k (mem_insert_self k {m, n})
  replace hy := hp.2 m (mem_insert_of_mem (mem_insert_self m {n}))
  replace hz := hp.2 n (mem_insert_of_mem (mem_insert_of_mem (mem_singleton_self n)))
  simp_rw [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow_self, mul_one, coeff_X_pow] at hx hy hz
  rw [ite_eq_right hkm.ne, ite_eq_right (hkm.trans hmn).ne] at hx
  rw [ite_eq_right hkm.ne', ite_eq_right hmn.ne] at hy
  rw [ite_eq_right (hkm.trans hmn).ne', ite_eq_right hmn.ne'] at hz
  simp_rw [mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at hx hy hz
  exact ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, hx.unit, hy.unit, hz.unit, rfl⟩

name: isUnitTrinomial_iff'
statement:
theorem isUnitTrinomial_iff' :
    p.IsUnitTrinomial ↔
      (p * p.mirror).coeff (((p * p.mirror).natDegree + (p * p.mirror).natTrailingDegree) / 2) =
        3
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDegree_mul_mirror, natTrailingDegree_mul_mirror, ← mul_add,
    Nat.mul_div_right _ zero_lt_two, coeff_mul_mirror]
  refine ⟨?_, fun hp => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, u, v, w, rfl⟩
    rw [sum_def, trinomial_support hkm hmn u.ne_zero v.ne_zero w.ne_zero,
      sum_insert (mt mem_insert.mp (not_or_intro hkm.ne (mt mem_singleton.mp (hkm.trans hmn).ne))),
      sum_insert (mt mem_singleton.mp hmn.ne), sum_singleton, trinomial_leading_coeff' hkm hmn,
      trinomial_middle_coeff hkm hmn, trinomial_trailing_coeff' hkm hmn]
    simp_rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Int.units_sq, Units.val_one]
    decide
  · have key : ∀ k ∈ p.support, p.coeff k ^ 2 = 1 := fun k hk =>
      Int.sq_eq_one_of_sq_le_three
        ((single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (p.coeff k)) hk).trans hp.le) (mem_support_iff.mp hk)
    refine isUnitTrinomial_iff.mpr ⟨?_, fun k hk => .of_pow_eq_one (key k hk) two_ne_zero⟩
    rw [sum_def, sum_congr rfl key, sum_const, Nat.smul_one_eq_cast] at hp
    exact Nat.cast_injective hp

name: isUnitTrinomial_iff''
statement:
theorem isUnitTrinomial_iff'' (h : p * p.mirror = q * q.mirror) :
    p.IsUnitTrinomial ↔ q.IsUnitTrinomial

name: irreducible_aux1
statement:
theorem irreducible_aux1 {k m n : ℕ} (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (u v w : Units ℤ)
    (hp : p = trinomial k m n (u : ℤ) v w) :
    C (v : ℤ) * (C (u : ℤ) * X ^ (m + n) + C (w : ℤ) * X ^ (n - m + k + n)) =
      ⟨.ofCoeff <| (p * p.mirror).toFinsupp.coeff.filter (· ∈ Set.Ioo (k + n) (n + n))⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : n - m + k < n := by rwa [← lt_tsub_iff_right, tsub_lt_tsub_iff_left_of_le hmn.le]
  rw [hp, trinomial_mirror hkm hmn u.ne_zero w.ne_zero]
  simp_rw [trinomial_def, C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, add_mul, mul_add, monomial_mul_monomial,
    toFinsupp_add, toFinsupp_monomial, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.filter_add,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single]
  rw [Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg, Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg, Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg,
    Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg, Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg, Finsupp.filter_single_of_pos,
    Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg, Finsupp.filter_single_of_pos, Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg]
  · simp only [add_zero, zero_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_add, ofFinsupp_add,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_single, ofFinsupp_single, C_mul_monomial, C_mul_monomial,
      mul_comm (v : ℤ) w, add_comm (n - m + k) n]
  · simp
  · refine ⟨?_, by gcongr⟩
    rwa [add_comm, add_lt_add_iff_left, lt_add_iff_pos_left, tsub_pos_iff_lt]
  · exact fun h => h.1.ne (add_comm k n)
  · constructor <;> gcongr
  · rw [← add_assoc, add_tsub_cancel_of_le hmn.le, add_comm]
    exact fun h => h.1.ne rfl
  · grind
  · exact fun h => h.1.ne rfl
  · exact fun h => asymm ((add_lt_add_iff_left k).mp h.1) key
  · exact fun h => asymm ((add_lt_add_iff_left k).mp h.1) (hkm.trans hmn)

name: irreducible_aux2
statement:
theorem irreducible_aux2 {k m m' n : ℕ} (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hkm' : k < m') (hmn' : m' < n)
    (u v w : Units ℤ) (hp : p = trinomial k m n (u : ℤ) v w) (hq : q = trinomial k m' n (u : ℤ) v w)
    (h : p * p.mirror = q * q.mirror) : q = p ∨ q = p.mirror
proof:
:= by
  let f (p : ℤ[X]) : ℤ[X] := ⟨.ofCoeff <| .filter (· ∈ Set.Ioo (k + n) (n + n)) p.toFinsupp.coeff⟩
  replace h := congr_arg f h
  replace h := (irreducible_aux1 hkm hmn u v w hp).trans h
  replace h := h.trans (irreducible_aux1 hkm' hmn' u v w hq).symm
  rw [(isUnit_C.mpr v.isUnit).mul_right_inj] at h
  rw [binomial_eq_binomial u.ne_zero w.ne_zero] at h
  simp only [add_left_inj, Units.val_inj] at h
  rcases h with (⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, h⟩ | ⟨-, hm, hm'⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (hq.trans hp.symm)
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    rw [← trinomial_mirror hkm' hmn' u.ne_zero u.ne_zero, eq_comm, mirror_eq_iff] at hp
    exact hq.trans hp
  · grind

name: irreducible_aux3
statement:
theorem irreducible_aux3 {k m m' n : ℕ} (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hkm' : k < m') (hmn' : m' < n)
    (u v w x z : Units ℤ) (hp : p = trinomial k m n (u : ℤ) v w)
    (hq : q = trinomial k m' n (x : ℤ) v z) (h : p * p.mirror = q * q.mirror) :
    q = p ∨ q = p.mirror
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := congr_arg leadingCoeff h
  rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_mul, mirror_leadingCoeff, mirror_leadingCoeff, hp, hq,
    trinomial_leadingCoeff hkm hmn w.ne_zero, trinomial_leadingCoeff hkm' hmn' z.ne_zero,
    trinomial_trailingCoeff hkm hmn u.ne_zero, trinomial_trailingCoeff hkm' hmn' x.ne_zero]
    at hmul
  have hadd := congr_arg (eval 1) h
  rw [eval_mul, eval_mul, mirror_eval_one, mirror_eval_one, ← sq, ← sq, hp, hq] at hadd
  simp only [eval_add, eval_C_mul, eval_X_pow, one_pow, mul_one, trinomial_def] at hadd
  rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm (u : ℤ), add_comm (x : ℤ), add_assoc, add_assoc] at hadd
  simp only [add_sq', add_assoc, add_right_inj, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Int.units_sq] at hadd
  rw [mul_assoc, hmul, ← mul_assoc, add_right_inj,
    mul_right_inj' (show 2 * (v : ℤ) ≠ 0 from mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero v.ne_zero)] at hadd
  replace hadd :=
    (Int.isUnit_add_isUnit_eq_isUnit_add_isUnit w.isUnit u.isUnit z.isUnit x.isUnit).mp hadd
  simp only [Units.val_inj] at hadd
  rcases hadd with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  · exact irreducible_aux2 hkm hmn hkm' hmn' u v w hp hq h
  · rw [← mirror_inj, trinomial_mirror hkm' hmn' w.ne_zero u.ne_zero] at hq
    rw [mul_comm q, ← q.mirror_mirror, q.mirror.mirror_mirror] at h
    rw [← mirror_inj, or_comm, ← mirror_eq_iff]
    exact
      irreducible_aux2 hkm hmn (lt_add_of_pos_left k (tsub_pos_of_lt hmn'))
        (lt_tsub_iff_right.mp ((tsub_lt_tsub_iff_left_of_le hmn'.le).mpr hkm')) u v w hp hq h

name: irreducible_of_coprime
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_coprime (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial)
    (h : IsRelPrime p p.mirror) : Irreducible p
proof:
:= by
  refine irreducible_of_mirror hp.not_isUnit (fun q hpq => ?_) h
  have hq : IsUnitTrinomial q := (isUnitTrinomial_iff'' hpq).mp hp
  obtain ⟨k, m, n, hkm, hmn, u, v, w, hp⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨k', m', n', hkm', hmn', x, y, z, hq⟩ := hq
  have hk : k = k' := by
    rw [← mul_right_inj' (show 2 ≠ 0 from two_ne_zero), ←
      trinomial_natTrailingDegree hkm hmn u.ne_zero, ← hp, ← natTrailingDegree_mul_mirror, hpq,
      natTrailingDegree_mul_mirror, hq, trinomial_natTrailingDegree hkm' hmn' x.ne_zero]
  have hn : n = n' := by
    rw [← mul_right_inj' (show 2 ≠ 0 from two_ne_zero), ← trinomial_natDegree hkm hmn w.ne_zero, ←
      hp, ← natDegree_mul_mirror, hpq, natDegree_mul_mirror, hq,
      trinomial_natDegree hkm' hmn' z.ne_zero]
  subst hk
  subst hn
  rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_sq_eq_sq (y : ℤ) (v : ℤ)
      ((Int.isUnit_sq y.isUnit).trans (Int.isUnit_sq v.isUnit).symm) with
    (h1 | h1)
  · rw [h1] at hq
    rcases irreducible_aux3 hkm hmn hkm' hmn' u v w x z hp hq hpq with (h2 | h2)
    · exact Or.inl h2
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h2))
  · rw [h1] at hq
    rw [trinomial_def] at hp
    rw [← neg_inj, neg_add, neg_add, ← neg_mul, ← neg_mul, ← neg_mul, ← C_neg, ← C_neg, ← C_neg]
      at hp
    rw [← neg_mul_neg, ← mirror_neg] at hpq
    rcases irreducible_aux3 hkm hmn hkm' hmn' (-u) (-v) (-w) x z hp hq hpq with (rfl | rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr p.mirror_neg))

name: irreducible_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_isCoprime (hp : p.IsUnitTrinomial) (h : IsCoprime p p.mirror) :
    Irreducible p

name: mem_lifts
statement: theorem mem_lifts (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts f ↔ ∃ q : R[X], map f q = p

name: lifts_iff_set_range
statement: theorem lifts_iff_set_range (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts f ↔ p ∈ Set.range (map f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, lifts, Set.mem_range, RingHom.mem_rangeS]

name: lifts_iff_ringHom_rangeS
statement: theorem lifts_iff_ringHom_rangeS (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts f ↔ p ∈ (mapRingHom f).rangeS

name: lifts_iff_coeff_lifts
statement: theorem lifts_iff_coeff_lifts (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts f ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, p.coeff n ∈ Set.range f

name: lifts_iff_coeffs_subset_range
statement:
theorem lifts_iff_coeffs_subset_range (p : S[X]) :
    p ∈ lifts f ↔ (p.coeffs : Set S) ⊆ Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  rw [lifts_iff_coeff_lifts]
  constructor
  · intro h _ hc
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨-, hn⟩⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.mp hc
    exact hn ▸ h n
  · intro h n
    by_cases hn : p.coeff n = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by simp [hn]⟩
    · exact h <| coeff_mem_coeffs hn

name: mem_lifts_of_surjective
statement: theorem mem_lifts_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts f

name: C_mem_lifts
statement: theorem C_mem_lifts (f : R →+* S) (r : R) : C (f r) ∈ lifts f

name: C'_mem_lifts
statement: theorem C'_mem_lifts {f : R →+* S} {s : S} (h : s ∈ Set.range f) : C s ∈ lifts f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_range.1 h
  use C r
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, map_C]

name: X_mem_lifts
statement: theorem X_mem_lifts (f : R →+* S) : (X : S[X]) ∈ lifts f

name: X_pow_mem_lifts
statement: theorem X_pow_mem_lifts (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) : (X ^ n : S[X]) ∈ lifts f
proof:
:=
  ⟨X ^ n, by
    simp only [coe_mapRingHom, map_pow, map_X]⟩

name: base_mul_mem_lifts
statement: theorem base_mul_mem_lifts {p : S[X]} (r : R) (hp : p ∈ lifts f) : C (f r) * p ∈ lifts f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lifts, RingHom.mem_rangeS] at hp ⊢
  obtain ⟨p₁, rfl⟩ := hp
  use C r * p₁
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, map_C, map_mul]

name: monomial_mem_lifts
statement: theorem monomial_mem_lifts {s : S} (n : ℕ) (h : s ∈ Set.range f) : monomial n s ∈ lifts f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_range.1 h
  use monomial n r
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, map_monomial]

name: erase_mem_lifts
statement: theorem erase_mem_lifts {p : S[X]} (n : ℕ) (h : p ∈ lifts f) : p.erase n ∈ lifts f
proof:
:= by
  rw [lifts_iff_ringHom_rangeS, mem_map_rangeS] at h ⊢
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = n
  · use 0
    simp only [hk, map_zero, erase_same]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h k
  use i
  simp only [hi, hk, erase_ne, Ne, not_false_iff]

name: monomial_mem_lifts_and_degree_eq
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_lifts_and_degree_eq {s : S} {n : ℕ} (hl : monomial n s ∈ lifts f) :
    ∃ q : R[X], map f q = monomial n s ∧ q.degree = (monomial n s).degree
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne s 0 with rfl | h
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := coeff_monomial_same n s ▸ (monomial n s).lifts_iff_coeff_lifts.mp hl n
  refine ⟨monomial n a, map_monomial f, ?_⟩
  rw [degree_monomial, degree_monomial n h]
  exact mt (fun ha ↦ ha ▸ map_zero f) h

name: exists_support_eq_of_mem_lifts
statement:
theorem exists_support_eq_of_mem_lifts {p : S[X]} (hlifts : p ∈ lifts f) :
    ∃ q : R[X], map f q = p ∧ q.support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [lifts_iff_coeff_lifts] at hlifts
  let g : ℕ → R := fun k ↦ (hlifts k).choose
  have hg : ∀ k, f (g k) = p.coeff k := fun k ↦ (hlifts k).choose_spec
  let q : R[X] := ∑ k ∈ p.support, monomial k (g k)
  have hq : map f q = p := by simp_rw [q, Polynomial.map_sum, map_monomial, hg, ← as_sum_support]
  have hq' : q.support = p.support := by
    simp_rw [Finset.ext_iff, mem_support_iff, q, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', ite_ne_right_iff, mem_support_iff, and_iff_left_iff_imp, not_imp_not]
    exact fun k h ↦ by rw [← hg, h, map_zero]
  exact ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩

name: exists_degree_eq_of_mem_lifts
statement:
theorem exists_degree_eq_of_mem_lifts {p : S[X]} (hlifts : p ∈ lifts f) :
    ∃ q : R[X], map f q = p ∧ q.degree = p.degree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩ := exists_support_eq_of_mem_lifts hlifts
  exact ⟨q, hq, congrArg Finset.max hq'⟩

name: exists_natDegree_eq_of_mem_lifts
statement:
theorem exists_natDegree_eq_of_mem_lifts {p : S[X]} (hlifts : p ∈ lifts f) :
    ∃ q, map f q = p ∧ q.natDegree = p.natDegree

name: lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic
statement:
theorem lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic [Nontrivial S] {p : S[X]} (hlifts : p ∈ lifts f)
    (hp : p.Monic) : ∃ q : R[X], map f q = p ∧ q.degree = p.degree ∧ q.Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [lifts_iff_coeff_lifts] at hlifts
  let g : ℕ → R := fun k ↦ (hlifts k).choose
  have hg k : f (g k) = p.coeff k := (hlifts k).choose_spec
  let q : R[X] := X ^ p.natDegree + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, C (g k) * X ^ k
  have hq : map f q = p := by
    simp_rw [q, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_sum, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow,
      map_X, map_C, hg, ← hp.as_sum]
  have h : q.Monic := monic_X_pow_add (by simp_rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, degree_sum_fin_lt])
  exact ⟨q, hq, hq ▸ (h.degree_map f).symm, h⟩

name: lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic
statement:
theorem lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic {p : S[X]} (hlifts : p ∈ lifts f) (hp : p.Monic) :
    ∃ q : R[X], map f q = p ∧ q.natDegree = p.natDegree ∧ q.Monic
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial S with hR | hR
  · obtain rfl : p = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact ⟨1, Subsingleton.elim _ _, by simp, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨p', h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic hlifts hp
  exact ⟨p', h₁, natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq h₂, h₃⟩

name: lifts_iff_liftsRing
statement: theorem lifts_iff_liftsRing (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts f ↔ p ∈ liftsRing f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lifts, liftsRing, RingHom.mem_range, RingHom.mem_rangeS]

name: mem_lifts_iff_mem_alg
statement:
theorem mem_lifts_iff_mem_alg (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {S : Type v} [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    (p : S[X]) : p ∈ lifts (algebraMap R S) ↔ p ∈ AlgHom.range (@mapAlg R _ S _ _)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, lifts, mapAlg_eq_map, AlgHom.mem_range, RingHom.mem_rangeS]

name: smul_mem_lifts
statement:
theorem smul_mem_lifts {p : S[X]} (r : R) (hp : p ∈ lifts (algebraMap R S)) :
    r • p ∈ lifts (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_lifts_iff_mem_alg] at hp ⊢
  exact Subalgebra.smul_mem (mapAlg R S).range hp r

name: monic_of_monic_mapAlg
statement:
theorem monic_of_monic_mapAlg [FaithfulSMul R S] {p : Polynomial R} (hp : (mapAlg R S p).Monic) :
    p.Monic

name: taylor_apply
statement: theorem taylor_apply : taylor r f = f.comp (X + C r)

name: taylor_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_X : taylor r X = X + C r

name: taylor_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_X_pow (n : ℕ) : taylor r (X ^ n) = (X + C r) ^ n

name: taylor_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_C (x : R) : taylor r (C x) = C x

name: taylor_zero
statement: theorem taylor_zero (f : R[X]) : taylor 0 f = f

name: taylor_zero'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_zero' : taylor (0 : R) = LinearMap.id

name: taylor_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_one : taylor r (1 : R[X]) = C 1

name: taylor_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_monomial (i : ℕ) (k : R) : taylor r (monomial i k) = C k * (X + C r) ^ i

name: taylor_coeff
statement: theorem taylor_coeff (n : ℕ) : (taylor r f).coeff n = (hasseDeriv n f).eval r
proof:
:=
  show (lcoeff R n).comp (taylor r) f = (leval r).comp (hasseDeriv n) f by
    congr 1; clear! f; ext i
    simp only [leval_apply, mul_one, one_mul, eval_monomial, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sum,
      hasseDeriv_monomial, taylor_apply, monomial_comp, C_1, (commute_X (C r)).add_pow i]
    simp only [lcoeff_apply, ← C_eq_natCast, mul_assoc, ← C_pow, ← C_mul, coeff_mul_C,
      (Nat.cast_commute _ _).eq, coeff_X_pow, boole_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_range]
    split_ifs with h; · rfl
    push Not at h; rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt h, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: taylor_coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_coeff_zero : (taylor r f).coeff 0 = f.eval r

name: taylor_coeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_coeff_one : (taylor r f).coeff 1 = f.derivative.eval r

name: coeff_taylor_natDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_taylor_natDegree : (taylor r f).coeff f.natDegree = f.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · rw [hf, map_zero, coeff_natDegree]
  · rw [taylor_coeff, hasseDeriv_natDegree_eq_C, eval_C]

name: natDegree_taylor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_taylor (p : R[X]) (r : R) : natDegree (taylor r p) = natDegree p
proof:
:= by
  refine map_natDegree_eq_natDegree _ ?_
  nontriviality R
  intro n c c0
  simp [taylor_monomial, natDegree_C_mul_of_mul_ne_zero, natDegree_pow_X_add_C, c0]

name: leadingCoeff_taylor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_taylor : (taylor r f).leadingCoeff = f.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff, natDegree_taylor, coeff_taylor_natDegree, leadingCoeff]

name: taylor_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_eq_zero : taylor r f = 0 ↔ f = 0

name: degree_taylor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_taylor (p : R[X]) (r : R) : degree (taylor r p) = degree p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, map_zero]
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_iff_natDegree_eq ((taylor_eq_zero r p).not.2 hp),
      natDegree_taylor]

name: eq_zero_of_hasseDeriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_hasseDeriv_eq_zero (f : R[X]) (r : R)
    (h : ∀ k, (hasseDeriv k f).eval r = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← taylor_eq_zero r]
  ext k
  rw [taylor_coeff, h, coeff_zero]

name: map_taylor
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_taylor {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] (p : R[X]) (r : R) (f : R →+* S) :
    (p.taylor r).map f = (p.map f).taylor (f r)

name: taylor_injective
statement: theorem taylor_injective (r : R) : Function.Injective (taylor r)

name: taylor_inj
statement:
@[simp] lemma taylor_inj {r : R} {p q : R[X]} :
    taylor r p = taylor r q ↔ p = q

name: taylor_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_mul (p q : R[X]) : taylor r (p * q) = taylor r p * taylor r q

name: taylor_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem taylor_pow (n : ℕ) : taylor r (f ^ n) = taylor r f ^ n

name: coe_taylorAlgHom
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_taylorAlgHom : taylorAlgHom r = taylor r

name: taylor_taylor
statement: theorem taylor_taylor (f : R[X]) (r s : R) : taylor r (taylor s f) = taylor (r + s) f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [taylor_apply, comp_assoc, map_add, add_comp, X_comp, C_comp, add_assoc]

name: taylor_eval
statement: theorem taylor_eval (r : R) (f : R[X]) (s : R) : (taylor r f).eval s = f.eval (s + r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [taylor_apply, eval_comp, eval_C, eval_X, eval_add]

name: exists_mul_sq_add_linear_part_eq_eval_add
statement:
theorem exists_mul_sq_add_linear_part_eq_eval_add (p : R[X]) (x y : R) :
    ∃ c : R, c * y ^ 2 + p.derivative.eval x * y + p.eval x = p.eval (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  have this t :
      (taylor x p).eval t =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ((taylor x p).natDegree + 2), (taylor x p).coeff i * t ^ i :=
    (taylor x p).eval_eq_sum_range' (n := (taylor x p).natDegree + 2) (by lia) t
  rw [add_comm, ← p.taylor_eval x y, this, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ']
  use ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, (taylor x p).coeff (i + 2) * y ^ i
  simp [pow_succ, mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]

name: eval_add_of_sq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_add_of_sq_eq_zero (p : R[X]) (x y : R) (hy : y ^ 2 = 0) :
    p.eval (x + y) = p.eval x + p.derivative.eval x * y
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_mul_sq_add_linear_part_eq_eval_add p x y with ⟨c, h⟩
  rw [← h, hy]; ring

name: aeval_add_of_sq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem aeval_add_of_sq_eq_zero {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (p : R[X]) (x y : S) (hy : y ^ 2 = 0) :
    p.aeval (x + y) = p.aeval x + p.derivative.aeval x * y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← eval_map_algebraMap, Polynomial.eval_add_of_sq_eq_zero _ _ _ hy, derivative_map]

name: toAlgHom_taylorEquiv
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma toAlgHom_taylorEquiv : taylorEquiv r = taylorAlgHom r

name: coe_taylorEquiv
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_taylorEquiv : taylorEquiv r = taylor r

name: taylorEquiv_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma taylorEquiv_symm : (taylorEquiv r).symm = taylorEquiv (-r)

name: taylor_eval_sub
statement:
theorem taylor_eval_sub (s : R) :
    (taylor r f).eval (s - r) = f.eval s

name: sum_taylor_eq
statement:
theorem sum_taylor_eq (f : R[X]) (r : R) :
    ((taylor r f).sum fun i a => C a * (X - C r) ^ i) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_eq_sum_left, sub_eq_add_neg, ← C_neg, ← taylor_apply, taylor_taylor, neg_add_cancel,
    taylor_zero]

name: natDegree_pos_of_aeval_root
statement:

name: smul_divByMonic_modByMonic
statement:
private theorem smul_divByMonic_modByMonic (c : R) (p : R[X]) :
    c • p /ₘ q = c • (p /ₘ q) ∧ c • p %ₘ q = c • (p %ₘ q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q.Monic
  · rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
    · simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]
    · exact div_modByMonic_unique (c • (p /ₘ q)) (c • (p %ₘ q)) hq
        ⟨by rw [mul_smul_comm, ← smul_add, modByMonic_add_div],
         (degree_smul_le _ _).trans_lt (degree_modByMonic_lt _ hq)⟩
  · simp [divByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq, modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ hq]

name: rootMultiplicity_mul_X_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_mul_X_sub_C_pow {p : R[X]} {a : R} {n : ℕ} (h : p ≠ 0) :
    (p * (X - C a) ^ n).rootMultiplicity a = p.rootMultiplicity a + n
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := monic_X_sub_C a |>.pow n |>.mul_left_ne_zero h
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [rootMultiplicity_le_iff h2, add_assoc, add_comm n, ← add_assoc, pow_add,
      dvd_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors (monic_X_sub_C a |>.pow n |>.mem_nonZeroDivisors)]
    exact pow_rootMultiplicity_not_dvd h a
  · rw [le_rootMultiplicity_iff h2, pow_add]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_right (pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd p a) _

name: rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_pow [Nontrivial R] (a : R) (n : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  have := rootMultiplicity_mul_X_sub_C_pow (a := a) (n := n) C.map_one_ne_zero
  rwa [rootMultiplicity_C, map_one, one_mul, zero_add] at this

proof:

  · rw [hxy]
    exact rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_self
  exact rootMultiplicity_eq_zero (mt root_X_sub_C.mp (Ne.symm hxy))

name: rootMultiplicity_comp_C_mul_X_add_C_le
statement:
private theorem rootMultiplicity_comp_C_mul_X_add_C_le (p : R[X]) (a b c : R) (ha : IsUnit a) :
    (p.comp (C a * X + C b)).rootMultiplicity c ≤ p.rootMultiplicity (a * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible a := ha.invertible
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp; · simp
  rw [le_rootMultiplicity_iff hp]
  have h := pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd (p.comp (C a * X + C b)) c
  rw [dvd_comp_C_mul_X_add_C_iff, pow_comp] at h
  refine (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd ((isUnit_C.mpr ha).dvd_mul_left.mp (dvd_of_eq ?_)) _).trans h
  simp [← map_mul, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, sub_sub, add_comm, mul_add]

name: rootMultiplicity_comp_C_mul_X_add_C
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_comp_C_mul_X_add_C (p : R[X]) (a b c : R) (ha : IsUnit a) :
    (p.comp (C a * X + C b)).rootMultiplicity c = p.rootMultiplicity (a * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible a := ha.invertible
  apply le_antisymm (rootMultiplicity_comp_C_mul_X_add_C_le p a b c ha)
  have := rootMultiplicity_comp_C_mul_X_add_C_le
    (p.comp (C a * X + C b)) ⅟a (- ⅟a * b) (a * c + b) (isUnit_of_invertible ⅟a)
  simpa [comp_assoc, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul] using this

name: rootMultiplicity_mul'
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_mul' {p q : R[X]} {x : R}
    (hpq : (p /ₘ (X - C x) ^ p.rootMultiplicity x).eval x *
      (q /ₘ (X - C x) ^ q.rootMultiplicity x).eval x ≠ 0) :
    rootMultiplicity x (p * q) = rootMultiplicity x p + rootMultiplicity x q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eval_divByMonic_eq_trailingCoeff_comp] at hpq
  simp_rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, mul_comp, natTrailingDegree_mul' hpq]

name: Monic.neg_one_pow_natDegree_mul_comp_neg_X
statement:
theorem Monic.neg_one_pow_natDegree_mul_comp_neg_X {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) :
    ((-1) ^ p.natDegree * p.comp (-X)).Monic
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Monic]
  calc
    ((-1) ^ p.natDegree * p.comp (-X)).leadingCoeff =
        (p.comp (-X) * C ((-1) ^ p.natDegree)).leadingCoeff := by
      simp [mul_comm]
    _ = 1 := by
      apply monic_mul_C_of_leadingCoeff_mul_eq_one
      simp [← pow_add, hp]

name: irreducible_of_degree_eq_one_of_isRelPrime_coeff
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_degree_eq_one_of_isRelPrime_coeff
    {p : R[X]} (hp : p.degree = 1) (hc : IsRelPrime (p.coeff 0) (p.coeff 1)) :
    Irreducible p where
  not_isUnit h
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨u, -, h⟩ := isUnit_iff.mp h
    apply not_le.mpr (zero_lt_one' (WithBot ℕ))
    simp [← hp, ← h, degree_C_le]
  isUnit_or_isUnit f g h := by
    wlog! H : f.degree ≤ g.degree generalizing f g
    · rw [mul_comm] at h
      exact (this g f h H.le).symm
    left
    rw [h, degree_mul, Nat.WithBot.add_eq_one_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with ⟨hf, hg⟩ | ⟨hf, hg⟩; swap
    · simp [← not_lt, hf, hg] at H
    replace hf := f.eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero hf
    rw [hf]
    apply IsUnit.map C
    rw [h, hf, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C_mul] at hc
    apply hc <;> simp

name: rootMultiplicity_mul
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_mul {p q : R[X]} {x : R} (hpq : p * q ≠ 0) :
    rootMultiplicity x (p * q) = rootMultiplicity x p + rootMultiplicity x q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hpq
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hpq
  rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity (p * q), ite_eq_right hpq,
    rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity p, ite_eq_right hp, rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity q,
    ite_eq_right hq, multiplicity_mul (prime_X_sub_C x) (finiteMultiplicity_X_sub_C _ hpq)]

name: exists_multiset_roots
statement:
theorem exists_multiset_roots [DecidableEq R] :
    ∀ {p : R[X]} (_ : p ≠ 0), ∃ s : Multiset R,
      (Multiset.card s : WithBot ℕ) ≤ degree p ∧ ∀ a, s.count a = rootMultiplicity a p
  | p, hp =>
    haveI
proof:
:= Classical.propDecidable (∃ x, IsRoot p x)
    if h : ∃ x, IsRoot p x then
      let ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
      have hpd : 0 < degree p := degree_pos_of_root hp hx
      have hd0 : p /ₘ (X - C x) ≠ 0 := fun h => by
        rw [← mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.2 hx, h, mul_zero] at hp; exact hp rfl
      have wf : degree (p /ₘ (X - C x)) < degree p :=
        degree_divByMonic_lt _ _ hp ((degree_X_sub_C x).symm ▸ by decide)
      let ⟨t, htd, htr⟩ := @exists_multiset_roots _ (p /ₘ (X - C x)) hd0
      have hdeg : degree (X - C x) ≤ degree p := by
        simpa using Nat.WithBot.one_le_iff_zero_lt.mpr hpd
      have hdiv0 : p /ₘ (X - C x) ≠ 0 :=
        mt (divByMonic_eq_zero_iff (monic_X_sub_C x)).1 <| not_lt.2 hdeg
      ⟨x ::ₘ t,
        calc
          (card (x ::ₘ t) : WithBot ℕ) = Multiset.card t + 1 := by
            congr
            exact mod_cast Multiset.card_cons _ _
          _ ≤ degree p := by
            rw [← degree_add_divByMonic (monic_X_sub_C x) hdeg, degree_X_sub_C, add_comm]
            exact add_le_add (le_refl (1 : WithBot ℕ)) htd,
        by
          intro a
          conv_rhs => rw [← mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.mpr hx]
          rw [rootMultiplicity_mul (mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero x) hdiv0),
            rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C, ← htr a]
          split_ifs with ha
          · rw [ha, count_cons_self, add_comm]
          · rw [count_cons_of_ne ha, zero_add]⟩
    else
      ⟨0, (degree_eq_natDegree hp).symm ▸ WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 (Nat.zero_le _), by
        intro a
        rw [count_zero, rootMultiplicity_eq_zero (not_exists.mp h a)]⟩

name: neg_cancelLeads
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_cancelLeads : -p.cancelLeads q = q.cancelLeads p

name: natDegree_cancelLeads_lt_of_natDegree_le_natDegree_of_comm
statement:
theorem natDegree_cancelLeads_lt_of_natDegree_le_natDegree_of_comm
    (comm : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff = q.leadingCoeff * p.leadingCoeff)
    (h : p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree) (hq : 0 < q.natDegree) :
    (p.cancelLeads q).natDegree < q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · convert! hq
    simp [hp, cancelLeads]
  rw [cancelLeads, sub_eq_add_neg, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr h, pow_zero, mul_one]
  by_cases h0 :
    C p.leadingCoeff * q + -(C q.leadingCoeff * X ^ (q.natDegree - p.natDegree) * p) = 0
  · exact (le_of_eq (by simp only [h0, natDegree_zero])).trans_lt hq
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne
  · compute_degree!
    rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel]
  · contrapose h0
    rw [← leadingCoeff_eq_zero, leadingCoeff, h0, mul_assoc, X_pow_mul, ← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h,
      add_comm _ p.natDegree]
    simp only [coeff_mul_X_pow, coeff_neg, coeff_C_mul, add_tsub_cancel_left, coeff_add]
    rw [add_comm p.natDegree, tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, ← leadingCoeff, ← leadingCoeff, comm,
      add_neg_cancel]

name: leadingCoeff_sum_of_degree_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | d := d
  · simp_all [WithBot.none_eq_bot]
  · replace hd k (hk : k ∈ s) : (f k).natDegree = d := natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some <| hd k hk
    suffices (∑ k ∈ s, f k).natDegree = d by simp_all [leadingCoeff]
    apply natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
    · aesop (add safe natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le)
    · simp_all [leadingCoeff]

name: degree_list_sum_le_of_forall_degree_le
statement:
theorem degree_list_sum_le_of_forall_degree_le (l : List S[X])
    (n : WithBot ℕ) (hl : ∀ p ∈ l, degree p ≤ n) :
    degree l.sum ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] at hl
    rcases hl with ⟨hhd, htl⟩
    rw [List.sum_cons]
    exact le_trans (degree_add_le hd tl.sum) (max_le hhd (ih htl))

name: degree_list_sum_le
statement: theorem degree_list_sum_le (l : List S[X]) : degree l.sum ≤ (l.map natDegree).maximum
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_list_sum_le_of_forall_degree_le
  intro p hp
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · subst h
    simp
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree h]
    apply List.le_maximum_of_mem'
    rw [List.mem_map]
    use p
    simp [hp]

name: coeff_list_prod_of_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem coeff_list_prod_of_natDegree_le (l : List S[X]) (n : ℕ) (hl : ∀ p ∈ l, natDegree p ≤ n) :
    coeff (List.prod l) (l.length * n) = (l.map fun p => coeff p n).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    have hl' : ∀ p ∈ tl, natDegree p ≤ n := fun p hp => hl p (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)
    simp only [List.prod_cons, List.map, List.length]
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, add_comm, ← IH hl', mul_comm tl.length]
    have h : natDegree tl.prod ≤ n * tl.length := by
      refine (natDegree_list_prod_le _).trans ?_
      rw [← tl.length_map natDegree, mul_comm]
      refine List.sum_le_length_nsmul _ _ ?_
      simpa using hl'
    exact coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le (hl _ List.mem_cons_self) h

name: degree_prod_le
statement: theorem degree_prod_le : (∏ i ∈ s, f i).degree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).degree
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Multiset.map_map] using! degree_multiset_prod_le (s.1.map f)

name: leadingCoeff_multiset_prod'
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_multiset_prod' (h : (t.map leadingCoeff).prod ≠ 0) :
    t.prod.leadingCoeff = (t.map leadingCoeff).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction t using Multiset.induction_on with | empty => simp | cons a t ih => ?_
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons] at h ⊢
  rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul']
  · rw [ih]
    simp only [ne_eq]
    apply right_ne_zero_of_mul h
  · rw [ih]
    · exact h
    simp only [ne_eq]
    apply right_ne_zero_of_mul h

name: leadingCoeff_prod'
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_prod' (h : (∏ i ∈ s, (f i).leadingCoeff) ≠ 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).leadingCoeff = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simpa using leadingCoeff_multiset_prod' (s.1.map f) (by simpa using h)

name: natDegree_multiset_prod'
statement:
theorem natDegree_multiset_prod' (h : (t.map fun f => leadingCoeff f).prod ≠ 0) :
    t.prod.natDegree = (t.map fun f => natDegree f).sum
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  refine Multiset.induction_on t ?_ fun a t ih ht => ?_; · simp
  rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons] at ht ⊢
  rw [Multiset.sum_cons, Polynomial.natDegree_mul', ih]
  · apply right_ne_zero_of_mul ht
  · rwa [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_multiset_prod']
    apply right_ne_zero_of_mul ht

name: natDegree_prod'
statement:
theorem natDegree_prod' (h : (∏ i ∈ s, (f i).leadingCoeff) ≠ 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  simpa using natDegree_multiset_prod' (s.1.map f) (by simpa using h)

name: natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic
statement:
theorem natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic (h : ∀ f ∈ t, Monic f) :
    t.prod.natDegree = (t.map natDegree).sum
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  apply natDegree_multiset_prod'
  simp_all

name: degree_multiset_prod_of_monic
statement:
theorem degree_multiset_prod_of_monic [Nontrivial R] (h : ∀ f ∈ t, Monic f) :
    t.prod.degree = (t.map degree).sum
proof:
:= by
  have : t.prod ≠ 0 := Monic.ne_zero <| by simpa using monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ _ h
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree this, natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic _ h, Nat.cast_multiset_sum,
    Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun f hf => (degree_eq_natDegree (h f hf).ne_zero).symm)]

name: natDegree_prod_of_monic
statement:
theorem natDegree_prod_of_monic (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Monic) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  simpa using natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic (s.1.map f) (by simpa using h)

name: degree_prod_of_monic
statement:
theorem degree_prod_of_monic [Nontrivial R] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Monic) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).degree = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).degree
proof:
:= by
  simpa using degree_multiset_prod_of_monic (s.1.map f) (by simpa using h)

name: coeff_multiset_prod_of_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem coeff_multiset_prod_of_natDegree_le (n : ℕ) (hl : ∀ p ∈ t, natDegree p ≤ n) :
    coeff t.prod ((Multiset.card t) * n) = (t.map fun p => coeff p n).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction t using Quotient.inductionOn
  simpa using coeff_list_prod_of_natDegree_le _ _ hl

name: coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le (f : ι → R[X]) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ p ∈ s, natDegree (f p) ≤ n) :
    coeff (∏ i ∈ s, f i) (#s * n) = ∏ i ∈ s, coeff (f i) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := s
  convert! coeff_multiset_prod_of_natDegree_le (l.map f) n ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · simpa using h

name: coeff_zero_multiset_prod
statement: theorem coeff_zero_multiset_prod : t.prod.coeff 0 = (t.map fun f => coeff f 0).prod
proof:
:= by
  refine Multiset.induction_on t ?_ fun a t ht => ?_; · simp
  rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero, ht]

name: coeff_zero_prod
statement: theorem coeff_zero_prod : (∏ i ∈ s, f i).coeff 0 = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff 0

name: multiset_prod_X_sub_C_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem multiset_prod_X_sub_C_nextCoeff (t : Multiset R) :
    nextCoeff (t.map fun x => X - C x).prod = -t.sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [nextCoeff_multiset_prod]
  · simp only [nextCoeff_X_sub_C]
    exact t.sum_hom (-AddMonoidHom.id R)
  · intros
    apply monic_X_sub_C

name: prod_X_sub_C_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem prod_X_sub_C_nextCoeff {s : Finset ι} (f : ι → R) :
    nextCoeff (∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (f i))) = -∑ i ∈ s, f i

name: multiset_prod_X_sub_C_coeff_card_pred
statement:
theorem multiset_prod_X_sub_C_coeff_card_pred (t : Multiset R) (ht : 0 < Multiset.card t) :
    (t.map fun x => X - C x).prod.coeff ((Multiset.card t) - 1) = -t.sum
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  convert! multiset_prod_X_sub_C_nextCoeff (by assumption)
  rw [nextCoeff, ite_eq_right]
  swap
  · rw [natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic]
    swap
    · simp only [Multiset.mem_map]
      rintro _ ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
      apply monic_X_sub_C
    simp_rw [Multiset.sum_eq_zero_iff, Multiset.mem_map]
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mp ht
    exact fun h => one_ne_zero <| h 1 ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, natDegree_X_sub_C _⟩
  congr; rw [natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic] <;> · simp [monic_X_sub_C]

name: prod_X_sub_C_coeff_card_pred
statement:
theorem prod_X_sub_C_coeff_card_pred (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (hs : 0 < #s) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (f i))).coeff (#s - 1) = -∑ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using multiset_prod_X_sub_C_coeff_card_pred (s.1.map f) (by simpa using hs)

name: degree_sum_eq_of_linearIndepOn
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (degree_sum_le s _).trans <| Finset.sup_le fun i hi ↦ (degree_smul_le _ _).trans <|
      degree_map_le.trans <| Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ (f i).degree) hi
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro i hi
    by_cases hf : f i = 0
    · simp [hf]
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hf]
    apply le_degree_of_ne_zero
    rw [finsetSum_coeff]
    conv in (fun _ ↦ _) =>
      ext
      rw [coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul, coeff_map, mul_comm, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    intro H
    exact hf (leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp (linearIndepOn_finset_iff.mp h _ H i hi))

name: natDegree_sum_eq_of_linearIndepOn
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i hi ↦ (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans <|
      natDegree_map_le.trans <| Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ (f i).natDegree) hi
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro i hi
    by_cases hf : f i = 0
    · simp [hf]
    apply le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
    rw [finsetSum_coeff]
    conv in (fun _ ↦ _) =>
      ext
      rw [coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul, coeff_map, mul_comm, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    intro H
    exact hf (leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp (linearIndepOn_finset_iff.mp h _ H i hi))

name: natDegree_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card
statement:
@[simp]
lemma natDegree_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card (s : Multiset R) :
    (s.map (X - C ·)).prod.natDegree = Multiset.card s
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic, Multiset.map_map]
  · simp
  · exact Multiset.forall_mem_map_iff.2 fun a _ => monic_X_sub_C a

name: natDegree_finsetProd_X_sub_C_eq_card
statement:
@[simp] lemma natDegree_finsetProd_X_sub_C_eq_card {α} (s : Finset α) (f : α → R) :
    (∏ a ∈ s, (X - C (f a))).natDegree = s.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod, ← (X - C ·).comp_def f, ← Multiset.map_map,
    natDegree_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card, Multiset.card_map, Finset.card]

name: natDegree_prod
statement:
theorem natDegree_prod (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree

name: natDegree_multiset_prod

  rw [natDegree_multiset_prod']

statement: theorem smul_eval_smul (m : M) (f : S[X]) (x : S) : (m • f).eval (m • x) = m • f.eval x
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.induction_on f (fun r ↦ by rw [smul_C, eval_C, eval_C])
    (fun f g ihf ihg ↦ by rw [smul_add, eval_add, ihf, ihg, eval_add, smul_add]) fun n r _ ↦ by
    rw [smul_mul', smul_pow', smul_C, smul_X, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X_pow, eval_mul, eval_C,

proof:

  (map_prod ((Polynomial.aeval x).toRingHom.toMonoidHom : R[X] →* R) _ _).trans <|
