name: eq_quo_mul_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_pow
statement:
theorem eq_quo_mul_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_pow [Nontrivial R] (f : R[X]) {g : R[X]} (hg : g.Monic)
    (n : ℕ) : ∃ (q : R[X]) (r : Fin n → R[X]), (∀ i, (r i).degree < g.degree) ∧
      f = q * g ^ n + ∑ i, r i * g ^ i.1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hf⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨q /ₘ g, Fin.snoc r (q %ₘ g), fun i => ?_, hf.trans ?_⟩
    · cases i using Fin.lastCases with
      | cast i => simpa using hr i
      | last => simpa using degree_modByMonic_lt q hg
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, ← add_rotate', Fin.snoc_last, Fin.val_last,
        ← add_assoc, pow_succ', ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, mul_comm (q /ₘ g) g,
        modByMonic_add_div q]
      simp

name: quo_mul_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_unique
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing q₁ q₂ with
  | zero => exact ⟨by simpa using hf, funext Fin.rec0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    cases r₁ using Fin.snocCases with | snoc rs₁ r₁
    cases r₂ using Fin.snocCases with | snoc rs₂ r₂
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc,
      Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.val_last] at hf
    rw [← add_rotate' (r₁ * g ^ n), ← add_rotate' (r₂ * g ^ n), pow_succ', ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
      ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, ← add_mul, ← add_mul, ← mul_comm g, ← mul_comm g] at hf
    obtain ⟨hqr, hrs⟩ := ih
      (fun i => by simpa using hr₁ i.castSucc)
      (fun i => by simpa using hr₂ i.castSucc) hf
    obtain ⟨hq₁, hrr₁⟩ := div_modByMonic_unique q₁ r₁ hg ⟨rfl, by simpa using hr₁ (Fin.last n)⟩
    obtain ⟨hq₂, hrr₂⟩ := div_modByMonic_unique q₂ r₂ hg ⟨rfl, by simpa using hr₂ (Fin.last n)⟩
    exact ⟨hq₁.symm.trans (hqr ▸ hq₂), congrArg₂ Fin.snoc hrs (hrr₁.symm.trans (hqr ▸ hrr₂))⟩

name: eq_quo_mul_prod_add_sum_rem_mul_prod
statement:
theorem eq_quo_mul_prod_add_sum_rem_mul_prod [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {s : Finset ι} (f : R[X]) {g : ι → R[X]} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic)
    (hgg : Set.Pairwise s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) :
    ∃ (q : R[X]) (r : ι → R[X]),
      (∀ i ∈ s, (r i).degree < (g i).degree) ∧
      f = q * (∏ i ∈ s, g i) + ∑ i ∈ s, r i * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.forall_mem_cons] at hg
    rw [Finset.coe_cons, Set.pairwise_insert] at hgg
    obtain ⟨q, r, -, hf⟩ := ih hg.2 hgg.1
    have hjs {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) : i ≠ j := fun hij => hi (hij ▸ hj)
    have hc (j : ι) : ∃ a b, j ∈ s → a * g i + b * g j = 1 :=
      if h : j ∈ s ∧ i ≠ j then
        (hgg.2 j h.1 h.2).1.elim fun a h => h.elim fun b h => ⟨a, b, fun _ => h⟩
      else
        ⟨0, 0, fun hj => (h ⟨hj, hjs hj⟩).elim⟩
    choose a b hab using hc
    refine ⟨(q + ∑ j ∈ s, r j * b j %ₘ g i) /ₘ g i + ∑ j ∈ s, (r j * b j /ₘ g i + r j * a j /ₘ g j),
      Function.update (fun j => r j * a j %ₘ g j) i ((q + ∑ j ∈ s, r j * b j %ₘ g i) %ₘ g i),
      ?_, hf.trans ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.forall_mem_cons, Function.update_self]
      refine ⟨degree_modByMonic_lt _ hg.1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (hjs hj).symm]
      exact degree_modByMonic_lt _ (hg.2 j hj)
    · rw [Finset.prod_cons, Finset.sum_cons, Function.update_self, Finset.erase_cons, add_mul,
        add_add_add_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, add_comm (_ * g i), ← mul_comm (g i),
        modByMonic_add_div, add_mul, add_assoc, add_right_inj, Finset.sum_mul,
        Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (hjs hj).symm, Finset.erase_cons_of_ne _ (hjs hj),
        Finset.prod_cons, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase s g hj]
      simp_rw [← mul_assoc, ← add_mul]
      refine congrArg (· * _) ?_
      rw [add_mul, add_mul, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, ← add_mul, ← mul_comm (g i),
        modByMonic_add_div, add_assoc, mul_right_comm (_ /ₘ g j),
        ← add_mul, add_comm (_ * g j) (_ %ₘ g j), mul_comm (_ /ₘ g j),
        modByMonic_add_div, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_add,
        add_comm, hab j hj, mul_one]

name: quo_mul_prod_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_unique
statement:
theorem quo_mul_prod_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_unique {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {s : Finset ι} {g : ι → R[X]} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic)
    (hgg : Set.Pairwise s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j))
    {q₁ q₂ : R[X]} {r₁ r₂ : ι → R[X]}
    (hr₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, (r₁ i).degree < (g i).degree) (hr₂ : ∀ i ∈ s, (r₂ i).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hf : q₁ * (∏ i ∈ s, g i) + ∑ i ∈ s, r₁ i * (∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k) =
      q₂ * (∏ i ∈ s, g i) + ∑ i ∈ s, r₂ i * (∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k)) :
    q₁ = q₂ ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, r₁ i = r₂ i
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simpa using hf
  | cons i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.forall_mem_cons] at hg hr₁ hr₂
    have cop : IsCoprime (g i) (∏ i ∈ s, g i) := by
      clear *-hgg
      induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
      | empty => simp [isCoprime_one_right]
      | cons j s hj ih =>
        rw [Finset.prod_cons, IsCoprime.mul_right_iff]
        refine ⟨hgg (by simp) (by simp) fun hij => hi (by simp [hij]), ih ?_ ?_⟩
        · exact mt Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hi
        · exact hgg.mono (SetLike.coe_mono (Finset.cons_subset_cons.2 (Finset.subset_cons hj)))
    rw [Finset.prod_cons, Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sum_cons, Finset.erase_cons] at hf
    have hjs {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) : i ≠ j := fun hij => hi (hij ▸ hj)
    simp +contextual only [Finset.erase_cons_of_ne hi (hjs _),
      Finset.prod_cons, ← mul_left_comm (g i), ← Finset.mul_sum] at hf
    rw [add_left_comm, ← mul_add, add_left_comm, ← mul_add] at hf
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, add_sub_add_comm, ← sub_mul, ← mul_sub,
      ← neg_sub, neg_mul, neg_add_eq_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hf
    have hgid : g i ∣ r₂ i - r₁ i := cop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (hf ▸ dvd_mul_right _ _)
    rw [add_sub_add_comm, ← sub_mul, mul_add, ← mul_assoc,
      ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', ← sub_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hf
    simp only [← sub_mul] at hf
    have hpgd : ∏ i ∈ s, g i ∣ _ := cop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (hf.symm ▸ dvd_mul_left _ _)
    have hdr : (r₂ i - r₁ i).degree < (g i).degree :=
      (degree_sub_le (r₂ i) (r₁ i)).trans_lt (max_lt hr₂.1 hr₁.1)
    have hr0 : r₂ i - r₁ i = 0 := (hg.1.not_dvd_of_degree_lt · hdr).mtr hgid
    have hpm : (∏ i ∈ s, g i).Monic := monic_prod_of_monic s g hg.2
    have hdp : (∑ i ∈ s, (r₁ i - r₂ i) * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k).degree < (∏ i ∈ s, g i).degree := by
      refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt ((Finset.sup_lt_iff ?_).2 ?_)
      · rw [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, degree_ne_bot]
        exact hpm.ne_zero_of_polynomial_ne fun h : r₂ i - r₁ i = g i => lt_irrefl _ (h ▸ hdr)
      · intro j hj
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase s g hj, mul_comm (g j), (hg.2 j hj).degree_mul]
        refine (degree_mul_le (r₁ j - r₂ j) (∏ k ∈ s.erase j, g k)).trans_lt ?_
        have dnb : (∏ k ∈ s.erase j, g k).degree ≠ ⊥ := by
          rw [degree_ne_bot]
          exact (monic_prod_of_monic _ g
            fun j hj => hg.2 j (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj)).ne_zero_of_polynomial_ne
            fun h : r₂ i - r₁ i = g i => lt_irrefl _ (h ▸ hdr)
        rw [add_comm, WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_left dnb]
        exact (degree_sub_le (r₁ j) (r₂ j)).trans_lt (max_lt (hr₁.2 j hj) (hr₂.2 j hj))
    have hp0 : ∑ i ∈ s, (r₁ i - r₂ i) * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k = 0 :=
      (hpm.not_dvd_of_degree_lt · hdp).mtr hpgd
    rw [hr0, hp0, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_mul, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero,
      ← mul_rotate, (hpm.mul hg.1).mul_right_eq_zero_iff] at hf
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hp0
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at hf hr0 hp0
    obtain ⟨-, hrr⟩ := ih hg.2 (hgg.mono (SetLike.coe_mono (Finset.subset_cons hi)))
      hr₁.2 hr₂.2 congr($hf * ∏ i ∈ s, g i + $hp0)
    exact ⟨hf, (Finset.forall_mem_cons hi (fun j => r₁ j = r₂ j)).2 ⟨hr0.symm, hrr⟩⟩

name: eq_quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow
statement:
theorem eq_quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {s : Finset ι} (f : R[X]) {g : ι → R[X]} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic)
    (hgg : Set.Pairwise s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) (n : ι → ℕ) :
    ∃ (q : R[X]) (r : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) → R[X]),
      (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r i j).degree < (g i).degree) ∧
      f = q * (∏ i ∈ s, g i ^ n i) +
        ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j, r i j * g i ^ j.1 * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k ^ n k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, -, hf⟩ := eq_quo_mul_prod_add_sum_rem_mul_prod f
    (fun i hi => (hg i hi).pow (n i))
    (hgg.mono' fun i j hij => hij.pow)
  have hc (i : ι) : ∃ (q' : R[X]) (r' : Fin (n i) → R[X]), i ∈ s →
      (∀ j, (r' j).degree < (g i).degree) ∧
      r i = q' * g i ^ (n i) + ∑ j, r' j * g i ^ j.1 :=
    if hi : i ∈ s then
      (eq_quo_mul_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_pow (r i) (hg i hi) (n i)).elim
        fun q' h => h.elim fun r' h => ⟨q', r', fun _ => h⟩
    else
      ⟨0, fun _ => 0, hi.elim⟩
  choose q' r' hr' hr using hc
  refine ⟨q + ∑ i ∈ s, q' i, r', hr', hf.trans ?_⟩
  rw [add_mul, add_assoc, add_right_inj, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase s _ hi, hr i hi, add_mul, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]

name: quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow_unique
statement:
theorem quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow_unique {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {s : Finset ι} {g : ι → R[X]} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic)
    (hgg : Set.Pairwise s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) {n : ι → ℕ}
    {q₁ q₂ : R[X]} {r₁ r₂ : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) → R[X]}
    (hr₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r₁ i j).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hr₂ : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r₂ i j).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hf : q₁ * (∏ i ∈ s, g i ^ n i) +
        ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j, r₁ i j * g i ^ j.1 * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k ^ n k =
      q₂ * (∏ i ∈ s, g i ^ n i) +
        ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j, r₂ i j * g i ^ j.1 * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k ^ n k) :
    q₁ = q₂ ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, r₁ i = r₂ i
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  simp only [← Finset.sum_mul] at hf
  have hrd {r : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) → R[X]} (hr : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r i j).degree < (g i).degree)
      (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : (∑ j, r i j * g i ^ j.1).degree < (g i ^ n i).degree := by
    refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt ((Finset.sup_lt_iff ?_).2 fun j _ => ?_)
    · rw [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, degree_ne_bot]
      exact ((hg i hi).pow (n i)).ne_zero
    · refine (degree_mul_le _ _).trans_lt ?_
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree ((hg i hi).pow j.1).ne_zero, (hg i hi).natDegree_pow,
        degree_eq_natDegree ((hg i hi).pow (n i)).ne_zero, (hg i hi).natDegree_pow]
      conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 j.neZero.ne)]
      rw [Nat.add_one_mul, Nat.add_comm, Nat.cast_add, ← degree_eq_natDegree (hg i hi).ne_zero]
      refine WithBot.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (WithBot.natCast_ne_bot _) (hr i hi j) ?_
      exact Nat.cast_le.2 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt j.isLt))
  obtain ⟨hq, hr⟩ := quo_mul_prod_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_unique
    (fun i hi => (hg i hi).pow (n i)) (hgg.imp fun i j hij => hij.pow) (hrd hr₁) (hrd hr₂) hf
  refine ⟨hq, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  exact (quo_mul_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_unique (hg i hi) (hr₁ i hi) (hr₂ i hi)
    (congrArg (0 * g i ^ n i + ·) (hr i hi))).2

name: mul_prod_pow_inverse_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse
statement:
theorem mul_prod_pow_inverse_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*}
    {s : Finset ι} (f : R[X]) {g : ι → R[X]} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic)
    (hgg : Set.Pairwise s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j))
    (n : ι → ℕ) {gi : ι → K} (hgi : ∀ i ∈ s, gi i * algebraMap R[X] K (g i) = 1) :
    ∃ (q : R[X]) (r : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) → R[X]),
      (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r i j).degree < (g i).degree) ∧
      algebraMap R[X] K f * ∏ i ∈ s, gi i ^ n i =
        algebraMap R[X] K q + ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j,
          algebraMap R[X] K (r i j) * gi i ^ (j.1 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hf⟩ := eq_quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow f hg hgg n
  refine ⟨q, fun i j => r i j.rev, fun i hi j => hr i hi j.rev, ?_⟩
  rw [hf, map_add, map_mul, map_prod, add_mul, mul_assoc, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  have hc (x : ι) (hx : x ∈ s) : (algebraMap R[X] K) (g x ^ n x) * gi x ^ n x = 1 := by
    rw [map_pow, ← mul_pow, mul_comm, hgi x hx, one_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl hc, Finset.prod_const_one,
    mul_one, add_right_inj, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ← Equiv.sum_comp Fin.revPerm]
  refine Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun j => ?_
  rw [Fin.revPerm_apply, map_mul, map_prod, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul s _ hi,
    ← mul_rotate', mul_assoc, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Finset.prod_congr rfl fun x hx => hc x (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx),
    Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one, map_mul, map_pow, mul_left_comm]
  refine congrArg (_ * ·) ?_
  rw [← mul_one (gi i ^ (j.1 + 1)), ← @one_pow K _ j.rev, ← hgi i hi,
    mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Fin.val_rev, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (by lia)]

name: quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse_unique
statement:
theorem quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse_unique [FaithfulSMul R[X] K] {ι : Type*}
    {s : Finset ι} {g : ι → R[X]} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic)
    (hgg : Set.Pairwise s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j))
    {n : ι → ℕ} {gi : ι → K} (hgi : ∀ i ∈ s, gi i * algebraMap R[X] K (g i) = 1)
    {q₁ q₂ : R[X]} {r₁ r₂ : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) → R[X]}
    (hr₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r₁ i j).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hr₂ : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, (r₂ i j).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hf : algebraMap R[X] K q₁ + ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j, algebraMap R[X] K (r₁ i j) * gi i ^ (j.1 + 1) =
      algebraMap R[X] K q₂ + ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j, algebraMap R[X] K (r₂ i j) * gi i ^ (j.1 + 1)) :
    q₁ = q₂ ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, r₁ i = r₂ i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices hff : ∀ {q : R[X]} {r : (i : ι) → Fin (n i) → R[X]},
      (algebraMap R[X] K q + ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j,
        algebraMap R[X] K (r i j) * gi i ^ (j.1 + 1)) * ∏ i ∈ s, algebraMap R[X] K (g i) ^ n i =
      algebraMap R[X] K (q * ∏ i ∈ s, g i ^ n i + ∑ i ∈ s,
        ∑ j : Fin (n i), r i j.rev * g i ^ j.1 * ∏ k ∈ s.erase i, g k ^ n k) by
    apply_fun (· * ∏ i ∈ s, algebraMap R[X] K (g i) ^ n i) at hf
    rw [hff, hff, (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R[X] K).eq_iff] at hf
    obtain ⟨hq, hr⟩ := quo_mul_prod_pow_add_sum_rem_mul_prod_pow_unique hg hgg
      (fun i hi j => hr₁ i hi j.rev) (fun i hi j => hr₂ i hi j.rev) hf
    exact ⟨hq, fun i hi => funext fun j => j.rev_rev ▸ congrFun (hr i hi) j.rev⟩
  intro q r
  simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_mul, map_add, map_sum, map_mul, map_prod, map_pow]
  refine congrArg (_ + ·) (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_)
  refine (Equiv.sum_comp Fin.revPerm _).symm.trans (Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun j => ?_)
  rw [Fin.revPerm_apply, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase s _ hi, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc (algebraMap R[X] K (r i j.rev))]
  refine congrArg (algebraMap R[X] K (r i j.rev) * · * _) ?_
  rw [← mul_one (gi i ^ (j.rev.1 + 1)), ← @one_pow K _ j, ← hgi i hi,
    mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Fin.val_rev, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (by lia), mul_right_comm, ← mul_pow, hgi i hi, one_pow, one_mul]

name: div_prod_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_div
statement:
theorem div_prod_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_div (f : R[X]) {ι : Type*} {g : ι → R[X]} {s : Finset ι}
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic) (hcop : Set.Pairwise ↑s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) :
    ∃ (q : R[X]) (r : ι → R[X]),
      (∀ i ∈ s, (r i).degree < (g i).degree) ∧
        ((↑f : K) / ∏ i ∈ s, ↑(g i)) = ↑q + ∑ i ∈ s, (r i : K) / (g i : K)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial R :=
    have : Nontrivial R[X] := Module.nontrivial R[X] K
    Module.nontrivial R R[X]
  have hgi (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : (algebraMap R[X] K (g i))⁻¹ * algebraMap R[X] K (g i) = 1 :=
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (by simpa using (hg i hi).ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hf⟩ := mul_prod_pow_inverse_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse
    f hg hcop (fun _ => 1) hgi
  refine ⟨q, fun i => r i 0, fun i hi => hr i hi 0, ?_⟩
  simp_rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.val_zero, zero_add, pow_one, Finset.prod_inv_distrib] at hf
  simp_rw [Algebra.cast, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact hf

name: quo_add_sum_rem_div_unique
statement:
theorem quo_add_sum_rem_div_unique {ι : Type*} {g : ι → R[X]} {s : Finset ι}
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic) (hcop : Set.Pairwise ↑s fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j))
    {q₁ q₂ : R[X]} {r₁ r₂ : ι → R[X]}
    (hr₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, (r₁ i).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hr₂ : ∀ i ∈ s, (r₂ i).degree < (g i).degree)
    (hf : ↑q₁ + ∑ i ∈ s, (r₁ i : K) / (g i : K) = ↑q₂ + ∑ i ∈ s, (r₂ i : K) / (g i : K)) :
    q₁ = q₂ ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, r₁ i = r₂ i
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial R :=
    have : Nontrivial R[X] := Module.nontrivial R[X] K
    Module.nontrivial R R[X]
  have hgi (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : (algebraMap R[X] K (g i))⁻¹ * algebraMap R[X] K (g i) = 1 :=
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (by simpa using (hg i hi).ne_zero)
  refine (quo_add_sum_rem_mul_pow_inverse_unique (n := fun _ => 1)
      hg hcop hgi (fun i hi _ => hr₁ i hi) (fun i hi _ => hr₂ i hi) ?_).imp_right
      fun h i hi => congrFun (h i hi) 0
  simp_rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.val_zero, zero_add, pow_one, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact hf

name: div_eq_quo_add_rem_div_add_rem_div
statement:
theorem div_eq_quo_add_rem_div_add_rem_div (f : R[X]) {g₁ g₂ : R[X]} (hg₁ : g₁.Monic)
    (hg₂ : g₂.Monic) (hcoprime : IsCoprime g₁ g₂) :
    ∃ q r₁ r₂ : R[X],
      r₁.degree < g₁.degree ∧
        r₂.degree < g₂.degree ∧ (f : K) / (↑g₁ * ↑g₂) = ↑q + ↑r₁ / ↑g₁ + ↑r₂ / ↑g₂
proof:
:= by
  let g : Bool → R[X] := Bool.rec g₂ g₁
  have hg (i : Bool) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) : (g i).Monic := Bool.rec hg₂ hg₁ i
  have hcoprime : Set.Pairwise (Finset.univ : Finset Bool) fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j) := by
    simp [g, Set.pairwise_insert, hcoprime, hcoprime.symm]
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hf⟩ := div_prod_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_div K f hg hcoprime
  refine ⟨q, r true, r false, hr true (Finset.mem_univ true), hr false (Finset.mem_univ false), ?_⟩
  simpa [g, add_assoc] using hf

name: quo_add_rem_div_add_rem_div_unique
statement:
theorem quo_add_rem_div_add_rem_div_unique {g₁ g₂ : R[X]} (hg₁ : g₁.Monic)
    (hg₂ : g₂.Monic) (hcoprime : IsCoprime g₁ g₂)
    {q₁ q₂ r₁₁ r₁₂ r₂₁ r₂₂ : R[X]}
    (hr₁₁ : r₁₁.degree < g₁.degree) (hr₁₂ : r₁₂.degree < g₁.degree)
    (hr₂₁ : r₂₁.degree < g₂.degree) (hr₂₂ : r₂₂.degree < g₂.degree)
    (hf : (↑q₁ + ↑r₁₁ / ↑g₁ + ↑r₂₁ / ↑g₂ : K) = ↑q₂ + ↑r₁₂ / ↑g₁ + ↑r₂₂ / ↑g₂) :
    q₁ = q₂ ∧ r₁₁ = r₁₂ ∧ r₂₁ = r₂₂
proof:
:= by
  let g : Bool → R[X] := Bool.rec g₂ g₁
  let r₁ : Bool → R[X] := Bool.rec r₂₁ r₁₁
  let r₂ : Bool → R[X] := Bool.rec r₂₂ r₁₂
  have hg (i : Bool) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) : (g i).Monic := Bool.rec hg₂ hg₁ i
  have hcoprime : Set.Pairwise (Finset.univ : Finset Bool) fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j) := by
    simp [g, Set.pairwise_insert, hcoprime, hcoprime.symm]
  have hr₁ (i : Bool) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) : (r₁ i).degree < (g i).degree := Bool.rec hr₂₁ hr₁₁ i
  have hr₂ (i : Bool) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) : (r₂ i).degree < (g i).degree := Bool.rec hr₂₂ hr₁₂ i
  refine (quo_add_sum_rem_div_unique K hg hcoprime hr₁ hr₂ ?_).imp_right fun h =>
    ⟨h true (Finset.mem_univ true), h false (Finset.mem_univ false)⟩
  simpa [g, r₁, r₂, add_assoc] using hf

name: monic_zero_iff_subsingleton
statement: theorem monic_zero_iff_subsingleton : Monic (0 : R[X]) ↔ Subsingleton R

name: not_monic_zero_iff
statement: theorem not_monic_zero_iff : ¬Monic (0 : R[X]) ↔ (0 : R) ≠ 1

name: monic_zero_iff_subsingleton'
statement:
theorem monic_zero_iff_subsingleton' :
    Monic (0 : R[X]) ↔ (∀ f g : R[X], f = g) ∧ ∀ a b : R, a = b
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.monic_zero_iff_subsingleton.trans
    ⟨by
      intro
      simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton], fun h => subsingleton_iff.mpr h.2⟩

name: Monic.as_sum
statement:
theorem Monic.as_sum (hp : p.Monic) :
    p = X ^ p.natDegree + ∑ i ∈ range p.natDegree, C (p.coeff i) * X ^ i
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow, sum_range_succ_comm]
  suffices C (p.coeff p.natDegree) = 1 by rw [this, one_mul]
  exact congr_arg C hp

name: Monic.map
statement: theorem Monic.map [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) (hp : Monic p) : Monic (p.map f)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_or_nontrivial S |>.elim (·.elim ..) fun _ ↦
    f.map_one ▸ hp ▸ leadingCoeff_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff _ <| isUnit_one

name: monic_C_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_eq_one
statement:
theorem monic_C_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_eq_one {b : R} (hp : b * p.leadingCoeff = 1) :
    Monic (C b * p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Monic
  nontriviality
  rw [leadingCoeff_mul' _] <;> simp [leadingCoeff_C b, hp]

name: monic_mul_C_of_leadingCoeff_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem monic_mul_C_of_leadingCoeff_mul_eq_one {b : R} (hp : p.leadingCoeff * b = 1) :
    Monic (p * C b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Monic
  nontriviality
  rw [leadingCoeff_mul' _] <;> simp [leadingCoeff_C b, hp]

name: monic_X_pow_add
statement: theorem monic_X_pow_add {n : ℕ} (H : degree p < n) : Monic (X ^ n + p)
proof:
:=
  monic_of_degree_le n
    (le_trans (degree_add_le _ _) (max_le (degree_X_pow_le _) (le_of_lt H)))
    (by rw [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt H, add_zero])

name: monic_X_pow_add_C
statement: theorem monic_X_pow_add_C {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) : (X ^ n + C a).Monic
proof:
:=
  monic_X_pow_add <| (lt_of_le_of_lt degree_C_le
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_pos, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, h, not_false_eq_true]))

name: monic_X_add_C
statement: theorem monic_X_add_C (x : R) : Monic (X + C x)

name: Monic.mul
statement: theorem Monic.mul (hp : Monic p) (hq : Monic q) : Monic (p * q)
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if h0 : (0 : R) = 1 then
    haveI := subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one h0
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  else by
    have : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
      simp [Monic.def.1 hp, Monic.def.1 hq, Ne.symm h0]
    rw [Monic.def, leadingCoeff_mul' this, Monic.def.1 hp, Monic.def.1 hq, one_mul]

name: Monic.pow
statement:
theorem Monic.pow (hp : Monic p) : ∀ n : ℕ, Monic (p ^ n)
  | 0 => monic_one
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact (Monic.pow hp n).mul hp

name: Monic.add_of_left
statement: theorem Monic.add_of_left (hp : Monic p) (hpq : degree q < degree p) : Monic (p + q)

name: Monic.add_of_right
statement: theorem Monic.add_of_right (hq : Monic q) (hpq : degree p < degree q) : Monic (p + q)

name: Monic.of_mul_monic_left
statement: theorem Monic.of_mul_monic_left (hp : p.Monic) (hpq : (p * q).Monic) : q.Monic
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hpq
  rw [Monic.def] at hpq ⊢
  rwa [leadingCoeff_monic_mul hp]

name: Monic.of_mul_monic_right
statement: theorem Monic.of_mul_monic_right (hq : q.Monic) (hpq : (p * q).Monic) : p.Monic
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hpq
  rw [Monic.def] at hpq ⊢
  rwa [leadingCoeff_mul_monic hq]

name: comp
statement: lemma comp (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q.Monic) (h : q.natDegree ≠ 0) : (p.comp q).Monic
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have : (p.comp q).natDegree = p.natDegree * q.natDegree :=
    natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero <| by simp [hp.leadingCoeff, hq.leadingCoeff]
  rw [Monic.def, Polynomial.leadingCoeff, this, coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree h, hp.leadingCoeff,
    hq.leadingCoeff, one_pow, mul_one]

name: comp_X_add_C
statement: lemma comp_X_add_C (hp : p.Monic) (r : R) : (p.comp (X + C r)).Monic
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  refine hp.comp (monic_X_add_C _) fun ha ↦ ?_
  rw [natDegree_X_add_C] at ha
  exact one_ne_zero ha

name: degree_le_zero_iff_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_le_zero_iff_eq_one (hp : p.Monic) : p.degree ≤ 0 ↔ p = 1

name: natDegree_mul
statement:
theorem natDegree_mul (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q.Monic) :
    (p * q).natDegree = p.natDegree + q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  apply natDegree_mul'
  simp [hp.leadingCoeff, hq.leadingCoeff]

name: degree_mul_comm
statement: theorem degree_mul_comm (hp : p.Monic) (q : R[X]) : (p * q).degree = (q * p).degree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : q = 0
  · simp [h]
  rw [degree_mul', hp.degree_mul]
  · exact add_comm _ _
  · rwa [hp.leadingCoeff, one_mul, leadingCoeff_ne_zero]

name: natDegree_mul_comm
statement: theorem natDegree_mul_comm (hp : p.Monic) (q : R[X]) : (p * q).natDegree = (q * p).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : q = 0
  · simp [h]
  rw [hp.natDegree_mul' h, Polynomial.natDegree_mul', add_comm]
  simpa [hp.leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_ne_zero]

name: _root_.Polynomial.not_isUnit_X_add_C
statement: theorem _root_.Polynomial.not_isUnit_X_add_C [Nontrivial R] (a : R) : ¬ IsUnit (X + C a)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨_, g, hfg, hgf⟩, rfl⟩
  have h := (monic_X_add_C a).natDegree_mul' (right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hfg)
  rw [hfg, natDegree_one, natDegree_X_add_C] at h
  grind

name: not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt (hp : Monic p) (h0 : q ≠ 0) (hl : natDegree q < natDegree p) :
    ¬p ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
  rw [hp.natDegree_mul' <| right_ne_zero_of_mul h0] at hl
  exact hl.not_ge (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: not_dvd_of_degree_lt
statement: theorem not_dvd_of_degree_lt (hp : Monic p) (h0 : q ≠ 0) (hl : degree q < degree p) : ¬p ∣ q
proof:
:=
  Monic.not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt hp h0 <| natDegree_lt_natDegree h0 hl

name: nextCoeff_mul
statement:
theorem nextCoeff_mul (hp : Monic p) (hq : Monic q) :
    nextCoeff (p * q) = nextCoeff p + nextCoeff q
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality
  simp only [← coeff_one_reverse]
  rw [reverse_mul] <;> simp [hp.leadingCoeff, hq.leadingCoeff, mul_coeff_one, add_comm]

name: nextCoeff_pow
statement: theorem nextCoeff_pow (hp : p.Monic) (n : ℕ) : (p ^ n).nextCoeff = n • p.nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, zero_smul, ← map_one (f := C), nextCoeff_C_eq_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, (hp.pow n).nextCoeff_mul hp, ih, succ_nsmul]

name: eq_one_of_map_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_map_eq_one {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S) (hp : p.Monic)
    (map_eq : p.map f = 1) : p = 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have hdeg : p.degree = 0 := by
    rw [← degree_map_eq_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero f _, map_eq, degree_one]
    · rw [hp.leadingCoeff, f.map_one]
      exact one_ne_zero
  have hndeg : p.natDegree = 0 :=
    WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp ((degree_eq_natDegree hp.ne_zero).symm.trans hdeg)
  convert! eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero hdeg
  rw [← hndeg, ← Polynomial.leadingCoeff, hp.leadingCoeff, C.map_one]

name: natDegree_pow
statement: theorem natDegree_pow (hp : p.Monic) (n : ℕ) : (p ^ n).natDegree = n * p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn => rw [pow_succ, (hp.pow n).natDegree_mul hp, hn, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm]

name: natDegree_le_of_dvd
statement:
theorem natDegree_le_of_dvd (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hdvd : p ∣ q) :
    p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rcases hdvd with ⟨r, rfl⟩
  by_cases r = 0 <;>
    simp_all [natDegree_mul']

name: natDegree_pow_X_add_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_pow_X_add_C [Nontrivial R] (n : ℕ) (r : R) : ((X + C r) ^ n).natDegree = n

name: Monic.eq_one_of_isUnit
statement: theorem Monic.eq_one_of_isUnit (hm : Monic p) (hpu : IsUnit p) : p = 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  obtain ⟨q, h⟩ := hpu.exists_right_inv
  have := hm.natDegree_mul' (right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h)
  rw [h, natDegree_one, eq_comm, add_eq_zero] at this
  exact hm.natDegree_eq_zero.mp this.1

name: Monic.isUnit_iff
statement: theorem Monic.isUnit_iff (hm : p.Monic) : IsUnit p ↔ p = 1

name: eq_of_monic_of_associated
statement: theorem eq_of_monic_of_associated (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q.Monic) (hpq : Associated p q) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hpq
  rw [(hp.of_mul_monic_left hq).eq_one_of_isUnit u.isUnit, mul_one]

name: MonicDegreeEq.natDegree
statement:
@[simp]
lemma MonicDegreeEq.natDegree [Nontrivial R] (p : MonicDegreeEq R n) :
    p.1.natDegree = n

name: MonicDegreeEq.degree
statement:
@[simp]
lemma MonicDegreeEq.degree [Nontrivial R] (p : MonicDegreeEq R n) :
    p.1.degree = n

name: MonicDegreeEq.monic
statement:
lemma MonicDegreeEq.monic (p : MonicDegreeEq R n) :
    p.1.Monic
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff, p.natDegree, p.2.1]

name: MonicDegreeEq.coeff_of_ge
statement:
lemma MonicDegreeEq.coeff_of_ge (p : MonicDegreeEq R n) (i : ℕ) (hi : n ≤ i) :
    p.1.coeff i = if i = n then 1 else 0

name: monic_multiset_prod_of_monic
statement:
theorem monic_multiset_prod_of_monic (t : Multiset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (ht : ∀ i ∈ t, Monic (f i)) :
    Monic (t.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  revert ht
  refine t.induction_on ?_ ?_; · simp
  intro a t ih ht
  rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
  exact (ht _ (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)).mul (ih fun _ hi => ht _ (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hi))

name: monic_prod_of_monic
statement:
theorem monic_prod_of_monic (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, Monic (f i)) :
    Monic (∏ i ∈ s, f i)

name: monic_finprod_of_monic
statement:
theorem monic_finprod_of_monic (α : Type*) (f : α → R[X])
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ Function.mulSupport f, Monic (f i)) :
    Monic (finprod f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finprod_def]
  split_ifs
  · exact monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun a ha => hf a ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp ha)
  · exact monic_one

name: Monic.nextCoeff_multiset_prod
statement:
theorem Monic.nextCoeff_multiset_prod (t : Multiset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (h : ∀ i ∈ t, Monic (f i)) :
    nextCoeff (t.map f).prod = (t.map fun i => nextCoeff (f i)).sum
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  refine Multiset.induction_on t ?_ fun a t ih ht => ?_
  · simp only [Multiset.notMem_zero, forall_prop_of_true, forall_prop_of_false, Multiset.map_zero,
      Multiset.prod_zero, Multiset.sum_zero, not_false_iff, forall_true_iff]
    rw [← C_1]
    rw [nextCoeff_C_eq_zero]
  · rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons,
      Monic.nextCoeff_mul, ih]
    exacts [fun i hi => ht i (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hi), ht a (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _),
      monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ _ fun b bs => ht _ (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem bs)]

name: Monic.nextCoeff_prod
statement:
theorem Monic.nextCoeff_prod (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Monic (f i)) :
    nextCoeff (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, nextCoeff (f i)

name: irreducible_of_monic
statement:
lemma irreducible_of_monic (hp : p.Monic) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) :
    Irreducible p ↔ ∀ f g : R[X], f.Monic → g.Monic → f * g = p → f = 1 ∨ g = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h f g hf hg hp => (h.2 hp.symm).imp hf.eq_one_of_isUnit hg.eq_one_of_isUnit, fun h =>
      ⟨hp1 ∘ hp.eq_one_of_isUnit, fun f g hfg =>
        (h (g * C f.leadingCoeff) (f * C g.leadingCoeff) ?_ ?_ ?_).symm.imp
          (.of_mul_eq_one _)
          (.of_mul_eq_one _)⟩⟩
  · rwa [Monic, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, ← leadingCoeff_mul, mul_comm, ← hfg, ← Monic]
  · rwa [Monic, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, ← leadingCoeff_mul, ← hfg, ← Monic]
  · rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← C_mul, ← leadingCoeff_mul, ← hfg, hp.leadingCoeff, C_1, mul_one,
      mul_comm, ← hfg]

name: Monic.irreducible_iff_natDegree
statement:
lemma Monic.irreducible_iff_natDegree (hp : p.Monic) :
    Irreducible p ↔
      p ≠ 1 ∧ ∀ f g : R[X], f.Monic → g.Monic → f * g = p → f.natDegree = 0 ∨ g.natDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp1 : p = 1; · simp [hp1]
  rw [irreducible_of_monic hp hp1, and_iff_right hp1]
  refine forall₄_congr fun a b ha hb => ?_
  rw [ha.natDegree_eq_zero, hb.natDegree_eq_zero]

name: Monic.irreducible_iff_natDegree'
statement:
lemma Monic.irreducible_iff_natDegree' (hp : p.Monic) : Irreducible p ↔ p ≠ 1 ∧
    ∀ f g : R[X], f.Monic → g.Monic → f * g = p → g.natDegree ∉ Ioc 0 (p.natDegree / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [hp.irreducible_iff_natDegree, mem_Ioc, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le zero_lt_two, mul_two]
  apply and_congr_right'
  constructor <;> intro h f g hf hg he <;> subst he
  · rw [hf.natDegree_mul hg, add_le_add_iff_right]
    exact fun ha => (h f g hf hg rfl).elim (ha.1.trans_le ha.2).ne' ha.1.ne'
  · simp_rw [hf.natDegree_mul hg, pos_iff_ne_zero] at h
    contrapose! h
    obtain hl | hl := le_total f.natDegree g.natDegree
    · exact ⟨g, f, hg, hf, mul_comm g f, h.1, by gcongr⟩
    · exact ⟨f, g, hf, hg, rfl, h.2, by gcongr⟩

name: Monic.irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt
statement:
lemma Monic.irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) :
    Irreducible p ↔ ∀ q, Monic q → natDegree q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (natDegree p / 2) → ¬ q ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.irreducible_iff_natDegree', and_iff_right hp1]
  constructor
  · rintro h g hg hdg ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact h f g (hg.of_mul_monic_left hp) hg (mul_comm f g) hdg
  · rintro h f g - hg rfl hdg
    exact h g hg hdg (dvd_mul_left g f)

name: Monic.not_irreducible_iff_exists_add_mul_eq_coeff
statement:
lemma Monic.not_irreducible_iff_exists_add_mul_eq_coeff (hm : p.Monic) (hnd : p.natDegree = 2) :
    ¬Irreducible p ↔ ∃ c₁ c₂, p.coeff 0 = c₁ * c₂ ∧ p.coeff 1 = c₁ + c₂
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · simp [natDegree_of_subsingleton] at hnd
  rw [hm.irreducible_iff_natDegree', and_iff_right, hnd]
  · push Not
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl, hdb⟩
      simp only [Nat.Ioc_succ_singleton, zero_add, mem_singleton] at hdb
      have hda := hnd
      rw [ha.natDegree_mul hb, hdb] at hda
      use a.coeff 0, b.coeff 0, mul_coeff_zero a b
      simpa only [nextCoeff, hnd, add_right_cancel hda, hdb] using! ha.nextCoeff_mul hb
    · rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, hmul, hadd⟩
      refine
        ⟨X + C c₁, X + C c₂, monic_X_add_C _, monic_X_add_C _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow, hnd, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
          Finset.sum_range_one, ← hnd, hm.coeff_natDegree, hnd, hmul, hadd, C_mul, C_add, C_1]
        ring
      · simp
  · rintro rfl
    simp [natDegree_one] at hnd

name: Monic.natDegree_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Monic.natDegree_map [Semiring S] [Nontrivial S] {P : R[X]} (hmo : P.Monic) (f : R →+* S) :
    (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm natDegree_map_le (le_natDegree_of_ne_zero ?_)
  rw [coeff_map, Monic.coeff_natDegree hmo, map_one]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: Monic.degree_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Monic.degree_map [Semiring S] [Nontrivial S] {P : R[X]} (hmo : P.Monic) (f : R →+* S) :
    (P.map f).degree = P.degree

name: monic_of_injective
statement: theorem monic_of_injective (hf : Injective f) {p : R[X]} (hp : (p.map f).Monic) : p.Monic
proof:
:= by
  apply hf
  rw [← leadingCoeff_map_of_injective hf, hp.leadingCoeff, f.map_one]

name: _root_.Function.Injective.monic_map_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Injective.monic_map_iff (hf : Injective f) {p : R[X]} :
    p.Monic ↔ (p.map f).Monic

name: monic_X_sub_C
statement: theorem monic_X_sub_C (x : R) : Monic (X - C x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, C_neg] using monic_X_add_C (-x)

name: monic_X_pow_sub
statement: theorem monic_X_pow_sub {n : ℕ} (H : degree p < n) : Monic (X ^ n - p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using monic_X_pow_add (show degree (-p) < n by rwa [← degree_neg p] at H)

name: monic_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem monic_X_pow_sub_C {R : Type*} [Ring R] (a : R) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    (X ^ n - C a).Monic
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using monic_X_pow_add_C (-a) h

name: monic_X_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem monic_X_pow_sub_one {R : Type*} [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    (X ^ n - 1 : R[X]).Monic
proof:
:= by
  simpa using monic_X_pow_sub_C (1 : R) h

name: not_isUnit_X_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem not_isUnit_X_pow_sub_one (R : Type*) [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] (n : ℕ) :
    ¬IsUnit (X ^ n - 1 : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp at h
  apply hn
  rw [← @natDegree_one R, ← (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hn).eq_one_of_isUnit h, natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]

name: Monic.comp_X_sub_C
statement: lemma Monic.comp_X_sub_C {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (r : R) : (p.comp (X - C r)).Monic

name: Monic.sub_of_left
statement:
theorem Monic.sub_of_left {p q : R[X]} (hp : Monic p) (hpq : degree q < degree p) :
    Monic (p - q)

name: Monic.sub_of_right
statement:
theorem Monic.sub_of_right {p q : R[X]} (hq : q.leadingCoeff = -1) (hpq : degree p < degree q) :
    Monic (p - q)
proof:
:= by
  have : (-q).coeff (-q).natDegree = 1 := by
    rw [natDegree_neg, coeff_neg, show q.coeff q.natDegree = -1 from hq, neg_neg]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply Monic.add_of_right this
  rwa [degree_neg]

name: not_monic_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_monic_zero : ¬Monic (0 : R[X])

name: Monic.mul_left_ne_zero
statement: theorem Monic.mul_left_ne_zero (hp : Monic p) {q : R[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) : q * p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 1
  · simpa [h]
  rw [Ne, ← degree_eq_bot, hp.degree_mul, WithBot.add_eq_bot, not_or, degree_eq_bot]
  refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
  rw [← hp.degree_le_zero_iff_eq_one, not_le] at h
  refine (lt_trans ?_ h).ne'
  simp

name: Monic.mul_right_ne_zero
statement: theorem Monic.mul_right_ne_zero (hp : Monic p) {q : R[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) : p * q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 1
  · simpa [h]
  rw [Ne, ← degree_eq_bot, hp.degree_mul_comm, hp.degree_mul, WithBot.add_eq_bot, not_or,
    degree_eq_bot]
  refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
  rw [← hp.degree_le_zero_iff_eq_one, not_le] at h
  refine (lt_trans ?_ h).ne'
  simp

name: Monic.mul_natDegree_lt_iff
statement:
theorem Monic.mul_natDegree_lt_iff (h : Monic p) {q : R[X]} :
    (p * q).natDegree < p.natDegree ↔ p ≠ 1 ∧ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · suffices 0 < p.natDegree ↔ p.natDegree ≠ 0 by simp [hq, ← h.natDegree_eq_zero, iffComm]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.ne', fun h => lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.zero_le _) h.symm⟩
  · simp [h.natDegree_mul', hq]

name: Monic.mul_right_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem Monic.mul_right_eq_zero_iff (h : Monic p) {q : R[X]} : p * q = 0 ↔ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0 <;> simp [h.mul_right_ne_zero, hq]

name: Monic.mul_left_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem Monic.mul_left_eq_zero_iff (h : Monic p) {q : R[X]} : q * p = 0 ↔ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0 <;> simp [h.mul_left_ne_zero, hq]

name: Monic.isRegular
statement: theorem Monic.isRegular {R : Type*} [Ring R] {p : R[X]} (hp : Monic p) : IsRegular p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro q r h
    dsimp only at h
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hp.mul_right_eq_zero_iff, mul_sub, h, sub_self]
  · intro q r h
    simp only at h
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hp.mul_left_eq_zero_iff, sub_mul, h, sub_self]

name: degree_smul_of_smul_regular
statement:
theorem degree_smul_of_smul_regular {S : Type*} [SMulZeroClass S R] {k : S}
    (p : R[X]) (h : IsSMulRegular R k) : (k • p).degree = p.degree
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [degree_le_iff_coeff_zero]
    intro m hm
    rw [degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero] at hm
    simp [hm m le_rfl]
  · rw [degree_le_iff_coeff_zero]
    intro m hm
    rw [degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero] at hm
    refine h ?_
    simpa using hm m le_rfl

name: natDegree_smul_of_smul_regular
statement:
theorem natDegree_smul_of_smul_regular {S : Type*} [SMulZeroClass S R] {k : S}
    (p : R[X]) (h : IsSMulRegular R k) : (k • p).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp]
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := WithBot ℕ), ← degree_eq_natDegree hp, ← degree_eq_natDegree,
    degree_smul_of_smul_regular p h]
  contrapose hp
  rw [← smul_zero k] at hp
  exact h.polynomial hp

name: leadingCoeff_smul_of_smul_regular
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_smul_of_smul_regular {S : Type*} [SMulZeroClass S R] {k : S}
    (p : R[X]) (h : IsSMulRegular R k) : (k • p).leadingCoeff = k • p.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff, Polynomial.leadingCoeff, coeff_smul,
    natDegree_smul_of_smul_regular p h]

name: monic_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_inv_smul
statement:
theorem monic_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_inv_smul (h : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) :
    Monic (h.unit⁻¹ • p)

name: isUnit_leadingCoeff_mul_right_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_leadingCoeff_mul_right_eq_zero_iff (h : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) {q : R[X]} :
    p * q = 0 ↔ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rw [← smul_eq_zero_iff_eq h.unit⁻¹] at hp
    have : h.unit⁻¹ • (p * q) = h.unit⁻¹ • p * q := by
      ext
      simp only [Units.smul_def, coeff_smul, coeff_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      rw [← mul_assoc]
    rwa [this, Monic.mul_right_eq_zero_iff] at hp
    exact monic_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_inv_smul _
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: isUnit_leadingCoeff_mul_left_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_leadingCoeff_mul_left_eq_zero_iff (h : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) {q : R[X]} :
    q * p = 0 ↔ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    replace hp := congr_arg (· * C ↑h.unit⁻¹) hp
    simp only [zero_mul] at hp
    rwa [mul_assoc, Monic.mul_left_eq_zero_iff] at hp
    refine monic_mul_C_of_leadingCoeff_mul_eq_one ?_
    simp
  · rintro rfl
    rw [zero_mul]

name: hasseDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem hasseDeriv_apply :
    hasseDeriv k f = f.sum fun i r => monomial (i - k) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

name: hasseDeriv_coeff
statement:
theorem hasseDeriv_coeff (n : ℕ) :
    (hasseDeriv k f).coeff n = (n + k).choose k * f.coeff (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasseDeriv_apply, coeff_sum, sum_def, Finset.sum_eq_single (n + k), coeff_monomial]
  · simp
  · #adaptation_note
    /
    `grind [coeff_monomial, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]` -/
    intro i _hi hink
    rw [coeff_monomial]
    by_cases hik : i < k
    · simp only [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hik, ite_self, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    · grind
  · intro h
    simp only [notMem_support_iff.mp h, monomial_zero_right, mul_zero, coeff_zero]

name: hasseDeriv_zero'
statement: theorem hasseDeriv_zero' : hasseDeriv 0 f = f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasseDeriv_apply, Nat.sub_zero, choose_zero_right, cast_one, one_mul, sum_monomial_eq]

name: hasseDeriv_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hasseDeriv_zero : @hasseDeriv R _ 0 = LinearMap.id

name: hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree
statement:
theorem hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) (h : p.natDegree < n) :
    hasseDeriv n p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasseDeriv_apply, sum_def]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_
  simp [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt ((le_natDegree_of_mem_supp _ hx).trans_lt h)]

name: hasseDeriv_one'
statement: theorem hasseDeriv_one' : hasseDeriv 1 f = derivative f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasseDeriv_apply, derivative_apply, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Nat.choose_one_right,
    (Nat.cast_commute _ _).eq]

name: hasseDeriv_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hasseDeriv_one : @hasseDeriv R _ 1 = derivative

name: hasseDeriv_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hasseDeriv_monomial (n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    hasseDeriv k (monomial n r) = monomial (n - k) (↑(n.choose k) * r)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [hasseDeriv_coeff, coeff_monomial]
  by_cases hnik : n = i + k
  · grind
  · rw [ite_eq_right hnik, mul_zero]
    by_cases! hkn : k ≤ n
    · rw [← tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le hkn] at hnik
      rw [ite_eq_right hnik]
    · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hkn, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, ite_self]

name: hasseDeriv_C
statement: theorem hasseDeriv_C (r : R) (hk : 0 < k) : hasseDeriv k (C r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← monomial_zero_left, hasseDeriv_monomial, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hk, Nat.cast_zero,
    zero_mul, monomial_zero_right]

name: hasseDeriv_apply_one
statement: theorem hasseDeriv_apply_one (hk : 0 < k) : hasseDeriv k (1 : R[X]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_1, hasseDeriv_C k _ hk]

name: hasseDeriv_X
statement: theorem hasseDeriv_X (hk : 1 < k) : hasseDeriv k (X : R[X]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← monomial_one_one_eq_X, hasseDeriv_monomial, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hk, Nat.cast_zero,
    zero_mul, monomial_zero_right]

name: hasseDeriv_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hasseDeriv_map {S : Type*} [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) (k : ℕ) (p : R[X]) :
    hasseDeriv k (p.map f) = (hasseDeriv k p).map f

name: factorial_smul_hasseDeriv
statement: theorem factorial_smul_hasseDeriv : ⇑(k ! • @hasseDeriv R _ k) = (@derivative R _)^[k]
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [hasseDeriv_zero, factorial_zero, iterate_zero, one_smul, LinearMap.id_coe]
  | succ k ih => ?_
  ext f n : 2
  rw [iterate_succ_apply', ← ih]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, coeff_smul, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, coeff_derivative,
    hasseDeriv_coeff, ← @choose_symm_add _ k]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, factorial_succ, mul_assoc, succ_eq_add_one, ← add_assoc,
    add_right_comm n 1 k, ← cast_succ]
  rw [← (cast_commute (n + 1) (f.coeff (n + k + 1))).eq]
  simp only [← mul_assoc]
  norm_cast
  congr 2
  rw [mul_comm (k + 1) _, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  have : n + k + 1 = n + (k + 1) := by apply add_assoc
  rw [← choose_symm_of_eq_add this, choose_succ_right_eq, mul_comm]
  congr
  rw [add_assoc, add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: hasseDeriv_comp
statement:
theorem hasseDeriv_comp (k l : ℕ) :
    (@hasseDeriv R _ k).comp (hasseDeriv l) = (k + l).choose k • hasseDeriv (k + l)
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 2
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, comp_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, smul_monomial, hasseDeriv_apply,
    mul_one, monomial_eq_zero_iff, sum_monomial_index, mul_zero, ←
    tsub_add_eq_tsub_tsub, add_comm l k]
  rw_mod_cast [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Nat.cast_mul]
  congr 2
  by_cases! hikl : i < k + l
  · rw [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hikl, mul_zero]
    by_cases! hil : i < l
    · rw [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hil, mul_zero]
    · rw [← tsub_lt_iff_right hil] at hikl
      rw [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hikl, zero_mul]
  apply @cast_injective ℚ
  have h1 : l ≤ i := le_of_add_le_right hikl
  have h2 : k ≤ i - l := le_tsub_of_add_le_right hikl
  have h3 : k ≤ k + l := le_self_add
  push_cast
  rw [cast_choose ℚ h1, cast_choose ℚ h2, cast_choose ℚ h3, cast_choose ℚ hikl]
  rw [show i - (k + l) = i - l - k by rw [add_comm]; apply tsub_add_eq_tsub_tsub]
  simp only [add_tsub_cancel_left]
  field

name: natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_hasseDeriv_le (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    natDegree (hasseDeriv n p) ≤ natDegree p - n
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [hasseDeriv_apply, sum_def]
    refine (natDegree_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
    simp_rw [Function.comp, natDegree_monomial]
    rw [Finset.fold_ite, Finset.fold_const]
    · simp only [ite_self, max_eq_right, zero_le, Finset.fold_max_le, true_and, and_imp,
        tsub_le_iff_right, mem_support_iff, Ne, Finset.mem_filter]
      intro x hx hx'
      have hxp : x ≤ p.natDegree := le_natDegree_of_ne_zero hx
      grind
    · simp

name: hasseDeriv_natDegree_eq_C
statement: theorem hasseDeriv_natDegree_eq_C : f.hasseDeriv f.natDegree = C f.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have : _ ≤ 0 := Nat.sub_self f.natDegree ▸ natDegree_hasseDeriv_le ..
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero this, hasseDeriv_coeff, zero_add, Nat.choose_self,
    Nat.cast_one, one_mul, leadingCoeff]

name: natDegree_hasseDeriv
statement:
theorem natDegree_hasseDeriv [IsAddTorsionFree R] (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    natDegree (hasseDeriv n p) = natDegree p - n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine map_natDegree_eq_sub (fun h => hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree _ _) ?_
  simp only [Ne, hasseDeriv_monomial, natDegree_monomial, ite_eq_right_iff]
  simp +contextual [← nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.choose_eq_zero_iff, le_of_lt]

name: hasseDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem hasseDeriv_mul (f g : R[X]) :
    hasseDeriv k (f * g) = ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal k, hasseDeriv ij.1 f * hasseDeriv ij.2 g
proof:
:= by
  let D k := (@hasseDeriv R _ k).toAddMonoidHom
  let Φ := @AddMonoidHom.mul R[X] _
  change
    (compHom (D k)).comp Φ f g =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal k, ((compHom.comp ((compHom Φ) (D ij.1))).flip (D ij.2) f) g
  simp only [← finsetSum_apply]
  congr 2
  clear f g
  ext m r n s : 4
  simp only [Φ, D, finsetSum_apply, coe_mulLeft, coe_comp, flip_apply, Function.comp_apply,
             hasseDeriv_monomial, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, compHom_apply_apply,
             coe_mul, monomial_mul_monomial]
  have aux :
    ∀ x : ℕ × ℕ,
      x ∈ antidiagonal k →
        monomial (m - x.1 + (n - x.2)) (↑(m.choose x.1) * r * (↑(n.choose x.2) * s)) =
          monomial (m + n - k) (↑(m.choose x.1) * ↑(n.choose x.2) * (r * s)) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hx
    subst hx
    by_cases! hm : m < x.1
    · simp only [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hm, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul,
                 monomial_zero_right]
    by_cases! hn : n < x.2
    · simp only [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hn, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul,
                 mul_zero, monomial_zero_right]
    rw [tsub_add_eq_add_tsub hm, ← add_tsub_assoc_of_le hn, ← tsub_add_eq_tsub_tsub,
      add_comm x.2 x.1, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc r, ← (Nat.cast_commute _ r).eq, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl aux]
  rw [← map_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  congr
  rw_mod_cast [← Nat.add_choose_eq]

name: splits_iff_exists_multiset'
statement:
theorem splits_iff_exists_multiset' {f : R[X]} :
    Splits f ↔ ∃ m : Multiset R, f = C f.leadingCoeff * (m.map (X + C ·)).prod
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · let S : Submonoid R[X] := MonoidHom.mrange C
    have hS : S = {C a | a : R} := MonoidHom.coe_mrange C
    rw [Splits, Submonoid.closure_union, ← hS, Submonoid.closure_eq, Submonoid.mem_sup] at hf
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨a, rfl⟩, g, hg, rfl⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨mg, hmg, rfl⟩ := Submonoid.exists_multiset_of_mem_closure hg
    choose! j hj using hmg
    have hmg : mg = (mg.map j).map (X + C ·) := by simp [Multiset.map_congr rfl hj]
    rw [hmg, leadingCoeff_mul_monic, leadingCoeff_C]
    · use mg.map j
    · rw [hmg]
      apply monic_multiset_prod_of_monic
      simp [monic_X_add_C]
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    exact hm ▸ (Splits.C _).mul (.multisetProd (by simp [Splits.X_add_C]))

name: Splits.natDegree_le_one_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem Splits.natDegree_le_one_of_irreducible {f : R[X]} (hf : Splits f)
    (h : Irreducible f) : natDegree f ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := splits_iff_exists_multiset'.mp hf
  rcases m.empty_or_exists_mem with rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rw [hm]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons] at hm
    rw [hm] at h
    simp only [irreducible_mul_iff, IsUnit.mul_iff, not_isUnit_X_add_C, false_and, and_false,
      or_false, false_or, ← Multiset.prod_toList, List.prod_isUnit_iff] at h
    have : m = 0 := by simpa [not_isUnit_X_add_C, ← Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem] using h.1.2
    grw [hm, this, natDegree_mul_le]
    simp

name: Splits.comp_of_natDegree_le_one_of_invertible
statement:
theorem Splits.comp_of_natDegree_le_one_of_invertible {f g : R[X]} (hf : f.Splits)
    (hg : g.natDegree ≤ 1) (h : Invertible g.leadingCoeff) : (f.comp g).Splits
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hg with hg | hg
  · rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hg)]
    simp
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := splits_iff_exists_multiset'.mp hf
  rw [hm, mul_comp, C_comp, multiset_prod_comp]
  refine (Splits.C _).mul (multisetProd ?_)
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map]
  rintro - ⟨-, ⟨a, -, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  apply of_natDegree_le_one_of_invertible (by simpa)
  rw [leadingCoeff, hg] at h
  simpa [leadingCoeff, hg]

name: Splits.comp_neg_X
statement: theorem Splits.comp_neg_X {f : R[X]} (hf : f.Splits) : (f.comp (-X)).Splits
proof:
:= by
  refine Submonoid.closure_induction ?_ (by simp)
    (fun f g _ _ hf hg ↦ mul_comp_neg_X f g ▸ hf.mul hg) hf
  · rintro f (⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · rw [add_comp, X_comp, C_comp, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub]
      exact (X_sub_C a).neg

name: splits_iff_exists_multiset
statement:
theorem splits_iff_exists_multiset :
    Splits f ↔ ∃ m : Multiset R, f = C f.leadingCoeff * (m.map (X - C ·)).prod
proof:
:= by
  refine splits_iff_exists_multiset'.trans ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    rintro ⟨m, hm⟩ <;> exact ⟨m.map (- ·), by simpa⟩

name: Splits.exists_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Splits.exists_eval_eq_zero (hf : Splits f) (hf0 : degree f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a, eval a f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := splits_iff_exists_multiset.mp hf
  by_cases hf₀ : f.leadingCoeff = 0
  · simp [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hf₀]
  obtain rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩ := m.empty_or_exists_mem
  · rw [hm, Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.prod_zero, mul_one, degree_C hf₀] at hf0
    contradiction
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
  exact ⟨a, by rw [hm]; simp⟩

name: eval_rootOfSplits
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_rootOfSplits (hf : f.Splits) (hfd : f.degree ≠ 0) :
    f.eval (rootOfSplits hf hfd) = 0

name: Splits.comp_X_sub_C
statement: theorem Splits.comp_X_sub_C (hf : f.Splits) (a : R) : (f.comp (X - C a)).Splits

name: Splits.eq_prod_roots
statement:
theorem Splits.eq_prod_roots (hf : Splits f) :
    f = C f.leadingCoeff * (f.roots.map (X - C ·)).prod
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf0 : f.leadingCoeff = 0
  · simp [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hf0]
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := splits_iff_exists_multiset.mp hf
    suffices hf : f.roots = m by rwa [hf]
    rw [hm, roots_C_mul _ hf0, roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C]

name: Splits.eq_prod_roots_of_monic
statement:
theorem Splits.eq_prod_roots_of_monic (hf : Splits f) (hm : f.Monic) :
    f = (f.roots.map (X - C ·)).prod
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hf.eq_prod_roots, hm.leadingCoeff, C_1, one_mul]

name: Splits.eval_eq_prod_roots
statement:
theorem Splits.eval_eq_prod_roots (hf : Splits f) (x : R) :
    f.eval x = f.leadingCoeff * (f.roots.map (x - ·)).prod

name: Splits.eval_eq_prod_roots_of_monic
statement:
theorem Splits.eval_eq_prod_roots_of_monic (hf : Splits f) (hm : Monic f) (x : R) :
    f.eval x = (f.roots.map (x - ·)).prod

name: Splits.aeval_eq_prod_aroots_of_monic
statement:
theorem Splits.aeval_eq_prod_aroots_of_monic
    (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).Splits) (hm : Monic f) (x : A) :
    f.aeval x = ((f.aroots A).map (x - ·)).prod

name: Splits.eval_derivative
statement:
theorem Splits.eval_derivative [DecidableEq R] (hf : f.Splits) (x : R) :
    eval x f.derivative = f.leadingCoeff *
      (f.roots.map fun a ↦ ((f.roots.erase a).map (x - ·)).prod).sum
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hf.eq_prod_roots]
  simp [derivative_prod, eval_multisetSum, eval_multiset_prod]

name: Splits.eval_root_derivative
statement:
theorem Splits.eval_root_derivative [DecidableEq R] (hf : f.Splits) (hm : f.Monic) {x : R}
    (hx : x ∈ f.roots) : eval x f.derivative = ((f.roots.erase x).map (x - ·)).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_derivative hx, ← hf.eq_prod_roots_of_monic hm]

name: Splits.of_splits_map_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  choose j hj using hi
  rw [splits_iff_exists_multiset]
  refine ⟨(f.map i).roots.pmap j fun _ ↦ id, map_injective i hi ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [hf.eq_prod_roots, leadingCoeff_map_of_injective hi]
  simp [Multiset.pmap_eq_map, hj, Multiset.map_pmap, Polynomial.map_multiset_prod]

name: Splits.of_splits_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Splits.of_splits_algebraMap [FaithfulSMul R A] (hf : Splits (f.map (algebraMap R A)))
    (h : ∀ a ∈ f.rootSet A, a ∈ (algebraMap R A).range) : Splits f
proof:
:= by
  apply hf.of_splits_map_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R A) fun a ha ↦ h a ?_
  rwa [mem_rootSet', ← eval_map_algebraMap, ← IsRoot.def, ← mem_roots']

name: Splits.mem_lift_of_roots_mem_range
statement:
theorem Splits.mem_lift_of_roots_mem_range (hf : f.Splits) (hm : f.Monic)
    {S : Type*} [Ring S] (i : S →+* R) (hr : ∀ a ∈ f.roots, a ∈ i.range) :
    f ∈ Polynomial.lifts i
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf.eq_prod_roots_of_monic hm, lifts_iff_liftsRing]
  refine Subring.multiset_prod_mem _ _ fun g hg => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hg
  exact Subring.sub_mem _ (X_mem_lifts i) (C'_mem_lifts (hr x hx))

name: Splits.eq_X_sub_C_of_single_root
statement:
theorem Splits.eq_X_sub_C_of_single_root (hf : Splits f) {x : R} (hr : f.roots = {x}) :
    f = C f.leadingCoeff * (X - C x)

name: Splits.natDegree_eq_card_roots
statement:
theorem Splits.natDegree_eq_card_roots (hf : Splits f) :
    f.natDegree = f.roots.card
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf0 : f.leadingCoeff = 0
  · simp [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hf0]
  · conv_lhs => rw [hf.eq_prod_roots, natDegree_C_mul hf0, natDegree_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card]

name: Splits.degree_eq_card_roots
statement:
theorem Splits.degree_eq_card_roots (hf : Splits f) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    f.degree = f.roots.card

name: splits_iff_card_roots
statement: theorem splits_iff_card_roots : Splits f ↔ f.roots.card = f.natDegree
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.natDegree_eq_card_roots.symm, fun h ↦ splits_iff_exists_multiset.mpr
    ⟨f.roots, (C_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_multiset_X_sub_C h).symm⟩⟩

name: Splits.roots_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Splits.roots_ne_zero (hf : Splits f) (hf0 : natDegree f ≠ 0) :
    f.roots ≠ 0

name: Splits.roots_map_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Splits.roots_map_of_ne_zero {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    {f : R[X]} (hf : Splits f) {φ : R →+* S} (hφ : f.map φ ≠ 0) :
    (f.map φ).roots = f.roots.map φ
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem p hp => obtain (⟨r, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩) := hp <;> simp
  | one => simp
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => simp_all [roots_mul, show x * y ≠ 0 by aesop]

name: Splits.roots_map_of_injective
statement:
theorem Splits.roots_map_of_injective {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (hf : f.Splits) {i : R →+* S} (hi : Function.Injective i) : (f.map i).roots = f.roots.map i

name: Splits.image_rootSet_of_map_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Splits.image_rootSet_of_map_ne_zero (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).Splits)
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (hφ : f.map (algebraMap R B) ≠ 0) : φ '' f.rootSet A = f.rootSet B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  replace hφ : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).map (φ : A →+* B) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [map_map, φ.comp_algebraMap]
  replace hf := hf.roots_map_of_ne_zero hφ
  rw [map_map, φ.comp_algebraMap] at hf
  simp [rootSet, aroots, hf, Multiset.toFinset_map]

name: Splits.coeff_zero_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_roots
statement:
theorem Splits.coeff_zero_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_roots (hf : Splits f) :
    f.coeff 0 = (-1) ^ f.natDegree * f.leadingCoeff * f.roots.prod
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hf.eq_prod_roots]
  simp [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, eval_multiset_prod, hf.natDegree_eq_card_roots,
    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: Splits.coeff_zero_eq_prod_roots_of_monic
statement:
theorem Splits.coeff_zero_eq_prod_roots_of_monic (hf : Splits f) (hm : Monic f) :
    coeff f 0 = (-1) ^ f.natDegree * f.roots.prod

name: Splits.nextCoeff_eq_neg_sum_roots_mul_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem Splits.nextCoeff_eq_neg_sum_roots_mul_leadingCoeff (hf : Splits f) :
    f.nextCoeff = -f.leadingCoeff * f.roots.sum
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [hf.eq_prod_roots]
  simp [Multiset.sum_map_neg', monic_X_sub_C, Monic.nextCoeff_multiset_prod]

name: Splits.nextCoeff_eq_neg_sum_roots_of_monic
statement:
theorem Splits.nextCoeff_eq_neg_sum_roots_of_monic (hf : Splits f) (hm : Monic f) :
    f.nextCoeff = -f.roots.sum

name: splits_X_sub_C_mul_iff
statement: theorem splits_X_sub_C_mul_iff {a : R} : Splits ((X - C a) * f) ↔ Splits f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ ?_, ((Splits.X_sub_C _).mul ·)⟩
  by_cases hf₀ : f = 0
  · aesop
  have := hf.eq_prod_roots
  rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_X_sub_C, one_mul,
    roots_mul (mul_ne_zero (X_sub_C_ne_zero _) hf₀), roots_X_sub_C,
    Multiset.singleton_add, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, mul_left_comm] at this
  rw [mul_left_cancel₀ (X_sub_C_ne_zero _) this]
  aesop

name: splits_mul
statement:
theorem splits_mul (hf₀ : f ≠ 0) (hg₀ : g ≠ 0) :
    Splits (f * g) ↔ Splits f ∧ Splits g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, and_imp.mpr .mul⟩
  generalize hp : f * g = p at *
  generalize hn : p.natDegree = n
  induction n generalizing p f g with
  | zero =>
    rw [← hp, natDegree_mul hf₀ hg₀, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at hn
    exact ⟨.of_natDegree_eq_zero hn.1, .of_natDegree_eq_zero hn.2⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Splits.exists_eval_eq_zero h (degree_ne_of_natDegree_ne <| hn ▸ by simp)
    have := dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr ha
    rw [← hp, (prime_X_sub_C a).dvd_mul] at this
    wlog hf : X - C a ∣ f with hf2
    · exact .symm <| hf2 n ih hg₀ hf₀ p ((mul_comm g f).trans hp) h hn a ha this.symm <|
        this.resolve_left hf
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hf
    rw [mul_assoc] at hp; subst hp
    rw [natDegree_mul (by aesop) (by aesop), natDegree_X_sub_C, add_comm, Nat.succ_inj] at hn
    have := ih (by aesop) hg₀ (f * g) rfl (splits_X_sub_C_mul_iff.mp h) hn
    aesop

name: splits_mul'
statement:
lemma splits_mul' : (f * g).Splits ↔ (f.Splits ∨ g = 0) ∧ (g.Splits ∨ f = 0) where
  mp hpq
proof:
:= by grind [splits_mul]
  mpr := by rintro ⟨hp | rfl, hq | rfl⟩ <;> simp [*]

statement: lemma splits_mul_iff_left (hg₀ : g ≠ 0) (hg : g.Splits) : (f * g).Splits ↔ f.Splits

name: Splits.of_dvd
statement: theorem Splits.of_dvd (hg : Splits g) (hg₀ : g ≠ 0) (hfg : f ∣ g) : Splits f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hfg
  exact ((splits_mul (by simp_all) (by simp_all)).mp hg).1

name: splits_prod_iff
statement:
theorem splits_prod_iff {ι : Type*} {f : ι → R[X]} {s : Finset ι} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    (∏ x ∈ s, f x).Splits ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, (f x).Splits
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hx ↦ h.of_dvd (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr hf) (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem f hx),
    Splits.prod⟩

name: map_sub_sprod_roots_eq_prod_map_eval
statement:
lemma map_sub_sprod_roots_eq_prod_map_eval
    (s : Multiset R) (g : R[X]) (hg : g.Monic) (hg' : g.Splits) :
    ((s ×ˢ g.roots).map fun ij ↦ ij.1 - ij.2).prod = (s.map g.eval).prod
proof:
:= by
  have := hg'.eq_prod_roots
  rw [hg.leadingCoeff, map_one, one_mul] at this
  conv_rhs => rw [this]
  simp_rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.prod_map_product_eq_prod_prod, Multiset.map_map]
  congr! with x hx
  ext; simp

name: map_sub_roots_sprod_eq_prod_map_eval
statement:
lemma map_sub_roots_sprod_eq_prod_map_eval
    (s : Multiset R) (g : R[X]) (hg : g.Monic) (hg' : g.Splits) :
    ((g.roots ×ˢ s).map fun ij ↦ ij.1 - ij.2).prod =
      (-1) ^ (s.card * g.roots.card) * (s.map g.eval).prod
proof:
:= by
  trans ((s ×ˢ g.roots).map fun ij ↦ (-1) * (ij.1 - ij.2)).prod
  · rw [← Multiset.map_swap_product, Multiset.map_map]; simp
  · rw [Multiset.prod_map_mul]; simp [map_sub_sprod_roots_eq_prod_map_eval _ _ hg hg']

name: Splits.of_natDegree_le_one
statement: theorem Splits.of_natDegree_le_one {f : R[X]} (hf : natDegree f ≤ 1) : Splits f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hf
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp_all
  · rw [← mul_inv_cancel_left₀ ha b, C_mul, ← mul_add]
    exact (X_add_C (a⁻¹ * b)).C_mul a

name: Splits.mem_range_of_isRoot
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_roots (map_ne_zero hf0), hf.roots_map, Multiset.mem_map] at hx
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: Splits.aeval_eq_prod_aroots
statement:
theorem Splits.aeval_eq_prod_aroots [Algebra R S]
    {f : R[X]} (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R S)).Splits) (x : S) :
    f.aeval x = algebraMap R S f.leadingCoeff * ((f.aroots S).map (x - ·)).prod

name: Splits.image_rootSet
statement:
theorem Splits.image_rootSet (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).Splits)
    (g : A →ₐ[R] B) : g '' f.rootSet A = f.rootSet B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rootSet, ← Finset.coe_image, ← Multiset.toFinset_map, ← g.coe_toRingHom,
    ← hf.roots_map, map_map, g.comp_algebraMap, ← rootSet]

name: Splits.adjoin_rootSet_eq_range
statement:
theorem Splits.adjoin_rootSet_eq_range
    (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).Splits) (g : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    Algebra.adjoin R (f.rootSet B) = g.range ↔ Algebra.adjoin R (f.rootSet A) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.image_rootSet g, Algebra.adjoin_image, ← Algebra.map_top]
  exact (Subalgebra.map_injective g.injective).eq_iff

name: Splits.map_aroots_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Splits.map_aroots_algebraMap (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).Splits) :
    (f.aroots A).map (algebraMap A B) = f.aroots B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← aroots_map B A, aroots, aroots,
    hf.roots_map_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A B)]

name: Splits.image_rootSet_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Splits.image_rootSet_algebraMap (hf : (f.map (algebraMap R A)).Splits) :
    (algebraMap A B) '' f.rootSet A = f.rootSet B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rootSet, ← Finset.coe_image, ← Multiset.toFinset_map, hf.map_aroots_algebraMap, ← rootSet]

name: Splits.dvd_of_roots_le_roots
statement:
theorem Splits.dvd_of_roots_le_roots (hp : f.Splits) (hp0 : f ≠ 0) (hq : f.roots ≤ g.roots) :
    f ∣ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.eq_prod_roots, C_mul_dvd (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hp0)]
  exact (Multiset.prod_dvd_prod_of_le (Multiset.map_le_map hq)).trans
    (prod_multiset_X_sub_C_dvd _)

statement:
theorem Splits.dvd_iff_roots_le_roots (hf : f.Splits) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) (hg0 : g ≠ 0) :

name: Splits.comp_of_natDegree_le_one
statement:
theorem Splits.comp_of_natDegree_le_one {f g : R[X]} (hf : f.Splits) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ 1) :
    (f.comp g).Splits
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne g 0 with rfl | hg0
  · simp
  · exact Splits.comp_of_natDegree_le_one_of_invertible hf hg
      (invertibleOfNonzero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hg0))

statement:
theorem Splits.comp_of_degree_le_one {f g : R[X]} (hf : f.Splits) (hg : g.degree ≤ 1) :
    (f.comp g).Splits

name: splits_iff_comp_splits_of_natDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem splits_iff_comp_splits_of_natDegree_eq_one {f g : R[X]} (hg : g.natDegree = 1) :
    f.Splits ↔ (f.comp g).Splits
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ hf.comp_of_natDegree_le_one hg.le, fun hf ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hg.le
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hg; simp [hg]
  have : f = (f.comp (C a * X + C b)).comp ((C a⁻¹ * (X - C b))) := by
    simp only [comp_assoc, add_comp, mul_comp, C_comp, X_comp]
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, C_1, one_mul, sub_add_cancel, comp_X]
  rw [this]
  refine Splits.comp_of_natDegree_le_one hf ?_
  rw [natDegree_C_mul (mt inv_eq_zero.mp ha), natDegree_X_sub_C]

statement:
theorem splits_iff_comp_splits_of_degree_eq_one {f g : R[X]} (hg : g.degree = 1) :

theorem Splits.degree_eq_one_of_irreducible {f : R[X]} (hf : Splits f)

theorem Splits.natDegree_eq_one_of_irreducible {f : R[X]} (hf : Splits f)

name: Splits.eval_derivative_eq_eval_mul_sum
statement:
theorem Splits.eval_derivative_eq_eval_mul_sum (hf : Splits f) {x : R} (hx : f.eval x ≠ 0) :
    f.derivative.eval x = f.eval x * (f.roots.map fun z ↦ 1 / (x - z)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [hf.eval_derivative, hf.eval_eq_prod_roots, ← Multiset.sum_map_mul_left, mul_assoc]
  refine congr_arg Multiset.sum (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun z hz ↦ ?_)
  rw [← Multiset.prod_map_erase hz, mul_one_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀]
  aesop (add simp sub_eq_zero)

name: Splits.eval_derivative_div_eval_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Splits.eval_derivative_div_eval_of_ne_zero (hf : Splits f) {x : R} (hx : f.eval x ≠ 0) :
    f.derivative.eval x / f.eval x = (f.roots.map fun z ↦ 1 / (x - z)).sum

name: Splits.mem_subfield_of_isRoot
statement:
theorem Splits.mem_subfield_of_isRoot (F : Subfield R) {f : F[X]} (hf : Splits f) (hf0 : f ≠ 0)
    {x : R} (hx : (f.map F.subtype).IsRoot x) : x ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hf.mem_range_of_isRoot hf0 hx

name: Splits.of_natDegree_eq_two
statement:
theorem Splits.of_natDegree_eq_two {x : R} (h₁ : f.natDegree = 2) (h₂ : f.eval x = 0) :
    Splits f
proof:
:= by
  have h : (f /ₘ (X - C x)).natDegree = 1 := by
    rw [natDegree_divByMonic f (monic_X_sub_C x), h₁, natDegree_X_sub_C]
  rw [← mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot.mpr h₂, splits_mul (X_sub_C_ne_zero x) (by aesop)]
  exact ⟨Splits.X_sub_C x, Splits.of_natDegree_eq_one h⟩

name: Splits.of_degree_eq_two
statement: theorem Splits.of_degree_eq_two {x : R} (h₁ : f.degree = 2) (h₂ : f.eval x = 0) : Splits f

@[simp]
theorem ofFn_zero' (v : Fin 0 → R) : ofFn 0 v = 0

name: ne_zero_of_ofFn_ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_ofFn_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {v : Fin n → R} (h : ofFn n v ≠ 0) : n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by

  simp

name: ofFn_coeff_eq_val_of_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFn_coeff_eq_val_of_lt {n i : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (hi : i < n) :
    (ofFn n v).coeff i = v ⟨i, hi⟩

name: ofFn_coeff_eq_zero_of_ge

@[simp]
theorem ofFn_coeff_eq_zero_of_ge {n i : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (hi : n ≤ i) :
    (ofFn n v).coeff i = 0

name: ofFn_natDegree_lt
statement: theorem ofFn_natDegree_lt {n : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ n) (v : Fin n → R) : (ofFn n v).natDegree < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.lt_iff_le_pred h, natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
  exact fun _ h ↦ ofFn_coeff_eq_zero_of_ge _ <| Nat.le_of_pred_lt h

name: ofFn_degree_lt
statement: theorem ofFn_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) : (ofFn n v).degree < n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ofFn n v = 0
  · simp only [h, degree_zero]
    exact Batteries.compareOfLessAndEq_eq_lt.mp rfl
  · exact (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h).mp
      <| ofFn_natDegree_lt (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr <| ne_zero_of_ofFn_ne_zero h) _

name: ofFn_eq_sum_monomial
statement:
theorem ofFn_eq_sum_monomial {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) : ofFn n v =
    ∑ i : Fin n, monomial i (v i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n = 0
  · subst h
    simp [ofFn]
  · rw [as_sum_range' (ofFn n v) n <| ofFn_natDegree_lt (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h) v]
    simp [Finset.sum_range]

name: toFn_comp_ofFn_eq_id
statement: theorem toFn_comp_ofFn_eq_id (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → R) : toFn n (ofFn n v) = v

name: surjective_toFn

name: ofFn_comp_toFn_eq_id_of_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem ofFn_comp_toFn_eq_id_of_natDegree_lt {n : ℕ} {p : R[X]} (h_deg : p.natDegree < n) :
    ofFn n (toFn n p) = p
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases! h : i < n
  · simp [h, toFn]
  · have : p.coeff i = 0 := coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt <| by lia
    simp [*]

name: coeff_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_add (p q : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : coeff (p + q) n = coeff p n + coeff q n
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨⟩
  rcases q with ⟨⟩
  simp_rw [← ofFinsupp_add, coeff]
  exact Finsupp.add_apply _ _ _

name: coeff_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_smul [SMulZeroClass S R] (r : S) (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (r • p) n = r • coeff p n

name: support_smul
statement:
theorem support_smul [SMulZeroClass S R] (r : S) (p : R[X]) :
    support (r • p) ⊆ support p
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [mem_support_iff] at hi ⊢
  contrapose hi
  simp [hi]

name: card_support_mul_le
statement: theorem card_support_mul_le : #(p * q).support ≤ #p.support * #q.support
proof:
:= by
  calc #(p * q).support
    _ = #(p.toFinsupp * q.toFinsupp).coeff.support := by rw [← support_toFinsupp, toFinsupp_mul]
    _ ≤ #(p.toFinsupp.coeff.support + q.toFinsupp.coeff.support) := by
      grw [AddMonoidAlgebra.support_coeff_mul_subset]
    _ ≤ #p.support * #q.support := Finset.card_image₂_le ..

name: lcoeff_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lcoeff_apply (n : ℕ) (f : R[X]) : lcoeff R n f = coeff f n

name: finsetSum_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsetSum_coeff {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (∑ b ∈ s, f b) n = ∑ b ∈ s, coeff (f b) n

name: coeff_list_sum
statement:
lemma coeff_list_sum (l : List R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    l.sum.coeff n = (l.map (lcoeff R n)).sum

name: coeff_list_sum_map
statement:
lemma coeff_list_sum_map {ι : Type*} (l : List ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (l.map f).sum.coeff n = (l.map (fun a => (f a).coeff n)).sum

name: coeff_sum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_sum [Semiring S] (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R → S[X]) :
    coeff (p.sum f) n = p.sum fun a b => coeff (f a b) n

name: coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_mul (p q : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (p * q) n = ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal n, coeff p x.1 * coeff q x.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨p⟩; rcases q with ⟨q⟩
  simp_rw [← ofFinsupp_mul, coeff]
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_antidiag p q n _ Finset.mem_antidiagonal

name: mul_coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_coeff_zero (p q : R[X]) : coeff (p * q) 0 = coeff p 0 * coeff q 0

name: mul_coeff_one
statement:
theorem mul_coeff_one (p q : R[X]) :
    coeff (p * q) 1 = coeff p 0 * coeff q 1 + coeff p 1 * coeff q 0

name: constantCoeff_surjective
statement: lemma constantCoeff_surjective : Function.Surjective (constantCoeff (R := R))

name: isUnit_C
statement: theorem isUnit_C {x : R} : IsUnit (C x) ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (congr_arg IsUnit coeff_C_zero).mp (h.map <| @constantCoeff R _), fun h => h.map C⟩

statement: theorem coeff_mul_X_zero (p : R[X]) : coeff (p * X) 0 = 0

name: coeff_C_mul_X
statement: theorem coeff_C_mul_X (x : R) (n : ℕ) : coeff (C x * X : R[X]) n = if n = 1 then x else 0

name: coeff_C_mul
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coeff_C_mul (p : R[X]) : coeff (C a * p) n = a * coeff p n
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨p⟩
  simp_rw [← monomial_zero_left, ← ofFinsupp_single, ← ofFinsupp_mul, coeff]
  exact p.coeff_single_zero_mul a n

name: C_mul'

  simp_rw [← monomial_zero_left, ← ofFinsupp_single, ← ofFinsupp_mul, coeff]
  exact p.coeff_mul_single_zero a n

@[simp] lemma coeff_mul_natCast {a k : ℕ} :

name: coeff_X_pow
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coeff_X_pow (k n : ℕ) : coeff (X ^ k : R[X]) n = if n = k then 1 else 0

name: coeff_X_pow_self
statement: theorem coeff_X_pow_self (n : ℕ) : coeff (X ^ n : R[X]) n = 1

name: support_binomial
statement:
theorem support_binomial {k m : ℕ} (hkm : k ≠ m) {x y : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    support (C x * X ^ k + C y * X ^ m) = {k, m}
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm (support_binomial_subset k m x y)
  simp_rw [insert_subset_iff, singleton_subset_iff, mem_support_iff, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_X_pow_self, mul_one, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right hkm, ite_eq_right hkm.symm, mul_zero,
    zero_add, add_zero, Ne, hx, hy, not_false_eq_true, and_true]

name: support_trinomial
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm (support_trinomial_subset k m n x y z)
  simp_rw [insert_subset_iff, singleton_subset_iff, mem_support_iff, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_X_pow_self, mul_one, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right hkm.ne, ite_eq_right hkm.ne',
    ite_eq_right hmn.ne, ite_eq_right hmn.ne', ite_eq_right (hkm.trans hmn).ne,
    ite_eq_right (hkm.trans hmn).ne', mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, Ne, hx, hy, hz,
    not_false_eq_true, and_true]

name: card_support_binomial
statement:
theorem card_support_binomial {k m : ℕ} (h : k ≠ m) {x y : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    #(support (C x * X ^ k + C y * X ^ m)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_binomial h hx hy, card_insert_of_notMem (mt mem_singleton.mp h), card_singleton]

name: card_support_trinomial
statement:
theorem card_support_trinomial {k m n : ℕ} (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) {x y z : R} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hy : y ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) : #(support (C x * X ^ k + C y * X ^ m + C z * X ^ n)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_trinomial hkm hmn hx hy hz,
    card_insert_of_notMem
      (mt mem_insert.mp (not_or_intro hkm.ne (mt mem_singleton.mp (hkm.trans hmn).ne))),
    card_insert_of_notMem (mt mem_singleton.mp hmn.ne), card_singleton]

name: coeff_mul_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff (p * Polynomial.X ^ n) (d + n) = coeff p d
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (d, n), coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h1 h2
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, mul_zero]
    grind [mem_antidiagonal]
  · grind [mem_antidiagonal]

name: coeff_X_pow_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_X_pow_mul (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff (Polynomial.X ^ n * p) (d + n) = coeff p d

name: coeff_mul_X_pow'
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow' (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    (p * X ^ n).coeff d = ite (n ≤ d) (p.coeff (d - n)) 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, coeff_mul_X_pow, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · refine (coeff_mul _ _ _).trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, mul_zero]
    exact ((le_of_add_le_right (mem_antidiagonal.mp hx).le).trans_lt <| not_le.mp h).ne

name: coeff_X_pow_mul'
statement:
theorem coeff_X_pow_mul' (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    (X ^ n * p).coeff d = ite (n ≤ d) (p.coeff (d - n)) 0

name: coeff_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_X (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : coeff (p * X) (n + 1) = coeff p n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_one] using coeff_mul_X_pow p 1 n

name: coeff_X_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_X_mul (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : coeff (X * p) (n + 1) = coeff p n

name: coeff_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_monomial (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) (r : R) :
    coeff (p * monomial n r) (d + n) = coeff p d * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, ← X_pow_mul, ← mul_assoc, coeff_mul_C, coeff_mul_X_pow]

name: coeff_monomial_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_monomial_mul (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) (r : R) :
    coeff (monomial n r * p) (d + n) = r * coeff p d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, X_pow_mul, coeff_mul_X_pow]

name: coeff_mul_monomial_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_monomial_zero (p : R[X]) (d : ℕ) (r : R) :
    coeff (p * monomial 0 r) d = coeff p d * r

name: coeff_monomial_zero_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_monomial_zero_mul (p : R[X]) (d : ℕ) (r : R) :
    coeff (monomial 0 r * p) d = r * coeff p d

name: mul_X_pow_eq_zero
statement: theorem mul_X_pow_eq_zero {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (H : p * X ^ n = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:=
  ext fun k => (coeff_mul_X_pow p n k).symm.trans <| ext_iff.1 H (k + n)

name: isRegular_X_pow
statement: theorem isRegular_X_pow (n : ℕ) : IsRegular (X ^ n : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  suffices IsLeftRegular (X ^ n : R[X]) from
    ⟨this, this.right_of_commute (fun p => commute_X_pow p n)⟩
  intro P Q (hPQ : X ^ n * P = X ^ n * Q)
  ext i
  rw [← coeff_X_pow_mul P n i, hPQ, coeff_X_pow_mul Q n i]

name: isRegular_X
statement: @[simp] theorem isRegular_X : IsRegular (X : R[X])

name: coeff_X_add_C_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_X_add_C_pow (r : R) (n k : ℕ) :
    ((X + C r) ^ n).coeff k = r ^ (n - k) * (n.choose k : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(commute_X (C r : R[X])).add_pow, ← lcoeff_apply, map_sum]
  simp only [lcoeff_apply, ← C_eq_natCast, ← C_pow, coeff_mul_C]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k, coeff_X_pow_self, one_mul]
  · intro _ _ h
    simp [coeff_X_pow, h.symm]
  · simp only [coeff_X_pow_self, one_mul, not_lt, Finset.mem_range]
    intro h
    rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt h, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: coeff_X_add_one_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_X_add_one_pow (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (n k : ℕ) :
    ((X + 1) ^ n).coeff k = (n.choose k : R)
proof: := by rw [← C_1, coeff_X_add_C_pow, one_pow, one_mul]

name: coeff_one_add_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_one_add_X_pow (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (n k : ℕ) :
    ((1 + X) ^ n).coeff k = (n.choose k : R)

name: one_add_X_pow_sub_X_pow
statement:
theorem one_add_X_pow_sub_X_pow {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (d : ℕ) :
    (1 + X : S[X]) ^ d - X ^ d = ∑ i ∈ range d, d.choose i • X ^ i
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_one_add_X_pow]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt, lt_iff_le_and_ne]

name: C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff
statement: theorem C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (r : R) (φ : R[X]) : C r ∣ φ ↔ ∀ i, r ∣ φ.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩ c
    rw [coeff_C_mul]
    apply dvd_mul_right
  · intro h
    choose c hc using h
    classical
      let c' : ℕ → R := fun i => if i ∈ φ.support then c i else 0
      let ψ : R[X] := ∑ i ∈ φ.support, monomial i (c' i)
      use ψ
      ext i
      simp only [c', ψ, coeff_C_mul, mem_support_iff, coeff_monomial, finsetSum_coeff,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq']
      split_ifs with hi
      · rw [hc]
      · rw [Classical.not_not] at hi
        rwa [mul_zero]

name: smul_eq_C_mul
statement: theorem smul_eq_C_mul (a : R) : a • p = C a * p

name: update_eq_add_sub_coeff
statement:
theorem update_eq_add_sub_coeff {R : Type*} [Ring R] (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    p.update n a = p + Polynomial.C (a - p.coeff n) * Polynomial.X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coeff_update_apply, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: natCast_coeff_zero
statement: theorem natCast_coeff_zero {n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [Semiring R] : (n : R[X]).coeff 0 = n

name: natCast_inj
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem natCast_inj {m n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [CharZero R] :
    (↑m : R[X]) = ↑n ↔ m = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply_fun fun p => p.coeff 0 at h
    simpa using h
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

:= by

  · intro h
