  have := (preadditiveYoneda.obj ((singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)).homologySequence_exact₁ _

    (e₂ := Ext.homAddEquiv) (e₃ := Ext.homAddEquiv) (H := this)
  · ext; dsimp; apply preadditiveYoneda_homologySequenceδ_singleTriangle_apply
  · ext; apply singleFunctor_map_comp_hom (C := C)

name: contravariantSequence_exact
statement:
lemma contravariantSequence_exact :
    (contravariantSequence hS Y n₀ n₁ h).Exact
proof:
:=
  exact_of_δ₀ (contravariant_sequence_exact₂' hS Y n₀).exact_toComposableArrows
    (exact_of_δ₀ (contravariant_sequence_exact₁' hS Y n₀ n₁ h).exact_toComposableArrows
      (exact_of_δ₀ (contravariant_sequence_exact₃' hS Y n₀ n₁ h).exact_toComposableArrows

lemma contravariant_sequence_exact₁ {n₀ : ℕ} (x₁ : Ext S.X₁ Y n₀) {n₁ : ℕ} (hn₁ : 1 + n₀ = n₁)

name: isSplitMono_from_singleFunctor_obj_of_injective
statement:
lemma isSplitMono_from_singleFunctor_obj_of_injective
    {I : C} [Injective I] {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ}
    (ι : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I ⟶ L) [L.IsStrictlyGE i] [QuasiIsoAt ι i] :
    IsSplitMono ι
proof:
:= by
  let e := L.pOpcyclesIso (i - 1) i (by simp)
    ((L.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE i (i - 1) (by simp)).eq_of_src _ _)
  let α := (singleObjHomologySelfIso _ _ _).inv ≫ homologyMap ι i ≫ L.homologyι i ≫ e.inv
  have : ι.f i = (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i I).hom ≫ α := by
    rw [← cancel_mono e.hom]
    dsimp [α, e]
    rw [assoc, assoc, assoc, assoc, pOpcyclesIso_inv_hom_id, comp_id, homologyι_naturality]
    dsimp [singleFunctor, singleFunctors]
    rw [singleObjHomologySelfIso_inv_homologyι_assoc,
      ← pOpcycles_singleObjOpcyclesSelfIso_inv_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, p_opcyclesMap]
  exact ⟨⟨{
    retraction := mkHomToSingle (Injective.factorThru (𝟙 I) α) (by
      rintro j rfl
      apply (L.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE (j + 1) j (by simp)).eq_of_src)
    id := by
      apply HomologicalComplex.to_single_hom_ext
      rw [comp_f, mkHomToSingle_f, id_f, this, assoc, Injective.comp_factorThru_assoc,
        id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id] }⟩⟩

name: to_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_injective
statement:
lemma to_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_injective {I : C} [Injective I]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ}
    (φ : Q.obj K ⟶ Q.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I))
    (n : ℤ) (hn : i < n) [K.IsStrictlyGE n] :
    φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, _, g, ι, h, rfl⟩ := left_fac_of_isStrictlyGE φ i
  have hπ : IsSplitMono ι := by
    rw [isIso_Q_map_iff_quasiIso] at h
    exact CochainComplex.isSplitMono_from_singleFunctor_obj_of_injective ι
  have h₁ : inv (Q.map ι) = Q.map (retraction ι) := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (Q.map ι), IsIso.hom_inv_id, ← Q.map_comp, IsSplitMono.id, Q.map_id]
  have h₂ : g ≫ retraction ι = 0 := by
    apply HomologicalComplex.to_single_hom_ext
    apply (K.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE n i hn).eq_of_src
  rw [h₁, ← Q.map_comp, h₂, Q.map_zero]

name: eq_zero_of_injective
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_injective [HasExt.{w} C] {X I : C} {n : ℕ} [Injective I]
    (e : Ext X I (n + 1)) : e = 0
proof:
:= by
  let K := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X
  have := K.isStrictlyGE_of_ge (-n) 0 (by lia)
  let := HasDerivedCategory.standard C
  apply homEquiv.injective
  simp only [← cancel_mono (((singleFunctors C).shiftIso (n + 1) (-(n + 1)) 0
    (by lia)).hom.app _), zero_hom, Limits.zero_comp]
  exact to_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_injective (K := K) (n := -n) _ (by lia)

name: hasExt_of_enoughInjectives
statement: lemma hasExt_of_enoughInjectives [LocallySmall.{w} C] [EnoughInjectives C] : HasExt.{w} C
proof:
:= by
    let := HasDerivedCategory.standard C
    have := hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory C
    rw [hasExt_iff_small_ext.{w}]
    intro X Y n
    induction n generalizing X Y with
    | zero =>
      rw [small_congr Ext.homEquiv₀]
      infer_instance
    | succ n hn =>
      let S := ShortComplex.mk _ _ (cokernel.condition (Injective.ι Y))
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel S.f) }
      have : Function.Surjective (Ext.postcomp hS.extClass X (rfl : n + 1 = _)) :=
        fun y₁ ↦ Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ X hS y₁ (Ext.eq_zero_of_injective _) rfl
      exact small_of_surjective.{w} this

name: DerivedCategory.map_triangleOfSES
statement:
lemma DerivedCategory.map_triangleOfSESδ [HasDerivedCategory.{t} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{t'} D]
    {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    dsimp% F.mapDerivedCategory.map (triangleOfSESδ hS) =
    (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app S.X₃) ≫
      triangleOfSESδ (hS.map_of_exact (F.mapHomologicalComplex _)) ≫
        (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app S.X₁)⟦1⟧' ≫
          (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app (Q.obj S.X₁)
proof:
:= by
  have := CochainComplex.mappingCone.quasiIso_descShortComplex hS
  rw [← cancel_epi (F.mapDerivedCategory.map
    (Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.descShortComplex S))), ← Functor.map_comp,
    descShortComplex_triangleOfSESδ, F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality_assoc,
    ← CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso_hom_descShortComplex,
    Functor.map_comp_assoc, descShortComplex_triangleOfSESδ_assoc]
  dsimp
  rw  [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [← CochainComplex.mappingCone.map_δ, Functor.map_comp_assoc,
    ← F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality_assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  simp [NatTrans.shift_app, Functor.commShiftIso_comp_hom_app, Functor.commShiftIso_comp_inv_app,
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]

name: ShortComplex.ShortExact.mapShiftedHom_single
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ShortComplex.ShortExact.mapShiftedHom_singleδ'
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{t'} D]
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] :
    (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app S.X₃ ≫
      ShiftedHom.map hS.singleδ F.mapDerivedCategory ≫
        ((F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app S.X₁)⟦1⟧' =
    (hS.map_of_exact F).singleδ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [ShiftedHom.map, ShortComplex.ShortExact.singleδ]
  simp only [Category.assoc, DerivedCategory.map_triangleOfSESδ]
  generalize_proofs _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 _ _ h2
  dsimp
  rw [Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_inv_app_mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_app_assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
    F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors_inv_app_mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_hom_app,
    dsimp% triangleOfSESδ_naturality h1 h2
      (S.mapNatTrans (F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).hom),
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  simp

name: ShortComplex.ShortExact.mapShiftedHom_single
statement:

lemma ShortComplex.ShortExact.mapShiftedHom_singleδ
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{t'} D]

    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] :

      (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app S.X₃ ≫
        (hS.map_of_exact F).singleδ ≫ ((F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app S.X₁)⟦1⟧'

name: Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom
statement:
lemma Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{t'} D]
    [HasExt.{w} C] [HasExt.{w'} D] {X Y : C} {n : ℕ} (e : Ext X Y n) :
    (e.mapExactFunctor F).hom =
    (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app X ≫ e.hom.map F.mapDerivedCategory ≫
    ((F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y)⟦(n : ℤ)⟧'
proof:
:= by
  have : (e.mapExactFunctor F).hom = _ :=
    ((F.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).equiv_smallShiftedHomMap DerivedCategory.Q DerivedCategory.Q
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X) ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y)
          F.mapDerivedCategory F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.symm e)
  rw [this, ← ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀ _ 0 rfl, ← ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp 0 rfl]
  congr 2
  · simp [← F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_inv_app_mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_app_assoc]
  · simp [← Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors_inv_app_mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_hom_app]

:=

lemma id_mapExactFunctor [HasExt.{w} C] {X Y : C} {n : ℕ}

proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [mapExactFunctor_hom, ← α.hom.map_naturality_2 (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C)]
  simp [ShiftedHom.id_map, ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp, ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀,
    mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_hom_app_singleFunctor_obj, ← Functor.map_comp,
    mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_inv_app_singleFunctor_obj]

name: comp_mapExactFunctor
statement:
lemma comp_mapExactFunctor [HasExt.{w} C] [HasExt.{w'} D] [HasExt.{w''} E] {X Y : C} {n : ℕ}
    (α : Ext X Y n) (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G] :
    α.mapExactFunctor (F ⋙ G) = (α.mapExactFunctor F).mapExactFunctor G
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [mapExactFunctor_hom]
  rw [← α.hom.map_naturality_1 (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G), ShiftedHom.comp_map]
  simp only [ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp, ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀,
    ShiftedHom.map, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  simp [mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_inv_app_comp_mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_inv_app_assoc,
    commShiftIso_hom_naturality_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
    mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_comp_mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_hom_app]

name: mapExactFunctor_comp_mk

lemma mapExactFunctor_comp_mk₀_natTransApp

    (α : Ext X Y n) {F G : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive]

proof:
:= by
  ext
  have := ShiftedHom.map_naturality α.hom (NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory τ)
  simp [← cancel_mono (((G.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y)⟦(n : ℤ)⟧'),
    ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp, ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀,
    NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory_app_singleFunctor_obj,
    ← Functor.map_comp] at this
  simp [mapExactFunctor_hom, ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp, ShiftedHom.comp_mk₀,
    ← Functor.map_comp, this]

name: hasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom_of_isLE_of_isGE
statement:
lemma hasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom_of_isLE_of_isGE
    [HasExt.{w} C] (K L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) [K.IsGE a] [K.IsLE a] [L.IsGE b] [L.IsLE b] :
    HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom.{w}
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso C (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ K L
proof:
:= by
  let := HasDerivedCategory.standard
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨eX⟩⟩ := DerivedCategory.exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE (Q.obj K) a
  obtain ⟨Y, ⟨eY⟩⟩ := DerivedCategory.exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE (Q.obj L) b
  simp only [hasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom_iff _ _ Q]
  exact fun p q ↦ small_of_injective (f := fun φ ↦
    ((singleFunctors C).shiftIso p (a - p) a (by simp)).inv.app X ≫
      eX.inv⟦p⟧' ≫ φ ≫ eY.hom⟦q⟧' ≫
        ((singleFunctors C).shiftIso q (b - q) b (by simp)).hom.app Y)
    (fun φ₁ φ₂ h ↦ by simpa [cancel_epi, cancel_mono] using h)

name: hasExt_iff
statement:
lemma hasExt_iff [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} C] :
    HasExt.{w} C ↔ ∀ (X Y : C) (n : ℤ) (_ : 0 ≤ n), Small.{w}
      ((singleFunctor C 0).obj X ⟶
        (((singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)⟦n⟧))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [HasExt]
  simp only [hasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom_iff _ _ Q]
  constructor
  · intro h X Y n hn
    exact (small_congr ((shiftFunctorZero _ ℤ).app
      ((singleFunctor C 0).obj X)).homFromEquiv).1 (h X Y 0 n)
  · intro h X Y a b
    obtain hab | hab := le_or_gt a b
    · refine (small_congr ?_).1 (h X Y (b - a) (by simpa))
      exact (Functor.FullyFaithful.ofFullyFaithful
        (shiftFunctor _ a)).homEquiv.trans
        ((shiftFunctorAdd' _ _ _ _ (Int.sub_add_cancel b a)).symm.app _).homToEquiv
    · suffices Subsingleton ((Q.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X))⟦a⟧ ⟶
          (Q.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y))⟦b⟧) from inferInstance
      constructor
      intro x y
      rw [← cancel_mono ((Q.commShiftIso b).inv.app _),
        ← cancel_epi ((Q.commShiftIso a).hom.app _)]
      have : (((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X)⟦a⟧).IsStrictlyLE (-a) :=
        CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_shift _ 0 _ _ (by lia)
      have : (((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)⟦b⟧).IsStrictlyGE (-b) :=
        CochainComplex.isStrictlyGE_shift _ 0 _ _ (by lia)
      apply (subsingleton_hom_of_isStrictlyLE_of_isStrictlyGE _ _ (-a) (-b) (by
        lia)).elim

name: add_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma add_hom (α β : Ext X Y n) : (α + β).hom = α.hom + β.hom
proof:
:= by
  let α' : Ext (X ⊞ X) Y n := (mk₀ biprod.fst).comp α (zero_add n)
  let β' : Ext (X ⊞ X) Y n := (mk₀ biprod.snd).comp β (zero_add n)
  have eq₁ : α + β = (mk₀ (biprod.lift (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X))).comp (α' + β') (zero_add n) := by
    simp [α', β']
  have eq₂ : α' + β' = homEquiv.symm (α'.hom + β'.hom) := by
    apply biprod_ext
    all_goals ext; simp [α', β', ← Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [eq₁, eq₂, comp_hom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ShiftedHom.comp_add]
  congr
  · dsimp [α']
    rw [comp_hom, mk₀_hom, mk₀_hom]
    dsimp
    rw [ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
      biprod.lift_fst, Functor.map_id, ShiftedHom.mk₀_id_comp]
  · dsimp [β']
    rw [comp_hom, mk₀_hom, mk₀_hom]
    dsimp
    rw [ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
      biprod.lift_snd, Functor.map_id, ShiftedHom.mk₀_id_comp]

name: Functor.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesProjectiveObjects
statement:
lemma Functor.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesProjectiveObjects [F.Full] [F.Faithful] [HasExt.{w} C]
    [HasExt.{w'} D] [EnoughProjectives C] [F.PreservesProjectiveObjects] (X Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (F.mapExtAddHom X Y n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing X with
  | zero => simpa [Ext.mapExactFunctor₀] using ⟨Faithful.map_injective, Full.map_surjective⟩
  | succ n hn =>
    let P : ProjectivePresentation X := Classical.arbitrary _
    let S := ShortComplex.mk _ _ (kernel.condition P.f)
    have : Projective (S.map F).X₂ := Functor.PreservesProjectiveObjects.projective_obj P.projective
    have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel P.f }
    exact AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_right_exact _ _ _ _
      (F.mapExtAddHom S.X₂ Y n) (F.mapExtAddHom S.X₁ Y n) (F.mapExtAddHom S.X₃ Y (n + 1))
      (by cat_disch) (by cat_disch)
      ((ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).1
        (Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁' hS Y n (n + 1) (add_comm 1 n)))
      ((ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).1
        (Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁' (hS.map F) (F.obj Y) n (n + 1) (add_comm 1 n)))
      (hn _).surjective (hn _)
      (fun x₃ ↦ Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS _ x₃ (by subsingleton) (add_comm 1 n))
      (fun y₃ ↦ Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ (hS.map F) _ y₃ (by subsingleton) (add_comm 1 n))

name: Functor.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesInjectiveObjects
statement:
lemma Functor.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesInjectiveObjects [F.Full] [F.Faithful] [HasExt.{w} C]
    [HasExt.{w'} D] [EnoughInjectives C] [F.PreservesInjectiveObjects] (X Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (F.mapExtAddHom X Y n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing Y with
  | zero => simpa [Ext.mapExactFunctor₀] using ⟨Faithful.map_injective, Full.map_surjective⟩
  | succ n hn =>
    let I : InjectivePresentation Y := Classical.arbitrary _
    let S := ShortComplex.mk _ _ (cokernel.condition I.f)
    have : Injective (S.map F).X₂ := Functor.PreservesInjectiveObjects.injective_obj I.injective
    have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_cokernel I.f }
    exact AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_right_exact _ _ _ _
      (F.mapExtAddHom X S.X₂ n) (F.mapExtAddHom X S.X₃ n) (F.mapExtAddHom X S.X₁ (n + 1))
      (by cat_disch) (by cat_disch)
      ((ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp
        (Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃' X hS n (n + 1) rfl))
      ((ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp
        (Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃' (F.obj X) (hS.map F) n (n + 1) rfl))
      (hn _).surjective (hn _)
      (fun x₁ ↦ Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ _ hS x₁ (by subsingleton) rfl)
      (fun y₁ ↦ Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ _ (hS.map F) y₁ (by subsingleton) rfl)

name: isSplitEpi_to_singleFunctor_obj_of_projective
statement:
lemma isSplitEpi_to_singleFunctor_obj_of_projective
    {P : C} [Projective P] {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ}
    (π : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj P) [K.IsStrictlyLE i] [QuasiIsoAt π i] :
    IsSplitEpi π
proof:
:= by
  let e := K.iCyclesIso i (i + 1) (by simp)
    ((K.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE i (i + 1) (by simp)).eq_of_tgt _ _)
  let α := e.inv ≫ K.homologyπ i ≫ homologyMap π i ≫ (singleObjHomologySelfIso _ _ _).hom
  have : π.f i = α ≫ (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i P).inv := by
    rw [← cancel_epi e.hom]
    dsimp [α, e]
    rw [assoc, assoc, assoc, iCyclesIso_hom_inv_id_assoc,
      homologyπ_naturality_assoc]
    dsimp [singleFunctor, singleFunctors]
    rw [homologyπ_singleObjHomologySelfIso_hom_assoc,
      ← singleObjCyclesSelfIso_inv_iCycles, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← cyclesMap_i]
  exact ⟨⟨{
    section_ := mkHomFromSingle (Projective.factorThru (𝟙 P) α) (by
      rintro _ rfl
      apply (K.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE i (i + 1) (by simp)).eq_of_tgt)
    id := by
      apply HomologicalComplex.from_single_hom_ext
      rw [comp_f, mkHomFromSingle_f, assoc, id_f, this, Projective.factorThru_comp_assoc,
        id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id] }⟩⟩

name: from_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_projective
statement:
lemma from_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_projective {P : C} [Projective P]
    {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ}
    (φ : Q.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj P) ⟶ Q.obj L)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : n < i) [L.IsStrictlyLE n] :
    φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, _, π, h, g, rfl⟩ := right_fac_of_isStrictlyLE φ i
  have hπ : IsSplitEpi π := by
    rw [isIso_Q_map_iff_quasiIso] at h
    exact CochainComplex.isSplitEpi_to_singleFunctor_obj_of_projective π
  have h₁ : inv (Q.map π) = Q.map (section_ π) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (Q.map π), IsIso.inv_hom_id, ← Q.map_comp, IsSplitEpi.id, Q.map_id]
  have h₂ : section_ π ≫ g = 0 := by
    apply HomologicalComplex.from_single_hom_ext
    apply (L.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE n i hn).eq_of_tgt
  rw [h₁, ← Q.map_comp, h₂, Q.map_zero]

name: eq_zero_of_projective
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_projective [HasExt.{w} C] {P Y : C} {n : ℕ} [Projective P]
    (e : Ext P Y (n + 1)) : e = 0
proof:
:= by
  let := HasDerivedCategory.standard C
  apply homEquiv.injective
  simp only [← cancel_mono (((singleFunctors C).shiftIso (n + 1) (-(n + 1)) 0
    (by lia)).hom.app _), zero_hom, Limits.zero_comp]
  apply from_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_projective
    (L := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C (-(n + 1))).obj Y) (n := -(n + 1)) _ (by lia)

name: subsingleton_of_projective
statement:
lemma subsingleton_of_projective [HasExt.{w} C]
    (P Y : C) [Projective P] (n : ℕ) : Subsingleton (Ext.{w} P Y (n + 1))

name: one_subsingleton_iff_of_projective
statement:
lemma one_subsingleton_iff_of_projective [HasExt.{w} C] (X : C)
    (S : ShortComplex C) (S_exact : S.ShortExact) (proj : Projective S.X₂) :
    Subsingleton (Ext S.X₃ X 1) ↔
      Function.Surjective ((Ext.mk₀ S.f).precomp X (add_zero 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x₁ ↦ Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁ S_exact _ x₁ (add_zero _)
    (by subsingleton), fun h ↦ subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 (fun x₃ ↦ ?_)⟩
  obtain ⟨x₁, rfl⟩ := Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ S_exact _ x₃
    (by subsingleton) (add_zero 1)
  obtain ⟨x₂, rfl⟩ := h x₁
  simp

name: hasExt_of_enoughProjectives
statement: lemma hasExt_of_enoughProjectives [LocallySmall.{w} C] [EnoughProjectives C] : HasExt.{w} C
proof:
:= by
  let := HasDerivedCategory.standard C
  have := hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory C
  rw [hasExt_iff_small_ext.{w}]
  intro X Y n
  induction n generalizing X Y with
  | zero =>
    rw [small_congr Ext.homEquiv₀]
    infer_instance
  | succ n hn =>
    let S := ShortComplex.mk _ _ (kernel.condition (Projective.π X))
    have hS : S.ShortExact :=
      { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel S.g) }
    have : Function.Surjective (Ext.precomp hS.extClass Y (add_comm 1 n)) := fun x₃ ↦
      Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS Y x₃
        (Ext.eq_zero_of_projective _) (by lia)
    exact small_of_surjective.{w} this

name: single_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma single_add (n : ℕ) (m₁ m₂ : M) :
    single R n (m₁ + m₂) = single R n m₁ + single R n m₂

name: lsingle_apply
statement: theorem lsingle_apply (i : ℕ) (m : M) (n : ℕ) : (lsingle R i m).coeff n = ite (i = n) m 0

name: single_smul
statement: theorem single_smul (i : ℕ) (r : R) (m : M) : single R i (r • m) = r • single R i m

name: induction_linear
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma induction_linear {p : PolynomialModule R M → Prop} (x : PolynomialModule R M) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ x y : PolynomialModule R M, p x → p y → p (x + y))
    (single : ∀ n m, p (single R n m)) : p x
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.induction_linear (motive := (p <| ofCoeff R ·)) x.coeff zero (fun _ _ ↦ add _ _)
    (fun _ _ ↦ single _ _)

name: smul_def
statement:
lemma smul_def (f : R[X]) (m : PolynomialModule R M) :
    f • m = aeval ((coeffLinearEquiv R R).symm.comp <|
    (Finsupp.lmapDomain M R Nat.succ).comp (coeffLinearEquiv R R).toLinearMap) f m

name: monomial_smul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_smul_single (i : ℕ) (r : R) (j : ℕ) (m : M) :
    monomial i r • single R j m = single R (i + j) (r • m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, Polynomial.aeval_monomial, Module.End.pow_apply,
    Module.algebraMap_end_apply, smul_def]
  induction i generalizing r j m with
  | zero =>
    rw [Function.iterate_zero, zero_add]
    exact congr(ofCoeff R $(Finsupp.smul_single r j m))
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ, Function.comp_apply, add_assoc, ← hn]
    congr 2
    rw [Nat.one_add]
    exact congr(ofCoeff R $(Finsupp.mapDomain_single))

name: monomial_smul_lsingle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_smul_lsingle (i : ℕ) (r : R) (j : ℕ) (m : M) :
    (monomial i) r • lsingle R j m = lsingle R (i + j) (r • m)

name: monomial_smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_smul_apply (i : ℕ) (r : R) (g : PolynomialModule R M) (n : ℕ) :
    (monomial i r • g).coeff n = ite (i ≤ n) (r • g.coeff (n - i)) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction g using PolynomialModule.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [smul_add, hp, hq, ite_add_ite]
  | single =>
    simp [monomial_smul_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
    grind

name: smul_single_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_single_apply (i : ℕ) (f : R[X]) (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    (f • single R i m).coeff n = ite (i ≤ n) (f.coeff (n - i) • m) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [add_smul, hp, hq, ite_add_ite]
  | monomial => simp; grind [monomial_smul_single, coeff_monomial, zero_smul]

name: smul_apply
statement:
theorem smul_apply (f : R[X]) (g : PolynomialModule R M) (n : ℕ) :
    (f • g).coeff n = ∑ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, f.coeff x.1 • g.coeff x.2
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [add_smul, hp, hq, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  | monomial f_n f_a =>
    rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ fun i j =>
      (monomial f_n f_a).coeff i • g.coeff j, monomial_smul_apply]
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]

name: equivPolynomialSelf_apply_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivPolynomialSelf_apply_eq (p : PolynomialModule R R) :
    equivPolynomialSelf p = equivPolynomial p

name: equivPolynomial_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivPolynomial_single {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (n : ℕ) (x : S) :
    equivPolynomial (single R n x) = monomial n x

name: equivPolynomial_symm_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivPolynomial_symm_monomial {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (n : ℕ) (x : S) :
    equivPolynomial.symm (monomial n x) = single R n x

name: equivPolynomial_symm_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivPolynomial_symm_one {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] :

name: hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← DFunLike.coe_fn_eq, funext_iff, PolynomialModule.forall] using Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    (φ := f.comp (coeffLinearEquiv R R).symm.toLinearMap)
    (ψ := g.comp (coeffLinearEquiv R R (M := M)).symm.toLinearMap) h

name: map_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_single (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (i : ℕ) (m : M) :
    map R' f (single R i m) = single R' i (f m)

name: map_lsingle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_lsingle (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (i : ℕ) (m : M) :
    map R' f (lsingle R i m) = lsingle R' i (f m)

name: map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (p : R[X]) (q : PolynomialModule R M) :
    map R' f (p • q) = p.map (algebraMap R R') • map R' f q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  | add f g e₁ e₂ => rw [smul_add, map_add, e₁, e₂, map_add, smul_add]
  | single i m =>
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add _ _ e₁ e₂ => rw [add_smul, map_add, e₁, e₂, Polynomial.map_add, add_smul]
    | monomial => rw [monomial_smul_single, map_single, Polynomial.map_monomial, map_single,
        monomial_smul_single, f.map_smul, algebraMap_smul]

name: eval_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_single (r : R) (i : ℕ) (m : M) : eval r (single R i m) = r ^ i • m

name: eval_lsingle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_lsingle (r : R) (i : ℕ) (m : M) : eval r (lsingle R i m) = r ^ i • m

name: eval_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_smul (p : R[X]) (q : PolynomialModule R M) (r : R) :
    eval r (p • q) = p.eval r • eval r q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  | add f g e₁ e₂ => rw [smul_add, map_add, e₁, e₂, map_add, smul_add]
  | single i m =>
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add _ _ e₁ e₂ => rw [add_smul, map_add, Polynomial.eval_add, e₁, e₂, add_smul]
    | monomial => simp only [monomial_smul_single, Polynomial.eval_monomial, eval_single]; module

name: eval_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_map (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (q : PolynomialModule R M) (r : R) :
    eval (algebraMap R R' r) (map R' f q) = f (eval r q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp_rw [map_zero]
  | add f g e₁ e₂ => simp_rw [map_add, e₁, e₂]
  | single i m => simp only [map_single, eval_single, f.map_smul]; module

name: eval_map'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_map' (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (q : PolynomialModule R M) (r : R) :
    eval r (map R f q) = f (eval r q)

name: aeval_equivPolynomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma aeval_equivPolynomial {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra S R]
    (f : PolynomialModule S S) (x : R) :
    aeval x (equivPolynomial f) = eval x (map R (Algebra.linearMap S R) f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g e₁ e₂ => simp_rw [map_add, e₁, e₂]
  | single i m => rw [equivPolynomial_single, aeval_monomial, mul_comm, map_single,
      Algebra.linearMap_apply, eval_single, smul_eq_mul]

name: comp_single
statement: theorem comp_single (p : R[X]) (i : ℕ) (m : M) : comp p (single R i m) = p ^ i • single R 0 m

name: comp_eval
statement:
theorem comp_eval (p : R[X]) (q : PolynomialModule R M) (r : R) :
    eval r (comp p q) = eval (p.eval r) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply]
  induction q using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp_rw [map_zero]
  | add _ _ e₁ e₂ => simp_rw [map_add, e₁, e₂]
  | single i m =>
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, comp_single, eval_single, eval_smul, eval_single, eval_pow]
    module

name: comp_smul
statement:
theorem comp_smul (p p' : R[X]) (q : PolynomialModule R M) :
    comp p (p' • q) = p'.comp p • comp p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply, map_smul, eval_smul, Polynomial.comp, Polynomial.eval_map, comp_apply]
  rfl

name: annihilator_eq_ker_aeval
statement:
lemma annihilator_eq_ker_aeval [FaithfulSMul A M] :
    annihilator R[X] (AEval R M a) = RingHom.ker (aeval a)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp_rw [mem_annihilator, RingHom.mem_ker]
  change (∀ m : M, aeval a p • m = 0) ↔ _
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := M) <| by simp [h], fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩

name: annihilator_top_eq_ker_aeval
statement:
@[simp]
lemma annihilator_top_eq_ker_aeval [FaithfulSMul A M] :
    (⊤ : Submodule R[X] <| AEval R M a).annihilator = RingHom.ker (aeval a)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Submodule.mem_annihilator, Submodule.mem_top, forall_true_left, RingHom.mem_ker]
  change (∀ m : M, aeval a p • m = 0) ↔ _
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := M) <| by simp [h], fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩

name: mem_mapSubmodule_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_mapSubmodule_apply {p : (Algebra.lsmul R R M a).invtSubmodule} {m : AEval R M a} :
    m ∈ mapSubmodule R M a p ↔ (of R M a).symm m ∈ (p : Submodule R M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, hm, hm'⟩ ↦ hm'.symm ▸ hm, fun hm ↦ ⟨(of R M a).symm m, hm, rfl⟩⟩

name: mem_mapSubmodule_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_mapSubmodule_symm_apply {q : Submodule R[X] (AEval R M a)} {m : M} :
    m ∈ ((mapSubmodule R M a).symm q : Submodule R M) ↔ of R M a m ∈ q

name: AEval'_def
statement: lemma AEval'_def : AEval' φ = AEval R M φ

name: AEval'.X_smul_of
statement: lemma AEval'.X_smul_of (m : M) : (X : R[X]) • AEval'.of φ m = AEval'.of φ (φ m)

name: AEval'.X_pow_smul_of
statement: lemma AEval'.X_pow_smul_of (m : M) (n : ℕ) : (X ^ n : R[X]) • AEval'.of φ m = .of φ (φ ^ n • m)

name: AEval'.of_symm_X_smul
statement:

theorem isTorsion_of_aeval_eq_zero [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A]

name: natTrailingDegree_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem natTrailingDegree_mul_X_pow {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (p * X ^ n).natTrailingDegree = p.natTrailingDegree + n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero fun h => mt trailingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hp ?_
    rwa [trailingCoeff, ← coeff_mul_X_pow]
  · rw [natTrailingDegree_eq_support_min' fun h => hp (mul_X_pow_eq_zero h), Finset.le_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    have key : n ≤ y := by
      rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_mul_X_pow'] at hy
      exact by_contra fun h => hy (ite_eq_right h)
    rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_mul_X_pow', ite_eq_left key] at hy
    exact (le_tsub_iff_right key).mp (natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero hy)

name: le_trailingDegree_mul
statement: theorem le_trailingDegree_mul : p.trailingDegree + q.trailingDegree ≤ (p * q).trailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.le_min fun n hn => ?_
  rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_mul] at hn
  obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij, hpq⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hn
  refine
    (add_le_add (min_le (mem_support_iff.mpr (left_ne_zero_of_mul hpq)))
          (min_le (mem_support_iff.mpr (right_ne_zero_of_mul hpq)))).trans_eq ?_
  rwa [← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_eq_coe, ← mem_antidiagonal]

name: le_natTrailingDegree_mul
statement:
theorem le_natTrailingDegree_mul (h : p * q ≠ 0) :
    p.natTrailingDegree + q.natTrailingDegree ≤ (p * q).natTrailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := fun hp => h (by rw [hp, zero_mul])
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := fun hq => h (by rw [hq, mul_zero])
  rw [← ENat.natCast_le_natCast, ENat.natCast_add, ← trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree hp,
    ← trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree hq, ← trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree h]
  exact le_trailingDegree_mul

name: coeff_mul_natTrailingDegree_add_natTrailingDegree
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_natTrailingDegree_add_natTrailingDegree : (p * q).coeff
    (p.natTrailingDegree + q.natTrailingDegree) = p.trailingCoeff * q.trailingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul]
  refine
    Finset.sum_eq_single (p.natTrailingDegree, q.natTrailingDegree) ?_ fun h =>
      (h (mem_antidiagonal.mpr rfl)).elim
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h₁ h₂
  rw [mem_antidiagonal] at h₁
  by_cases! hi : i < p.natTrailingDegree
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree hi, zero_mul]
  by_cases! hj : j < q.natTrailingDegree
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree hj, mul_zero]
  refine (h₂ (Prod.ext_iff.mpr ?_).symm).elim
  exact (add_eq_add_iff_eq_and_eq hi hj).mp h₁.symm

name: trailingDegree_mul'
statement:
theorem trailingDegree_mul' (h : p.trailingCoeff * q.trailingCoeff ≠ 0) :
    (p * q).trailingDegree = p.trailingDegree + q.trailingDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := fun hp => h (by rw [hp, trailingCoeff_zero, zero_mul])
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := fun hq => h (by rw [hq, trailingCoeff_zero, mul_zero])
  refine le_antisymm ?_ le_trailingDegree_mul
  rw [trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree hp, trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree hq, ←
    ENat.natCast_add]
  apply trailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero
  rwa [coeff_mul_natTrailingDegree_add_natTrailingDegree]

statement:

proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := fun hp => h (by rw [hp, trailingCoeff_zero, zero_mul])
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := fun hq => h (by rw [hq, trailingCoeff_zero, mul_zero])
  apply natTrailingDegree_eq_of_trailingDegree_eq_some
  rw [trailingDegree_mul' h, ENat.natCast_add, ← trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree hp,
    ← trailingDegree_eq_natTrailingDegree hq]

name: cardPowDegree_isEuclidean
statement: theorem cardPowDegree_isEuclidean : IsEuclidean (cardPowDegree : AbsoluteValue Fq[X] ℤ)
proof:
:=
  have card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card Fq := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance
  have pow_pos : ∀ n, 0 < (Fintype.card Fq : ℤ) ^ n := fun n =>
    pow_pos (Int.natCast_pos.mpr card_pos) n
  { map_lt_map_iff' := fun {p q} => by
      classical
      change cardPowDegree p < cardPowDegree q ↔ degree p < degree q
      simp only [cardPowDegree_apply]
      split_ifs with hp hq hq
      · simp only [hp, hq, lt_self_iff_false]
      · simp only [hp, hq, degree_zero, Ne, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, degree_eq_bot, pow_pos,
          not_false_iff]
      · simp only [hq, degree_zero, not_lt_bot, (pow_pos _).not_gt]
      · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_natDegree hq, Nat.cast_lt, pow_lt_pow_iff_right₀]
        exact mod_cast @Fintype.one_lt_card Fq _ _ }

name: natDegree_comp_le
statement: theorem natDegree_comp_le : natDegree (p.comp q) ≤ natDegree p * natDegree q
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if h0 : p.comp q = 0 then by rw [h0, natDegree_zero]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  else
    WithBot.coe_le_coe.1 <|
      calc
        ↑(natDegree (p.comp q)) = degree (p.comp q) := (degree_eq_natDegree h0).symm
        _ = _ := congr_arg degree comp_eq_sum_left
        _ ≤ _ := degree_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ _ :=
          Finset.sup_le fun n hn =>
            calc
              degree (C (coeff p n) * q ^ n) ≤ degree (C (coeff p n)) + degree (q ^ n) :=
                degree_mul_le _ _
              _ ≤ natDegree (C (coeff p n)) + n • degree q :=
                (add_le_add degree_le_natDegree (degree_pow_le _ _))
              _ ≤ natDegree (C (coeff p n)) + n • ↑(natDegree q) := by grw [degree_le_natDegree]
              _ = (n * natDegree q : ℕ) := by
                rw [natDegree_C, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, nsmul_eq_mul]
                simp
              _ ≤ (natDegree p * natDegree q : ℕ) :=
                WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 <|
                  by gcongr; exact le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (mem_support_iff.1 hn)

name: natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero (h : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff ^ p.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    natDegree (p.comp q) = natDegree p * natDegree q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : natDegree q = 0
  · exact le_antisymm natDegree_comp_le (by simp [hq])
  apply natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero natDegree_comp_le
  rwa [coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree hq]

name: degree_pos_of_root
statement: theorem degree_pos_of_root {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : IsRoot p a) : 0 < degree p
proof:
:=
  lt_of_not_ge fun hlt => by
    have := eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hlt
    rw [IsRoot, this, eval_C] at h
    simp only [h, map_zero] at this
    exact hp this

name: natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero
statement: theorem natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero : p.natDegree ≤ n ↔ ∀ N : ℕ, n < N → p.coeff N = 0

name: natDegree_add_le_iff_left
statement:
theorem natDegree_add_le_iff_left {n : ℕ} (p q : R[X]) (qn : q.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p + q).natDegree ≤ n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le h qn⟩
  refine natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr fun m hm => ?_
  convert! natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp h m hm using 1
  rw [coeff_add, natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp qn _ hm, add_zero]

name: natDegree_add_le_iff_right
statement:
theorem natDegree_add_le_iff_right {n : ℕ} (p q : R[X]) (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p + q).natDegree ≤ n ↔ q.natDegree ≤ n

name: natDegree_C_mul_le
statement: theorem natDegree_C_mul_le (a : R) (f : R[X]) : (C a * f).natDegree ≤ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  simpa using natDegree_mul_le (p := C a)

name: natDegree_mul_C_le
statement: theorem natDegree_mul_C_le (f : R[X]) (a : R) : (f * C a).natDegree ≤ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  simpa using natDegree_mul_le (q := C a)

name: eq_natDegree_of_le_mem_support
statement:
theorem eq_natDegree_of_le_mem_support (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (ns : n ∈ p.support) :
    p.natDegree = n

name: natDegree_C_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_C_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_one {ai : R} (au : ai * a = 1) :
    (C a * p).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (natDegree_C_mul_le a p)
    (calc
      p.natDegree = (1 * p).natDegree := by nth_rw 1 [← one_mul p]
      _ = (C ai * (C a * p)).natDegree := by rw [← C_1, ← au, map_mul, ← mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (C a * p).natDegree := natDegree_C_mul_le ai (C a * p))

name: natDegree_mul_C_eq_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_mul_C_eq_of_mul_eq_one {ai : R} (au : a * ai = 1) :
    (p * C a).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (natDegree_mul_C_le p a)
    (calc
      p.natDegree = (p * 1).natDegree := by nth_rw 1 [← mul_one p]
      _ = (p * C a * C ai).natDegree := by rw [← C_1, ← au, map_mul, ← mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (p * C a).natDegree := natDegree_mul_C_le (p * C a) ai)

name: natDegree_mul_C_eq_of_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem natDegree_mul_C_eq_of_mul_ne_zero (h : p.leadingCoeff * a ≠ 0) :
    (p * C a).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_natDegree_of_le_mem_support (natDegree_mul_C_le p a) ?_
  refine mem_support_iff.mpr ?_
  rwa [coeff_mul_C]

name: natDegree_C_mul_of_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem natDegree_C_mul_of_mul_ne_zero (h : a * p.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) :
    (C a * p).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_natDegree_of_le_mem_support (natDegree_C_mul_le a p) ?_
  refine mem_support_iff.mpr ?_
  rwa [coeff_C_mul]

name: degree_C_mul_of_mul_ne_zero
statement: lemma degree_C_mul_of_mul_ne_zero (h : a * p.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) : (C a * p).degree = p.degree

name: natDegree_add_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem natDegree_add_coeff_mul (f g : R[X]) :
    (f * g).coeff (f.natDegree + g.natDegree) = f.coeff f.natDegree * g.coeff g.natDegree

name: natDegree_lt_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem natDegree_lt_coeff_mul (h : p.natDegree + q.natDegree < m + n) :
    (p * q).coeff (m + n) = 0

name: coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p ^ m).coeff (m * n) = p.coeff n ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m hm =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ← hm, Nat.succ_mul, coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le _ pn]
    refine natDegree_pow_le.trans (le_trans ?_ (le_refl _))
    gcongr

name: coeff_pow_eq_ite_of_natDegree_le_of_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne o (m * n) with rfl | h
  · simpa only [ite_true] using coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le pn
  · simpa only [h, ite_false] using coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt <|
      lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_pow_le_of_le m pn) (lt_of_le_of_ne mno h.symm)

name: coeff_add_eq_left_of_lt
statement: theorem coeff_add_eq_left_of_lt (qn : q.natDegree < n) : (p + q).coeff n = p.coeff n

name: coeff_add_eq_right_of_lt
statement: theorem coeff_add_eq_right_of_lt (pn : p.natDegree < n) : (p + q).coeff n = q.coeff n

name: degree_sum_eq_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem degree_sum_eq_of_disjoint (f : S → R[X]) (s : Finset S)
    (h : Set.Pairwise { i | i ∈ s ∧ f i ≠ 0 } (Ne on degree ∘ f)) :
    degree (s.sum f) = s.sup fun i => degree (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert x s hx IH =>
    simp only [hx, Finset.sum_insert, not_false_iff, Finset.sup_insert]
    specialize IH (h.mono fun _ => by simp +contextual)
    rcases lt_trichotomy (degree (f x)) (degree (s.sum f)) with (H | H | H)
    · rw [← IH, sup_eq_right.mpr H.le, degree_add_eq_right_of_degree_lt H]
    · rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | hs)
      · simp
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup s hs fun i => degree (f i)
      rw [IH, hy'] at H
      by_cases hx0 : f x = 0
      · simp [hx0, IH]
      have hy0 : f y ≠ 0 := by
        contrapose! H
        simpa [H, degree_eq_bot] using hx0
      refine absurd H (h ?_ ?_ fun H => hx ?_)
      · simp [hx0]
      · simp [hy, hy0]
      · exact H.symm ▸ hy
    · rw [← IH, sup_eq_left.mpr H.le, degree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt H]

name: natDegree_sum_eq_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem natDegree_sum_eq_of_disjoint (f : S → R[X]) (s : Finset S)
    (h : Set.Pairwise { i | i ∈ s ∧ f i ≠ 0 } (Ne on natDegree ∘ f)) :
    natDegree (s.sum f) = s.sup fun i => natDegree (f i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! H : ∃ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := H
    have hs : s.Nonempty := ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some ?_
    rw [degree_sum_eq_of_disjoint]
    · rw [← Finset.sup'_eq_sup hs, ← Finset.sup'_eq_sup hs,
        Nat.cast_withBot, Finset.coe_sup' hs, ←
        Finset.sup'_eq_sup hs]
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · rw [Finset.sup'_le_iff]
        intro b hb
        by_cases hb' : f b = 0
        · simpa [hb'] using! hs
        rw [degree_eq_natDegree hb', Nat.cast_withBot]
        exact Finset.le_sup' (fun i : S => (natDegree (f i) : WithBot ℕ)) hb
      · rw [Finset.sup'_le_iff]
        intro b hb
        simp only [Finset.le_sup'_iff, Function.comp_apply]
        by_cases hb' : f b = 0
        · refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
          contrapose! hx'
          simpa [← Nat.cast_withBot, hb', degree_eq_bot] using! hx'
        exact ⟨b, hb, (degree_eq_natDegree hb').ge⟩
    · exact h.imp fun x y hxy hxy' => hxy (natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq hxy')
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero H, natDegree_zero, eq_comm, show 0 = ⊥ from rfl, Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    simp [H x hx]

name: natDegree_pos_of_eval
statement:
theorem natDegree_pos_of_eval₂_root {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (f : R →+* S) {z : S}
    (hz : eval₂ f z p = 0) (inj : ∀ x : R, f x = 0 → x = 0) : 0 < natDegree p
proof:
:=
  lt_of_not_ge fun hlt => by
    have A : p = C (p.coeff 0) := eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero hlt
    rw [A, eval₂_C] at hz
    simp only [inj (p.coeff 0) hz, map_zero] at A
    exact hp A

name: degree_pos_of_eval
statement:
theorem degree_pos_of_eval₂_root {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (f : R →+* S) {z : S}
    (hz : eval₂ f z p = 0) (inj : ∀ x : R, f x = 0 → x = 0) : 0 < degree p

name: coe_lt_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_lt_degree {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} : (n : WithBot ℕ) < degree p ↔ n < natDegree p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · simp [h]
  simp [degree_eq_natDegree h, Nat.cast_lt]

name: degree_map_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_map_eq_iff {f : R →+* S} {p : Polynomial R} :
    degree (map f p) = degree p ↔ f (leadingCoeff p) ≠ 0 ∨ p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with h | h
  · simp [h]
  simp only [h, or_false]
  refine ⟨fun h2 ↦ ?_, degree_map_eq_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero f⟩
  have h3 : natDegree (map f p) = natDegree p := by simp_rw [natDegree, h2]
  have h4 : map f p ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [ne_eq, ← degree_eq_bot, h2, degree_eq_bot]
  rwa [← coeff_natDegree, ← coeff_map, ← h3, coeff_natDegree, ne_eq, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]

name: natDegree_map_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_map_eq_iff {f : R →+* S} {p : Polynomial R} :
    natDegree (map f p) = natDegree p ↔ f (p.leadingCoeff) ≠ 0 ∨ natDegree p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (natDegree p) 0 with h | h
  · simp_rw [h, ne_eq, or_true, iff_true, ← Nat.le_zero, ← h, natDegree_map_le]
  simp_all [natDegree, WithBot.unbotD_eq_unbotD_iff]

name: degree_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem degree_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hp : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) : (p.map f).degree = p.degree

name: natDegree_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem natDegree_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hp : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) : (p.map f).natDegree = p.natDegree

name: leadingCoeff_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hp : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) : (p.map f).leadingCoeff = f p.leadingCoeff

statement:
theorem nextCoeff_map_eq_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hp : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff) : (p.map f).nextCoeff = f p.nextCoeff

statement:
theorem degree_map_eq_of_injective {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : Polynomial R) :

name: natDegree_map_eq_of_injective
statement:
theorem natDegree_map_eq_of_injective {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : Polynomial R) :
    (p.map f).natDegree = p.natDegree

name: leadingCoeff_map_of_injective
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_map_of_injective {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : Polynomial R) : (p.map f).leadingCoeff = f p.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingCoeff, natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hf, coeff_map]

name: nextCoeff_map
statement:
theorem nextCoeff_map {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : Polynomial R) :

proof:
:= by
  simp only [hf, nextCoeff, natDegree_map_eq_of_injective]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: natDegree_pos_of_nextCoeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem natDegree_pos_of_nextCoeff_ne_zero (h : p.nextCoeff ≠ 0) : 0 < p.natDegree

statement: theorem natDegree_sub : (p - q).natDegree = (q - p).natDegree

name: natDegree_sub_le_iff_left
statement:
theorem natDegree_sub_le_iff_left (qn : q.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p - q).natDegree ≤ n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natDegree_neg] at qn
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, natDegree_add_le_iff_left _ _ qn]

statement:
theorem natDegree_sub_le_iff_right (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p - q).natDegree ≤ n ↔ q.natDegree ≤ n

statement: theorem coeff_sub_eq_left_of_lt (dg : q.natDegree < n) : (p - q).coeff n = p.coeff n
proof:
:= by

  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, coeff_add_eq_left_of_lt dg]

name: nextCoeff_C_mul_X_add_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nextCoeff_C_mul_X_add_C (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : R) : nextCoeff (C a * X + C c) = c

name: natDegree_eq_one
statement: lemma natDegree_eq_one : p.natDegree = 1 ↔ ∃ a ≠ 0, ∃ b, C a * X + C b = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hp ↦ ⟨p.coeff 1, fun h ↦ ?_, p.coeff 0, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hp, coeff_natDegree, leadingCoeff_eq_zero] at h
    simp_all
  · ext n
    obtain _ | _ | n := n
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp only [coeff_add, coeff_mul_X, coeff_C_succ, add_zero]
      rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt]
      simp [hp]
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, rfl⟩
    simp [ha]

name: subsingleton_isRoot_of_natDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem subsingleton_isRoot_of_natDegree_eq_one [IsLeftCancelMulZero R]
    (h : p.natDegree = 1) : { x | IsRoot p x }.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  intro r₁
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, r₃, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, a ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ b, C a * X + C b = p := by rwa [natDegree_eq_one] at h
  have (x y : R) := mul_left_cancel₀ hr₂ (b := x) (c := y)
  grind [IsRoot, eval_add, eval_mul_X, eval_C]

name: degree_mul_C
statement: theorem degree_mul_C (a0 : a ≠ 0) : (p * C a).degree = p.degree

name: degree_C_mul
statement: theorem degree_C_mul (a0 : a ≠ 0) : (C a * p).degree = p.degree

name: natDegree_mul_C
statement: theorem natDegree_mul_C (a0 : a ≠ 0) : (p * C a).natDegree = p.natDegree

name: natDegree_C_mul
statement: theorem natDegree_C_mul (a0 : a ≠ 0) : (C a * p).natDegree = p.natDegree

name: natDegree_comp
statement: theorem natDegree_comp : natDegree (p.comp q) = natDegree p * natDegree q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases q0 : q.natDegree = 0
  · rw [degree_le_zero_iff.mp (natDegree_eq_zero_iff_degree_le_zero.mp q0), comp_C, natDegree_C,
      natDegree_C, mul_zero]
  · by_cases p0 : p = 0
    · simp only [p0, zero_comp, natDegree_zero, zero_mul]
    · simp only [Ne, mul_eq_zero, leadingCoeff_eq_zero, p0, natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero,
        ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero q0), not_false_eq_true, pow_ne_zero, or_self]

name: natDegree_iterate_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_iterate_comp (k : ℕ) :
    (p.comp^[k] q).natDegree = p.natDegree ^ k * q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k IH => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', natDegree_comp, IH, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: leadingCoeff_comp
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_comp (hq : natDegree q ≠ 0) :
    leadingCoeff (p.comp q) = leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q ^ natDegree p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree hq, ← natDegree_comp, coeff_natDegree]

name: nextCoeff_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nextCoeff_C_mul : (C a * p).nextCoeff = a * p.nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₀ : a = 0 <;> simp [h₀, nextCoeff, natDegree_C_mul]

name: nextCoeff_mul_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nextCoeff_mul_C : (p * C a).nextCoeff = p.nextCoeff * a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₀ : a = 0 <;> simp [h₀, nextCoeff, natDegree_mul_C]

name: comp_neg_X_leadingCoeff_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_neg_X_leadingCoeff_eq [Ring R] (p : R[X]) :
    (p.comp (-X)).leadingCoeff = (-1) ^ p.natDegree * p.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  by_cases h : p = 0
  · simp [h]
  rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff, natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero, coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree] <;>
  simp [((Commute.neg_one_left _).pow_left _).eq, h]

name: comp_neg_X_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_neg_X_eq_zero_iff [Ring R] {p : R[X]} : p.comp (-X) = 0 ↔ p = 0

name: comp_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma comp_eq_zero_iff [Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {p q : R[X]} :
    p.comp q = 0 ↔ p = 0 ∨ p.eval (q.coeff 0) = 0 ∧ q = C (q.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, Or.rec (fun h ↦ by simp [h]) fun h ↦ by rw [h.2, comp_C, h.1, C_0]⟩
  have key : p.natDegree = 0 ∨ q.natDegree = 0 := by
    rw [← mul_eq_zero, ← natDegree_comp, h, natDegree_zero]
  obtain key | key := Or.imp eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero key
  · rw [key, C_comp] at h
    exact Or.inl (key.trans h)
  · rw [key, comp_C, C_eq_zero] at h
    exact Or.inr ⟨h, key⟩

name: degree_comp
statement:
lemma degree_comp [Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {p q : R[X]} (hq : 0 < q.degree) :
    (p.comp q).degree = p.degree * q.degree
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · rw [zero_comp, degree_zero, WithBot.bot_mul']
    simp [hq.ne']
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_natDegree (ne_zero_of_degree_gt hq), ← Nat.cast_mul,
    ← natDegree_comp]
  apply degree_eq_natDegree
  simp_rw [Ne, comp_eq_zero_iff, hp, false_or, not_and_or, ← degree_le_zero_iff]
  simp [hq]

name: degree_comp_neg_X
statement: @[simp] lemma degree_comp_neg_X [Ring R] {p : R[X]} : (p.comp (-X)).degree = p.degree
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · rw [zero_comp]
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (by simp [hp]), degree_eq_natDegree hp, Nat.cast_inj,
    natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero (by simp [hp]), natDegree_neg, natDegree_X, mul_one]

name: irreducible_mul_leadingCoeff_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem irreducible_mul_leadingCoeff_inv {p : K[X]} :
    Irreducible (p * C (leadingCoeff p)⁻¹) ↔ Irreducible p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  exact irreducible_mul_isUnit
    (isUnit_C.mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ (inv_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp0))))

theorem sum_over_range' [AddCommMonoid S] (p : R[X]) {f : ℕ → R → S} (h : ∀ n, f n 0 = 0) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : p.natDegree < n) : p.sum f = ∑ a ∈ range n, f a (coeff p a)
proof:
:= by
  have := supp_subset_range hn
  simp only [Polynomial.sum, support, coeff] at this ⊢
  exact Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ this _ fun n _hn => h n

theorem sum_fin [AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S) (hf : ∀ i, f i 0 = 0) {n : ℕ} {p : R[X]}

proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0

    intro i _
    exact hf i
  rw [sum_over_range' _ hf n ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp).mpr hn),
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range fun i => f i (p.coeff i)]

theorem ext_iff_natDegree_le {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.natDegree ≤ n) (hq : q.natDegree ≤ n) :

:= by
  refine Iff.trans Polynomial.ext_iff ?_
  refine forall_congr' fun i => ⟨fun h _ => h, fun h => ?_⟩
  refine (le_or_gt i n).elim h fun k => ?_

    (coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hp.trans_lt k)).trans
      (coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hq.trans_lt k)).symm

:= by

  · simp
  by_cases! hpd : p.degree ≤ 0
  · rw [eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hpd, ← C_add, natDegree_C, natDegree_C]
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, Nat.cast_pos, ← natDegree_C a] at hpd

name: degree_add_eq_of_leadingCoeff_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degree_add_eq_of_leadingCoeff_add_ne_zero (h : leadingCoeff p + leadingCoeff q ≠ 0) :
    degree (p + q) = max p.degree q.degree
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (degree_add_le _ _) <|
    match lt_trichotomy (degree p) (degree q) with
    | Or.inl hlt => by
      rw [degree_add_eq_right_of_degree_lt hlt, max_eq_right_of_lt hlt]
    | Or.inr (Or.inl HEq) =>
      le_of_not_gt fun hlt : max (degree p) (degree q) > degree (p + q) =>
        h <|
          show leadingCoeff p + leadingCoeff q = 0 by
            rw [HEq, max_self] at hlt
            rw [leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff, natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq HEq, ← coeff_add]
            exact coeff_natDegree_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hlt
    | Or.inr (Or.inr hlt) => by
      rw [degree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt hlt, max_eq_left_of_lt hlt]

name: natDegree_eq_of_natDegree_add_lt_left
statement:
lemma natDegree_eq_of_natDegree_add_lt_left (p q : R[X])

proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  cases Nat.lt_or_lt_of_ne h with
  | inl h => exact lt_asymm h (by rwa [natDegree_add_eq_right_of_natDegree_lt h] at H)
  | inr h =>
    rw [natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt h] at H
    exact LT.lt.false H

lemma natDegree_eq_of_natDegree_add_lt_right (p q : R[X])

statement:
lemma natDegree_eq_of_natDegree_add_eq_zero (p q : R[X])

proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : natDegree p = 0; on_goal 1 => by_cases h₂ : natDegree q = 0
  · exact h₁.trans h₂.symm
  · apply natDegree_eq_of_natDegree_add_lt_right; rwa [H, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  · apply natDegree_eq_of_natDegree_add_lt_left; rwa [H, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

:= by
  unfold Monic
  nontriviality
  refine (congr_arg _ <| natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero pn ?_).trans p1

statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_add_of_degree_lt (h : degree p < degree q) :
    leadingCoeff (p + q) = leadingCoeff q
proof:
:= by
  have : coeff p (natDegree q) = 0 := coeff_natDegree_eq_zero_of_degree_lt h
  simp only [leadingCoeff, natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq (degree_add_eq_right_of_degree_lt h), this,

    leadingCoeff (p + q) = leadingCoeff p + leadingCoeff q
proof:
:= by
  have : natDegree (p + q) = natDegree p := by
    apply natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq
    rw [degree_add_eq_of_leadingCoeff_add_ne_zero hlc, h, max_self]

name: coeff_mul_degree_add_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_degree_add_degree (p q : R[X]) :
    coeff (p * q) (natDegree p + natDegree q) = leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q
proof:
:=
  calc
    coeff (p * q) (natDegree p + natDegree q) =
        ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal (natDegree p + natDegree q), coeff p x.1 * coeff q x.2 :=
      coeff_mul _ _ _
    _ = coeff p (natDegree p) * coeff q (natDegree q) := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_single (natDegree p, natDegree q) ?_ ?_
      · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h₁ h₂
        rw [mem_antidiagonal] at h₁
        by_cases H : natDegree p < i
        · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
              (lt_of_le_of_lt degree_le_natDegree (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 H)),
            zero_mul]
        · rw [not_lt_iff_eq_or_lt] at H
          rcases H with H | H
          · simp_all
          · suffices natDegree q < j by
              rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
                  (lt_of_le_of_lt degree_le_natDegree (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 this)),
                mul_zero]
            by_contra! H'
            exact
              ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_right H j) (Nat.add_le_add_left H' _))
                h₁
      · intro H
        exfalso
        apply H
        rw [mem_antidiagonal]

name: degree_mul'
statement:
theorem degree_mul' (h : leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q ≠ 0) :
    degree (p * q) = degree p + degree q
proof:
:=
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by refine mt ?_ h; exact fun hp => by rw [hp, leadingCoeff_zero, zero_mul]
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by refine mt ?_ h; exact fun hq => by rw [hq, leadingCoeff_zero, mul_zero]
  le_antisymm (degree_mul_le _ _)
    (by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_natDegree hq]
      refine le_degree_of_ne_zero (n := natDegree p + natDegree q) ?_
      rwa [coeff_mul_degree_add_degree])

name: Monic.degree_mul
statement: theorem Monic.degree_mul (hq : Monic q) : degree (p * q) = degree p + degree q
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if hp : p = 0 then by simp [hp]
  else degree_mul' <| by rwa [hq.leadingCoeff, mul_one, Ne, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]

name: natDegree_mul'
statement:
theorem natDegree_mul' (h : leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q ≠ 0) :
    natDegree (p * q) = natDegree p + natDegree q
proof:
:=
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.2 fun h₁ => h <| by rw [h₁, zero_mul]
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.2 fun h₁ => h <| by rw [h₁, mul_zero]
  natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some <| by
    rw [degree_mul' h, Nat.cast_add, degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_natDegree hq]

name: leadingCoeff_mul'
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_mul' (h : leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q ≠ 0) :
    leadingCoeff (p * q) = leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q
proof:
:= by
  simp [← coeff_natDegree, natDegree_mul' h, coeff_mul_degree_add_degree]

name: Monic.leadingCoeff_C_mul
statement: lemma Monic.leadingCoeff_C_mul (hp : p.Monic) (r : R) : (C r * p).leadingCoeff = r

name: leadingCoeff_pow'
statement: theorem leadingCoeff_pow' : leadingCoeff p ^ n ≠ 0 → leadingCoeff (p ^ n) = leadingCoeff p ^ n
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n (by simp) fun n ih h => by
    have h₁ : leadingCoeff p ^ n ≠ 0 := fun h₁ => h <| by rw [pow_succ, h₁, zero_mul]
    have h₂ : leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff (p ^ n) ≠ 0 := by rwa [pow_succ', ← ih h₁] at h
    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', leadingCoeff_mul' h₂, ih h₁]

name: degree_pow'
statement:
theorem degree_pow' : ∀ {n : ℕ}, leadingCoeff p ^ n ≠ 0 → degree (p ^ n) = n • degree p
  | 0 => fun h => by rw [pow_zero, ← C_1] at *; rw [degree_C h, zero_nsmul]
  | n + 1 => fun h => by
    have h₁ : leadingCoeff p ^ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h₁ => h <| by rw [pow_succ, h₁, zero_mul]
    have h₂ : leadingCoeff (p ^ n) * leadingCoeff p ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [pow_succ, ← leadingCoeff_pow' h₁] at h
    rw [pow_succ, degree_mul' h₂, succ_nsmul, degree_pow' h₁]

name: natDegree_pow'
statement: theorem natDegree_pow' {n : ℕ} (h : leadingCoeff p ^ n ≠ 0) : natDegree (p ^ n) = n * natDegree p
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  if hp0 : p = 0 then
    if hn0 : n = 0 then by simp [*] else by rw [hp0, zero_pow hn0]; simp
  else
    have hpn : p ^ n ≠ 0 := fun hpn0 => by
      have h1 := h
      rw [← leadingCoeff_pow' h1, hpn0, leadingCoeff_zero] at h; exact h rfl
    Option.some_inj.1 <|
      show (natDegree (p ^ n) : WithBot ℕ) = (n * natDegree p : ℕ) by
        rw [← degree_eq_natDegree hpn, degree_pow' h, degree_eq_natDegree hp0]; simp

name: leadingCoeff_monic_mul
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_monic_mul {p q : R[X]} (hp : Monic p) :
    leadingCoeff (p * q) = leadingCoeff q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with (rfl | H)
  · simp
  · rw [leadingCoeff_mul', hp.leadingCoeff, one_mul]
    rwa [hp.leadingCoeff, one_mul, Ne, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]

name: leadingCoeff_mul_monic
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_mul_monic {p q : R[X]} (hq : Monic q) :
    leadingCoeff (p * q) = leadingCoeff p
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  Decidable.byCases
    (fun H : leadingCoeff p = 0 => by
      rw [H, leadingCoeff_eq_zero.1 H, zero_mul, leadingCoeff_zero])
    fun H : leadingCoeff p ≠ 0 => by
      rw [leadingCoeff_mul', hq.leadingCoeff, mul_one]
      rwa [hq.leadingCoeff, mul_one]

name: coeff_pow_mul_natDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_pow_mul_natDegree (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (p ^ n).coeff (n * p.natDegree) = p.leadingCoeff ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i hi =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, Nat.succ_mul]
    by_cases hp1 : p.leadingCoeff ^ i = 0
    · rw [hp1, zero_mul]
      by_cases hp2 : p ^ i = 0
      · rw [hp2, zero_mul, coeff_zero]
      · apply coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        have h1 : (p ^ i).natDegree < i * p.natDegree := by
          refine lt_of_le_of_ne natDegree_pow_le fun h => hp2 ?_
          rw [← h, hp1] at hi
          exact leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hi
        calc
          (p ^ i * p).natDegree ≤ (p ^ i).natDegree + p.natDegree := natDegree_mul_le
          _ < i * p.natDegree + p.natDegree := by gcongr
    · rw [← natDegree_pow' hp1, ← leadingCoeff_pow' hp1]
      exact coeff_mul_degree_add_degree _ _

name: coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (df, dg)]
  · rw [mem_antidiagonal]
  rintro ⟨df', dg'⟩ hmem hne
  obtain h | hdf' := lt_or_ge df df'
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hdf.trans_lt h), zero_mul]
  obtain h | hdg' := lt_or_ge dg dg'
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hdg.trans_lt h), mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ :=
    (add_eq_add_iff_eq_and_eq hdf' hdg').mp (mem_antidiagonal.1 hmem)
  exact (hne rfl).elim

name: degree_smul_le
statement:
theorem degree_smul_le {S : Type*} [SMulZeroClass S R] (a : S) (p : R[X]) :
    degree (a • p) ≤ degree p
proof:
:= by
  refine (degree_le_iff_coeff_zero _ _).2 fun m hm => ?_
  rw [degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero] at hm
  simp [hm m le_rfl]

proof:

name: natDegree_X_sub_C
statement: theorem natDegree_X_sub_C (x : R) : (X - C x).natDegree = 1

name: nextCoeff_X_sub_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nextCoeff_X_sub_C [Ring S] (c : S) : nextCoeff (X - C c) = -c
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← map_neg C c, nextCoeff_X_add_C]

name: degree_X_pow_sub_C
statement: theorem degree_X_pow_sub_C {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : R) : degree ((X : R[X]) ^ n - C a) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← map_neg C a, degree_X_pow_add_C hn]

name: X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero
statement: theorem X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : R) : (X : R[X]) ^ n - C a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← map_neg C a]
  exact X_pow_add_C_ne_zero hn _

name: X_sub_C_ne_zero
statement: theorem X_sub_C_ne_zero (r : R) : X - C r ≠ 0

name: zero_notMem_multiset_map_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem zero_notMem_multiset_map_X_sub_C {α : Type*} (m : Multiset α) (f : α → R) :
    (0 : R[X]) ∉ m.map fun a => X - C (f a)
proof:
:= fun mem =>
  let ⟨_a, _, ha⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp mem
  X_sub_C_ne_zero _ ha

name: natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
statement: theorem natDegree_X_pow_sub_C {n : ℕ} {r : R} : (X ^ n - C r).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← map_neg C r, natDegree_X_pow_add_C]

name: leadingCoeff_X_sub_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_X_sub_C [Ring S] (r : S) : (X - C r).leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← map_neg C r, leadingCoeff_X_add_C]

name: isMonicOfDegree_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isMonicOfDegree_zero_iff {p : R[X]} : IsMonicOfDegree p 0 ↔ p = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isMonicOfDegree_iff']
  refine ⟨fun ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ ↦ eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero H₂ H₁, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  subst H
  simp

name: IsMonicOfDegree.leadingCoeff_eq
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.leadingCoeff_eq {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) :
    p.leadingCoeff = 1

name: isMonicOfDegree_iff_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isMonicOfDegree_iff_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} :
    IsMonicOfDegree p n ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.eq_one p]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨H, _⟩ ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  · rwa [natDegree_one, eq_comm] at H
  · rw [H, isMonicOfDegree_zero_iff]

name: isMonicOfDegree_iff
statement:
lemma isMonicOfDegree_iff [Nontrivial R] (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    IsMonicOfDegree p n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ p.coeff n = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isMonicOfDegree_iff']
  refine ⟨fun ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ ↦ ⟨H₁.le, H₁ ▸ Monic.coeff_natDegree H₂⟩, fun ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero H₁ <| H₂ ▸ one_ne_zero
  · exact monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one n H₁ H₂

name: IsMonicOfDegree.exists_natDegree_lt
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.exists_natDegree_lt {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) :
    ∃ q : R[X], p = X ^ n + q ∧ q.natDegree < n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨p.eraseLead, ?_, ?_⟩
  · nth_rewrite 1 [← p.eraseLead_add_C_mul_X_pow]
    rw [add_comm, hp.natDegree_eq, hp.leadingCoeff_eq, map_one, one_mul]
  · refine p.eraseLead_natDegree_le.trans_lt ?_
    rw [hp.natDegree_eq]
    lia

name: IsMonicOfDegree.mul
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.mul {p q : R[X]} {m n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p m)
    (hq : IsMonicOfDegree q n) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p * q) (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with H | H
  · simp only [isMonicOfDegree_iff_of_subsingleton, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at hp hq ⊢
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hp.monic.mul hq.monic⟩
  have : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hp.leadingCoeff_eq, hq.leadingCoeff_eq, one_mul]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [natDegree_mul' this, hp.natDegree_eq, hq.natDegree_eq]

name: IsMonicOfDegree.pow
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.pow {p : R[X]} {m : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p m) (n : ℕ) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p ^ n) (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, mul_add, mul_one]
    exact ih.mul hp

name: IsMonicOfDegree.coeff_eq
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.coeff_eq {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n)
    (hq : IsMonicOfDegree q n) {m : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ m) :
    p.coeff m = q.coeff m
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [isMonicOfDegree_iff] at hp hq
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hm with rfl | hm
  · rw [hp.2, hq.2]
  · replace hp : p.natDegree < m := hp.1.trans_lt hm
    replace hq : q.natDegree < m := hq.1.trans_lt hm
    rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hp, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hq]

name: IsMonicOfDegree.of_mul_left
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.of_mul_left {p q : R[X]} {m n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p m)
    (hpq : IsMonicOfDegree (p * q) (m + n)) :
    IsMonicOfDegree q n
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with H | H
  · simp only [isMonicOfDegree_iff_of_subsingleton, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at hpq ⊢
    exact hpq.2
  have h₂ : q.Monic := hp.monic.of_mul_monic_left hpq.monic
  refine ⟨?_, h₂⟩
  have := hpq.natDegree_eq
  have h : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hp.leadingCoeff_eq, h₂.leadingCoeff, one_mul]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [natDegree_mul' h, hp.natDegree_eq] at this
  exact (Nat.add_left_cancel this.symm).symm

name: IsMonicOfDegree.of_mul_right
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.of_mul_right {p q : R[X]} {m n : ℕ} (hq : IsMonicOfDegree q n)
    (hpq : IsMonicOfDegree (p * q) (m + n)) :
    IsMonicOfDegree p m
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with H | H
  · simp only [isMonicOfDegree_iff_of_subsingleton, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at hpq ⊢
    exact hpq.1
  have h₂ : p.Monic := hq.monic.of_mul_monic_right hpq.monic
  refine ⟨?_, h₂⟩
  have := hpq.natDegree_eq
  have h : p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    rw [h₂.leadingCoeff, hq.leadingCoeff_eq, one_mul]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [natDegree_mul' h, hq.natDegree_eq] at this
  exact (Nat.add_right_cancel this.symm).symm

name: IsMonicOfDegree.add_right
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.add_right {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n)
    (hq : q.natDegree < n) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p + q) n
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with H | H
  · simpa using hp
  refine (isMonicOfDegree_iff ..).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le hp.natDegree_eq.le hq.le
  · rw [coeff_add_eq_left_of_lt hq]
    exact ((isMonicOfDegree_iff p n).mp hp).2

name: IsMonicOfDegree.add_left
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.add_left {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.natDegree < n)
    (hq : IsMonicOfDegree q n) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p + q) n

name: IsMonicOfDegree.comp
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.comp {p q : R[X]} {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p m)
    (hq : IsMonicOfDegree q n) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p.comp q) (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with h | h
  · simp only [isMonicOfDegree_iff_of_subsingleton, mul_eq_zero] at hp ⊢
    exact .inl hp
  rw [← hp.natDegree_eq, ← hq.natDegree_eq]
  refine (isMonicOfDegree_iff ..).mpr ⟨natDegree_comp_le, ?_⟩
  rw [coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree (hq.natDegree_eq ▸ hn), hp.leadingCoeff_eq, hq.leadingCoeff_eq,
    one_pow, one_mul]

name: IsMonicOfDegree.ne_zero
statement: lemma IsMonicOfDegree.ne_zero {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (h : IsMonicOfDegree p n) : p ≠ 0

name: isMonicOfDegree_X
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_X : IsMonicOfDegree (X : R[X]) 1

name: isMonicOfDegree_X_pow
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_X_pow (n : ℕ) : IsMonicOfDegree ((X : R[X]) ^ n) n

name: isMonicOfDegree_monomial_one
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_monomial_one (n : ℕ) : IsMonicOfDegree (monomial n (1 : R)) n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [monomial_one_right_eq_X_pow] using isMonicOfDegree_X_pow R n

name: isMonicOfDegree_X_add_one
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_X_add_one (r : R) : IsMonicOfDegree (X + C r) 1

name: isMonicOfDegree_one_iff
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_one_iff {f : R[X]} : IsMonicOfDegree f 1 ↔ ∃ r : R, f = X + C r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun ⟨r, H⟩ ↦ H ▸ isMonicOfDegree_X_add_one r⟩
  refine ⟨f.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  ext1 n
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · exact H.coeff_eq (isMonicOfDegree_X_add_one _) (by lia)

name: isMonicOfDegree_add_add_two
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_add_add_two (a b : R) : IsMonicOfDegree (X ^ 2 + C a * X + C b) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc]
  exact (isMonicOfDegree_X_pow R 2).add_right <|
    calc
    _ ≤ max (C a * X).natDegree (C b).natDegree := natDegree_add_le ..
    _ = (C a * X).natDegree := by simp
    _ < 2 := natDegree_C_mul_le .. |>.trans natDegree_X_le |>.trans_lt one_lt_two

name: isMonicOfDegree_two_iff
statement:
lemma isMonicOfDegree_two_iff {f : R[X]} :
    IsMonicOfDegree f 2 ↔ ∃ a b : R, f = X ^ 2 + C a * X + C b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ isMonicOfDegree_add_add_two a b⟩
  refine ⟨f.coeff 1, f.coeff 0, ext fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 1 with hn | rfl | hn
  · obtain rfl : n = 0 := Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hn
    simp
  · simp
  · exact H.coeff_eq (isMonicOfDegree_add_add_two ..) (by lia)

name: IsMonicOfDegree.natDegree_sub_X_pow
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.natDegree_sub_X_pow {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) :
    (p - X ^ n).natDegree < n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂⟩ := hp.exists_natDegree_lt hn
  simpa [hq₁]

name: IsMonicOfDegree.natDegree_sub_lt
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.natDegree_sub_lt {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n)
    (hq : IsMonicOfDegree q n) :
    (p - q).natDegree < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_sub_sub_cancel_right p q (X ^ n)]
  replace hp := hp.natDegree_sub_X_pow hn
  replace hq := hq.natDegree_sub_X_pow hn
  rw [← Nat.le_sub_one_iff_lt (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hn)] at hp hq ⊢
  exact (natDegree_sub_le_iff_left hq).mpr hp

name: IsMonicOfDegree.sub
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.sub {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) (hq : q.natDegree < n) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p - q) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hp.add_right <| (natDegree_neg q) ▸ hq

name: isMonicOfDegree_X_sub_one
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_X_sub_one (r : R) : IsMonicOfDegree (X - C r) 1

name: isMonicOfDegree_sub_add_two
statement: lemma isMonicOfDegree_sub_add_two (a b : R) : IsMonicOfDegree (X ^ 2 - C a * X + C b) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_add]
  exact (isMonicOfDegree_X_pow R 2).add_right <| by
    rw [natDegree_neg]
    calc
    _ ≤ max (C a * X).natDegree (C b).natDegree := natDegree_sub_le ..
    _ = (C a * X).natDegree := by simp
    _ < 2 := natDegree_C_mul_le .. |>.trans natDegree_X_le |>.trans_lt one_lt_two

name: isMonicOfDegree_two_iff'
statement:
lemma isMonicOfDegree_two_iff' {f : R[X]} :
    IsMonicOfDegree f 2 ↔ ∃ a b : R, f = X ^ 2 - C a * X + C b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ isMonicOfDegree_sub_add_two a b⟩
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_mul, ← map_neg]
  obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := isMonicOfDegree_two_iff.mp H
  exact ⟨-a, b, (neg_neg a).symm ▸ h⟩

name: IsMonicOfDegree.of_dvd_add
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.of_dvd_add {a b r : R[X]} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : n ≤ m) (ha : IsMonicOfDegree a m)
    (hb : IsMonicOfDegree b n) (hr : r.natDegree < m) (h : b ∣ a + r) :
    ∃ q : R[X], IsMonicOfDegree q (m - n) ∧ a = q * b - r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_eq_mul_left_of_dvd h
  refine ⟨q, hb.of_mul_right ?_, eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr hq⟩
  rw [← hq, show m - n + n = m by lia]
  exact ha.add_right hr

name: IsMonicOfDegree.of_dvd_sub
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.of_dvd_sub {a b r : R[X]} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : n ≤ m) (ha : IsMonicOfDegree a m)
    (hb : IsMonicOfDegree b n) (hr : r.natDegree < m) (h : b ∣ a - r) :
    ∃ q : R[X], IsMonicOfDegree q (m - n) ∧ a = q * b + r
proof:
:= by
  convert ha.of_dvd_add hmn hb ?_ h with q
  · rw [sub_neg_eq_add]
  · rwa [natDegree_neg]

name: IsMonicOfDegree.aeval_add
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.aeval_add {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) (r : R) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (aeval (X + C r) p) n
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with H | H
  · simpa using hp
  rw [← mul_one n]
  exact hp.comp one_ne_zero (isMonicOfDegree_X_add_one r)

name: IsMonicOfDegree.aeval_sub
statement:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.aeval_sub {p : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) (r : R) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (aeval (X - C r) p) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← map_neg]
  exact aeval_add hp (-r)

name: natDegree_mul
statement: lemma natDegree_mul (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) : (p * q).natDegree = p.natDegree + q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := WithBot ℕ), ← degree_eq_natDegree (mul_ne_zero hp hq),
    Nat.cast_add, ← degree_eq_natDegree hp, ← degree_eq_natDegree hq, degree_mul]

name: natDegree_smul
statement:
lemma natDegree_smul {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [IsDomain S] [Module S R] [Module.IsTorsionFree S R]
    {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0) : (a • p).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp only [hp, smul_zero]
  · apply natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
    · exact (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans (le_refl _)
    · simp only [coeff_smul]
      apply smul_ne_zero ha
      simp [hp]

name: natDegree_pow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma natDegree_pow (p : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : natDegree (p ^ n) = n * natDegree p
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p 0
  · obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0 <;> simp [*]
  exact natDegree_pow' <| by
    rw [← leadingCoeff_pow, Ne, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]; exact pow_ne_zero _ hp

name: natDegree_le_of_dvd
statement: lemma natDegree_le_of_dvd (h1 : p ∣ q) (h2 : q ≠ 0) : p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := h1
  rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at h2
  rw [natDegree_mul h2.1 h2.2]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: degree_le_of_dvd
statement: lemma degree_le_of_dvd (h1 : p ∣ q) (h2 : q ≠ 0) : degree p ≤ degree q
proof:
:= by
  rcases h1 with ⟨q, rfl⟩; rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at h2
  exact degree_le_mul_left p h2.2

name: eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt (h₁ : p ∣ q) (h₂ : degree q < degree p) : q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  exact lt_iff_not_ge.mp h₂ (degree_le_of_dvd h₁ hc)

name: eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natDegree_lt
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natDegree_lt (h₁ : p ∣ q) (h₂ : natDegree q < natDegree p) :
    q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  exact lt_iff_not_ge.mp h₂ (natDegree_le_of_dvd h₁ hc)

name: not_dvd_of_degree_lt
statement: lemma not_dvd_of_degree_lt (h0 : q ≠ 0) (hl : q.degree < p.degree) : ¬p ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcontra
  exact h0 (eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt hcontra hl)

name: not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt
statement:
lemma not_dvd_of_natDegree_lt (h0 : q ≠ 0) (hl : q.natDegree < p.natDegree) :
    ¬p ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcontra
  exact h0 (eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natDegree_lt hcontra hl)

name: natDegree_sub_eq_of_prod_eq
statement:
lemma natDegree_sub_eq_of_prod_eq {p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : R[X]} (hp₁ : p₁ ≠ 0) (hq₁ : q₁ ≠ 0)
    (hp₂ : p₂ ≠ 0) (hq₂ : q₂ ≠ 0) (h_eq : p₁ * q₂ = p₂ * q₁) :
    (p₁.natDegree : ℤ) - q₁.natDegree = (p₂.natDegree : ℤ) - q₂.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add]
  norm_cast
  rw [← natDegree_mul hp₁ hq₂, ← natDegree_mul hp₂ hq₁, h_eq]

name: Monic.def
statement: theorem Monic.def : Monic p ↔ leadingCoeff p = 1

name: Monic.leadingCoeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Monic.leadingCoeff {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) : leadingCoeff p = 1

name: Monic.coeff_natDegree
statement: theorem Monic.coeff_natDegree {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) : p.coeff p.natDegree = 1

name: degree_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem degree_zero : degree (0 : R[X]) = ⊥

name: natDegree_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem natDegree_zero : natDegree (0 : R[X]) = 0

name: coeff_natDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_natDegree : coeff p (natDegree p) = leadingCoeff p

name: degree_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_eq_bot : degree p = ⊥ ↔ p = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => support_eq_empty.1 (Finset.max_eq_bot.1 h), fun h => h.symm ▸ rfl⟩

name: degree_ne_bot
statement: theorem degree_ne_bot : degree p ≠ ⊥ ↔ p ≠ 0

name: degree_eq_natDegree
statement: theorem degree_eq_natDegree (hp : p ≠ 0) : degree p = (natDegree p : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := not_forall.1 (mt Option.eq_none_iff_forall_not_mem.2 (mt degree_eq_bot.1 hp))

name: degree_sub_lt_left
statement:
theorem degree_sub_lt_left (hd : degree p = degree q) (hp0 : p ≠ 0)
    (hlc : leadingCoeff p = leadingCoeff q) : degree (p - q) < degree p
proof:
:=
  have hp : monomial (natDegree p) (leadingCoeff p) + p.erase (natDegree p) = p :=
    monomial_add_erase _ _
  have hq : monomial (natDegree q) (leadingCoeff q) + q.erase (natDegree q) = q :=
    monomial_add_erase _ _
  have hd' : natDegree p = natDegree q := by unfold natDegree; rw [hd]
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := mt degree_eq_bot.2 (hd ▸ mt degree_eq_bot.1 hp0)
  calc
    degree (p - q) = degree (erase (natDegree q) p + -erase (natDegree q) q) := by
      conv =>
        lhs
        rw [← hp, ← hq, hlc, hd', add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, sub_eq_add_neg]
    _ ≤ max (degree (erase (natDegree q) p)) (degree (erase (natDegree q) q)) :=
      (degree_neg (erase (natDegree q) q) ▸ degree_add_le _ _)
    _ < degree p := max_lt_iff.2 ⟨hd' ▸ degree_erase_lt hp0, hd.symm ▸ degree_erase_lt hq0⟩

:= by
  rw [← degree_neg, neg_sub]
  exact degree_sub_lt_left hd.symm hq0 hlc.symm

statement: theorem eq_X_add_C_of_degree_le_one (h : degree p ≤ 1) : p = C (p.coeff 1) * X + C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:=
  ext fun n =>
