name: card_preimage_eq_sum_card_image_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let t := (Set.finite_coe_iff.mp (Finite.Set.finite_inter_of_left ↑s (Set.range f))).toFinset
  rw [show Nat.card (f ⁻¹' s) = Nat.card (f ⁻¹' t) by simp [t]]
  rw [show ∑ b ∈ s, Nat.card {a //f a = b} = ∑ b ∈ t, Nat.card {a | f a = b} by
    exact (Finset.sum_subset (by simp [t]) (by aesop)).symm]
  have ht : Set.Finite (f ⁻¹' t) := Set.Finite.preimage' (finite_toSet t) (by aesop)
  rw [Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset ht, Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image (f := f)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun m hm ↦ ?_
  · simpa [← Finset.coe_inj, t] using Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range
  · rw [Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset (hb _ (by aesop))]
    suffices {a | f a = m} ⊆ ht.toFinset from
      congr_arg (Finset.card ·) (Finset.ext_iff.mpr fun a ↦ by simpa using fun h ↦ this h)
    intro _ h
    simp_all

name: prod_sum
statement:
lemma prod_sum {κ : ι → Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : ∀ i, Finset (κ i)) (f : ∀ i, κ i → R) :
    ∏ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ t a, f a b = ∑ p ∈ s.pi t, ∏ x ∈ s.attach, f x.1 (p x.1 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    have h₁ : ∀ x ∈ t a, ∀ y ∈ t a, x ≠ y →
      Disjoint (image (Pi.cons s a x) (pi s t)) (image (Pi.cons s a y) (pi s t)) := by
      intro x _ y _ h
      simp only [disjoint_iff_ne, mem_image]
      rintro _ ⟨p₂, _, eq₂⟩ _ ⟨p₃, _, eq₃⟩ eq
      have : Pi.cons s a x p₂ a (mem_insert_self _ _)
              = Pi.cons s a y p₃ a (mem_insert_self _ _) := by rw [eq₂, eq₃, eq]
      rw [Pi.cons_same, Pi.cons_same] at this
      exact h this
    rw [prod_insert ha, pi_insert ha, ih, sum_mul, sum_biUnion h₁]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    have h₂ : ∀ p₁ ∈ pi s t, ∀ p₂ ∈ pi s t, Pi.cons s a b p₁ = Pi.cons s a b p₂ → p₁ = p₂ :=
      fun p₁ _ p₂ _ eq => Pi.cons_injective ha eq
    rw [sum_image h₂, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
    rw [attach_insert, prod_insert, prod_image]
    · simp only [Pi.cons_same]
      congr with ⟨v, hv⟩
      congr
      exact (Pi.cons_ne (by rintro rfl; exact ha hv)).symm
    · exact fun _ _ _ _ => Subtype.ext ∘ Subtype.mk.inj
    · simpa only [mem_image, mem_attach, Subtype.mk.injEq, true_and,
        Subtype.exists, exists_prop, exists_eq_right] using ha

name: prod_add
statement:
theorem prod_add (f g : ι → R) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (f i + g i) = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (∏ i ∈ t, f i) * ∏ i ∈ s \ t, g i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∏ i ∈ s, (f i + g i) =
        ∏ i ∈ s, ∑ p ∈ ({True, False} : Finset Prop), if p then f i else g i := by simp
    _ = ∑ p ∈ (s.pi fun _ => {True, False} : Finset (∀ a ∈ s, Prop)),
          ∏ a ∈ s.attach, if p a.1 a.2 then f a.1 else g a.1 := prod_sum _ _ _
    _ = ∑ t ∈ s.powerset, (∏ a ∈ t, f a) * ∏ a ∈ s \ t, g a :=
      sum_bij'
        (fun f _ ↦ {a ∈ s | ∃ h : a ∈ s, f a h})
        (fun t _ a _ => a ∈ t)
        (by simp)
        (by simp [Classical.em])
        (by simp_rw [mem_filter, funext_iff, eq_iff_iff, mem_pi, mem_insert]; tauto)
        (by simp_rw [Finset.ext_iff, mem_filter, mem_powerset]; tauto)
        (fun a _ ↦ by
          simp only [prod_ite, filter_attach', prod_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk,
            Subtype.map_coe, id_eq, prod_attach]
          congr 2 with x
          simp only [mem_filter, mem_sdiff, not_and, not_exists, and_congr_right_iff]
          tauto)

statement:

name: prod_add_ordered
statement:
theorem prod_add_ordered [LinearOrder ι] (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (f i + g i) =
      (∏ i ∈ s, f i) +
        ∑ i ∈ s, g i * (∏ j ∈ s with j < i, (f j + g j)) * ∏ j ∈ s with i < j, f j
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.induction_on_max s (by simp) ?_
  clear s
  intro a s ha ihs
  have ha' : a ∉ s := fun ha' => lt_irrefl a (ha a ha')
  rw [prod_insert ha', prod_insert ha', sum_insert ha', filter_insert, ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl a),
    filter_true_of_mem ha, ihs, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, add_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  · rw [filter_false_of_mem, prod_empty, mul_one]
    exact (forall_mem_insert _ _ _).2 ⟨lt_irrefl a, fun i hi => (ha i hi).not_gt⟩
  · rw [mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    rw [filter_insert, ite_eq_right (ha i hi).not_gt, filter_insert, ite_eq_left (ha i hi),
      prod_insert, mul_left_comm]
    exact mt (fun ha => (mem_filter.1 ha).1) ha'

name: Finset.prod_eq_prod_range_intervalGapsWithin
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Finset.prod_eq_prod_range_intervalGapsWithin (f : α → α → β) :
    ∏ z ∈ F, f z.1 z.2 = ∏ i ∈ range k,
      f (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i).2 (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i.succ).1
proof:
:= by
  set p := F.intervalGapsWithin h a b
  symm
  apply prod_bij (fun (i : ℕ) hi ↦ ((p i).2, (p i.succ).1))
  · exact fun i _ ↦ F.intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo h a b (x := i) (by grind)
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    rw [mem_range] at hi hj
    apply F.intervalGapsWithin_injOn h a b <;> grind
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂⟩ := F.intervalGapsWithin_surjOn h a b hz
    exact ⟨i, by grind, hi₂⟩
  · simp

name: Finset.prod_intervalGapsWithin_mul_prod_eq_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Finset.prod_intervalGapsWithin_mul_prod_eq_div :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      g (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i).2 / g (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i).1) *
      ∏ z ∈ F, g z.2 / g z.1 = g b / g a
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.prod_eq_prod_range_intervalGapsWithin h (fun x y ↦ g y / g x), mul_comm,
      prod_range_succ, ← mul_assoc,
      ← prod_mul_distrib,
      prod_congr rfl (fun _ _ ↦ div_mul_div_cancel _ _ _),
      prod_range_div (fun i ↦ g (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i).1)]
  simp

name: Finset.prod_intervalGapsWithin_eq_div_div_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Finset.prod_intervalGapsWithin_eq_div_div_prod :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      g (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i).2 / g (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b i).1) =

name: prod_mulIndicator_subset_of_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive /
`n ↦ (n • ·)`, which maps a second argument of `0` to `0` (or a weighted sum of `f i * h i` or
`f i • h i`, where `f` gives the weights that are multiplied by some other function `h`). Then if
`f` is replaced by the corresponding indicator function, the finset may be replaced by a possibly
larger finset without changing the value of the sum. -/]
lemma prod_mulIndicator_subset_of_eq_one [One α] (f : ι → α) (g : ι → α → β) {s t : Finset ι}
    (h : s ⊆ t) (hg : ∀ a, g a 1 = 1) :
    ∏ i ∈ t, g i (mulIndicator ↑s f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, g i (f i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∏ i ∈ s, g i (mulIndicator ↑s f i) := by rw [prod_subset h fun i _ hn ↦ by simp [hn, hg]]
    _ = _ := prod_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ congr_arg _ <| mulIndicator_of_mem hi f

name: prod_mulIndicator_subset
statement:
@[to_additive /
summing the original function over the original finset. -/]
lemma prod_mulIndicator_subset (f : ι → β) {s t : Finset ι} (h : s ⊆ t) :

name: prod_mulIndicator_eq_prod_filter
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_mulIndicator_eq_prod_filter (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ → β) (t : ι → Set κ) (g : ι → κ)
    [DecidablePred fun i ↦ g i ∈ t i] :
    ∏ i ∈ s, mulIndicator (t i) (f i) (g i) = ∏ i ∈ s with g i ∈ t i, f i (g i)
proof:
:= by
  refine (prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not s (fun i ↦ g i ∈ t i) _).symm.trans <|
     Eq.trans (congr_arg₂ (· * ·) ?_ ?_) (mul_one _)
  · exact prod_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ mulIndicator_of_mem (mem_filter.1 hx).2 _
  · exact prod_eq_one fun x hx ↦ mulIndicator_of_notMem (mem_filter.1 hx).2 _

name: mulIndicator_biUnion
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mulIndicator_biUnion (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Set κ) {f : κ → β}
    (hs : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint t) :
    mulIndicator (⋃ i ∈ s, t i) f = fun a ↦ ∏ i ∈ s, mulIndicator (t i) f a
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s hi ih =>
    ext j
    rw [coe_cons, Set.pairwiseDisjoint_insert_of_notMem (Finset.mem_coe.not.2 hi)] at hs
    classical
    rw [prod_cons, cons_eq_insert, set_biUnion_insert, mulIndicator_union_of_notMem_inter, ih hs.1]
    exact (Set.disjoint_iff.mp (Set.disjoint_iUnion₂_right.mpr hs.2) ·)

name: isSquare_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isSquare_prod {s : Finset ι} (f : ι → M) (h : ∀ c ∈ s, IsSquare (f c)) :

proof:

name: prod_apply_dite
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_apply_dite {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    [DecidablePred fun x => ¬p x] (f : ∀ x : ι, p x → γ) (g : ∀ x : ι, ¬p x → γ) (h : γ → M) :
    (∏ x ∈ s, h (if hx : p x then f x hx else g x hx)) =
      (∏ x : {x ∈ s | p x}, h (f x.1 <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2)) *
        ∏ x : {x ∈ s | ¬p x}, h (g x.1 <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2)
proof:
:=
  calc
    (∏ x ∈ s, h (if hx : p x then f x hx else g x hx)) =
        (∏ x ∈ s with p x, h (if hx : p x then f x hx else g x hx)) *
          ∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, h (if hx : p x then f x hx else g x hx) :=
      (prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not s p _).symm
    _ = (∏ x : {x ∈ s | p x}, h (if hx : p x.1 then f x.1 hx else g x.1 hx)) *
          ∏ x : {x ∈ s | ¬p x}, h (if hx : p x.1 then f x.1 hx else g x.1 hx) :=
      congr_arg₂ _ (prod_attach _ _).symm (prod_attach _ _).symm
    _ = (∏ x : {x ∈ s | p x}, h (f x.1 <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2)) *
          ∏ x : {x ∈ s | ¬p x}, h (g x.1 <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2) :=
      congr_arg₂ _ (prod_congr rfl fun x _hx ↦
        congr_arg h (dite_eq_left <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2))
        (prod_congr rfl fun x _hx =>
          congr_arg h (dite_eq_right <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2))

name: prod_apply_ite
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_apply_ite {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f g : ι → γ)
    (h : γ → M) :
    (∏ x ∈ s, h (if p x then f x else g x)) =
      (∏ x ∈ s with p x, h (f x)) * ∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, h (g x)

name: prod_dite
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_dite {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f : ∀ x : ι, p x → M)
    (g : ∀ x : ι, ¬p x → M) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, (if hx : p x then f x hx else g x hx) =
      (∏ x : {x ∈ s | p x}, f x.1 (by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2)) *
        ∏ x : {x ∈ s | ¬p x}, g x.1 (by simpa using (mem_filter.mp x.2).2)

name: prod_dite_eq

theorem prod_dite_eq [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (a : ι) (b : ∀ x : ι, a = x → M) :

name: prod_pi_mulSingle'
statement: lemma prod_pi_mulSingle' (i : ι) (a : M) : ∏ j, Pi.mulSingle i a j = a

name: prod_Icc_of_even_eq_range
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_Icc_of_even_eq_range {α : Type*} [CommGroup α] {f : ℤ → α} (hf : f.Even) (N : ℕ) :
    ∏ m ∈ Icc (-N : ℤ) N, f m = (∏ m ∈ range (N + 1), f m) ^ 2 / f 0
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [sq]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Icc_succ_succ, prod_union (by simp), prod_pair (by lia), ih,
      prod_range_succ _ (N + 1), hf, ← pow_two, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← mul_pow, Nat.cast_succ]

name: prod_Icc_eq_prod_Ico_mul
prod_Icc_succ_eq_mul_endpoints
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_Icc_succ_eq_mul_endpoints {R : Type*} [CommGroup R] (f : ℤ → R) {N : ℕ} :
    ∏ m ∈ Icc (-(N + 1) : ℤ) (N + 1), f m =
    f (N + 1) * f (-(N + 1) : ℤ) * ∏ m ∈ Icc (-N : ℤ) N, f m
proof:
:= by
  induction N
  · rw [Icc_succ_succ]
    grind
  · rw [Icc_succ_succ, prod_union (by simp)]
    grind

name: prod_Ico_int_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_Ico_int_div (b : ℕ) {α : Type*} [CommGroup α] (f : ℤ → α) :
    ∏ n ∈ Ico (-b : ℤ) b, f n / f (n + 1) = f (-b) / f b
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ b ihb =>
    simp only [Nat.cast_add_one, Ico_succ_succ]
    rw [prod_union (by simp), prod_insert (by grind), prod_singleton, ihb, ← mul_assoc, mul_div]
    simp [mul_comm, mul_div, ← mul_assoc]

name: prod_sigma
statement:
@[to_additive /
in the reverse direction, use `Finset.sum_sigma'`.

See also `Fintype.sum_sigma` for the sum over the whole type. -/]
theorem prod_sigma {σ : α → Type*} (s : Finset α) (t : ∀ a, Finset (σ a)) (f : Sigma σ → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.sigma t, f x = ∏ a ∈ s, ∏ s ∈ t a, f ⟨a, s⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← disjiUnion_map_sigma_mk, prod_disjiUnion, prod_map, Function.Embedding.sigmaMk_apply]

name: prod_sigma'
statement:
@[to_additive /
in the reverse direction, use `Finset.sum_sigma` -/]
theorem prod_sigma' {σ : α → Type*} (s : Finset α) (t : ∀ a, Finset (σ a)) (f : ∀ a, σ a → β) :
    (∏ a ∈ s, ∏ s ∈ t a, f a s) = ∏ x ∈ s.sigma t, f x.1 x.2
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| prod_sigma s t fun x => f x.1 x.2

name: prod_finset_product
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_finset_product (r : Finset (γ × α)) (s : Finset γ) (t : γ → Finset α)
    (h : ∀ p : γ × α, p ∈ r ↔ p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ t p.1) {f : γ × α → β} :
    ∏ p ∈ r, f p = ∏ c ∈ s, ∏ a ∈ t c, f (c, a)
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (prod_sigma s t fun p => f (p.1, p.2))
  apply prod_equiv (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd _ _).symm <;> simp [h]

name: prod_finset_product'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_finset_product' (r : Finset (γ × α)) (s : Finset γ) (t : γ → Finset α)
    (h : ∀ p : γ × α, p ∈ r ↔ p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ t p.1) {f : γ → α → β} :
    ∏ p ∈ r, f p.1 p.2 = ∏ c ∈ s, ∏ a ∈ t c, f c a

name: prod_finset_product_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_finset_product_right (r : Finset (α × γ)) (s : Finset γ) (t : γ → Finset α)
    (h : ∀ p : α × γ, p ∈ r ↔ p.2 ∈ s ∧ p.1 ∈ t p.2) {f : α × γ → β} :
    ∏ p ∈ r, f p = ∏ c ∈ s, ∏ a ∈ t c, f (a, c)
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (prod_sigma s t fun p => f (p.2, p.1))
  apply prod_equiv ((Equiv.prodComm _ _).trans (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd _ _).symm) <;> simp [h]

name: prod_finset_product_right'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_finset_product_right' (r : Finset (α × γ)) (s : Finset γ) (t : γ → Finset α)
    (h : ∀ p : α × γ, p ∈ r ↔ p.2 ∈ s ∧ p.1 ∈ t p.2) {f : α → γ → β} :
    ∏ p ∈ r, f p.1 p.2 = ∏ c ∈ s, ∏ a ∈ t c, f a c

name: prod_product
statement:
@[to_additive /
in the reverse direction, use `Finset.sum_product'` -/]
theorem prod_product (s : Finset γ) (t : Finset α) (f : γ × α → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s ×ˢ t, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f (x, y)
proof:
:=
  prod_finset_product (s ×ˢ t) s (fun _a => t) fun _p => mem_product

name: prod_product'
statement:
@[to_additive /
in the reverse direction, use `Finset.sum_product` -/]
theorem prod_product' (s : Finset γ) (t : Finset α) (f : γ → α → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s ×ˢ t, f x.1 x.2 = ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f x y

name: prod_product_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_product_right (s : Finset γ) (t : Finset α) (f : γ × α → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s ×ˢ t, f x = ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s, f (x, y)
proof:
:=
  prod_finset_product_right (s ×ˢ t) t (fun _a => s) fun _p => mem_product.trans and_comm

name: prod_comm'
statement:
@[to_additive /
theorem prod_product_right' (s : Finset γ) (t : Finset α) (f : γ → α → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s ×ˢ t, f x.1 x.2 = ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s, f x y :=
  prod_product_right ..

/
variable. -/
@[to_additive /
the outer variable. -/]
theorem prod_comm' {s : Finset γ} {t : γ → Finset α} {t' : Finset α} {s' : α → Finset γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, x ∈ s ∧ y ∈ t x ↔ x ∈ s' y ∧ y ∈ t') {f : γ → α → β} :
    (∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t x, f x y) = ∏ y ∈ t', ∏ x ∈ s' y, f x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
    have : ∀ z : γ × α, (z ∈ s.biUnion fun x => (t x).map <| Function.Embedding.sectR x _) ↔
      z.1 ∈ s ∧ z.2 ∈ t z.1 := by
      rintro ⟨x, y⟩
      simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_map, Function.Embedding.sectR_apply, Prod.mk.injEq,
        exists_eq_right, ← and_assoc]
    exact
      (prod_finset_product' _ _ _ this).symm.trans
        ((prod_finset_product_right' _ _ _) fun ⟨x, y⟩ => (this _).trans ((h x y).trans and_comm))

name: prod_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_comm {s : Finset γ} {t : Finset α} {f : γ → α → β} :
    (∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f x y) = ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s, f x y

name: prod_comm_cycle
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_comm_cycle {s : Finset γ} {t : Finset α} {u : Finset κ} {f : γ → α → κ → β} :
    (∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ z ∈ u, f x y z) = ∏ z ∈ u, ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f x y z

name: card_sigma
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_sigma {σ : α → Type*} (s : Finset α) (t : ∀ a, Finset (σ a)) :
    #(s.sigma t) = ∑ a ∈ s, #(t a)

name: prod_univ_pi
statement:
@[to_additive /
`Fintype.piFinset t`. `univ.pi t` and `Fintype.piFinset t` are essentially the same `Finset`,
but differ in the type of their element, `univ.pi t` is a `Finset (Π a ∈ univ, t a)` and
`Fintype.piFinset t` is a `Finset (Π a, t a)`. -/]
lemma prod_univ_pi [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {κ : ι → Type*} (t : ∀ i, Finset (κ i))
    (f : (∀ i ∈ (univ : Finset ι), κ i) → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ univ.pi t, f x = ∏ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, f fun a _ ↦ x a
proof:
:= by
  apply prod_nbij' (fun x i ↦ x i <| mem_univ _) (fun x i _ ↦ x i) <;> simp

name: prod_eq_fold
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_eq_fold (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i = s.fold (β := M) (· * ·) 1 f

name: prod_cons
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_cons (h : a ∉ s) : ∏ x ∈ cons a s h, f x = f a * ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_cons'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := grind =)]
theorem prod_cons' (h : a ∉ s) :
    Finset.prod (cons a s h) = fun (f : ι → M) => f a * ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_insert
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_insert [DecidableEq ι] : a ∉ s → ∏ x ∈ insert a s, f x = f a * ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_insert'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := grind =)]
theorem prod_insert' [DecidableEq ι] (h : a ∉ s) :
    Finset.prod (insert a s) = fun (f : ι → M) => f a * ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_insert_of_eq_one_if_notMem
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /
the sum over `s`, as long as `a` is in `s` or `f a = 0`. -/]
theorem prod_insert_of_eq_one_if_notMem [DecidableEq ι] (h : a ∉ s → f a = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ insert a s, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_insert_one
statement:
@[to_additive /
the sum over `s`, as long as `f a = 0`. -/]
theorem prod_insert_one [DecidableEq ι] (h : f a = 1) : ∏ x ∈ insert a s, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_singleton
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_singleton (f : ι → M) (a : ι) : ∏ x ∈ singleton a, f x = f a

name: prod_singleton'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := grind =)]
theorem prod_singleton' (a : ι) :
    Finset.prod (singleton a) = fun (f : ι → M) => f a

name: prod_pair
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_pair [DecidableEq ι] {a b : ι} (h : a ≠ b) :
    (∏ x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset ι), f x) = f a * f b

name: prod_image
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /
finset or its image coincide.
See also `sum_image_of_pairwise_eq_zero` for a version with weaker assumptions. -/]
theorem prod_image [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset κ} {g : κ → ι} :
    Set.InjOn g s → ∏ x ∈ s.image g, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f (g x)

name: prod_attach
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_attach (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) : ∏ x ∈ s.attach, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [← prod_image Subtype.coe_injective.injOn, attach_image_val]

name: prod_congr
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := congr)]
theorem prod_congr (h : s₁ = s₂) : (∀ x ∈ s₂, f x = g x) → s₁.prod f = s₂.prod g

name: prod_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_one (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1
proof:
:= calc
  ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ _x ∈ s, 1 := prod_congr rfl h
  _ = 1 := prod_const_one

name: prod_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma prod_eq_one_iff [Subsingleton Mˣ] : ∏ i ∈ s, f i = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction <;> simp [*]

name: prod_disjUnion
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_disjUnion (h) :
    ∏ x ∈ s₁.disjUnion s₂ h, f x = (∏ x ∈ s₁, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (fold_disjUnion h)
  rw [one_mul]
  rfl

name: prod_disjiUnion
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_disjiUnion (s : Finset κ) (t : κ → Finset ι) (h) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.disjiUnion t h, f x = ∏ i ∈ s, ∏ x ∈ t i, f x
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (fold_disjiUnion h)
  dsimp [Finset.prod, Multiset.prod, Multiset.fold, Finset.disjUnion, Finset.fold]
  congr
  exact prod_const_one.symm

name: prod_union_inter
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_union_inter [DecidableEq ι] :
    (∏ x ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s₁ ∩ s₂, f x = (∏ x ∈ s₁, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x

name: prod_union
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_union [DecidableEq ι] (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    ∏ x ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂, f x = (∏ x ∈ s₁, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_union_inter, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h]; exact (mul_one _).symm

name: prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [∀ x, Decidable (¬p x)] (f : ι → M) :
    (∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι
  rw [← prod_union (disjoint_filter_filter_not s s p), filter_union_filter_not_eq]

name: prod_filter_not_mul_prod_filter
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_filter_not_mul_prod_filter (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    [∀ x, Decidable (¬p x)] (f : ι → M) :
    (∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_eq_of_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_eq_of_subset
    {s₁ s₂ : Finset ι} (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) (f : ι → M) (hf : ∀ (i : ι), i ∈ s₂ → i ∉ s₁ → f i = 1) :
    ∏ i ∈ s₁, f i = ∏ i ∈ s₂, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [show s₂ = s₁.disjUnion (s₂ \ s₁) disjoint_sdiff by simpa, Finset.prod_disjUnion,
    Finset.prod_eq_one (s := s₂ \ s₁) (by aesop), mul_one]

name: prod_filter_xor
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter_xor (p q : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    (∏ x ∈ s with (Xor (p x) (q x)), f x) =
      (∏ x ∈ s with (p x ∧ ¬ q x), f x) * (∏ x ∈ s with (q x ∧ ¬ p x), f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [← prod_union (disjoint_filter_and_not_filter _ _), ← filter_or]
  simp only [Xor]

name: _root_.IsCompl.prod_mul_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem _root_.IsCompl.prod_mul_prod [Fintype ι] {s t : Finset ι} (h : IsCompl s t) (f : ι → M) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ i ∈ t, f i = ∏ i, f i
proof:
:=
  (Finset.prod_disjUnion h.disjoint).symm.trans <| by
    classical rw [Finset.disjUnion_eq_union, ← Finset.sup_eq_union, h.sup_eq_top]; rfl

name: prod_mul_prod_compl
statement:
@[to_additive /
For a version expressed with subtypes, see `Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype`. -/]
lemma prod_mul_prod_compl [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i) * ∏ i ∈ sᶜ, f i = ∏ i, f i

name: prod_compl_mul_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_compl_mul_prod [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :
    (∏ i ∈ sᶜ, f i) * ∏ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ i, f i

name: prod_sdiff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_sdiff [DecidableEq ι] (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) :
    (∏ x ∈ s₂ \ s₁, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s₁, f x = ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_union sdiff_disjoint, sdiff_union_of_subset h]

name: prod_subset_one_on_sdiff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_subset_one_on_sdiff [DecidableEq ι] (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) (hg : ∀ x ∈ s₂ \ s₁, g x = 1)
    (hfg : ∀ x ∈ s₁, f x = g x) : ∏ i ∈ s₁, f i = ∏ i ∈ s₂, g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_sdiff h, prod_eq_one hg, one_mul]
  exact prod_congr rfl hfg

name: prod_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_subset (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ s₂, x ∉ s₁ → f x = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s₁, f x = ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x
proof:
:=
  haveI := Classical.decEq ι
  prod_subset_one_on_sdiff h (by simpa) fun _ _ => rfl

name: prod_disjSum
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_disjSum (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι ⊕ κ → M) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.disjSum t, f x = (∏ x ∈ s, f (Sum.inl x)) * ∏ x ∈ t, f (Sum.inr x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_inl_disjUnion_map_inr, prod_disjUnion, prod_map, prod_map]
  rfl

name: prod_sum_eq_prod_toLeft_mul_prod_toRight
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_sum_eq_prod_toLeft_mul_prod_toRight (s : Finset (ι ⊕ κ)) (f : ι ⊕ κ → M) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = (∏ x ∈ s.toLeft, f (Sum.inl x)) * ∏ x ∈ s.toRight, f (Sum.inr x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.toLeft_disjSum_toRight (u := s), Finset.prod_disjSum, Finset.toLeft_disjSum,
    Finset.toRight_disjSum]

name: prod_sumElim
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_sumElim (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι → M) (g : κ → M) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.disjSum t, Sum.elim f g x = (∏ x ∈ s, f x) * ∏ x ∈ t, g x

name: prod_biUnion
statement:
@[to_additive /
the sum of the sums over the sets.
See also `sum_biUnion_of_pairwise_eq_zero` for a version with weaker assumptions. -/]
theorem prod_biUnion [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset κ} {t : κ → Finset ι}
    (hs : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑s) t) : ∏ x ∈ s.biUnion t, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ i ∈ t x, f i

name: prod_of_injOn
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_of_injOn (e : ι → κ) (he : Set.InjOn e s) (hest : Set.MapsTo e s t)
    (h' : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ e '' s → g i = 1) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = g (e i)) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ j ∈ t, g j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (prod_nbij e (fun a ↦ mem_image_of_mem e) he (by simp [Set.surjOn_image]) h).trans <|
    prod_subset (image_subset_iff.2 hest) <| by simpa using h'

name: prod_fiberwise_eq_prod_filter
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise_eq_prod_filter (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ j ∈ t, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f i = ∏ i ∈ s with g i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_disjiUnion, disjiUnion_filter_eq]
  #adaptation_note /
  intro x' hx y' hy hne
  simp_rw [disjoint_left, mem_filter]; rintro i ⟨_, rfl⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩; exact hne rfl

name: prod_fiberwise_eq_prod_filter'
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise_eq_prod_filter' (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (g : ι → κ) (f : κ → M) :
    ∏ j ∈ t, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f j = ∏ i ∈ s with g i ∈ t, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∏ j ∈ t, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f (g i) :=
        prod_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ prod_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ by rw [(mem_filter.1 hi).2]
    _ = _ := prod_fiberwise_eq_prod_filter _ _ _ _

name: prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to {g : ι → κ} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ∈ t) (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ j ∈ t, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_disjiUnion, disjiUnion_filter_eq_of_maps_to h]
  #adaptation_note /
  intro x' hx y' hy hne
  simp_rw [disjoint_left, mem_filter]; rintro i ⟨_, rfl⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩; exact hne rfl

name: prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to'
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to' {g : ι → κ} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ∈ t) (f : κ → M) :
    ∏ j ∈ t, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f j = ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∏ j ∈ t, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f (g i) :=
        prod_congr rfl fun y _ ↦ prod_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ by rw [(mem_filter.1 hx).2]
    _ = _ := prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to h _

name: prod_fiberwise
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ j, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i

name: prod_fiberwise'
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise' (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → κ) (f : κ → M) :
    ∏ j, ∏ i ∈ s with g i = j, f j = ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)

name: prod_diag
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma prod_diag (s : Finset ι) (f : ι × ι → M) :
    ∏ i ∈ s.diag, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f (i, i)

name: prod_image'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_image' [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset κ} {g : κ → ι} (h : κ → M)
    (eq : ∀ i ∈ s, f (g i) = ∏ j ∈ s with g j = g i, h j) :
    ∏ a ∈ s.image g, f a = ∏ i ∈ s, h i
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∏ a ∈ s.image g, f a = ∏ a ∈ s.image g, ∏ j ∈ s with g j = a, h j :=
      (prod_congr rfl) fun _a hx =>
        let ⟨i, his, hi⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
        hi ▸ eq i his
    _ = ∏ i ∈ s, h i := prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun _ => mem_image_of_mem g) _

name: prod_mul_distrib
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_mul_distrib : ∏ x ∈ s, f x * g x = (∏ x ∈ s, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s, g x

name: prod_mul_prod_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_mul_prod_comm (f g h i : ι → M) :
    (∏ a ∈ s, f a * g a) * ∏ a ∈ s, h a * i a = (∏ a ∈ s, f a * h a) * ∏ a ∈ s, g a * i a

name: prod_filter_of_ne
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter_of_ne {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 1 → p x) :
    ∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:=
  (prod_subset (filter_subset _ _)) fun x => by
    rw [not_imp_comm, mem_filter]
    exact fun h₁ h₂ => ⟨h₁, by simpa using hp _ h₁ h₂⟩

name: prod_filter_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter_ne_one (s : Finset ι) [∀ x, Decidable (f x ≠ 1)] :
    ∏ x ∈ s with f x ≠ 1, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_filter
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s with p a, if p a then f a else 1 :=
      prod_congr rfl fun a h => by rw [ite_eq_left]; simpa using (mem_filter.1 h).2
    _ = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 := by
      { refine prod_subset (filter_subset _ s) fun x hs h => ?_
        rw [mem_filter, not_and] at h
        exact ite_eq_right (by simpa using h hs) }

name: prod_eq_single_of_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_single_of_mem {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι) (h : a ∈ s)
    (h₀ : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ {a}, f x := by
      { refine (prod_subset ?_ ?_).symm
        · intro _ H
          rwa [mem_singleton.1 H]
        · simpa only [mem_singleton] }
    _ = f a := prod_singleton _ _

name: prod_eq_single
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_single {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι) (h₀ : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 1)
    (h₁ : a ∉ s → f a = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a
proof:
:=
  haveI := Classical.decEq ι
  by_cases (prod_eq_single_of_mem a · h₀) fun this =>
    (prod_congr rfl fun b hb => h₀ b hb <| by rintro rfl; exact this hb).trans <|
      prod_const_one.trans (h₁ this).symm

name: prod_ite_mem_eq
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma prod_ite_mem_eq [Fintype ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] :
    (∏ i, if i ∈ s then f i else 1) = ∏ i ∈ s, f i

name: prod_eq_ite
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_eq_ite [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι)
    (h₀ : ∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = if a ∈ s then f a else 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · simp [Finset.prod_eq_single_of_mem a h h₀, h]
  · replace h₀ : ∀ b ∈ s, f b = 1 := by grind
    simp +contextual [h₀]

name: prod_union_eq_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_union_eq_left [DecidableEq ι] (hs : ∀ a ∈ s₂, a ∉ s₁ → f a = 1) :
    ∏ a ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂, f a = ∏ a ∈ s₁, f a
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <|
    prod_subset subset_union_left fun _a ha ha' ↦ hs _ ((mem_union.1 ha).resolve_left ha') ha'

name: prod_union_eq_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_union_eq_right [DecidableEq ι] (hs : ∀ a ∈ s₁, a ∉ s₂ → f a = 1) :
    ∏ a ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂, f a = ∏ a ∈ s₂, f a

name: prod_congr_of_eq_on_inter
statement:
@[to_additive /
are equal if the functions agree on `s₁ ∩ s₂`, `f = 0` and `g = 0` on the respective
set differences. -/]
lemma prod_congr_of_eq_on_inter {ι M : Type*} {s₁ s₂ : Finset ι} {f g : ι → M} [CommMonoid M]
    (h₁ : ∀ a ∈ s₁, a ∉ s₂ → f a = 1) (h₂ : ∀ a ∈ s₂, a ∉ s₁ → g a = 1)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s₁, a ∈ s₂ → f a = g a) :
    ∏ a ∈ s₁, f a = ∏ a ∈ s₂, g a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [← sdiff_union_inter s₁ s₂, prod_union_eq_right (by simp_all)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← sdiff_union_inter s₂ s₁, prod_union_eq_right (by simp_all), inter_comm]
  exact prod_congr rfl (by simpa)

name: prod_eq_mul_of_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_mul_of_mem {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a b : ι) (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s)
    (hn : a ≠ b) (h₀ : ∀ c ∈ s, c ≠ a ∧ c ≠ b → f c = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a * f b
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι; let s' := ({a, b} : Finset ι)
  have hu : s' ⊆ s := by grind
  have hf : ∀ c ∈ s, c ∉ s' → f c = 1 := by grind
  rw [← Finset.prod_subset hu hf]
  exact Finset.prod_pair hn

name: prod_eq_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_mul {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a b : ι) (hn : a ≠ b)
    (h₀ : ∀ c ∈ s, c ≠ a ∧ c ≠ b → f c = 1) (ha : a ∉ s → f a = 1) (hb : b ∉ s → f b = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f a * f b
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι; by_cases h₁ : a ∈ s <;> by_cases h₂ : b ∈ s
  · exact prod_eq_mul_of_mem a b h₁ h₂ hn h₀
  · rw [hb h₂, mul_one]
    apply prod_eq_single_of_mem a h₁
    exact fun c hc hca => h₀ c hc ⟨hca, ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hc h₂⟩
  · rw [ha h₁, one_mul]
    apply prod_eq_single_of_mem b h₂
    exact fun c hc hcb => h₀ c hc ⟨ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hc h₁, hcb⟩
  · rw [ha h₁, hb h₂, mul_one]
    exact
      _root_.trans
        (prod_congr rfl fun c hc =>
          h₀ c hc ⟨ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hc h₁, ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hc h₂⟩)
        prod_const_one

name: prod_subtype_eq_prod_filter
statement:
theorem prod_subtype_eq_prod_filter (f : ι → M) {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :
    ∏ x ∈ s.subtype p, f x = ∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x
proof:
:= by
  have := prod_map (s.subtype p) (Function.Embedding.subtype _) f
  simp_all

name: prod_subtype_of_mem
statement:
@[to_additive /
over `s.subtype p` equals that sum over `s`. -/]
theorem prod_subtype_of_mem (f : ι → M) {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (h : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.subtype p, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_subtype_eq_prod_filter, filter_true_of_mem]
  simpa using h

name: prod_subtype_map_embedding
statement:
@[to_additive /
sum in the main type of a function that agrees with the first
function on that `Finset`. -/]
theorem prod_subtype_map_embedding {p : ι → Prop} {s : Finset { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → M}
    {g : ι → M} (h : ∀ x : { x // p x }, x ∈ s → g x = f x) :
    (∏ x ∈ s.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _), g x) = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_map]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl h

name: prod_coe_sort
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_coe_sort : ∏ i : s, f i = ∏ i ∈ s, f i

name: prod_finset_coe
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_finset_coe (f : ι → M) (s : Finset ι) : (∏ i : (s : Set ι), f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, f i

name: prod_subtype
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_subtype {p : ι → Prop} {F : Fintype (Subtype p)} (s : Finset ι) (h : ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ p x)
    (f : ι → M) : ∏ a ∈ s, f a = ∏ a : Subtype p, f a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : p = (· ∈ s) := by simp [h]
  rw [← prod_coe_sort]
  congr!

name: prod_set_coe
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_set_coe (s : Set ι) [Fintype s] : (∏ i : s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s.toFinset, f i

name: prod_congr_set
statement:
@[to_additive /
the sum of a function `f` defined everywhere,
as long as `f` and `g` agree on `s`, and `f = 0` off `s`. -/]
theorem prod_congr_set [Fintype ι] (s : Set ι) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (f : ι → M) (g : s → M)
    (w : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ s), f x = g ⟨x, hx⟩) (w' : ∀ x ∉ s, f x = 1) : ∏ i, f i = ∏ i, g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_subset s.toFinset.subset_univ (by simpa), prod_subtype (p := (· ∈ s)) _ (by simp)]
  congr! with ⟨x, h⟩
  exact w x h

name: prod_extend_by_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_extend_by_one [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (if i ∈ s then f i else 1) = ∏ i ∈ s, f i

name: prod_eq_prod_extend
statement: theorem prod_eq_prod_extend (f : s → M) : ∏ x, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, Subtype.val.extend f 1 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [univ_eq_attach, ← Finset.prod_attach s]
  congr with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply]

name: prod_bij_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_bij_ne_one {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset κ} {f : ι → M} {g : κ → M}
    (i : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ≠ 1 → κ) (hi : ∀ a h₁ h₂, i a h₁ h₂ ∈ t)
    (i_inj : ∀ a₁ h₁₁ h₁₂ a₂ h₂₁ h₂₂, i a₁ h₁₁ h₁₂ = i a₂ h₂₁ h₂₂ → a₁ = a₂)
    (i_surj : ∀ b ∈ t, g b ≠ 1 → ∃ a h₁ h₂, i a h₁ h₂ = b) (h : ∀ a h₁ h₂, f a = g (i a h₁ h₂)) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ t, g x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ s with f x ≠ 1, f x := by rw [prod_filter_ne_one]
    _ = ∏ x ∈ t with g x ≠ 1, g x :=
      prod_bij (fun a ha => i a (mem_filter.mp ha).1 <| by simpa using (mem_filter.mp ha).2)
        ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    _ = ∏ x ∈ t, g x := prod_filter_ne_one _
  · grind
  · solve_by_elim
  · intro b hb
    refine (mem_filter.mp hb).elim fun h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂, eq⟩ := i_surj b h₁ fun H ↦ by rw [H] at h₂; simp at h₂
    exact ⟨a, mem_filter.mpr ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩, eq⟩
  · solve_by_elim

name: exists_ne_one_of_prod_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem exists_ne_one_of_prod_ne_one (h : ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 1) : ∃ a ∈ s, f a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact prod_eq_one h

name: prod_range_succ_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_succ_comm (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ x ∈ range (n + 1), f x) = f n * ∏ x ∈ range n, f x

name: prod_range_succ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_succ (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ x ∈ range (n + 1), f x) = (∏ x ∈ range n, f x) * f n

name: prod_range_succ'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_succ' (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (∏ k ∈ range (n + 1), f k) = (∏ k ∈ range n, f (k + 1)) * f 0
  | 0 => prod_range_succ _ _
  | n + 1 => by rw [prod_range_succ _ n, mul_right_comm, ← prod_range_succ' _ n, prod_range_succ]

@[to_additive]

name: eventually_constant_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eventually_constant_prod {u : ℕ → M} {N : ℕ} (hu : ∀ n ≥ N, u n = 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : N ≤ n) :
    (∏ k ∈ range n, u k) = ∏ k ∈ range N, u k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl : n = N + m⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  clear hn
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m hm => simp [← add_assoc, prod_range_succ, hm, hu]

name: prod_range_add
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_range_add (f : ℕ → M) (n m : ℕ) :
    (∏ x ∈ range (n + m), f x) = (∏ x ∈ range n, f x) * ∏ x ∈ range m, f (n + x)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m hm => rw [Nat.add_succ, prod_range_succ, prod_range_succ, hm, mul_assoc]

name: prod_range_one
statement:
@[to_additive sum_range_one]
theorem prod_range_one (f : ℕ → M) : ∏ k ∈ range 1, f k = f 0

name: prod_list_map_count
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_list_map_count [DecidableEq ι] (l : List ι) (f : ι → M) :
    (l.map f).prod = ∏ m ∈ l.toFinset, f m ^ l.count m
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [map_nil, prod_nil, count_nil, pow_zero, prod_const_one]
  | cons a s IH =>
  simp only [List.map, List.prod_cons, toFinset_cons, IH]
  by_cases has : a ∈ s.toFinset
  · rw [insert_eq_of_mem has, ← insert_erase has, prod_insert (notMem_erase _ _),
      prod_insert (notMem_erase _ _), ← mul_assoc, count_cons_self, pow_succ']
    congr 1
    refine prod_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
    rw [count_cons_of_ne (ne_of_mem_erase hx).symm]
  rw [prod_insert has, count_cons_self, count_eq_zero_of_not_mem (mt mem_toFinset.2 has), pow_one]
  grind [Finset.prod_congr]

name: prod_list_count
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_list_count [DecidableEq M] (s : List M) :
    s.prod = ∏ m ∈ s.toFinset, m ^ s.count m
proof: := by simpa using prod_list_map_count s id

name: prod_list_count_of_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_list_count_of_subset [DecidableEq M] (m : List M) (s : Finset M)
    (hs : m.toFinset ⊆ s) : m.prod = ∏ i ∈ s, i ^ m.count i
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_list_count]
  refine prod_subset hs fun x _ hx => ?_
  rw [mem_toFinset] at hx
  rw [count_eq_zero_of_not_mem hx, pow_zero]

name: prod_multiset_map_count
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_multiset_map_count [DecidableEq ι] (s : Multiset ι) {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M]
    (f : ι → M) : (s.map f).prod = ∏ m ∈ s.toFinset, f m ^ s.count m
proof:
:= by
  refine Quot.induction_on s fun l => ?_
  simp [prod_list_map_count l f]

name: prod_multiset_count
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_multiset_count [DecidableEq M] (s : Multiset M) :
    s.prod = ∏ m ∈ s.toFinset, m ^ s.count m
proof:
:= by
  convert! prod_multiset_map_count s id
  rw [Multiset.map_id]

name: prod_multiset_count_of_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_multiset_count_of_subset [DecidableEq M] (m : Multiset M) (s : Finset M)
    (hs : m.toFinset ⊆ s) : m.prod = ∏ i ∈ s, i ^ m.count i
proof:
:= by
  revert hs
  refine Quot.induction_on m fun l => ?_
  simp only [quot_mk_to_coe'', prod_coe, coe_count]
  apply prod_list_count_of_subset l s

name: prod_range_induction
statement:
@[to_additive /
can verify that it's equal to a different function just by checking differences of adjacent terms
up to `n`.

This is a discrete analogue of the fundamental theorem of calculus. -/]
theorem prod_range_induction (f s : ℕ → M) (base : s 0 = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (step : ∀ k < n, s (k + 1) = s k * f k) :
    ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k = s n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Finset.prod_range_zero, base]
  | succ k hk =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, step _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _), hk]
    exact fun _ hl ↦ step _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hl)

name: prod_const
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_const (b : M) : ∏ _x ∈ s, b = b ^ #s

name: prod_eq_pow_card
statement:
@[to_additive sum_eq_card_nsmul]
theorem prod_eq_pow_card {b : M} (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a = b) : ∏ a ∈ s, f a = b ^ #s

name: pow_card_mul_prod
statement:
@[to_additive card_nsmul_add_sum]
theorem pow_card_mul_prod {b : M} : b ^ #s * ∏ a ∈ s, f a = ∏ a ∈ s, b * f a

name: prod_mul_pow_card
statement:
@[to_additive sum_add_card_nsmul]
theorem prod_mul_pow_card {b : M} : (∏ a ∈ s, f a) * b ^ #s = ∏ a ∈ s, f a * b

name: pow_eq_prod_const
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_eq_prod_const (b : M) : ∀ n, b ^ n = ∏ _k ∈ range n, b

name: prod_pow_eq_pow_sum
statement:
@[to_additive sum_nsmul_assoc]
lemma prod_pow_eq_pow_sum (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (a : M) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, a ^ f i = a ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:=
  cons_induction (by simp) (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ by simp [prod_cons, sum_cons, pow_add, *]) s

name: prod_flip
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_flip {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → M) :
    (∏ r ∈ range (n + 1), f (n - r)) = ∏ k ∈ range (n + 1), f k
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [prod_range_one, prod_range_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [prod_range_succ', prod_range_succ _ (Nat.succ n)]
    simp [← ih]

name: prod_involution
statement:
@[to_additive /
use membership of the domain of the sum, rather than being a non-dependent function. -/]
lemma prod_involution (g : ∀ a ∈ s, ι) (hg₁ : ∀ a ha, f a * f (g a ha) = 1)
    (hg₃ : ∀ a ha, f a ≠ 1 → g a ha ≠ a)
    (g_mem : ∀ a ha, g a ha ∈ s) (hg₄ : ∀ a ha, g (g a ha) (g_mem a ha) = a) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.strongInduction with | H s ih => ?_
  obtain rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩ := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp
  have : {x, g x hx} ⊆ s := by simp [insert_subset_iff, hx, g_mem]
  suffices h : ∏ x ∈ s \ {x, g x hx}, f x = 1 by
    rw [← prod_sdiff this, h, one_mul]
    cases eq_or_ne (g x hx) x with
    | inl hx' => simpa [hx'] using hg₃ x hx
    | inr hx' => grind
  suffices h₃ : ∀ a (ha : a ∈ s \ {x, g x hx}), g a (sdiff_subset ha) ∈ s \ {x, g x hx} from
    ih (s \ {x, g x hx}) (ssubset_iff.2 ⟨x, by simp [insert_subset_iff, hx]⟩) _
      (by simp [hg₁]) (fun _ _ => hg₃ _ _) h₃ (fun _ _ => hg₄ _ _)
  grind

name: prod_ninvolution
statement:
@[to_additive /
non-dependent function, rather than being allowed to use membership of the domain of the sum. -/]
lemma prod_ninvolution (g : ι → ι) (hg₁ : ∀ a, f a * f (g a) = 1) (hg₂ : ∀ a, f a ≠ 1 → g a ≠ a)
    (g_mem : ∀ a, g a ∈ s) (hg₃ : ∀ a, g (g a) = a) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1
proof:
:=
  prod_involution (fun i _ => g i) (fun i _ => hg₁ i) (fun _ _ hi => hg₂ _ hi)
    (fun i _ => g_mem i) (fun i _ => hg₃ i)

name: prod_comp
statement:
@[to_additive /
`b ∈ s.image g` of `f b` times of the cardinality of the fibre of `b`. See also
`Finset.sum_image`. -/]
theorem prod_comp [DecidableEq κ] (f : κ → M) (g : ι → κ) :
    ∏ a ∈ s, f (g a) = ∏ b ∈ s.image g, f b ^ #{a ∈ s | g a = b}
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← prod_const, prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to' fun _ ↦ mem_image_of_mem _]

name: prod_partition
statement:
theorem prod_partition (R : Setoid ι) [DecidableRel R.r] :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ xbar ∈ s.image (Quotient.mk _), ∏ y ∈ s with ⟦y⟧ = xbar, f y
proof:
:= by
  refine (Finset.prod_image' f fun x _hx => ?_).symm
  rfl

name: prod_cancels_of_partition_cancels
statement:
@[to_additive /
cancels. -/]
theorem prod_cancels_of_partition_cancels (R : Setoid ι) [DecidableRel R]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∏ a ∈ s with R a x, f a = 1) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_partition R, ← Finset.prod_eq_one]
  intro xbar xbar_in_s
  obtain ⟨x, x_in_s, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp xbar_in_s
  simp only [← Quotient.eq] at h
  exact h x x_in_s

name: eq_of_card_le_one_of_prod_eq
statement:
@[to_additive eq_of_card_le_one_of_sum_eq /
value, so do the terms in that sum. -/]
theorem eq_of_card_le_one_of_prod_eq {s : Finset ι} (hc : #s ≤ 1) {f : ι → M} {b : M}
    (h : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = b) : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = b
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_cases hc0 : #s = 0
  · exact False.elim (card_ne_zero_of_mem hx hc0)
  · have h1 : #s = 1 := le_antisymm hc (Nat.one_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0))
    rw [card_eq_one] at h1
    grind

name: mul_prod_erase
statement:
@[to_additive /
element `f a` to the sum over `s.erase a`.

See `Multiset.sum_map_erase` for the `Multiset` version. -/]
theorem mul_prod_erase [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) {a : ι} (h : a ∈ s) :
    (f a * ∏ x ∈ s.erase a, f x) = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_insert (notMem_erase a s), insert_erase h]

name: prod_erase_mul
statement:
theorem prod_erase_mul [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) {a : ι} (h : a ∈ s) :
    (∏ x ∈ s.erase a, f x) * f a = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, mul_prod_erase s f h]

name: prod_erase
statement:
@[to_additive /
removing that point, if present, from a `Finset`. -/]
theorem prod_erase [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → M} {a : ι} (h : f a = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.erase a, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
  refine prod_subset sdiff_subset fun x hx hnx => ?_
  grind

name: prod_erase_lt_of_one_lt
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_erase_lt_of_one_lt {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [CommMonoid κ] [LT κ]
    [MulLeftStrictMono κ] {s : Finset ι} {d : ι} (hd : d ∈ s) {f : ι → κ}
    (hdf : 1 < f d) : ∏ m ∈ s.erase d, f m < ∏ m ∈ s, f m
proof:
:= by
  conv in ∏ m ∈ s, f m => rw [← Finset.insert_erase hd]
  rw [Finset.prod_insert (Finset.notMem_erase d s)]
  exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_left' _ hdf

name: eq_one_of_prod_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive /
point, it is 0 everywhere on the `Finset`. -/]
theorem eq_one_of_prod_eq_one {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} {a : ι} (hp : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1)
    (h1 : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ a → f x = 1) : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  classical
    by_cases h : x = a
    · rw [h]
      rw [h] at hx
      rw [← prod_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 hx) fun t ht ha => h1 t ht (notMem_singleton.1 ha),
        prod_singleton] at hp
      exact hp
    · exact h1 x hx h

name: prod_mul_eq_prod_mul_of_exists
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_mul_eq_prod_mul_of_exists {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} {b₁ b₂ : M}
    (a : ι) (ha : a ∈ s) (h : f a * b₁ = f a * b₂) :
    (∏ a ∈ s, f a) * b₁ = (∏ a ∈ s, f a) * b₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← insert_erase ha]
  simp only [mem_erase, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and, not_false_eq_true, prod_insert]
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_comm b₁, h, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (f a)]

name: prod_biUnion_of_pairwise_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_biUnion_of_pairwise_eq_one [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset κ} {t : κ → Finset ι}
    (hs : (s : Set κ).Pairwise fun i j ↦ ∀ k ∈ t i ∩ t j, f k = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.biUnion t, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ i ∈ t x, f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t' k := (t k).filter (fun i ↦ f i ≠ 1)
  have : s.biUnion t' = (s.biUnion t).filter (fun i ↦ f i ≠ 1) := by grind
  rw [← prod_filter_ne_one, ← this, prod_biUnion]
  swap
  · intro i hi j hj hij a hai haj k hk
    have hki : k ∈ t' i := hai hk
    have hkj : k ∈ t' j := haj hk
    simp only [ne_eq, mem_filter, t'] at hki hkj
    exact (hki.2 (hs hi hj hij k (by grind))).elim
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i hi ↦ prod_filter_ne_one (t i))

name: prod_filter_of_pairwise_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_filter_of_pairwise_eq_one [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} {g : ι → M} {n : κ} {I : Finset κ}
    (hn : n ∈ I) (hf : (I : Set κ).Pairwise fun i j ↦ f i = f j → g (f i) = 1) :
    ∏ j ∈ I with f j = f n, g (f j) = g (f n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h j (hj : j ∈ {i ∈ I | f i = f n}.erase n) : g (f j) = 1 := by
    simp only [mem_erase, mem_filter] at hj
    exact hf hj.2.1 hn hj.1 hj.2.2
  rw [← mul_one (g (f n)), ← prod_eq_one h,
    ← mul_prod_erase {i ∈ I | f i = f n} (fun i ↦ g (f i)) <| mem_filter.mpr ⟨hn, by rfl⟩]

name: prod_image_of_pairwise_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
injective. Rather, we assume that the image of `f` on `I` only overlaps where `g (f i) = 0`.
The conclusion is the same as in `sum_image`. -/]
lemma prod_image_of_pairwise_eq_one [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} {g : ι → M} {I : Finset κ}
    (hf : (I : Set κ).Pairwise fun i j ↦ f i = f j → g (f i) = 1) :
    ∏ s ∈ I.image f, g s = ∏ i ∈ I, g (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_image']
  exact fun n hnI => (prod_filter_of_pairwise_eq_one hnI hf).symm

name: prod_image_of_disjoint
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
injective. Rather, we assume that the images of `f` are disjoint on `I`, and `g ⊥ = 0`. The
conclusion is the same as in `sum_image`. -/]
lemma prod_image_of_disjoint [DecidableEq ι] [PartialOrder ι] [OrderBot ι] {f : κ → ι} {g : ι → M}
    (hg_bot : g ⊥ = 1) {I : Finset κ} (hf_disj : (I : Set κ).PairwiseDisjoint f) :
    ∏ s ∈ I.image f, g s = ∏ i ∈ I, g (f i)
proof:
:= by
  refine prod_image_of_pairwise_eq_one <| hf_disj.imp fun i j hdisj hfij ↦ ?_
  rw [Function.onFun, ← hfij, disjoint_self] at hdisj
  rw [hdisj, hg_bot]

name: prod_unique_nonempty
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_unique_nonempty [Unique ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) (h : s.Nonempty) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = f default

name: prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd
statement:
lemma prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd (f g : ι → M) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∣ g i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i ∣ ∏ i ∈ s, g i

name: prod_map_equiv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_map_equiv (e : ι ≃ κ) : (s.map e).prod (f ∘ e.symm) = s.prod f

name: prod_comp_equiv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_comp_equiv {f : κ → M} (e : ι ≃ κ) : s.prod (f ∘ e) = (s.map e).prod f

name: prod_sdiff_eq_prod_sdiff_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_sdiff_eq_prod_sdiff_iff :
    ∏ i ∈ s \ t, f i = ∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i ↔ ∏ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:=
  eq_comm.trans <| eq_iff_eq_of_mul_eq_mul <| by
    rw [← prod_union disjoint_sdiff_self_left, ← prod_union disjoint_sdiff_self_left,
      sdiff_union_self_eq_union, sdiff_union_self_eq_union, union_comm]

name: prod_sdiff_ne_prod_sdiff_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_sdiff_ne_prod_sdiff_iff :
    ∏ i ∈ s \ t, f i ≠ ∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i ↔ ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≠ ∏ i ∈ t, f i

name: prod_insert_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_insert_div (ha : a ∉ s) (f : ι → G) :
    (∏ x ∈ insert a s, f x) / f a = ∏ x ∈ s, f x

name: prod_erase_eq_div
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_erase_eq_div {a : ι} (h : a ∈ s) : ∏ x ∈ s.erase a, f x = (∏ x ∈ s, f x) / f a

name: prod_range_div
statement:
@[to_additive /
additive group reduces to the difference of the last and first terms. -/]
lemma prod_range_div (f : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) : (∏ i ∈ range n, f (i + 1) / f i) = f n / f 0

name: prod_range_div'
statement:
@[to_additive /
commutative additive group reduces to the difference of the first and last terms. -/]
lemma prod_range_div' (f : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) : (∏ i ∈ range n, f i / f (i + 1)) = f 0 / f n

name: eq_prod_range_div
statement:
@[to_additive /
`0` to `n - 1`. -/]
lemma eq_prod_range_div (f : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) : f n = f 0 * ∏ i ∈ range n, f (i + 1) / f i

name: eq_prod_range_div'
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma eq_prod_range_div' (f : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) :
    f n = ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), if i = 0 then f 0 else f i / f (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [Finset.eq_prod_range_div f]
  simp [Finset.prod_range_succ', mul_comm]

name: prod_range_add_div_prod_range
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_range_add_div_prod_range (f : ℕ → G) (n m : ℕ) :
    (∏ k ∈ range (n + m), f k) / ∏ k ∈ range n, f k = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range m, f (n + k)

name: prod_sdiff_eq_div
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma prod_sdiff_eq_div (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) : ∏ x ∈ s₂ \ s₁, f x = (∏ x ∈ s₂, f x) / ∏ x ∈ s₁, f x

name: prod_sdiff_div_prod_sdiff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_sdiff_div_prod_sdiff :
    (∏ x ∈ s₂ \ s₁, f x) / ∏ x ∈ s₁ \ s₂, f x = (∏ x ∈ s₂, f x) / ∏ x ∈ s₁, f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [← Finset.prod_sdiff (@inf_le_left _ _ s₁ s₂), ← Finset.prod_sdiff (@inf_le_right _ _ s₁ s₂)]

name: sum_range_tsub
statement:
lemma sum_range_tsub {f : ℕ → M} (h : Monotone f) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, (f (i + 1) - f i) = f n - f 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_range_induction
  case base => apply tsub_eq_of_eq_add; rw [zero_add]
  case step =>
    intro n _
    have h₁ : f n ≤ f (n + 1) := h (Nat.le_succ _)
    have h₂ : f 0 ≤ f n := h (Nat.zero_le _)
    rw [tsub_add_eq_add_tsub h₂, add_tsub_cancel_of_le h₁]

name: sum_tsub_distrib
statement:
lemma sum_tsub_distrib (s : Finset ι) {f g : ι → M} (hfg : ∀ x ∈ s, g x ≤ f x) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, (f x - g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, f x - ∑ x ∈ s, g x

name: card_eq_sum_ones
statement: lemma card_eq_sum_ones (s : Finset ι) : #s = ∑ _ ∈ s, 1

name: sum_const_nat
statement: theorem sum_const_nat {m : ℕ} {f : ι → ℕ} (h₁ : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = m) : ∑ x ∈ s, f x = #s * m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, ← sum_const]
  apply sum_congr rfl h₁

name: sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter
statement:
lemma sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (g : ι → κ) : ∑ j ∈ t, #{i ∈ s | g i = j} = #{i ∈ s | g i ∈ t}

name: card_disjiUnion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_disjiUnion (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Finset M) (h) :
    #(s.disjiUnion t h) = ∑ a ∈ s, #(t a)

name: card_biUnion
statement:
theorem card_biUnion [DecidableEq M] {t : ι → Finset M} (h : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint t) :
    #(s.biUnion t) = ∑ u ∈ s, #(t u)
proof: := by simpa using sum_biUnion h (M := ℕ) (f := 1)

name: card_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem card_biUnion_le [DecidableEq M] {s : Finset ι} {t : ι → Finset M} :
    #(s.biUnion t) ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, #(t a)
proof:
:=
  haveI := Classical.decEq ι
  Finset.induction_on s (by simp) fun a s has ih =>
    calc
      #((insert a s).biUnion t) ≤ #(t a) + #(s.biUnion t) := by
        rw [biUnion_insert]; exact card_union_le ..
      _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ insert a s, #(t a) := by grind

name: card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
statement:
theorem card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise [DecidableEq M] {f : ι → M} {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset M}
    (H : (s : Set ι).MapsTo f t) : #s = ∑ b ∈ t, #{a ∈ s | f a = b}

name: card_eq_sum_card_image
statement:
theorem card_eq_sum_card_image [DecidableEq M] (f : ι → M) (s : Finset ι) :
    #s = ∑ b ∈ s.image f, #{a ∈ s | f a = b}

name: prod_of_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_of_injective (e : ι → κ) (he : Injective e) (f : ι → M) (g : κ → M)
    (h' : ∀ i ∉ Set.range e, g i = 1) (h : ∀ i, f i = g (e i)) : ∏ i, f i = ∏ j, g j
proof:
:=
  prod_of_injOn e he.injOn (by simp) (by simpa using h') (fun i _ ↦ h i)

name: prod_fiberwise
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise [DecidableEq κ] (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ j, ∏ i : {i // g i = j}, f i = ∏ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise _ g f]
  congr with j
  exact (prod_subtype _ (by simp) _).symm

name: prod_fiberwise'
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_fiberwise' [DecidableEq κ] (g : ι → κ) (f : κ → M) :
    ∏ j, ∏ _i : {i // g i = j}, f j = ∏ i, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise' _ g f]
  congr with j
  exact (prod_subtype _ (by simp) fun _ ↦ _).symm

name: prod_unique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_unique [Unique ι] (f : ι → M) : ∏ x : ι, f x = f default

name: prod_subsingleton
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] (f : ι → M) (a : ι) : ∏ x : ι, f x = f a
proof:
:= by
  have : Unique ι := uniqueOfSubsingleton a
  rw [prod_unique f, Subsingleton.elim default a]

name: prod_Prop
statement: @[to_additive] theorem prod_Prop (f : Prop → M) : ∏ p, f p = f True * f False

name: prod_subtype_mul_prod_subtype
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_subtype_mul_prod_subtype (p : ι → Prop) (f : ι → M) [DecidablePred p] :
    (∏ i : { x // p x }, f i) * ∏ i : { x // ¬p x }, f i = ∏ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
    let s := { x | p x }.toFinset
    rw [← Finset.prod_subtype s, ← Finset.prod_subtype sᶜ]
    · exact Finset.prod_mul_prod_compl _ _
    · simp [s]
    · simp [s]

name: prod_subset
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma prod_subset {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (h : ∀ i, f i ≠ 1 → i ∈ s) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ i, f i

name: prod_toFinset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_toFinset {M : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [CommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) :
    ∀ {l : List ι} (_hl : l.Nodup), l.toFinset.prod f = (l.map f).prod
  | [], _ => by simp
  | a :: l, hl => by
    let ⟨notMem, hl⟩
proof:
:= List.nodup_cons.mp hl
    simp [Finset.prod_insert (mt List.mem_toFinset.mp notMem), prod_toFinset _ hl]

name: sum_toFinset_count_eq_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_toFinset_count_eq_length [DecidableEq ι] (l : List ι) :
    ∑ a ∈ l.toFinset, l.count a = l.length
proof:
:= by
  simpa [List.map_const'] using (Finset.sum_list_map_count l fun _ => (1 : ℕ)).symm

name: mem_sum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_sum {a : M} {s : Finset ι} {m : ι → Multiset M} :
    a ∈ ∑ i ∈ s, m i ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, a ∈ m i
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with grind

name: prod_map_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_map_prod {α : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {m : Multiset ι} {s : Finset α} {f : ι → α → M} :
    (m.map fun i ↦ ∏ a ∈ s, f i a).prod = ∏ a ∈ s, (m.map fun i ↦ f i a).prod
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => simp [Finset.prod_insert ha, prod_map_mul, ih]

name: toFinset_sum_count_eq
statement: theorem toFinset_sum_count_eq (s : Multiset ι) : ∑ a ∈ s.toFinset, s.count a = card s

name: sum_count_eq_card
statement:
@[simp] lemma sum_count_eq_card {s : Finset ι} {m : Multiset ι} (hms : ∀ a ∈ m, a ∈ s) :
    ∑ a ∈ s, m.count a = card m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toFinset_sum_count_eq, ← Finset.sum_filter_ne_zero]
  congr with a
  simpa using hms a

name: toFinset_sum_count_nsmul_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFinset_sum_count_nsmul_eq (s : Multiset ι) :
    ∑ a ∈ s.toFinset, s.count a • {a} = s

name: exists_smul_of_dvd_count
statement:
theorem exists_smul_of_dvd_count (s : Multiset ι) {k : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ a : ι, a ∈ s → k ∣ Multiset.count a s) : ∃ u : Multiset ι, s = k • u
proof:
:= by
  use ∑ a ∈ s.toFinset, (s.count a / k) • {a}
  have h₂ :
    (∑ x ∈ s.toFinset, k • (count x s / k) • ({x} : Multiset ι)) =
      ∑ x ∈ s.toFinset, count x s • {x} := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    rw [← mul_nsmul', Nat.mul_div_cancel' (h x (mem_toFinset.mp hx))]
  rw [← Finset.sum_nsmul, h₂, toFinset_sum_count_nsmul_eq]

name: prod_sum
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_sum {ι : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ι → Multiset M) (s : Finset ι) :

proof:

name: prod_powerset_insert
statement:
@[to_additive /
subsets of `s`, and over all subsets of `s` to which one adds `x`. -/]
lemma prod_powerset_insert [DecidableEq α] (ha : a ∉ s) (f : Finset α → β) :
    ∏ t ∈ (insert a s).powerset, f t =
      (∏ t ∈ s.powerset, f t) * ∏ t ∈ s.powerset, f (insert a t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerset_insert, prod_union, prod_image]
  · exact insert_erase_invOn.2.injOn.mono fun t ht ↦ notMem_mono (mem_powerset.1 ht) ha
  · aesop (add simp [disjoint_left, insert_subset_iff])

name: prod_powerset_cons
statement:
@[to_additive /
subsets of `s`, and over all subsets of `s` to which one adds `x`. -/]
lemma prod_powerset_cons (ha : a ∉ s) (f : Finset α → β) :
    ∏ t ∈ (s.cons a ha).powerset, f t = (∏ t ∈ s.powerset, f t) *
      ∏ t ∈ s.powerset.attach, f (cons a t <| notMem_mono (mem_powerset.1 t.2) ha)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [cons_eq_insert]
  rw [prod_powerset_insert ha, prod_attach _ fun t ↦ f (insert a t)]

name: prod_powerset
statement:
@[to_additive /
with `#s = k`, for `k = 0, ..., #s` -/]
lemma prod_powerset (s : Finset α) (f : Finset α → β) :
    ∏ t ∈ powerset s, f t = ∏ j ∈ range (#s + 1), ∏ t ∈ powersetCard j s, f t

name: prod_powersetCard
statement:
lemma prod_powersetCard (n : ℕ) (s : Finset α) (f : ℕ → β) :
    ∏ t ∈ powersetCard n s, f #t = f n ^ (#s).choose n
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_eq_pow_card, card_powersetCard]; rintro a ha; rw [(mem_powersetCard.1 ha).2]

name: _root_.Equiv.Perm.prod_comp
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem _root_.Equiv.Perm.prod_comp (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M)

proof:

  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: prod_bij
statement:
@[to_additive /

The difference with `Finset.sum_bij'` is that the bijection is specified as a surjective injection,
rather than by an inverse function.

The difference with `Finset.sum_nbij` is that the bijection is allowed to use membership of the
domain of the sum, rather than being a non-dependent function. -/]
theorem prod_bij (i : ∀ a ∈ s, κ) (hi : ∀ a ha, i a ha ∈ t)
    (i_inj : ∀ a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂, i a₁ ha₁ = i a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂)
    (i_surj : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, i a ha = b) (h : ∀ a ha, f a = g (i a ha)) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ t, g x
proof:
:=
  congr_arg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_eq_map_of_bij_of_nodup f g s.2 t.2 i hi i_inj i_surj h)

name: prod_bij'
statement:
@[to_additive /

The difference with `Finset.sum_bij` is that the bijection is specified with an inverse, rather than
as a surjective injection.

The difference with `Finset.sum_nbij'` is that the bijection and its inverse are allowed to use
membership of the domains of the sums, rather than being non-dependent functions. -/]
theorem prod_bij' (i : ∀ a ∈ s, κ) (j : ∀ a ∈ t, ι) (hi : ∀ a ha, i a ha ∈ t)
    (hj : ∀ a ha, j a ha ∈ s) (left_inv : ∀ a ha, j (i a ha) (hi a ha) = a)
    (right_inv : ∀ a ha, i (j a ha) (hj a ha) = a) (h : ∀ a ha, f a = g (i a ha)) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ t, g x
proof:
:= by
  refine prod_bij i hi (fun a1 h1 a2 h2 eq ↦ ?_) (fun b hb ↦ ⟨_, hj b hb, right_inv b hb⟩) h
  rw [← left_inv a1 h1, ← left_inv a2 h2]
  simp only [eq]

name: prod_nbij
statement:
@[to_additive /

The difference with `Finset.sum_nbij'` is that the bijection is specified as a surjective injection,
rather than by an inverse function.

The difference with `Finset.sum_bij` is that the bijection is a non-dependent function, rather than
being allowed to use membership of the domain of the sum. -/]
lemma prod_nbij (i : ι → κ) (hi : ∀ a ∈ s, i a ∈ t) (i_inj : (s : Set ι).InjOn i)
    (i_surj : (s : Set ι).SurjOn i t) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, f a = g (i a)) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ t, g x
proof:
:=
  prod_bij (fun a _ ↦ i a) hi i_inj (by simpa using! i_surj) h

name: prod_nbij'
statement:
@[to_additive /

The difference with `Finset.sum_nbij` is that the bijection is specified with an inverse, rather
than as a surjective injection.

The difference with `Finset.sum_bij'` is that the bijection and its inverse are non-dependent
functions, rather than being allowed to use membership of the domains of the sums.

The difference with `Finset.sum_equiv` is that bijectivity is only required to hold on the domains
of the sums, rather than on the entire types. -/]
lemma prod_nbij' (i : ι → κ) (j : κ → ι) (hi : ∀ a ∈ s, i a ∈ t) (hj : ∀ a ∈ t, j a ∈ s)
    (left_inv : ∀ a ∈ s, j (i a) = a) (right_inv : ∀ a ∈ t, i (j a) = a)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s, f a = g (i a)) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x = ∏ x ∈ t, g x
proof:
:=
  prod_bij' (fun a _ ↦ i a) (fun b _ ↦ j b) hi hj left_inv right_inv h

name: prod_equiv
statement:
@[to_additive /

See `Fintype.sum_equiv` for the version where `s` and `t` are `univ`. -/]
lemma prod_equiv (e : ι ≃ κ) (hst : ∀ i, i ∈ s ↔ e i ∈ t) (hfg : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = g (e i)) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i = ∏ i ∈ t, g i
proof: := by refine prod_nbij' e e.symm ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hfg <;> simp [hst]

name: prod_hom_rel

theorem prod_hom_rel [CommMonoid N] {r : M → N → Prop} {f : ι → M} {g : ι → N} {s : Finset ι}

proof:
:= by

  apply Multiset.prod_hom_rel <;> assumption

name: prod_mem_multiset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_mem_multiset [DecidableEq ι] (m : Multiset ι) (f : { x // x ∈ m } → M) (g : ι → M)
    (hfg : ∀ x, f x = g x) : ∏ x : { x // x ∈ m }, f x = ∏ x ∈ m.toFinset, g x
proof:
:= by
  refine prod_bij' (fun x _ ↦ x) (fun x hx ↦ ⟨x, Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
    simp [hfg]

name: prod_induction
statement:
@[to_additive /
the property is additive and holds on summands. -/]
theorem prod_induction {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) (p : M → Prop)
    (hom : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b)) (unit : p 1) (base : ∀ x ∈ s, p <| f x) :

name: prod_induction_nonempty
statement:
@[to_additive /
the property is additive and holds on summands. -/]
theorem prod_induction_nonempty {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) (p : M → Prop)
    (hom : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b)) (nonempty : s.Nonempty) (base : ∀ x ∈ s, p <| f x) :
    p <| ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:=
  Multiset.prod_induction_nonempty p hom (by simp [nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp nonempty])
    (Multiset.forall_mem_map_iff.mpr base)

name: disjoint_list_sum_left
statement:
theorem disjoint_list_sum_left {a : Multiset α} {l : List (Multiset α)} :
    Disjoint l.sum a ↔ ∀ b ∈ l, Disjoint b a
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [zero_disjoint, List.not_mem_nil, IsEmpty.forall_iff, forall_const, List.sum_nil]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp [ih]

name: toFinset_prod_dvd_prod
statement:

name: prod_preimage'
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_preimage' (f : ι → κ) [DecidablePred (· ∈ Set.range f)] (s : Finset κ) (hf) (g : κ → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.preimage f hf, g (f x) = ∏ x ∈ s with x ∈ Set.range f, g x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∏ x ∈ preimage s f hf, g (f x) = ∏ x ∈ image f (preimage s f hf), g x :=
      Eq.symm <| prod_image <| by simpa [mem_preimage, Set.InjOn] using hf
    _ = ∏ x ∈ s with x ∈ Set.range f, g x := by rw [image_preimage]

name: prod_preimage
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_preimage (f : ι → κ) (s : Finset κ) (hf) (g : κ → β)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ Set.range f → g x = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.preimage f hf, g (f x) = ∏ x ∈ s, g x
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [prod_preimage', prod_filter_of_ne]; exact fun x hx ↦ Not.imp_symm (hg x hx)

name: prod_preimage_of_bij
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_preimage_of_bij (f : ι → κ) (s : Finset κ) (hf : Set.BijOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑s) ↑s) (g : κ → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s.preimage f hf.injOn, g (f x) = ∏ x ∈ s, g x
proof:
:=
  prod_preimage _ _ hf.injOn g fun _ hs h_f ↦ (h_f <| hf.subset_range hs).elim

name: prod_isUnit
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_isUnit : ∀ {L : List M}, (∀ m ∈ L, IsUnit m) → IsUnit L.prod
  | [], _ => by simp
  | h :: t, u => by
    simp only [List.prod_cons]
    exact IsUnit.mul (u h mem_cons_self) (prod_isUnit fun m mt => u m (mem_cons_of_mem h mt))

@[to_additive]

name: prod_isUnit_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_isUnit_iff {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {L : List M} :
    IsUnit L.prod ↔ ∀ m ∈ L, IsUnit m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, prod_isUnit⟩
  induction L with
  | nil => exact fun m' h' => False.elim (not_mem_nil h')
  | cons m L ih =>
    rw [prod_cons, IsUnit.mul_iff] at h
    exact fun m' h' ↦ Or.elim (eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons h') (fun H => H.substr h.1) fun H => ih h.2 _ H

name: Perm.prod_eq'
statement:
@[to_additive /
depend on the order of elements. -/]
lemma Perm.prod_eq' (h : l₁ ~ l₂) (hc : l₁.Pairwise Commute) : l₁.prod = l₂.prod
proof:
:= by
  have : Std.Symm fun x y ↦ ∀ z : M, y * (x * z) = x * (y * z) := { symm x y h z := h z |>.symm }
  refine h.foldr_eq' (Pairwise.forall_of_forall (fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl) <| hc.imp fun {a b} h z ↦ ?_) 1
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, h]

name: prod_rotate_eq_one_of_prod_eq_one
statement:
lemma prod_rotate_eq_one_of_prod_eq_one :
    ∀ {l : List G} (_ : l.prod = 1) (n : ℕ), (l.rotate n).prod = 1
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | a :: l, hl, n => by
    have : n % List.length (a :: l) ≤ List.length (a :: l)
proof:
:= le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ (by simp))
    rw [← List.take_append_drop (n % List.length (a :: l)) (a :: l)] at hl
    rw [← rotate_mod, rotate_eq_drop_append_take this, List.prod_append, mul_eq_one_iff_inv_eq,
      ← one_mul (List.prod _)⁻¹, ← hl, List.prod_append, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]

name: sum_map_count_dedup_filter_eq_countP
statement:
theorem sum_map_count_dedup_filter_eq_countP (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
    ((l.dedup.filter p).map fun x => l.count x).sum = l.countP p
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as h =>
    simp_rw [List.countP_cons, List.count_cons, List.sum_map_add]
    congr 1
    · refine _root_.trans ?_ h
      by_cases ha : a ∈ as
      · simp [dedup_cons_of_mem ha]
      · simp only [dedup_cons_of_notMem ha, List.filter]
        match p a with
        | true => simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.count_eq_zero.2 ha, zero_add]
        | false => simp only
    · simp only [beq_iff_eq]
      by_cases hp : p a
      · refine _root_.trans (sum_map_eq_nsmul_single a _ fun _ h _ => by simp [h.symm]) ?_
        simp [hp, count_dedup]
      · exact _root_.trans (List.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => by grind) (by simp [hp])

name: sum_map_count_dedup_eq_length
statement:
theorem sum_map_count_dedup_eq_length (l : List α) :
    (l.dedup.map fun x => l.count x).sum = l.length
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sum_map_count_dedup_filter_eq_countP (fun _ => True) l

lemma drop_take_succ_flatten_eq_getElem (L : List (List α)) (i : Nat) (h : i < L.length) :

name: neg_one_mem_of_prod_eq_neg_one
statement: theorem neg_one_mem_of_prod_eq_neg_one {l : List ℤ} (h : l.prod = -1) : (-1 : ℤ) ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, h₁, h₂⟩ := exists_mem_ne_one_of_prod_ne_one (ne_of_eq_of_ne h (by decide))
  exact Or.resolve_left
    (Int.isUnit_iff.mp (prod_isUnit_iff.mp
      (h.symm ▸ ⟨⟨-1, -1, by decide, by decide⟩, rfl⟩ : IsUnit l.prod) x h₁)) h₂ ▸ h₁

name: dvd_prod
statement: theorem dvd_prod [CommMonoid M] {a} {l : List M} (ha : a ∈ l) : a ∣ l.prod
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨s, t, h⟩ := append_of_mem ha
  rw [h, prod_append, prod_cons, mul_left_comm]
  exact dvd_mul_right _ _

proof:

  rw [hl.prod_eq, prod_append]
  exact dvd_mul_right _ _

name: alternatingProd_append
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem alternatingProd_append :
    ∀ l₁ l₂ : List G,
      alternatingProd (l₁ ++ l₂) = alternatingProd l₁ * alternatingProd l₂ ^ (-1 : ℤ) ^ length l₁
  | [], l₂ => by simp
  | a :: l₁, l₂ => by
    simp_rw [cons_append, alternatingProd_cons, alternatingProd_append, length_cons, pow_succ',
      Int.neg_mul, one_mul, zpow_neg, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_div]

@[to_additive]

name: alternatingProd_reverse
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem alternatingProd_reverse :
    ∀ l : List G, alternatingProd (reverse l) = alternatingProd l ^ (-1 : ℤ) ^ (length l + 1)
  | [] => by simp only [alternatingProd_nil, one_zpow, reverse_nil]
  | a :: l => by
    simp_rw [reverse_cons, alternatingProd_append, alternatingProd_reverse,
      alternatingProd_singleton, alternatingProd_cons, length_reverse, length, pow_succ',
      Int.neg_mul, one_mul, zpow_neg, inv_inv]
    rw [mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_zpow]

end Alternating

name: op_list_prod
statement: lemma op_list_prod : ∀ l : List M, op l.prod = (l.map op).reverse.prod
proof:

  intro l; induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.prod_cons, List.map_cons, List.reverse_cons', List.prod_concat, op_mul, ih]

theorem prod_hom_nonempty {l : List M} {F : Type*} [FunLike F M N] [MulHomClass F M N] (f : F)

proof:

theorem prod_hom (l : List M) {F : Type*} [FunLike F M N] [MonoidHomClass F M N] (f : F) :

proof:

name: prod_hom
statement:

theorem prod_hom₂_nonempty {l : List ι} (f : M → N → P)
    (hf : ∀ a b c d, f (a * b) (c * d) = f a c * f b d) (f₁ : ι → M) (f₂ : ι → N) (hl : l ≠ []) :
    (l.map fun i => f (f₁ i) (f₂ i)).prod = f (l.map f₁).prod (l.map f₂).prod
proof:
:= by
  match l, hl with | x :: xs, hl => induction xs generalizing x <;> simp_all

name: prod_hom
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_hom₂ (l : List ι) (f : M → N → P) (hf : ∀ a b c d, f (a * b) (c * d) = f a c * f b d)
    (hf' : f 1 1 = 1) (f₁ : ι → M) (f₂ : ι → N) :
    (l.map fun i => f (f₁ i) (f₂ i)).prod = f (l.map f₁).prod (l.map f₂).prod
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prod_eq_foldr, foldr_map]
  rw [← foldr_hom₂ l f _ _ ((fun x y => f (f₁ x) (f₂ x) * y)) _ _ (by simp [hf]), hf']

name: prod_erase_of_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_erase_of_comm [DecidableEq M] (ha : a ∈ l) (comm : ∀ x ∈ l, ∀ y ∈ l, x * y = y * x) :
    a * (l.erase a).prod = l.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [not_mem_nil] at ha
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain rfl | ⟨ne, h⟩ := List.eq_or_ne_mem_of_mem ha
    · simp only [erase_cons_head, prod_cons]
    rw [List.erase, beq_false_of_ne ne.symm, List.prod_cons, List.prod_cons, ← mul_assoc,
      comm a ha b mem_cons_self, mul_assoc,
      ih h fun x hx y hy ↦ comm _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem b hx) _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem b hy)]

name: prod_map_eq_pow_single
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_map_eq_pow_single [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} (a : α) (f : α → M)
    (hf : ∀ a', a' ≠ a → a' ∈ l → f a' = 1) : (l.map f).prod = f a ^ l.count a
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => rw [map_nil, prod_nil, count_nil, _root_.pow_zero]
  | cons a' as h =>
    specialize h a fun a' ha' hfa' => hf a' ha' (mem_cons_of_mem _ hfa')
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, count_cons, h]
    simp only [beq_iff_eq]
    split_ifs with ha'
    · rw [ha', _root_.pow_succ']
    · rw [hf a' ha' mem_cons_self, one_mul, add_zero]

name: prod_insertIdx
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_insertIdx {i} (hlen : i ≤ l.length) (hcomm : ∀ a' ∈ l.take i, Commute a a') :
    (l.insertIdx i a).prod = a * l.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction i generalizing l
  case zero => rfl
  case succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨hd, tl, rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_length_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hlen)
    simp only [insertIdx_succ_cons, prod_cons,
      ih (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlen) (fun a' a'_mem => hcomm a' (mem_of_mem_tail a'_mem))]
    exact Commute.left_comm (hcomm hd (mem_of_mem_head? rfl)).symm tl.prod

name: mul_prod_eraseIdx
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mul_prod_eraseIdx {i} (hlen : i < l.length) (hcomm : ∀ a' ∈ l.take i, Commute l[i] a') :
    l[i] * (l.eraseIdx i).prod = l.prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_insertIdx (by grind : i ≤ (l.eraseIdx i).length) (fun a' a'_mem =>
      hcomm a' (by rwa [take_eraseIdx_eq_take_of_le l i i (Nat.le_refl i)] at a'_mem)),
    insertIdx_eraseIdx_getElem hlen]

name: prod_filter_bne_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_filter_bne_one [BEq M] [LawfulBEq M] (l : List M) :

name: CommMonoid.prod_insertIdx
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem CommMonoid.prod_insertIdx {i} (h : i ≤ l.length) : (l.insertIdx i a).prod = a * l.prod
proof:
:=
  List.prod_insertIdx h (fun a' _ ↦ Commute.all a a')

name: CommMonoid.mul_prod_eraseIdx
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem CommMonoid.mul_prod_eraseIdx {i} (h : i < l.length) : l[i] * (l.eraseIdx i).prod = l.prod
proof:
:=
  List.mul_prod_eraseIdx h (fun a' _ ↦ Commute.all l[i] a')

name: prod_erase
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma prod_erase [DecidableEq M] (ha : a ∈ l) : a * (l.erase a).prod = l.prod
proof:
:=
  prod_erase_of_comm ha fun x _ y _ ↦ mul_comm x y

name: prod_map_erase
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma prod_map_erase [DecidableEq α] (f : α → M) {a} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, a ∈ l → f a * ((l.erase a).map f).prod = (l.map f).prod
  | b :: l, h => by
    obtain rfl | ⟨ne, h⟩
proof:
:= List.eq_or_ne_mem_of_mem h
    · simp only [map, erase_cons_head, prod_cons]
    · simp only [map, erase_cons_tail (not_beq_of_ne ne.symm), prod_cons, prod_map_erase _ h,
        mul_left_comm (f a) (f b)]

name: Perm.prod_eq
statement: @[to_additive] lemma Perm.prod_eq (h : Perm l₁ l₂) : prod l₁ = prod l₂

name: prod_mul_prod_eq_prod_zipWith_mul_prod_drop
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_mul_prod_eq_prod_zipWith_mul_prod_drop :
    ∀ l l' : List M,
      l.prod * l'.prod =
        (zipWith (· * ·) l l').prod * (l.drop l'.length).prod * (l'.drop l.length).prod
  | [], ys => by simp
  | xs, [] => by simp
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => by
    simp only [zipWith_cons_cons, prod_cons]
    conv =>
      lhs; rw [mul_assoc]; right; rw [mul_comm, mul_assoc]; right
      rw [mul_comm, prod_mul_prod_eq_prod_zipWith_mul_prod_drop xs ys]
    simp [mul_assoc]

@[to_additive]

name: prod_mul_prod_eq_prod_zipWith_of_length_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_mul_prod_eq_prod_zipWith_of_length_eq (l l' : List M) (h : l.length = l'.length) :
    l.prod * l'.prod = (zipWith (· * ·) l l').prod
proof:
:= by
  apply (prod_mul_prod_eq_prod_zipWith_mul_prod_drop l l').trans
  rw [← h, drop_length, h, drop_length, prod_nil, mul_one, mul_one]

name: prod_map_ite
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_map_ite (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f g : α → M) (l : List α) :
    (l.map fun a => if p a then f a else g a).prod =
      ((l.filter p).map f).prod * ((l.filter fun a ↦ ¬p a).map g).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [map_cons, filter_cons, prod_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih]
    clear ih
    by_cases hx : p x
    · simp only [hx, ↓reduceIte, decide_not, decide_true, map_cons, prod_cons, not_true_eq_false,
        decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, mul_assoc]
    · simp only [hx, ↓reduceIte, decide_not, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true,
      decide_true, map_cons, prod_cons, mul_left_comm]

name: prod_map_filter_mul_prod_map_filter_not
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_map_filter_mul_prod_map_filter_not (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : α → M)
    (l : List α) :
