proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, ← lim_neg, lim_add f (-g)]

name: lim_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem lim_eq_zero_iff (f : CauSeq β abv) : lim f = 0 ↔ LimZero f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    have hf := equiv_lim f
    rw [h] at hf
    exact (limZero_congr hf).mpr (const_limZero.mpr rfl),
   fun h => by
    have h₁ : f = f - const abv 0 := ext fun n => by simp
    rw [h₁] at h
    exact lim_eq_of_equiv_const h⟩

name: lim_inv
statement: theorem lim_inv {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf : ¬LimZero f) : lim (inv f hf) = (lim f)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  have hl : lim f ≠ 0 := by rwa [← lim_eq_zero_iff] at hf
  lim_eq_of_equiv_const <|
    show LimZero (inv f hf - const abv (lim f)⁻¹) from
      have h₁ : ∀ (g f : CauSeq β abv) (hf : ¬LimZero f), LimZero (g - f * inv f hf * g) :=
        fun g f hf => by
          have h₂ : g - f * inv f hf * g = 1 * g - f * inv f hf * g := by rw [one_mul g]
          have h₃ : f * inv f hf * g = (f * inv f hf) * g := by simp [mul_assoc]
          have h₄ : g - f * inv f hf * g = (1 - f * inv f hf) * g := by rw [h₂, h₃, ← sub_mul]
          have h₅ : g - f * inv f hf * g = g * (1 - f * inv f hf) := by rw [h₄, mul_comm]
          have h₆ : g - f * inv f hf * g = g * (1 - inv f hf * f) := by rw [h₅, mul_comm f]
          rw [h₆]; exact mul_limZero_right _ (Setoid.symm (CauSeq.inv_mul_cancel _))
      have h₂ :
        LimZero
          (inv f hf - const abv (lim f)⁻¹ -
            (const abv (lim f) - f) * (inv f hf * const abv (lim f)⁻¹)) := by
              rw [sub_mul, ← sub_add, sub_sub, sub_add_eq_sub_sub, sub_right_comm, sub_add]
              change LimZero
                (inv f hf - const abv (lim f) * (inv f hf * const abv (lim f)⁻¹) -
                  (const abv (lim f)⁻¹ - f * (inv f hf * const abv (lim f)⁻¹)))
              exact sub_limZero
                (by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm, const_inv hl]; exact h₁ _ _ _)
                (by rw [← mul_assoc]; exact h₁ _ _ _)
      (limZero_congr h₂).mpr <| mul_limZero_left _ (Setoid.symm (equiv_lim f))

name: rat_add_continuous_lemma
statement:
theorem rat_add_continuous_lemma {ε : α} (ε0 : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : β}, abv (a₁ - b₁) < δ → abv (a₂ - b₂) < δ →
      abv (a₁ + a₂ - (b₁ + b₂)) < ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨ε / 2, half_pos ε0, fun {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂} h₁ h₂ => by
    grw [add_sub_add_comm, abv_add abv, h₁, h₂, add_halves]⟩

name: rat_mul_continuous_lemma
statement:
theorem rat_mul_continuous_lemma {ε K₁ K₂ : α} (ε0 : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : β}, abv a₁ < K₁ → abv b₂ < K₂ → abv (a₁ - b₁) < δ →
      abv (a₂ - b₂) < δ → abv (a₁ * a₂ - b₁ * b₂) < ε
proof:
:= by
  have K0 : (0 : α) < max 1 (max K₁ K₂) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  have εK := div_pos (half_pos ε0) K0
  refine ⟨_, εK, fun {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂} ha₁ hb₂ h₁ h₂ => ?_⟩
  replace ha₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha₁ (le_trans (le_max_left _ K₂) (le_max_right 1 _))
  replace hb₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hb₂ (le_trans (le_max_right K₁ _) (le_max_right 1 _))
  set M := max 1 (max K₁ K₂)
  suffices abv ((a₁ - b₁) * b₂ + a₁ * (a₂ - b₂)) < ε by
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, mul_add, add_mul, add_left_comm] using this
  grw [abv_add abv, abv_mul abv, abv_mul abv, h₁.le, h₂.le, ha₁, hb₂, mul_comm M,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt K0), add_halves]

name: rat_inv_continuous_lemma
statement:
theorem rat_inv_continuous_lemma {β : Type*} [DivisionRing β] (abv : β → α) [IsAbsoluteValue abv]
    {ε K : α} (ε0 : 0 < ε) (K0 : 0 < K) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ {a b : β}, K ≤ abv a → K ≤ abv b → abv (a - b) < δ → abv (a⁻¹ - b⁻¹) < ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨K * ε * K, mul_pos (mul_pos K0 ε0) K0, fun {a b} ha hb h => ?_⟩
  have a0 := K0.trans_le ha
  have b0 := K0.trans_le hb
  rw [inv_sub_inv' ((abv_pos abv).1 a0) ((abv_pos abv).1 b0), abv_mul abv, abv_mul abv, abv_inv abv,
    abv_inv abv, abv_sub abv]
  grw [← ha, mul_assoc, ← hb, h]
  simp [K0.ne']

name: cauchy
statement:
theorem cauchy₂ (hf : IsCauSeq abv f) {ε : α} (ε0 : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, ∀ k ≥ i, abv (f j - f k) < ε
proof:
:= by
  refine (hf _ (half_pos ε0)).imp fun i hi j ij k ik => ?_
  rw [← add_halves ε]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_sub_le abv _ _ _) (add_lt_add (hi _ ij) ?_)
  rw [abv_sub abv]; exact hi _ ik

name: cauchy
statement:
theorem cauchy₃ (hf : IsCauSeq abv f) {ε : α} (ε0 : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, ∀ k ≥ j, abv (f k - f j) < ε
proof:
:=
  let ⟨i, H⟩ := hf.cauchy₂ ε0
  ⟨i, fun _ ij _ jk => H _ (le_trans ij jk) _ ij⟩

name: bounded
statement: lemma bounded (hf : IsCauSeq abv f) : ∃ r, ∀ i, abv (f i) < r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, h⟩ := hf _ zero_lt_one
  set R : ℕ → α := @Nat.rec (fun _ => α) (abv (f 0)) fun i c => max c (abv (f i.succ)) with hR
  have : ∀ i, ∀ j ≤ i, abv (f j) ≤ R i := by
    refine Nat.rec (by simp [hR]) ?_
    rintro i hi j (rfl | hj)
    · simp [R]
    · exact (hi j hj).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨R i + 1, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain hji | hij := le_total j i
  · exact (this i _ hji).trans_lt (lt_add_one _)
  · simpa using (abv_add abv _ _).trans_lt <| add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (this i _ le_rfl) (h _ hij)

name: bounded'
statement: lemma bounded' (hf : IsCauSeq abv f) (x : α) : ∃ r > x, ∀ i, abv (f i) < r
proof:
:=
  let ⟨r, h⟩ := hf.bounded
  ⟨max r (x + 1), (lt_add_one x).trans_le (le_max_right _ _),
    fun i ↦ (h i).trans_le (le_max_left _ _)⟩

name: const
statement: lemma const (x : β) : IsCauSeq abv fun _ ↦ x
proof:
:=
  fun ε ε0 ↦ ⟨0, fun j _ => by simpa [abv_zero] using ε0⟩

name: add
statement: theorem add (hf : IsCauSeq abv f) (hg : IsCauSeq abv g) : IsCauSeq abv (f + g)
proof:
:= fun _ ε0 =>
  let ⟨_, δ0, Hδ⟩ := rat_add_continuous_lemma abv ε0
  let ⟨i, H⟩ := exists_forall_ge_and (hf.cauchy₃ δ0) (hg.cauchy₃ δ0)
  ⟨i, fun _ ij =>
    let ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ := H _ le_rfl
    Hδ (H₁ _ ij) (H₂ _ ij)⟩

name: mul
statement: lemma mul (hf : IsCauSeq abv f) (hg : IsCauSeq abv g) : IsCauSeq abv (f * g)
proof:
:= fun _ ε0 =>
  let ⟨_, _, hF⟩ := hf.bounded' 0
  let ⟨_, _, hG⟩ := hg.bounded' 0
  let ⟨_, δ0, Hδ⟩ := rat_mul_continuous_lemma abv ε0
  let ⟨i, H⟩ := exists_forall_ge_and (hf.cauchy₃ δ0) (hg.cauchy₃ δ0)
  ⟨i, fun j ij =>
    let ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ := H _ le_rfl
    Hδ (hF j) (hG i) (H₁ _ ij) (H₂ _ ij)⟩

name: _root_.isCauSeq_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma _root_.isCauSeq_neg : IsCauSeq abv (-f) ↔ IsCauSeq abv f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsCauSeq, Pi.neg_apply, ← neg_sub', abv_neg]

name: add_limZero
statement:
theorem add_limZero {f g : CauSeq β abv} (hf : LimZero f) (hg : LimZero g) : LimZero (f + g)
  | ε, ε0 =>
    (exists_forall_ge_and (hf _ <| half_pos ε0) (hg _ <| half_pos ε0)).imp fun _ H j ij => by
      let ⟨H₁, H₂⟩
proof:
:= H _ ij
      simpa [add_halves ε] using lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_add abv _ _) (add_lt_add H₁ H₂)

name: mul_limZero_right
statement:
theorem mul_limZero_right (f : CauSeq β abv) {g} (hg : LimZero g) : LimZero (f * g)
  | ε, ε0 =>
    let ⟨F, F0, hF⟩
proof:
:= f.bounded' 0
    (hg _ <| div_pos ε0 F0).imp fun _ H j ij => by
      have := mul_lt_mul' (le_of_lt <| hF j) (H _ ij) (abv_nonneg abv _) F0
      rwa [mul_comm F, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt F0), ← abv_mul] at this

name: mul_limZero_left
statement:
theorem mul_limZero_left {f} (g : CauSeq β abv) (hg : LimZero f) : LimZero (f * g)
  | ε, ε0 =>
    let ⟨G, G0, hG⟩
proof:
:= g.bounded' 0
    (hg _ <| div_pos ε0 G0).imp fun _ H j ij => by
      have := mul_lt_mul'' (H _ ij) (hG j) (abv_nonneg abv _) (abv_nonneg abv _)
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt G0), ← abv_mul] at this

name: neg_limZero
statement: theorem neg_limZero {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf : LimZero f) : LimZero (-f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_mul f]
  exact mul_limZero_right _ hf

name: sub_limZero
statement: theorem sub_limZero {f g : CauSeq β abv} (hf : LimZero f) (hg : LimZero g) : LimZero (f - g)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using add_limZero hf (neg_limZero hg)

name: limZero_sub_rev
statement: theorem limZero_sub_rev {f g : CauSeq β abv} (hfg : LimZero (f - g)) : LimZero (g - f)

name: zero_limZero
statement:
theorem zero_limZero : LimZero (0 : CauSeq β abv)
  | ε, ε0 => ⟨0, fun j _ => by simpa [abv_zero abv] using ε0⟩

name: const_limZero
statement: theorem const_limZero {x : β} : LimZero (const x) ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H =>
    (abv_eq_zero abv).1 <|
      (eq_of_le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense (abv_nonneg abv _)) fun _ ε0 =>
        let ⟨_, hi⟩ := H _ ε0
        le_of_lt <| hi _ le_rfl,
    fun e => e.symm ▸ zero_limZero⟩

name: add_equiv_add
statement:
theorem add_equiv_add {f1 f2 g1 g2 : CauSeq β abv} (hf : f1 ≈ f2) (hg : g1 ≈ g2) :
    f1 + g1 ≈ f2 + g2
proof: := by simpa only [← add_sub_add_comm] using! add_limZero hf hg

name: neg_equiv_neg
statement: theorem neg_equiv_neg {f g : CauSeq β abv} (hf : f ≈ g) : -f ≈ -g
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_sub'] using! neg_limZero hf

name: sub_equiv_sub
statement:
theorem sub_equiv_sub {f1 f2 g1 g2 : CauSeq β abv} (hf : f1 ≈ f2) (hg : g1 ≈ g2) :
    f1 - g1 ≈ f2 - g2
proof: := by simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using add_equiv_add hf (neg_equiv_neg hg)

name: equiv_def
statement:
theorem equiv_def₃ {f g : CauSeq β abv} (h : f ≈ g) {ε : α} (ε0 : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, ∀ k ≥ j, abv (f k - g j) < ε
proof:
:=
  (exists_forall_ge_and (h _ <| half_pos ε0) (f.cauchy₃ <| half_pos ε0)).imp fun _ H j ij k jk => by
    let ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := H _ ij
    have := lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_add abv (f j - g j) _) (add_lt_add h₁ (h₂ _ jk))
    rwa [sub_add_sub_cancel', add_halves] at this

name: limZero_congr
statement: theorem limZero_congr {f g : CauSeq β abv} (h : f ≈ g) : LimZero f ↔ LimZero g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun l => by simpa using add_limZero (Setoid.symm h) l, fun l => by simpa using add_limZero h l⟩

name: abv_pos_of_not_limZero
statement:
theorem abv_pos_of_not_limZero {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf : ¬LimZero f) :
    ∃ K > 0, ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, K ≤ abv (f j)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra nk
  refine hf fun ε ε0 => ?_
  simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_le] at nk
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := f.cauchy₃ (half_pos ε0)
  rcases nk _ (half_pos ε0) i with ⟨j, ij, hj⟩
  refine ⟨j, fun k jk => ?_⟩
  have := lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_add abv _ _) (add_lt_add (hi j ij k jk) hj)
  rwa [sub_add_cancel, add_halves] at this

name: of_near
statement:
theorem of_near (f : ℕ → β) (g : CauSeq β abv) (h : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, abv (f j - g j) < ε) :
    IsCauSeq abv f
  | ε, ε0 =>
    let ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= exists_forall_ge_and (h _ (half_pos <| half_pos ε0)) (g.cauchy₃ <| half_pos ε0)
    ⟨i, fun j ij => by
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hi _ le_rfl; rw [abv_sub abv] at h₁
      have := lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_add abv _ _) (add_lt_add (hi _ ij).1 h₁)
      have := lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_add abv _ _) (add_lt_add this (h₂ _ ij))
      rwa [add_halves, add_halves, add_right_comm, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_add_sub_cancel] at this⟩

name: not_limZero_of_not_congr_zero
statement: theorem not_limZero_of_not_congr_zero {f : CauSeq _ abv} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) : ¬LimZero f
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : LimZero (f - 0) := by simp [h]
  exact hf this

name: mul_equiv_zero
statement: theorem mul_equiv_zero (g : CauSeq _ abv) {f : CauSeq _ abv} (hf : f ≈ 0) : g * f ≈ 0
proof:
:=
  have : LimZero (f - 0) := hf
  have : LimZero (g * f) := mul_limZero_right _ <| by simpa
  show LimZero (g * f - 0) by simpa

name: mul_equiv_zero'
statement: theorem mul_equiv_zero' (g : CauSeq _ abv) {f : CauSeq _ abv} (hf : f ≈ 0) : f * g ≈ 0
proof:
:=
  have : LimZero (f - 0) := hf
  have : LimZero (f * g) := mul_limZero_left _ <| by simpa
  show LimZero (f * g - 0) by simpa

name: mul_not_equiv_zero
statement: theorem mul_not_equiv_zero {f g : CauSeq _ abv} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (hg : ¬g ≈ 0) : ¬f * g ≈ 0
proof:
:=
  fun (this : LimZero (f * g - 0)) => by
  have hlz : LimZero (f * g) := by simpa
  have hf' : ¬LimZero f := by simpa using show ¬LimZero (f - 0) from hf
  have hg' : ¬LimZero g := by simpa using show ¬LimZero (g - 0) from hg
  rcases abv_pos_of_not_limZero hf' with ⟨a1, ha1, N1, hN1⟩
  rcases abv_pos_of_not_limZero hg' with ⟨a2, ha2, N2, hN2⟩
  have : 0 < a1 * a2 := mul_pos ha1 ha2
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hlz _ this
  let i := max N (max N1 N2)
  have hN' := hN i (le_max_left _ _)
  have hN1' := hN1 i (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hN1' := hN2 i (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  apply not_le_of_gt hN'
  change _ ≤ abv (_ * _)
  rw [abv_mul abv]
  gcongr

name: const_equiv
statement: theorem const_equiv {x y : β} : const x ≈ const y ↔ x = y
proof:
:=
  show LimZero _ ↔ _ by rw [← const_sub, const_limZero, sub_eq_zero]

name: mul_equiv_mul
statement:
theorem mul_equiv_mul {f1 f2 g1 g2 : CauSeq β abv} (hf : f1 ≈ f2) (hg : g1 ≈ g2) :
    f1 * g1 ≈ f2 * g2

name: smul_equiv_smul
statement:
theorem smul_equiv_smul {G : Type*} [SMul G β] [IsScalarTower G β β] {f1 f2 : CauSeq β abv} (c : G)
    (hf : f1 ≈ f2) : c • f1 ≈ c • f2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [const_smul, smul_one_mul _ _] using
    mul_equiv_mul (const_equiv.mpr <| Eq.refl <| c • (1 : β)) hf

name: pow_equiv_pow
statement: theorem pow_equiv_pow {f1 f2 : CauSeq β abv} (hf : f1 ≈ f2) (n : ℕ) : f1 ^ n ≈ f2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Setoid.refl]
  | succ n ih => simpa only [pow_succ'] using mul_equiv_mul hf ih

name: one_not_equiv_zero
statement: theorem one_not_equiv_zero : ¬const abv 1 ≈ const abv 0
proof:
:= fun h =>
  have : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ i, ∀ k, i ≤ k → abv (1 - 0) < ε := h
  have h1 : abv 1 ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_not_gt fun h2 : 0 < abv 1 =>
      (Exists.elim (this _ h2)) fun i hi => lt_irrefl (abv 1) <| by simpa using hi _ le_rfl
  have h2 : 0 ≤ abv 1 := abv_nonneg abv _
  have : abv 1 = 0 := le_antisymm h1 h2
  have : (1 : β) = 0 := (abv_eq_zero abv).mp this
  absurd this one_ne_zero

name: inv_aux
statement:
theorem inv_aux {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf : ¬LimZero f) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, abv ((f j)⁻¹ - (f i)⁻¹) < ε
  | _, ε0 =>
    let ⟨_, K0, HK⟩
proof:
:= abv_pos_of_not_limZero hf
    let ⟨_, δ0, Hδ⟩ := rat_inv_continuous_lemma abv ε0 K0
    let ⟨i, H⟩ := exists_forall_ge_and HK (f.cauchy₃ δ0)
    ⟨i, fun _ ij =>
      let ⟨iK, H'⟩ := H _ le_rfl
      Hδ (H _ ij).1 iK (H' _ ij)⟩

name: coe_inv
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_inv {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf) : ⇑(inv f hf) = (f : ℕ → β)⁻¹

name: inv_apply
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem inv_apply {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf i) : inv f hf i = (f i)⁻¹

name: inv_mul_cancel
statement: theorem inv_mul_cancel {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf) : inv f hf * f ≈ 1
proof:
:= fun ε ε0 =>
  let ⟨K, K0, i, H⟩ := abv_pos_of_not_limZero hf
  ⟨i, fun j ij => by simpa [(abv_pos abv).1 (lt_of_lt_of_le K0 (H _ ij)), abv_zero abv] using ε0⟩

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement: theorem mul_inv_cancel {f : CauSeq β abv} (hf) : f * inv f hf ≈ 1
proof:
:= fun ε ε0 =>
  let ⟨K, K0, i, H⟩ := abv_pos_of_not_limZero hf
  ⟨i, fun j ij => by simpa [(abv_pos abv).1 (lt_of_lt_of_le K0 (H _ ij)), abv_zero abv] using ε0⟩

name: const_inv
statement:
theorem const_inv {x : β} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    const abv x⁻¹ = inv (const abv x) (by rwa [const_limZero])

name: not_limZero_of_pos
statement:
theorem not_limZero_of_pos {f : CauSeq α abs} : Pos f → ¬LimZero f
  | ⟨_, F0, hF⟩, H =>
    let ⟨_, h⟩
proof:
:= exists_forall_ge_and hF (H _ F0)
    let ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h _ le_rfl
    not_lt_of_ge h₁ (abs_lt.1 h₂).2

name: const_pos
statement: theorem const_pos {x : α} : Pos (const x) ↔ 0 < x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, K0, _, h⟩ => lt_of_lt_of_le K0 (h _ le_rfl), fun h => ⟨x, h, 0, fun _ _ => le_rfl⟩⟩

name: add_pos
statement:
theorem add_pos {f g : CauSeq α abs} : Pos f → Pos g → Pos (f + g)
  | ⟨_, F0, hF⟩, ⟨_, G0, hG⟩ =>
    let ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= exists_forall_ge_and hF hG
    ⟨_, _root_.add_pos F0 G0, i, fun _ ij =>
      let ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h _ ij
      add_le_add h₁ h₂⟩

name: pos_add_limZero
statement:
theorem pos_add_limZero {f g : CauSeq α abs} : Pos f → LimZero g → Pos (f + g)
  | ⟨F, F0, hF⟩, H =>
    let ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= exists_forall_ge_and hF (H _ (half_pos F0))
    ⟨_, half_pos F0, i, fun j ij => by
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h j ij
      have := add_le_add h₁ (le_of_lt (abs_lt.1 h₂).1)
      rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_self_div_two] at this⟩

name: mul_pos
statement:
protected theorem mul_pos {f g : CauSeq α abs} : Pos f → Pos g → Pos (f * g)
  | ⟨_, F0, hF⟩, ⟨_, G0, hG⟩ =>
    let ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= exists_forall_ge_and hF hG
    ⟨_, mul_pos F0 G0, i, fun _ ij =>
      let ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h _ ij
      mul_le_mul h₁ h₂ (le_of_lt G0) (le_trans (le_of_lt F0) h₁)⟩

name: trichotomy
statement: theorem trichotomy (f : CauSeq α abs) : Pos f ∨ LimZero f ∨ Pos (-f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Classical.em (LimZero f) with h | h
  · simp [*]
  simp only [false_or, h]
  rcases abv_pos_of_not_limZero h with ⟨K, K0, hK⟩
  rcases exists_forall_ge_and hK (f.cauchy₃ K0) with ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine (le_total 0 (f i)).imp ?_ ?_ <;>
    refine fun h => ⟨K, K0, i, fun j ij => ?_⟩ <;>
    have := (hi _ ij).1 <;>
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hi _ le_rfl
  · rwa [abs_of_nonneg] at this
    rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at h₁
    exact
      (le_add_iff_nonneg_right _).1
        (le_trans h₁ <| neg_le_sub_iff_le_add'.1 <| le_of_lt (abs_lt.1 <| h₂ _ ij).1)
  · rwa [abs_of_nonpos] at this
    rw [abs_of_nonpos h] at h₁
    rw [← sub_le_sub_iff_right, zero_sub]
    exact le_trans (le_of_lt (abs_lt.1 <| h₂ _ ij).2) h₁

name: lt_of_lt_of_eq
statement: theorem lt_of_lt_of_eq {f g h : CauSeq α abs} (fg : f < g) (gh : g ≈ h) : f < h
proof:
:=
  show Pos (h - f) by
    convert pos_add_limZero fg (neg_limZero gh)
    simp

name: lt_of_eq_of_lt
statement: theorem lt_of_eq_of_lt {f g h : CauSeq α abs} (fg : f ≈ g) (gh : g < h) : f < h
proof:
:= by
  have := pos_add_limZero gh (neg_limZero fg)
  rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] at this

name: lt_trans
statement: theorem lt_trans {f g h : CauSeq α abs} (fg : f < g) (gh : g < h) : f < h
proof:
:=
  show Pos (h - f) by
    convert add_pos fg gh
    simp

name: lt_irrefl
statement:
theorem lt_irrefl {f : CauSeq α abs} : ¬f < f
  | h => not_limZero_of_pos h (by simp [zero_limZero])

name: le_of_eq_of_le
statement: theorem le_of_eq_of_le {f g h : CauSeq α abs} (hfg : f ≈ g) (hgh : g ≤ h) : f ≤ h

name: le_of_le_of_eq
statement: theorem le_of_le_of_eq {f g h : CauSeq α abs} (hfg : f ≤ g) (hgh : g ≈ h) : f ≤ h
proof:
:=
  hfg.elim (fun h => Or.inl (CauSeq.lt_of_lt_of_eq h hgh)) fun h => Or.inr (Setoid.trans h hgh)

name: le_antisymm
statement: theorem le_antisymm {f g : CauSeq α abs} (fg : f ≤ g) (gf : g ≤ f) : f ≈ g

name: lt_total
statement: theorem lt_total (f g : CauSeq α abs) : f < g ∨ f ≈ g ∨ g < f
proof:
:=
  (trichotomy (g - f)).imp_right fun h =>
    h.imp (fun h => Setoid.symm h) fun h => by rwa [neg_sub] at h

name: le_total
statement: theorem le_total (f g : CauSeq α abs) : f ≤ g ∨ g ≤ f

name: const_lt
statement: theorem const_lt {x y : α} : const x < const y ↔ x < y
proof:
:=
  show Pos _ ↔ _ by rw [← const_sub, const_pos, sub_pos]

name: const_le
statement: theorem const_le {x y : α} : const x ≤ const y ↔ x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq]; exact or_congr const_lt const_equiv

name: le_of_exists
statement: theorem le_of_exists {f g : CauSeq α abs} (h : ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, f j ≤ g j) : f ≤ g
proof:
:=
  let ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
  (or_assoc.2 (CauSeq.lt_total f g)).elim id fun hgf =>
    False.elim
      (let ⟨_, hK0, j, hKj⟩ := hgf
      not_lt_of_ge (hi (max i j) (le_max_left _ _))
        (sub_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hK0 (hKj _ (le_max_right _ _)))))

name: exists_gt
statement: theorem exists_gt (f : CauSeq α abs) : ∃ a : α, f < const a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨K, H⟩ := f.bounded
  ⟨K + 1, 1, zero_lt_one, 0, fun i _ => by
    rw [sub_apply, const_apply, le_sub_iff_add_le', add_le_add_iff_right]
    exact le_of_lt (abs_lt.1 (H _)).2⟩

name: exists_lt
statement: theorem exists_lt (f : CauSeq α abs) : ∃ a : α, const a < f
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, h⟩ := (-f).exists_gt
  ⟨-a, show Pos _ by rwa [const_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm, ← sub_neg_eq_add]⟩

name: rat_sup_continuous_lemma
statement:
theorem rat_sup_continuous_lemma {ε : α} {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : α} :
    abs (a₁ - b₁) < ε → abs (a₂ - b₂) < ε → abs (a₁ ⊔ a₂ - b₁ ⊔ b₂) < ε

name: rat_inf_continuous_lemma
statement:
theorem rat_inf_continuous_lemma {ε : α} {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : α} :
    abs (a₁ - b₁) < ε → abs (a₂ - b₂) < ε → abs (a₁ ⊓ a₂ - b₁ ⊓ b₂) < ε

name: coe_sup
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sup (f g : CauSeq α abs) : ⇑(f ⊔ g) = (f : ℕ → α) ⊔ g

name: coe_inf
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_inf (f g : CauSeq α abs) : ⇑(f ⊓ g) = (f : ℕ → α) ⊓ g

name: sup_limZero
statement:
theorem sup_limZero {f g : CauSeq α abs} (hf : LimZero f) (hg : LimZero g) : LimZero (f ⊔ g)
  | ε, ε0 =>
    (exists_forall_ge_and (hf _ ε0) (hg _ ε0)).imp fun _ H j ij => by
      let ⟨H₁, H₂⟩
proof:
:= H _ ij
      rw [abs_lt] at H₁ H₂ ⊢
      exact ⟨lt_sup_iff.mpr (Or.inl H₁.1), sup_lt_iff.mpr ⟨H₁.2, H₂.2⟩⟩

name: inf_limZero
statement:
theorem inf_limZero {f g : CauSeq α abs} (hf : LimZero f) (hg : LimZero g) : LimZero (f ⊓ g)
  | ε, ε0 =>
    (exists_forall_ge_and (hf _ ε0) (hg _ ε0)).imp fun _ H j ij => by
      let ⟨H₁, H₂⟩
proof:
:= H _ ij
      rw [abs_lt] at H₁ H₂ ⊢
      exact ⟨lt_inf_iff.mpr ⟨H₁.1, H₂.1⟩, inf_lt_iff.mpr (Or.inl H₁.2)⟩

name: sup_equiv_sup
statement:
theorem sup_equiv_sup {a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : CauSeq α abs} (ha : a₁ ≈ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≈ b₂) :
    a₁ ⊔ b₁ ≈ a₂ ⊔ b₂
proof:
:= by
  intro ε ε0
  obtain ⟨ai, hai⟩ := ha ε ε0
  obtain ⟨bi, hbi⟩ := hb ε ε0
  exact
    ⟨ai ⊔ bi, fun i hi =>
      (abs_max_sub_max_le_max (a₁ i) (b₁ i) (a₂ i) (b₂ i)).trans_lt
        (max_lt (hai i (sup_le_iff.mp hi).1) (hbi i (sup_le_iff.mp hi).2))⟩

name: inf_equiv_inf
statement:
theorem inf_equiv_inf {a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : CauSeq α abs} (ha : a₁ ≈ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≈ b₂) :
    a₁ ⊓ b₁ ≈ a₂ ⊓ b₂
proof:
:= by
  intro ε ε0
  obtain ⟨ai, hai⟩ := ha ε ε0
  obtain ⟨bi, hbi⟩ := hb ε ε0
  exact
    ⟨ai ⊔ bi, fun i hi =>
      (abs_min_sub_min_le_max (a₁ i) (b₁ i) (a₂ i) (b₂ i)).trans_lt
        (max_lt (hai i (sup_le_iff.mp hi).1) (hbi i (sup_le_iff.mp hi).2))⟩

name: sup_lt
statement: protected theorem sup_lt {a b c : CauSeq α abs} (ha : a < c) (hb : b < c) : a ⊔ b < c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨εa, εa0, ia, ha⟩, ⟨εb, εb0, ib, hb⟩⟩ := ha, hb
  refine ⟨εa ⊓ εb, lt_inf_iff.mpr ⟨εa0, εb0⟩, ia ⊔ ib, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := min_le_min (ha _ (sup_le_iff.mp hi).1) (hb _ (sup_le_iff.mp hi).2)
  exact this.trans_eq (min_sub_sub_left _ _ _)

name: lt_inf
statement: protected theorem lt_inf {a b c : CauSeq α abs} (hb : a < b) (hc : a < c) : a < b ⊓ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨εb, εb0, ib, hb⟩, ⟨εc, εc0, ic, hc⟩⟩ := hb, hc
  refine ⟨εb ⊓ εc, lt_inf_iff.mpr ⟨εb0, εc0⟩, ib ⊔ ic, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := min_le_min (hb _ (sup_le_iff.mp hi).1) (hc _ (sup_le_iff.mp hi).2)
  exact this.trans_eq (min_sub_sub_right _ _ _)

name: sup_idem
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem sup_idem (a : CauSeq α abs) : a ⊔ a = a

name: inf_idem
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem inf_idem (a : CauSeq α abs) : a ⊓ a = a

name: sup_comm
statement: protected theorem sup_comm (a b : CauSeq α abs) : a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a

name: inf_comm
statement: protected theorem inf_comm (a b : CauSeq α abs) : a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a

name: sup_eq_right
statement: protected theorem sup_eq_right {a b : CauSeq α abs} (h : a ≤ b) : a ⊔ b ≈ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, ε0 : _ < _, i, h⟩ | h := h
  · intro _ _
    refine ⟨i, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [← max_sub_sub_right]
    rwa [sub_self, max_eq_right, abs_zero]
    rw [sub_nonpos, ← sub_nonneg]
    exact ε0.le.trans (h _ hj)
  · refine Setoid.trans (sup_equiv_sup h (Setoid.refl _)) ?_
    rw [CauSeq.sup_idem]

name: inf_eq_right
statement: protected theorem inf_eq_right {a b : CauSeq α abs} (h : b ≤ a) : a ⊓ b ≈ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, ε0 : _ < _, i, h⟩ | h := h
  · intro _ _
    refine ⟨i, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [← min_sub_sub_right]
    rwa [sub_self, min_eq_right, abs_zero]
    exact ε0.le.trans (h _ hj)
  · refine Setoid.trans (inf_equiv_inf (Setoid.symm h) (Setoid.refl _)) ?_
    rw [CauSeq.inf_idem]

name: sup_eq_left
statement: protected theorem sup_eq_left {a b : CauSeq α abs} (h : b ≤ a) : a ⊔ b ≈ a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [CauSeq.sup_comm] using CauSeq.sup_eq_right h

name: inf_eq_left
statement: protected theorem inf_eq_left {a b : CauSeq α abs} (h : a ≤ b) : a ⊓ b ≈ a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [CauSeq.inf_comm] using CauSeq.inf_eq_right h

name: le_sup_left
statement: protected theorem le_sup_left {a b : CauSeq α abs} : a ≤ a ⊔ b

name: inf_le_left
statement: protected theorem inf_le_left {a b : CauSeq α abs} : a ⊓ b ≤ a

name: le_sup_right
statement: protected theorem le_sup_right {a b : CauSeq α abs} : b ≤ a ⊔ b

name: inf_le_right
statement: protected theorem inf_le_right {a b : CauSeq α abs} : a ⊓ b ≤ b

name: sup_le
statement: protected theorem sup_le {a b c : CauSeq α abs} (ha : a ≤ c) (hb : b ≤ c) : a ⊔ b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ha | ha := ha
  · obtain hb | hb := hb
    · exact Or.inl (CauSeq.sup_lt ha hb)
    · replace ha := le_of_le_of_eq ha.le (Setoid.symm hb)
      refine le_of_le_of_eq (Or.inr ?_) hb
      exact CauSeq.sup_eq_right ha
  · replace hb := le_of_le_of_eq hb (Setoid.symm ha)
    refine le_of_le_of_eq (Or.inr ?_) ha
    exact CauSeq.sup_eq_left hb

name: le_inf
statement: protected theorem le_inf {a b c : CauSeq α abs} (hb : a ≤ b) (hc : a ≤ c) : a ≤ b ⊓ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb := hb
  · obtain hc | hc := hc
    · exact Or.inl (CauSeq.lt_inf hb hc)
    · replace hb := le_of_eq_of_le (Setoid.symm hc) hb.le
      refine le_of_eq_of_le hc (Or.inr ?_)
      exact Setoid.symm (CauSeq.inf_eq_right hb)
  · replace hc := le_of_eq_of_le (Setoid.symm hb) hc
    refine le_of_eq_of_le hb (Or.inr ?_)
    exact Setoid.symm (CauSeq.inf_eq_left hc)

name: sup_inf_distrib_left
statement: protected theorem sup_inf_distrib_left (a b c : CauSeq α abs) : a ⊔ b ⊓ c = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c)

name: sup_inf_distrib_right
statement: protected theorem sup_inf_distrib_right (a b c : CauSeq α abs) : a ⊓ b ⊔ c = (a ⊔ c) ⊓ (b ⊔ c)

name: of_abv_le
statement:
lemma of_abv_le (n : ℕ) (hm : ∀ m, n ≤ m → abv (f m) ≤ a m) :
    IsCauSeq abs (fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, a i) → IsCauSeq abv fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, f i
proof:
:= by
  intro hg ε ε0
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hg (ε / 2) (div_pos ε0 (by simp))
  exists max n i
  intro j ji
  have hi₁ := hi j (le_trans (le_max_right n i) ji)
  have hi₂ := hi (max n i) (le_max_right n i)
  have sub_le :=
    abs_sub_le (∑ k ∈ range j, a k) (∑ k ∈ range i, a k) (∑ k ∈ range (max n i), a k)
  have := add_lt_add hi₁ hi₂
  rw [abs_sub_comm (∑ k ∈ range (max n i), a k), add_halves ε] at this
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_trans ?_ (le_abs_self _)) sub_le) this
  generalize hk : j - max n i = k
  clear this hi₂ hi₁ hi ε0 ε hg sub_le
  rw [tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le ji] at hk
  rw [hk]
  dsimp only
  clear hk ji j
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [abv_zero abv]
  | succ k hi =>
    simp only [Nat.succ_add, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Finset.sum_range_succ_comm]
    simp only [add_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg] at hi
    grw [abv_add abv, hm _ (by omega), hi]

name: of_abv
statement:
lemma of_abv (hf : IsCauSeq abs fun m ↦ ∑ n ∈ range m, abv (f n)) :
    IsCauSeq abv fun m ↦ ∑ n ∈ range m, f n

name: _root_.cauchy_product
statement:
theorem _root_.cauchy_product (ha : IsCauSeq abs fun m ↦ ∑ n ∈ range m, abv (f n))
    (hb : IsCauSeq abv fun m ↦ ∑ n ∈ range m, g n) (ε : α) (ε0 : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ i,
      abv ((∑ k ∈ range j, f k) * ∑ k ∈ range j, g k -
        ∑ n ∈ range j, ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), f m * g (n - m)) < ε
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨P, hP⟩ := ha.bounded
  let ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hb.bounded
  have hP0 : 0 < P := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) (hP 0)
  have hPε0 : 0 < ε / (2 * P) := div_pos ε0 (mul_pos (show (2 : α) > 0 by simp) hP0)
  let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hb.cauchy₂ hPε0
  have hQε0 : 0 < ε / (4 * Q) :=
    div_pos ε0 (mul_pos (show (0 : α) < 4 by simp) (lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_nonneg _ _) (hQ 0)))
  let ⟨M, hM⟩ := ha.cauchy₂ hQε0
  refine ⟨2 * (max N M + 1), fun K hK ↦ ?_⟩
  have h₁ :
    (∑ m ∈ range K, ∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), f k * g (m - k)) =
      ∑ m ∈ range K, ∑ n ∈ range (K - m), f m * g n := by
    simpa using sum_range_diag_flip K fun m n ↦ f m * g n
  have h₂ :
    (fun i ↦ ∑ k ∈ range (K - i), f i * g k) = fun i ↦ f i * ∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k := by
    simp [Finset.mul_sum]
  have h₃ :
    ∑ i ∈ range K, f i * ∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k =
      ∑ i ∈ range K, f i * (∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k - ∑ k ∈ range K, g k) +
        ∑ i ∈ range K, f i * ∑ k ∈ range K, g k := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib]; simp [(mul_add _ _ _).symm]
  have two_mul_two : (4 : α) = 2 * 2 := by norm_num
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hQε0
  have h2Q0 : 2 * Q ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hQ0
  have hε : ε / (2 * P) * P + ε / (4 * Q) * (2 * Q) = ε := by
    rw [← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (Ne.symm (ne_of_lt hP0)), two_mul_two, mul_assoc, ← div_div,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2Q0, add_halves]
  have hNMK : max N M + 1 < K :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by rw [two_mul]; exact lt_add_of_pos_left _ (Nat.succ_pos _)) hK
  have hKN : N < K :=
    calc
      N ≤ max N M := le_max_left _ _
      _ < max N M + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
      _ < K := hNMK
  have hsumlesum :
      (∑ i ∈ range (max N M + 1),
        abv (f i) * abv ((∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k) - ∑ k ∈ range K, g k)) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ range (max N M + 1), abv (f i) * (ε / (2 * P)) := by
    gcongr with m hmJ
    refine le_of_lt <| hN (K - m) (le_tsub_of_add_le_left <| hK.trans' ?_) K hKN.le
    rw [two_mul]
    gcongr
    · exact (mem_range.1 hmJ).le
    · exact Nat.le_succ_of_le (le_max_left _ _)
  have hsumltP : (∑ n ∈ range (max N M + 1), abv (f n)) < P :=
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ range (max N M + 1), abv (f n)) = |∑ n ∈ range (max N M + 1), abv (f n)| :=
        Eq.symm (abs_of_nonneg (sum_nonneg fun x _ ↦ abv_nonneg abv (f x)))
      _ < P := hP (max N M + 1)
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, sum_mul, ← sub_sub, sub_right_comm, sub_self, zero_sub, abv_neg abv]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsAbsoluteValue.abv_sum _ _ _) ?_
  suffices
    (∑ i ∈ range (max N M + 1),
          abv (f i) * abv ((∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k) - ∑ k ∈ range K, g k)) +
        ((∑ i ∈ range K, abv (f i) * abv ((∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k) - ∑ k ∈ range K, g k)) -
          ∑ i ∈ range (max N M + 1),
            abv (f i) * abv ((∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k) - ∑ k ∈ range K, g k)) <
      ε / (2 * P) * P + ε / (4 * Q) * (2 * Q) by
    rw [hε] at this
    simpa [abv_mul abv] using this
  gcongr
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt hsumlesum
        (by rw [← sum_mul, mul_comm]; gcongr)
  rw [sum_range_sub_sum_range (le_of_lt hNMK)]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ range K with max N M + 1 ≤ i,
          abv (f i) * abv ((∑ k ∈ range (K - i), g k) - ∑ k ∈ range K, g k)) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ range K with max N M + 1 ≤ i, abv (f i) * (2 * Q) := by
        gcongr
        rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
        grw [abv_add abv]
        rw [two_mul, abv_neg abv]
        gcongr <;> exact le_of_lt (hQ _)
    _ < ε / (4 * Q) * (2 * Q) := by
        rw [← sum_mul, ← sum_range_sub_sum_range (le_of_lt hNMK)]
        have := lt_of_le_of_lt (abv_nonneg _ _) (hQ 0)
        gcongr
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans_lt <|
          hM _ ((Nat.le_succ_of_le (le_max_right _ _)).trans hNMK.le) _ <|
            Nat.le_succ_of_le <| le_max_right _ _

name: of_decreasing_bounded
statement:
lemma of_decreasing_bounded (f : ℕ → α) {a : α} {m : ℕ} (ham : ∀ n ≥ m, |f n| ≤ a)
    (hnm : ∀ n ≥ m, f n.succ ≤ f n) : IsCauSeq abs f
proof:
:= fun ε ε0 ↦ by
  classical
  let ⟨k, hk⟩ := Archimedean.arch a ε0
  have h : ∃ l, ∀ n ≥ m, a - l • ε < f n :=
    ⟨k + k + 1, fun n hnm ↦
      lt_of_lt_of_le (show a - (k + (k + 1)) • ε < -|f n| from
          lt_neg.1 <| (ham n hnm).trans_lt
              (by
                rw [neg_sub, lt_sub_iff_add_lt, add_nsmul, add_nsmul, one_nsmul]
                exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hk (lt_of_le_of_lt hk (lt_add_of_pos_right _ ε0))))
        (neg_le.2 <| abs_neg (f n) ▸ le_abs_self _)⟩
  let l := Nat.find h
  have hl : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ m → f n > a - l • ε := Nat.find_spec h
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := fun hl0 ↦
    not_lt_of_ge (ham m le_rfl)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by have := hl m (le_refl m); simpa [hl0] using this) (le_abs_self (f m)))
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.1 (Nat.find_min h (Nat.pred_lt hl0))
  rw [Classical.not_imp, not_lt] at hi
  exists i
  intro j hj
  have hfij : f j ≤ f i := (Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_le (· ≥ ·) hnm hi.1 hj).le
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.2 hfij), neg_sub, sub_lt_iff_lt_add']
  calc
    f i ≤ a - Nat.pred l • ε := hi.2
    _ = a - l • ε + ε := by
      conv =>
        rhs
        rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hl0), succ_nsmul, sub_add,
          add_sub_cancel_right]
    _ < f j + ε := by gcongr; exact hl _ <| hi.1.trans hj

name: of_mono_bounded
statement:
lemma of_mono_bounded (f : ℕ → α) {a : α} {m : ℕ} (ham : ∀ n ≥ m, |f n| ≤ a)
    (hnm : ∀ n ≥ m, f n ≤ f n.succ) : IsCauSeq abs f
proof:
:=
  (of_decreasing_bounded (-f) (a := a) (m := m) (by simpa using ham) <| by simpa using hnm).of_neg

name: geo_series
statement:
lemma geo_series [Nontrivial β] (x : β) (hx1 : abv x < 1) :
    IsCauSeq abv fun n ↦ ∑ m ∈ range n, x ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hx1' : abv x ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hx1
  refine of_abv ?_
  simp only [abv_pow abv, geom_sum_eq hx1']
  conv in _ / _ => rw [← neg_div_neg_eq, neg_sub, neg_sub]
  have : 0 < 1 - abv x := sub_pos.2 hx1
  refine of_mono_bounded _ (a := (1 : α) / (1 - abv x)) (m := 0) ?_ ?_
  · intro n _
    rw [abs_of_nonneg]
    · gcongr
      exact sub_le_self _ (abv_pow abv x n ▸ abv_nonneg _ _)
    refine div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ?_) (sub_nonneg.2 <| le_of_lt hx1)
    exact pow_le_one₀ (by positivity) hx1.le
  · intro n _
    rw [← one_mul (abv x ^ n), pow_succ']
    gcongr

name: geo_series_const
statement:
lemma geo_series_const (a : α) {x : α} (hx1 : |x| < 1) :
    IsCauSeq abs fun m ↦ ∑ n ∈ range m, (a * x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_sum, Pi.mul_def] using (const a).mul (geo_series x hx1)

name: series_ratio_test
statement:
lemma series_ratio_test {f : ℕ → β} (n : ℕ) (r : α) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (h : ∀ m, n ≤ m → abv (f m.succ) ≤ r * abv (f m)) :
    IsCauSeq abv fun m ↦ ∑ n ∈ range m, f n
proof:
:= by
  have har1 : |r| < 1 := by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hr0]
  refine (geo_series_const (abv (f n.succ) * r⁻¹ ^ n.succ) har1).of_abv_le n.succ fun m hmn ↦ ?_
  obtain rfl | hr := hr0.eq_or_lt
  · have m_pos := lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_pos n) hmn
    have := h m.pred (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ (by rwa [Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos m_pos]))
    simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel m_pos, pow_succ] using this
  generalize hk : m - n.succ = k
  replace hk : m = k + n.succ := (tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le hmn).1 hk
  induction k generalizing m n with
  | zero =>
    rw [hk, Nat.zero_add, mul_right_comm, inv_pow _ _, ← div_eq_mul_inv, mul_div_cancel_right₀]
    positivity
  | succ k ih =>
    have kn : k + n.succ ≥ n.succ := by
      rw [← zero_add n.succ]; exact add_le_add (Nat.zero_le _) (by simp)
    rw [hk, Nat.succ_add, pow_succ r, ← mul_assoc]
    refine
      le_trans (by rw [mul_comm] <;> exact h _ (Nat.le_of_succ_le kn))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hr0)
    exact ih _ h _ (by simp) rfl

name: tendsto_sup'_antidiagonal_cofinite
statement:
lemma tendsto_sup'_antidiagonal_cofinite (hf : Tendsto f cofinite F) : Tendsto
    (fun a ↦ (Finset.antidiagonal a).sup' (nonempty_antidiagonal _) f) cofinite F
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  refine ((((hf hU).image Prod.fst)).add ((hf hU).image Prod.snd)).subset ?_
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, e⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' (nonempty_antidiagonal x) f
  obtain rfl : i.1 + i.2 = x := by simpa using hi
  exact Set.add_mem_add (by simpa using ⟨i.2, e ▸ hx⟩) (by simpa using ⟨i.1, e ▸ hx⟩)

name: mulAntidiagonal_congr
statement:
@[to_additive
/

See also `Finset.antidiagonal_congr'`. -/]
theorem mulAntidiagonal_congr (hp : p ∈ mulAntidiagonal n) (hq : q ∈ mulAntidiagonal n) :
    p = q ↔ p.1 = q.1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst, fun h ↦ Prod.ext h ((mul_right_inj q.fst).mp ?_)⟩

name: mulAntidiagonal_congr'
statement:
@[to_additive /

See also `Finset.antidiagonal_congr`. -/]
lemma mulAntidiagonal_congr' (hp : p ∈ mulAntidiagonal n) (hq : q ∈ mulAntidiagonal n) :

:= by

statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulAntidiagonal.fst_le {n : A} {kl : A × A} (hlk : kl ∈ mulAntidiagonal n) : kl.1 ≤ n
proof:
:= by

  use kl.1
  rwa [mem_mulAntidiagonal, eq_comm, mul_comm] at hlk

name: filter_fst_eq_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem filter_fst_eq_antidiagonal (n m : A) [DecidablePred (· = m)] [Decidable (m ≤ n)] :
    {x ∈ antidiagonal n | x.fst = m} = if m ≤ n then {(m, n - m)} else ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩
  suffices a = m → (a + b = n ↔ m ≤ n ∧ b = n - m) by
    rw [mem_filter, mem_antidiagonal, apply_ite (fun n ↦ (a, b) ∈ n), mem_singleton,
      Prod.mk_inj, ite_prop_iff_or]
    simpa [← and_assoc, @and_right_comm _ (a = _), and_congr_left_iff]
  rintro rfl
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨le_add_right le_rfl, (add_tsub_cancel_left _ _).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact add_tsub_cancel_of_le h

name: filter_snd_eq_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem filter_snd_eq_antidiagonal (n m : A) [DecidablePred (· = m)] [Decidable (m ≤ n)] :
    {x ∈ antidiagonal n | x.snd = m} = if m ≤ n then {(n - m, m)} else ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_swap_antidiagonal, filter_map]
  simp [filter_fst_eq_antidiagonal, apply_ite (Finset.map _)]

name: mem_mulAntidiagonal_ofAdd_iff_toAdd_mem_antidiagonal
proof:
:= by

name: mem_finMulAntidiag
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_finMulAntidiag {d n : ℕ} {f : Fin d → ℕ} :
    f ∈ finMulAntidiag d n ↔ ∏ i, f i = n ∧ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold finMulAntidiag
  split_ifs with h
  · simp_rw [mem_map, mem_finAntidiagonal, Function.Embedding.arrowCongrRight_apply,
      Function.comp_def, Function.Embedding.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding,
      Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, ← Additive.ofMul.symm_apply_eq, Additive.ofMul_symm_eq,
      toMul_sum, (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ => Additive.ofMul).surjective.exists,
      Equiv.piCongrRight_apply, Pi.map_apply, toMul_ofMul, ← PNat.coe_inj, PNat.mk_coe,
      PNat.coe_prod]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha_mem, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ha_mem, h.ne.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, _⟩
      refine ⟨fun i ↦ ⟨f i, ?_⟩, rfl, funext fun _ => rfl⟩
      apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp h.ne.symm _ (mem_univ _)
  · simp only [not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at h
    simp only [h, notMem_empty, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, and_false]

theorem finMulAntidiag_zero_right (d : ℕ) :

theorem finMulAntidiag_one {d : ℕ} :

:= by

  simp only [mem_finMulAntidiag, prod_eq_one_iff, mem_univ, forall_const, ne_eq, one_ne_zero,
    not_false_eq_true, and_true, mem_singleton]

statement:
theorem finMulAntidiag_zero_left {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 1) :

statement:
theorem dvd_of_mem_finMulAntidiag {n d : ℕ} {f : Fin d → ℕ} (hf : f ∈ finMulAntidiag d n)
    (i : Fin d) : f i ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_finMulAntidiag] at hf
  rw [← hf.1]
  exact dvd_prod_of_mem f (mem_univ i)

name: finMulAntidiag_eq_piFinset_divisors_filter
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [ne_eq,
    Fintype.mem_piFinset, mem_divisors, mem_filter]
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨?_, prod_eq_of_mem_finMulAntidiag hf⟩
    exact fun i => ⟨(dvd_of_mem_finMulAntidiag hf i).trans hmn, hn⟩
  · rw [mem_finMulAntidiag]
    exact fun ⟨_, hprod⟩ => ⟨hprod, ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn hmn⟩

name: image_apply_finMulAntidiag
statement:
lemma image_apply_finMulAntidiag {d n : ℕ} {i : Fin d} (hd : d ≠ 1) :
    (finMulAntidiag d n).image (fun f => f i) = divisors n
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [mem_image, ne_eq, mem_divisors]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨dvd_of_mem_finMulAntidiag hf _, (mem_finMulAntidiag.mp hf).2⟩
  · simp_rw [mem_finMulAntidiag]
    rintro ⟨⟨r, rfl⟩, hn⟩
    have hs : Nontrivial (Fin d) := by
      rw [Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le]
      obtain rfl | hd' := eq_or_ne d 0
      · exact i.elim0
      lia
    obtain ⟨i', hi_ne⟩ := exists_ne i
    use fun j => if j = i then k else if j = i' then r else 1
    simp only [ite_true, and_true]
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (h := mem_univ i),
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (a := i')]
    · simp_all
    exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨hi_ne, mem_univ _⟩

statement:
lemma image_piFinTwoEquiv_finMulAntidiag {n : ℕ} :
    (finMulAntidiag 2 n).image (piFinTwoEquiv <| fun _ => ℕ) = divisorsAntidiagonal n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [(piFinTwoEquiv <| fun _ => ℕ).symm.surjective.exists]

name: finMulAntidiag_existsUnique_prime_dvd
statement:
lemma finMulAntidiag_existsUnique_prime_dvd {d n p : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n)
    (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactorsList) (f : Fin d → ℕ) (hf : f ∈ finMulAntidiag d n) :
    ∃! i, p ∣ f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_finMulAntidiag] at hf
  rw [mem_primeFactorsList hf.2, ← hf.1, hp.1.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff] at hp
  obtain ⟨i, his, hi⟩ := hp.2
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  by_contra hij
  apply Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mpr ⟨p, hp.1, hi, hj⟩
  apply Nat.coprime_of_squarefree_mul
  apply hn.squarefree_of_dvd
  rw [← hf.1, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ his,
    ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, mem_univ _⟩), ← mul_assoc]
  apply Nat.dvd_mul_right

name: primeFactorsPiBij_img
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_finMulAntidiag]
  refine ⟨?_, hn.ne_zero⟩
  unfold Nat.primeFactorsPiBij
  rw [prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to, prod_attach (f := fun x => x)]
  · apply prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hn
  · apply fun _ _ => mem_univ _

name: primeFactorsPiBij_inj
statement:
private theorem primeFactorsPiBij_inj (d n : ℕ)
    (f : (p : ℕ) → p ∈ n.primeFactors → Fin d) (hf : f ∈ pi n.primeFactors fun _ => univ)
    (g : (p : ℕ) → p ∈ n.primeFactors → Fin d) (hg : g ∈ pi n.primeFactors fun _ => univ) :
    Nat.primeFactorsPiBij d n f hf = Nat.primeFactorsPiBij d n g hg → f = g
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  simp_rw [Function.ne_iff]
  intro ⟨p, hp, hfg⟩
  use f p hp
  dsimp only [Nat.primeFactorsPiBij]
  apply ne_of_mem_of_not_mem (s := {x | p ∣ x}) <;> simp_rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  · rw [Finset.prod_filter]
    convert! Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (mem_attach (n.primeFactors) ⟨p, hp⟩)
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
  · rw [mem_primeFactors] at hp
    rw [Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hp.1.prime]
    push Not
    intro q hq
    rw [Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp.1 (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList
      <| List.mem_toFinset.mp q.2)]
    rintro rfl
    rw [(mem_filter.mp hq).2] at hfg
    exact hfg rfl

name: primeFactorsPiBij_surj
proof:
:= by
  have existsUnique := fun (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) =>
    (finMulAntidiag_existsUnique_prime_dvd hn
      (mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mp hp) t ht)
  choose f hf hf_unique using existsUnique
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_pi, mem_univ, forall_true_iff]
  funext i
  have : t i ∣ n := dvd_of_mem_finMulAntidiag ht _
  trans (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.attach, if p.1 ∣ t i then p else 1)
  · rw [Nat.primeFactorsPiBij, ← prod_filter]
    congr
    grind
  rw [prod_attach (f := fun p => if p ∣ t i then p else 1), ← Finset.prod_filter]
  rw [primeFactors_filter_dvd_of_dvd hn.ne_zero this]
  exact prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree <| hn.squarefree_of_dvd this

name: card_finMulAntidiag_pi
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_bij (Nat.primeFactorsPiBij d n) (primeFactorsPiBij_img d n hn)
    (primeFactorsPiBij_inj d n) (primeFactorsPiBij_surj d n hn)

name: card_finMulAntidiag_of_squarefree
statement:
theorem card_finMulAntidiag_of_squarefree {d n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) :
    #(finMulAntidiag d n) = d ^ ω n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_finMulAntidiag_pi d n hn, Finset.card_pi, Finset.prod_const,
    ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_apply, ← List.card_toFinset, toFinset_factors,
    Finset.card_fin]

name: finMulAntidiag_three
statement: theorem finMulAntidiag_three {n : ℕ} (a) (ha : a ∈ finMulAntidiag 3 n) : a 0 * a 1 * a 2 = n

name: f_img
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, mem_divisors, mem_divisors]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, hn.ne_zero⟩, ⟨?_, hn.ne_zero⟩⟩, ?_⟩ <;> rw [f, ← finMulAntidiag_three a ha]
  · apply dvd_mul_right
  · use a 1; ring
  dsimp only
  rw [lcm_mul_left, Nat.Coprime.lcm_eq_mul]
  · ring
  refine coprime_of_squarefree_mul (hn.squarefree_of_dvd ?_)
  use a 0; rw [← finMulAntidiag_three a ha]; ring

name: f_inj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfab1, hfab2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hfab
  have hprods : a 0 * a 1 * a 2 = a 0 * a 1 * b 2 := by
    rw [finMulAntidiag_three a ha, hfab1, finMulAntidiag_three b hb]
  have hab2 : a 2 = b 2 := by
    rw [← mul_right_inj' <| mul_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_mem_finMulAntidiag ha 0)
      (ne_zero_of_mem_finMulAntidiag ha 1)]
    exact hprods
  have hab0 : a 0 = b 0 := by
    rw [hab2] at hfab2
    exact (mul_left_inj' <| ne_zero_of_mem_finMulAntidiag hb 2).mp hfab2;
  have hab1 : a 1 = b 1 := by
    rw [hab0] at hfab1
    exact (mul_right_inj' <| ne_zero_of_mem_finMulAntidiag hb 0).mp hfab1;
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: f_surj
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only at hb
  let g := b.fst.gcd b.snd
  let a := ![g, b.fst / g, b.snd / g]
  have ha : a ∈ finMulAntidiag 3 n := by
    rw [mem_finMulAntidiag]
    rw [mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hb
    refine ⟨?_, hn⟩
    · rw [Fin.prod_univ_three a]
      dsimp only [a, Matrix.cons_val]
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _), ← hb.2, lcm,
        Nat.mul_div_assoc b.fst (Nat.gcd_dvd_right b.fst b.snd)]
  use a; use ha
  apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp only [a, Matrix.cons_val]
    <;> apply Nat.mul_div_cancel'
  · apply Nat.gcd_dvd_left
  · apply Nat.gcd_dvd_right

name: card_pair_lcm_eq

proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_finMulAntidiag_of_squarefree hn, eq_comm]

name: mem_piAntidiag
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_piAntidiag : f ∈ piAntidiag s n ↔ s.sum f = n ∧ ∀ i, f i ≠ 0 → i ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [piAntidiag]
  induction Fintype.truncEquivFinOfCardEq (Fintype.card_coe s) using Trunc.ind with | _ e
  simp only [Trunc.lift_mk, mem_map, mem_finAntidiagonal, Embedding.coeFn_mk]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, ⟨hf, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [sum_dite_of_true fun _ ↦ id]
    exact ⟨Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (by simp), by simp +contextual⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hf⟩
    refine ⟨f ∘ (↑) ∘ e.symm, ?_, by grind⟩
    rw [← sum_attach s]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv e.symm _ _ (by simp)

name: pairwiseDisjoint_piAntidiag_map_addRightEmbedding
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_piAntidiag_map_addRightEmbedding (hi : i ∉ s) (n : μ) :

      map (addRightEmbedding fun j ↦ if j = i then p.1 else 0) (s.piAntidiag p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hab ⟨c, d⟩ hcd
  simp only [ne_eq, HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal_congr' hab hcd, disjoint_left, mem_map,
    mem_piAntidiag, addRightEmbedding_apply, not_exists, not_and, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
  rintro hfg _ f rfl - rfl g rfl - hgf
  exact hfg <| by simpa [sum_add_distrib, hi] using congr_arg (∑ j ∈ s, · j) hgf.symm

name: piAntidiag_cons

      (piAntidiag s p.snd).map (addRightEmbedding fun t ↦ if t = i then p.fst else 0))
        (pairwiseDisjoint_piAntidiag_map_addRightEmbedding hi _)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [mem_piAntidiag, sum_cons, ne_eq, mem_cons, mem_disjiUnion, mem_antidiagonal, mem_map,
    Prod.exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, hf⟩
    refine ⟨_, _, hn, update f i 0, ⟨sum_update_of_notMem hi _ _, fun j ↦ ?_⟩, by aesop⟩
    grind
  · rintro ⟨a, _, hn, g, ⟨rfl, hg⟩, rfl⟩
    have := hg i
    aesop (add simp [sum_add_distrib])

name: nsmul_piAntidiag
statement:
lemma nsmul_piAntidiag [DecidableEq (ι → ℕ)] (s : Finset ι) (m : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n • piAntidiag s m = {f ∈ piAntidiag s (n * m) | ∀ i ∈ s, n ∣ f i}
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  refine mem_smul_finset.trans ?_
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_piAntidiag, and_assoc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl, hf, rfl⟩
    simpa [← mul_sum, hn] using hf
  rintro ⟨hfsum, hfsup, hfdvd⟩
  have (i : _) : n ∣ f i := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · exact hfdvd _ hi
    · rw [not_imp_comm.1 (hfsup _) hi]
      exact dvd_zero _
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ f i / n, ?_⟩
  simp [funext_iff, Nat.mul_div_cancel', ← Nat.sum_div, *]
  grind

proof:

statement:
lemma map_sym_eq_piAntidiag [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ) :

      piAntidiag s n
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [Sym.val_eq_coe, mem_map, mem_sym_iff, Embedding.coeFn_mk, funext_iff, Sym.exists,
    Sym.mem_mk, Sym.coe_mk, exists_and_left, exists_prop, mem_piAntidiag, ne_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl, hf⟩
    simpa [← hf, Multiset.sum_count_eq_card hm]
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hf⟩
    refine ⟨∑ a ∈ s, f a • {a}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp +contextual
    · simpa [Multiset.count_sum', Multiset.count_singleton, not_imp_comm, eq_comm (a := 0)] using hf

name: mem_finsuppAntidiag_insert
statement:
theorem mem_finsuppAntidiag_insert {a : ι} {s : Finset ι}
    (h : a ∉ s) (n : μ) {f : ι →₀ μ} :
    f ∈ finsuppAntidiag (insert a s) n ↔
      ∃ m ∈ antidiagonal n, ∃ (g : ι →₀ μ),
        f = Finsupp.update g a m.1 ∧ g ∈ finsuppAntidiag s m.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_finsuppAntidiag, mem_antidiagonal, Prod.exists, sum_insert h]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hsupp⟩
    refine ⟨_, _, rfl, Finsupp.erase a f, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [update_erase_eq_update, Finsupp.update_self]
    · apply sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      rw [Finsupp.erase_ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hx h)]
    · rwa [support_erase, ← subset_insert_iff]
  · rintro ⟨n1, n2, rfl, g, rfl, rfl, hgsupp⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (support_update_subset _ _).trans (insert_subset_insert a hgsupp)⟩
    simp only [coe_update]
    apply congr_arg₂
    · rw [Function.update_self]
    · apply sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      rw [update_of_ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hx h) n1 ⇑g]

name: finsuppAntidiag_insert
statement:
theorem finsuppAntidiag_insert {a : ι} {s : Finset ι}
    (h : a ∉ s) (n : μ) :
    finsuppAntidiag (insert a s) n = (antidiagonal n).biUnion
      (fun p : μ × μ =>
        (finsuppAntidiag s p.snd).attach.map
        ⟨fun f => Finsupp.update f.val a p.fst,
        (fun ⟨f, hf⟩ ⟨g, hg⟩ hfg => Subtype.ext <| by
          simp only [mem_finsuppAntidiag] at hf hg
          simp only [DFunLike.ext_iff] at hfg ⊢
          intro x
          obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x a
          · replace hf := mt (hf.2 ·) h
            replace hg := mt (hg.2 ·) h
            rw [notMem_support_iff.mp hf, notMem_support_iff.mp hg]
          · simpa only [coe_update, Function.update, dite_eq_right hx] using hfg x)⟩)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_finsuppAntidiag_insert h, mem_biUnion]
  simp_rw [mem_map, mem_attach, true_and, Subtype.exists, Embedding.coeFn_mk, exists_prop, and_comm,
    eq_comm]

name: mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_subset
statement:
lemma mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_subset {e : μ ≃+ μ'} {s : Finset ι} {n : μ} :
    (finsuppAntidiag s n).map (mapRange.addEquiv e).toEmbedding ⊆ finsuppAntidiag s (e n)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  simp only [mem_map, mem_finsuppAntidiag']
  rintro ⟨g, ⟨hsum, hsupp⟩, rfl⟩
  simp only [AddEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe, mapRange.addEquiv_toEquiv, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding,
    mapRange.equiv_apply, EquivLike.coe_coe]
  constructor
  · rw [sum_mapRange_index (fun _ ↦ rfl), ← hsum, _root_.map_finsuppSum]
  · exact subset_trans (support_mapRange) hsupp

name: mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_eq
statement:
lemma mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_eq {e : μ ≃+ μ'} {s : Finset ι} {n : μ} :
    (finsuppAntidiag s n).map (mapRange.addEquiv e).toEmbedding = finsuppAntidiag s (e n)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · apply mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_subset
  · set h := (mapRange.addEquiv e).toEquiv with hh
    intro hf
    have : n = e.symm (e n) := (AddEquiv.eq_symm_apply e).mpr rfl
    rw [mem_map_equiv, this]
    apply mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_subset
    rw [← mem_map_equiv]
    convert! hf
    rw [map_map, hh]
    convert! map_refl
    apply Function.Embedding.equiv_symm_toEmbedding_trans_toEmbedding

  rw [← inv_le_inv₀ ha.pos hc] at hh
  simpa [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ ha, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']
    using mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt_of_nonneg_of_pos hh h zero_le (inv_pos.2 hc)

name: denselyOrdered_iff_denselyOrdered_units_and_nontrivial_units
statement:
lemma denselyOrdered_iff_denselyOrdered_units_and_nontrivial_units :
    DenselyOrdered α ↔ Nontrivial αˣ ∧ DenselyOrdered αˣ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := exists_between (zero_lt_one' α)
    exact ⟨Units.mk0 x hx.ne', 1, by simpa [Units.ext_iff] using hx'.ne⟩
  · refine ⟨fun x y h ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_between (Units.val_lt_val.mpr h)
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 z (ne_zero_of_lt hz.1), by simp [← Units.val_lt_val, hz]⟩
  · refine ⟨fun x y h ↦ ?_⟩
    lift y to αˣ using (ne_zero_of_lt h).isUnit
    obtain rfl | hx := eq_zero_or_pos x
    · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_one_lt' (α := αˣ)
      exact ⟨(y * z⁻¹ : αˣ), by simp, Units.val_lt_val.mpr <| by simp [hz]⟩
    · lift x to αˣ using hx.ne'.isUnit
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := H₂.dense x y (Units.val_lt_val.mpr h)
      exact ⟨z, by simp [hz, hz']⟩

protected lemma addLeftMono [AddZeroClass α] [AddLeftMono α]
    (h : ∀ a : α, 0 ≤ a) : AddLeftMono (WithZero α)
proof:

  refine ⟨fun a b c hbc => ?_⟩
  induction a
  · rwa [zero_add, zero_add]
  induction b
  · rw [add_zero]
    induction c
    · rw [add_zero]
    · rw [← coe_add, coe_le_coe]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (h _)
  · rcases WithZero.coe_le_iff.1 hbc with ⟨c, rfl, hbc'⟩
    rw [← coe_add, ← coe_add _ c, coe_le_coe]
    gcongr

name: mul_eq_mul_iff_eq_and_eq_of_pos
statement:
theorem mul_eq_mul_iff_eq_and_eq_of_pos [PosMulStrictMono α] [MulPosStrictMono α]
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) (a0 : 0 < a) (d0 : 0 < d) :
    a * c = b * d ↔ a = b ∧ c = d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩
  simp only [eq_iff_le_not_lt, hab, hcd, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun hab ↦ h.not_lt ?_, fun hcd ↦ h.not_lt ?_⟩
  · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd a0.le).trans_lt (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hab d0)
  · exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcd a0).trans_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab d0.le)

name: mul_eq_mul_iff_eq_and_eq_of_pos'
statement:

    (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) (b0 : 0 < b) (c0 : 0 < c) :
    a * c = b * d ↔ a = b ∧ c = d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩
  simp only [eq_iff_le_not_lt, hab, hcd, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun hab ↦ h.not_lt ?_, fun hcd ↦ h.not_lt ?_⟩
  · exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hab c0).trans_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd b0.le)
  · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab c0.le).trans_lt (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcd b0)

name: eq_and_eq_of_pos_of_le_of_mul_le_mul
statement:
theorem eq_and_eq_of_pos_of_le_of_mul_le_mul [PosMulReflectLE α] [MulPosReflectLE α]
    [PosMulMono α] [MulPosMono α] (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (h : b * d ≤ a * c) : a = b ∧ c = d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨le_antisymm hab ?_, le_antisymm hcd ?_⟩
  · grw [hcd] at h
    · exact le_of_mul_le_mul_of_pos_right h <| hc.trans_le hcd
    · exact ha.le
  · grw [hab] at h
    · exact le_of_mul_le_mul_of_pos_left h <| ha.trans_le hab
    · exact hc.le

  · rw [zero_mul] at hab

    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha.le hb

statement:
lemma BddAbove.range_comp_of_nonneg {α β γ : Type*} [Nonempty α] [Preorder β] [Zero β] [Preorder γ]

    (hg : MonotoneOn g {x : β | 0 ≤ x}) : BddAbove (range (fun x => g (f x)))
proof:
:= by
  suffices hg' : BddAbove (g '' range f) by
    rwa [← Function.comp_def, Set.range_comp]
  apply hg.map_bddAbove (by rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact hf0 a)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hf
  use b, hb
  simp only [mem_upperBounds, mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff] at hb
  exact le_trans (hf0 Classical.ofNonempty) (hb Classical.ofNonempty)

name: bddAbove_range_mul
statement:
theorem bddAbove_range_mul {α β : Type*} [Nonempty α] {u v : α → β} [Preorder β] [Zero β] [Mul β]
    [PosMulMono β] [MulPosMono β] (hu : BddAbove (Set.range u)) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u)
    (hv : BddAbove (Set.range v)) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) : BddAbove (Set.range (u * v))
proof:
:=
  letI : Zero (β × β) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  BddAbove.range_comp_of_nonneg (f := fun i ↦ (u i, v i)) (g := fun x ↦ x.1 * x.2)
    (bddAbove_range_prod.mpr ⟨hu, hv⟩) (fun x ↦ ⟨hu0 x, hv0 x⟩) ((monotone_fst.monotoneOn _).mul
      (monotone_snd.monotoneOn _) (fun _ hx ↦ hx.1) (fun _ hx ↦ hx.2))

name: Pi.exists_forall_pos_add_lt
statement:
theorem Pi.exists_forall_pos_add_lt [ExistsAddOfLE α] [Finite ι] {x y : ι → α}
    (h : ∀ i, x i < y i) : ∃ ε, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ i, x i + ε < y i
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_ne (0 : α)
    obtain ha | ha := ha.lt_or_gt <;> obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := exists_pos_add_of_lt' ha <;>
      exact ⟨b, hb, isEmptyElim⟩
  choose ε hε hxε using fun i => exists_pos_add_of_lt' (h i)
  obtain rfl : x + ε = y := funext hxε
  have hε : 0 < Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty ε := (Finset.lt_inf'_iff _).2 fun i _ => hε _
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδε⟩ := exists_between hε
  exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun i ↦ add_lt_add_right (hδε.trans_le <| Finset.inf'_le _ <| Finset.mem_univ _) _⟩

theorem div_le_iff_of_neg (hc : c < 0) : b / c ≤ a ↔ a * c ≤ b where
  mp h
proof:
:= div_mul_cancel₀ b (ne_of_lt hc) ▸ mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right h hc.le
  mpr h := calc
    a = a * c * (1 / c) := mul_mul_div a (ne_of_lt hc)
    _ ≥ b * (1 / c) := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right h <| inv_eq_one_div c ▸ (inv_lt_zero'.2 hc).le
    _ = b / c := (div_eq_mul_one_div b c).symm

name: exists_lt_mul_left_of_nonneg
statement:
private lemma exists_lt_mul_left_of_nonneg {a b c : α} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : c < a * b) :
    ∃ a' ∈ Set.Ico 0 a, c < a' * b
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := pos_of_mul_pos_right (hc.trans_lt h) ha
  obtain ⟨a', ha', a_a'⟩ := exists_between ((div_lt_iff₀ hb).2 h)
  exact ⟨a', ⟨(div_nonneg hc hb.le).trans ha'.le, a_a'⟩, (div_lt_iff₀ hb).1 ha'⟩

proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := pos_of_mul_pos_right (hc.trans_lt h) ha
  simp_rw [mul_comm a] at h ⊢
  exact exists_lt_mul_left_of_nonneg hb.le hc h

name: exists_mul_left_lt
statement: private lemma exists_mul_left_lt₀ {a b c : α} (hc : a * b < c) : ∃ a' > a, a' * b < c
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt b 0 with hb | hb
  · obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := exists_gt a
    exact ⟨a', ha', hc.trans_le' (antitone_mul_right hb ha'.le)⟩
  · obtain ⟨a', ha', hc'⟩ := exists_between ((lt_div_iff₀ hb).2 hc)
    exact ⟨a', ha', (lt_div_iff₀ hb).1 hc'⟩

name: le_mul_of_forall_lt
statement: lemma le_mul_of_forall_lt₀ {a b c : α} (h : ∀ a' > a, ∀ b' > b, c ≤ a' * b') : c ≤ a * b
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense fun d hd ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hd⟩ := exists_mul_left_lt₀ hd
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hd⟩ := exists_mul_right_lt₀ hd
  exact (h a' ha' b' hb').trans hd.le

name: mul_le_of_forall_lt_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma mul_le_of_forall_lt_of_nonneg {a b c : α} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ a' ≥ 0, a' < a → ∀ b' ≥ 0, b' < b → a' * b' ≤ c) : a * b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun d d_ab ↦ ?_
  rcases lt_or_ge d 0 with hd | hd
  · exact hd.le.trans hc
  obtain ⟨a', ha', d_ab⟩ := exists_lt_mul_left_of_nonneg ha hd d_ab
  obtain ⟨b', hb', d_ab⟩ := exists_lt_mul_right_of_nonneg ha'.1 hd d_ab
  exact d_ab.le.trans (h a' ha'.1 ha'.2 b' hb'.1 hb'.2)

name: uniform_continuous_npow_on_bounded
statement:
theorem uniform_continuous_npow_on_bounded (B : α) {ε : α} (hε : 0 < ε) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ q r : α, |r| ≤ B → |q - r| ≤ δ → |q ^ n - r ^ n| < ε
proof:
:= by
  wlog! B_pos : 0 < B generalizing B
  · have ⟨δ, δ_pos, cont⟩ := this 1 zero_lt_one
    exact ⟨δ, δ_pos, fun q r hr ↦ cont q r (hr.trans (B_pos.trans zero_le_one))⟩
  have pos : 0 < 1 + ↑n * (B + 1) ^ (n - 1) := zero_lt_one.trans_le <| le_add_of_nonneg_right <|
    mul_nonneg n.cast_nonneg <| (pow_pos (B_pos.trans <| lt_add_of_pos_right _ zero_lt_one) _).le
  refine ⟨min 1 (ε / (1 + n * (B + 1) ^ (n - 1))), lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hε pos),
    fun q r hr hqr ↦ (abs_pow_sub_pow_le ..).trans_lt ?_⟩
  rw [le_inf_iff, le_div_iff₀ pos, mul_one_add, ← mul_assoc] at hqr
  obtain h | h := (abs_nonneg (q - r)).eq_or_lt
  · simpa only [← h, zero_mul] using hε
  refine (lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ <| lt_add_of_pos_left _ h).trans_le hqr.2
  gcongr
  · exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) n.cast_nonneg
  · exact (abs_nonneg _).trans le_sup_left
  refine max_le ?_ (hr.trans <| le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)
  exact add_sub_cancel r q ▸ (abs_add_le ..).trans (add_le_add hr hqr.1)

name: two_mul_le_add_mul_sq
statement:
lemma two_mul_le_add_mul_sq {ε : α} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    2 * a * b ≤ ε * a ^ 2 + ε⁻¹ * b ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : 2 * (ε * a) * b ≤ (ε * a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := two_mul_le_add_sq (ε * a) b
  calc 2 * a * b
  _ = 2 * a * b * (ε * ε⁻¹) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hε.ne', mul_one]
  _ = (2 * (ε * a) * b) * ε⁻¹ := by simp_rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm ε, mul_assoc]
  _ ≤ ((ε * a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * ε⁻¹ := by gcongr; exact inv_nonneg.mpr hε.le
  _ = ε * a ^ 2 + ε⁻¹ * b ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_comm _ ε⁻¹, mul_pow, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, pow_two, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hε.ne',
      one_mul]

statement: lemma geom_sum_lt (h0 : x ≠ 0) (h1 : x < 1) (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i < (1 - x)⁻¹
proof:

  rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero] at h0
  rw [geom_sum_of_lt_one h1, div_lt_iff₀, inv_mul_cancel₀, tsub_lt_self_iff]
  · exact ⟨h0.trans h1, pow_pos h0 n⟩

proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt m n with (hmn | hmn)
  · rw [geom_sum_Ico' h'x.ne hmn]
    apply div_le_div₀ (pow_nonneg hx _) _ (sub_pos.2 h'x) le_rfl
    simpa using pow_nonneg hx _
  · rw [Ico_eq_empty, sum_empty]
    · apply div_nonneg (pow_nonneg hx _)
      simpa using h'x.le
    · simpa using hmn.le

name: Even.zpow_abs

proof:

name: zpow_eq_zpow_iff_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma zpow_eq_zpow_iff_of_ne_zero₀ (hn : n ≠ 0) : a ^ n = b ^ n ↔ a = b ∨ a = -b ∧ Even n
proof:
:=
  match n with
  | Int.ofNat m => by
    simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, zpow_natCast, Int.even_coe_nat] at *
    exact pow_eq_pow_iff_of_ne_zero hn
  | Int.negSucc m => by
    simp only [← neg_ofNat_succ, ne_eq, neg_eq_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      inv_inj, even_neg, Int.even_coe_nat] at *
    exact pow_eq_pow_iff_of_ne_zero hn

name: zpow_eq_zpow_iff_cases
statement: lemma zpow_eq_zpow_iff_cases₀ : a ^ n = b ^ n ↔ n = 0 ∨ a = b ∨ a = -b ∧ Even n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn <;> simp [zpow_eq_zpow_iff_of_ne_zero₀, *]

name: zpow_eq_one_iff_of_ne_zero

name: zpow_eq_one_iff_cases
statement: lemma zpow_eq_one_iff_cases₀ : a ^ n = 1 ↔ n = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = -1 ∧ Even n

name: zpow_eq_neg_zpow_iff
statement: lemma zpow_eq_neg_zpow_iff₀ (hb : b ≠ 0) : a ^ n = -b ^ n ↔ a = -b ∧ Odd n
proof:
:=
  match n with
  | Int.ofNat m => by
    simp [pow_eq_neg_pow_iff, hb]
  | Int.negSucc m => by
    simp only [← neg_ofNat_succ, zpow_neg, ← inv_neg, pow_eq_neg_pow_iff hb, inv_inj,
      zpow_natCast]
    simp [parity_simps]

name: zpow_eq_neg_one_iff
statement: lemma zpow_eq_neg_one_iff₀ : a ^ n = -1 ↔ a = -1 ∧ Odd n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using zpow_eq_neg_zpow_iff₀ (α := α) one_ne_zero

name: sub_eq_top_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_eq_top_iff {a b : WithTop α} : a - b = ⊤ ↔ a = ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction a <;> induction b <;>
    simp only [← coe_sub, coe_ne_top, sub_top, top_sub_coe, false_and, Ne, not_true_eq_false,
      not_false_eq_true, and_false, and_self]

name: map_sub
statement:
protected
theorem map_sub [Sub β] [Bot β] {f : α → β} (h : ∀ x y, f (x - y) = f x - f y) (h₀ : f ⊥ = ⊥) :
    ∀ x y : WithTop α, (x - y).map f = x.map f - y.map f
  | _, ⊤ => by simp only [sub_top, map_coe, h₀, map_top]
  | ⊤, (x : α) => rfl
  | (x : α), (y : α) => by simp only [← coe_sub, map_coe, h]

end

instance : OrderedSub (WithTop α)
proof:
:= by

  cases y

  cases x
  · simp
  cases z
  · simp
  norm_cast
  exact tsub_le_iff_right

  rw [tsub_le_iff_left, ← hc.add_tsub_assoc_of_le h, hc.le_tsub_iff_right (h.trans le_add_self),

proof:

  rw [← h, tsub_pos_iff_lt] at h₁
  exact h₂.not_ge (ha.add_le_iff_nonpos_left.1 <| add_le_of_le_tsub_left_of_le h₁.le h.ge)

name: Even.tsub
statement:
lemma Even.tsub [AddLeftReflectLE α] {m n : α} (hm : Even m) (hn : Even n) :
    Even (m - n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hn
  refine ⟨a - b, ?_⟩
  obtain h | h := le_total a b
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_of_le h, tsub_eq_zero_of_le (add_le_add h h), add_zero]
  · exact (tsub_add_tsub_comm h h).symm

name: toOrderedSub
statement:
theorem toOrderedSub [AddRightReflectLE α] : OrderedSub α where
  tsub_le_iff_right a b c
proof:
:= by
    change dite _ _ _ ≤ c ↔ _
    split_ifs with h
    · have := (exists_add_of_le h).choose_spec
      rw [this] at h
      conv_rhs => rw [this, add_comm]
      rw [add_le_add_iff_right]
    · rw [not_le] at h
      constructor <;> intro h'
      · simpa using add_le_add h' h.le
      · exact zero_le

      _ ≤ a - b + (c + (b - c)) := by grw [← le_add_tsub]
      _ = a - b + c + (b - c) := (add_assoc _ _ _).symm

  refine (tsub_le_tsub_right add_tsub_le_assoc c).trans ?_
  rw [add_comm a, add_comm (a - c)]
  exact add_tsub_le_assoc

name: smul_mem_closure_star_mul
proof:
:= by
  induction hr using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add r₁ r₂ _ _ hr₁ hr₂ => simpa [add_smul] using add_mem hr₁ hr₂
  | mem r hr =>
  induction ha using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add a₁ a₂ _ _ ha₁ ha₂ => simpa [smul_add] using add_mem ha₁ ha₂
  | mem a ha =>
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨r • a, by simp [star_smul, smul_mul_smul_comm]⟩

name: of_le_iff
statement:
lemma of_le_iff (h_le_iff : ∀ x y : R, x ≤ y ↔ ∃ s, y = x + star s * s) : StarOrderedRing R where
  le_iff x y
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (h_le_iff x y).mp h
      exact ⟨star p * p, AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨p, rfl⟩, hp⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpxy⟩
      revert x y hpxy
      refine AddSubmonoid.closure_induction ?_ (fun x y h => add_zero x ▸ h.ge) ?_ hp
      · rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩ x y rfl
        exact (h_le_iff _ _).mpr ⟨s, rfl⟩
      · rintro _ _ _ _ ha hb x y rfl
        rw [← add_assoc]
        exact (ha _ _ rfl).trans (hb _ _ rfl)

name: of_nonneg_iff
statement:
lemma of_nonneg_iff [NonUnitalRing R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R]
    (h_add : ∀ {x y : R}, x ≤ y → ∀ z, z + x ≤ z + y)
    (h_nonneg_iff : ∀ x : R, 0 ≤ x ↔ x ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun s : R => star s * s)) :
    StarOrderedRing R where
  le_iff x y
proof:
:= by
    have : AddLeftMono R := ⟨fun _ _ _ h => h_add h _⟩
    simpa only [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', sub_nonneg, exists_eq_right'] using h_nonneg_iff (y - x)

name: of_nonneg_iff'
statement:
lemma of_nonneg_iff' [NonUnitalRing R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R]

proof:
:=
  of_le_iff <| by
    have : AddLeftMono R := ⟨fun _ _ _ h => h_add h _⟩
    simpa [sub_eq_iff_eq_add', sub_nonneg] using fun x y => h_nonneg_iff (y - x)

name: star_left_conjugate_nonneg
statement:
@[aesop safe apply]
theorem star_left_conjugate_nonneg {a : R} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (c : R) : 0 ≤ star c * a * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [StarOrderedRing.nonneg_iff] at ha
  refine AddSubmonoid.closure_induction (fun x hx => ?_)
    (by rw [mul_zero, zero_mul]) (fun x y _ _ hx hy => ?_) ha
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
    convert! star_mul_self_nonneg (x * c) using 1
    rw [star_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ _ c]
  · calc
      0 ≤ star c * x * c + 0 := by rw [add_zero]; exact hx
      _ ≤ star c * x * c + star c * y * c := by gcongr
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [mul_add, add_mul]

lemma star_le_star_iff {x y : R} : star x ≤ star y ↔ x ≤ y
proof:

  have h₂ := OrderHomClass.mono f hc

statement: theorem abs_sub_lt_one_of_floor_eq_floor {a b : R} (h : ⌊a⌋ = ⌊b⌋) : |a - b| < 1
proof:
:= by
  wlog h0 : b ≤ a generalizing a b
  · rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact this h.symm (le_of_not_ge h0)
  calc |a - b|
    _ = a - b := abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg_of_le h0)
    _ < ⌊a⌋ + 1 - b := sub_lt_sub_right (lt_floor_add_one a) _
    _ ≤ ⌊a⌋ + 1 - ⌊b⌋ := sub_le_sub_left (floor_le b) _
    _ = 1 := by rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem floor_fract (a : R) : ⌊fract a⌋ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [floor_eq_iff, Int.cast_zero, zero_add]; exact ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _⟩

name: fract_eq_iff
statement: theorem fract_eq_iff {a b : R} : fract a = b ↔ 0 ≤ b ∧ b < 1 ∧ ∃ z : ℤ, a - b = z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rw [← h]
    exact ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _, ⟨⌊a⌋, sub_sub_cancel _ _⟩⟩,
   by
    rintro ⟨h₀, h₁, z, hz⟩
    rw [← self_sub_floor, eq_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, hz]
    refine congrArg Int.cast ?_
    rw [floor_eq_iff, ← hz]
    constructor <;> simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] ⟩

name: fract_eq_fract
statement: theorem fract_eq_fract {a b : R} : fract a = fract b ↔ ∃ z : ℤ, a - b = z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨⌊a⌋ - ⌊b⌋, by unfold fract at h; rw [Int.cast_sub, sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub.1 h]⟩,
   by
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine fract_eq_iff.2 ⟨fract_nonneg _, fract_lt_one _, z + ⌊b⌋, ?_⟩
    rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hz, add_comm, Int.cast_add]
    exact add_sub_sub_cancel _ _ _⟩

name: fract_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_eq_self {a : R} : fract a = a ↔ 0 ≤ a ∧ a < 1

name: fract_fract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_fract (a : R) : fract (fract a) = fract a

name: fract_fract_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_fract_add (a b : R) : fract (fract a + b) = fract (a + b)
proof:
:=
  fract_eq_fract.2 ⟨-⌊a⌋, by unfold fract; push_cast; abel⟩

name: fract_add_fract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_add_fract (a b : R) : fract (a + fract b) = fract (a + b)
proof:
:=
  fract_eq_fract.2 ⟨-⌊b⌋, by unfold fract; push_cast; abel⟩

name: fract_fract_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_fract_sub (a b : R) : fract (fract a - b) = fract (a - b)
proof:
:=
  fract_eq_fract.2 ⟨-⌊a⌋, by unfold fract; push_cast; abel⟩

name: fract_sub_fract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_sub_fract (a b : R) : fract (a - fract b) = fract (a - b)

name: fract_fract_add_fract
statement: theorem fract_fract_add_fract (a b : R) : fract (fract a + fract b) = fract (a + b)

name: fract_fract_sub_fract
statement: theorem fract_fract_sub_fract (a b : R) : fract (fract a - fract b) = fract (a - b)

name: fract_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem fract_eq_zero_iff {a : R} : fract a = 0 ↔ a ∈ range Int.cast

name: fract_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem fract_ne_zero_iff {a : R} : fract a ≠ 0 ↔ a ∉ range Int.cast

name: fract_neg
statement: theorem fract_neg {x : R} (hx : fract x ≠ 0) : fract (-x) = 1 - fract x
proof:
:= by
  rw [fract_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, zero_add]
    exact (fract_lt_one x).le
  refine ⟨sub_lt_self _ (lt_of_le_of_ne' (fract_nonneg x) hx), -⌊x⌋ - 1, ?_⟩
  simp only [sub_sub_eq_add_sub, cast_sub, cast_neg, cast_one, sub_left_inj]
  conv in -x => rw [← floor_add_fract x]
  simp [-floor_add_fract]

name: fract_neg_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fract_neg_eq_zero {x : R} : fract (-x) = 0 ↔ fract x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fract_eq_iff, le_refl, zero_lt_one, tsub_zero, true_and]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ <;> use -z <;> simp [← hz]

name: fract_mul_natCast
statement: theorem fract_mul_natCast (a : R) (b : ℕ) : ∃ z : ℤ, fract a * b - fract (a * b) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => use 0; simp
  | succ c hc =>
    rcases hc with ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [Nat.cast_add, mul_add, mul_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, mul_one]
    rcases fract_add (a * c) a with ⟨y, hy⟩
    use z - y
    rw [Int.cast_sub, ← hz, ← hy]
    abel

name: preimage_fract
statement:
theorem preimage_fract (s : Set R) :
    fract ⁻¹' s = ⋃ m : ℤ, (fun x => x - (m : R)) ⁻¹' (s ∩ Ico (0 : R) 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨⌊x⌋, h, fract_nonneg x, fract_lt_one x⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨m, hms, hm0, hm1⟩
  obtain rfl : ⌊x⌋ = m := floor_eq_iff.2 ⟨sub_nonneg.1 hm0, sub_lt_iff_lt_add'.1 hm1⟩
  exact hms

name: image_fract
statement: theorem image_fract (s : Set R) : fract '' s = ⋃ m : ℤ, (fun x : R => x - m) '' s ∩ Ico 0 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_image, mem_inter_iff, mem_iUnion]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⌊y⌋, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, fract_nonneg y, fract_lt_one y⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, ⟨y, hys, rfl⟩, h0, h1⟩
    obtain rfl : ⌊y⌋ = m := floor_eq_iff.2 ⟨sub_nonneg.1 h0, sub_lt_iff_lt_add'.1 h1⟩
    exact ⟨y, hys, rfl⟩

name: fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico
statement: theorem fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico (a b : k) (ha : 0 < a) : fract (b / a) * a ∈ Ico 0 a

name: fract_div_mul_self_add_zsmul_eq
statement:
theorem fract_div_mul_self_add_zsmul_eq (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    fract (b / a) * a + ⌊b / a⌋ • a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul, ← add_mul, fract_add_floor, div_mul_cancel₀ b ha]

name: sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg
statement: theorem sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg (a : k) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ a - ⌊a / b⌋ * b

name: sub_floor_div_mul_lt
statement: theorem sub_floor_div_mul_lt (a : k) (hb : 0 < b) : a - ⌊a / b⌋ * b < b
proof:
:=
  sub_lt_iff_lt_add.2 <| by
    rw [← one_add_mul, ← div_lt_iff₀ hb, add_comm]
    exact lt_floor_add_one _

name: fract_div_natCast_eq_div_natCast_mod
statement: theorem fract_div_natCast_eq_div_natCast_mod {m n : ℕ} : fract ((m : k) / n) = ↑(m % n) / n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  have hn' : 0 < (n : k) := by
    norm_cast
  refine fract_eq_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_, m / n, ?_⟩
  · positivity
  · simpa only [div_lt_one hn', Nat.cast_lt] using m.mod_lt hn
  · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← mul_right_inj' hn'.ne', mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn'.ne', mul_add,
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn'.ne']
    norm_cast
    rw [← Nat.cast_add, Nat.mod_add_div m n]

name: fract_div_intCast_eq_div_intCast_mod
statement:
theorem fract_div_intCast_eq_div_intCast_mod {m : ℤ} {n : ℕ} :
    fract ((m : k) / n) = ↑(m % n) / n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  replace hn : 0 < (n : k) := by norm_cast
  have : ∀ {l : ℤ}, 0 ≤ l → fract ((l : k) / n) = ↑(l % n) / n := by
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨l₀, rfl | rfl⟩ := l.eq_nat_or_neg
    · rw [cast_natCast, ← natCast_mod, cast_natCast, fract_div_natCast_eq_div_natCast_mod]
    · rw [Right.nonneg_neg_iff, natCast_nonpos_iff] at hl
      simp [hl]
  obtain ⟨m₀, rfl | rfl⟩ := m.eq_nat_or_neg
  · exact this (natCast_nonneg m₀)
  let q := ⌈↑m₀ / (n : k)⌉
  let m₁ := q * ↑n - (↑m₀ : ℤ)
  have hm₁ : 0 ≤ m₁ := by
    simpa [m₁, ← @cast_le k, ← div_le_iff₀ hn] using FloorRing.gc_ceil_coe.le_u_l _
  calc
    fract ((Int.cast (-(m₀ : ℤ)) : k) / (n : k))
      = fract (-(m₀ : k) / n) := by simp
    _ = fract ((m₁ : k) / n) := ?_
    _ = Int.cast (m₁ % (n : ℤ)) / Nat.cast n := this hm₁
    _ = Int.cast (-(↑m₀ : ℤ) % ↑n) / Nat.cast n := ?_
  · rw [← fract_intCast_add q, ← mul_div_cancel_right₀ (q : k) hn.ne', ← add_div, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [m₁]
  · congr 2
    simp only [m₁]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm (q * ↑n), add_mul_emod_self_right]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_le_ceil_iff : 1 ≤ ⌈a⌉ ↔ 0 < a

name: ceil_le_floor_add_one

theorem ceil_le_floor_add_one (a : R) : ⌈a⌉ ≤ ⌊a⌋ + 1
proof:

  rw [ceil_le, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]
  exact (lt_floor_add_one a).le

statement: theorem ceil_nonneg_of_neg_one_lt (ha : -1 < a) : 0 ≤ ⌈a⌉

name: ceil_eq_iff
statement: theorem ceil_eq_iff : ⌈a⌉ = z ↔ ↑z - 1 < a ∧ a ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ceil_le, ← Int.cast_one, ← Int.cast_sub, ← lt_ceil, Int.sub_one_lt_iff, le_antisymm_iff,
    and_comm]

statement:

theorem ceil_eq_zero_iff : ⌈a⌉ = 0 ↔ a ∈ Ioc (-1 : R) 0

name: floor_neg
statement: theorem floor_neg : ⌊-a⌋ = -⌈a⌉
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_le_iff fun z => by rw [le_neg, ceil_le, le_floor, Int.cast_neg, le_neg]

name: ceil_neg
statement: theorem ceil_neg : ⌈-a⌉ = -⌊a⌋
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun z => by rw [neg_le, ceil_le, le_floor, Int.cast_neg, neg_le]

name: ceil_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_intCast (z : ℤ) : ⌈(z : R)⌉ = z
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun a => by rw [ceil_le, Int.cast_le]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_natCast (n : ℕ) : ⌈(n : R)⌉ = n
proof:

  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun a => by rw [ceil_le, ← cast_natCast, cast_le]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_ofNat (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] : ⌈(ofNat(n) : R)⌉ = ofNat(n)

statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_add_intCast (a : R) (z : ℤ) : ⌈a + z⌉ = ⌈a⌉ + z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_inj, neg_add', ← floor_neg, ← floor_neg, neg_add', floor_sub_intCast]

statement:

proof:

theorem ceil_sub_natCast (a : R) (n : ℕ) : ⌈a - n⌉ = ⌈a⌉ - n
proof:
:= by
  convert ceil_sub_intCast a n
  simp

statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_sub_one (a : R) : ⌈a - 1⌉ = ⌈a⌉ - 1
