name: ceil_lt_add_one
statement:
@[bound]
theorem ceil_lt_add_one (a : R) : (⌈a⌉ : R) < a + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lt_ceil, ← Int.cast_one, ceil_add_intCast]
  apply lt_add_one

name: ceil_add_le
statement:
@[bound]
theorem ceil_add_le (a b : R) : ⌈a + b⌉ ≤ ⌈a⌉ + ⌈b⌉
proof:
:= by
  rw [ceil_le, Int.cast_add]
  gcongr <;> apply le_ceil

name: ceil_add_ceil_le
statement:
@[bound]
theorem ceil_add_ceil_le (a b : R) : ⌈a⌉ + ⌈b⌉ ≤ ⌈a + b⌉ + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_sub_iff_add_le, ceil_le, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, le_sub_comm]
  refine (ceil_lt_add_one _).le.trans ?_
  rw [le_sub_iff_add_le', ← add_assoc, add_le_add_iff_right]
  exact le_ceil _

name: ceil_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_zero : ⌈(0 : R)⌉ = 0

name: ceil_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceil_one : ⌈(1 : R)⌉ = 1

name: ceil_eq_on_Ioc'
statement: theorem ceil_eq_on_Ioc' (z : ℤ) : ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioc (z - 1 : R) z, (⌈a⌉ : R) = z
proof:
:=
  fun a ha => congrArg Int.cast (ceil_eq_on_Ioc z a ha)

name: ceil_eq_self_iff_mem
statement: lemma ceil_eq_self_iff_mem (a : R) : ⌈a⌉ = a ↔ a ∈ Set.range Int.cast

name: floor_le_ceil
statement:
@[bound]
theorem floor_le_ceil (a : R) : ⌊a⌋ ≤ ⌈a⌉

name: floor_lt_ceil_of_lt
statement:
@[bound]
theorem floor_lt_ceil_of_lt {a b : R} (h : a < b) : ⌊a⌋ < ⌈b⌉

name: ceil_eq_floor_add_one_iff_notMem
statement: lemma ceil_eq_floor_add_one_iff_notMem (a : R) : ⌈a⌉ = ⌊a⌋ + 1 ↔ a ∉ Set.range Int.cast
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ht => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have h0 := ((floor_eq_self_iff_mem _).mpr ht).trans ((ceil_eq_self_iff_mem _).mpr ht).symm
    rw [h, cast_add, cast_one, left_eq_add] at h0
    exact one_ne_zero h0
  · apply le_antisymm (Int.ceil_le_floor_add_one _)
    rw [add_one_le_iff, lt_ceil]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Int.floor_le a) ((iff_false_right h).mp (floor_eq_self_iff_mem a))

name: fract_eq_zero_or_add_one_sub_ceil
statement: theorem fract_eq_zero_or_add_one_sub_ceil (a : R) : fract a = 0 ∨ fract a = a + 1 - (⌈a⌉ : R)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (fract a) 0 with ha | ha
  · exact Or.inl ha
  right
  suffices (⌈a⌉ : R) = ⌊a⌋ + 1 by
    rw [this, ← self_sub_fract]
    abel
  rw [← Int.cast_one, ← Int.cast_add]
  refine congrArg Int.cast (ceil_eq_iff.mpr ⟨?_, _root_.le_of_lt <| by simp⟩)
  rw [cast_add, cast_one, add_tsub_cancel_right, ← self_sub_fract a, sub_lt_self_iff]
  exact ha.symm.lt_of_le (fract_nonneg a)

name: ceil_eq_add_one_sub_fract
statement: theorem ceil_eq_add_one_sub_fract (ha : fract a ≠ 0) : (⌈a⌉ : R) = a + 1 - fract a

name: ceil_sub_self_eq
statement: theorem ceil_sub_self_eq (ha : fract a ≠ 0) : (⌈a⌉ : R) - a = 1 - fract a

name: mul_lt_floor
statement: lemma mul_lt_floor (hb₀ : 0 < b) (hb : b < 1) (hba : ⌈b / (1 - b)⌉ ≤ a) : b * a < ⌊a⌋
proof:
:= by
  calc
    b * a < b * (⌊a⌋ + 1) := by gcongr; apply lt_floor_add_one
    _ ≤ ⌊a⌋ := by
      rwa [_root_.mul_add_one, ← le_sub_iff_add_le', ← one_sub_mul, ← div_le_iff₀' (by linarith),
        ← ceil_le, le_floor]

name: ceil_div_ceil_inv_sub_one
statement: lemma ceil_div_ceil_inv_sub_one (ha : 1 ≤ a) : ⌈⌈(a - 1)⁻¹⌉ / a⌉ = ⌈(a - 1)⁻¹⌉
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := ha.eq_or_lt
  · simp
  have : 0 < a - 1 := by linarith
  refine le_antisymm (ceil_le.2 <| div_le_self (by positivity) ha.le) <| ?_
  rw [le_ceil_iff, sub_lt_comm, div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_one_sub,
    ← lt_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.2 <| inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ ha)]
  convert ceil_lt_add_one (R := k) _
  field

name: ceil_lt_mul
statement: lemma ceil_lt_mul (hb : 1 < b) (hba : ⌈(b - 1)⁻¹⌉ / b < a) : ⌈a⌉ < b * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain hab | hba := le_total a (b - 1)⁻¹
  · calc
      ⌈a⌉ ≤ (⌈(b - 1)⁻¹⌉ : k) := by gcongr
      _ < b * a := by rwa [← div_lt_iff₀']; positivity
  · rw [← sub_pos] at hb
    calc
      ⌈a⌉ < a + 1 := ceil_lt_add_one _
      _ = a + (b - 1) * (b - 1)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀]; positivity
      _ ≤ a + (b - 1) * a := by gcongr
      _ = b * a := by rw [sub_one_mul, add_sub_cancel]

name: ceil_le_mul
statement: lemma ceil_le_mul (hb : 1 < b) (hba : ⌈(b - 1)⁻¹⌉ / b ≤ a) : ⌈a⌉ ≤ b * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hba := hba.eq_or_lt
  · rw [ceil_div_ceil_inv_sub_one hb.le, mul_div_cancel₀]
    positivity
  · exact (ceil_lt_mul hb hba).le

name: div_two_lt_floor
statement: lemma div_two_lt_floor (ha : 1 ≤ a) : a / 2 < ⌊a⌋
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul]; refine mul_lt_floor ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> norm_num; assumption

name: ceil_lt_two_mul
statement: lemma ceil_lt_two_mul (ha : 2⁻¹ < a) : ⌈a⌉ < 2 * a
proof:
:=
  ceil_lt_mul one_lt_two (by norm_num at ha ⊢; exact ha)

name: ceil_le_two_mul
statement: lemma ceil_le_two_mul (ha : 2⁻¹ ≤ a) : ⌈a⌉ ≤ 2 * a
proof:
:=
  ceil_le_mul one_lt_two (by norm_num at ha ⊢; exact ha)

name: preimage_Ioo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preimage_Ioo {a b : R} : ((↑) : ℤ → R) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b = Set.Ioo ⌊a⌋ ⌈b⌉

name: preimage_Ico
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preimage_Ico {a b : R} : ((↑) : ℤ → R) ⁻¹' Set.Ico a b = Set.Ico ⌈a⌉ ⌈b⌉

name: preimage_Ioc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preimage_Ioc {a b : R} : ((↑) : ℤ → R) ⁻¹' Set.Ioc a b = Set.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋

name: preimage_Icc
statement:

name: mul_lt_floor
statement: lemma mul_lt_floor (hb₀ : 0 < b) (hb : b < 1) (hba : ⌈b / (1 - b)⌉₊ ≤ a) : b * a < ⌊a⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  calc
    b * a < b * (⌊a⌋₊ + 1) := by gcongr; apply lt_floor_add_one
    _ ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ := by
      rw [_root_.mul_add_one, ← le_sub_iff_add_le', ← one_sub_mul, ← div_le_iff₀' (by linarith),
        ← ceil_le]
      exact le_floor hba

name: ceil_lt_mul
statement: lemma ceil_lt_mul (hb : 1 < b) (hba : ⌈(b - 1)⁻¹⌉₊ / b < a) : ⌈a⌉₊ < b * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain hab | hba := le_total a (b - 1)⁻¹
  · calc
      ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ (⌈(b - 1)⁻¹⌉₊ : K) := by gcongr
      _ < b * a := by rwa [← div_lt_iff₀']; positivity
  · rw [← sub_pos] at hb
    calc
      ⌈a⌉₊ < a + 1 := ceil_lt_add_one <| hba.trans' <| by positivity
      _ = a + (b - 1) * (b - 1)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀]; positivity
      _ ≤ a + (b - 1) * a := by gcongr
      _ = b * a := by rw [sub_one_mul, add_sub_cancel]

name: ceil_le_mul
statement: lemma ceil_le_mul (hb : 1 < b) (hba : ⌈(b - 1)⁻¹⌉₊ / b ≤ a) : ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ b * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hba := hba.eq_or_lt
  · rw [mul_div_cancel₀, cast_le, ceil_le]
    · exact _root_.div_le_self (by positivity) hb.le
    · positivity
  · exact (ceil_lt_mul hb hba).le

statement:
@[push]
theorem floor_add_natCast [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (ha : 0 ≤ a) (n : ℕ) : ⌊a + n⌋₊ = ⌊a⌋₊ + n
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_le_iff fun b => by
    rw [le_floor_iff (add_nonneg ha n.cast_nonneg)]
    obtain hb | hb := le_total n b
    · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hb
      rw [Nat.cast_add, add_comm n, add_comm (n : R), add_le_add_iff_right, add_le_add_iff_right,
        le_floor_iff ha]
    · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hb
      rw [Nat.cast_add, add_left_comm _ b, add_left_comm _ (b : R)]
      refine iff_of_true ?_ le_self_add
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right <| ha.trans <| le_add_of_nonneg_right d.cast_nonneg

@[simp]
theorem floor_sub_natCast [Sub R] [OrderedSub R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (a : R) (n : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain ha | ha := le_total a 0
  · rw [floor_of_nonpos ha, floor_of_nonpos (tsub_nonpos_of_le (ha.trans n.cast_nonneg)), zero_tsub]
  rcases le_total a n with h | h
  · rw [floor_of_nonpos (tsub_nonpos_of_le h), eq_comm, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le]
    exact Nat.cast_le.1 ((Nat.floor_le ha).trans h)
  · rw [eq_tsub_iff_add_eq_of_le (le_floor h), ← floor_add_natCast _, tsub_add_cancel_of_le h]
    exact le_tsub_of_add_le_left ((add_zero _).trans_le h)

theorem floor_congr [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [IsStrictOrderedRing S]

  have h₀ : 0 ≤ a ↔ 0 ≤ b := by simpa only [cast_zero] using h 0
  obtain ha | ha := lt_or_ge a 0
  · rw [floor_of_nonpos ha.le, floor_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge <| h₀.not.mp ha.not_ge)]

name: subsingleton_floorSemiring
statement:
theorem subsingleton_floorSemiring {R} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] :
    Subsingleton (FloorSemiring R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H₁ H₂ => ?_⟩
  have : H₁.ceil = H₂.ceil := funext fun a => (H₁.gc_ceil.l_unique H₂.gc_ceil) fun n => rfl
  have : H₁.floor = H₂.floor := by
    ext a
    rcases lt_or_ge a 0 with h | h
    · rw [H₁.floor_of_neg, H₂.floor_of_neg] <;> exact h
    · refine eq_of_forall_le_iff fun n => ?_
      rw [H₁.gc_floor, H₂.gc_floor] <;> exact h
  cases H₁
  cases H₂
  congr

proof:

  by_cases hb : b = 0; · rw [hb, mul_zero, ← coe_zero, untopD_coe, mul_zero]
  cases a; · rw [top_mul hb, untopD_top, zero_mul]

proof:
:= by
  lift a to α using hinf
  rintro b c hbc
  lift b to α using hbc.ne_top
  match c with
  | ⊤ => simp [← coe_mul, mul_top h₀.ne']

  simp only [coe_pos, coe_lt_coe, ← coe_mul, gt_iff_lt] at *
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hbc h₀

name: mul_lt_mul
statement:
@[gcongr]
protected lemma mul_lt_mul (ha : a₁ < a₂) (hb : b₁ < b₂) : a₁ * b₁ < a₂ * b₂
proof:
:= by
  have := posMulStrictMono_iff_mulPosStrictMono.1 ‹_›
  lift a₁ to α using ha.lt_top.ne
  lift b₁ to α using hb.lt_top.ne
  obtain rfl | ha₂ := eq_or_ne a₂ ⊤
  · rw [top_mul (by simpa [bot_eq_zero] using hb.bot_lt.ne')]
    exact coe_lt_top _
  obtain rfl | hb₂ := eq_or_ne b₂ ⊤
  · rw [mul_top (by simpa [bot_eq_zero] using ha.bot_lt.ne')]
    exact coe_lt_top _
  lift a₂ to α using ha₂
  lift b₂ to α using hb₂
  norm_cast at *
  exact CanonicallyOrderedAdd.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt ha hb

name: pow_right_strictMono
statement:
protected lemma pow_right_strictMono : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → StrictMono fun a : WithTop α ↦ a ^ n
  | 0, h => absurd rfl h
  | 1, _ => by simpa only [pow_one] using! strictMono_id
  | n + 2, _ => fun x y h ↦ by
    simp_rw [pow_succ _ (n + 1)]
    exact WithTop.mul_lt_mul (WithTop.pow_right_strictMono n.succ_ne_zero h) h

proof:

name: Commute.pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg
statement:
lemma Commute.pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg (Hcomm : Commute a b) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (Hsq : 0 ≤ b ^ 2) (Hsq' : 0 ≤ (a + b) ^ 2) (H : 0 ≤ 2 * a + b) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ n + n * a ^ (n - 1) * b ≤ (a + b) ^ n
  | 0 => by simp
  | 1 => by simp
  | 2 =>
    calc
      a ^ 2 + (2 : ℕ) * a ^ 1 * b ≤ a ^ 2 + (2 : ℕ) * a ^ 1 * b + b ^ 2
proof:
:=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right Hsq
      _ = (a + b) ^ 2 := by simp [sq, add_mul, mul_add, two_mul, Hcomm.eq, add_assoc]
  | n + 3 => by
    calc
      _ ≤ a ^ (n + 3) + ↑(n + 3) * a ^ (n + 2) * b +
            ((n + 1) * (b ^ 2 * (2 * a + b) * a ^ n) + a ^ (n + 1) * b ^ 2) :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right <| by
          apply_rules [add_nonneg, mul_nonneg, Nat.cast_nonneg, pow_nonneg, zero_le_one]
      _ = (a + b) ^ 2 * (a ^ (n + 1) + ↑(n + 1) * a ^ n * b) := by
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_succ', add_mul, mul_add,
          two_mul, pow_zero, mul_one,
          Hcomm.eq, (n.cast_commute (_ : R)).symm.left_comm, mul_assoc, (Hcomm.pow_left _).eq,
          (Hcomm.pow_left _).left_comm, Hcomm.left_comm, ← @two_add_one_eq_three R, one_mul]
        abel
      _ ≤ (a + b) ^ 2 * (a + b) ^ (n + 1) := by
        gcongr
        apply Commute.pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg <;> assumption
      _ = (a + b) ^ (n + 3) := by simp [pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: one_add_mul_le_pow_of_sq_nonneg
statement:
lemma one_add_mul_le_pow_of_sq_nonneg (Hsq : 0 ≤ a ^ 2) (Hsq' : 0 ≤ (1 + a) ^ 2) (H : 0 ≤ 2 + a)
    (n : ℕ) : 1 + n * a ≤ (1 + a) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (Commute.one_left a).pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg zero_le_one Hsq Hsq'
    (by simpa using H) n

    (n : ℕ) : a ^ n + n * a ^ (n - 1) * b ≤ (a + b) ^ n

  (Commute.all a b).pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg ha Hsq Hsq' H n

name: one_add_mul_sub_le_pow
statement: lemma one_add_mul_sub_le_pow (H : -1 ≤ a) (n : ℕ) : 1 + n * (a - 1) ≤ a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have : -2 ≤ a - 1 := by
    rwa [← one_add_one_eq_two, neg_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_le_sub_iff_right]
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using one_add_mul_le_pow this n

name: mk_eq_mk
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk {x y : FiniteElement K} : mk x = mk y ↔ 0 < ArchimedeanClass.mk (x.1 - y.1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Quotient.eq.trans
  rw [Submodule.quotientRel_def, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff,
    FiniteElement.not_isUnit_iff_mk_pos, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub]

name: mk_le_mk

proof:

name: mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left'
statement:
private theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left' {x y z : FiniteResidueField K} (h : x ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    z * x ≤ z * y
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | mk x
  induction y with | mk y
  induction z with | mk z
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  rw [← map_zero mk] at hz
  rw [mk_le_mk] at h hz ⊢
  grind [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left]

name: mk_ratCast
statement:

theorem mk_ratCast (q : ℚ) : mk (q : FiniteElement K) = q
proof:
:= by

  cases q with | div n d hd
  rw [← mul_left_inj' (c := ↑d) (mod_cast hd), ← map_natCast mk d, ← map_mul,
    ← FiniteElement.mk_natCast, FiniteElement.mk_mul_mk]
  simp_all

proof:

name: stdPart_of_mk_nonneg
statement:
theorem stdPart_of_mk_nonneg (f : FiniteResidueField K →+*o ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ mk x) :

proof:

  rw [stdPart, dite_eq_left h, OrderRingHom.comp_apply]

  exact Subsingleton.allEq _ _

name: stdPart_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stdPart_eq_zero {x : K} : stdPart x = 0 ↔ mk x ≠ 0 where
  mpr h
proof:
:= by
    obtain h | h := h.lt_or_gt
    · exact dite_eq_right h.not_ge
    · rw [stdPart, dite_eq_left h.le, OrderRingHom.comp_apply, FiniteResidueField.mk_eq_zero.2 h,
        map_zero]
  mp := by
    contrapose!
    intro h
    rwa [stdPart_of_mk_nonneg Classical.ofNonempty h.ge, map_ne_zero, FiniteResidueField.mk_ne_zero]

name: stdPart_monotoneOn
statement: theorem stdPart_monotoneOn : MonotoneOn stdPart {x : K | 0 ≤ mk x}
proof:
:= by
  intro x (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) y (hy : 0 ≤ mk y) h
  unfold stdPart
  rw [dite_eq_left hx, dite_eq_left hy]
  apply OrderRingHom.monotone'
  rwa [FiniteElement.mk_le_mk]

theorem stdPart_zero : stdPart (0 : K) = 0

theorem stdPart_one : stdPart (1 : K) = 1

name: stdPart_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stdPart_neg (x : K) : stdPart (-x) = -stdPart x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [stdPart, ArchimedeanClass.mk_neg]
  split_ifs
  · rw [← FiniteElement.neg_mk, map_neg]
  · simp

name: stdPart_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stdPart_inv (x : K) : stdPart x⁻¹ = (stdPart x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain hx | hx := eq_or_ne (mk x) 0
  · unfold stdPart
    have hx' : 0 ≤ mk x⁻¹ := by simp_all
    rw [dite_eq_left hx.ge, dite_eq_left hx']
    · apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
      suffices FiniteElement.mk x⁻¹ hx' * .mk x hx.ge = 1 by
        rw [← map_mul, this, map_one]
      ext
      apply inv_mul_cancel₀
      aesop
  · rw [stdPart_of_mk_ne_zero hx, stdPart_of_mk_ne_zero, inv_zero]
    rwa [mk_inv, neg_ne_zero]

name: stdPart_add
statement: theorem stdPart_add (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) (hy : 0 ≤ mk y) : stdPart (x + y) = stdPart x + stdPart y
proof:
:= by
  unfold stdPart
  rw [dite_eq_left hx, dite_eq_left hy, dite_eq_left]
  exact map_add _ (FiniteElement.mk x hx) (.mk y hy)

name: stdPart_add_eq_right
statement: theorem stdPart_add_eq_right (hx : 0 < mk x) : stdPart (x + y) = stdPart y
proof:
:= by
  obtain hy | hy := le_or_gt 0 (mk y)
  · rw [stdPart_add hx.le hy, stdPart_of_mk_ne_zero hx.ne', zero_add]
  · rw [stdPart_of_mk_ne_zero hy.ne, stdPart_of_mk_ne_zero]
    rw [mk_add_eq_mk_right (hy.trans hx)]
    exact hy.ne

name: stdPart_add_eq_left
statement: theorem stdPart_add_eq_left (hy : 0 < mk y) : stdPart (x + y) = stdPart x

name: stdPart_sub
statement: theorem stdPart_sub (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) (hy : 0 ≤ mk y) : stdPart (x - y) = stdPart x - stdPart y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, stdPart_add hx, stdPart_neg]
  rwa [mk_neg]

name: stdPart_sub_eq_left

name: stdPart_mul

  exact map_mul _ (FiniteElement.mk x hx) (.mk y hy)

name: stdPart_div
statement:
theorem stdPart_div (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) (hy : 0 ≤ -mk y) :

  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, stdPart_mul hx, stdPart_inv]

name: mk_sub_pos_iff
statement:
theorem mk_sub_pos_iff (f : ℝ →+*o K) {r : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) :
    0 < mk (x - f r) ↔ stdPart x = r
proof:
:= by
  refine (FiniteResidueField.mk_eq_zero
    (x := .mk x hx - .mk _ (mk_map_nonneg_of_archimedean f r))).symm.trans ?_
  rw [map_sub, ← FiniteResidueField.ofArchimedean_apply, ← ofArchimedean_stdPart f hx,
    sub_eq_zero, FiniteResidueField.ofArchimedean_inj f]

name: lt_of_lt_stdPart
statement: theorem lt_of_lt_stdPart (f : ℝ →+*o K) {r : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) (h : r < stdPart x) : f r < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_lt_sub_iff_right (c := f (stdPart x)), ← map_sub]
  apply lt_of_mk_lt_mk_of_nonpos
  · rw [mk_map_of_archimedean', mk_sub_pos_iff f hx]
    rw [ne_eq, sub_eq_zero]
    exact h.ne
  · simpa using f.monotone' h.le

name: stdPart_eq
statement:
theorem stdPart_eq (f : ℝ →+*o K) {r : ℝ} (hl : ∀ s < r, f s ≤ x) (hr : ∀ s > r, x ≤ f s) :
    stdPart x = r
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 ≤ mk x := by
    apply mk_nonneg_of_le_of_le_of_archimedean f (hl (r - 1) _) (hr (r + 1) _) <;> simp
  obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy (stdPart x) r
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := exists_between h
    cases (le_stdPart_of_le f hx (hl _ hs')).not_gt hs
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := exists_between h
    cases (stdPart_le_of_le f hx (hr _ hs)).not_gt hs'

name: stdPart_eq_sInf
statement: theorem stdPart_eq_sInf (f : ℝ →+*o K) (x : K) : stdPart x = sInf {r | x < f r}
proof:
:= by
  obtain hx | hx := le_or_gt 0 (mk x)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_int_lt_of_mk_nonneg hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_int_gt_of_mk_nonneg hx
    have hn : {r | x < f r}.Nonempty := ⟨b, by simpa using hb⟩
    have hb : BddBelow {r | x < f r} := by
      refine ⟨a, fun r hr ↦ ?_⟩
      by_contra! hra
      exact (f.monotone' hra.le).not_gt (by simpa using ha.trans hr)
    apply stdPart_eq f <;> intro r hr
    · simpa using notMem_of_lt_csInf hr hb
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := (csInf_lt_iff hb hn).1 hr
      exact hs.le.trans (f.monotone' hs'.le)
  · rw [stdPart_of_mk_ne_zero hx.ne]
    have hr {r} := hx.trans_le (mk_map_nonneg_of_archimedean f r)
    obtain h | h := le_or_gt 0 x
    · convert! Real.sInf_empty.symm
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      exact fun r ↦ (lt_of_mk_lt_mk_of_nonneg hr h).not_gt
    · convert! Real.sInf_univ.symm
      rw [Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
      exact fun r ↦ lt_of_mk_lt_mk_of_nonpos hr h.le

name: stdPart_eq_sSup
statement: theorem stdPart_eq_sSup (f : ℝ →+*o K) (x : K) : stdPart x = sSup {r | f r < x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_inj, ← stdPart_neg, stdPart_eq_sInf f, ← Real.sInf_neg]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp [neg_lt]

name: Nat.exists_add_mul_eq_of_gcd_dvd_of_mul_pred_le
statement:
theorem Nat.exists_add_mul_eq_of_gcd_dvd_of_mul_pred_le (p q n : ℕ) (dvd : p.gcd q ∣ n)
    (le : p.pred * q.pred ≤ n) : ∃ a b : ℕ, a * p + b * q = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | p := p
  · have ⟨b, eq⟩ := q.gcd_zero_left ▸ dvd
    exact ⟨0, b, by simpa [mul_comm, eq_comm] using eq⟩
  obtain _ | q := q
  · have ⟨a, eq⟩ := p.gcd_zero_right ▸ dvd
    exact ⟨a, 0, by simpa [mul_comm, eq_comm] using eq⟩
  rw [← Int.gcd_natCast_natCast, Int.gcd_dvd_iff] at dvd
  have ⟨a_n, b_n, eq⟩ := dvd
  let a := a_n % q.succ
  let b := b_n + a_n / q.succ * p.succ
  refine ⟨a.toNat, b.toNat, Nat.cast_injective (R := ℤ) ?_⟩
  have : a * p.succ + b * q.succ = n := by rw [add_mul, ← add_assoc,
    add_right_comm, mul_right_comm, ← add_mul, Int.emod_add_ediv_mul, eq, mul_comm, mul_comm b_n]
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Int.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr
    (Int.emod_nonneg _ <| by lia), Int.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr, this]
  
  by_contra hb
  replace hb : b ≤ -1 := by lia
  apply lt_irrefl (n : ℤ)
  have ha := Int.emod_lt a_n (by lia : (q.succ : ℤ) ≠ 0)
  rw [p.pred_succ, q.pred_succ] at le
  calc n = a * p.succ + b * q.succ := this.symm
       _ ≤ q * p.succ + -1 * q.succ := by gcongr <;> lia
       _ = p * q - 1 := by simp_rw [Nat.cast_succ, mul_add, mul_comm]; lia
       _ ≤ n - 1 := by rwa [sub_le_sub_iff_right, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_le]
       _ < n := by lia

protected lemma mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt
    [PosMulStrictMono R] {a b c d : R} (hab : a < b) (hcd : c < d) :

name: mul_tsub
statement:
protected theorem mul_tsub {a b c : R}
    (h : AddLECancellable (a * c)) : a * (b - c) = a * b - a * c
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hbc | hcb) := total_of (· ≤ ·) b c
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 hbc, mul_zero, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 (mul_le_mul_right hbc a)]
  · apply h.eq_tsub_of_add_eq
    rw [← mul_add, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hcb]

name: tsub_mul
statement:
protected theorem tsub_mul [MulRightMono R] {a b c : R}
    (h : AddLECancellable (b * c)) : (a - b) * c = a * c - b * c
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hab | hba) := total_of (· ≤ ·) a b
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 hab, zero_mul, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 (mul_le_mul_left hab c)]
  · apply h.eq_tsub_of_add_eq
    rw [← add_mul, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hba]

statement: @[simp] lemma top_ne_zero : (⊤ : ArchimedeanClass R) ≠ 0

name: zero_ne_top
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_ne_top : 0 ≠ (⊤ : ArchimedeanClass R)

name: mk_mul_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem mk_mul_le_of_le {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : R} (hx : mk x₁ ≤ mk x₂) (hy : mk y₁ ≤ mk y₂) :
    mk (x₁ * y₁) ≤ mk (x₂ * y₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hy
  use m * n
  convert mul_le_mul hm hn (abs_nonneg _) (nsmul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) <;>
    simp_rw [ArchimedeanOrder.val_of, abs_mul]
  ring

name: mk_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_mul (x y : R) : mk (x * y) = mk x + mk y

name: mk_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_pow (n : ℕ) (x : R) : mk (x ^ n) = n • mk x

name: zero_add'
statement: private theorem zero_add' (x : ArchimedeanClass R) : 0 + x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | mk x
  rw [← mk_one, ← mk_mul, one_mul]

name: add_assoc'
statement: private theorem add_assoc' (x y z : ArchimedeanClass R) : x + y + z = x + (y + z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | mk x
  induction y with | mk y
  induction z with | mk z
  simp_rw [← mk_mul, mul_assoc]

name: isAddRegular_mk
statement: lemma isAddRegular_mk {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) : IsAddRegular (mk x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isAddLeftRegular_iff_isAddRegular]
  rintro y z hyz
  induction y with | mk y =>
  induction z with | mk z =>
  simpa [← mk_mul, mk_eq_mk, mul_left_comm _ (|x|), abs_pos.2 hx] using hyz

name: addValuation_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem addValuation_apply (a : R) : addValuation R a = mk a

name: orderHom_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderHom_zero (f : S →+o R) : orderHom f 0 = mk (f 1)

name: mk_eq_zero_of_archimedean
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_zero_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] {x : S} (h : x ≠ 0) : mk x = 0

name: eq_zero_or_top_of_archimedean
statement: theorem eq_zero_or_top_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (x : ArchimedeanClass S) : x = 0 ∨ x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | mk x
  obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne x 0 <;> simp_all

name: mk_map_of_archimedean
statement:
theorem mk_map_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+o R) {x : S} (h : x ≠ 0) :
    mk (f x) = mk (f 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orderHom_mk, mk_eq_zero_of_archimedean h, orderHom_zero]

name: mk_map_of_archimedean'
statement:
theorem mk_map_of_archimedean' [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R) {x : S} (h : x ≠ 0) :
    mk (f x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mk_map_of_archimedean f.toOrderAddMonoidHom h

name: mk_le_mk_add_of_archimedean
statement:
theorem mk_le_mk_add_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R) (x : R) (y : S) :
    mk x ≤ mk (f y) + mk x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hy := eq_or_ne y 0
  · simp
  · rw [mk_map_of_archimedean' f hy, zero_add]

name: mk_le_add_mk_of_archimedean
statement:
theorem mk_le_add_mk_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R) (x : R) (y : S) :
    mk x ≤ mk x + mk (f y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact mk_le_mk_add_of_archimedean f x y

name: mk_map_nonneg_of_archimedean
statement: theorem mk_map_nonneg_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R) (y : S) : 0 ≤ mk (f y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mk_le_mk_add_of_archimedean f 1 y

name: lt_of_pos_of_archimedean
statement:
theorem lt_of_pos_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R)
    {x : R} (hx : 0 < mk x) {y : S} (hy : 0 < y) : x < f y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_mk_lt_mk_of_nonneg
  · rwa [mk_map_of_archimedean' f hy.ne']
  · simpa using f.monotone' hy.le

name: lt_of_neg_of_archimedean
statement:
theorem lt_of_neg_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R)
    {x : R} (hx : 0 < mk x) {y : S} (hy : y < 0) : f y < x
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_mk_lt_mk_of_nonpos
  · rwa [mk_map_of_archimedean' f hy.ne]
  · simpa using f.monotone' hy.le

name: mk_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_intCast {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) : mk (n : S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial S
  · exact Subsingleton.allEq ..
  · exact mk_map_of_archimedean' ⟨Int.castRingHom S, fun _ ↦ by simp⟩ h

name: mk_intCast_nonneg
statement: theorem mk_intCast_nonneg (n : ℤ) : 0 ≤ mk (n : S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  · rw [mk_intCast hn]

name: mk_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_natCast {n : ℕ} : n ≠ 0 → mk (n : S) = 0

name: mk_ofNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_ofNat {n : ℕ} [n.AtLeastTwo] : mk (ofNat(n) : S) = 0

name: mk_natCast_nonneg
statement: theorem mk_natCast_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ mk (n : S)

name: exists_nat_ge_of_mk_nonneg
statement: theorem exists_nat_ge_of_mk_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) : ∃ n : ℕ, x ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨n, le_of_abs_le ?_⟩
  simpa using hn

name: exists_nat_gt_of_mk_nonneg
statement: theorem exists_nat_gt_of_mk_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) : ∃ n : ℕ, x < n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge_of_mk_nonneg hx
  refine ⟨n + 1, hn.trans_lt ?_⟩
  simp

name: exists_int_ge_of_mk_nonneg
statement: theorem exists_int_ge_of_mk_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) : ∃ n : ℤ, x ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge_of_mk_nonneg hx
  exact ⟨n, mod_cast hn⟩

name: exists_int_gt_of_mk_nonneg
statement: theorem exists_int_gt_of_mk_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) : ∃ n : ℤ, x < n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt_of_mk_nonneg hx
  exact ⟨n, mod_cast hn⟩

name: exists_int_le_of_mk_nonneg
statement: theorem exists_int_le_of_mk_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) : ∃ n : ℤ, n ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge_of_mk_nonneg (mk_neg x ▸ hx)
  use -n
  simpa [neg_le]

name: exists_int_lt_of_mk_nonneg
statement: theorem exists_int_lt_of_mk_nonneg {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ mk x) : ∃ n : ℤ, n < x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt_of_mk_nonneg (mk_neg x ▸ hx)
  use -n
  simpa [neg_lt]

name: mk_nonneg_of_le_of_le_of_archimedean
statement:
theorem mk_nonneg_of_le_of_le_of_archimedean [Archimedean S] (f : S →+*o R) {x : R} {r s : S}
    (hr : f r ≤ x) (hs : x ≤ f s) : 0 ≤ mk x

name: add_left_cancel_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem add_left_cancel_of_ne_top {x y z : ArchimedeanClass R} (hx : x ≠ ⊤) (h : x + y = x + z) :
    y = z

name: add_right_cancel_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem add_right_cancel_of_ne_top {x y z : ArchimedeanClass R} (hx : x ≠ ⊤) (h : y + x = z + x) :
    y = z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← add_comm x] at h
  exact add_left_cancel_of_ne_top hx h

name: mk_le_mk_iff_denselyOrdered
statement:
theorem mk_le_mk_iff_denselyOrdered [Ring S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S]
    [DenselyOrdered R] [Archimedean R] {x y : S} (f : R →+* S) (hf : StrictMono f) :
    mk x ≤ mk y ↔ ∃ q : R, 0 < f q ∧ f q * |y| ≤ |x|
proof:
:= by
  have H {q} : 0 < f q ↔ 0 < q := by simpa using hf.lt_iff_lt (a := 0)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨(_ | n), hn⟩
    · simp_all [exists_zero_lt]
    · obtain ⟨q, hq₀, hq⟩ := exists_nsmul_lt_of_pos (one_pos (α := R)) (n + 1)
      refine ⟨q, H.2 hq₀, le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ n.cast_add_one_pos⟩
      simpa [← mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul (hf hq).le hn (abs_nonneg y) (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨q, hq₀, hq⟩
    have hq₀' := H.1 hq₀
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_lt_nsmul hq₀' 1
    refine ⟨n, le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hq₀⟩
    have h : 0 ≤ f (n • q) := by
      rw [← f.map_zero]
      exact hf.monotone (nsmul_nonneg hq₀'.le n)
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul (hf hn).le hq (mul_nonneg hq₀.le (abs_nonneg y)) h

name: mk_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_inv (x : R) : mk x⁻¹ = -mk x

name: mk_zpow
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_zpow (n : ℤ) (x : R) : mk (x ^ n) = n • mk x

name: zsmul_succ'
statement:
private theorem zsmul_succ' (n : ℕ) (x : ArchimedeanClass R) :
    (n.succ : ℤ) • x = (n : ℤ) • x + x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | mk x
  rw [← mk_zpow, Nat.cast_succ]
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp [zero_zpow _ n.cast_add_one_ne_zero]
  · rw [zpow_add_one₀ hx, mk_mul, mk_zpow]

name: mk_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_div (x y : R) : mk (x / y) = mk x - mk y

name: mk_ratCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_ratCast {q : ℚ} (h : q ≠ 0) : mk (q : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mk_map_of_archimedean ⟨(Rat.castHom R).toAddMonoidHom, fun _ ↦ by simp⟩ h

name: mk_ratCast_nonneg
statement: theorem mk_ratCast_nonneg (q : ℚ) : 0 ≤ mk (q : R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne q 0
  · simp
  · rw [mk_ratCast hn]

name: mk_le_mk_iff_ratCast
statement: theorem mk_le_mk_iff_ratCast {x y : R} : mk x ≤ mk y ↔ ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ q * |y| ≤ |x|
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mk_le_mk_iff_denselyOrdered (Rat.castHom _) Rat.cast_strictMono (x := x)

name: add_le
statement:
theorem add_le [Semiring R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [Add α] (f_nonneg : ∀ x : α, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hna : IsNonarchimedean f) : f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (hna _ _)
  rw [max_le_iff, le_add_iff_nonneg_right, le_add_iff_nonneg_left]
  exact ⟨f_nonneg _, f_nonneg _⟩

name: nsmul_le
statement: theorem nsmul_le (f_zero_le : f 0 ≤ f a) : f (n • a) ≤ f a
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using f_zero_le
  | succ n _ =>
    rw [add_nsmul]
    apply le_trans <| hna (n • a) (1 • a)
    simpa

name: nsmul_le_of_pos
statement:
theorem nsmul_le_of_pos (hn : 0 < n) :
    f (n • a) ≤ f a
proof:
:= by
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ n _ ih =>
    rw [succ_nsmul]
    exact (hna _ _).trans (max_le ih (by simp))

name: nmul_le
statement: theorem nmul_le (f_zero_le : f 0 ≤ f a) : f (n * a) ≤ f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact hna.nsmul_le f_zero_le

name: nmul_le_of_pos
statement: theorem nmul_le_of_pos (a : α) (hn : 0 < n) : f (n * a) ≤ f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact hna.nsmul_le_of_pos hn

name: add_eq_right_of_lt
statement: lemma add_eq_right_of_lt : f (a + b) = f b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have h1 : f (a + b) ≤ f b := (hna a b).trans_eq (max_eq_right_of_lt h_lt)
  apply lt_irrefl (f b)
  calc
    f b = f (-a + (a + b)) := by simp
    _   ≤ max (f (-a)) (f (a + b)) := hna (-a) (a + b)
    _   < max (f b) (f b) := by
      rw [max_self, f_neg]
      exact max_lt h_lt <| lt_of_le_of_ne h1 h
    _   = f b := max_self (f b)

name: add_eq_left_of_lt
statement: lemma add_eq_left_of_lt : f (b + a) = f b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have h1 : f (b + a) ≤ f b := (hna b a).trans_eq (max_eq_left_of_lt h_lt)
  apply lt_irrefl (f b)
  calc
    f b = f (b + a + -a) := by simp
    _   ≤ max (f (b + a)) (f (-a)) := hna (b + a) (-a)
    _   < max (f b) (f b) := by
      rw [max_self, f_neg]
      exact max_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne h1 h) h_lt
    _   = f b := max_self (f b)

name: add_eq_max_of_ne
statement: theorem add_eq_max_of_ne (hne : f a ≠ f b) : f (a + b) = max (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hne.lt_or_gt with h_lt | h_lt
  · rw [hna.add_eq_right_of_lt f_neg h_lt]
    exact (max_eq_right_of_lt h_lt).symm
  · rw [hna.add_eq_left_of_lt f_neg h_lt]
    exact (max_eq_left_of_lt h_lt).symm

name: apply_natCast_le_one
statement:
lemma apply_natCast_le_one [AddMonoidWithOne α] [One R] (f_zero_le : f 0 ≤ f 1) (f_one : f 1 = 1)
    (hna : IsNonarchimedean f) : f n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nsmul_one n, ← f_one]
  exact hna.nsmul_le f_zero_le

name: apply_intCast_le_one
statement:
theorem apply_intCast_le_one [One R] [AddGroupWithOne α] (f_zero_le : f 0 ≤ f 1) (f_one : f 1 = 1)
    (f_neg : ∀ a, f (-a) = f a) (hna : IsNonarchimedean f) {n : ℤ} : f n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg n <;>
  simp [f_neg, hna.apply_natCast_le_one f_zero_le f_one]

name: multiset_image_add_of_nonempty
statement: theorem multiset_image_add_of_nonempty (hs : s ≠ 0) : ∃ b ∈ s, f (s.map g).sum ≤ f (g b)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => contradiction
  | cons a s h =>
    simp only [mem_cons, map_cons, sum_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
    by_cases h1 : s = 0
    · simp [h1]
    · obtain ⟨w, h2, h3⟩ := h h1
      rcases le_max_iff.mp <| hna (g a) (s.map g).sum with h4 | h4
      · exact .inl h4
      · exact .inr ⟨w, h2, le_trans h4 h3⟩

name: multiset_image_add
statement:
theorem multiset_image_add [Nonempty β] (s : Multiset β) (f_zero_le : ∀ x, f 0 ≤ f x) :
    ∃ b : β, (s ≠ 0 → b ∈ s) ∧ f (s.map g).sum ≤ f (g b)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    exact ⟨Classical.arbitrary β, by simp, by simpa using f_zero_le _⟩
  | cons a s h =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb1, hb2⟩ := hna.multiset_image_add_of_nonempty (s := a ::ₘ s) g
      Multiset.cons_ne_zero
    exact ⟨b, fun _ ↦ hb1, hb2⟩

name: multiset_powerset_image_add
statement:
theorem multiset_powerset_image_add (n : ℕ) [CommMonoid α] (s : Multiset α) :
    ∃ t : Multiset α, card t = card s - n ∧ (∀ x : α, x ∈ t → x ∈ s) ∧
    f (map prod (powersetCard (card s - n) s)).sum ≤ f t.prod
proof:
:= by
  set g := fun t : Multiset α ↦ t.prod
  have hne : powersetCard (card s - n) s ≠ 0 := card_pos.mp
    (card_powersetCard (s.card - n) s ▸ Nat.choose_pos ((card s).sub_le n))
  obtain ⟨b, hb_in, hb_le⟩ := hna.multiset_image_add_of_nonempty g hne
  have hb : b ≤ s ∧ card b = card s - n := by
    rw [← mem_powersetCard]
    exact hb_in
  exact ⟨b, hb.2, fun x hx ↦ mem_of_le hb.left hx, hb_le⟩

name: apply_sum_le_sup
statement: lemma apply_sum_le_sup (hne : s.Nonempty) : f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ s.sup' hne fun i => f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  induction hne using Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton i => simp
  | cons i s _ hs hind =>
    simp only [sum_cons, le_sup'_iff, mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
    rw [← le_sup'_iff hs]
    rcases le_max_iff.mp <| hna (g i) (∑ i ∈ s, g i) with h₁ | h₂
    · exact .inl h₁
    · exact .inr <| le_trans h₂ hind

name: finset_image_add_of_nonempty
statement: theorem finset_image_add_of_nonempty (hs : s.Nonempty) : ∃ b ∈ s, f (s.sum g) ≤ f (g b)

name: finset_image_add
statement:
lemma finset_image_add [Nonempty β] (f_zero_le : ∀ x, f 0 ≤ f x) :
    ∃ i, (s.Nonempty → i ∈ s) ∧ f (s.sum g) ≤ f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hs
  · let b := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty β)
    exact ⟨b, by simp, by simpa using f_zero_le (g b)⟩
  · exact (fun ⟨i, h, h'⟩ => ⟨i, fun _ ↦ h, h'⟩) <| hna.finset_image_add_of_nonempty g hs

name: finset_powerset_image_add
statement:
theorem finset_powerset_image_add [CommMonoid α] : ∃ u : s.powersetCard (s.card - n),
    f ((s.powersetCard (s.card - n)).sum fun t ↦ ∏ i ∈ t, g i) ≤ f (∏ i ∈ u.val, g i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb_in, hb⟩ := hna.finset_image_add_of_nonempty (fun t ↦ ∏ i ∈ t, g i)
    (powersetCard_nonempty.mpr (s.card.sub_le n))
  exact ⟨⟨b, hb_in⟩, hb⟩

name: apply_sum_eq_of_lt
statement:
lemma apply_sum_eq_of_lt [AddCommGroup α] (hna : IsNonarchimedean f)
    (f_neg : ∀ a, f (-a) = f a) {s : Finset β} {k : β} (hk : k ∈ s)
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ k → f (g j) < f (g k)) : f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = f (g k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcard : s.card = 1
  · grind [Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard]
  · classical
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hk]
    have hNonempty : (s.erase k).Nonempty :=
      Finset.Nontrivial.erase_nonempty (Finset.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (by grind))
    have hrest_le := hna.apply_sum_le_sup hNonempty (g := g)
    simp only [Finset.le_sup'_iff, Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq] at hrest_le
    rw [hna.add_eq_max_of_ne f_neg (by grind), max_eq_left (le_of_lt (by grind))]

name: add_pow_le
statement:
theorem add_pow_le [Mul R] [CommSemiring α] (f_mul : ∀ x y, f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y)
    (hna : IsNonarchimedean f) : ∃ m < n + 1, f ((a + b) ^ n) ≤ f (a ^ m) * f (b ^ (n - m))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm_lt, hM⟩ := hna.finset_image_add_of_nonempty
    (fun m => a ^ m * b ^ (n - m) * ↑(n.choose m)) (s := Finset.range (n + 1)) (by simp)
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm_lt
  refine ⟨m, hm_lt, ?_⟩
  simp only [← add_pow] at hM
  rw [mul_comm] at hM
  exact le_trans hM <| le_trans (hna.nmul_le_of_pos _ (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hm_lt)))
    (f_mul _ _)

name: RingCone.mem_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem RingCone.mem_mk {R : Type*} [Ring R] {toSubsemiring : Subsemiring R}
    (eq_zero_of_mem_of_neg_mem) {x : R} :
    x ∈ mk toSubsemiring eq_zero_of_mem_of_neg_mem ↔ x ∈ toSubsemiring

name: RingCone.coe_set_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem RingCone.coe_set_mk {R : Type*} [Ring R] {toSubsemiring : Subsemiring R}
    (eq_zero_of_mem_of_neg_mem) :
    (mk toSubsemiring eq_zero_of_mem_of_neg_mem : Set R) = toSubsemiring

name: nonneg_toSubsemiring

name: pow_add_pow_le
statement: theorem pow_add_pow_le (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hn : n ≠ 0) : x ^ n + y ^ n ≤ (x + y) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hn with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add, pow_one, le_refl]
  | succ k ih =>
    let n := k.succ
    have h1 := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hx (pow_nonneg hy n)) (mul_nonneg hy (pow_nonneg hx n))
    have h2 := add_nonneg hx hy
    calc
      x ^ (n + 1) + y ^ (n + 1) ≤ x * x ^ n + y * y ^ n + (x * y ^ n + y * x ^ n) := by
        rw [pow_succ' _ n, pow_succ' _ n]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right h1
      _ = (x + y) * (x ^ n + y ^ n) := by
        rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, add_comm (y * x ^ n), ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc,
          add_assoc (x * x ^ n) (x * y ^ n), add_comm (x * y ^ n) (y * y ^ n), ← add_assoc]
      _ ≤ (x + y) ^ (n + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ' _ n]
        gcongr; exact ih (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)

name: pow_add_pow_le'

name: add_sq_le
statement: lemma add_sq_le : (a + b) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (a + b) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + (a * b + b * a) := by
        simp_rw [pow_succ', pow_zero, mul_one, add_mul, mul_add, add_comm (b * a), add_add_add_comm]
    _ ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + (a * a + b * b) := add_le_add_right ?_ _
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [pow_succ', pow_zero, mul_one, two_mul]
  cases le_total a b
  · exact mul_add_mul_le_mul_add_mul ‹_› ‹_›
  · exact mul_add_mul_le_mul_add_mul' ‹_› ‹_›

name: add_pow_le
statement:
lemma add_pow_le (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : ∀ n, (a + b) ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (n - 1) * (a ^ n + b ^ n)
  | 0 => by simp
  | 1 => by simp
  | n + 2 => by
    rw [pow_succ]
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) * (a + b)
proof:
:=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_pow_le ha hb (n + 1)) <| add_nonneg ha hb
      _ = 2 ^ n * (a ^ (n + 2) + b ^ (n + 2) + (a ^ (n + 1) * b + b ^ (n + 1) * a)) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, mul_add, add_mul, add_mul, ← pow_succ, ← pow_succ, add_comm _ (b ^ _),
            add_add_add_comm, add_comm (_ * a)]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (a ^ (n + 2) + b ^ (n + 2) + (a ^ (n + 1) * a + b ^ (n + 1) * b)) := by
        gcongr _ * (_ + _ + ?_)
        · exact pow_nonneg zero_le_two _
        obtain hab | hba := le_total a b
        · exact mul_add_mul_le_mul_add_mul (by gcongr) hab
        · exact mul_add_mul_le_mul_add_mul' (by gcongr) hba
      _ = _ := by simp only [← pow_succ, ← two_mul, ← mul_assoc]; rfl

name: Even.add_pow_le
statement:
protected lemma Even.add_pow_le (hn : Even n) :
    (a + b) ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (n - 1) * (a ^ n + b ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hn
  rw [← two_mul, pow_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg _) add_sq_le _
    _ = 2 ^ n * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ n := by 
        rw [Commute.mul_pow]; simp [Commute, SemiconjBy, two_mul, mul_two]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (2 ^ (n - 1) * ((a ^ 2) ^ n + (b ^ 2) ^ n)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (add_pow_le (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _) _) <| pow_nonneg (zero_le_two (α := R)) _
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_mul]
      cases n
      · rfl
      · simp [Nat.two_mul]

name: Odd.strictMono_pow
statement: lemma Odd.strictMono_pow (hn : Odd n) : StrictMono fun a : R => a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hn₀ : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp [Odd] at hn
  intro a b hab
  obtain ha | ha := le_total 0 a
  · exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ hab ha hn₀
  obtain hb | hb := lt_or_ge 0 b
  · exact (hn.pow_nonpos ha).trans_lt (pow_pos hb _)
  obtain ⟨c, hac⟩ := exists_add_of_le ha
  obtain ⟨d, hbd⟩ := exists_add_of_le hb
  have hd := nonneg_of_le_add_right (hb.trans_eq hbd)
  refine lt_of_add_lt_add_right (a := c ^ n + d ^ n) ?_
  dsimp
  calc
    a ^ n + (c ^ n + d ^ n) = d ^ n := by
      rw [← add_assoc, hn.pow_add_pow_eq_zero hac.symm, zero_add]
    _ < c ^ n := pow_lt_pow_left₀ ?_ hd hn₀
    _ = b ^ n + (c ^ n + d ^ n) := by rw [add_left_comm, hn.pow_add_pow_eq_zero hbd.symm, add_zero]
  refine lt_of_add_lt_add_right (a := a + b) ?_
  rwa [add_rotate', ← hbd, add_zero, add_left_comm, ← add_assoc, ← hac, zero_add]

name: isOrderedRing
statement:
protected lemma isOrderedRing [IsOrderedRing R] [Semiring S] [PartialOrder S]
    (f : S → R) (zero : f 0 = 0) (one : f 1 = 1)
    (add : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (mul : ∀ x y, f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    (le : ∀ {x y}, f x ≤ f y ↔ x ≤ y) :
    IsOrderedRing S where
  __
proof:
:= Function.Injective.isOrderedAddMonoid f add le
  zero_le_one := by simp only [← le, zero, one, zero_le_one]
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a ha b c hbc := by
    rw [← le, mul, mul]; refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le.2 hbc) ?_; rwa [← zero, le]
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a ha b c hbc := by
    rw [← le, mul, mul]; refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le.2 hbc) ?_; rwa [← zero, le]

name: isStrictOrderedRing
statement:
protected lemma isStrictOrderedRing [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [Semiring S] [PartialOrder S]
    (f : S → R) (zero : f 0 = 0) (one : f 1 = 1)
    (add : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (mul : ∀ x y, f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    (le : ∀ {x y}, f x ≤ f y ↔ x ≤ y) (lt : ∀ {x y}, f x < f y ↔ x < y) :
    IsStrictOrderedRing S where
  __
proof:
:= Function.Injective.isOrderedCancelAddMonoid f add le
  __ := domain_nontrivial f zero one
  __ := Function.Injective.isOrderedRing f zero one add mul le
  mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left a ha b c hbc := by
    rw [← lt, mul, mul]; refine mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (lt.2 hbc) ?_; rwa [← zero, lt]
  mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right a ha b c hbc := by
    rw [← lt, mul, mul]; refine mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (lt.2 hbc) ?_; rwa [← zero, lt]

name: IsOrderedRing.of_mul_nonneg
statement:
lemma IsOrderedRing.of_mul_nonneg [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedAddMonoid R]
    [ZeroLEOneClass R] (mul_nonneg : ∀ a b : R, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → 0 ≤ a * b) :
    IsOrderedRing R where
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a ha b c hbc
proof:
:= by
    simpa only [mul_sub, sub_nonneg] using mul_nonneg _ _ ha (sub_nonneg.2 hbc)
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a ha b c hbc := by
    simpa only [sub_mul, sub_nonneg] using mul_nonneg _ _ (sub_nonneg.2 hbc) ha

name: IsStrictOrderedRing.of_mul_pos
statement:
lemma IsStrictOrderedRing.of_mul_pos [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedAddMonoid R]
    [ZeroLEOneClass R] [Nontrivial R] (mul_pos : ∀ a b : R, 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 < a * b) :
    IsStrictOrderedRing R where
  mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left a ha b c hbc
proof:
:= by
    simpa only [mul_sub, sub_pos] using mul_pos _ _ ha (sub_pos.2 hbc)
  mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right a ha b c hbc := by
    simpa only [sub_mul, sub_pos] using mul_pos _ _ (sub_pos.2 hbc) ha

statement:
theorem AddMonoidWithOne.toCharZero {R}

name: geom_sum_pos
statement: lemma geom_sum_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hn : n ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i
proof:
:=
  sum_pos' (fun _ _ => pow_nonneg hx _) ⟨0, mem_range.2 hn.bot_lt, by simp⟩

name: geom_sum_alternating_of_le_neg_one
statement:
lemma geom_sum_alternating_of_le_neg_one (hx : x + 1 ≤ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    if Even n then (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i) ≤ 0 else 1 ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≤ 0 := (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one).trans hx
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [range_zero, sum_empty, le_refl, ite_true, Even.zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [Nat.even_add_one, geom_sum_succ]
    split_ifs at ih ⊢ with h
    · rw [le_add_iff_nonneg_left]
      exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hx0 ih
    · grw [← hx]
      gcongr
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left ih hx0

name: geom_sum_pos_and_lt_one
statement:
lemma geom_sum_pos_and_lt_one (hx : x < 0) (hx' : 0 < x + 1) (hn : 1 < n) :
    0 < ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i ∧ ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i < 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_ n (show 2 ≤ n from hn)
  · rw [geom_sum_two]
    exact ⟨hx', (add_lt_iff_neg_right _).2 hx⟩
  clear hn
  intro n _ ihn
  rw [geom_sum_succ, add_lt_iff_neg_right, ← neg_lt_iff_pos_add', neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]
  exact
    ⟨by grw [ihn.2, mul_one, neg_le_iff_add_nonneg', hx']; exact neg_pos.2 hx,
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hx ihn.1⟩

name: geom_sum_alternating_of_lt_neg_one
statement:
lemma geom_sum_alternating_of_lt_neg_one (hx : x + 1 < 0) (hn : 1 < n) :
    if Even n then ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i < 0 else 1 < ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x < 0 := (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one).trans_lt hx
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_ n (show 2 ≤ n from hn)
  · simp only [geom_sum_two, lt_add_iff_pos_left, ite_true, hx, even_two]
  clear hn
  intro n _ ihn
  simp only [Nat.even_add_one, geom_sum_succ]
  split_ifs at ihn ⊢ with hn'
  · rw [lt_add_iff_pos_left]
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hx0 ihn
  · grw [← hx.le]
    gcongr
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_lt_mul_of_neg_left ihn hx0

name: geom_sum_pos'
statement: lemma geom_sum_pos' (hx : 0 < x + 1) (hn : n ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ | n := n
  · cases hn rfl
  · simp only [zero_add, range_one, sum_singleton, pow_zero, zero_lt_one]
  obtain hx' | hx' := lt_or_ge x 0
  · exact (geom_sum_pos_and_lt_one hx' hx n.one_lt_succ_succ).1
  · exact geom_sum_pos hx' (by simp)

name: Odd.geom_sum_pos
statement: lemma Odd.geom_sum_pos (h : Odd n) : 0 < ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with (_ | _ | k)
  · exact (Nat.not_odd_zero h).elim
  · simp only [zero_add, range_one, sum_singleton, pow_zero, zero_lt_one]
  rw [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd] at h
  rcases lt_trichotomy (x + 1) 0 with (hx | hx | hx)
  · have := geom_sum_alternating_of_lt_neg_one hx k.one_lt_succ_succ
    simp only [h, ite_false] at this
    exact zero_lt_one.trans this
  · simp only [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hx, h, neg_one_geom_sum, ite_false, zero_lt_one]
  · exact geom_sum_pos' hx k.succ.succ_ne_zero

name: geom_sum_pos_iff
statement: lemma geom_sum_pos_iff (hn : n ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i ↔ Odd n ∨ 0 < x + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← not_le, Nat.not_odd_iff_even]
    refine fun hn hx => h.not_ge ?_
    simpa [ite_eq_left hn] using geom_sum_alternating_of_le_neg_one hx n
  · rintro (hn | hx')
    · exact hn.geom_sum_pos
    · exact geom_sum_pos' hx' hn

name: geom_sum_ne_zero
statement: lemma geom_sum_ne_zero (hx : x ≠ -1) (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ | n := n
  · cases hn rfl
  · simp only [zero_add, range_one, sum_singleton, pow_zero, ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]
  rw [Ne, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← Ne] at hx
  obtain h | h := hx.lt_or_gt
  · have := geom_sum_alternating_of_lt_neg_one h n.one_lt_succ_succ
    split_ifs at this
    · exact this.ne
    · exact (zero_lt_one.trans this).ne'
  · exact (geom_sum_pos' h n.succ.succ_ne_zero).ne'

name: geom_sum_eq_zero_iff_neg_one
statement: lemma geom_sum_eq_zero_iff_neg_one (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i = 0 ↔ x = -1 ∧ Even n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, @fun ⟨h, hn⟩ => by simp only [h, hn, neg_one_geom_sum, ite_true]⟩
  contrapose! h
  have hx := eq_or_ne x (-1)
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · rw [hx, neg_one_geom_sum]
    simp only [h hx, ite_false, ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]
  · exact geom_sum_ne_zero hx hn

name: geom_sum_neg_iff
statement: lemma geom_sum_neg_iff (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ i < 0 ↔ Even n ∧ x + 1 < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, not_lt, le_iff_lt_or_eq, eq_comm,
    or_congr (geom_sum_pos_iff hn) (geom_sum_eq_zero_iff_neg_one hn), ← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, ←
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, not_and, not_lt, le_iff_lt_or_eq, eq_comm, ← imp_iff_not_or, or_comm,
    and_comm, Decidable.and_or_imp, or_comm]

name: Nat.pred_mul_geom_sum_le
statement:
lemma Nat.pred_mul_geom_sum_le (a b n : ℕ) :
    ((b - 1) * ∑ i ∈ range n.succ, a / b ^ i) ≤ a * b - a / b ^ n
proof:
:=
  calc
    ((b - 1) * ∑ i ∈ range n.succ, a / b ^ i) =
    (∑ i ∈ range n, a / b ^ (i + 1) * b) + a * b - ((∑ i ∈ range n, a / b ^ i) + a / b ^ n) := by
      rw [Nat.sub_mul, mul_comm, sum_mul, one_mul, sum_range_succ', sum_range_succ, pow_zero,
        Nat.div_one]
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, a / b ^ i) + a * b - ((∑ i ∈ range n, a / b ^ i) + a / b ^ n) := by
      gcongr with i hi
      rw [pow_succ, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
      exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
    _ = a * b - a / b ^ n := add_tsub_add_eq_tsub_left _ _ _

name: Nat.geom_sum_le
statement:
lemma Nat.geom_sum_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (a n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, a / b ^ i ≤ a * b / (b - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le <| tsub_pos_of_lt hb).2 ?_
  rcases n with - | n
  · rw [sum_range_zero, zero_mul]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact (Nat.pred_mul_geom_sum_le a b n).trans tsub_le_self

name: Nat.geom_sum_Ico_le
statement:
lemma Nat.geom_sum_Ico_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (a n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 n, a / b ^ i ≤ a / (b - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · rw [Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by lia), sum_empty]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  rw [← add_le_add_iff_left a]
  calc
    (a + ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 n.succ, a / b ^ i) = a / b ^ 0 + ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 n.succ, a / b ^ i := by
      rw [pow_zero, Nat.div_one]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range n.succ, a / b ^ i := by
      rw [range_eq_Ico, ← Finset.insert_Ico_add_one_left_eq_Ico (Nat.succ_pos _), sum_insert] <;>
        simp
    _ ≤ a * b / (b - 1) := Nat.geom_sum_le hb a _
    _ = (a * 1 + a * (b - 1)) / (b - 1) := by rw [← mul_add, add_tsub_cancel_of_le (by lia)]
    _ = a + a / (b - 1) := by rw [mul_one, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (tsub_pos_of_lt hb), add_comm]

name: Nat.geomSum_lt
statement: lemma Nat.geomSum_lt (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hs : ∀ k ∈ s, k < n) : ∑ k ∈ s, m ^ k < m ^ n
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∑ k ∈ s, m ^ k ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, m ^ k := sum_le_sum_of_subset fun _ hk ↦
      mem_range.2 <| hs _ hk
    _ = (m ^ n - 1) / (m - 1) := Nat.geomSum_eq hm _
    _ ≤ m ^ n - 1 := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    _ < m ^ n := tsub_lt_self (Nat.pow_pos <| by lia) (by lia)

name: mabs_zpow

  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le n0

  · obtain ⟨m, h⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (neg_nonneg.2 n0)

    exact mabs_pow m _

name: abs_geomSum_le

proof:
:= by
  induction n with | zero => simp [geomSum] | succ n ih => ?_
  refine (abs_add_le ..).trans ?_
  rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, Nat.cast_succ, add_one_mul]
  refine add_le_add ?_ (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) le_sup_right _)
  rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm |a|]
  gcongr
  exacts [abs_nonneg _, (abs_nonneg _).trans ih, le_sup_left]

    a ^ (n + 1) - b ^ (n + 1) = (a - b) * geomSum a b n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with | zero => simp [geomSum] | succ n ih => ?_
  rw [geomSum, mul_add, mul_comm a, ← mul_assoc, ← ih,

:= by
  obtain _ | n := n; · simp
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_sub_pow_eq_sub_mul_geomSum, abs_mul, mul_assoc, Nat.cast_succ]
  gcongr
  · exact abs_nonneg _
  · exact abs_geomSum_le ..

@[simp] lemma cast_nonneg_iff : ∀ {n : ℤ}, (0 : R) ≤ n ↔ 0 ≤ n

statement: lemma nneg_mul_add_sq_of_abs_le_one (n : ℤ) (hx : |x| ≤ 1) : (0 : R) ≤ n * x + n * n
proof:
:= by
  have hnx : 0 < n → 0 ≤ x + n := fun hn => by
    have := _root_.add_le_add (neg_le_of_abs_le hx) (cast_one_le_of_pos hn)
    rwa [neg_add_cancel] at this
  have hnx' : n < 0 → x + n ≤ 0 := fun hn => by
    have := _root_.add_le_add (le_of_abs_le hx) (cast_le_neg_one_of_neg hn)
    rwa [add_neg_cancel] at this
  rw [← mul_add, mul_nonneg_iff]
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 0 with (h | rfl | h)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨mod_cast h.le, hnx' h⟩
  · simp [le_total 0 x]
  · exact Or.inl ⟨mod_cast h.le, hnx h⟩

statement: theorem hasIdealSupport_of_isUnit_two (h : IsUnit (2 : R)) : P.HasIdealSupport
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasIdealSupport_iff]
  intro x a _ _
  rcases h.exists_right_inv with ⟨half, h2⟩
  set y := (1 + x) * half
  set z := (1 - x) * half
  rw [show x = y ^ 2 - z ^ 2 by
    linear_combination (-x - x * half * 2) * h2]
  ring_nf
  aesop (add simp sub_eq_add_neg)

name: isOrdering_iff
statement:
theorem isOrdering_iff :
    P.IsOrdering ↔ ∀ a b : R, -(a * b) ∈ P → a ∈ P ∨ b ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ a b _ => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · by_contra
    have : a * b ∈ P := by simpa using mul_mem (by aesop : -a ∈ P) (by aesop : -b ∈ P)
    have : a ∈ P.support ∨ b ∈ P.support :=
      Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem inferInstance (by simp_all [mem_support])
    simp_all [mem_support]
  · have : HasMemOrNegMem P := ⟨by simp [h]⟩
    refine IsOrdering.mk' P (fun {x y} _ => ?_)
    by_contra
    have := h (-x) y
    have := h (-x) (-y)
    have := h x y
    have := h x (-y)
    cases (by aesop : x ∈ P ∨ -x ∈ P) <;> simp_all [mem_support]

proof:

name: mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulMono R]
    [AddRightMono R] [AddRightReflectLE R]
    (h : b ≤ a) (hc : c ≤ 0) : c * a ≤ c * b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hcd⟩ := exists_add_of_le hc
  refine le_of_add_le_add_right (a := d * b + d * a) ?_
  calc
    _ = d * b := by rw [add_left_comm, ← add_mul, ← hcd, zero_mul, add_zero]
    _ ≤ d * a := by gcongr; exact hcd.trans_le <| add_le_of_nonpos_left hc
    _ = _ := by rw [← add_assoc, ← add_mul, ← hcd, zero_mul, zero_add]

proof:

  obtain ⟨d, hcd⟩ := exists_add_of_le hc
  refine le_of_add_le_add_right (a := b * d + a * d) ?_
  calc
    _ = b * d := by rw [add_left_comm, ← mul_add, ← hcd, mul_zero, add_zero]
    _ ≤ a * d := by gcongr; exact hcd.trans_le <| add_le_of_nonpos_left hc
    _ = _ := by rw [← add_assoc, ← mul_add, ← hcd, mul_zero, zero_add]

name: mul_lt_mul_of_neg_left
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_of_neg_left [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulStrictMono R]
    [AddRightStrictMono R] [AddRightReflectLT R]
    (h : b < a) (hc : c < 0) : c * a < c * b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hcd⟩ := exists_add_of_le hc.le
  refine (add_lt_add_iff_right (d * b + d * a)).1 ?_
  calc
    _ = d * b := by rw [add_left_comm, ← add_mul, ← hcd, zero_mul, add_zero]
    _ < d * a := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h <| hcd.trans_lt <| add_lt_of_neg_left _ hc
    _ = _ := by rw [← add_assoc, ← add_mul, ← hcd, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: mul_lt_mul_of_neg_right
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_of_neg_right [ExistsAddOfLE R] [MulPosStrictMono R]
    [AddRightStrictMono R] [AddRightReflectLT R]
    (h : b < a) (hc : c < 0) : a * c < b * c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hcd⟩ := exists_add_of_le hc.le
  refine (add_lt_add_iff_right (b * d + a * d)).1 ?_
  calc
    _ = b * d := by rw [add_left_comm, ← mul_add, ← hcd, mul_zero, add_zero]
    _ < a * d := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h <| hcd.trans_lt <| add_lt_of_neg_left _ hc
    _ = _ := by rw [← add_assoc, ← mul_add, ← hcd, mul_zero, zero_add]

name: add_le_mul_of_left_le_right
statement:
theorem add_le_mul_of_left_le_right [ZeroLEOneClass R] [NeZero (1 : R)]
    [MulPosStrictMono R] [AddLeftMono R]
    (a2 : 2 ≤ a) (ab : a ≤ b) : a + b ≤ a * b
proof:
:=
  have : 0 < b :=
    calc
      0 < 2 := zero_lt_two
      _ ≤ a := a2
      _ ≤ b := ab
  calc
    a + b ≤ b + b := by gcongr
    _ = 2 * b := (two_mul b).symm
    _ ≤ a * b := (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ this).mpr a2

proof:

  have : 0 < a :=
    calc 0
      _ < 2 := zero_lt_two
      _ ≤ b := b2
      _ ≤ a := ba
  calc
    a + b ≤ a + a := by gcongr
    _ = a * 2 := (mul_two a).symm
    _ ≤ a * b := (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ this).mpr b2

name: sq_nonneg
statement:
lemma sq_nonneg [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulMono R] [AddLeftMono R]
    (a : R) : 0 ≤ a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ha | ha := le_or_gt 0 a
  · exact pow_succ_nonneg ha _
  obtain ⟨b, hab⟩ := exists_add_of_le ha.le
  have hb : 0 < b := not_le.1 fun hb ↦ (add_neg_of_neg_of_nonpos ha hb).ne' hab
  calc
    0 ≤ b ^ 2 := pow_succ_nonneg hb.le _
    _ = b ^ 2 + a * (a + b) := by rw [← hab, mul_zero, add_zero]
    _ = a ^ 2 + (a + b) * b := by rw [add_mul, mul_add, sq, sq, add_comm, add_assoc]
    _ = a ^ 2 := by rw [← hab, zero_mul, add_zero]

proof:

name: pos_of_right_mul_lt_le
statement:
theorem pos_of_right_mul_lt_le [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulMono R]

    0 < a
proof:
:= by

  · exact ha
  · grind [mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hbc ha]

name: max_mul_mul_le_max_mul_max
statement:
lemma max_mul_mul_le_max_mul_max [PosMulMono R] [MulPosMono R] (b c : R) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    max (a * b) (d * c) ≤ max a c * max d b
proof:
:=
  have ba : b * a ≤ max d b * max c a := by
    grw [← le_max_right c a, ← le_max_right]
    exact hd.trans <| le_max_left d b
  have cd : c * d ≤ max a c * max b d :=
    mul_le_mul (le_max_right a c) (le_max_right b d) hd (le_trans ha (le_max_left a c))
  max_le (by simpa [mul_comm, max_comm] using ba) (by simpa [mul_comm, max_comm] using cd)

name: two_mul_le_add_sq
statement:
lemma two_mul_le_add_sq [ExistsAddOfLE R] [MulPosStrictMono R]
    [AddLeftReflectLE R] [AddLeftMono R]

name: four_mul_le_sq_add
statement:
lemma four_mul_le_sq_add [ExistsAddOfLE R] [MulPosStrictMono R]
    [AddLeftReflectLE R] [AddLeftMono R]
    (a b : R) : 4 * a * b ≤ (a + b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc 4 * a * b
    _ = 2 * a * b + 2 * a * b := by rw [mul_assoc, two_add_two_eq_four.symm, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 2 * a * b := by gcongr; exact two_mul_le_add_sq _ _
    _ = a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b + b ^ 2 := by rw [add_right_comm]
    _ = (a + b) ^ 2 := (add_sq a b).symm

name: two_mul_le_add_of_sq_le_mul
proof:
:= by
  apply nonneg_le_nonneg_of_sq_le_sq (Left.add_nonneg ha hb)
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← pow_two r, two_mul, two_add_two_eq_four]
  grw [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht zero_le_four, ← mul_assoc, four_mul_le_sq_add a b, sq]

proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_pos, neg_mul_eq_mul_neg, mul_pos_iff (R := R), neg_pos, neg_lt_zero]

    [AddLeftReflectLE R] [AddLeftMono R] :

proof:

name: mul_nonneg_iff_neg_imp_nonpos
statement:
lemma mul_nonneg_iff_neg_imp_nonpos [PosMulStrictMono R] [MulPosStrictMono R]
    [AddLeftMono R] [AddLeftReflectLE R] :
    0 ≤ a * b ↔ (a < 0 → b ≤ 0) ∧ (b < 0 → a ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_mul_neg, mul_nonneg_iff_pos_imp_nonneg (R := R)]; simp only [neg_pos, neg_nonneg]

    [AddLeftMono R] [AddLeftReflectLE R] :

proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_nonneg, ← mul_neg, mul_nonneg_iff_pos_imp_nonneg (R := R)]
  simp only [neg_pos, neg_nonneg]

name: mul_nonpos_iff_neg_imp_nonneg

statement:
lemma mul_self_le_mul_self_of_le_of_neg_le

    (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : -a ≤ b) : a * a ≤ b * b
proof:
:=
  (le_total 0 a).elim (mul_self_le_mul_self · h₁) fun h ↦

name: sub_mul_sub_nonneg_iff

lemma sub_mul_sub_nonneg_iff [MulPosStrictMono R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [AddLeftMono R]

proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_nonneg_iff, sub_nonneg, sub_nonneg, sub_nonpos, sub_nonpos,

proof:

name: le_tsub_mul
statement:
theorem le_tsub_mul {R : Type*} [NonUnitalCommSemiring R] [Preorder R] [Sub R] [OrderedSub R]
    [MulLeftMono R] {a b c : R} : a * c - b * c ≤ (a - b) * c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_comm _ c] using le_mul_tsub

name: map_tsub_of_le
statement:
theorem map_tsub_of_le {F : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [AddCommSemigroup α] [ExistsAddOfLE α]
    [AddLeftMono α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α] [PartialOrder β] [AddCommSemigroup β] [Sub β]
    [OrderedSub β] [AddLeftReflectLE β] [FunLike F α β] [AddHomClass F α β]
    (f : F) (a b : α) (h : b ≤ a) : f a - f b = f (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h]
  rw [map_add, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: OrderIso.map_tsub
statement:
theorem OrderIso.map_tsub {M N : Type*} [Preorder M] [Add M] [Sub M] [OrderedSub M]
    [PartialOrder N] [Add N] [Sub N] [OrderedSub N] (e : M ≃o N)
    (h_add : ∀ a b, e (a + b) = e a + e b) (a b : M) : e (a - b) = e a - e b
proof:
:= by
  let e_add : M ≃+ N := { e with map_add' := h_add }
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (e_add.toAddHom.le_map_tsub e.monotone a b)
  suffices e (e.symm (e a) - e.symm (e b)) ≤ e (e.symm (e a - e b)) by simpa
  exact e.monotone (e_add.symm.toAddHom.le_map_tsub e.symm.monotone _ _)

name: AddMonoidHom.le_map_tsub
statement:
theorem AddMonoidHom.le_map_tsub [Preorder β] [AddZeroClass β] [Sub β] [OrderedSub β] (f : α →+ β)
    (hf : Monotone f) (a b : α) : f a - f b ≤ f (a - b)

name: Forall
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma Forall₂.prod_le_prod [Preorder M] [MulRightMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] {l₁ l₂ : List M} (h : Forall₂ (· ≤ ·) l₁ l₂) :
    l₁.prod ≤ l₂.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hab ih ih' => simpa only [prod_cons] using mul_le_mul' hab ih'

name: Sublist.prod_le_prod
statement:
@[to_additive /
  then `l₁.sum ≤ l₂.sum`.
  One can prove a stronger version assuming `∀ a ∈ l₂.diff l₁, 0 ≤ a` instead of `∀ a ∈ l₂, 0 ≤ a`
  but this lemma is not yet in `mathlib`. -/]
lemma Sublist.prod_le_prod [Preorder M] [MulRightMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] {l₁ l₂ : List M} (h : l₁ <+ l₂)
    (h₁ : ∀ a ∈ l₂, (1 : M) ≤ a) : l₁.prod ≤ l₂.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | slnil => rfl
  | cons a _ ih =>
    simp only [prod_cons, forall_mem_cons] at h₁ ⊢
    exact (ih h₁.2).trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left' h₁.1)
  | cons_cons a _ ih =>
    simp only [prod_cons, forall_mem_cons] at h₁ ⊢
    grw [ih h₁.2]

name: SublistForall
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma SublistForall₂.prod_le_prod [Preorder M]
    [MulRightMono M] [MulLeftMono M]
    {l₁ l₂ : List M} (h : SublistForall₂ (· ≤ ·) l₁ l₂) (h₁ : ∀ a ∈ l₂, (1 : M) ≤ a) :
    l₁.prod ≤ l₂.prod
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hall, hsub⟩ := sublistForall₂_iff.1 h
  hall.prod_le_prod.trans <| hsub.prod_le_prod h₁

name: prod_le_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_le_prod [Preorder M] [MulRightMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] {l : List ι} {f g : ι → M} (h : ∀ i ∈ l, f i ≤ g i) :
    (l.map f).prod ≤ (l.map g).prod

name: prod_lt_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_lt_prod [Preorder M] [MulLeftStrictMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightStrictMono M]
    [MulRightMono M] {l : List ι} (f g : ι → M)
    (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ l, f i ≤ g i) (h₂ : ∃ i ∈ l, f i < g i) : (l.map f).prod < (l.map g).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at h₂
  | cons i l ihl =>
    simp only [forall_mem_cons, map_cons, prod_cons] at h₁ ⊢
    simp only [mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp] at h₂
    cases h₂
    · exact mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le ‹_› (prod_le_prod h₁.2)
    · exact mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt h₁.1 <| ihl h₁.2 ‹_›

name: prod_lt_prod_of_ne_nil
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_lt_prod_of_ne_nil [Preorder M] [MulLeftStrictMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightStrictMono M]
    [MulRightMono M] {l : List ι} (hl : l ≠ []) (f g : ι → M)
    (hlt : ∀ i ∈ l, f i < g i) : (l.map f).prod < (l.map g).prod
proof:
:=
  (prod_lt_prod f g fun i hi => (hlt i hi).le) <|
    (exists_mem_of_ne_nil l hl).imp fun i hi => ⟨hi, hlt i hi⟩

name: prod_le_pow_length
statement:
@[to_additive sum_le_length_nsmul]
lemma prod_le_pow_length [Preorder M] [MulRightMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] (l : List M) (n : M) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ n) :
    l.prod ≤ n ^ l.length
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_id', map_const', prod_replicate] using prod_le_prod h

name: pow_length_le_prod
statement:
@[to_additive length_nsmul_le_sum]
lemma pow_length_le_prod [Preorder M] [MulRightMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] (l : List M) (n : M) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, n ≤ x) :
    n ^ l.length ≤ l.prod

name: exists_lt_of_prod_lt
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma exists_lt_of_prod_lt [LinearOrder M] [MulRightMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] {l : List ι} (f g : ι → M)
    (h : (l.map f).prod < (l.map g).prod) : ∃ i ∈ l, f i < g i
proof:

  contrapose! h
  exact prod_le_prod h

name: exists_le_of_prod_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma exists_le_of_prod_le [LinearOrder M] [MulLeftStrictMono M]
    [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightStrictMono M]
    [MulRightMono M] {l : List ι} (hl : l ≠ []) (f g : ι → M)
    (h : (l.map f).prod ≤ (l.map g).prod) : ∃ x ∈ l, f x ≤ g x
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact prod_lt_prod_of_ne_nil hl _ _ h

name: one_le_prod_of_one_le
proof:
:= by
  
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    rw [prod_cons]
    exact one_le_mul (hl₁ hd mem_cons_self) (ih fun x h => hl₁ x (mem_cons_of_mem hd h))

name: max_prod_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma max_prod_le (l : List α) (f g : α → M) [LinearOrder M]
    [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightMono M] :
    max (l.map f).prod (l.map g).prod ≤ (l.map fun i ↦ max (f i) (g i)).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [max_le_iff]
  constructor <;> apply List.prod_le_prod <;> intros
  · apply le_max_left
  · apply le_max_right

name: prod_min_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_min_le [LinearOrder M] [MulLeftMono M]
    [MulRightMono M] (l : List α) (f g : α → M) :
    (l.map fun i ↦ min (f i) (g i)).prod ≤ min (l.map f).prod (l.map g).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_min_iff]
  constructor <;> apply List.prod_le_prod <;> intros
  · apply min_le_left
  · apply min_le_right

name: monotone_prod_take
statement: @[to_additive] lemma monotone_prod_take (L : List M) : Monotone fun i ↦ (L.take i).prod
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => ?_
  rcases lt_or_ge n L.length with h | h
  · rw [prod_take_succ _ _ h]
    exact le_self_mul
  · simp [take_of_length_le h, take_of_length_le (le_trans h (Nat.le_succ _))]

name: le_prod_of_mem
statement: theorem le_prod_of_mem {xs : List M} {x : M} (h₁ : x ∈ xs) : x ≤ xs.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at h₁
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [mem_cons] at h₁
    rcases h₁ with (rfl | h₁)
    · simp
    · specialize ih h₁
      simp only [List.prod_cons]
      exact le_mul_left ih

name: le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_of_subadditive_on_pred]
lemma le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred (f : α → β)
    (p : α → Prop) (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1) (hp_one : p 1)
    (h_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) (hp_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b))
    (l : List α) (hpl : ∀ a, a ∈ l → p a) : f l.prod ≤ (l.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [h_one]
  | cons a s ih =>
    have hpla : ∀ x, x ∈ s → p x := fun x hx => hpl x (mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
    have hp_prod : p s.prod := prod_induction p hp_mul hp_one hpla
    grw [prod_cons, map_cons, prod_cons, h_mul a s.prod (hpl _ mem_cons_self) hp_prod, ih hpla]

name: le_prod_of_submultiplicative
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_of_subadditive]
lemma le_prod_of_submultiplicative (f : α → β) (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1)
    (h_mul : ∀ a b, f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) (l : List α) : f l.prod ≤ (l.map f).prod
proof:
:=
  le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred f (fun _ => True) h_one trivial (fun x y _ _ => h_mul x y)
    (by simp) l (by simp)

name: le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_nonempty_of_subadditive_on_pred]
lemma le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop)
    (h_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) (hp_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b))
    (l : List α) (hl_nonempty : l ≠ []) (hl : ∀ a, a ∈ l → p a) : f l.prod ≤ (l.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hl_nonempty
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [prod_cons, map_cons, prod_cons]
    by_cases hl_empty : l = []
    · simp [hl_empty]
    have hla_restrict : ∀ x, x ∈ l → p x := fun x hx => hl x (mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
    have hp_sup : p l.prod := prod_induction_nonempty p hp_mul hl_empty hla_restrict
    have hp_a : p a := hl a mem_cons_self
    grw [h_mul a _ hp_a hp_sup, ← ih hl_empty hla_restrict]

name: le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_nonempty_of_subadditive]
lemma le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative (f : α → β) (h_mul : ∀ a b, f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b)
    (l : List α) (hs_nonempty : l ≠ ∅) : f l.prod ≤ (l.map f).prod
proof:
:=
  le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred f (fun _ => True) (by simp [h_mul]) (by simp) l
    hs_nonempty (by simp)

name: sum_le_foldr_max
statement:
lemma sum_le_foldr_max [AddZeroClass M] [Zero N] [LinearOrder N] (f : M → N) (h0 : f 0 ≤ 0)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, f (x + y) ≤ max (f x) (f y)) (l : List M) : f l.sum ≤ (l.map f).foldr max 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using h0
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    simp only [List.sum_cons, List.foldr_map, List.foldr] at IH ⊢
    exact (hadd _ _).trans (max_le_max le_rfl IH)

name: single_le_prod
statement:
lemma single_le_prod [CommMonoid M] [Preorder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M]
    {l : List M} (hl₁ : ∀ x ∈ l, (1 : M) ≤ x) :
    ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ l.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l
  · simp
  simp_rw [prod_cons, forall_mem_cons] at hl₁ ⊢
  constructor
  case cons.left => exact le_mul_of_one_le_right' (one_le_prod_of_one_le hl₁.2)
  case cons.right hd tl ih => exact fun x H => le_mul_of_one_le_of_le hl₁.1 (ih hl₁.right x H)

name: all_one_of_le_one_le_of_prod_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive all_zero_of_le_zero_le_of_sum_eq_zero]
lemma all_one_of_le_one_le_of_prod_eq_one [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M]
    {l : List M} (hl₁ : ∀ x ∈ l, (1 : M) ≤ x) (hl₂ : l.prod = 1) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ l) : x = 1

name: prod_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma prod_eq_one_iff [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M]
     [CanonicallyOrderedMul M] {l : List M} : l.prod = 1 ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, x = (1 : M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨all_one_of_le_one_le_of_prod_eq_one fun _ _ => one_le, fun h => by
    rw [List.eq_replicate_iff.2 ⟨_, h⟩, prod_replicate, one_pow]
    · exact (length l)
    · rfl⟩

name: apply_prod_le_sum_map
statement:
theorem apply_prod_le_sum_map (h_one : f 1 ≤ 0) (h_mul : ∀ (a b : α), f (a * b) ≤ f a + f b) :
    f l.prod ≤ (l.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [h_one]
  | cons hd tl IH => grw [prod_cons, h_mul, IH]; simp

name: sum_map_le_apply_prod
statement:
theorem sum_map_le_apply_prod (h_one : 0 ≤ f 1) (h_mul : ∀ (a b : α), f a + f b ≤ f (a * b)) :
    (l.map f).sum ≤ f l.prod
proof:
:=
  apply_prod_le_sum_map (β := βᵒᵈ) l f h_one h_mul

name: le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_nonempty_of_subadditive_on_pred]
theorem le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop)
    (h_mul : ∀ x y, p x → p y → f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) (hp_mul : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x * y))
    (g : ι → M) (s : Finset ι) (hs_nonempty : s.Nonempty) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) :
    f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans
    (Multiset.le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred f p h_mul hp_mul _ ?_ ?_) ?_
  · simp [hs_nonempty.ne_empty]
  · exact Multiset.forall_mem_map_iff.mpr hs
  simp

name: le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_nonempty_of_subadditive]
theorem le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N)
    (h_mul : ∀ x y, f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (g : ι → M) :
    f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
proof:
:=
  le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred f (fun _ ↦ True) (fun x y _ _ ↦ h_mul x y)
    (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ trivial) g s hs fun _ _ ↦ trivial

name: le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_of_subadditive_on_pred]
theorem le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop)
    (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1) (h_mul : ∀ x y, p x → p y → f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y)
    (hp_mul : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x * y)) (g : ι → M) {s : Finset ι} (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) :
    f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty s with (rfl | hs_nonempty)
  · simp [h_one]
  · exact le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred f p h_mul hp_mul g s hs_nonempty hs

name: le_prod_of_submultiplicative
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_of_subadditive]
theorem le_prod_of_submultiplicative [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N) (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1)

name: _root_.Monotone.finsetProd'
statement:
theorem _root_.Monotone.finsetProd' [MulLeftMono N] {γ : Type*} [Preorder γ]

    Monotone fun x ↦ ∏ i ∈ s, f i x

theorem one_le_prod [MulLeftMono N] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ f i) : 1 ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i

statement:

theorem one_le_prod'' [MulLeftMono N] (h : ∀ i : ι, 1 ≤ f i) : 1 ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i

statement:

theorem prod_le_one [MulLeftMono N] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 1) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 1

name: prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le [MulLeftMono N] (h : s ⊆ t)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → 1 ≤ f i) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  classical calc
      ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ (∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i) * ∏ i ∈ s, f i :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_left' <| one_le_prod <| by simpa only [mem_sdiff, and_imp]
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t \ s ∪ s, f i := (prod_union sdiff_disjoint).symm
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]

statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one [MulLeftMono N] (h : s ⊆ t) (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → f i ≤ 1) :
    ∏ i ∈ t, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i

statement:

theorem prod_mono_set_of_one_le [MulLeftMono N] (hf : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) :
    Monotone fun s ↦ ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hst ↦ prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le hst fun x _ _ ↦ hf x

name: prod_le_univ_prod_of_one_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_le_univ_prod_of_one_le [MulLeftMono N] [Fintype ι] {s : Finset ι} (w : ∀ x, 1 ≤ f x) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∏ x, f x
proof:
:=
  prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le (subset_univ s) fun a _ _ ↦ w a

name: prod_le_prod_of_injOn
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_injOn [DecidableEq α] [MulLeftMono N]
    {g : α → N} {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset α} (e : ι → α) (he : Set.InjOn e s)
    (ht : image e s ⊆ t) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g (e i))
    (hg : ∀ a ∈ t, a ∉ image e s → 1 ≤ g a) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ a ∈ t, g a
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ <| prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le ht hg
  grw [prod_image he, prod_le_prod h]

name: prod_eq_one_iff_of_one_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_one_iff_of_one_le {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [CommMonoid N] [PartialOrder N]
    {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι} [IsOrderedMonoid N] :
    (∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ f i) → ((∏ i ∈ s, f i) = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    refine Finset.induction_on s
      (fun _ ↦ ⟨fun _ _ h ↦ False.elim (Finset.notMem_empty _ h), fun _ ↦ rfl⟩) ?_
    intro a s ha ih H
    have : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ f i := fun _ ↦ H _ ∘ mem_insert_of_mem
    rw [prod_insert ha, mul_eq_one_iff_of_one_le (H _ <| mem_insert_self _ _) (one_le_prod this),
      forall_mem_insert, ih this]

name: one_lt_prod_iff_of_one_le
statement:
@[to_additive sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg]
lemma one_lt_prod_iff_of_one_le {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [CommMonoid N] [PartialOrder N]
    {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι} [IsOrderedMonoid N] (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ f x) :
    1 < ∏ x ∈ s, f x ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, 1 < f x
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : 1 ≤ ∏ x ∈ s, f x := one_le_prod hf
  rw [hsum.lt_iff_ne', Ne, prod_eq_one_iff_of_one_le hf, not_forall]
  simp +contextual [← exists_prop, -exists_const_iff, hf _ _ |>.lt_iff_ne']

name: prod_eq_one_iff_of_le_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_one_iff_of_le_one {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [CommMonoid N] [PartialOrder N]
    {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι} [IsOrderedMonoid N] :
    (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 1) → ((∏ i ∈ s, f i) = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1)

name: prod_lt_one_iff_of_le_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_lt_one_iff_of_le_one {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [CommMonoid N] [PartialOrder N]
    {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι} [IsOrderedMonoid N] (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x < 1 ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, f x < 1

name: single_le_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem single_le_prod [MulLeftMono N] (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ f i) {a} (h : a ∈ s) :
    f a ≤ ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:=
  calc
    f a = ∏ i ∈ {a}, f i := (prod_singleton _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i :=
      prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le (singleton_subset_iff.2 h) fun i hi _ ↦ hf i hi

name: mul_le_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mul_le_prod [MulLeftMono N] {i j : ι} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ f i) (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s)
    (hne : i ≠ j) :
    f i * f j ≤ ∏ k ∈ s, f k
proof:
:=
  calc
    f i * f j = ∏ k ∈ .cons i {j} (by simpa), f k := by rw [prod_cons, prod_singleton]
    _ ≤ ∏ k ∈ s, f k := by
      refine prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le ?_ fun k hk _ ↦ hf k hk
      simp [cons_subset, *]

name: prod_le_pow_card
statement:
@[to_additive sum_le_card_nsmul]
theorem prod_le_pow_card [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → N) (n : N) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) :
    s.prod f ≤ n ^ #s
proof:
:= by
  refine (Multiset.prod_le_pow_card (s.val.map f) n ?_).trans ?_
  · simpa using h
  · simp

theorem pow_card_le_prod [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → N) (n : N) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) :
    n ^ #s ≤ s.prod f

name: prod_fiberwise_le_prod_of_one_le_prod_fiber
statement:
@[to_additive sum_fiberwise_le_sum_of_sum_fiber_nonneg]
theorem prod_fiberwise_le_prod_of_one_le_prod_fiber [MulLeftMono N] {t : Finset ι'} {g : ι → ι'}
    {f : ι → N} (h : ∀ y ∉ t, (1 : N) ≤ ∏ x ∈ s with g x = y, f x) :
    (∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s with g x = y, f x) ≤ ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:=
  calc
    (∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s with g x = y, f x) ≤
        ∏ y ∈ t ∪ s.image g, ∏ x ∈ s with g x = y, f x :=
      prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le subset_union_left fun y _ ↦ h y
    _ = ∏ x ∈ s, f x :=
      prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun _ hx ↦ mem_union.2 <| Or.inr <| mem_image_of_mem _ hx) _

name: prod_le_prod_fiberwise_of_prod_fiber_le_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_le_prod_fiberwise_of_prod_fiber_le_one [MulLeftMono N] {t : Finset ι'} {g : ι → ι'}
    {f : ι → N} (h : ∀ y ∉ t, ∏ x ∈ s with g x = y, f x ≤ 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s with g x = y, f x

name: prod_image_le_of_one_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_image_le_of_one_le [MulLeftMono N]
    {g : ι → ι'} {f : ι' → N} (hf : ∀ u ∈ s.image g, 1 ≤ f u) :
    ∏ u ∈ s.image g, f u ≤ ∏ u ∈ s, f (g u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_comp f g]
  refine prod_le_prod fun a hag ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hig⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hag
  apply le_self_pow (hf a hag)
  rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, card_pos]
  exact ⟨i, mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, hig⟩⟩

name: apply_prod_le_sum_apply
statement:
theorem apply_prod_le_sum_apply (h_one : g 1 ≤ 0) (h_mul : ∀ (a b : α), g (a * b) ≤ g a + g b) :

proof:
:= by

  rw [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_map_val]

name: card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to
statement:
theorem card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to {f : α → β} {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β}
    (Hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) (n : ℕ) (hn : ∀ b ∈ t, #{a ∈ s | f a = b} ≤ n) : #s ≤ n * #t
proof:
:=
  calc
    #s = ∑ b ∈ t, #{a ∈ s | f a = b} := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise Hf
    _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ t, n := sum_le_sum hn
    _ = _ := by simp [mul_comm]

name: mul_card_image_le_card_of_maps_to
proof:
:=
  calc
    n * #t = ∑ _a ∈ t, n := by simp [mul_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ t, #{a ∈ s | f a = b} := sum_le_sum hn
