name: sum_card_inter_le
statement: theorem sum_card_inter_le (h : ∀ a ∈ s, #{b ∈ B | a ∈ b} ≤ n) : (∑ t ∈ B, #(s ∩ t)) ≤ #s * n
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ (s.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ h)
  simp_rw [← filter_mem_eq_inter, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
  exact sum_comm.le

name: sum_card_le
statement: lemma sum_card_le [Fintype α] (h : ∀ a, #{b ∈ B | a ∈ b} ≤ n) : ∑ s ∈ B, #s ≤ Fintype.card α * n
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∑ s ∈ B, #s = ∑ s ∈ B, #(univ ∩ s) := by simp_rw [univ_inter]
    _ ≤ Fintype.card α * n := sum_card_inter_le fun a _ ↦ h a

name: le_sum_card_inter
statement: theorem le_sum_card_inter (h : ∀ a ∈ s, n ≤ #{b ∈ B | a ∈ b}) : #s * n ≤ ∑ t ∈ B, #(s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  apply (s.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ h).trans
  simp_rw [← filter_mem_eq_inter, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
  exact sum_comm.le

name: le_sum_card
statement:
theorem le_sum_card [Fintype α] (h : ∀ a, n ≤ #{b ∈ B | a ∈ b}) :
    Fintype.card α * n ≤ ∑ s ∈ B, #s
proof:
:=
  calc
    Fintype.card α * n ≤ ∑ s ∈ B, #(univ ∩ s) := le_sum_card_inter fun a _ ↦ h a
    _ = ∑ s ∈ B, #s := by simp_rw [univ_inter]

name: sum_card_inter
statement:
theorem sum_card_inter (h : ∀ a ∈ s, #{b ∈ B | a ∈ b} = n) :
    (∑ t ∈ B, #(s ∩ t)) = #s * n
proof:
:=
  (sum_card_inter_le fun a ha ↦ (h a ha).le).antisymm (le_sum_card_inter fun a ha ↦ (h a ha).ge)

name: sum_card
statement:
theorem sum_card [Fintype α] (h : ∀ a, #{b ∈ B | a ∈ b} = n) :
    ∑ s ∈ B, #s = Fintype.card α * n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Fintype.card, ← sum_card_inter fun a _ ↦ h a, univ_inter]

name: card_le_card_biUnion
statement:
theorem card_le_card_biUnion {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α} (hs : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Nonempty) : #s ≤ #(s.biUnion f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_biUnion hs, card_eq_sum_ones]
  exact sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ (hf i hi).card_pos

name: card_le_card_biUnion_add_card_fiber
statement:
theorem card_le_card_biUnion_add_card_fiber {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α}
    (hs : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) : #s ≤ #(s.biUnion f) + #{i ∈ s | f i = ∅}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not fun i ↦ f i = ∅, add_comm]
  grw [card_le_card_biUnion (hs.subset <| filter_subset _ _) fun i hi ↦
    nonempty_of_ne_empty (mem_filter.1 hi).2, filter_subset]

name: card_le_card_biUnion_add_one
statement:
theorem card_le_card_biUnion_add_one {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Finset α} (hf : Injective f)
    (hs : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) : #s ≤ #(s.biUnion f) + 1
proof:
:= by
  grw [card_le_card_biUnion_add_card_fiber hs,
    card_le_one.2 fun _ hi _ hj ↦ hf <| (mem_filter.1 hi).2.trans (mem_filter.1 hj).2.symm]

name: single_le_prod_of_canonicallyOrdered
statement:
@[to_additive /

See also `Finset.single_le_sum`. -/]
lemma single_le_prod_of_canonicallyOrdered {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    f i ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, f j
proof:
:=
  have := CanonicallyOrderedMul.toIsOrderedMonoid (α := M)
  single_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ one_le) hi

name: prod_le_prod_of_subset

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_subset (h : s ⊆ t) : ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∏ x ∈ t, f x
proof:
:=
  have := CanonicallyOrderedMul.toIsOrderedMonoid (α := M)
  prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le h fun _ _ _ ↦ one_le

name: prod_mono_set
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_mono_set (f : ι → M) : Monotone fun s ↦ ∏ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:= fun _ _ hs ↦
  have := CanonicallyOrderedMul.toIsOrderedMonoid (α := M)

name: prod_le_prod_of_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_ne_one (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 1 → x ∈ t) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∏ x ∈ t, f x
proof:
:= by
  have := CanonicallyOrderedMul.toIsOrderedMonoid (α := M)
  classical calc
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = (∏ x ∈ s with f x = 1, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s with f x ≠ 1, f x := by
      rw [← prod_union, filter_union_filter_not_eq]
      exact disjoint_filter.2 fun _ _ h n_h ↦ n_h h
    _ ≤ ∏ x ∈ t, f x :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_of_le
        (prod_le_one <| by simp only [mem_filter, and_imp]; exact fun _ _ ↦ le_of_eq)
        (prod_le_prod_of_subset <| by simpa only [subset_iff, mem_filter, and_imp])

name: one_lt_prod_iff
statement:
@[to_additive sum_pos_iff]
lemma one_lt_prod_iff {ι M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [CanonicallyOrderedMul M]
    {f : ι → M} {s : Finset ι} : 1 < ∏ x ∈ s, f x ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, 1 < f x
proof:
:=
  have := CanonicallyOrderedMul.toIsOrderedMonoid (α := M)
  Finset.one_lt_prod_iff_of_one_le <| fun _ _ => one_le

name: prod_lt_prod_of_subset_erase_union_singleton
statement:
@[to_additive /
`(S.erase d) ∪ {d'}` and `f d' < f d` for some `d ∈ S`, then the sum of `f` over `S'` is
strictly less than over `S`. -/]
lemma prod_lt_prod_of_subset_erase_union_singleton {ι M : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [CommMonoid M]
    [PartialOrder M] [CanonicallyOrderedMul M] [MulLeftStrictMono M] {S S' : Finset ι} {f : ι → M}
    {d d' : ι} (hd_mem : d ∈ S) (hS' : S' ⊆ S.erase d ∪ {d'}) (hlt : f d' < f d) :
    ∏ x ∈ S', f x < ∏ x ∈ S, f x
proof:
:= by
  have hd_not : d ∉ S' := fun hd ↦ (Finset.mem_union.mp (hS' hd)).elim
    (fun h ↦ (Finset.mem_erase.mp h).1 rfl)
    (fun h ↦ hlt.ne' (congrArg f (Finset.mem_singleton.mp h)))
  by_cases hd'S : d' ∈ S
  · calc ∏ x ∈ S', f x
        ≤ ∏ x ∈ S.erase d, f x := Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset (fun x hx ↦
          Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h ↦ hd_not (h ▸ hx),
            match Finset.mem_union.mp (hS' hx) with
            | .inl h => Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h
            | .inr h => Finset.mem_singleton.mp h ▸ hd'S⟩)
      _ < (∏ x ∈ S.erase d, f x) * f d :=
          lt_mul_of_one_lt_right' _ (one_le.trans_lt hlt)
      _ = ∏ x ∈ S, f x := Finset.prod_erase_mul S f hd_mem
  · calc ∏ x ∈ S', f x
        ≤ ∏ x ∈ S.erase d ∪ {d'}, f x := Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset hS'
      _ = (∏ x ∈ S.erase d, f x) * f d' := by
          rw [Finset.prod_union (Finset.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr
            (fun h ↦ hd'S (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h))), Finset.prod_singleton]
      _ < (∏ x ∈ S.erase d, f x) * f d := mul_lt_mul_right hlt _
      _ = ∏ x ∈ S, f x := Finset.prod_erase_mul S f hd_mem

name: prod_lt_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_lt_prod [MulLeftStrictMono M] (hle : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) (hlt : ∃ i ∈ s, f i < g i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i < ∏ i ∈ s, g i

name: prod_lt_prod_of_nonempty
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
theorem prod_lt_prod_of_nonempty [MulLeftStrictMono M] (hs : s.Nonempty)
  (hlt : ∀ i ∈ s, f i < g i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i < ∏ i ∈ s, g i

name: prod_lt_prod_of_subset
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_lt_prod_of_subset [MulLeftStrictMono M] (h : s ⊆ t) {i : ι} (ht : i ∈ t)
  (hs : i ∉ s) (hlt : 1 < f i)
    (hle : ∀ j ∈ t, j ∉ s → 1 ≤ f j) : ∏ j ∈ s, f j < ∏ j ∈ t, f j
proof:
:= by
  classical calc
    ∏ j ∈ s, f j < ∏ j ∈ insert i s, f j := by
      rw [prod_insert hs]
      exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_left' (∏ j ∈ s, f j) hlt
    _ ≤ ∏ j ∈ t, f j := by
      apply prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
      · simp [Finset.insert_subset_iff, h, ht]
      · intro x hx h'x
        simp only [mem_insert, not_or] at h'x
        exact hle x hx h'x.2

name: single_lt_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem single_lt_prod [MulLeftStrictMono M] {i j : ι} (hij : j ≠ i) (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s)
    (hlt : 1 < f j) (hle : ∀ k ∈ s, k ≠ i → 1 ≤ f k) : f i < ∏ k ∈ s, f k
proof:
:=
  calc
    f i = ∏ k ∈ {i}, f k := by rw [prod_singleton]
    _ < ∏ k ∈ s, f k :=
      prod_lt_prod_of_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 hi) hj (mt mem_singleton.1 hij) hlt
        fun k hks hki ↦ hle k hks (mt mem_singleton.2 hki)

statement:

theorem one_lt_prod [MulLeftStrictMono M] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 < f i) (hs : s.Nonempty) :

theorem prod_lt_one [MulLeftStrictMono M] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i < 1) (hs : s.Nonempty) :

statement:

theorem one_lt_prod' [MulLeftStrictMono M] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ f i) (hs : ∃ i ∈ s, 1 < f i) :

name: prod_lt_one'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_lt_one' [MulLeftStrictMono M] (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 1) (hs : ∃ i ∈ s, f i < 1) :

name: prod_eq_prod_iff_of_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_prod_iff_of_le {ι M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M]
  [IsOrderedCancelMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {f g : ι → M} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) :
    ((∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, g i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = g i
proof:
:= by
  classical
    revert h
    refine Finset.induction_on s (fun _ ↦ ⟨fun _ _ h ↦ False.elim (Finset.notMem_empty _ h),
      fun _ ↦ rfl⟩) fun a s ha ih H ↦ ?_
    specialize ih fun i ↦ H i ∘ Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.forall_mem_insert, ← ih]
    exact
      mul_eq_mul_iff_eq_and_eq (H a (s.mem_insert_self a))
        (Finset.prod_le_prod fun i ↦ H i ∘ Finset.mem_insert_of_mem)

name: prod_sdiff_le_prod_sdiff
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma prod_sdiff_le_prod_sdiff [DecidableEq ι] :
    ∏ i ∈ s \ t, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i ↔ ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_le_mul_iff_right, ← prod_union (disjoint_sdiff_inter _ _), sdiff_union_inter,
    ← prod_union, inter_comm, sdiff_union_inter]
  simpa only [inter_comm] using disjoint_sdiff_inter t s

name: prod_sdiff_lt_prod_sdiff
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma prod_sdiff_lt_prod_sdiff {ι M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M]
  [IsOrderedCancelMonoid M] [DecidableEq ι] {s t : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} :
    ∏ i ∈ s \ t, f i < ∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i ↔ ∏ i ∈ s, f i < ∏ i ∈ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_right, ← prod_union (disjoint_sdiff_inter _ _), sdiff_union_inter,
    ← prod_union, inter_comm, sdiff_union_inter]
  simpa only [inter_comm] using disjoint_sdiff_inter t s

name: exists_lt_of_prod_lt
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem exists_lt_of_prod_lt [IsOrderedMonoid M] (Hlt : ∏ i ∈ s, f i < ∏ i ∈ s, g i) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, f i < g i
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! Hlt with Hle
  exact prod_le_prod Hle

name: exists_one_lt_of_prod_one_of_exists_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive exists_pos_of_sum_zero_of_exists_nonzero]
theorem exists_one_lt_of_prod_one_of_exists_ne_one [IsOrderedMonoid M] (f : ι → M)
    (h₁ : ∏ i ∈ s, f i = 1) (h₂ : ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 1) : ∃ i ∈ s, 1 < f i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have : ¬ ∃ x ∈ s, f x < 1 := by simp [← prod_lt_one_iff_of_le_one h, h₁]
  grind

name: exists_lt_one_of_prod_one_of_exists_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive exists_neg_of_sum_zero_of_exists_nonzero]
theorem exists_lt_one_of_prod_one_of_exists_ne_one [IsOrderedMonoid M] (f : ι → M)
    (h₁ : ∏ i ∈ s, f i = 1) (h₂ : ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 1) : ∃ i ∈ s, f i < 1

name: exists_le_of_prod_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem exists_le_of_prod_le (hs : s.Nonempty) (Hle : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, g i) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! Hle with Hlt
  exact prod_lt_prod_of_nonempty hs Hlt

name: apply_sup_le_sum
statement:
theorem apply_sup_le_sum [SemilatticeSup α] [OrderBot α]
    [AddCommMonoid β] [Preorder β] [AddLeftMono β]
    {f : α → β} (zero : f ⊥ = 0) (ih : ∀ {s t}, f (s ⊔ t) ≤ f s + f t)
    {s : ι → α} (t : Finset ι) :
    f (t.sup s) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, f (s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine t.induction_on zero.le fun i t it h ↦ ?_
  simpa only [sup_insert, Finset.sum_insert it] using ih.trans (by gcongr)

name: apply_union_le_sum
statement:
theorem apply_union_le_sum [AddCommMonoid β] [Preorder β] [AddLeftMono β]
    {f : Set α → β} (zero : f ∅ = 0) (ih : ∀ {s t}, f (s ∪ t) ≤ f s + f t)
    {s : ι → Set α} (t : Finset ι) :
    f (⋃ i ∈ t, s i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, f (s i)
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion t s ▸ t.apply_sup_le_sum zero (by simpa)

name: sum_le_one_iff
statement:
theorem sum_le_one_iff {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℕ} :
    ∑ x ∈ s, f x ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ x y, x ∈ s → y ∈ s → f x ≠ 0 → f y ≠ 0 → x = y ∧ f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h x y hsx hsy hfx hfy ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · replace h := (sum_mono_set f (show {x, y} ⊆ s by grind)).trans h
    grind
  · by_cases! hx : ∃ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0
    · obtain ⟨x, hsx, hfx⟩ := hx
      have hs : ∀ y ∈ s \ {x}, f y = 0 := by grind
      simp [← sum_sdiff (singleton_subset_iff.2 hsx), sum_congr rfl hs, (h x x hsx hsx hfx hfx).2]
    · simp [sum_congr rfl hx]

name: prod_mono
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := mono)]
theorem prod_mono : Monotone fun f : ι → M ↦ ∏ i, f i
proof:
:= fun _ _ hfg ↦
  Finset.prod_le_prod fun x _ ↦ hfg x

name: prod_eq_one_iff_of_one_le

lemma prod_eq_one_iff_of_one_le {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [CommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M]

name: prod_strictMono
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_strictMono : StrictMono fun f : ι → M ↦ ∏ x, f x
proof:

  let ⟨hle, i, hlt⟩ := Pi.lt_def.mp hfg

statement:

lemma one_lt_prod (hf : 1 < f) : 1 < ∏ i, f i
proof:

name: finsetSum_eq_sup_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem finsetSum_eq_sup_iff_disjoint [DecidableEq α] {i : Finset β} {f : β → Multiset α} :
    i.sum f = i.sup f ↔ ∀ x ∈ i, ∀ y ∈ i, x ≠ y → Disjoint (f x) (f y)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, IsEmpty.forall_iff, imp_true_iff, Finset.sum_empty,
      Finset.sup_empty, bot_eq_zero]
  | cons z i hz hr =>
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_cons hz, Finset.sup_cons, Finset.mem_cons, Multiset.sup_eq_union,
      forall_eq_or_imp, Ne, not_true_eq_false, IsEmpty.forall_iff, true_and,
      imp_and, forall_and, ← hr, @eq_comm _ z]
    have := fun x (H : x ∈ i) => ne_of_mem_of_not_mem H hz
    simp +contextual only [this, not_false_iff, true_imp_iff]
    simp_rw [← disjoint_finsetSum_left, ← disjoint_finsetSum_right, disjoint_comm, ← and_assoc,
      and_self_iff]
    exact add_eq_union_left_of_le (Finset.sup_le fun x hx => le_sum_of_mem (mem_map_of_mem f hx))

name: sup_powerset_len
statement:
theorem sup_powerset_len [DecidableEq α] (x : Multiset α) :
    (Finset.sup (Finset.range (card x + 1)) fun k => x.powersetCard k) = x.powerset
proof:
:= by
  convert bind_powerset_len x
  rw [Multiset.bind, Multiset.join, ← Finset.range_val, ← Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
  exact
    Eq.symm (finsetSum_eq_sup_iff_disjoint.mpr fun _ _ _ _ h => pairwise_disjoint_powersetCard x h)

name: card_le_card_toFinset_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem card_le_card_toFinset_add_one_iff [DecidableEq α] {m : Multiset α} :
    m.card ≤ m.toFinset.card + 1 ↔
      ∀ x y, 1 < m.count x → 1 < m.count y → x = y ∧ m.count x = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← m.toFinset_sum_count_eq, m.toFinset.card_eq_sum_ones, ← tsub_le_iff_left,
    ← Finset.sum_tsub_distrib _ (by simp [one_le_count_iff_mem]), Finset.sum_le_one_iff]
  simp only [← pos_iff_ne_zero, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt, mem_toFinset, Nat.pred_eq_succ_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h x y hx hy ↦ h x y (one_le_count_iff_mem.mp hx.le)
    (one_le_count_iff_mem.mp hy.le) hx hy, fun h x y _ _ hx hy ↦ h x y hx hy⟩

name: one_le_prod_of_one_le

@[to_additive sum_nonneg]
lemma one_le_prod_of_one_le [MulLeftMono α] : (∀ x ∈ s, (1 : α) ≤ x) → 1 ≤ s.prod

name: single_le_prod

name: all_one_of_le_one_le_of_prod_eq_one

    (∀ x ∈ s, (1 : α) ≤ x) → s.prod = 1 → ∀ x ∈ s, x = (1 : α)
proof:

  Quotient.inductionOn s (by

name: le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred
statement:
@[to_additive le_sum_of_subadditive_on_pred]
lemma le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred (f : α → β)
    (p : α → Prop) (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1) (hp_one : p 1)
    (h_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) (hp_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b))
    (s : Multiset α) (hps : ∀ a, a ∈ s → p a) : f s.prod ≤ (s.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h l => simp [l.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred f p h_one hp_one h_mul hp_mul (by simpa)]

proof:

lemma le_prod_nonempty_of_submultiplicative_on_pred (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop)

    (s : Multiset α) (hs_nonempty : s ≠ ∅) (hs : ∀ a, a ∈ s → p a) : f s.prod ≤ (s.map f).prod
proof:

      (by simpa using hs_nonempty) (by simpa)]

lemma prod_lt_prod (hle : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) (hlt : ∃ i ∈ s, f i < g i) :

proof:
:= by

lemma prod_prod_Ioi_mul_eq_prod_prod_off_diag (f : α → α → M) :

proof:

  refine prod_nbij' (fun i ↦ ⟨i.2, i.1⟩) (fun i ↦ ⟨i.2, i.1⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp

name: prod_eq_prod_range_sdiff
statement:
@[to_additive /
equal to `∑_{i ∈ s₀} gᵢ` + `∑_{j < n, i ∈ sⱼ₊₁ \ sⱼ} gᵢ`.-/]
lemma prod_eq_prod_range_sdiff
    {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [CommMonoid β] (s : ℕ → Finset α) (hs : Monotone s)
    (g : α → β) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s n, g i = (∏ i ∈ s 0, g i) * ∏ i ∈ range n, ∏ j ∈ s (i + 1) \ s i, g j
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hs.partialSups_eq, ← disjiUnion_Iic_disjointed, Iic_eq_Icc,
    prod_disjiUnion, Nat.bot_eq_zero, ← Nat.range_succ_eq_Icc_zero, prod_range_succ', mul_comm]
  congrm (∏ x ∈ ?_, g x) * ∏ k ∈ range n, ∏ x ∈ s (k + 1) \ ?_, g x
  · simp
  · change (Iic k).sup (s ∘ id) = s k
    rw [← apply_sup_eq_sup_comp_of_nonempty hs nonempty_Iic, sup_Iic]

name: prod_map_le_prod_map
statement:
theorem prod_map_le_prod_map₀ {ι : Type*} {s : List ι} (f : ι → R) (g : ι → R)

proof:

name: prod_map_lt_prod_map
statement:
theorem prod_map_lt_prod_map {ι : Type*} {s : List ι} (hs : s ≠ [])
    (f : ι → R) (g : ι → R) (h0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < f i) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i < g i) :
    (map f s).prod < (map g s).prod
proof:
:= by
  match s with
  | [] => contradiction
  | a :: s =>
    simp only [map_cons, prod_cons]
    have := posMulStrictMono_iff_mulPosStrictMono.1 ‹PosMulStrictMono R›
    apply mul_lt_mul
    · apply h
      simp
    · apply prod_map_le_prod_map₀
      · intro i hi
        apply le_of_lt
        apply h0
        simp [hi]
      · intro i hi
        apply le_of_lt
        apply h
        simp [hi]
    · apply prod_pos
      grind
    · apply le_of_lt ((h0 _ _).trans (h _ _)) <;> simp

name: prod_le_prod

lemma prod_le_prod₀ (h0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i) :

name: le_prod_max_one
statement:
lemma le_prod_max_one {M : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [LinearOrder M] [ZeroLEOneClass M]
    [PosMulMono M] {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) (f : ι → M) :
    f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, max (f i) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases lt_or_ge (f i) 0 with hf | hf
  · exact (hf.trans_le <| prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ le_sup_of_le_right zero_le_one).le
  have : f i = ∏ j ∈ s, if i = j then f i else 1 := by
    rw [prod_eq_single_of_mem i hi fun _ _ _ ↦ by grind]
    simp
  exact this ▸ prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ ↦ by grind [zero_le_one]) fun _ _ ↦ by grind

name: prod_mono_of_subset_of_one_le
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma prod_mono_of_subset_of_one_le₀ (h : s ⊆ t) (hf₀ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hfg : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → 1 ≤ g i) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, g i
proof:
:= by
  have := posMulMono_iff_mulPosMono.1 ‹PosMulMono R›
  classical
  calc
      ∏ i ∈ s, f i
    _ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, g i := by gcongr with i hi; exacts [hf₀, hfg i hi]
    _ ≤ (∏ i ∈ t \ s, g i) * ∏ i ∈ s, g i :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (prod_nonneg fun i hi ↦ (hf₀ i hi).trans (hfg i hi)) <|
        one_le_prod₀ <| by simpa only [mem_sdiff, and_imp]
    _ = ∏ i ∈ t \ s ∪ s, g i := (prod_union sdiff_disjoint).symm
    _ = ∏ i ∈ t, g i := by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]

name: prod_mono_of_subset_of_le_one
statement:
lemma prod_mono_of_subset_of_le_one₀ (h : s ⊆ t) (hg₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ g i) (hgf : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ≤ f i)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → g i ≤ 1) :
    ∏ i ∈ t, g i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= by
  have := posMulMono_iff_mulPosMono.1 ‹PosMulMono R›
  classical
  calc
    ∏ i ∈ t, g i
    _ = ∏ i ∈ t \ s ∪ s, g i := by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]
    _ = (∏ i ∈ t \ s, g i) * ∏ i ∈ s, g i := prod_union sdiff_disjoint
    _ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, g i :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_left (prod_nonneg (by grind)) (prod_le_one₀ (by grind) (by grind))
    _ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i := by gcongr with i hi; exacts [fun i hi ↦ hg₀ _ <| h hi, hgf i hi]

name: prod_le_prod_of_injOn
statement:
theorem prod_le_prod_of_injOn₀ {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    {g : α → R} {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset α} (e : ι → α) (he : Set.InjOn e s)
    (ht : image e s ⊆ t) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g (e i))

name: prod_lt_prod
statement:
lemma prod_lt_prod₀ (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < f i) (hfg : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i)
    (hlt : ∃ i ∈ s, f i < g i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i < ∏ i ∈ s, g i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hilt⟩ := hlt
  rw [← insert_erase hi, prod_insert (notMem_erase _ _), prod_insert (notMem_erase _ _)]
  have := posMulStrictMono_iff_mulPosStrictMono.1 ‹PosMulStrictMono R›
  refine mul_lt_mul_of_pos_of_nonneg' hilt ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact prod_le_prod₀ (fun j hj => (hf j (mem_of_mem_erase hj)).le)
      (fun _ hj ↦ hfg _ <| mem_of_mem_erase hj)
  · exact prod_pos fun j hj => hf j (mem_of_mem_erase hj)
  · exact (hf i hi).le.trans hilt.le

name: prod_add_prod_le
statement:
lemma prod_add_prod_le {i : ι} {f g h : ι → R} (hi : i ∈ s) (h2i : g i + h i ≤ f i)
    (hgf : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → g j ≤ f j) (hhf : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → h j ≤ f j) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i)
    (hh : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ h i) : ((∏ i ∈ s, g i) + ∏ i ∈ s, h i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i
proof:

  refine le_trans ?_ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2i ?_)
  · rw [right_distrib]
    gcongr with j hj <;> aesop

name: le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : M → R)
    (p : M → Prop) (h_nonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a) (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1)
    (h_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) (hp_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b))
    (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M) (hps : ∀ a, a ∈ s → p (g a)) :
    f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (Multiset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg f p h_nonneg h_one
    h_mul hp_mul _ ?_) (by simp [Multiset.map_map])
  intro _ ha
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp ha
  exact hps i hi

    f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)

    (hhf : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → h j ≤ f j) : ((∏ i ∈ s, g i) + ∏ i ∈ s, h i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i

name: sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul
statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [ExistsAddOfLE R]
    (s : Finset ι) {r f g : ι → R} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i)
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, r i ^ 2 ≤ f i * g i) : (∑ i ∈ s, r i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := (sum_nonneg hg).eq_or_lt'
  · have ht' : ∑ i ∈ s, r i = 0 := sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ by
      simpa [(sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hg).1 h i hi] using ht i hi
    rw [h, ht']
    simp
  · refine le_of_mul_le_mul_of_pos_left
      (le_of_add_le_add_left (a := (∑ i ∈ s, g i) * (∑ i ∈ s, r i) ^ 2) ?_) h
    calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, 2 * r i * (∑ j ∈ s, g j) * (∑ j ∈ s, r j) := by
          simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_sum, ← sum_mul]; ring
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i * (∑ j ∈ s, g j) ^ 2 + g i * (∑ j ∈ s, r j) ^ 2) := by
          gcongr with i hi
          have ht : (r i * (∑ j ∈ s, g j) * (∑ j ∈ s, r j)) ^ 2 ≤
              (f i * (∑ j ∈ s, g j) ^ 2) * (g i * (∑ j ∈ s, r j) ^ 2) := by
            grw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← mul_pow, mul_assoc, mul_pow, ht i hi]
            exact sq_nonneg _
          refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ (two_mul_le_add_of_sq_le_mul
            (mul_nonneg (hf i hi) (sq_nonneg _)) (mul_nonneg (hg i hi) (sq_nonneg _)) ht)
          repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by simp_rw [sum_add_distrib, ← sum_mul]; ring

name: sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_eq_mul
statement:
@[deprecated sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul (since := "2026-05-12")]
lemma sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_eq_mul [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [ExistsAddOfLE R]
    (s : Finset ι) {r f g : ι → R} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i)
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, r i ^ 2 = f i * g i) : (∑ i ∈ s, r i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i
proof:
:=
  sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul s hf hg (fun i hi => (ht i hi).le)

name: sq_sum_div_le_sum_sq_div
statement:
theorem sq_sum_div_le_sum_sq_div [Semifield R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → R) {g : ι → R} (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < g i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ 2 / ∑ i ∈ s, g i ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2 / g i
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i := fun i hi ↦ (hg i hi).le
  have H : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i ^ 2 / g i := fun i hi ↦ div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hg' i hi)
  refine div_le_of_le_mul₀ (sum_nonneg hg') (sum_nonneg H)
    (sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _ H hg' fun i hi ↦ ?_)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀]
  exact (hg i hi).ne'

name: Multiset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem Multiset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop)
    (h0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a) (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1) (h_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b)
    (hp_mul : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (a * b)) (s : Multiset α) (hps : ∀ a, a ∈ s → p a) :
    f s.prod ≤ (s.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  revert s
  refine Multiset.induction (by simp [h_one]) ?_
  intro a s hs hpsa
  by_cases hs0 : s = ∅
  · simp [hs0]
  · have hps : ∀ x, x ∈ s → p x := fun x hx ↦ hpsa x (mem_cons_of_mem hx)
    have hp_prod : p s.prod := prod_induction_nonempty p hp_mul hs0 hps
    rw [prod_cons, map_cons, prod_cons]
    exact (h_mul a s.prod (hpsa a (mem_cons_self a s)) hp_prod).trans
      (by gcongr; exacts [h0 _, hs hps])

name: Multiset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem Multiset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_of_nonneg (f : α → β) (h0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a)
    (h_one : f 1 ≤ 1) (h_mul : ∀ a b, f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) (s : Multiset α) :
    f s.prod ≤ (s.map f).prod
proof:
:=
  le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg f (fun _ ↦ True) h0 h_one
    (fun x y _ _ ↦ h_mul x y) (by simp) s (by simp)

name: Multiset.mem_le_prod_of_one_le
statement:
lemma Multiset.mem_le_prod_of_one_le [ZeroLEOneClass β] {f : α → β} (h1 : ∀ a : α, 1 ≤ f a)
    {s : Multiset α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ s) : f a ≤ (s.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_mem ha
  rw [map_cons, prod_cons]
  calc f a = f a * 1 := (mul_one (f a)).symm
    _ ≤ f a * (s'.map f).prod := by
      gcongr
      · exact le_trans (zero_le_one' β) (h1 a)
      · simp_all [one_le_prod]

  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le (mem_Ici.mp h)

name: pairwise_disjoint_Ioc_mul_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pairwise_disjoint_Ioc_mul_zpow :
    Pairwise (Disjoint on fun n : ℤ => Ioc (a * b ^ n) (a * b ^ (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  simp +unfoldPartialApp only [Function.onFun]
  simp_rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
  intro m n hmn x hx
  apply hmn
  have hb : 1 < b := by
    have : a * b ^ m < a * b ^ (m + 1) := hx.1.1.trans_le hx.1.2
    rwa [mul_lt_mul_iff_left, ← mul_one (b ^ m), zpow_add_one, mul_lt_mul_iff_left] at this
  have i1 := hx.1.1.trans_le hx.2.2
  have i2 := hx.2.1.trans_le hx.1.2
  rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_left, zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right hb, Int.lt_add_one_iff] at i1 i2
  exact le_antisymm i1 i2

  simp_rw [Set.disjoint_iff]

    have : a * b ^ m < a * b ^ (m + 1) := hx.1.1.trans_lt hx.1.2
    rwa [mul_lt_mul_iff_left, ← mul_one (b ^ m), zpow_add_one, mul_lt_mul_iff_left] at this
  have i1 := hx.1.1.trans_lt hx.2.2
  have i2 := hx.2.1.trans_lt hx.1.2
  rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_left, zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right hb, Int.lt_add_one_iff] at i1 i2

name: sum_le_sum_Ioc
statement:
lemma sum_le_sum_Ioc {s : Finset ℤ} {c : ℤ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, x ≤ ∑ x ∈ Ioc (c - #s) c, x
proof:
:= by
  set r := Ioc (c - #s) c
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ s ∩ r, x + #(s \ r) • (c - #s) := by
      rw [← sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff s r _]
      gcongr
      apply sum_le_card_nsmul
      grind
    _ = ∑ x ∈ r ∩ s, x + #(r \ s) • (c - #s) := by
      rw [inter_comm, card_sdiff_comm]
      rw [Int.card_Ioc, sub_sub_cancel, Int.toNat_natCast]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [← sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff r s _]
      gcongr
      refine card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ _ fun x mx ↦ ?_
      rw [mem_sdiff, mem_Ioc] at mx; exact mx.1.1.le

name: sum_le_sum_range
statement:
lemma sum_le_sum_range {s : Finset ℤ} {c : ℤ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, x ≤ ∑ n ∈ range #s, (c - n)
proof:
:= by
  convert! sum_le_sum_Ioc hs
  refine sum_nbij (c - ·) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
  · intro x mx; rw [mem_Ioc]; rw [mem_range] at mx; lia
  · intro x mx y my (h : c - x = c - y); lia
  · intro x mx; simp_rw [coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio]
    rw [mem_coe, mem_Ioc] at mx
    use (c - x).toNat; grind

name: sum_Ico_le_sum
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_le_sum {s : Finset ℤ} {c : ℤ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, c ≤ x) :
    ∑ x ∈ Ico c (c + #s), x ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, x
proof:
:= by
  set r := Ico c (c + #s)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ r ∩ s, x + #(r \ s) • (c + #s) := by
      grw [← sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff r s, ← sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ fun x mx ↦ ?_]
      rw [mem_sdiff, mem_Ico] at mx; exact mx.1.2.le
    _ = ∑ x ∈ s ∩ r, x + #(s \ r) • (c + #s) := by
      rw [inter_comm, card_sdiff_comm]
      rw [Int.card_Ico, add_sub_cancel_left, Int.toNat_natCast]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      grw [← sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff s r, card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ _ fun x mx ↦ ?_]
      grind

name: sum_range_le_sum
statement:
lemma sum_range_le_sum {s : Finset ℤ} {c : ℤ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, c ≤ x) :
    ∑ n ∈ range #s, (c + n) ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, x
proof:
:= by
  convert! sum_Ico_le_sum hs
  refine sum_nbij (c + ·) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
  · intro x mx; rw [mem_Ico]; rw [mem_range] at mx; lia
  · intro x mx y my (h : c + x = c + y); lia
  · intro x mx; simp_rw [coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio]
    rw [mem_coe, mem_Ico] at mx
    use (x - c).toNat; grind

name: abs_ediv_le_abs
statement: theorem abs_ediv_le_abs : ∀ a b : ℤ, |a / b| ≤ |a|
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ), |a / n| ≤ |a| from fun a b =>
    match b, Int.eq_nat_or_neg b with
    | _, ⟨n, Or.inl rfl⟩ => this _ _
    | _, ⟨n, Or.inr rfl⟩ => by rw [Int.ediv_neg, abs_neg]; apply this
  fun a n => by
  rw [abs_eq_natAbs, abs_eq_natAbs];
  exact ofNat_le_ofNat_of_le
    (match a, n with
      | (m : ℕ), n => Nat.div_le_self _ _
      | -[m+1], 0 => Nat.zero_le _
      | -[m+1], n + 1 => Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.div_le_self _ _))

name: mabs_div_sup_mul_mabs_div_inf
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mabs_div_sup_mul_mabs_div_inf (a b c : α) :
    |(a ⊔ c) / (b ⊔ c)|ₘ * |(a ⊓ c) / (b ⊓ c)|ₘ = |a / b|ₘ
proof:
:= by
  let : DistribLattice α := CommGroup.toDistribLattice α
  calc
    |(a ⊔ c) / (b ⊔ c)|ₘ * |(a ⊓ c) / (b ⊓ c)|ₘ =
        (b ⊔ c ⊔ (a ⊔ c)) / ((b ⊔ c) ⊓ (a ⊔ c)) * |(a ⊓ c) / (b ⊓ c)|ₘ := by
        rw [sup_div_inf_eq_mabs_div]
    _ = (b ⊔ c ⊔ (a ⊔ c)) / ((b ⊔ c) ⊓ (a ⊔ c)) * ((b ⊓ c ⊔ a ⊓ c) / (b ⊓ c ⊓ (a ⊓ c))) := by
        rw [sup_div_inf_eq_mabs_div (b ⊓ c) (a ⊓ c)]
    _ = (b ⊔ a ⊔ c) / (b ⊓ a ⊔ c) * (((b ⊔ a) ⊓ c) / (b ⊓ a ⊓ c)) := by
        rw [← sup_inf_right, ← inf_sup_right, sup_assoc, sup_comm c (a ⊔ c), sup_right_idem,
          sup_assoc, inf_assoc, inf_comm c (a ⊓ c), inf_right_idem, inf_assoc]
    _ = (b ⊔ a ⊔ c) * ((b ⊔ a) ⊓ c) / ((b ⊓ a ⊔ c) * (b ⊓ a ⊓ c)) := by rw [div_mul_div_comm]
    _ = (b ⊔ a) * c / ((b ⊓ a) * c) := by
        rw [mul_comm, inf_mul_sup, mul_comm (b ⊓ a ⊔ c), inf_mul_sup]
    _ = (b ⊔ a) / (b ⊓ a) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ = |a / b|ₘ := by rw [sup_div_inf_eq_mabs_div]

statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    dsimp
    constructor <;> gcongr
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

name: Icc_mul_Icc
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, preimage_mul_const_uIcc (inv_ne_zero ha), inv_inv]

name: preimage_const_mul_Ioi_or_Iio
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨aU, (haU | haU)⟩ := hU <;>
  simp only [hV, haU, mem_ofPred_eq] <;>
  use a⁻¹ * aU <;>
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hb with (hb | hb)
  · right; rw [Set.preimage_const_mul_Ioi_of_neg _ hb, div_eq_inv_mul]
  · left; rw [Set.preimage_const_mul_Ioi₀ _ hb, div_eq_inv_mul]
  · left; rw [Set.preimage_const_mul_Iio_of_neg _ hb, div_eq_inv_mul]
  · right; rw [Set.preimage_const_mul_Iio₀ _ hb, div_eq_inv_mul]

name: image_mul_const_uIcc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_mul_const_uIcc (a b c : α) : (· * a) '' [[b, c]] = [[b * a, c * a]]
proof:
:=
  if ha : a = 0 then by simp [ha]
  else calc
    (fun x => x * a) '' [[b, c]] = (· * a⁻¹) ⁻¹' [[b, c]] :=
      (Units.mk0 a ha).mulRight.image_eq_preimage_symm _
    _ = (fun x => x / a) ⁻¹' [[b, c]] := by simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ = [[b * a, c * a]] := preimage_div_const_uIcc ha _ _

  exact ⟨b * d, by simp [← mul_assoc, hd]⟩

name: isCauSeq_iff_lift
statement:
theorem isCauSeq_iff_lift {f : ℕ → ℚ} : IsCauSeq abs f ↔ IsCauSeq abs fun i => (f i : ℝ) where
  mp H ε ε0
proof:
:=
    let ⟨δ, δ0, δε⟩ := exists_pos_rat_lt ε0
    (H _ δ0).imp fun i hi j ij => by dsimp; exact lt_trans (mod_cast hi _ ij) δε
  mpr H ε ε0 :=
    (H _ (Rat.cast_pos.2 ε0)).imp fun i hi j ij => by dsimp at hi; exact mod_cast hi _ ij

name: of_near
statement:
theorem of_near (f : ℕ → ℚ) (x : ℝ) (h : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, |(f j : ℝ) - x| < ε) :
    ∃ h', Real.mk ⟨f, h'⟩ = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨isCauSeq_iff_lift.2 (CauSeq.of_near _ (const abs x) h),
    sub_eq_zero.1 <|
      abs_eq_zero.1 <|
        (eq_of_le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense (abs_nonneg _)) fun _ε ε0 =>
          mk_near_of_forall_near <| (h _ ε0).imp fun _i h j ij => le_of_lt (h j ij)⟩

name: exists_isLUB
statement: theorem exists_isLUB (hne : s.Nonempty) (hbdd : BddAbove s) : ∃ x, IsLUB s x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hne, hbdd with ⟨⟨L, hL⟩, ⟨U, hU⟩⟩
  have : ∀ d : ℕ, BddAbove { m : ℤ | ∃ y ∈ s, (m : ℝ) ≤ y * d } := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_int_gt U
    refine fun d => ⟨k * d, fun z h => ?_⟩
    rcases h with ⟨y, yS, hy⟩
    refine Int.cast_le.1 (hy.trans ?_)
    push_cast
    gcongr
    exact (hU yS).trans hk.le
  choose f hf using fun d : ℕ =>
    Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd (this d) ⟨⌊L * d⌋, L, hL, Int.floor_le _⟩
  have hf₁ : ∀ n > 0, ∃ y ∈ s, ((f n / n : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ y := fun n n0 =>
    let ⟨y, yS, hy⟩ := (hf n).1
    ⟨y, yS, by simpa using (div_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.2 n0 : (_ : ℝ) < _)).2 hy⟩
  have hf₂ : ∀ n > 0, ∀ y ∈ s, (y - ((n : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) < (f n / n : ℚ) := by
    intro n n0 y yS
    have := (Int.sub_one_lt_floor _).trans_le (Int.cast_le.2 <| (hf n).2 _ ⟨y, yS, Int.floor_le _⟩)
    simp only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, Rat.cast_natCast, gt_iff_lt]
    rwa [lt_div_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.2 n0 : (_ : ℝ) < _), sub_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀]
    exact (Nat.cast_pos.2 n0).ne'
  have hg : IsCauSeq abs (fun n => f n / n : ℕ → ℚ) := by
    intro ε ε0
    suffices ∀ j ≥ ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊, ∀ k ≥ ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊, (f j / j - f k / k : ℚ) < ε by
      refine ⟨_, fun j ij => abs_lt.2 ⟨?_, this _ ij _ le_rfl⟩⟩
      rw [neg_lt, neg_sub]
      exact this _ le_rfl _ ij
    intro j ij k ik
    replace ij := le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) (Nat.cast_le.2 ij)
    replace ik := le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) (Nat.cast_le.2 ik)
    have j0 := Nat.cast_pos.1 ((inv_pos.2 ε0).trans_le ij)
    have k0 := Nat.cast_pos.1 ((inv_pos.2 ε0).trans_le ik)
    rcases hf₁ _ j0 with ⟨y, yS, hy⟩
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ((Rat.cast_lt (K := ℝ)).1 ?_) ((inv_le_comm₀ ε0 (Nat.cast_pos.2 k0)).1 ik)
    simpa using sub_lt_iff_lt_add'.2 (lt_of_le_of_lt hy <| sub_lt_iff_lt_add.1 <| hf₂ _ k0 _ yS)
  let g : CauSeq ℚ abs := ⟨fun n => f n / n, hg⟩
  refine ⟨mk g, ⟨fun x xS => ?_, fun y h => ?_⟩⟩
  · refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun z xz => ?_
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_nat_gt (x - z)⁻¹
    refine le_mk_of_forall_le ⟨K, fun n nK => ?_⟩
    replace xz := sub_pos.2 xz
    replace hK := hK.le.trans (Nat.cast_le.2 nK)
    have n0 : 0 < n := Nat.cast_pos.1 ((inv_pos.2 xz).trans_le hK)
    refine le_trans ?_ (hf₂ _ n0 _ xS).le
    rwa [le_sub_comm, inv_le_comm₀ (Nat.cast_pos.2 n0 : (_ : ℝ) < _) xz]
  · exact
      mk_le_of_forall_le
        ⟨1, fun n n1 =>
          let ⟨x, xS, hx⟩ := hf₁ _ n1
          le_trans hx (h xS)⟩

name: exists_isGLB
statement: theorem exists_isGLB (hne : s.Nonempty) (hbdd : BddBelow s) : ∃ x, IsGLB s x

proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_forall_pos_lt_add]
  constructor <;> intro H ε ε_pos
  · exact exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h' (H ε ε_pos)

proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_forall_pos_lt_add]
  refine ⟨fun H ε ε_neg => ?_, fun H ε ε_pos => ?_⟩
  · exact exists_lt_of_lt_csSup h' (lt_sub_iff_add_lt.mp (H _ (neg_pos.mpr ε_neg)))
  · rcases H _ (neg_lt_zero.mpr ε_pos) with ⟨x, x_in, hx⟩
    exact sub_lt_iff_lt_add.mp (lt_csSup_of_lt h x_in hx)

@[simp]
theorem sSup_neg (s : Set ℝ) : sSup (-s) = -sInf s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty; · simp

name: cauSeq_converges
statement: theorem cauSeq_converges (f : CauSeq ℝ abs) : ∃ x, f ≈ const abs x
proof:
:= by
  let s := {x : ℝ | const abs x < f}
  have lb : ∃ x, x ∈ s := exists_lt f
  have ub' : ∀ x, f < const abs x → ∀ y ∈ s, y ≤ x := fun x h y yS =>
    le_of_lt <| const_lt.1 <| CauSeq.lt_trans yS h
  have ub : ∃ x, ∀ y ∈ s, y ≤ x := (exists_gt f).imp ub'
  refine ⟨sSup s, ((lt_total _ _).resolve_left fun h => ?_).resolve_right fun h => ?_⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨ε, ε0, i, ih⟩
    refine (csSup_le lb (ub' _ ?_)).not_gt (sub_lt_self _ (half_pos ε0))
    refine ⟨_, half_pos ε0, i, fun j ij => ?_⟩
    rw [sub_apply, const_apply, sub_right_comm, le_sub_iff_add_le, add_halves]
    exact ih _ ij
  · rcases h with ⟨ε, ε0, i, ih⟩
    refine (le_csSup ub ?_).not_gt ((lt_add_iff_pos_left _).2 (half_pos ε0))
    refine ⟨_, half_pos ε0, i, fun j ij => ?_⟩
    rw [sub_apply, const_apply, add_comm, ← sub_sub, le_sub_iff_add_le, add_halves]
    exact ih _ ij

name: iInf_Ioi_eq_iInf_rat_gt
statement:
theorem iInf_Ioi_eq_iInf_rat_gt {f : ℝ → ℝ} (x : ℝ) (hf : BddBelow (f '' Ioi x))
    (hf_mono : Monotone f) : ⨅ r : Ioi x, f r = ⨅ q : { q' : ℚ // x < q' }, f q
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have : Nonempty { r' : ℚ // x < ↑r' } := by
      obtain ⟨r, hrx⟩ := exists_rat_gt x
      exact ⟨⟨r, hrx⟩⟩
    refine le_ciInf fun r => ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hxy, hyr⟩ := exists_rat_btwn r.prop
    refine ciInf_set_le hf (hxy.trans ?_)
    exact_mod_cast hyr
  · refine le_ciInf fun q => ?_
    have hq := q.prop
    rw [mem_Ioi] at hq
    obtain ⟨y, hxy, hyq⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hq
    refine (ciInf_le ?_ ?_).trans ?_
    · refine ⟨hf.some, fun z => ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
      suffices hfu : f u ∈ f '' Ioi x from hf.choose_spec hfu
      exact ⟨u, u.prop, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨y, hxy⟩
    · refine hf_mono (le_trans ?_ hyq.le)
      norm_cast

name: exists_natCast_add_one_lt_pow_of_one_lt
statement: lemma exists_natCast_add_one_lt_pow_of_one_lt (ha : 1 < a) : ∃ m : ℕ, (m + 1 : ℝ) < a ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, posk, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ 1 / k + 1 < a := by
    contrapose! ha
    refine le_of_forall_lt_rat_imp_le ?_
    intro q hq
    refine (ha q.den (by positivity)).trans ?_
    rw [← le_sub_iff_add_le, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity), sub_mul, one_mul]
    norm_cast at hq ⊢
    rw [← q.num_div_den, one_lt_div (by positivity)] at hq
    rw [q.mul_den_eq_num]
    norm_cast at hq ⊢
    lia
  use 2 * k ^ 2
  calc
    ((2 * k ^ 2 : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * k) := mod_cast Nat.two_mul_sq_add_one_le_two_pow_two_mul _
    _ = (1 / k * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) := by simp [posk.ne']; norm_num
    _ ≤ ((1 / k + 1) ^ k : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) := by gcongr; exact mul_add_one_le_add_one_pow (by simp) _
    _ = (1 / k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k ^ 2) := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_left_comm, sq]
    _ < a ^ (2 * k ^ 2) := by gcongr

name: pow_le_pow_mul_of_sq_le_mul
statement:
lemma pow_le_pow_mul_of_sq_le_mul [MulLeftMono M] {a b : M} (hab : a ^ 2 ≤ b * a) :
    ∀ {n}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n ≤ b ^ (n - 1) * a
  | 1, _ => by simp
  | n + 2, _ => by
    calc
      a ^ (n + 2) = a ^ (n + 1) * a
proof:
:= by rw [pow_succ]
      _ ≤ b ^ n * a * a := by grw [pow_le_pow_mul_of_sq_le_mul hab (by lia)]; simp
      _ = b ^ n * a ^ 2 := by rw [mul_assoc, sq]
      _ ≤ b ^ n * (b * a) := by grw [hab]
      _ = b ^ (n + 1) * a := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]

  | 1, _ => by simpa
  | Nat.succ <| Nat.succ n, _ => by
    simpa only [pow_succ] using (hf.pow_const n.succ_ne_zero).mul' hf

name: mul_le_mul_iff_of_ge
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma mul_le_mul_iff_of_ge [MulLeftStrictMono α]
    [MulRightStrictMono α] {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : α} (ha : a₁ ≤ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≤ b₂) :
    a₂ * b₂ ≤ a₁ * b₁ ↔ a₁ = a₂ ∧ b₁ = b₂
proof:
:= by
  have := mulLeftMono_of_mulLeftStrictMono α
  have := mulRightMono_of_mulRightStrictMono α
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩
  simp only [eq_iff_le_not_lt, ha, hb, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun ha ↦ h.not_gt ?_, fun hb ↦ h.not_gt ?_⟩
  exacts [mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le ha hb, mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt ha hb]

proof:

  have := mulLeftMono_of_mulLeftStrictMono α
  have := mulRightMono_of_mulRightStrictMono α
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, eq_true (mul_le_mul' hac hbd), true_and, mul_le_mul_iff_of_ge hac hbd]

name: mul_left_inj_of_comparable
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mul_left_inj_of_comparable [MulRightStrictMono α] (h : b ≤ c ∨ c ≤ b) :
    c * a = b * a ↔ c = b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h' => ?_, (· ▸ rfl)⟩
  contrapose h'
  obtain h | h := h
  · exact mul_lt_mul_left (h.lt_of_ne' h') a |>.ne'
  · exact mul_lt_mul_left (h.lt_of_ne h') a |>.ne

name: mul_right_inj_of_comparable
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mul_right_inj_of_comparable [MulLeftStrictMono α] (h : b ≤ c ∨ c ≤ b) :
    a * c = a * b ↔ c = b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h' => ?_, (· ▸ rfl)⟩
  contrapose h'
  obtain h | h := h
  · exact mul_lt_mul_right (h.lt_of_ne' h') a |>.ne'
  · exact mul_lt_mul_right (h.lt_of_ne h') a |>.ne

name: trichotomy_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem trichotomy_of_mul_eq_mul [MulLeftStrictMono α] [MulRightStrictMono α]
    (h : a * b = c * d) : (a = c ∧ b = d) ∨ a < c ∨ b < d
proof:
:= by
  obtain hac | rfl | hca := lt_trichotomy a c
  · grind
  · left; simpa using mul_right_inj_of_comparable (le_total d b) |>.1 h
  · obtain hbd | rfl | hdb := lt_trichotomy b d
    · grind
    · exact False.elim <| ne_of_lt (mul_lt_mul_left hca b) h.symm
    · exact False.elim <| ne_of_lt (mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hca hdb) h.symm

statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mul_eq_one_iff_of_one_le [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α] (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    a * b = 1 ↔ a = 1 ∧ b = 1
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (fun hab : a * b = 1 =>
      have : a ≤ 1 := hab ▸ le_mul_of_le_of_one_le le_rfl hb
      have : a = 1 := le_antisymm this ha
      have : b ≤ 1 := hab ▸ le_mul_of_one_le_of_le ha le_rfl
      have : b = 1 := le_antisymm this hb
      And.intro ‹a = 1› ‹b = 1›)
    (by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rw [mul_one])

statement: theorem exists_square_le [MulLeftStrictMono α] (a : α) : ∃ b : α, b * b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : a < 1
  · use a
    have : a * a < a * 1 := mul_lt_mul_right h a
    rw [mul_one] at this
    exact le_of_lt this
  · use 1
    rwa [mul_one]

statement:

theorem Group.covariant_iff_contravariant [Group N] :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h a b c bc ↦ ?_, fun h a b c bc ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← inv_mul_cancel_left a b, ← inv_mul_cancel_left a c]
    exact h a⁻¹ bc
  · rw [← inv_mul_cancel_left a b, ← inv_mul_cancel_left a c] at bc
    exact h a⁻¹ bc

statement:
theorem contravariant_le_iff_contravariant_lt_and_eq [PartialOrder N] :
    Contravariant M N μ (· ≤ ·) ↔ Contravariant M N μ (· < ·) ∧ Contravariant M N μ (· = ·)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun a b c bc ↦ ?_, fun a b c bc ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ fun a b c bc ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact (h a bc.le).lt_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact lt_irrefl _ bc)
  · exact (h a bc.le).antisymm (h a bc.ge)
  · exact bc.lt_or_eq.elim (fun bc ↦ (h.1 a bc).le) (fun bc ↦ (h.2 a bc).le)

name: exists_one_le_mul_of_le
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma exists_one_le_mul_of_le [MulLeftReflectLE α] (h : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ c, 1 ≤ c ∧ a * c = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := exists_mul_of_le h; exact ⟨c, one_le_of_le_mul_right h, rfl⟩

name: exists_one_lt_mul_of_lt'
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma exists_one_lt_mul_of_lt' [MulLeftReflectLT α] (h : a < b) :
    ∃ c, 1 < c ∧ a * c = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := exists_mul_of_le h.le; exact ⟨c, one_lt_of_lt_mul_right h, rfl⟩

name: le_iff_exists_one_le_mul
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma le_iff_exists_one_le_mul [MulLeftMono α]
    [MulLeftReflectLE α] : a ≤ b ↔ ∃ c, 1 ≤ c ∧ a * c = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_one_le_mul_of_le, by rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right' hc⟩

name: lt_iff_exists_one_lt_mul
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma lt_iff_exists_one_lt_mul [MulLeftStrictMono α]
    [MulLeftReflectLT α] : a < b ↔ ∃ c, 1 < c ∧ a * c = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_one_lt_mul_of_lt', by rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩; exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_right' _ hc⟩

name: le_of_forall_one_lt_le_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem le_of_forall_one_lt_le_mul (h : ∀ ε : α, 1 < ε → a ≤ b * ε) : a ≤ b
proof:
:=
  le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense fun x hxb => by
    obtain ⟨ε, rfl⟩ := exists_mul_of_le hxb.le
    exact h _ (one_lt_of_lt_mul_right hxb)

name: le_of_forall_one_lt_lt_mul'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem le_of_forall_one_lt_lt_mul' (h : ∀ ε : α, 1 < ε → a < b * ε) : a ≤ b
proof:
:=
  le_of_forall_one_lt_le_mul fun ε hε => (h ε hε).le

name: le_iff_forall_one_lt_le_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem le_iff_forall_one_lt_le_mul [MulLeftStrictMono α] :
    a ≤ b ↔ ∀ ε, 1 < ε → a ≤ b * ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hε ↦ lt_mul_of_le_of_one_lt h hε |>.le, le_of_forall_one_lt_le_mul⟩
